[1]
atha granthakartuḥ praśastiḥ
pādaprāntaviniḥsṛtasyusarito devasya lakṣmīpater
vyaktāmbhoruhasaṃbhavā trijagatībandhyā jayanti dvijāḥ |
rāgadveṣamadādidoṣavirahād antasphurajjyotiṣām
teṣām eva śiromaṇir vijayate viśvābhidhāno muniḥ || 1 ||
gotre tasya babhūva nirmalaguṇaśreṇībhṛtām agraṇīr
vidyācāravivekavikaramanidhiḥ nīvāsudevaḥ kṛtau |
yatkīrtyā dhavalīkṛte tribhuvane śrīkaṇṭhavaikuṇṭhayoḥ
kailāsācaladugdhasindhuviṣaye naśīn nivāso gṛhe || 2 ||
nānādānaprīṇitaprāṇiloko
[2] lokālokaprāntaviśrāntakīrtiḥ |
tasmād āsīn nāmataḥ kāmadevaḥ
puṇyācārair mūrtimān dharma eva || 3 ||
vimalaguṇamaṇīnām ākaraḥ kāmadevā
dabhavad atulatejā nāma hemādrisūriḥ |
sakalakalikalaṅkātaṅkapaṅkāpahārī
surasarita ivaughaḥ śārṅgapāṇeḥ padāñjāt || 4 ||
purāpi yat puṇyam agaṇyarūpam
śrīkāmadevena kṛtaṃ tu vidmaḥ |
yenādaridrāṃ jagatīṃ vidhātum
hemādrir apy asya gṛhe ‘vatīrṇaḥ || 5 ||
caritaṃ tasya hemādrer adbhutaṃ kena varṇyate |
upaiti prārthito yasya santānaḥ kalpavṛkṣatām || 6 ||
dṛṣṭvaiva bhāvīti yaśāṃsi yasya
jagattrayī maṇḍalapaṇḍitāni |
tathāvidhaṃ śilpam analpam indor
dhātā vidhātuṃ śithilādaro ‘bhūt || 7 ||
asau visīmā mahimā himādrim
hemādrisūrer adharī karoti |
dūrād agamyaṃ mṛgalocanānām
yenājaḍaṃ mānasam eva dhatte || 8 ||
kalākalāpaṃ sakalaṃ bibharti
gavāṃ sahasrāṇi sadā dadāti |
[3] jagatprasiddhadvijarājabhāvas
tathāpi yas tārakatāṃ dadhāti || 9 ||
vidhvastā khila vairiṇaḥ kila mahādevasya pṛthvīpater
ājyakṣīrasamudravardhanaśaśī hemādisūriḥ paraḥ |
yena śrīkaraṇādhipatyapadavīm āsādya vidyām api
nyastā śrīś ca sarasvatī ca viduṣāṃ geheṣu deheṣu ca || 10 ||
jijñāsām iha kurvate katipaye dharmasya tebhyo pare
jānanty eva samastaśāstraracanād asmābhir evaṃ punaḥ |
niḥśeṣair abhidhīyate kṣititale hemādrisūreḥ paro
jātuṃ vā carituṃ kṣamo na hi purā bhūto na bhāvī puraḥ || 11 ||
sa saṃprati nirālokalokaśāṅkāpanuttaye |
vidadhāti caturvargacintāmaṇim udāradhīḥ || 12 ||
yaṃ pūrvaṃ cārucintāmaṇim amitaguṇaṃ mandrādriḥ samudram
nirmathya prāyaśo ‘yaṃ vitarati bahuśaḥ prārthanād artham eva |
saṃpraty ālocya sarvasmṛtinigamapurāṇetihāsāmburāśīn
hemādirḥ spardhayaiva prakaṭayati caturvargacintāmaṇiṃ saḥ || 13 ||
rundhānamandhāni tamāṃsi dūre vicintya cintāmaṇim etam eva |
manorathānāṃ paripūraṇāya nānyatra santaḥ śramam ācarantu || 14 ||
ananyamanasā so ‘yaṃ cintāmaṇir upāsitaḥ |
vidadhātu sadāśeṣam anīṣitakalāni vaḥ || 15 ||
khaṇḍāni cāsmin vratadānatīrtha-
mokṣābhidhāni kramaśo bhavanti |
[4] yat pañcamaṃ tat pariśeṣakhaṇḍam
akhaṇdito yatra vibhāti dharmaḥ || 16 ||
dharmo jayaty abhyudayaikahetur
yasya prakārān ṣaḍ udāharanti |
avāntarān ekaviśeṣayogād
anye ‘pi yasmin bahavo bhavanti || 17 ||
amuṣya bhedān akhilān pravaktum
vācaspater apy asamarthabhāvaḥ |
mahānubhāvā munayo ‘pi śāstre
tad ekadeśaṃ pratipādayanti || 18 ||
teneha hemādrisudhīḥ svaśāstre
sādhāraṇaṃ dharmaviśeṣam āha |
kalābhilāṣan abhilāṣabhedāt
kāmyaṃ ca nityaṃ ca yam āmananti || 19 ||
yad āha hārītaḥ |
kāmyair etaiḥ kriyamāṇais tapobhiḥ
svargāl lokāt punar āyānti janma
kāmair muktāḥ satyalokāḥ sa yajñās
taponiṣṭhān akṣayān yānti lokān || iti || 20 ||
atha ke te dharmasya ṣaṭ prakārāḥ katamaś cāsāv asmin śāstre pratipādayiṣyamāṇaḥ sādhāraṇākhyo dharmaviśeṣa ity ucyate | tatra dharma ity anuvṛttau bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[5] varṇadharmaḥ smṛtas tv eka āśramāṇām ataḥ param |
varṇāśramas tṛtīyas tu gauṇī naimittikas tathā ||
varṇatvam ekam āśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate |
varṇadharmaḥ sa uktas tu yathopanayanaṃ nṛpa ||
āśramaṃ ca samāśritya (?) yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate |
sa khalv āśramadharmas tu bhikṣādaṇḍādiko yathā ||
varṇatvam āśramataṃ ca yo ‘dhikṛtya pravartate |
sa varṇāśramadharmas tu syān mauñjī mekhalā yathā ||
yo guṇena pravarteta guṇadharmaḥ sa ucyate |
yathāmūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ paripālanam ||
nimittam ekam āśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate |
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhir yathā ||
varṇatvamekam āśriyeti ekaśabdo vakṣyamānobhayanimittavyāvṛttiparaḥ, vakṣamāṇadharmasya varṇadharmatvāt ayaṃ tv āśramatvam anapekṣya varṇatvanimittako ‘taḥ satyām apy upanayanasyāṣṭavarṣatvādyapekṣāyāṃ naikaśabdavirodha iti | atha vā vīpsāyām ekaśabdaḥ tataś caikaikaṃ varṇatvam uddiśya yo vidhīyate sa varṇadharma iti ata evāṣṭavarṣādivākyair anekavarṇatvoddeśena vidhīyamānam upanayanaṃ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtam | nimittam ekam āśrityety atra prāyaścittasya nityakāmyavaidharmyamātreṇa naimittikatvaṃ na tu rāhudarśananimittasnānādivad akaraṇajanitadoṣaparihārārthatayā niṣiddhakarmakṛtādharma-parihārārthatayaiva tadvidhā[6]nopapatteḥ na ca jāteṣṭivad ubhayārthatvam, tatra phalanimittayor ubhayīrūpāt tattvān na tv iha tatheti |
sādhāraṇadharmas tu mahābhārate |
śrāddhakarma tapaś caiva satyam akrodha eva ca |
sveṣu dāreṣu saṃtoṣaḥ śaucaṃ nityānasūyitā |
ātmajñānaṃ titikṣā ca dharmaḥ sādhāraṇo nṛpa ||
cāturvarṇyasyeti śeṣaḥ | tapaś cāndrāyaṇādi | yad āha devalaḥ |
vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ śarīrottāpanaṃ nṛpa |
vrataśabdo ‘tra snānadānajapahomapūjopavāsādiparaḥ, etena vratakhaṇḍapratipādyānāṃ dharmāṇām api sādhāraṇatvaṃ sūcitam, ātmajñānam ity anena mokṣakhaṇḍapratipādyānām api dharmāṇāṃ sādhāraṇatvam, na cāpi śūdrādhikaraṇanyāyena śūdrāṇāṃ vidyāyām anadhikāra iti kathaṃ mokṣadharmāṇāṃ sādhāraṇatvam iti vācyam | teṣām upanayanābhāvenādhyayanāsaṃ-bhavād vedavākyavicāra evānadhikāraḥ | na punar avaidike śrāvayec caturo varṇān iti śūdrāṇām api pañcayajñādivat purāṇsmṛtipratipādyavidyopadeśadarśanāt |
nanu tathāpi kathaṃ vedāntavākyavicārajanitajñānābhāve śūdrāṇāṃ mokṣadharmādhikāra iti cet, maivam | mokṣasādhanasya jñānasya tadekasādhanatvasiddheḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ: “tarati śokam ātmavid brahmaveda (vid?) brahmaiva [7] bhavati brahmavid āpnoti paraṃ vidyayāmṛtatvam aśṇute” iti mokṣasyātmajñānasādhyatāṃ vadati | ātmajñānasya ca purāṇādivacananicayavicāraparicayād apy upapatteḥ śrītavya ityādi vākyānāṃ tu vicāraniyamavidhitvānaṅgīkārāt aṅgīkāre vā, tasya dvijātiniyatatayā śrāvayec caturo varṇān ityādpurāṇavacanaviṣayavidher apy adhyayanavidhivad vicāraparyantatās tu | tataś ca yathā dravyasādhyatvāviśeṣe ‘pi kratūnāṃ tattadvarṇavihitopāyaniyamārjitadravyāsādhyatvam evam ātmajñānasādhyatvāviśeṣe ‘pi mokṣasya tadupāyaviśeṣajanitajñānasādhyatvam iti sarvam anavadyam |
athā coktaṃ bhāgavate |
strīśudradvijabandhūnāṃ trayī na śrutigocarā |
iti bhāratam ākhyānaṃ muninā kṛpayā kṛtam ||
mahābhārate ‘pi |
mām upāśritya kaunteya ya ‘pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ |
striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās te ‘pi yānti parāṃ gatim ||
viṣṇuḥ |
kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śaucaṃ dānam indriyasaṃyamaḥ |
ahiṃsā guruśuśrūṣā tīrthānusaraṇaṃ dayā ||
ārjavaṃ lobhaśūnyatvaṃ devabrāhmaṇapūjanam |
anabhyasūyā ca tathā dharmaḥ sāmānya ucyate iti ||
brahmavaivarte |
vidyā dayā damaḥ śaucaṃ satyam asteyatā tapaḥ |
jitendriyatvam akrodho lajjā dharma iti smṛtaḥ ||
[8] viṣṇudharmottare |
tasya dvārāṇi yajanaṃ tapo dānaṃ dayā kṣamā |
brahmacaryaṃ tathā satyaṃ tīrthānusaraṇaṃ śubham ||
svādhyāyasevā sādhūnāṃ sahavāsaḥ surārcanam |
gurūṇāṃ caiva śuśrūṣā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam ||
indriyāṇāṃ yamaś caiva brahmacaryam amatsaram |
gaṅgāsnānaṃ śivo devo viprapūjātmacintanam |
dyānaṃ nārāyaṇasyaitat saṃkṣepād dharmalakṣaṇam ||
dānam ity anena dānakhaṇḍapratipādyānām tīrthānusaraṇam ity anenāpi tīrthakhaṇḍapratipādyānām devabrāhmaṇapūjanam ity anenāpi pariśeṣakhaṇḍapratipādyānām devatāpūjanādiharmāṇāṃ sādhāraṇatvam |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
dayā kṣamānasūyā ca śaucānāyāsammaṅgalam |
akārpaṇyam aspṛhatvaṃ sarvasādhāraṇāni ca ||
pare vā bandhuvarge vā mitre dveṣṭati vā sadā |
āpanne rakṣitavyaṃ tu dayaiṣā parikīrtitā ||
bāhye vādhyātmake caiva duḥkhe cautpātike kvacit |
na kupyati na vā hanti sā kṣamā parikīrtitā ||
na guṇān guṇino hanti stauti mandaguṇān api |
nānyadoṣeṣu ramate sānasūyā prakīrtitā ||
abhakṣyaparihāraś ca saṃsargaś cāpy aninditaiḥ |
[9] svadharmeṇa vyavasthānaṃ śaucam etat prakīrtitam ||
śarīraṃ pīḍyate yena suśubhenāpi karmaṇā |
atyantaṃ tan na kurvīta anāyāsaḥ sa ucyate ||
praśastācaraṇaṃ nityam apraśastavivarjanam |
etad dhi maṅgalaṃ proktam ṛṣibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ ||
stokād apy upakartavyam adīnenāntarātmanā |
ahany ahani yat kiṃcit akārpaṇyaṃ hi tat smṛtam ||
yathopapanne saṃtoṣaḥ kartavyo ‘tyalpavastuni |
parasya cintayaṇn arthaṃ sāspṛhā parikīrtitā ||
tad evaṃ nirūpitāḥ | ṣaṭprakārā dharmākhyāḥ | atha krameṇa pratipādyam ucyate |
prathame vratakhaṇḍe ‘sinn ādau dharmanirūpaṇam |
paribhāṣā vratānāṃ ca praśaṃsā tadanantaram ||
vratāni pratipanmukhyatithīnāṃ kramaśas tathā |
nānātithivratavrātavāratārāvratāni ca ||
tataś ca yogakaraṇasaṃkrāntivratasaṃgrahaḥ |
māseṣu nānāmāsartuvatsareṣu vratāny ataḥ ||
prakīrṇakavratānīha tataḥ śāntikapauṣṭikam || iti |
iti pratipādyasaṃgrahaḥ |
atha śrotṛpravṛttisādhanadharmanirūpaṇam | tatra bhavatīśrutiḥ |
[10] dharmo niśvasya jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā, loke dharmiṣṭhaṃ prajā upasarpanti, dharmeṇa
pāpam apanudanti dharme sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam, tasmād dharmaṃ paramaṃ vadanti |
bhaviṣtatpurāṇe |
dharmaḥ śreyaḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ śreyo ‘bhyudayalakṣaṇam ||
prathamaśreyaḥśabdenātra śreyaḥsādhanaṃ lakṣyate, śreyo ‘bhyudayalakṣaṇam iti śreyaḥśabdasyābhyudayārthatvāt | manuḥ |
vidvadbhiḥ sevitaḥ sadbhir nityam adveṣarāgibhiḥ |
hṛdayenābhyanujñāto yo dharmas taṃ nibodhata ||
adveṣarāgibhiḥ avihatarāgadveṣaśūnyaiḥ | hṛdayena nirvicikitsitatayā abhyanujñātaḥ pratipanno hṛdayābhyanujñātaḥ | āpastambaḥ |
na dharmādharmau carata āvāṃ svata iti, na devā na gandharvā na pitara ity ācakṣate, ayaṃ dharmo ayam adharma iti, yaṃ tv āryāḥ kriyamāṇaṃ praśaṃsanti sa dharmo yaṃ vigarhanti so ‘dharmaḥ |
viśvāmitraḥ |
yathārthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ hi śaṃsanty āgamavedinaḥ |
sa dharmo yaṃ vigarhanti tam adharmaṃ pracakṣate ||
bhṛguḥ |
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam |
svargādau sṛjatā sṛṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā vedarūpiṇā ||
pravṛttasaṃjñako dharmo guṇatas trividho bhavet |
[11] sātviko rājasaś caiva māmasaś ceti bhedataḥ ||
mākyabuddhyā ca yat karma mokeṣe ‘pi phalavarjitam |
kriyate dvija karmeha tat śātvikam udāhṛtam ||
mokṣāyedaṃ karomīti saṃkalpya kriyate tu yat |
tat karma rājasaṃ jñeyaṃ na sākṣān mokṣakṛd bhavet ||
kāryabuddhyanapekṣaṃ yat karmavidhyanapekṣayā |
kriyate dvijavaryeha tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||
varāhapurāṇe |
mahātapā uvāca |
athotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmasya mahatīṃ nṛpa |
māhātmyena samāyuktaṃ vistareṇa narādhipa ||
pūrvaṃ brahmāvyayaḥ śuddhaḥ parād aparasaṃjñitaḥ |
sa sisṛkṣuḥ prajās tv ādau pālanaṃ tāsu cintayan ||
tasya cintayatas tv aṅgād dakṣiṇāṅgāt sakuṇḍalaḥ |
prādur babhūva puruṣaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvovāca bhagavāṃś catuṣpādaṃ vṛṣākṛtim |
pālayemāḥ prajāḥ putra tvaṃ jyeṣṭho jagato bhava ||
ity uktaḥ sa samuttasthau catuṣpādaḥ kṛte yuge |
tretāyāṃ sa tribhiḥ pādair dvābhyāṃ vai dvāpare ‘bhavat ||
kalāv ekena pādena prajāḥ pālayate vibhuḥ |
ṣaḍbhedā brāhmaṇānāṃ sa tredhā kṣatre vyavasthitaḥ ||
dvedhā vaiśyeṣu śūdreṣu tv ekadhā jagataḥ prabhuḥ |
rasātaleṣu sarveṣu dvāpareṣu svayaṃbhuvaḥ ||
[12] catuḥśṛṅgas tripāc caiva dviśirāḥ saptahastavān |
tridhaiva baddho viprāṇāṃ mukhagaḥ pālayan prajāḥ ||
brahmavaivarte |
goṣu vipreṣu vedeṣu vahniṣv atha ca sādhuṣu |
suhṛtsu śrīnivāseṣu tathā cāsau viśeṣataḥ ||
satīṣu satyeṣu ca tathā dānaśīleṣu tiṣṭhati |
śuddhasattvamayaḥ śrīmān saptalokasamāśrayaḥ |
bhaviṣyati manuṣyeṣu nātiriktaḥ kadācana ||
atha phalato dharmanirūpaṇam |
pravṛttasaṃjñake dharme phalam abhyudayo mataḥ |
nivṛttasaṃjñake dharme pahlaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ matam ||
mahābhārate |
vidyā vittaṃ vapuḥ śauryaṃ kule janma virogitā |
saṃsārocchittihetuś ca dharmād eva prakīrtitaḥ ||
śabde sparśe ca rūpe ca rase gandhe ca bhārata |
prabhutvaṃ labhate jantur dharmād etat phalaṃ viduḥ ||
tathā |
arthasiddhiṃ parām icchan dharmam evāditaś caret |
na hi dharmād vinaiśvaryaṃ svargalokādi vā mṛtam ||
[13] dharmaṃ cintayamāno ‘pi yadi prāṇair vimucyate |
tataḥ svargam avāpnoti dharmasyaitat phalaṃ viduḥ ||
yathā dharmeṇa te satyā ye ‘dharmeṇa dhig astu tān |
dharmaṃ hi śāśvate loke na jahyād dhanakāṅkṣayā ||
ūrdhvabāhur virauty eṣa na ca kaścid vṛṇoti me |
dharmād arthaś ca kāmaś ca sa kimarthaṃ na sevyate ||
utsavād utsavaṃ yānti svargāt svargaṃ sukhāt sukham |
śraddadhānāś ca śāntāś ca dhanāḍhyāḥ śubhakāriṇaḥ ||
dharmaḥ prajñāṃ vardhayati kriyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
vṛddhaprajās tato nityaṃ puṇyam ārabhate naraḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
dharmāt sukhaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca yasmād ubhayam āpnuyāt |
tasmāt sarvaṃ parityajya vidvān dharmaṃ samācaret ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
dharmāt saṃjāyate hy artho dharmāt kāmo ‘bhijāyate |
dharmād eva paraṃ brahma tasmād dharmaṃ samāśrayet ||
āha vedavyāsaḥ |
kāmārthī lipsamānas tu dharmam evāditaś caret |
na hi dharmād ṛte kiṃcid duṣprāpam iti me matiḥ ||
nipānam iva maṇḍūkā rasapūrṇam ivāṇḍajāḥ |
śubhakarmā ca māyānti vivaśāḥ sarvasaṃpadaḥ ||
[14] skandapurāṇe |
dharmād rājyaṃ dhanaṃ saukhyam adharmād duḥkhasaṃbhavaḥ |
tasmād dharmaṃ sukhārthāya kuryāt pāpaṃ ca varjayet ||
lokadvaye ‘pi yat saukhyaṃ tad dharmāt prāpyate yataḥ |
dharmam ekam ataḥ kuryāt sarvakāmārthasiddhaye ||
yaḥ karma dharmasaṃyuktaṃ manasāpi vicintayet |
sa vardhate yathā vātaḥ śuklapakṣa ivoḍurāṭ ||
dīrghakālena tapasā sevitena tapovane |
dharmanirdhūtapāpānāṃ saṃsidhyanti manorathāḥ ||
dharmavṛddhau ca vardhante sarvabhūtāni sarvadā |
tasminn asati hīyeta tasmād dharmaṃ vivardhayet ||
manuḥ |
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmam anutiṣṭhan hi mānavaḥ |
iha kīrtim avāpnoti pretya cānuttamaṃ sukham ||
eka eva suhṛd dharmo nidhane ‘pi anuyāti yaḥ |
śarīreṇa samaṃ nāśaṃ sarvam anyad dhi gacchati ||
tasmād dharmaṃ sahāyārthaṃ nityaṃ saṃcinuyāc chanaiḥ |
dharmeṇa hi sahāyena tamas tarati dustaram ||
mahābhārate |
dharmo mātā pitā caiva dharmo bandhuḥ suhṛt tathā |
dharmo bhrātā sakhā caiva dharmaḥ svāmī paraṃtapa ||
nāsti dharmasamo bandhur nāsti dharmasamaḥ suhṛt |
nāsti dharmasamo lābho nāśti dharmasamā gatiḥ ||
[15] tasmād dharmaḥ sahāyatve sevitavyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ |
dharmaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ puṃsāṃ dharmaś caivāśrayaḥ satām |
dharmo lokāśrayaś cātaḥ pravṛttaḥ sacarācaram ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
karmaṇā manasā vācā yasmād dharmaṃ samācaret |
manuḥ |
dharma eva hato hanti dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ |
tasmād dharmo na hantavyo mā no dharmo hato ‘vadhīt ||
mahābhārate |
bāla eva cared dharmam anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ |
phalānām iva pakvānāṃ śaśvat patanatobhayam ||
na kāmān na ca saṃrambhān nodvegād dharmam utsṛjet |
dharma eva pare loka iha caivāśrayaḥ satām ||
tathā |
idaṃ ca tvām aparaṃ bravīmi
puṇyapradaṃ tāta mahāviśiṣṭam |
na jātu kāmān na bhayān na lobhād
dharmaṃ jahyāj jīvitasyāpi hetoḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
dharmād apetaṃ yat karma yady api syān mahāphalam |
na tat seveta medhāvī śuciḥ kuśatilaṃ yathā ||
sudurlabham idaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ lokam adhruvam |
na kuryād ātmanaḥ śreyas tenāsmād vañcitaś ciram ||
tṛṇapatrāgramāmyambubinduvac capale yataḥ |
jīvitaṃ vā dhanaṃ (?) viprās tasmād dharmaṃ samācaret ||
[16] mahābhārate |
ekasminn apy atikrānte divase dharmavarjite |
dasyubhir muṣitasyeva yuktam ākrandituṃ ciram ||
ajarāmaravat prājño vidyām arthaṃ ca cintayet |
gṛhīta iva keśeṣu mṛtyunā dharmam ācaret ||
yasya trivargaśūnyasya dināny āyānti yānti ca |
sa lohakārabhastreva sa sann api na jīvati ||
tasmāt sarvātmanā dharmaṃ nityam eva samācaret |
mā dharmavimukhaḥ pretya tamasy andhe patiṣyati ||
nāvasīdati ced dharmaḥ kapālenāpi jīvatā |
āḍhyo ’smīty eva mantavyaṃ dharmavittā hi sādhavaḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmād vasu cātīva cañcalam |
keśeṣv iva gṛhītas tu mṛtyunā dharmam ācaret ||
ādityapurāṇe |
mānuṣyaṃ yaḥ samāsādya svargamokṣapradāyakam |
dvayor na sādhayaty ekaṃ sa mṛtas tapyate ciram ||
yāvat svāsthaśarīratvaṃ tāvad dharmaṃ samācaret |
asvāsthaś codito nānyat kiṃcit kartuṃ samutsahet ||
viṣṇuḥ |
yuvaiva dharmam anvicched anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ |
kṛte dharme bhavet kīrtir iha pretya ca vai sukham ||
[17] yathekṣuhetor api sevitaṃ payas
tṛṇāni vallīr api ca prasiñcati |
tathā naro dharmapathena saṃcaran
sukhaṃ ca kāmāṃś ca vasūni cāśnute ||
atha pramāṇato dharmanirūpaṇam | tatra manuḥ |
vedo ‘khilo dharmamūlaṃ smṛtiśīle ca tadvidām |
ācāraś caiva sādhūnām ātmanas tuṣṭir eva ca ||
vidhir vidheyas tarkaś ca vedaṣaḍakgāni ceti | vidhir ajñātajñāpako vedabhāgaḥ | vidheyo mantraḥ | tarko mīmāṃsā | aṅgāny āha devalaḥ |
śikṣāvyākaraṇaniruktachandaḥkalpajyotīṃṣīti vedāṅgāni |
śucau tu carite śīlam ity ācārasaiva śīlatvābhidhānāt kathaṃ pṛthagupādānam | na, ācāryānuṣṭhānalakṣaṇa-kriyārūpatvād ācārasya svarūpaviśeṣatvāc chīlasya vyakta eva bhedaḥ | śucau tu carite śīlam iti śīlasya caritaviśeṣahetutvād upacāreṇa caritatvābhidānam | atha śīlaṃ kasya dharmatāṃ pramāpayati | ātmana eva puruṣaviśeṣasvabhāvo ‘nyathānupapadyamānaḥ svasya śreyaḥsādhanatāṃ bodhayati | tathā ca brāhmaṇyatetyādihārītavacane bhāvapratyayāntatayābhidhānaṃ śīlasya kriyāvyatirekitā bodhayan svabhāvatām eva jñāpayati yad āha hārītaḥ |
brahmaṇyatā, devapitṛ[18]bhaktatā, saumyatā aparopatāpitā, anaślīlatā mṛdutā, apāruṣyaṃ mitratā, priyavāditvam kāruṇyaṃ kṛtajñatā śaraṇyatā praśāṇtiś ceti trayodaśavidhaṃ śīlam, ācāre vivāhādau kaṅkaṇabandhanādyanuṣṭhānād ātmatuṣṭir atra dharmasaṃdehe vaidikasaṃskāravāsitāntaḥkaraṇānāṃ sādhūnām ekatra pakṣe manaparitoṣaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyam ātmanaḥ |
samyak saṃkalpajaḥ kāmo dharmamūlam idaṃ smṛtam ||
purāṇaṃ nyāyamīmāṃsā dharmaśāstrāṅgamiśritāḥ |
vedā sthānāni vidyānāṃ dharmasya ca caturdaśa ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
aṅgāni vedā catvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ |
dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca vidyā hy etāś caturdaśa ||
āyurvado dhanurvedo gāndharvaś ceti te trayaḥ |
arthaśāstraṃ caturthaṃ ca vidyā hy aṣṭādaśaiva tāḥ ||
dṛṣṭārthānām api catasṛṇā kvacid alaukikārthapratipādanād dharme pramāṇabhāvaḥ | śaṅkhalikhitau |
smṛtayo dharmaśāstrāṇi | teṣāṃ praṇetāro manuviṣṇuyamadakṣāṅgiraso’tri-bṛhaspatyuśanaāpastambavaśiṣṭhakātyāyanaparāśaravyāsaśaṅkhalikhita-saṃvartagautamaśātātapahārītayājñavalkyaprācetasādayaḥ |
[19] yamaḥ |
manur yamo vasiṣṭho ‘triḥ dakṣo viṣṇus tathāṅgirāḥ |
uśanā vākpatir vyāsa āpastambo ‘tha gautamaḥ ||
kātyayano nāradaś ca yājñavalkyaḥ parāśaraḥ |
saṃvartaś caiva śaṅkhaś ca hārīto likhitas tathā ||
etair yāni praṇītāni dharmaśāstrāṇi vai purā |
tāny evātipramāṇāni na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ ||
ādiśabdāś ca budhadevalasomajamadagniprajāpativiśvāmitravṛddhaśātātapapaiṭhīnasi-pitāmahabodhāyanachāgaleyajābālicyavanamarīcikaśyapāḥ | tathā hi bhavitṣyatpurāṇe |
aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu yāni vākyāni putraka |
tāny ālocya mahābāho tathā smṛtyantareṣu ca ||
manvādismṛtayo yāś ca ṣaḍviṃśat parikīrtitāḥ |
tāsāṃ vākyāni kramaśaḥ samālokya bravīmi te || iti |
manvādismṛtīnāṃ ṣaḍviṃśatvam uktam | tac cānantaroktābhir eva pūryate | yāni punar mahābhāratarāmāyaṇaviṣṇudharmaśivadharmaprabhṛtīni gṛhyapariśiṣṭāni ca tāni ca smṛtyantareṣu cety anenaivoktāni | tathā coktaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni rāmasya caritaṃ tathā |
viṣṇudharmāṇi śāstrāṇi śivadharmāś ca bhārata ||
[20] kārṣṇyaṃ ca pañcamo vedo yan mahābhārataṃ smṛtam |
saurāś ca dharmā rājendra mānavoktā mahīpate ||
jayeti nāma vai teṣāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || iti |
tad api smṛtyantareṣu caivety anenaiva parigṛhītaṃ veditavyam evaṃ yac cānyad apy avigītamahājanaparigṛhītaṃ yad api smṛtyantareṣu cety anenaiva parigṛhītaṃ veditavyam |
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
śrutismṛtivihito dharmas tasalābhe śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇam | tathā |
pāraṃparyāgato yeṣāṃ vedaḥ sa paribṛṃhaṇaḥ |
viśiṣṭā brāhmaṇā jñeyā śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ ||
purāṇalakṣaṇam ucyate | matsyapurāṇe |
sargaś ca pratisargaś ca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca |
vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni purāṇajñāḥ pracakṣate |
brāhmampādyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā ||
tathānyaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca saptamam |
āgneyam aṣṭamaṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ navamaṃ smṛtam ||
daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgam ekādaśaṃ smṛtam |
vārāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ caiva skāndaṃ caiva trayodaśam ||
[21] caturdaśaṃ vāmanaṃ ca kaurmaṃ pañcadaśaṃ smṛtam |
mātsyaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ caiva brahmāṇḍaṃ ca tataḥ param ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
anyāny upapurāṇāni munibhiḥ kathitāni tu |
ādyaṃ sanatkumāroktaṃ nārasiṃham ataḥ parm ||
tṛtīyaṃ nāndam uddiṣṭaṃ kumāreṇa tu bhāṣitam |
caturthaṃ śivadharmākhyaṃ sākṣān nandīśabhāṣītam ||
durvāsasoktam āścaryaṃ nāradoktam ataḥ param |
kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam ||
brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ caiva kāpilāhvayam eva ca |
māheśvaraṃ tahā śāmbaṃ sauraṃ sarvārthasaṃcayam ||
parāśaroktaṃ prathamaṃ tathā bāgavatadvayam |
idam aṣṭādaśa proktaṃ purāṇaṃ kaurmam uttamam ||
vedārthavittamaiḥ kāryaṃ yaḥ smṛtaṃ munibhiḥ purā |
sa jñeyaḥ paramo dharmo nānyaśāstreṣu saṃsthitaḥ ||
yā vedavāhyāḥ smṛtayo yāś ca kāś ca kudṛṣṭayaḥ |
sarvās tā niṣphalāḥ pretya tamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
pādme purāṇe yat proktaṃ narasiṃhopavarṇanam |
tatrāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ nārasiṃham ihocyate ||
[22] nandayā yatra māhātmyaṃ kārtikeyena varṇyate |
nandīpurāṇaṃ talloke nandākhyam iti kīrtyate ||
yatra sāmbaṃ puraskṛtya bhaviṣyati kathānakam |
procyate tat punar loke sāmbam eva śucivratāḥ ||
evam ādityasaṃjñaṃ ca tatraiva parigadyate ||
aṣṭādaśabhyas tu pṛthak purāṇe yat tu dṛśyate |
vijānīdhvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhās tad etebhyo vinirgatam ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
śaivaṃ yad vāyunā proktaṃ vairiñcaṃ sauram eva ca |
yad idaṃ kālikākhyaṃ yat mūlaṃ bhāagavataṃ smṛtam ||
devalaḥ |
ārṣāḥ pūrvavṛttāntāśrayāḥ pravṛttiphalā itihāsaḥ |
manuḥ |
pratyakṣam anumānaṃ ca śābdaṃ ca vividhāgamam |
trayaṃ suviditaṃ kāryaṃ dharmaśuddhim abhīpsatā ||
manuḥ |
ārṣaṃ dharmopadeśaṃ ca vedaśāstrāvirodhinā |
yas tarkeṇa tu saṃdhatte sa dharmaṃ veda netaraḥ ||
tarkeṇa mīmāṃsādinā | vyāsaḥ |
dharmaśuddhim abhīpsadbhir na vedād anyad iṣyate |
dharmasya kāraṇaṃ śuddhaṃ miśram anyat prakīrtitam ||
ataḥ sa paramo dharmo yo vedād avagamyate |
avaraḥ sa tu vijñeyo yaḥ purāṇādiṣu saṃsthitaḥ ||
etebhyo ‘pi yad anyasmāt kiṃcid dharmābhidhāyakam |
tac ca dūrataraṃ viddhi mohas tasyāśrayo mataḥ ||
[23] śaṅkhalikhitau |
rāgadveṣāgnidagdhānāṃ magnānāṃ viṣayāmbhasi |
cikitsā sarvaśāstrāṇi vyādhīnām iva bheṣajam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
sumantur uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvedaṃ mahābāho bhaviṣyat pañcalakṣaṇam |
yat śrutvā mucyate rājan puruṣo brahmahatyayā ||
yāny anekatra vai pañca kīrtitāni svayaṃbhuvā |
prathamaṃ kathyate brāhmaṃ dvitīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ smṛtam ||
tṛtīyaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ vyākhyātaṃ caturthaṃ bhāvyam ucyate |
pañcamaṃ pratibhāvyaṃ ca sarvalokeṣu pūjitam ||
hārītaḥ |
ajñānatamasāndhānāṃ bhrāmitānāṃ tu dṛṣṭibhiḥ |
dharmaśāstrapradīpo ‘yaṃ dharmo mārgānudeśakaḥ ||
śātātapaḥ |
śrutiḥ smṛtis tu viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī dve prakīrtite |
kāṇas tatraikahīnas tu dvābhyām andhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
yamapurāṇe |
[24] bahutvād iha śāstrāṇāṃ dharmamūlaṃ śrutismṛtī |
itihāsapurāṇāni tasmāt teṣu manaḥ kṛthāḥ ||
śaṅkhalikhitau |
vedā vai viprakīrṇatvād durjñeyā dharmasādhanam |
subodhāt tatsamarthā hi brahmaṇā vihitā śrutiḥ ||
śrutismṛtyuditān dharmān mānavās tān pṛthak pṛthak |
kurvataḥ prāpnuyur dharmam anyathā narake gatiḥ ||
śrautaṃ smārtaṃ kriyāvākyaṃ hetubhir yo vighātayet |
asacchāstram upāśritya sa jñeyaḥ śiṣṭaninditaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet |
bibhety alpaśrutād vedo mām ayaṃ pratariṣyati ||
dharmaśāstrāṇi vedāś ca ṣaḍaṅgāni narādhipa |
śrayo ‘rthaṃ vidhīyante narasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
śrutismṛtī dvijātīnāṃ puruṣārthaprasādhike |
itihāsapurāṇaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ dharmaniścayaḥ ||
yamaḥ |
vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ smṛtayaḥ pramāṇaṃ
dharmārthayuktaṃ vacanaṃ pramāṇam |
yasya pramāṇaṃ na bhavet pramāṇaṃ
kas tasya kuryād vacanaṃ pramāṇam ||
[25] na yasya vedā na ca dharmaśāstraṃ
na vṛddhavākyaṃ ca bhave pramāṇam |
sa dharmakāryān nihato durātmā
na so ‘pi tasyeha bhavet pramāṇam ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
śāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ pañcarātraṃ vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā |
kṛtāntaṃ pañcamaṃ viddhi brahmaṇaḥ parimārgaṇe ||
saṃsārakṣayadaḥ svargabhāvopakaraṇeṣu ca |
setur ā vaiṣṇavād dharmā sāram etat prakīrtitam ||
etāvān eva sakalo vedamārga udīritaḥ |
ābhyaḥ praśastāś caivānyāḥ śataśo ‘tha sahasraśaḥ ||
atha nimittato dharmanirūpaṇam | śaṅkhalikhitau |
tatra dharmalakṣaṇāni | deśaḥ kāla upāyo dravyaṃ śraddhā pātraṃ tyāga iti | samasteṣu dharmodayaḥ sāshāraṇo ‘nyathā viparītaḥ śraddhāpātrasaṃpanno dharmaḥ kālaḥ saṃkrāntyādiḥ śraddhā dravyotpattir iti kālas tanmūlo deśaḥ deśo brahmāvartādiḥ |
upāya iti kartavyatā, dravyaṃ svavṛttyupārjitam, śraddhā āstikyabuddhiḥ, pātraṃ vidyātrayo[pa]saṃpannam (?) | eṣu sādhāraṇadharmotpattiḥ | [26] anythā dharmānudayaḥ | śraddhādravyotpattir kāla iti ayam api saṃkrāntyādivad dānādau dharmakālaḥ | tanmūlo deśa iti | evaṃbhūtakālasaṃpanno deśo ‘pi dharmasya saṃpādayitety arthaḥ |
atha deśanirūpaṇaṃ tāvat prastūyate | tatra mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
bhagavan kathitas tv eṣa jambudvīpaḥ samāsataḥ |
yad etad bhavatā proktaṃ karma nānyatra puṇyadam ||
pāpadambā mahārāja varjayitvā tu bhāratam |
itaḥ svargaś ca mokṣaś ca madhyaś cāntaś ca gamyate ||
na khalv atra manuṣyāṇāṃ bhūmau karma vidhīyate |
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ vai dvīpo ‘yaṃ dakṣiṇottarāt ||
pūrve kirātā yasyānte paścime yavanāḥ smṛtāḥ |
dakṣiṇe malayo yasya himavān uttare tathā ||
tad etad bhārataṃ varṣaṃ sarvabījaṃ dvijottama |
brahmatvam amareśatvaṃ devatvam api durlabham ||
mṛgapakṣyauṣadhicarāyonis taddadato ‘śnute |
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām ato brahman śubhāśubhe ||
prayānti karmabhūr brahman nānyalokeṣu vidyate |
svargāpavargaprāptiś ca puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ ca vai tathā ||
[27] devānām api viprarṣe sadevaiṣa manorathaḥ |
api mānuṣyam āpsyāmo devatvāt pracyutāḥ kṣitau |
manuṣyaḥ kurute yad yat tan na śakyaṃ surāsuraiḥ ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
uttaraṃ ca samudrasya himādreś caiva dakṣiṇam |
varṣaṃ yad bhārataṃ nāma bhāratī yatra santatiḥ ||
atra janma sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrair api sattama |
kadācil labhate jantur mānuṣyaṃ puṇyasaṃcarāt ||
gāyanti devāḥ kila gītakāni
dhānyās tu ye bhāratabhūmibhāge |
svargāpavargāspadamārgabhūte
bhavanti bhūyaḥ puruṣaḥ suratvāt ||
karmāṇy asaṃkalpitatatphalāni
saṃnyasya viṣṇau paramātmarūpe |
avāpya tāṃ karmamahīm anante
tasmin layaṃ ye tv amalāḥ prayānti ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
brahmāvartāt paro deśaḥ ṛṣideśas tv anantaram |
madhyadeśas tato nyūna āryāvartas tv anantaram ||
nañ īṣadarthe anantaraḥ īṣannyūna ity arthaḥ | manuḥ |
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyor devanadyor yad antaram |
taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmāvartaṃ pracakṣate ||
[28] kurukṣetraṃ ca matsyāś ca pāñcālāḥ śūrasenikāḥ |
eṣa brahmarṣideśo vai brahmāvartād anantaraḥ |
matsyo virāṭadeśaḥ, pañcālāḥ kānyakubjādideśāḥ, śūrasenikā mathurādeśaḥ |
himavadvindhyayor madhye yat prāg vinaśanād api |
pratyag eva prayāgāc ca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
vinaśanaṃ kurukṣetram |
ā samudrāt tu vai pūrvād ā samudrāt tu paścimāt |
tayor evāntaraṃ giryor āryāvartaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
kṛṣṇasāras tu carati mṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ |
sa jñeyo yajñiyo deśo mlecchadeśas tataḥ paraḥ ||
etān dvijātayo deśān saṃśrayeran prayatnataḥ |
śūdras tu yasmin kasmin vā nivased vṛttikarṣitaḥ ||
eṣa dharmasya vo yonir samāmāt kathitaḥ kila |
sarvapāpaharaḥ puṇyaḥ sādhanaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
dharma āryāvarte prāg ādarśāt pratyag ālokācalād udak kumārikāyā dakṣiṇena himavataḥ, uttareṇa vindhādrer ye dharmā ye cācārās te sarve pratyetavyāḥ na tv anye pratilomakadharmāḥ enam āryāvartam ity ācakṣate gaṅgāyamunayor antarālam apy eke yāvad vā kṛṣṇamṛgo vicarati tāvad brahmavarcasam |
[29] paiṭhīnasiḥ |
āhimavata ākumāryāḥ sindhuvaitaraṇī nadī sūryasyodagayanaṃ punaḥ yāvad vā kṛṣṇamṛgo vicarati tatra dharmaś catuṣpādo bhavati |
saṃvartaḥ |
svabhāvād yatra carati kṛṣṇasāraḥ sadā mṛgaḥ |
dharmadeśaḥ sa vijñeyo dvijānāṃ dharmasādhanam ||
vyāsaḥ |
sarve śiloccayāḥ puṇyāḥ sāgarāḥ saritas tathā |
araṇyāni ca puṇyāni viśeṣān naimiṣaṃ tathā ||
devīpurāṇe |
deśo nadā gayā śailagaṅgānarmadapuṣkaram |
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prayāgo jambukeśvaraḥ ||
kedāraṃ bhīmanādaṃ ca kuṇḍakaṃ puṣkarāhvayam |
someśvaraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tathā cāmarakaṇṭakam ||
kāliñjaraṃ tathā vindhyaṃ yatra vāmīguhasya ca |
sarve śivāśramāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvā nadyaḥ śubhapradāḥ ||
dānasnānopavāsā vai phaladāḥ satataṃ nṛṇām ||
viṣṇuḥ |
cāturvarṇyavyavasthānaṃ yasmin deśe na divyate |
taṃ mlecchadeśaṃ jānīyād aryāvartas tataḥ param ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
ānartakāṅgamagadhāḥ surāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathaḥ |
tathā ca sindhusauvīrā ete saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ ||
[30] ānartakaḥ yasmin deśe yāskāḥ |
tathā |
padbhyāṃ sa kurute pāpaṃ yaḥ kaliṅgān prapadyate |
ṛṣayo niṣkṛtiṃ tasya prāhur naiśvānaraṃ haviḥ ||
atha śrāddhanirūpaṇam | āha bagavatīśrutiḥ |
śraddhayāgniḥ samidhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ |
śraddhā bhagsya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasītyādiḥ |
manuḥ |
śraddhāpūtaṃ vadānyasya hatam aśraddhayaitarat |
śraddhayeṣṭaṃ ca pūrtaṃ ca nityaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ ||
vahnipurāṇe |
śraddhāpūrvāḥ sarvadharmāḥ śraddhāmadhyāntasaṃsthitāḥ |
śraddhāniṣṭhāḥ pratiṣṭhāś ca dharmāḥ śraddhaiva kīrtitāḥ ||
śrutimātrarasāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvarāḥ |
śraddhāmātreṇa gṛhyante na kareṇa na cakṣuṣā ||
kāyakleśair na bahubhir na caivārthasya rāśibhiḥ |
dhamaḥ saṃprāpyate sūkṣmaḥ śraddhāhīnaiḥ surair api ||
śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā jñānaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ |
śraddhā svargaś ca mokṣaś ca śraddhā sarvam idaṃ jagat ||
[31] sarvasvaṃ jīvitaṃ vāpi dadyād aśraddhayā yadi |
nāpnuyāt sakalaṃ kiṃcit śraddadhānas tv ato bhavet ||
vyāsaḥ |
śraddhā vai sātvikī devī sūryasya duhitā nṛpa |
sāvitrī prasavitrī ca viśvasaṃjīvanī tathā ||
skandapurāṇe |
śraddhā māteva jananī jñānasya sukṛtasya ca |
tasmāc chraddhāṃ samutpādya jñānaṃ sukṛtam arjayet ||
mahābhārate |
śraddhā dharmasutā devī pāvinī viśvadhāriṇī |
śraddhayā sādhyate dharmo mahadbhir nārtharāśibhiḥ ||
niṣkiṃcanā hi munayaḥ śraddhāpūtā divaṃ gatāḥ |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śraddhā paramakāraṇam |
puṃsām aśraddadhānānāṃ na dharmo nāpi tatphalam ||
tathā kriyā śraddadhāno dātā prājño ‘nasūyakaḥ |
dharmādharmaviśeṣajñas tamas tarati dustaram ||
kālādīni tu dānakhaṇḍe vakṣyāmaḥ, teṣāṃ tatropayuktatamatvāt |
atha paribhāṣā | bhavaiṣyatpurāṇe |
samyak saṃsādhanaṃ karma kartavyam adhikāriṇā |
niṣkāmena mahāvīra kāmyaṃ kāmānvitena ca ||
[32] ācārayuktaḥ śraddhāvān vedajño ‘dhyātmavittamaḥ |
karmaṇāṃ phalam āpnoti nyāyārjitadhanaś ca yaḥ ||
samyak prathamakalpādinā, saṃsādhanaṃ yathāvihitaṃ sāddhanam | adhikāriṇā arthinā samarthena viduṣā ca | adhyātmavittamaḥ paralokaphalabhāginy ātmani dṛḍhapratyayavān | nyāyārjitadhanaḥ svavṛttyārjitadhanaḥ | āpastambaḥ |
prayojayitānumantā kartā ceti svarganarakaphaleṣu bhāginaḥ | yo bhūya ārabhate tasmin phalaviśeṣaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
vidhidṛṣṭaṃ tu yat karma karoty avidhinā tu yaḥ |
phalaṃ na kiṃcid āpnoti kleśamātraṃ hi tasya tat ||
manuḥ |
prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo ‘nukalpena vartate |
na sāmparāyikaṃ tasya durmater vidyate phalam ||
chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
akriyā trividhā proktā vidvadbhiḥ kāmacāriṇām |
akriyā ca paroktā yā tṛtīyā cāyathākriyā ||
svaśākhāśeṣam utsṛjya paraśākhāśrayaṃ ca yaḥ |
kartum icchati durmedhā moghaṃ tasya tu tat phalam ||
yan nāmnātaṃ svaśākhāyāṃ pārakyam avirodhi yat |
vidvadbhis tad anuṣṭheyam agnihotrādikarmavat ||
agnihotraṃ yajurvedaśākhāsu vihitaṃ yathā ||
[33] chandogaprabhṛtibhir anuṣṭhīyate | gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
bahv alpaṃ vā svagṛhyoktaṃ yas karma prakīrtitam |
tasya tāvati śāstrārthe kṛte sarvaḥ kṛto bhavet ||
tathā |
pravṛttam anyathā kuryād yadi mohāt kathaṃcana |
yatas tad anyathā bhūtaṃ tata eva samāpayet ||
pravṛttam ārabdham anyathā bhūtaṃ kramādyanyatvena yad vaiparītyam āpannam ||
samāpte yadi jānīyān mayaitad anyathā kṛtam |
tāvad eva punaḥ kuryān nāvṛttiḥ sarvakarmaṇaḥ ||
etat tu karmasamāptāv anyathākaraṇajñānaviṣayam |
pradhānasyākriyā yatra sāṅgaṃ tat kriyate punaḥ |
tadaṅgasyākriyāyāṃ tu nāvṛttir na ca tatkriyā ||
yatra pradhānasya karmaṇo ‘karaṇaṃ tat sāṅgam eva punaḥ kartavyam, tadaṅgākaraṇe tu na sāṅgapradhānāvṛttir nāpi tāvanmātrasyāṅgasya karaṇaṃ kiṃ tu prāyaścittam eva kāryam |
hārītaḥ |
aṅguṣṭasyottarato rekhā brahmatīrtham, kaniṣṭhakāyāḥ paścāt prājāpatyam, agram aṅgulīnāṃ daivam, aṅguṣṭhapradeśinyor antarā pitram [pitryam?], madhya āgneyam | upasparśanaṃ brāhmeṇa ācamanahomatarpaṇāni prājā[34]patyena kuryāt, mārjanārcanabalikarmabhojanāni daivena kuryāt pitrarthān pitryeṇa, pratigraham āgneyena pratigṛhṇīyāt |
chāgaleyaḥ |
hastamadhye brahmatīrthaṃ dakṣiṇāgrahaṇe tu tat |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
nāndīmukhānāṃ kurvanti prājñāḥ piṇḍodakakriyāḥ |
prājāpatyena tīrthena yac ca kiṃcit prajāyate ||
brahmapurāṇe |
mūlarekhāsu svāṅguṣṭhamaṇibandheṣu madhyamam |
prājāpatyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ vipras tenācamet sadā ||
dhanāyurdārarekhāsu somatīrthe tu madhyamam |
lājādihavanaṃ tena kartavyaṃ vapanaṃ tathā ||
vapanaṃ vrīhyādinirvāpaḥ | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
kamaṇḍalusparśanaṃ yat dadhiprāśanam eva ca |
somatīrthena rajendra sadā kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
snāto ‘dhikārī bhavati daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
pavitrāṇāṃ tathā jāpye dāne ca vidhinodite ||
vāyupurāṇe |
kriyāṃ yaḥ kurute mohād anācamyeha nāstikaḥ |
[35] bhavanti tu vṛthā tasya kriyāḥ sarvā na saṃśayaḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
dānam ācamanaṃ homaṃ bhojanaṃ devatārcanam |
prauḍhapādo na kurvīta svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ||
āsanārūḍhapādastu jānvor vāñjalayos tathā |
kṛtāvasakthiko yaḥ syāt prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyate ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
japahomopavāseṣu dhautavastradharo bhavet |
alaṃkṛtaḥ śucir maunī śraddhāvān vijitendriyaḥ ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
kāṣāyavāsāḥ kurute japahomapratigrahān |
na tad devagamaṃ bhavati havyaṃ kavyaṃ svadhā haviḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
ārdravāsās tu yaḥ kuryāj japahomapratigrahān |
sarvaṃ tad āsuraṃ jñeyaṃ bahirjānuṃ ca yat kṛtam ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
homadevārcanādyās tu kriyāsv ācamane tathā |
naikavastraḥ pravarteta dvijavacanake jape ||
dvijavācanake dvijasvastivācanādau | śātātapaḥ |
savyād aṃśāt paribhraṣṭaṃ kaṭideśasthitāmbaram |
[36] ekavastraṃ tu tad vidyād daive pitrye ca varjayet ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
paridhānād bahiḥkakṣā nibaddhā hy āsurī bhavet |
dharmakarmaṇi vidvadbhir varjanīyā prayatnataḥ ||
bahiḥkakṣā bahirnirgatakakṣety arthaḥ | chandogpariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
yatropadiśyate karma kartur aṅgaṃ na sūcyate |
dakṣiṇas tatra vijñeyaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragaḥ karaḥ ||
yatra diṅniyamo nāsti japahomādikarmasu |
tisras tatra diśaḥ proktā aindrī saumyāparājitāḥ ||
aindrī prācī, saumyā uttarā, aparājitā īśānadik |
āsīna ūrdhvaḥ prahvo vā niyamo yatra nedṛśaḥ |
tadāsīnena kartavyaṃna prahveṇa na tiṣṭhatā ||
prahvaḥ pragatajānukaḥ | praveṇa namreṇa, tiṣṭhatā ūrdhvena | oṃkāra ity anuvṛttau, āha āpastambaḥ |
tasmād om ity udāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ |
vartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinām ||
[37] trimātras tu prayoktavyaḥ karmārambheṣu sarvaśaḥ |
tisraḥ sārdhās tu kartavyā mātrās tattvārthacintakaiḥ ||
devatādhyānakāle tu plutaḥ kuryān na saṃśayaḥ ||
kaśyapaḥ |
bhūtikarmāṇy uccais tadādīny eva vākyāni syur yathā puṇyāhaṃ susamṛddham iti, bhūtikarmāṇi sampatkarāṇi tadānīti | oṃkārdīni svastyādivācanādīni ||
yamaḥ |
puṇyāhavācanaṃ devi brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate |
etad eva niroṃkāraṃ kuryāt kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
sūryodayaṃ vinā naiva snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
agner viharaṇaṃ caiva kratvabhāvaś ca lakṣyate ||
sūryodayaśabdena uṣaḥ kālo gṛhyate, tena rātrau na kuryād iti tātpartyam |
dakṣaḥ |
devakāryāṇi pūrvāhne manuṣyāṇāṃ tu madhyame |
pitṝṇām aparāhṇe ca kāryāṇīti niviścayaḥ ||
aṅgirāḥ |
saṃdhyayor ubhayor japye bhojane dantadhāvane |
pitṛkārye ca daive ca tathā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ||
gurūṇāṃ saṃnidhau dāne yāge caive viśeṣataḥ |
eṣu maunaṃ samatiṣṭhan svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syāj japādiṣu kathaṃcana |
[38] vyāhared vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smared vā viṣṇum avyayam ||
ajñānād yadi vā mohāt pracyavetādhvareṣu yat |
smaraṇād eva tad viṣṇoḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ syād iti śrutiḥ ||
tathā śapathaśrutiḥ |
atha yad vācaṃyamo vyāharati tasmād u haiṣa visṛṣṭo yajñaḥ parāṅparyāvartate | tato vaiṣṇavīm ṛcaṃ yajur vā japed ityādiḥ |
manuḥ |
na kuryāt kasyacit pīḍāṃ karmaṇā manasā girā |
ācarann abhiṣekaṃ tu karmāṇy anyāny athācaret ||
vāyupurāṇe |
dānaṃ pratigraho homo bhojanaṃ balir eva ca |
sāṅguṣṭhena sadā kāryam asurebhyo ‘nyathā bhavet ||
sāṅguṣṭhena aṅgulīsaṅgatāṅguṣṭhena |
etāny eva tu kāryāṇi dānādīni viśeṣataḥ |
antarjānu vidheyāni tadvad ācamanaṃ nṛpa ||
tadvad ācamanaṃ smṛtam | chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
sadopavītinā bhāvyaṃ sadā baddhaśikhena tu |
viśikho ‘nupavītaś ca yat karoti na tat kṛtam ||
[39] nigamapariśiṣṭe |
vāmaskandhe yajñopavītaṃ daive, prācīnāvītam, itarathā pitṛyajñe tābhyāṃ dvikaṇṭhāsaktaṃ utsarge nivītam | pṛṣṭhadeśāvalambitaṃ grāmyadharmeṣu | grāmyadharmaḥ strīsaṃbhogaḥ |
bodhāyanaḥ |
karmayukto nāber adhaḥ sparśaṃ varjayet |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
raudrapitrāsurān mantrān tathā daivābhicārikān |
vyāhṛtyālabhya cātmānam apa spṛśyānyad ācaret ||
chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
pitramantrapravaraṇe ātmalambhe avekṣaṇe |
adho vāyusamutsarge prahāsye ‘nṛtabhāṣaṇe ||
mārjāramūṣikasparśam ākruṣṭe krodhasaṃbhave |
nimitteṣv eṣu sarvatra karma kuarvann apaḥ spṛśet ||
ātmālambhe hṛdi sparśe yajñādau vihite | avekṣaṇam ap yajñādi vihitam eva grāhyam |
laghuhārītaḥ |
jape home tathā dāne svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇe |
aśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kuryāt suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥ ||
[40] darbhahīnā tu yā saṃdhyā yac ca dānaṃ vinodakam |
asaṃkhyātaṃ ca yaj japtaṃ tat sarvaṃ niṣprayojanam ||
tathā |
citau dharbhāḥ pathi dharbhāḥ ye darbhā yajñabhūmiṣu |
staraṇāsanapiṇḍeṣu ṣaṭkuśān parivarjayet ||
piṇḍārthaṃ ye kṛtā darbhā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
mūtrocchiṣṭaghṛtā ye ca teṣāṃ tyāgo vidhīyate ||
nivīmadhye ca ye darbhā brahmasūtre ca ye kṛtāḥ |
pavitrāṃs tān vijānīyād yathā kāyas tathā kuśāḥ ||
gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
darbhāḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ mantrā brāhmaṇā havir agnayaḥ |
ayātayāmāny etāni niyojyāni punaḥ punaḥ ||
marīciḥ |
māse nabhasyamāvāspā tasyāṃ darbhacayo mataḥ |
ayātayāmās te darbhā viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
chandopariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
haritā yajñiyā darbhāḥ pītakāḥ pañcayajñiyāḥ |
samūlāḥ pitṛdaivatyāḥ kalmāṣā vaiśvadevikāḥ ||
hrasvāḥ pravaraṇīyāh syuḥ kuśā dīrghāś ca barhiṣaḥ |
[41] pañcayajñiyāḥ pañcayajñārthāḥ, pravaraṇam anuṣṭhānaṃ tadarhāḥ pravaraṇīyāḥ |
anantargarbhakaṃ sāgraṃ kauśaṃ dvidalam eva ca |
prādeśamātraṃ vijñeyaṃ pavitraṃ yatra kutracit ||
tad eva darbhapiñjalyā lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam |
ājyasyotpavanārthaṃ yat tad apy etāvad eva tu ||
āpastambaḥ |
devāgāre tathā śrāddhe gavāṃ goṣṭhe tathādhvare |
saṃdhyayoś ca dvayoḥ sādhsaṃgame gurusaṃnidhau ||
agnyāgāre vivāhe tu svādhyāye bhojane tathā |
uddhared dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāpathe ||
dakṣiṇam iti savyāṃśe vastraṃ nidhāya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum uttarīyād vaheḥ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
yathoktavastvasaṃpattau grāhyaṃ tadanukāri yat |
yavanām iva godhūmā vrīhīṇām iva śālayaḥ ||
ājyaṃ dravyam anādeśe juhotiṣu vidhīyate |
mantrasya devatāyāś ca prajāpatir iti sthitiḥ ||
anādeśe avidhāne |
mantrasya devatāyāś ca anādeśe prajāpatiḥ |
devatā tatjñāpakā, mantrā samastavyāhṛtayaś ca |

anuktadravyasaṃkhyāś ca pratimādevatā nṛpa |
sauvarṇī rājatī tāmrī vṛkṣajā mārtikī tathā ||
citrajā piṣṭajā jñeyā nijavittānurūpataḥ |
āmāṣāt palaparyantaṃ kartavyāḥ śāṭhyavarjitaiḥ ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
kāṇḍamūlaparṇapuṣpaphalapraroheṣu gandhādīnāṃ sādṛśyena pratinidhiṃ kuryāt, sarvālābhe yavaḥ pratinidhir bhavati |
matirāyaṇīyapariśiṣṭe |
dakṣiṇālābhamūlānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti | na cātra yajeta darbhābhāve kāśaḥ pratinidhiḥ |athedhma pālāśāśvatthakhadiralohitaharitoumbarāṇāṃ tadalābhe sarvavanaspatīnām | bilvanīpa, nimbarājavṛkṣaśālmalūkakapittha-kovidāravibhītakaśleṣmātakasarvakaṇṭakivarjaṃ ghṛtam anyārthaṃ pratinidhis tadalābhe dadhipayo vā |
chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
pāṇyāhutir dvādaśaparvapūrikā
rasādinā ceta srucigartapūrikā |
daivena tīrthena ca hūyate haviḥ
[43] svaṅgāriṇi svarciṣi tac ca pāvake ||
yo ‘nacirṣi juhoty agnau vyaṅgāriṇi ca mānavaḥ |
mandāgnir āmayāvī ca daridraś caiva jāyate ||
tasmāt samiddhe hotavyaṃ nāsamiddhe kathaṃcana |
ārogyam icchatāyuś ca śriyam ātyantikīṃ tathā ||
juhuvāṃś ca hute caiva pāṇipūryasrucādibhiḥ |
na kuryād agnidhamanaṃ kuryāt tu vyajanādinā ||
mukhenaiva dhamed agniṃ mukhād doṣo ‘bhijāyate |
nāgniṃ mukheneti tu yat laukike yojayanti tat ||
atha gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
pṛṣadājyam iti proktaṃ dadhisarpir iti dvayam |
kṣīre śṛtoṣṇe dadhiṣu cāmikṣeti dvisaṃbhavā ||
skandapurāṇe |
tvakpatrakeśaralavaddhais tu trisamaṃ munibhiḥ smṛtam ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
ājyaṃ kṣīraṃ madhu tathā madhuratrayam ucyate |
tvakpatrakalavaṅgāni keśaraṃ ca catuḥ samam ||
garuḍapurāṇe |
[44] kastūrikāyā dvau bhāgau catvāraś candanasya ca |
kuṅkumasya trayaś caikaḥ śaśinaḥ syāc catuḥ samam ||
karpūraṃ candanaṃ darbhaḥ kuṅkumaṃ ca catuḥ samam |
sarvagandham iti proktaṃ samastasuravallabham ||
vṛddhagargaḥ |
kuṅkumaṃ candano śīraṃ mustālāmajjakeśaram |
karpūraṃ trisugandhaṃ ca sarvagandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
tvagailāpatrakais tulyais trisugandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
karpūram aguruś caiva kastūrī candanaṃ tathā |
kakkolaṃ ca bhaved ebhiḥ pañcabhir yakṣakardamaḥ ||
śivadharme |
pañcāmṛtaṃ dadhikṣīraṃ sitā madhu ghṛtaṃ nṛpa |
skandapurāṇe |
tāmrāruṇāśvetakṛṣṇānīlānām āharet gavām |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpīṃṣi ca kramāt ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
apaḥ kāñcanavarṇāyā nīlāyāś ca tathā ghṛtam |
dadhi vai kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāś caiva gomayam |
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ pañcagavye prayojayet ||
[45] skandapurāṇe |
viṣṇuḥ |
tathā vahnīndravāyvarkadaivatyāni yathā kramam |
viddhy etāni kuśodaṃ ca pitṛrājādhidaivatam ||
proktābhāve tv athaitāni kapilāyāḥ prakalpayet |
gomūtrabhāgas tasyārdhaṃ śakṛt kṣīrasya ca trayam ||
dvayaṃ dadhnor ghṛtasyaikam ekaś ca kuśavārijaḥ |
gāyatryā caiva gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam ||
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvaṇeti vai dadhi |
tejo ‘si śukram ity ājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam ||
ebhis tu pañcabhir yuktaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pracakṣate |
etad eva mahāpuṇyaṃ brahmakūrcam iti smṛtam ||
brahmakūrcalakṣaṇaṃ brahmapurāṇāt |
vyāsaḥ |
gomūtre tāmravarṇāyās tveṣamāṣakasaṃkhyayā |
puṇyaṃ varuṇadaivatyaṃ gāyatryarcābhimantritam ||
gomayaṃ śvetavarṇāyāś caturmāṣakamātrayā |
gṛhṇīyād agnidaivatyaṃ gandhadvāreti vai śanaiḥ ||
kṣīraṃ kāñcanavarṇāyāḥ somadaivatyam eva ca |
āpyāyasveti mantreṇa māṣadvādaśamaṃmitam ||
gṛhṇanti vāyudaivatyaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇodbhavaṃ dadhi |
daśamāṣakamātraṃ tu dadhikrāvṇa iti smaran ||
ghṛte tu nīlavarṇāyāḥ pañcamāṣakasaṃkhyayā |
gṛhṇanti sūryadaivatyaṃ tejo ‘sīti japan kramāt ||
[46] śatatrayaṃ māṣamānaṃ catvāriṃśac ca pañca ca |
kuśodakasya gṛhṇīyād devasya tveti kīrtayan ||
tāmrapātre palāśe vā pātre miśrīkṛtaṃ ca yat |
āpohiṣṭeti cāloḍya praṇavena pibanti ca ||
udaṅmukhas trir ācamya tato gacchet sa tad gṛham |
tatrāpi home prāg dehaṃ kṛtvā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇam ||
brāhmaṇasya yathāśaktyā śobhanaṃ tu manoharam |
gavāṃ varṇās tu śuklādyāḥ santi deśeṣu yatra na ||
tatra varṇāvibhāgena pañcagavyāni cāharet |
varṇālābhān na doṣo ‘sti mātrāhīnaṃ vivarjayet ||
tyājyāni dūṣitānāṃ ca dadhimūtrapayāṃsi ca |
prasaktānāṃ ca śukreṇa yatvajñānāṃ ca śoṇitam ||
celakeśāsthibhakṣyāṇām abhakṣyaiḥ saṃpṛcāṃ tathā |
rogārtānāṃ ca yukārtimṛtāṇḍānām amaṅgalam ||
mṛtāṇḍā mṛtagarbhāḥ |
niṣkalatvena vandhyānāṃ kṛttānāṃ kṛmibhis tathā |
amānapratidattāni sandhinīprabhavāni ca ||
śuddhabhāṇḍe manojñe ca bhūmāv patitāni ca |
grahītavyāni vividhaṃ khedaṃ tāsāṃ na kārayet ||
brahmakūrcavratam idaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ rūpārogyayaśaḥpradam ||
mahatām api pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ śrīvivardhanam |
[47] brahmapurāṇe |
aśvattodumbaraplakṣacūtanyagrodhapallavāḥ |
pañcabhaṅgā iti proktāḥ sarvakarmasu śobhanāḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
savarṇaṃ rajataṃ muktā rājāvartaṃ pravālakam |
ratnapañcakam ākhyātaṃ śeṣaṃ vastu bravīmy aham ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
muktāphalaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca vaidūryaṃ padmarāgakam |
puṣparāgaṃ ca gomadṃ nīlaṃ gārutmataṃ tathā ||
pravālamuktādīny uktāni | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
madhuro ‘mlaś ca lavaṇaṃ kaṣāyas tikta eva ca |
kaṭukaś ceti rājendra rasaṣaṭkam udāhṛtam ||
śākalakṣaṇaṃ tu kṣīrasvāminoktam |
mūlapatrakarīrāgraphalakāṇḍādhirūḍhakāḥ |
tvak puṣpaṃ kavakaṃ ceti śākaṃ daśavidhaṃ smṛtam ||
karīraḥ vaṃśāṅkuraḥ, agraṃ pallavāḥ, kāṇḍaṃ nālam, kavakaṃ chatrākam |
[48] ṣaṭtriṃśanmate ca |
yavagodhūmadhānyāni tilāḥ kaṅgus tathaiva ca |
śyāmākaṃ cīnakaṃ caiva saptadhānyam udāhṛtam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmram ārakūṭaṃ tathaiva ca |
lohaṃ trapu tathā sīsaṃ dhātavaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ ||
apaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi dadhyakṣatatilās tathā |
yavāḥ siddhārthakāś caivam argho ‘ṣṭaāṅgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
puṣpaṃ phalaṃ yavāḥ kṣīraṃ dadhi dugdhakuśās tilāḥ |
taṇḍulāś ca tilair miśrā ardho ‘ṣṭāṅgaḥ sa ucyate ||
matsyapurāṇe |
tathā dagdheṣu lokeṣu bhūr bhuvaḥ svar mahādiṣu |
saubhāgyaṃ sarvalokānām ekastham abhavat tadā ||
dyām āpnoti vasudhātalam |
utkṣiptam antarikṣasthaṃ brahmaputreṇa dhīmatā |
dakṣeṇa pītamātraṃ tu rūpalāvaṇyakārakam ||
balaṃ tejo havirjātaṃ dakṣasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
śeṣaṃ tad apatad bhūmāv aṣṭadhā tad ajāyate ||
ikṣavas tarurājaṃ ca nīṣpāvā yaji dhānyakam |
vikāro yavagokṣīraṃ kusumbhaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā ||
[49] lavaṇaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tatra saubhāgyāṣṭakam ucyate ||
vātulāgama |
ghṛtaṃ dadhi madhu kṣīraṃ tarurājaś ca dhānyakam |
ajāvī caiva niṣpāvā maṅgalāṣṭaka ucyate ||
ādityapurāṇe |
madhyāhnaḥ khaḍgapātraṃ tat tathā nepālakambalaḥ |
rūpyaṃ darbhās tilā gāvī dauhitraḥ kutapāṣṭakam ||
tathā |
dūrvā yavāṅkurāś caiva vālakaṃ cūtapallavāḥ |
haridrādvayasiddhārthaṃ śikhipatroragatvacaḥ ||
kaṅkaṇauṣadhayaś caitāḥ kautukākhyā nava smṛtāḥ ||
chandogapariśiṣṭe |
kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridre dve murāśaileyacandanam |
vacā campakamuste ca sarvauṣadhyo daśa smṛtāḥ ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
jagmur etāni bījāni grāmyāraṇyābhidhāni ca |
oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāḥ śataṃ saptadaś smṛtāḥ ||
vrīhayaś ca yavāś caiva godhūmāḥ kaṅgusarṣapāḥ |
priyaṅgavaḥ kovidārāḥ koradūṣāḥ sacīnakāḥ ||
māṣā mudgā masūrāś ca niṣpāvāḥ sakulatthakāḥ |
āḍhakyaś caṇakāś caiva grāmyāraṇyāśca ṣoḍaśam ||
[50] ity etā oṣadhīnāṃ tu grāmyāṇāṃ jātayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
oṣadhyo yajñiyā jñeyā grāmyāraṇyāś caturdaśa ||
vrīhayaś ca yavāś caiva godhūmāḥ kaṅgusarṣapāḥ |
māṣā mudgāḥ saptamāś ca aṣṭamāś ca kulatthakāḥ ||
śyāmākāś caiva nīvārā jartilāḥ sagavedhukāḥ |
kovidārasamāyuktās tathā veṇuyavāś ca ye |
grāmyāraṇyāś catā hy etā oṣadhyaś ca caturdaśa ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
aguruṃ candanaṃ mustā sihlakaṃ vṛṣaṇam tathā |
samabhāgaṃ tu kartavyaṃ dhūpo ‘yam amṛtāhvayaḥ ||
tathā |
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ granthisahitam aguruṃ sihlakaṃ tathā |
mustā tathendubhūteṣa śarkarāṃ ca dahet tryaham |
ity eṣo ‘nantadhūpaś ca kathito devasattama ||
tathā |
kṛṣṇāguruṃ sihlakaṃ ca vālakaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ tathā |
candanaṃ tagaraṃ mustā prabodhaḥ śarkarānvitaḥ ||
karpūraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭham uśīraṃ sihlakaṃ tathā ||
granthakaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bīma kuṅkumaṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā |
harītakī tathośīraṃ yakṣadhūpa udāhṛtaḥ ||
tathā|
ṣaḍbhāgakuṣṭhaṃ dviguṇo guḍasya
lākṣātrayaṃ pañcanakhasya bhāgāḥ |
harītakī sarjarasaḥ samāṃsī
bhāgaikam ekaṃ trilavaṃ śilājam ||
[51] dhanasya catvāri purasya caiko
dhūpo daśāṅgaḥ kathito munīndraiḥ ||
tathā |
vṛṣaṇaṃ sihlakaṃ vipra śrīkhaṇḍama agurūṃ tathā |
karpūraṃ ca tathā mustāṃ śarkarāṃ satvacaṃ dvija ||
ity eṣa vijayo dhūpaḥ svayaṃ devena nirmitaḥ |
karpūraṃ candanaṃ māṃsī tvak patrailālavaṅgakam ||
aguruṃ sihlakaṃ dhūpaṃ prājāpatyaṃ pracakṣate ||
atha mānakathanam | atha nāmāni | ādityapurāṇe |
jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃdṛśyate rajaḥ |
prathamaṃ tat pramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate ||
trasareṇuś ca vijñeya aṣṭau tu paramāṇavaḥ |
trasareṇavas tu te hy aṣṭau rathareṇus tu saṃmataḥ ||
rathareṇavas tu te hy aṣṭau vālāgraṃ tat smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ |
aṣṭau yūkā yavaṃ prāhur aṅgulaṃ tu yavāṣṭakam ||
dvādaśākgulamātro vai vitastiś ca prakīrtitaḥ |
aṅguṣṭhasya pradeśinyā vyāsāḥ prādeśa ucyate ||
tālaḥ smṛto madhyamayā gokarṇaś cāpy anāmayā |
kaniṣṭhayā vitastis tu dvādaśāṅgulikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ratnis tv aṅguliparvāṇi vijñeyaś caikaviṃśatiḥ |
[52] catvāri viṃśatiś caiva hastapādāṅgulāni tu ||
kiṣkuḥ smṛtocchitaḥ srisraḥ dvicatvāriṃśad aṅgulaḥ |
ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulaiś caiva dhanur daṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
dhanur daṇḍayugaṃ nālir jñeyā hy etā yavākgulaiḥ |
dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatārnalvam āhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ ||
dhanuḥ sahasre dve vāpi gavyūtir upadiśyate |
aṣṭau dhanuḥsahasrāṇi yojanaṃ tu prakīrtitam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
paramāṇuḥ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ trasareṇur mahīrajaḥ |
vālāgraṃ caiva likṣā ca yukā cātha yavāṅgulam ||
kramād aṣṭaguṇān prāhur yavāś cāṣṭa tato ‘ṅgulam |
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ padaṃ prāhur vitastir dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
dvau vitastau tato hasto brahmatīrthaṃ dviveṣṭanaiḥ |
caturhasto dhanur daṇḍo nālikā tadyugena tu ||
krośo dhanuḥsahasre dve gavyūtiś ca caturguṇā |
dviguṇaṃ yojanaṃ tasmāt proktaṃ saṃkhyānakovidaiḥ ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
daśahastena daṇḍena triṃśadaṇḍā nivartanam |
daśa tāny eva gocarma brāhmaṇēbhyo dadāti yaḥ ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
daśahastena vaṃśena daśavaṃśātmam antataḥ |
[53] pañca cāpy adhikān dadyād etad gocarma cocyate ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
yad utpannam athāśnāti naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ |
etad gocarmamātraṃ tu bhuvaḥ proktaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
daṇḍena saptahastena triṃśad daṇḍā nivartanam |
tribhāgahīnaṃ gocarmamānam āha prajāpatiḥ ||
vṛddhavaśiṣṭaḥ |
gavāṃ śataṃ vṛṣaś caiko yatra tiṣṭhed ayantritaḥ |
etad gocarmamātraṃ tu prāhur vedavido janāḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
dharmaśāstreṣu mānārthaṃ yāḥ saṃjñā munibhiḥ smṛtāḥ |
tāḥ sarvāḥ vyavahārārthaṃ boddhavyāḥ saṃpradāyataḥ ||
manuḥ |
lokasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ yāḥ saṃjñāḥ prathitā bhuvi |
tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ tāḥ pravkṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ ||
jānāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |
paraṃ tat parmāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate ||
trasareṇvaṣṭakaṃ likṣā jñeyāikā parimāṇataḥ |
tā rājasarṣapas tisras te trayo gaurasarṣapaḥ ||
[54] sarṣapāḥ ṣaṭ yo madhyaḥ triyavaṃ tv ekakṛṣṇalam |
pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa ||
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ palāni dharaṇaṃ daśa |
dve kṛṣṇale samadhṛte vijjeyo raupyamāṣakaḥ ||
te ṣoḍaśa syān dharaṇaṃ purāṇaś caiva rājataḥ |
kārṣāpaṇas tu vijñeyas tāmrikaḥ kārṣikaḥ paṇaḥ ||
dharaṇāni daśa jñeyaḥ śatamānas tu rājataḥ |

ṛju vai madhyaśṛṅgaṃ syāt kiṃcid vakraṃ tu pārśvayoḥ |

śalyaṃ vasvaṅgulānāham paraṃ vai ṣoḍaśāṅgulāt ||

anyam etat samākhyātaṃ śeṣe ‘ṣṭāṅgulavṛddhitaḥ ||
svastikaḥ śrīkajākaṃ vā sarvatoraṇam iṣṭadam |
ucchrayeṇa tadardhārdhāt toraṇānāṃ pravistaraḥ ||

khātaṃ pañcāṃśatas teṣāṃ bhūmibhāgavaśena vā ||
vedī catuṣkarā madhye koṇe stambhacatuṣṭayaṃ |
aṣṭāṅgulocchirtān yeṣāṃ karāṅguṣṭhaikavṛddhitaḥ ||
vistārād ucchrayād vāpi nāntare granthibandhanam |
pītā mahotkā devī tu liṅgāyāmadvivistarā ||
vistāraṃ navadhā kṛtvā maṇḍapānāṃ kvacin mate |
madhye padena vedī syāt kuṇḍānāṃ saiṣa vistaraḥ ||
hastād ūrdhvaṃ kvacid vedī ṣaḍaṅgulavṛddhitaḥ |
vedīpādottaraṃ tyaktvā kuṇḍāni nava pañca ca ||
vedās tāny eva tāni syur vartulāny atha vā kvacit ||

raudryāṃ bhayadam aṣṭāsram iti vṛddhiśivāgamaḥ |

tathā pratiṣṭhāsārasaṃgrahe |

āgneyyāṃ bodhipatrābhaṃ sadā santānavardhanam ||

trikoṇaṃ nairṛtāśāyāṃ māraṇārthaṃ prakalpayet ||

aṣṭakoṇam atheśānyām atyantaṃ ca bhayapradam |

khātādhike bhaved rogī hīne dhenudhanakṣayaḥ |
cakrakuṇḍe tu saṃtāpo maraṇaṃ bhinnamekhale ||

lokapālāḥ suvarṇena navamī tuhinaprabhāḥ |

saptaviṃśatibhiḥ kāṇḍo viṣṭarā bahumātrakāḥ ||
hastārdhāḥ samidhaḥ śastā iha vai cottare punaḥ |
pañcahastāḥ dvajāḥ kāryā vaipulyena dvihastakāḥ ||
saptahastāḥ patākāḥ syur viṃśatyaṅgulavistṛtāḥ |
pañcahastadhvajānāṃ tu pañcamāṃśapraveśitāḥ ||
daśahastapatākānāṃ daṇḍāḥ pañca praveśitāḥ |
sindūrāḥ karburā dhūmrā dhūsarā meghasaṃnibhāḥ ||
haritāḥ pāṇḍuvarṇāś ca śubhrāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt |
evaṃ varṇā dhvajāḥ kāryāḥ patākāḥ pākaśāsana ||
kalaśotpattikalaśalakṣaṇam | devīpurāṇe |
kalaśān sudṛḍhān kuryāl lakṣaṇāni vadāmi te |
utpattilakṣaṇaṃ mānaṃ kathayāmi yathā mune ||
vārakāḥ kalaśāś caiva yena loke prakīrtitāḥ |
amṛte mathyamāne tu sarvadevaiḥ samanvitaiḥ ||
[66] manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim |
utpannam amṛtaṃ tatra mahāvīryaparākramam ||
tasyāyaṃ dhāraṇāyaiva kalaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
kalāṃ kalāṃ gṛhītvā vai devānāṃ viśvakarmaṇā ||
nirmito ‘yaṃ surair yasmāt kalaśas tena kathyate |
vārayanti grahān yasmān mānavā vividhāṃs tathā ||
durhṛdaś ca tathādyorāṃs tena te vārakāḥ smṛtāḥ |
kalaśasya mukhe brahmā grīvāyāṃ tu maheśvaraḥ ||
mūle tu saṃsthito viṣṇur madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ |
śikhāsu devatāḥ sarvā veṣṭayanti caturdiśam ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni kalaśe nivasanti hi |
gṛhe śāntiś ca puṣṭiś ca prītir gotṛptir eva ca ||

atharvavedasahitāḥ sarve kalaśasaṃsthitāḥ ||
pūrṇāmṛtena toyena śritās tv ekāntato ghṛtāḥ |
saritsaraḥkhātajena taḍāgena jalena vā ||
vāpīkūpodadivyena sāmudreṇa sukhāvahāḥ |
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyāḥ sarvakilbiṣanāśakāḥ ||
abhiṣeke sadā grāhyāḥ kalaśā īdṛśāḥ śubhāḥ |
yātrāvivāhakāle vā pratiṣṭhā yajñakarmaṇi ||
yojanīyā viśeṣeṇa sarvakarmaprasādhakāḥ |
pañcāśāṅgulavaipulyā utsedhaḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ ||
kalaśānāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu mukham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet |

atha ṛtvigvaraṇam | tatra brahmāṇḍadānam adhikṛtyoktam padmapurāṇe |
bālāgnihotriṇaṃ vipraṃ surūpaṃ ca guṇānvitam |
sapatnīkaṃ ca saṃpūjya bhūṣayitvā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
purohitaṃ mukhyatamaṃ kṛtvānyāṃśca tathā dvijān |
caturviṃśadguṇopetān sapatnīkān nimantritān ||
ahatāmbarasaṃchannān sragviṇas tu vibhūṣitān |
aṅgulīyakāni tathā karṇaveṣṭāṃś ca dāpayet ||
evaṃ viśvāsya saṃpūjya teṣām agre svayaṃ sthitaḥ |
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
purohitāya punaḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā vai karasaṃpuṭam |
yūyaṃ vai brāhmaṇā dhātrā maitratve cānugṛhṇatā ||
saumukhyeneha bhavatāṃ bhavet pūto naraḥ svayam |
bhavatāṃ prītiyogena svayaṃ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
tulā puruṣam adhikṛtyoktam | liṅgapurāṇe |
śataniṣkādhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam |
tasyāpy ardhaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ syāt trividhaṃ tatra kalpitam ||
vastrayugmamayoṣṇīṣaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam |
aṅgulībhūṣaṇaṃ caiva maṇibandhasya bhūṣaṇam ||
[68] etāni caiva sarvāṇi prārambhe sarvakarmaṇi |
purohitāya datvātha ṛtvigbhyaḥ saṃpradāpayet ||
pūrvoktaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ soṣṇīṣaṃ vastrasaṃyutam |
dadyād etat prayoktṛbhya ācchādanapaṭaṃ budhaḥ ||
anyāṃś caturviṃśa ṛtvijaḥ |
kṛtvetivacanāt pañcaviṃśatir brāhmaṇā nimantraṇīyāḥ | te ca pratiṣṭhām adhikṛtya matsyapurāṇe bhedenoktāḥ |
śubhās tatrāṣṭa hotāro dvārapālās tathāṣṭa vai |
aṣṭau tu jāpakāḥ kāryāḥ brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ||
sarve lakṣaṇasaṃpannā mantravanto jitendriyāḥ |
kulaśīlasamāyuktāḥ jāpakāḥ syur dvijottamāḥ ||
hemālaṃkāriṇaḥ kāryāḥ pañcaviṃśatir ṛtvijaḥ |
dīkṣayec ca samaṃ sarvān ācāryo dviguṇaṃ labhet || iti |
niṣkādīn ārabhya śataṃ pañcaviṃśatir vā vastrālaṃkāram ūhyam | etat prayoktṛbhyo varaṇavākyam, oṃ adya amukayajñenāhaṃ yakṣye yadaṅgabhūtam amukakarmārtham amukagotram amukaśarmāṇam amukadevādhyāyinam amukaṃ tvām ahaṃ vṛṇomi, vṛto ‘smīti prativacanam |
karmabhedaś cokto matsyapurāṇe |
gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya dvārapālān samantataḥ |
paṭadhvam iti tān brūyād ācaryaṃ tv abhipūjayet ||
[69] yajadhvam iti tān brūyād dhotṛkān pura eva tu |
utkṛṣṭamantrajāpyena tiṣṭhadhvam iti jāpakān || iti |
prārambhe sarvakarmaṇīti liṅgapurāṇe vacanād asya sarvavratādīnāṃ ṛtviksādhyadharmasādhāraṇam |
atha madhuparkaḥ | āha jābāliḥ |

arcayen madhuparkeṇa snātakaṃ priyam eva ca ||

parisamuhyopalipyollikhyodvṛtyāgnim upasamādhāya dakṣiṇato brahmāsanam āstrīrya praṇīya paristīryārthavad āsādya pavitre kṛtvā prokṣaṇīś ca saṃskṛtyārthavat prokṣaṇīś ca saṃskṛtyārthvat prokṣaṇī nirūpyājyāv adhiśritya (?) paryāgniṃ kuryāt sruvaṃ pratapya darbhaiś ca saṃmṛjyābhyukṣya punaḥ pratapyābhyukṣya dadhyād ājyam udvāsyotthāpya utpūyāvekṣya prokṣaṇīś ca pūrvavad upayaman kuśān ādāya samidhopyādhāya paryukṣya juhuyāt | eṣa eva vidhir yatra kvacid dhomataḥ, parisamūhanaṃ mānastokety upalepanam |

abhyukṣya agnim ūrddheti agnim upasamādhāya samhidhāgniṃ devasya tveti samidham ādadhyāt, api gṛhṇāmīty agner abhyukṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyagarbher dakṣiṇato brahmā āpohiṣṭeti uttarataḥ praṇītā kayānaś citra iti praṇītāprastāraṇam | pavitrestho vaiṣṇavyau savitre dveṣṭṛnityājyanirūpaṇam | trātāram iti srucam pratapya aniśito ‘si sa patrakṣid iti saṃmārjanam | pratyuṣṭarakṣaḥ iti pratapanam | savitur vaḥ prasava utpunāmīti punaḥ pratapanam | tad evāgnir ity utpavanam | dhūsaro ‘sīti paryukṣaṇam | prajāpataye svāhā mūlahomāhutayaḥ evaṃ vaidiko ‘gniḥ saṃskṛto bhavati |
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yājñikam |
vidhānaṃ vihitaṃ tatra brahmaṇā mitatejasā ||
anyathā ye prakurvanti sūtram āśritya kevalam |
nirāśās tatra gacchanti sarve devā na saṃśayaḥ ||
athātaḥ paristaraṇadevatāḥ kathyante |
parisamūhane karapayaḥ, upalepane viśvedevāḥ, ullekhane mitrāvaruṇau, uddharaṇe pṛthivī, abhyukṣaṇe gandharvāḥ, agnyāsādane sarvaḥ, dakṣiṇāsādane brahmā, uttarataḥ praṇītāyāṃ sāgaraḥ, arthāvasādane śatakratuḥ, pavitrabandhane pitaraḥ, prokṣaṇīsaṃskāre mātaraḥ, juhusruksruve tathā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ, ājyatāpane vasavaḥ, [71] adhiśrayaṇe vaivasvataḥ, paryagnikaraṇe marutaḥ, udvāsane skandaḥ, utpavane pratyutpavane ca candrādityo, ājyāvekṣaṇe diśaḥ sarvāḥ pavitrādhāne, praṇītāyām umā devī, idhme lakṣmīḥ, viśvasya bhūtāni |
pūrvoktānāṃ tu vahnīnām ekam ādāya pāvakam |
homakarmaprakartavyaṃ vidhiṃ jñātvā mahāmune ||
etā vai devatāḥ proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vai |
yajñeṣu paśubandhi tu tathā sarvakriyāsu ca ||
brahmovāca |
vahner vidhānaṃ paramaṃ sarvakarmasukhāvaham |
kathayāmi nṛpaśreṣṭha nāmabhedakriyādibhiḥ ||
agneḥ parigrahaḥ kāryaḥ sarvaśāstrārthavedakaiḥ |
vāmadakṣiṇasiddhānte svagṛhyapāragais tathā ||

anyathā antarāyās te bhavanti dhanaāyuṣoḥ ||
nityavyādhir adhanyo vā sarvalokatiraskṛtaḥ |
aviditvā yathāvac ca tajjñaḥ sarvasukhāyate ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena agnyādheye kriyā matā |
kuṇḍāṣṭakaṃ samākhyātaṃ tribhedaṃ tu mayā tava ||
bahuvidhividhānaṃ tu ekasmai vopacārataḥ |
strībālaśūdrais tu hotavyaṃ hotavyaṃ pratyayaṃyathā ||
sabhye mahānase vāpi na kuṇḍe ca kadācana |

śrūyate ca purā vatsa aviditvā ca tat suta ||
saṃskṛtabahamānas tu rājyabhraṃśama avāpnuyāt |
tathā vāraṇihotā ca cirān mṛtyum avāptavān ||
tasmād asthiravahnau tu na hotavyam avedinā |
vedanaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yena siddhiḥ prajāyate ||
catuṣkoṇotthakuṇḍe ca maṇḍale madhusūdana |
dhanuṣākṛtike rudraḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ||
caturasre bhaved agnir maṇḍale tu hutāśanaḥ |
ardhacandre ‘nalo hy agnir agnir evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
dvijānāṃ devatāḥ sapta ācāryo yogadaivataḥ |
udako varuṇo devo darbheṣu ca mahoragāḥ ||
sruvāyāṃ tu mahādevī sruco devas trilocanaḥ |
tatsaṃyoge paraḥ sarvaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ||
praṇītā pṛthivī jñeyā svādhikāre mahāmakhāḥ |
puṇyeṣu kratavo viddhi pātreṣu ca mahodadhiḥ ||
vedīmadhye tu gayatrī sāmaskṛtyukṣaṇe sthitaḥ |
indhane maṇibhadras tu śikhāvajradharas tathā ||
hotāras tu vijānīyāt camasādiṣu parvatān |
ūṣāyāṃ devatā rudras tālavṛnte ca vāyvaḥ ||
mantreṣu caraṇe sarve bhasmabhūyo ‘pi śaṅkara |

mātaro homabhāge tu putanādisphuliṅgakāḥ |

prātarhomas tu devānāṃ praharārdhena bhūtidaḥ |

aparāhṇe pitṝṇāṃ ca saṃdhyāyāṃ cāṅgabhautikā |
rātrau pāpavināśārthaṃ divāsiddhiprasādhane ||

pratyūṣe putradaṃ vatsa gudāya sarvakāmikam ||
kṣaṇādau sarmakāryeṣu sarvaprāptipradāyakam |
kṣaṇādidevatā deyā prathamā tryavarāhutiḥ ||
anyathā viphalaṃ vipra bhavate havanaṃ tadā |

vṛṣārūḍhā jayā raktā yāmye daṇḍāsidhāriṇī |
kartarīkārdhabhṛd vāme tarjanyāsaktasikthakā ||
layā (11) |
kartarī mārjanī yāmye samye piḍanakaṅkare |
śūlaṃ ruruyutaṃ dvābhyāṃ dhatte lolā tu sāradā ||
lolā (12) ||
vāme lulāpamuṇḍaṃ ca tat pibanty asṛk raktikā |
laṅke śorasthitā laṅkā khādantī piśitaṃ dhanam ||
[95] laṅkā (13) |
triphalā śākakhoṭādāmodakāśī ca dakṣiṇe |
śoṇālaṅkeśvarī kumbhe ḍimbhābhūrvos tu bibhratī ||
laṅkeśvarī (14) |
dakṣiṇe varadaṃ cakre vāme kaṅkaṇakaṅkare |
bibhrāṇakolagā raktā lālāṛglālasā matā ||
lālasā (15) |
dvīpisthā vimalā raktā tryakṣālaṅkārabhūṣitā |
kartarīkumbhabhṛd yāmye vāme pāśakapālinī ||
vimalā (16) |
kṛṣṇā hutāśanāñjasthā jvālinī dakṣiṇe śubhā |
vāme tv abhayahastā syād viṣṭarājyaghaṭānvitā ||
hutāśanā (17) |
śūkarāsyā viśālākṣī trisandhasthāpitetarā |
ghaṇṭāvādyakarā saumye yāmye kartarikābhayā ||
viśālākṣī (18) |
huṅkārā mīnavaktrā syāt mīnagā sākṣamālinī |
muśalaṃ bibhratī vāme saumye tu phalapallavau ||
huṅkārā (19) |
aṅgābhyāṃ bibhratī vālau paryaṅke vaḍavāmukhī |
[96] samatsyakūrmabhṛd yāmye kṛṣṇā nīladharān yataḥ ||
vaḍavāmukhī (20) |
tarjanyabhayabhṛt saumye yāmye daṇḍakapālinī |
kṛṣṇā hāhāravā krūrā rāsabhasthā kharasthitā ||
hāhāravā (21) |
lulāpāsyā lulāpasthā mahākrūrā sitetarā |
vāme ‘syāḥ pāśamelāñjaṃ dakṣiṇe daṇḍalekhanī ||
mahākrūrā (22) |
asitā krodhanā yāmye khādantī māṃsamaṇḍakam |
vāme vidyujjihvā krūrā savye sīrakapālinī |
cakrasthā karṇe madiraṃ bibhratī jambukasthitā ||
krodhanā (23) |
kṛṣṇā bhayānanā gṛdhrī daṃṣṭrogrāsthivibhūṣaṇā |
yāmye syāt śikharaṃ śūlaṃ ghargharaṃ lelihānyataḥ ||
bhayānanā (24) |
triśūlapṛṣṭhabhṛd vāme muṇḍaṃ ḍamarukaṃ śavam |
bibhāṇā bhājanaṃ dvābhyāṃ sarvajñā pretagā sitā ||
sarvajñā (25) |
jānukṣiptau karau kṛtvā udyantī taralāyate |
śūlaḍamaruhastā ca godhāṅgā taralā sitā ||
[97] taralā (26) |
tārā tāraguṇair yuktā kauśikasthā sitetarā |
dhatte śavārdhake saumye śūlamudgaram anyataḥ ||
tārā (27) |
kṛṣṇā padmasthitā dakṣe jñānamudrākṣamālinī |
ṛgvedaṃ vāmato dhatte pustakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum ||
kṛṣṇā (28) |
raudrā kṛṣṇā turaṅgāsyā kabandhasthā hayānanā |
muṇḍaśūrpadharā yāmye samye saṃhārikāṅkabhṛt ||
hayānanā (29) |
chinnahastā śavākṛṣṭā sārā sthūlā jaṭādharā |
khaṭvāṅgaṃ ḍamaruṃ saumye śūlaulke bibhratī tataḥ ||
śavasthā rasasaṃgrāhī nṛtyantī jaṭilā sitā |
kuśūlān cakrakaṅkālān bibhratī carmavāsinī ||
rasasaṅgrāhī (30) |
sadevakadvijāsaktā kaniṣṭhā śabarālibhā |
vāme karopadhānāsidharā ulkādharān yataḥ ||
[98] śabarā (31) |
sphaṭikābhā garutmasthā sukāntā tālujihvikā |
śaṅkhakheṭakahastāgrā yāmye svastikakhaḍgabhṛt ||
tālujihvikā (32) |
raktākṣī vāhanārūḍhā raktapānā śaśiprabhā |
gadākhaḍgadharā yāmye vāme pāśakapālabhṛt ||
raktākṣī (33) |
vidyujjihvā sitā krūrā savye sīrakapālinī |
cakrasvaracakrakartari dhāriṇī dakṣiṇe kare ||
vidyujjihvā (34) |
grāhasthā cāmarachatrabhṛd dṛtidvayasaṃyutā |
kumbhapāśadharā śvetā krodhaputrā karaṅkinī ||
karaṅkinī (35) |
meghanādā tu candrābhā khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī |
jālair vṛtā ghanārūḍhā taḍinmaṇḍalasaṃnibhā ||
meghanādā (36) |
pracaṇḍogrā tu nakrasthā yāmye syāḥ kartarīphalam |
kapālaṃ muṇḍam anyatra śatrughnā sphaṭikaprabhā ||
pracaṇḍogrā (37) |
śuklavṛṣāsanā raudrā bibhraty añjākṣasūtrakam |
[99] kālakarṇī jagatkhyātā karṇikālavibhūṣaṇā ||
kālakarṇī (38) |
kartarīm abhayaṃ yāmye dhatte śvetā varapradā |
vṛṣadaṃśasamārūḍhā pūrṇapātradharān yataḥ ||
varadā (39) |
candrahāsā sthitā gaurī vedāsyā dordvayoḥ kramāt |
kamaṇḍalvaṅkuśavyagrā mantramālā śrucānvitā ||
candrahāsā (40) |
candravalī tu hemābhā hemasiṃhāsanasthitā |
yāmye ‘kṣamālā mālābhṛt śeṣe ‘ñjadhvajadhāriṇī ||
candrāvalī (41) |
phalasraganvitā yāmye kuntakuṇḍīdharān yataḥ |
raukmamālā prapañcāsyā gaurī viśvaprapañcikā || 42 ||\
markaṭasthā praśākhyākhyāṃ bibhratīṃ karayor dvayoḥ |
khādanty āmraphalaṃ hṛṣṭā gaurāṅgī vānarānanā ||
prapañcikā (43) |
picuvaktrā mṛgavyālī piṅgākṣī yāmyasaumyayoḥ |
bhindipālakakheṭābhyāṃ pāśāsibhyāṃ ca saṃyutā ||
[100] picuvaktrā (44) |
kākāsyā śyenagā gaurī piśācī raktamaṇḍitā |
kaṅkālakartarī khaḍgaṃ bibhratī yāmyasaumyayoḥ ||
piśācī (45) |
phalatūladharā vāme saumye śastrāsidhāriṇī |
khaḍgasthā babhruvarṇā syāt piśitāśātidurbalā ||
piśitāśā (46) |
nṛtyantī lolupā pīnā kharasthā yāmyasaumyayoḥ |
khaḍgaḍamarukartarau (?) pāśaṃ caiva tu bibhratī ||
lolupā (47) |
vamanī puṣpakasthā syāt gaurī yakṣagaṇānvitā |
gadāpaṭṭiśabhṛt saumye sthūlatomariṇī tataḥ ||
vamanī (48) |
tapanī sarpagā gaurī varāṅgī pannagānanā |
svakarṇe yānayor bhoge nyastahastograrūpiṇī ||
tapanī (49) |
pītā mahākhugā yā syāt vāmanī bibhratī kare |
kuṭhāraṃ laguḍaṃ vāme ‘kṣamālāṃ panasaṃ tataḥ ||
[101] vāmanī (50) |
śūlabhinnalulāpāśyā siṃhākṛṣṭaśarīriṇī |
jihve dve bibhratī caiva caturdhā vikṛtānanā || 51 ||
śaṅkhapūraṇikā dvābhyāṃ vṛkābhayadharā dvayoḥ |
dvisiṃharathasaṃsthā syāt tālābhā vāyuvegikā || 52 ||
bhāsasthitā bṛhatkukṣiḥ saumye muṇḍakapālabhṛt |
gaurī mahātanuḥ śaurye kararīpaṭṭikādanī ||
bṛhatkukṣiḥ (53) |
uṣṭrasthā vikṛtā gaurī bhakṛd vikṛtānanā |
tūṇaṃ c ḍamaruṃ yāmye saumye khaḍgāṅgamastakam ||
vikṛtā (54) |
kheṭakaṃ khaḍgabhṛd vāme gadācakrāsibhṛt tataḥ |
vanamālāvatī pītā tārkṣyasthā viśvarūpikā ||
viśvarūpikā (55) |
muśalaṃ mudgraṃ yāmye paraśuṃ bandhanaṃ tataḥ |
bibhratī yamajihvā syāt karālā mahiṣasthitā ||
yamajihvā (56) |
nṛtyantī kharagā śvetā yāmye ḍamarutūlabhṛt |
sadaitya śaile muṇḍogrā jayantī vāmahastayoḥ ||
[102] jayantī (57) |
śvārūḍhā durjayā śvetā raudrī bhūtagaṇāvṛtā |
khaḍgakuntodyatakarā durgakānanavāminī ||
durjayā (58) |
asakṛt kheṭinīdorbhyāṃ caturdyor yāmyasaumyayoḥ |
śūlabāṇadharā yāmye dhanuḥśaktikaronyataḥ ||
yamāṅkikā (59) |
śakaṭasthātighorāsyā kṣīravarṇā yamāntikā |
mārjārasthā biḍālī ca biḍālākṣī bhavet sitā ||
biḍālī (60) |
vāme tūṇaṃ ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ śūlaṃṭaṅkañcabibhratī |
kṛśā piśācavakrogrā kapālasthā ca revatī ||
revatī (61) |
kuśūlyaṣṭibhṛd vāme bhindimālākapālabhṛt |
kuṇḍābhā pūtanā tryakṣā vikṛtāsyā śavasthitā ||
pūtanā (62) |
kartarīśūlabhṛd yāmye vāme muṇḍakapālinī |
śvetavarṇā vṛṣārūḍhā vijayā vijayapradā ||
vijayantikā (63) |
[103] viṣṇudharmottarāt |
brahmāṇaṃ kārayed vidvān devaṃ saumyaṃ caturbhujam |
baddhapadmāsanaṃ tuṣṭaṃ tathā kṛṣṇājināmbaram ||
jaṭādharaṃ caturbāhuṃ saptahaṃsarathasthitam |
vāme nyastetarakaraṃ tasyaikaṃ doryugaṃ bhavet ||
etasmin dakṣiṇe pāṇāv akṣamālā tathā śubhā |
kamaṇḍaluṃ dvitīye ca sarvābharaṇadhāriṇam ||
sarvalakṣaṇayuktāsyaṃ śāntirūpasya pārthiva |
padmapatradalāgrābhaṃ dhyānsaṃmīlitekṣaṇam |
arcāyāṃ kārayed devaṃ citre vā vāstukarmaṇi ||
brahmā |
padmapatrāsanasthaś ca brahmā kāryaś caturmukhaḥ |
sāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṅgagatā tathā ||
ādityapurāṇe |
ādityavarṇā dharmajñā sākṣamālakarā tathā |
rūpaṃ pūrvoditaṃ kāryaṃ rūpam anyaj jagatpateḥ ||
prajāpatiḥ |
haṃsayāne ka kartavyo na kāryaś ca caturmukhaḥ |
brahmākhyam aparaṃ rūpaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prajāpateḥ ||
akṣasūtraṃ pustakaṃ ca dhatte padmaṃ kamaṇḍalum |
caturṣaktā tu sāvitrī śrotriyāṇāṃ gṛhe hitā ||
[104] lokapālabrahmā |
viśvakarmā tu kartavyaḥ surarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ |
sandaṃśapāṇir dvibhujas tejomūrtidharo mahān ||
viśvakarmā |
caturvakraś catuṣpādaś caturbāhuḥ sitāmbaraḥ |
sarvābharaṇavān śveto dharmaḥ kāryo vijānatā ||
dakṣiṇe cākṣamāla ca tasya vāme ca pustakam |
mūrtimān vyavasāyas tu kāryo dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ ||
vāmabhāge tataḥ kāryo vṛṣaḥ paramarūpavān |
kāryo padmakarau mūrdhni vinyastau tu tathā tayoḥ ||
dharmaḥ viśvakarmaśāstrāt |
ṛgvedaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ syād dvibhujo rāsabhānanaḥ |
akṣamālāmayaḥ saumyaḥ prītaś cādhyayanodyataḥ ||
ṛgvedaḥ |
nīlotpaladalābhāsaḥ sāmavedo hayānanaḥ |
akṣamālānvito dakṣe vāme kambudharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sāmavedaḥ |
ajāsyaḥ pītavarṇaḥ syād yajurvedo ‘kṣasūtradhṛk |
[105] vāme kuliśapāṇisa tu bhūtido maṅgalapradaḥ ||
yajurvedaḥ |
atharvaāṇbhidho vedo dhavalo markaṭānanaḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ bibhrāṇo ‘yaṃ jayapriyaḥ ||
atharvavedaḥ |
śikṣā śubhrābhayakarā jñānamudrānvitā śubhā |
akṣasūtrā sakuṇḍīkā dvibhujā daṇḍapaṅkajā ||
śikṣā |
kalpas tu kumudābhāso vāyasāsyo mahodaraḥ |
daṇḍī kuṇḍīdharo ‘bjastho mekhalākuṇḍalānvitaḥ ||
kalpaḥ |
sitaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ mayūrāsyaṃ kaṭodaram |
vīṇākajānvitaṃ divyaṃ divyavastravibhūṣitam ||
vyākaraṇam |
induvan nirmalaṃ śāntaṃ bakavaktraṃ kṛśodaram |
pāśapaṅkajahastaṃ syāc cākṣasūtraṃ sapustakam |
niruktam iti nirṇītaṃ chandonirṇīyate ‘dhunā ||
niruktam |
javākusumasaṃkāśaṃ chando jñeyaṃ vipaścitā |
[106] cakorāsyaṃ japākaṃ tu śaktiṃ bibhrac chikānvitam |
lohakuṇḍalakopetaṃ pravālakṛtakuṇḍalam ||
chandaḥ |
jyotiṣaṃ tu biḍālāsyam indragopanibhaṃ śubham |
akṣasūtraṃ kajaṃ bibhrad dhastayor dakṣavāmayoḥ ||
jyotiṣam |
somakāntisamābhāsaṃ mīmāṃsāśāstram uttamam |
akṣasūtraṃ dadhad dakṣe sudhāpūrṇaghaṭaṃ kare ||
mīmāṃsā|
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśo nyāyo jñyeo vipaścitā |
siṃhāsyo dakṣiṇe sūtraṃ dhvajaṃ vāmakare dadhat ||
nyāyaḥ |
dharmaśāstraṃ sitaṃ śāṇ=ntaṃ cāṣavaktraṃ kajāsanam |
muktājapāṅkadhṛg dakṣe tulāhastaṃ tu vāmataḥ ||
dharmaśāstram |
purāṇaṃ campakābhāsaṃ śukavaktraṃ caturdalam |
akṣasūtratraye jñeyaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
itihāsaḥ kajābhāsaḥ śūkarāsyo mahodaraḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ ghaṭaṃ vibhrat paṅkajābharaṇānvitaḥ ||
[107] itihāsaḥ |
pītavarṇo dharnurvedaḥ pikavaktro mahātanuḥ |
ratnamālāvaliṃ dhatte mantrake bhūṣitā jaṭāḥ ||
dhanurvedaḥ |
āyurvedo haridrābho vānarāsyo viśāladṛk |
akṣasūtraṃ sudhākumbhaṃ bibhrad ārogyado bhṛśam ||
āyurvedaḥ |
nṛtyaśāstraṃ sitaṃ ramyaṃ mṛgavaktraṃ jaṭādharam |
akṣasūtraṃ triśūlaṃ ca bibhāṇaś ca trilocanam ||
nṛtyaśāstram |
pañcaśāstrābhidhaṃ śāstraṃ dhavalaṃ vṛṣabhānanam |
akṣasūtraṃ halaṃ dhatte vanamālāvibhūṣitam ||
pañcaśāstram |
śāstraṃ pāśupataṃ śubhraṃ vyālavaktraṃ kṛśodaram |
sūtrapātradharaṃ bhīmaṃ vyāghracarmāmbarāvṛtam ||
pāśupatam |
pātañjalābhidhaṃ raktaṃ sarpavaktraṃ sutejasam |
akṣasūtraṃ pṛḍākuṃ ca dārayan kuṇḍalānvitam ||
[108] pṛdākuḥ sarpaḥ | pātañjalam |
sāṅkhyaṃ tat kapilaṃ babhruvakram ujvalatundilam |
jāpyadaṇḍadharaṃ dīrghaṃ nakhalomajaṭādharam ||
sāṅkhyam |
arthaśāstraṃ bhaved gauraṃ sārikācandanaṃ śubham |
akṣasūtraṃ phalaṃ bibhrad annahāraṃ kamaṇḍalum ||
arthaśāstram |
vidyā || 33 ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
ṛgvedas tu smṛto brahmā yajurvedas tu vasavaḥ |
sāmaveds tathā viṣṇuḥ śambhuś cātharvaṇo bhavet ||
śikṣā prajāpater jñeyaḥ kalpo brahmā prakīrtitaḥ |
sarasvatī vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
chando viṣṇus tathaivāgnir jyotiṣaṃ bhagavān raviḥ |
mīmāṃsā bhagavā somo nyāyamārgo samīraṇaḥ ||
dharmaś ca dharmaśāstrāṇi purāṇaṃ ca tathā manuḥ |
itihāsaḥ prajādhyakṣo dhanurvedaḥ śatakratuḥ ||
āyurvedas tathā sākṣād devao dhanvantariḥ prabhuḥ |
kalāvedaṃ mahī devī nṛtyaśāstraṃ maheśvaraḥ ||
saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pañcarātraṃ rudraḥ pāśupataṃ tathā |
pātañjalam anantaś ca sāṅgāṃ ca kapito muniḥ ||
[109] arthaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi dhanādhvajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
kalāśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kāmadevo jagadguruḥ ||
anyāni yāni śāstrāṇi yat karmāṇi pracakṣate |
sa eva devatā tasya śāstraṃ kāryaṃ ca devavat ||
adhidevatā |atha munirūpāṇi nayasaṃgrahe |
udāsīnāḥ sopavītāḥ kamaṇḍalvakṣasūtriṇaḥ |
jaṭilāḥ śvaśrulāḥ śāntāḥ āsīnā dhyānatatparāḥ ||
saptarṣayo vasiṣṭhaś ca karyo bhāryāsamanvitaḥ |
gautamaś ca bharadvājo viśvāmitraś ca kaśyapaḥ |
jamadagnir vasiṣṭho ‘triḥ vaivasvate ‘ntare ||
ṛṣayaḥ |
marīcir atryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
pracetāś ca vasiṣṭhaś ca bhṛgur nārada eva ca ||
jaṭilāḥ śmaśulāḥ śāntāh kṛśā bhramanisantatāḥ |
kusumbhākṣadharāḥ kāryā munayo dvibhujā daśa ||
nārado devagandharvaḥ sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaluḥ |
sevyo vai vīṇayā vāmabhujamūlopagūḍhayā ||
nāradasya | munayo bhaviṣyottarāt |
agastyaḥ |
prakṛtyā kāñcanaṃ kārayitvā śaktyā tu śobhitam |
[110] puruṣākṛtiṃ praśāntaṃ ca jaṭāmañjuladhāriṇam ||
kamaṇḍalukaraṃ śiṣyair mṛgaiś ca parivāritam |
mṛtyudhrug viṣahantāraṃ darbhahastaṃ varaṃ munim ||
agastyasya |
kartavyāḥ śakrarūpeṇa bhṛgavo nāma devatāḥ |
bhuvano bhāvanaś caiva sujanyaḥ sujanas tathā ||
kratuḥ suvaḥ svasur nāma vyajaś ca vyamunas tathā |
prasavaś cāvyayaś caiva dakṣo dvādaśakas tathā ||
bhṛgavo nāma nirdiṣṭā devā dvādaśa yajñiyāḥ ||
bṛgavaḥ |
jīvarūpeṇa kartavyā devāś cāṅgirasas tathā |
ātmā bhy āyur mano dakṣaḥ padaprāṇas tathaiva ca |
haviṣyaś ca gaviṣṭhaś ca ṛtaḥ satyaś ca tejasaḥ ||
aṅgirasaḥ | viṣṇudharmottarāt |
devadevaṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ kārayed garūpasthitam (?) |
kaustabhodbhāsitoraskaṃ sarvābharaṇadhāriṇam ||
sajalāmbuda (?) sachāyaṃ pītadivyāmbaraṃ tathā |
mukhāś ca kāryāś catvāro bāhavo dviguṇās tathā ||
