triśūlam akṣasūtraṃ ca bhujayoḥ savyayoḥ smṛtam |
darpaṇaṃ cotpalaṃ kāryaṃ bhujayor apasavyayoḥ ||
ardhanārīśvaraḥ | evam eva dikpāleśānaḥ |
dakṣiṇamudrāṃ pratipādayantaṃ
sitākṣasūtraṃ ca tathordhvabhāge |
vāme ca pustāmakhilāgamādyāṃ
bibhrāṇamūrdhena sudhādharaṃ ca ||
sitāmbujasthaṃ sitavarṇam īśaṃ
sitāmbarālepanam indaumaulim |
jñānaṃ munibhyaḥ pratipādayantaṃ
taṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtim udāharantam ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ |
yugmaṃ strīpuruṣaṃ kāryaṃ umeśau divyarūpiṇau |
aṣṭavakraṃ tu deveśaṃ jaṭācandrārdhabhūṣitam ||
dvipāṇiṃ dvibhujāṃ devīṃ sumadhyāṃ supayodharām |
vāmapāṇiṃ tu devasya devyāḥ skandhe niyojayet ||
dakṣiṇaṃ tu karaṃ śambor utpalena vibhūṣitam |
[126] devyās tu dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ skandhe devasya kalpayet |
vāpapāṇau tathā devyā darpaṇaṃ dāpayendubham || iti |
umāmaheśvarau |
kāryaṃ hariharasyāpi dakṣiṇārdhaṃ sadāśivaḥ |
vāmam ardhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ śvetanīlākṛtiḥ kramāt ||
varaṃ triśūlaṃ cakrāñjadhāriṇo bāhavaḥ kramāt |
dakṣiṇe vṛṣabhaḥ pārśve vāmabhāge vihaṅgarāḍ || iti |
hariharamūrtiḥ |
digvarṇā jaṭilāḥ tryakṣāḥ pura (?) triśūladhāriṇaḥ |
puṭāñjalikarāḥ sarve viśveśāś caikavaktrakāḥ ||
anantaś ca trimūrtiś ca sūkṣmaḥ śrīkaṇṭha eva ca |
śivaḥ śikhaṇḍy ekanetra ekarudraś ca te kramāt ||
vidyeśvarāḥ | viśvakarmaśāstrāt |
atha rudrān pravakṣyāmi bāhuṣoḍaśakānvitān |
ajo nāmā mahārudro dhatte śūlam athāṅkuśam ||
kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ sarpaṃ mudgaraṃ ca sudarśanam |
akṣasūtramayo dakṣe tathā vāme karāṣṭake ||
tarjanī mūrdhnatas tatra khaṭvāṅgaṃ tadadhaḥ kare |
gadāṃ ca paṭṭiśaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ śaktiṃ paraśukuṇḍikāḥ ||
[127] ajekapadaḥ || 1 ||
ekapādābhidho bibhrat dvādaśārdhād bahiḥ śaram |
cakraṃ ḍamarukaṃ śūlaṃ mudgaraṃ tadadho varam ||
akṣasūtram adho vāme khaṭvāṅgaṃ cordhvahastake |
dhanur ghaṇṭḥāṃ kapālaṃ ca kaumudīṃ tarjanīghaṭam ||
paraśuṃ ca kramād dhatte dhatte bāhvaṣṭake tv iti |
anekabogasaṃpattiṃ kurute yajanāt sadā ||
ekapādaḥ || 2 ||
ahirbudhno gadāṃ cakraṃ caṇḍau ḍamarumudgarau |
śūlāṅkuśākṣamālāṃ ca dakṣor bādhaḥ karaḥ (?) kramāt ||
tomaraṃ paṭṭiśaṃ carma kapālaṃ tarjanīghaṭam |
śaktiḥ paraśukaṃ vāme dakṣavad dhārayaty asau ||
ahirbudhnaḥ || 3 ||
virūpākṣas tataḥ khaḍgaśūlaṃ ḍamarukāṅkuśam |
sarpaṃ cakraṃ gadām akṣasūtraṃ bibhrat karāṣṭake ||
kheṭaṃ khaṭvāṅgakaṃ śaktiṃ paraśuṃ tarjanī ghaṭam |
ghaṇṭākapolakau ceti vāmārddhādikarāṣṭake ||
virūpākaḥ || 4 ||
revato dakṣiṇe cāpaṃ khaḍgaśūlaṃ gadāṃ mahīm |
[128] cakrāṅkuśākṣamālās tu dhārayann ūrdhvam āditaḥ ||
dhanuḥ kheṭaṃ ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ ghaṇṭātarjanikāṃ tataḥ |
paraśuṃ paṭṭiśaṃ pātraṃ vāmbāhvake ‘rkavat ||
sarvasaṃspat karoty eṣa jāyate vārcanād bhṛśam ||
revataḥ || 5 ||
harākhye mudgaraṃ caiva ḍamaruṃ śūlam aṅkuśam |
gadāsarpākṣasūtrāṇi dārayan dakṣiṇordhvataḥ ||
paṭṭiśaṃ tomaraṃ śaktiṃ paraśuṃ tarjanīghaṭam |
khaṭvāṅgaṃ pātrakaṃ ceti vāmorddhādikrameṇa tu ||
haraḥ || 6 ||
bahurūpo dadhad dakṣe ḍamaruṃ ca sudarśanam |
sūrpśūlāṅkuśeyas tu kaumudīṃ japamālikām ||
ghaṇṭākapālakhaṭvāṅgaṃ tarjanīṃ kuṇḍikāṃ dhanuḥ |
paraśuṃ paṭṭiśaṃ caiva vāmārddhādi karāṣṭake ||
bahurūpaḥ || 7 ||
ambako ‘pi dadhac cakraṃ ḍamaruṃ mudgaraṃ śaram |
śūlāṅkuśāhijāpyaṃ ca dakṣorddhādikrameṇa hi ||
gadākhaṭvāṅgapātrāṇi kāmukaṃ tarjanīṃ ghaṭau |
paraśuṃ paṭṭiśaṃ ceti vāmārdhādikarāṣṭake ||
ambakaḥ || 8 ||
sureśvaraṃ hi ḍamaruṃ cakraṃ śūlāṅkuśāv api |
śaraṃ ca mudgaraṃ cāpaṃ dakṣabāhvaṣṭake tv iti ||
[129] paṅkajṃ paraśuṃ ghaṇṭāṃ paṭṭiśaṃ tarjanīṃ dhanuḥ |
khatvāṅgaṃ kārayet pātraṃ vāme ‘ṣṭakapallave ||
sureśvaraḥ || 9 ||
jayanto daśamo rudro ‘py aṅkuśaṃ cakramudgaram |
śūlā hi ḍamaruṃ vāṇam akṣasūtraṃ yametv iti ||
gadākhaṭvāṅgaparaśuṃ kapālaṃ śaktitarjanīm |
dhanuḥ kuṇḍī srucorddhādi vāmavbāhvaṣṭake dadhat ||
jayantaḥ || 10 ||
athāparājito dakṣe tomaraṃ khaḍgam aṅkuśam |
śūlāhicakraḍamarum akṣamālāṃ dadhat kramāt ||
śaktiṃ kheṭaṃ gadāṃ pātraṃ tarjanīṃ paṭṭiśaṅkhajam |
ghaṇṭām uttarataś cātha dhārayann ūrdhvam āditaḥ ||
aparājitaḥ || 11 ||
ajaikapād ahirbradhnaḥ virūpākṣaś ca raivataḥ |
haraś ca bahurūpaś ca tryambakaś ca sureśvaraḥ |
rudrā ekādaśa proktā jayantaś cāparājitaḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ karyaḥ śikhaṇḍikavibhūṣaṇaḥ |
raktāmbaradharaḥ kāryo mayūravaravāhanaḥ ||
kukkuṭaś ca tathā ghaṇṭā tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ |
patākā vaijayantī ca śaktiḥ kāryā ca vāmayoḥ ||
[130] skandaḥ |
athāto rūpanirmāṇaṃ vakṣye ‘haṃ bhairavasya tu |
lambodaraṃ tu kartavyaṃ vṛttapiṅgalalocanam ||
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ phullanāsāpuṭaṃ tathā |
kapālamālinaṃ raudraṃ sarvataḥ sarpabhūṣaṇam ||
vyālena trāsayantaṃ ca devīṃ parvatanandinīm |
sajalāmbudasaṅkāśaṃ gajacarmottarachadam ||
bahubhir bāhubhir vyāptaṃ sarvāyudhavibhūṣaṇam |
bṛhatśālapratīkāśais tathā tīkṣṇanakhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
sācīkṛtam idaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam ||
bhairavaḥ |
mahākālasya kathitam etad vai bhairavaṃ mukham |
devītrāsanakaś cāsya kare kāryaś ca pannagaḥ |
na cāsya purataḥ kāryā devī parvatanandinī ||
śuklā na kāryāsya tathā na raktā
samīpato mātṛgaṇapradhāne |
kāryaṃ tathā yā parivarham asya
gaṇāś ca kāryā bahurūparūpakāḥ ||
mahākālaḥ |
nandī kāryas trinetras tu caturbāhur mahābhujaḥ |
[131] sindūrāruṇasaṅkāśo vyāghracarmaparichadaḥ ||
triśūlabhindipāle ca karayos tasya kārayet |
śirogataṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu tarjayantaṃ tathāparam ||
ālokayānaṃ kartavyaṃ dūrād āgamikaṃ janam ||
nandī |
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa vīrabhadraṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
vīrabhadraḥ |
jvaras tripādaḥ kartavyas trinetrair vdanais tribhiḥ |
bhasmapraharaṇo rudras tribāhur vyākulekṣaṇaḥ ||
jvaraḥ |
viśvakarmaśāstrāt |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vasurūpāṇi te jaya |
padmākṣamālike tasya dakṣavāmakaradvaye ||
sīraśaktī dadhāno ‘yaṃ dharākhyo vasurādimaḥ |
mālāṃ puṣkaravījotthāṃ cakraṃ śaktiṃ kamaṇḍalum ||
dakṣādharādisavyena yasya syuḥ sa dhruvo mataḥ |
muktāphalakṛtā mālā paṅkajaṃ śaktir aṅkuśaḥ ||
sa vasuḥ kīrtito vatsa somanāmeti vai budhaiḥ |
savyavāmordhvagau yasya karau staḥ śaktisaṃyutau ||
sīrāṅkuśānvitau cādhaḥ sa bhaved āpasaṃjñakaḥ |
[132] akṣamālopavīty ūrdhve śṛṇiśaktikarāv adhaḥ ||
yasya staḥ so ‘nilākhyaḥ syāc chubhadaḥ pañcamo vasuḥ |
sruvākṣamāliko dakṣe vāme śaktikapālabhṛt ||
savyordhvādikramād yo ‘sau nalākhyas tu vasuḥ smṛtaḥ |
khaṭvāṅkuśadharaḥ savye śaktikheṭakaro ‘nyataḥ ||
pratyūṣākhyo vasuś cāyaṃ saptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
savye daṇḍakapālo ‘sau vāme tu śṛṇiśaktikaḥ ||
śubhadaḥ kīrtitaś cāyaṃ prabhāso vasur aṣṭamaḥ |
ete sarve samākhyātā navakāñcanasaṃnibhāḥ ||
dharodhruvaś ca somaḥ syād āpaś caivānilo ‘nalaḥ |
pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavo ‘ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ ||
iti vasurūpanirmāṇam |
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi sūryabhedāṃs tu te jaya |
yāvat prakāśakaḥ sūryo jāyate mūrtibhir yathā ||
dakṣiṇe pauṣkarī mālā kare vāme kamaṇḍaluḥ |
padmābhyāṃ śobhitakarā sā dhātrī prathamā smṛtā ||
śūlaṃ vāmakare cāsyāḥ dakṣiṇe soma eva ca |
mitrā nāma trinayanā kuśeśayavibhūṣitā ||
prathame tu kare cakraṃ tathā vāme ca kaumudī |
mūrtir maṇimayī jñeyā sapadmaiḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ ||
[133] akṣamālā kare savye cakraṃ vāme pratiṣṭhitam |
sā mūrtī raudrī jñātavyā pradhānā padmabhūṣitā ||
cakraṃ tu dakṣiṇe yasyā vāme pāśaḥ suśobhanaḥ |
sā vāruṇī bhaven mūrtiḥ padmavyagrakaradvayā ||
kamaṇḍalur dakṣiṇato mālā cākṣamayī bhavet |
sā bhavet sanmatā sūryamūrtiḥ padmavibhūṣitā ||
yasyā dakṣiṇataḥ śūlaṃ vāmahaste sudarśanaḥ |
bhagmūrtiḥ samākhyātā padmahastā śubhā jaya ||
atha vāmakare mālā triśūlaṃ dakṣiṇe smṛtam |
vivasvanmūrtir evāsyāḥ padmalāñchanalakṣitā ||
pūṣākhyasya bhaven mūrtir dvibhujā padmalāñchitā |
sarvapāpaharā jñeyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā ||
dakṣiṇe tu gadā vāme caiva sudarśanaḥ |
padmavyagrā tu sāvitrī mūrtiḥ sarvārthasādhanī ||
srucaṃ ca dakṣiṇe haste vāme homajakīlakam |
mūrtis tvāṣṭrī bhaved asya padmaruddhakaradvayā ||
sudarśanakarā savye padmahastā tu rābhataḥ |
eṣā syād dvādaśī mūrtir viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ ||
dhātā mitror yamārudro varuṇaḥ sūrya eva ca |
bhago vivasvān pūṣā ca savitā daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
[134] ekādaśas tathā tvṣṭrā viṣṇur dvādaśa ucyate |
iti dvādaśādityarūpanirmāṇam |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rūpāṇi marutāṃ tava |
akṣamālāmbuje dakṣe vāme kuṇḍīdhvajānvitaḥ ||
śvasanākhyo bhaved evaṃ sādhakānāṃ susiddhidaḥ |
cakṣākṣamālikā pātradhvajayuk sparśanābhidhaḥ ||
kapāladhvajāpāśābjadhārako vāyunāmakaḥ |
mārariśvā kapālābjadhvajapātrakaro mataḥ ||
dhvajākṣasūtrapātrābjaṃ bibhrāṇaḥ syāt sadā gatiḥ |
dhvajāsikheṭapātrāṇi dhārayaṃs tu mahābalaḥ ||
dhvajapāśakapālāhisaṃyuto balavardhanaḥ |
pātrākṣasūtrapāśābjadhārakaḥ pṛṣadaśvakaḥ ||
akṣasūtragadākambudhvajī gandhavahābhidhaḥ |
kapāladhvajapātrābjahastako gandhavāhakaḥ ||
jñānamudrākṣasūtrābjadhvajahasto nilo mataḥ |
akṣamālāsunīlābjadhvajakambudharāśugaḥ ||
dhvajavāṇadhanuḥ kuṇḍīkarayuk sumukho bhavet |
dhvajābjapātramudrāṇi dhārayet karkarābhidhaḥ ||
abjākṣamālikāpātradhvajahastaḥ samīraṇaḥ |
dhvajapātraghanābjāni bibhrāṇas tu samīrakaḥ ||
akṣasūtradhvajābjāni muṇḍaṃ bibhraty anuttamaḥ |
[135] akṣamālādhvajābjāni dhārayan mārutābhidhaḥ ||
kaṃ śiraḥ |
pavyakṣasūtrapāśābjasaṃyuto nāgayonijaḥ |
dhvajamuṇḍākṣapātrī syāj jagatprāṇābhidhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
dhvajasūtrasapāśābjasaṃyutaḥ pāvanābhidhaḥ |
khaṭvāṅgadhvajakhetāni bibhrāṇo vātasaṃjñakaḥ ||
dhvajākṣakṛtapātrāṇi dhāryaṃs tu prabhañjanaḥ |
akṣasūtradhvajābjāhipāṇiyukyavanāmakaḥ ||
śūlābhadhvajapātrāṇi nabhasvān iti dhārayan |
dhvajāṅkuśākṣamuṇḍāni bibhrāṇo ‘tibalo mataḥ ||
sadhvajāmbujapātrāṅkas tarasvīnāma kīrtitaḥ |
daṇḍamuṇḍadhvajābjāni dhārayan drāvaṇo mataḥ ||
dhvajākṣatarjanīpātrapāṇiyug devayakṣakaḥ |
akṣamālā kuṭharābjadhvajayugmātrajāhakaḥ ||
ghaṇṭākṣadhvajamuṇḍāni dhārayann adharābhidhaḥ |
vodhipallavasūtrābjadhvajahastaḥ sadorddhvadṛk (?) ||
akṣasūtradhvajāśokapātrayuk matirodhanaḥ |
pāṇiko nāma vijñeyo valākṣadhvajamuṇḍayuk ||
dhvajākṣaghaṭapātrāṇi dhārayan sādhako mataḥ |
bījapūradhvajābjākṣasaṃyuto viśvapūrakaḥ ||
ghaṇṭākṣadhvajamālābhiḥ saṃyuto jagadāśrayaḥ |
[136] viśvātiriktako nāma dhvajalāñchanapāśayuk ||
akṣamālākaje ghaṇṭādhvajau bibhrat kajāgaraḥ |
viśvodaro bhaved eṣa śaṅkhaśūlaghaṭadhvajī ||
agrajo nāma vijñeyo yakṣabāṇadhanurdhaṭī |
śrīphalābjākṣapātrāṇi dhārayaṃs tīvrako mataḥ ||
śuktimuṇḍadhvajapāśī suvaho ‘yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ |
akṣasūtradhvajapāśapātrayuk bījavardhanaḥ ||
dhvajapāśakapālābjair juto bhadrajavo mataḥ |
ṭaṅkapāśadhvajābjāni dhārayan puṣkarodbhavaḥ ||
palāśapatrapāśābjadhvajahasto ‘bjinī patiḥ |
jambuvījadhvajābjākṣapāṇiyuk vyaktamūrtimān ||
parighākṣadhvajābjāni dhārayan viśvago mataḥ |
sarve caturbhujā jñeyā yuvānaḥ kuṭilabhruvaḥ ||
sarvorddhādyuttarorddhāntakrameṇāyudhadhāriṇaḥ |
raktākṣāś ca mahāvīryāḥ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||
dhūmravarṇā mṛgārūḍhāḥ sarve te śavalāṃśukāḥ |
iti te ‘tra samākhyātā śubhadās tu marudgaṇāḥ ||
saṃkhyayaikonapañcāśat sarvarogāpanuttaye |
ekonapañcāśan marutā |
skānde |
sādhyāḥ padmāsanagatāḥ kamaṇḍalvakṣasūtriṇaḥ |
dharmaputrā mahātmāno dvādaśāmarapūjitāḥ ||
[137] brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
mano’numantā prāṇaś ca narayānaś ca vīryavān |
vittir haryo nayaś caiva haṃso nārāyaṇas tathā |
prabhavo viṣṇur viśvaś ca sādhyā dvādaśa jambhire (?) ||
sādhyānāṃ | viṣṇudharmottare |
padmapatrasvarṇābhau padmapatrasamāmbarau |
dvibhujau devabhiṣajau kartavyau dehasaṃyutau ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannau viśeṣāc cārulocanau |
tayor auṣadhayaḥ kāryā divyā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ||
vāmayoḥ pustake kārye darśanīye tathā dvija |
ekasya dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme vānyasya yādava ||
nārīyugaṃ prakartavyaṃ surūpaṃ cārudarśanam |
tayoś ca nāmanī prokte rūpasampat tathākṛtiḥ ||
madhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśā rāupasaṃpat prakīrtitā |
ākṛtiḥ kathitā loke śarakāṇḍanibhā tathā |
ratnabhāṇḍakare kārye candraśuklāmbare tathā ||
aśvinau |
pṛṣṭhasthaḥ sūryavat kāryo revantaś ca tathā prabhuḥ |
revantasya |
[138] mayasaṃgrahe | yakṣarūpāṇi |
tundilā dvibhujā kāryā nidhihastā madotkaṭāḥ |
gadī vaiśravaṇaḥ preṣṭho nṛpālas tv aṣṭamo varaḥ ||
siddhārtho maṇibhadraś ca sumanā nandano yaśāḥ |
kaṇḍūtiḥ pāñcakaḥ śaṅkho maṇimān padmarāmakau ||
sarvatra bhojī piṅgākṣaś caturo mandarāśrayaḥ |
śubhadracandrapradyotameghavarṇajayāvahāḥ ||
dyutimān ketumān śveto maulimān vijayākṛtiḥ |
padmavarṇamahāghāsapuṣpadantāḥ sudarśanāḥ ||
pūrṇamāsahiraṇyākṣaśatajihvabalāhakāḥ |
valākavipulau padmanābhaḥ kumudavīrakau ||
sugandha ity amī yakṣās teṣāṃ rājā dhanādhipaḥ ||
yakṣarūpanirmāṇam | rākṣasarūpaṃ mayadīpikāyām |
raktavastradharāḥ kṛṣṇā nakhadīrghāḥ sadaṃṣṭrikāḥ |
kārttīkhaḍgāṅgahastāś ca rākṣasā ghorarūpiṇaḥ ||
heti praheti yajñaghna śaṅkuś ca sanabandhanāḥ |
vidyutsarjamanuṣyādapauruṣeyasukeśinaḥ ||
ugramālīty amī proktāḥ pradhānā rākṣasāḥ kila |
bhūtās tathaiva dānāś ca dīrghavaktrāḥ piśācakāḥ ||
[139] iti rākṣasabhūtapiśācarūpanirmāṇam |
varado bhaktalokānāṃ kirīṭī kuṇḍalī gadī |

kṛṣṇasaptamyāḥ |
pretagā vāṣṭamī raktā kṛṣṇagrīvā śitāṃśukā |
akṣaṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā kheṭaṃ pātraṃ dhatte caturbhujā ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāḥ |
sarpagā navamī nīlā daṃṣṭriṇī pātratarjanī |
[155] kṛṣṇanavamyāḥ |
siṃhāsanasthitā śubhrā daśamī pītakuṇḍalā |
jñānamadrākṣapātreyaṃ pītavastrābjamālinī ||
kṛṣṇadaśmyāḥ |
ekādaśī vṛṣasthābjanīlaśubhrāraśūlinī |
kṛṣṇaikādaśyāḥ |
tāmravarṇā rathārūḍhā pātrakheṭāsipaṅkajā |
dvādaśī śubhavastreyaṃ nīlakuṇḍalabhūṣitā ||
kṛṣṇadvādaśyāḥ |
aśokakalikā vāṇacāpapātrā trayodaśī |
mecakābjāsanā śyāmā haridvastrā madālasā |
gadāpātradharā gaurā nidhisthā vā trayodaśī ||
kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāḥ |
dvibhujā turagārūḍhā kṛṣṇavarṇā caturdaśī |
khaḍgabhalladharā nīlakuṇḍalā śukabhūṣaṇā ||
kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāḥ |
[156] amāvāsyā vidhātavyā dvirdormarakataprabhā |
darbhāsanasthitā ceyaṃ darbhapiṇḍadharā kṛśā ||
amāvāsyāyāḥ |
atha nakṣatrarūpāṇi kathayāmi samāsataḥ |
tatrādāv aśvinī jñeyā padmapatranibhā śubhā ||
aśvavaktrāmbujārūḍhā dvibhujā ca sitāmbarā |
dakṣe divyauṣadhīpātraṃ bibhratī pustakaṃ kare ||
aśvinyāḥ |
bharaṇī mahiṣārūḍhā gajavaktrāñjanaprabhā |
daṇḍapāśadharātyugrā raktadṛk parikīrtitā ||
bharaṇyāḥ |
chāgasthā chāgavaktrāsyā piṅgbhrūkeśalocanā |
sūtraṃ śaktiṃ ca bibhrāṇā pīnāṅgajaṭharāruṇā |
kīttikā kīrtitā ceyaṃ svarṇamālāvibhūṣaṇā ||
kṛttikā |
rohiṇī tuhinābhāsā sarpavaktrā tu haṃsagā |
sūtrakuṇḍīdharā devī kīrtitā hārabhūṣaṇā ||
rohiṇyāḥ |
mṛgānanā hayāsyā vā nāgavaktrāgrahāyiṇī |
[157] ghṛdhrasthā candragaurābhakuṇḍikā jayamālinī ||
mṛgaśīrṣāyāḥ |
śvamukhī kṛṣṇavarṇā tu raktārdrā śūlapāṇinī |
nīlavastrā vṛṣārūḍhā vāsthimālā vibhūṣaṇā ||
ārdrāyāḥ |
śūkarāsyo viḍālastho gauravarṇaḥ punarvasuḥ |
sūtravajrāṅkuśābhītīr bibhrāṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
punarvasoḥ |
chāgārūḍaś ca meghābhaḥ puṣyeyaṃ madhupiṅgabhāk |
akṣacaṇḍāsaṇī kuṇḍīṃ dadhāno ‘tra caturbhujaḥ ||
puṣyasya |
kapivaktrā maghā śyāmā kṛśāṅgī ca mahodarā |
darbhapiṇḍadharābjasthā dvibhujeyam (?) udīritā ||
maghāyāḥ |
pūrvā hastimukhā sphasthā śukahastadvayāruṇā |
[158] skaḥ (sphaḥ?) cakram |
pūrvyāyāḥ |
vyāghrānanottarā gosthā śubhavarṇā caturbhujā |
dvyakṣiṇī sūtrakhaṭṭāṅgadhāriṇī parikīrtitā ||
uttarāyāḥ |
gaurāruṇo lulāpāsyo hastanāmā hayasthitaḥ |
akṣavajrabhujadvandvo bhūtidaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
hastasya |
vyāghrāsyā mahiṣārūḍhā citrā gaurā caturbhujā |
akṣakuṇḍī sapustī ca sudhāpūrṇaghaṭānvitā ||
citrāyāḥ |
mahiṣasthā mṛgārūḍhā gaurā śyāmātha vā matā |
pīnā caturbhujā svātyakṣakuśadhvajapātriṇī ||
svātyāḥ |
haryakṣavadanā raktā nābhipādāntahemabhā |
meṣacchāgasthitā seyaṃ viśākhāṅkuśavajriṇau |
vāme śaktim adhaḥ pātraṃ bibhrāṇā hemabhūṣaṇā ||
viśākhāyāḥ |
[159] haristhā ca viḍālāsyā dvibhujāmbujavajriṇī |
mūrdhādinābhipādāntaśyāmagaurā krameṇa tu |
anurādhā parijñeyā padmarāgavibhūṣaṇā ||
anurādhāyāḥ |
pītavarṇā gajārūḍhā bhallāsyā vā mṛgānanā |
akṣasūtraṃ pavindhatte vāme jyeṣṭhāṅkuśaṃ śaye ||
jyeṣṭhāyāḥ |
mūlarūpaṃ vidhātavyaṃ śyāmaṃ kuṇapavāhanam |
khaḍgakheṭadharaṃ cograṃ dvibhujaṃ ca vṛkānanam ||
mūlasya |
kumbhīravdanā nīlā markaṭasthā caturbhujā |
akṣasūtraṃ kajaṃ pāśaṃ pātraṃ yā bibhratī sadā |
pūrvāṣāḍhā samuddiṣṭā pītavastrābjabhūṣaṇā ||
pūrvāṣāḍhāyāḥ |
sarpagā cottarāṣāḍhā goravarṇā surūpiṇī |
nāgabandhajaṭājūṭasvarṇakuṇḍalabhūṣitā ||
akṣanāgadharā dakṣe vāme pustī sakuṇḍikā ||
uttarāṣāḍhāyāḥ |
abhijit kumudābhā sā nakravaktrā tu haṃsagā |
[160] varaśrukpustakābhītisaṃyuteyaṃ caturbhujā ||
abhijitaḥ |
nīraruk turagārūḍhā śravaṇī markaṭānanaḥ |
śaṅkhacakragadābjāni bibhrāṇaḥ svarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
śravaṇasya |
taptacāmīkarābhā sā nidhisthā paṅkajāsanā |
pakvabimbādharā tanvī pīnonnatapayodharā ||
dīrghaveṇī sapuṣpā sā mauktikābharaṇānvitā |
cārunetrā suveṣāṭhyā dvibhujā vasanāruṇā ||
varālayānvitā saumyā dhaniṣṭhā parikīrtitā |
dhaniṣṭhāyāḥ |
śubhrā makaragāśvāśyā dvibhujā pāśapātriṇī |
pāṭalā vastrsaṃyuktā kīrtitā śatatārakā ||
śatatārāḥ |
pūrvā bhādrapadā śubhragovaktrā chāgagāminī |
meṣaśīrṣadharā seyaṃ sīdhupātraṃ ca bibhratī ||
pūrvabhādrapadāyāḥ |
gardhabhāsyā vṛṣārūḍhā sitā bhādrapadottarā |
pātraṃ ca ḍamaruṃ dhatte dvibhujeyam udīritā ||
[161] uttarabhādrapadāyāḥ |
revatī karabhāsyāsyā dvibhujā hastigāminī |
kamalaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ dhatte śvetavarṇā mahāsvanā ||
revatyāḥ |
atha yogānāṃ |
viṣkumbhaḥ prathamo jñeyaḥ pītavarṇas tu ṣaḍbhujaḥ |
raktāsyo nīlakaṇṭhas tu vṛttanetraḥ subhīṣaṇaḥ ||
viśālabhālo dīrghāṅgas taṅganāso jaṭādharaḥ |
lambakarṇendranīlotthasvarṇaratnajakuṇḍalaḥ ||
śubhranīlendragopālābhavasanaḥ svarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ |
mudgaraṃ prathame dakṣe dvitīye kartarīm iha ||
tṛtīye kuliśaṃ pāṇau vāmādye ṭaṅkam eva ca |
śvenapucchaṃ dvitīye ca tṛtīye cāmṛtaṃ dhaṭam ||
bibhrāṇaḥ pūjanīyo ‘yaṃ pītapuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
kāryaniṣpattaye nūnam anyathā vighanadāyakaḥ ||
viṣkumbhasya |
prītināmā dvitīyas tu javākusumasaṃnibhaḥ |
śvetavaktro viśālākṣo lambakarṇendukuṇḍalaḥ ||
bhālālitilakopetaḥ saumyo muktāvibhūṣaṇaḥ |
śvetavastro jaṭāmaulir aṣṭabāhur vṛkodaraḥ ||
bandhupuṣpāṅkajīvotthamallikāmādime yame |
[162] dvitīye modakaṃ pāṇau tṛtīye kadalīphalam ||
caturthe paṅkajaṃ caiva vāmādye cāmṛtaṃ ghaṭam |
dvitīye cātra vai pātraṃ somapūrṇaṃ manoharam ||
tṛtīye kuliśaṃ haste caturthe cātra vai dhvajām |
dadhāno bhūtaye prītyai sarvatāpanivṛttaye ||
prīteḥ |
āyuṣmāṃs tu tṛtīyo ‘yaṃ mauktikābho ‘ruṇodaraḥ |
kṣaumavastrānvitaś caiva muktāsauvarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
dvibhujaḥ prathame dakṣe cākṣasūtraṃ ca mauktikam |
dūrvām atra dvitīye vai tṛtīye cūtapallavam ||
caturthe paṅkajaṃ caiva pañcame cātapatrakam |
sudhākumbhaṃ tu vāmādye bījapūrapidhānakam ||
pātraṃ dadhyakṣatopetaṃ dvitīye karapallave |
tṛtīye śrīphalaṃ haste caturthe pavim eva ca ||
pañcame cāmaraṃ haste svarṇadaṇḍaṃ sitaṃ śubham |
dhārayenn eṣa vai pūjyo bhogāyuṣyavivṛddhaye ||
āyuṣmataḥ |
saubhāgyākhyaś caturtho ‘tra sphāṭikābhas trilocanaḥ |
skandhāruṇo mahāsatvaḥ sundaraḥ kumudāmbaraḥ ||
daśabāhurayaś cārke prathame śrīphalaṃ kare |
akṣasūtraṃ pravālotthaṃ dvitīye karapallave ||
tṛtīye (?) kamalaṃ haste caturthe vāravālakam |
[163] pañcame śaktim atraiva vāmādye pātram eva ca ||
dvitīye cāmṛte kumbhaṃ tṛtīye tu prakīrṇakam |
caturthaṃ darpaṇaṃ haste vekṣudaṇḍaṃ ca pañcame ||
bibhrāṇaḥ saumyaḥ saubhāgyo vṛddhaye cāyuṣe śriye |
saubhāgyasya |
śobhanaḥ pañcamo yogaḥ śvetāvaktro vaśī balī |
śeṣoruṇakṛśaś cāṅgaḥ pravālakrtakuṇḍalaḥ ||
śoṇaśukalāmbaraś caiva muktāvidrumabhūṣaṇaḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ suhemotthaṃ prathame dakṣiṇe kare ||
dvitīye paṅkajaṃ haste tṛtīye śrīphalaṃ śaye |
tūrye śaktiṃ karāmbhoje vāmādye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
dvitīye svarṇajaṃ pātraṃ tṛtīye caiva darpaṇam |
caturthe cāmaraṃ pāṇau dārayann aṣṭador iti ||
pūjanīyo mahābhaktyā saukhyasaubhāgyavṛddhaye |
śobhanasya |
atigaṇḍābhidhaś cātha ṣaṣṭho yogaḥ pratīyate |
gaṇḍāruṇasitaḥ krūraḥ kṛṣṇavaktro ‘rkabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
sthūlo vṛddhaśrutis tuṅganāsiko ‘ruṇabhūṣaṇaḥ |
piṅgaśmastrujaṭāmauliḥ ṣaḍbhujaḥ kaṭisūtravān ||
akṣasūtraṃ yam āditye lohajaṃ karapallave |
eṇaṃ mṛgaṃ dvitīye ca tṛtīye caiva vārijam ||
[164] pātraṃ vāmād ime pāṇau dvitīye śaktim eva ca |
patākāṃ tu tṛtīye vai dadhānaḥ kṛṣṇalohitaiḥ ||
pūjanīyo mahābhaktyā duṣṭabhītinivṛttaye ||
atigaṇḍasya |
caturbhujaḥ sukarmā vai śvetabāhūdaraśrutiḥ |
nīlaśubhrāṃśukopetaḥ svarṇanīlavibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
rudrākṣamālikām arke prathame karapallave |
dvitīye kamalaṃ pāṇau vāmādau daṇḍam eva ca ||
patākām atra vai haste dvitīye sumanohare |
bhbhrat suvṛddhaye nṝṇāṃ karmārambhaśubhapradaḥ ||
sukarmaṇaḥ |
dhṛtyākhyaś cāṣṭamo yogaḥ kathyate vasuvāhukaḥ |
bhālāruṇas tu sarvāṅge śvetavarṇāruṇāmbaraḥ ||
svarṇamuktendranīlāḍhyo vidrumānvitabhūṣaṇaḥ |
muktākṣamālikāṃ dakṣe prathame ratnamudrike ||
dvitīye śrīphalaṃ pāṇau tṛtīye ‘śokapallavam |
caturthe hemajaṃ daṇḍaṃ vāmādye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
dvitīye cāmṛtaṃ pātraṃ tṛtīye cāmbujaṃ kare |
patākām atra vai turye bibhrāṇaḥ śrīvivṛddhaye ||
dhṛteḥ |
navamaḥ śūlanāmātha kathyate vyaktabhāgataḥ |
[165] tāmrāruṇagalaś caiva śvetavarṇaḥ kṛśodaraḥ ||
bhālarekhātrayaś caiva trijaṭī nīlakuntalaḥ |
arkahaste yamādisthe triśūlaṃ cātibhīṣaṇam ||
dvitīye mudgaraṃ pāṇau tṛtīye cākṣasūtrakam |
caturthe śṛṅkhalām atra pañcame daṇḍam eva ca ||
ṣaṣṭhe caivāmbujaṃ pāṇau kapālaṃ cottarād ime |
ṭaṅkaṃ dvitīyake caiva tṛtīye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
saṃdaṃśaṃ tu kare turyaṃ pañcame caiva darpaṇam |
patākām atra vai ṣaṣṭhe dhārayann eṣa pūjitaḥ ||
bhaved aniṣṭanāśāya vairividhvastaye nṛṇām ||
śūlasya |
gaṇḍākhyaḥ kathyate yogo daśamaḥ so ‘yam atra hi |
gaṇḍaḥ śubhrāruṇāṅgas tu ṣaḍbhujo mecakāmbaraḥ ||
harinmaṇivibhūṣāḍhyo nīlavidrumakuṇḍalaḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ yamādisthe dvitīye candrahāsakam ||
tṛtīye vārijaṃ nīlaṃ vāmādye vai kamaṇḍalum |
dvitīye kheṭakaṃ haste patākāṃ ca tṛtīyake ||
vidhāno yajvanas tuṣṭyai rogāniṣṭanivṛttaye ||
gaṇḍasya |
ekādaśas tu vṛddhyākhyaḥ kathyate rasacandadoḥ |
pādāruṇāparaśveto bhālavis tīrṇamaṇḍalaḥ ||
vicitravasanopeto muktāsauvarṇabhūṣaṇḥ
[166] akṣasutraṃ yamādisthe dvitīye cāmṛtaṃ ghaṭam ||
tṛtīye nandakaṃ pāṇau caturthe vāṇam eva ca |
pañcame mugdaraṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhe saṃdaṃśam eva ca ||
saptame kambum atraiva paṅkajaṃ cāṣṭame śaye |
kuṇḍikām ādime vāme dvitīye patram eva ca ||
tṛtīya kheṭakaṃ haste caturthe caiva kārmukam |
pañcame ṭaṅkamatraiva ṣaṣṭhe vaiṇaṃ viṣāṇakam ||
saptame cāpam atraiva patākām aṣṭame kare |
bibhrāṇaḥ sreyso vrddhyai cānyugoradhanasya ca \\
vṛddheḥ |
dvādaśo dhrūvanāmā vai yogaś cātraiva kathyate |
dakṣasthālāruṇaś caiva śvetasarvāṅga eva ca ||
māñjiṣṭhavasanopetā hemamukāvibhūṣaṇaḥ |
caturdaśabhujopeto dakṣiṇādye ‘kṣasūtrakam ||
dvitīye tu kajaṃ khaḍgaṃ tṛtīya caiva mudgaram |
caturthe sāyakaṃ haste pañcame caiva paṅkajam ||
ṣaṣṭhe manoharaṃśaṅkhaṃ saptame cāmaraṃ śaye |
pātraṃ saumyādime pāṇau dvitīye caiva kheṭakam ||
ṭaṅkaṃ tṛtīyake haste caturthe caiva kārmukam |
patākām atra vai haste pañcame varalakṣaṇe ||
ṣaṣṭhe manoharādarśo saptame ca kramād dadhat |
pūjanīyo mahābhaktyā lakṣmī sthairyādihetave ||
[167] dhruvasya |
kathyate cādhunā yogo vyāghātākhyas trayodaśaḥ |
nābhyūrdhvaṃ (?) lohitaś cāyaṃ śvetapūrvas trilocanaḥ ||
antaḥśvetāruṇaprāntavasanaḥ sūryakuṇḍalaḥ |
gale sphaṭikamālo ‘sau śeṣarudrākṣabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
maṇibandhālivarṇas tu ṣaḍbhujaḥ kuṭilānanaḥ |
paṅkajaṃ prathame dakṣe dvitīye paraśuṃśaye ||
tṛtīya cātra vai pāśaṃ vāme pātram ihādime |
dvitīye cāmṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ tṛtīye cāṅkuśaṃ śaye ||
bibhrāṇo ‘yaṃ mahāpūjyaḥ kāryabhraṃśativṛttaye ||
vyāghātasya |
adhunā kathyate yogo harṣaṇākhyaś caturdaśaḥ |
jānūrddhe lohitaś cāyaṃ tatpūrvaṃ śveta eva ca ||
pāṭalābhāṃśukopeto muktāvaidūryabhūṣaṇaḥ |
bhujadvādaśakopeto lambakarṇo viśāladṛk ||
kaustubhaṃ prathame dakṣe dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam |
tṛtīye paṅkajaṃ haste caturthe bāṇam eva ca ||
pañcame śaṅkham atraiva ṣaṣṭhe pāśaṃ karāmbuje |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye cāmṛtaṃ ghaṭam ||
tṛtīye paraśuṃ haste caturthe caiva kārmukam |
pañcame tu kare cakraṃ ṣaṣṭhe caivāṅkuśaṃ śaye ||
bibhrāṇaḥ śreyase bhūtyai mānonnatyai sukhāya ca |
[168] harṣaṇasya |
atha pañcadaśī yogaḥ kathyate vajrasaṃjñakaḥ |
śvetāhikāñcīṃ bibhrāṇaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvāruṇānanaḥ ||
rocanāvasanopeto viddhakarṇas trilocanaḥ |
vajravaidūryabhūṣāḍhyaḥ kaṭisūtrasamanvitaḥ ||
jaṭāṃ trivalayaṃ bibhrat digbhujaḥ parito balī |
akṣasūtraṃ yamāditye dvitīye bāṇam eva ca ||
tṛtīye paṅkajaṃ haste caturthe kuliśaṃ śaye |
pañcame paraśuṃ pāṇau vāmādye cāmṛtaṃ ghaṭam ||
dvitīye kārmukaṃ caiva tṛtīye pātram uttamam |
caturthe kuliśaṃ caiva pañcame pāśam eva ca ||
bibhradvijayasaukhyāya lakṣmīsantānavṛddhaye |
vajrasya |
kathyate cādhunā yogaḥ siddhināmā tu ṣoḍaśaḥ |
pādajaṅghāruṇaś corddhve śvetavarṇaḥ śubhānanaḥ ||
digbhujo lohitagrīvo lohitānihitāmbaraḥ |
muktāhāramaṇisvarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ somakuṇḍālaḥ ||
śrīphalaṃ prathame dakṣe dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
tṛtīya pustakaṃ haste caturthe bāṇam eva ca ||
pañcame tu dhvajaṃ haste vāme pātram ihādime |
dvitīye cāmṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ tṛtīye caive cāmaram ||
caturthe caive kodaṇḍaṃ patākām iha pañcame |
[169] dadhānaḥ siddhaye nṝṇāṃ vāñchitārthasya siddhidaḥ ||
siddheḥ |
vyatīpātābhidhaś caiva yogaḥ saptadaśas tv iha |
kaṇṭhena lohitaś cāyaṃ śvetagrīvo ‘limānanaḥ ||
śubhramāñjiṣṭavasano nīlasvarṇajabhūṣaṇaḥ |
aṣṭādaśabhujo devo bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ||
dātramarkādime haste dvitīye loṣṭhabhedanam |
akṣasūtraṃ tṛtīye tu turye bāṇaṃ manoharam ||
pañcame śṛṅkhalāṃ lauhīṃ ṣaṣṭe kavacam eva ca |
saptame mudgaraṃ haste paṅkajaṃ cāṣṭame kare ||
kuddālaṃ navame haste śṛṅgikām ādimottare |
pātraṃ dvitīyake caive svarṇakumbhaṃ tṛtīyake ||
caturthe kārmukaṃ pāṇau pañcame kartikām iha |
muśalaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhe saptame ṭaṅkam eva ca ||
aṣṭame ca dhvajaṃ haste navame prāṅkuṭaṃ śaye |
dadhāno vairivargasya dhvastaye caiva mṛtyave ||
yajvanaḥ putrasantatyai lakṣmībhogasukhāya ca ||
vyatīpātasya |
aṣṭādaśo varīyāṃś ca kathyate yoga uttamaḥ |
ākaṇṭhaśubhravarṇas tu lohitagrīva eva ca ||
śvetavaktro viśālākṣo lambakarṇo ‘rkakuṇḍalaḥ |
[170] svarṇābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyo lakṣaṇānekasaṃyutaḥ ||
sitāmbaro ‘ruṇaprānto dvātriṃśadbhujasaṃyutaḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ yamāditye dvitīye bījapūrakam ||
candrahāsaṃ tṛtīye tu turye bāṇaṃ karāmbuje |
pañcame śaṅkham atraiva ṣaṣṭhe paraśum eva ca ||
saptame mudgaraṃ haste cāṣṭame dātram eva ca |
navame cātra vai śṛṅgaṃ daśame kamalaṃ kare ||
ekādaśe paviṃ cātra dvādaśe halam eva ca |
daṇḍaṃ trayodaśe haste śaktim astraṃ caturdaśe ||
kajaṃ pañcadaśe haste ṣoḍaśe ‘tha triśūlakam |
ghaṭhaṃ vāmādime pāṇau patram atra dvitīyake ||
tṛtīye kheṭakaṃ caiva turye kārmukam eva ca |
cakraṃ tu pañcame haste ṣaṣṭhe caiva kuṭhārakam ||
saptame ṭaṅkam atraiva cāmaraṃ cāṣṭame śaye |
navame ḍamaruṃ caiva daśame cātra vallakīm ||
ekādaśe śṛṇiṃ caiva dvādaśe muśalaṃ śaye |
trayodaśe tu vai pāśaṃ gadām atra caturdaśe ||
darpaṇaṃ tithije haste dhvajam atraiva ṣoḍaśe |
dadhānaḥ śreyase bhūtyai sarvabhogasukhāya ca ||
varīyasaḥ |
ekonaviṃśakaś cātra kathyate parighāsanaḥ |
[171] pādajānvantaśubhro ‘sau śvetavaktro jaṭādharaḥ ||
madhyāruṇodare nīlarekhāsaṃyuta eva ca |
nīlāmbaro mahāsatvo hemaratnajakuṇḍalaḥ ||
suvarṇabhūṣaṇopeto ṣaḍbhujaḥ krūradarśanaḥ |
gadām arkādime haste dvitīye parighaṃ śaye ||
tṛtīye kamalaṃ pāṇau vāmādye pātram eva ca |
dvitīye paṭṭiśaṃ haste tṛtīye cātra vai dhvajam ||
bibhrāṇaḥ śatrunāśāya duṣṭabhītinivṛttaye ||
parighasya |
atha viṃśatimo (?) yogaḥ śivākhyaś cātra kathyate |
śubhravarṇas trinetras tu mauktikābharaṇānvitaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe prathame haste vījapūraṃ manoharam |
akṣasūtraṃ dvitīye ca tṛtīye kambum eva ca ||
caturthe sāyakaṃ haste pañcame candrahāsakam |
mudgaraṃ ca kare ṣaṣṭhe saptame paraśuṃ śaye ||
kuddālam aṣṭame pāṇau navame dātram eva ca |
daśame cātra vai śṛṅgaṃ pavim ekādaśe tv iha ||
dvādaśe pañcaśākhāṃ vai loṣṭabhedanam eva ca |
trayodaśe halaṃ caiva śaktim astraṃ caturdaśe ||
kare pañcadaśe daṇḍaṃ ṣoḍaśe cāmbujaṃ tv iha |
triśūlaṃ municandre ca vasucandre ca tomaram ||
vāmādime śaye pātraṃ dvitīye cāmṛtaṃ ghaṭam |
[172] tṛtīye cakram atraiva caturthe vai śarāsanam ||
pañcame kheṭakaṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe ṭaṅkaṃ karāmbuje |
kuṭhāraṃ saptame pāṇau prāṅkuṭaṃ cāṣṭame tv iha ||
navame cāmaraṃ śubhraṃ daśame ḍamaruṃ tv iha |
śṛṇim ekādaśe haste dvādaśe caiva darpaṇam ||
aṣṭādaśe śaye kuntaṃ bibhrāṇaḥ śāntivṛddhaye ||
śobhanasya |
ekaviṃśo ‘dhunā yogaḥ siddhināmābhidhīyate (?) |
javākusumasaṅkāśaḥ śubhrarekhātrayodaraḥ ||
jaṭābhir aṣṭabhis tasya mukuṭaḥ khaṇḍacandrayuk |
śoṇaśubhrāṃśukopetaḥ sphāṭikābharaṇānvitaḥ ||
vasupakṣabhujaḥ saumyas tundilaḥ sarvalakṣaṇaḥ |
tomaraṃ cādime dakṣe dvitīye ‘tra triśūlakam ||
tṛtīye paṅkajaṃ pāṇau turye daṇḍaṃ suvarṇajam |
pañcame tu kare śaktiṃ ṣaṣṭhe vai lāṅgalaṃ śaye ||
saptame kuliśaṃ haste śṛṅgam atraiva cāṣṭame |
navame dātram atraiva daśame tu parasvadham ||
mudgaraṃ rudrahaste vai dvādaśe candrahāsakam |
trayodaśe śaye bāṇaṃ śaṅkham atra caturdaśe ||
[173] kumbham idrādime haste dvitīye ḍamaruṃ śaye |
pātraṃ tu naveme haste daśame vai kuṭhārakam ||
ṭaṅkam ekādaśe haste dvadaśe caiva kheṭakam |
trayodaśe śaye cāpaṃ cakram atra caturdaśe ||
dārayan pūjanīyo ‘sau bhogasaukhyaśriye jaye ||
siddheḥ |
sādhyo dvāviṃsakaś caiva kathyate yoga eva saḥ |
śubhravarṇo viśālākṣo vahnirekhāgalānanaḥ ||
kausumbhavasanopeto vajravaidūryakuṇḍalaḥ |
devavahnibhujopeto mekhalānekaratnayuk ||
akṣasūtraṃ yamāditye dvitīye bījapūrakam |
tṛtīye śaktim atraiva turye caiva triśūlakam ||
pañcame sāyakaṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe vajraṃ karāmbuje |
saptame paṅkajaṃ pāṇau daṇḍam atraiva cāṣṭame ||
navame tomaraṃ pāṇau daśame śaktim eva ca |
ekādaśe halaṃ haste dvādaśe śṛṅgam eva ca ||
trayodaśe śaye khaḍgaṃ paraśuṃ tu caturdaśe |
kare pañcadaśe ramye mudgaraṃ kaṭhināṅgulau ||
ṣaḍaśe dātram atraiva śaṅkhaṃ saptadaśe tv iha |
vāmādime kare kuṇḍīṃ dvitīye pātram eva ca ||
tṛtīye cābhayaṃ haste turye ḍamarum eva ca |
[174] pañcame kārmukaṃ pāṇau ṣaṣṭhe caivāṅkuśaṃ śaye ||
saptame tu dhvajaṃ divyam aṣṭame pāśam eva ca |
navame kuntam atraiva daśame tu gadām iha ||
muśalaṃ rudrahaste vai dvādaśe caiva cāmaram |
trayodaśe kare kheṭaṃ kuṭhāraṃ tu caturdaśe ||
ṭaṅkaṃ pañcadaśe pāṇau ṣoḍaśe caiva darpaṇam |
cakraṃ saptadaśe haste dadhānaḥ śrīvivṛddhaye ||
sādhyasya |
śubhanāmā trayoviṃśo yogaś cātraiva kathyate |
nīlakālikaśoṇas tu mauktikābhas trilocanaḥ ||
śoṇarekhāṅkitagrīvaḥ śoṇaśubhrāṃsukāvṛtaḥ |
muktāvidrumamāṇikyabhūṣaṇaḥ svarṇakuṇḍalaḥ ||
dātriṃśadbāhusaṃyukto jaṭākapilamaṇḍalaḥ |
varaṃ yamādime pāṇau dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam ||
tṛtīye ca triśūlaṃ vai turye bāṇaṃ karāmbuje |
pañcame paṅkajaṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhe kuliśam eva ca ||
saptame śaktim atraiva daṇḍaṃ vai cāṣṭame kare |
navame tomaraṃ haste daśame śṛṅgikām iha ||
halam ekādaśe caiva dvādaśe khaḍgam atra hi |
datraṃ tryodaśe haste mudgaraṃ ca caturdaśe ||
śaṅkhaṃ pañcadaśe pāṇau ṣoḍaśe tu parasvadham |
abhayaṃ cādime vāme dvitīye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
[175] tṛtīye pātram atraiva turye kārmukam eva ca |
pañcame ḍamaruṃ pāṇau ṣaṣṭhe cāṅkuśam eva ca ||
saptame vījapūraṃ vai dhvajaṃ vai cāṣṭame kare |
navame pānapātraṃ ca daśame kuntam eva ca ||
gadām ekādaśe haste dvādaśe caiva kheṭikam |
cāmaraṃ manmathe pāṇau ṛaṅkam atra caturdaśe ||
cakraṃ pañcadaśe caiva ṣoḍaśe tu kuṭhārakam |
bibhrāṇo bhuktaye pūjyaḥ saundaryāya sukhāya ca ||
śubhasya |
caturviṃśatim athātra śuklākhyaḥ kathyate ‘dhunā |
cibuke lohitaś cāyaṃ candragauras trilocanaḥ ||
jaṭāmukuṭakhaṇḍendunīlarekhās trilocanaḥ |
sindaravadanopeto bhālālitilakāṅkitaḥ ||
pravālamauktikasvarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ kaṇṭhakaustubhaḥ |
khavahnivāhusaṃyukto ratnamudrāsamanvitaḥ ||
śūrpākṣamālikāṃ yāmye prathame karapallave |
dvitīye ca triśūlaṃ vai tṛtīye bāṇam eva ca ||
param vadhaṃ kare turye pañcame śaṅkham eva ca |
mudgaraṃ cātra vai ṣaṣṭhe saptame dātram eva ca ||
aṣṭame tu kare khaḍgaṃ navame caiva lāṅgalam |
daśame śṛṅgam atraiva tomaraṃ rudrasaṃmite ||
[176] dvādaśe tu kare daṇḍaṃ śaktim atra trayodaśe |
caturdaśe śaye vajraṃ kare pañcadaśe kajam ||
vījapūraṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye pātram eva ca |
tṛtīye kārmukaṃ pāṇau turye caiva kuṭhārakam ||
pañcame cakram atraiva ṣaṣṭhe ṭaṅkaṃ karāmbuje |
saptame cāmaraṃ pāṇau kheṭakaṃ cāṣṭame śaye ||
navame tu gadām atra daśame vāmṛtaṃ ghaṭam |
kuntam ekādaśe haste dvādaśe pātram eva ca ||
trayodaśe śṛṇiṃ caiva darpaṇaṃ ca caturdaśe |
dhvajaṃ pañcadaśe haste dadhānas tu mahāya ca ||
śuklasya |
pañcaviṃśatimo yogo brahmanāmā pratīyate |
śoṇorūpāṇḍurāśeṣo candragauras trilocanaḥ ||
nīlakālikaśoṇas tu grīvāsvarṇas trirekhikaḥ |
jaṭātrayapralambo ‘sau saumyaḥ prahasitānana ||
tāmravarṇāṃsukopetaḥ kaṇṭharudrākṣamālikaḥ |
suktāmāṇikyahemotthabhūṣaṇaḥ somakuṇḍalaḥ ||
viyadvāṇdabhujopetaḥ kiṅkaṇījālamekhalaḥ |
saumyākṣamālikāṃ dakṣe prathame talaśobhane ||
dvitīye tu varaṃ pāṇau dhaḍgam atra trayodaśe |
halaṃ caturdaśe haste śṛṅgaṃ pañcadaśe tv iha ||
ṣoḍaśe caiva lohāsiṃ munirandhre ca tomaram |
[177] aṣṭādaśe śaye daṇḍaṃ śaktim ekonaviṃśake ||
kare viṃśatime cakraṃ tv ekaviṃśe śaye kajam |
dvāviṃśe camasaṃ haste trayoviṃśe śaye ‘rbudam ||
caturviṃśatime pāṇau sudṛṣṭaṃ lohabhedanam |
pañcaviṃśe tu rakṣāstraṃ vāmādye vai kamaṇdalum ||
dvitīye cābhayaṃ haste tṛtīye cātra vai dhruvam |
turye khaṭvāṅgam eveha kuddālaṃ caiva pañcame ||
ṣaṣṭhe śarāsanaṃ pāṇau saptame kavacaṃ śaye |
aṣṭame paṭṭiśaṃ haste navame vai sudarśanam ||
daśame bījapūraṃ vai pāśam ekādaśe kare |
dvādaśe cātra vai ṭaṅkaṃ kheṭam atra trayodaśe ||
caturdaśe kuṭhārākhyaṃ ḍamaruṃ tithisaṃjñite |
ṣoḍaśe cāmaraṃ haste kumbhaṃ saptadaśe tv iha ||
aṣṭādaśe gadām atra muśalaṃ nandacandrame |
aṅkuśam viṃśake haste pāśaṃ caivaikaviṃśake ||
dvāviṃśake dhvajaṃ śubhraṃ vīrabhadraṃ tripakṣaje |
jine sunirmalādarśaṃ pañca viṃśe ‘jinaṃ śaye ||
dadhāno yajvano gotraparamāyurvivṛddhaye ||
brahmaṇaḥ |
aindraḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ cātra kathyate tava sāṃpratam |
[178] hastapādāruṇaś cāyaṃ śeṣaḥ śubhrāyate ‘kṣaṇaḥ ||
dharmillamallikāmālyacandanādyanulepanaḥ |
bhālālitilakaś caiva karṇakuṇḍalamecakaḥ ||
muktāhārojvaloraskaḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣaṇaḥ |
śubhraśocendranīlābhavsanaḥ sarvalakaṇaḥ ||
yugmabāṇabhujopeto manāgaruṇalocanaḥ |
śaktimarkādime haste dvitīye mauktikasrajam ||
tṛtīye kamalaṃ pāṇau caturthe śuktikām iha |
sruvantu pañcame pāṇau ṣaṣṭhe cātra triśūlakam ||
saptame caiva yodhāsiṃ kuddālaṃ cāṣṭame kare |
navame patrikāṃ caiva daśame candrahāsakam ||
ekādaśe halaṃ haste dvādaśe śṛṅgam eva ca |
tomaraṃ manmathe pāṇau daṇḍaṃ caiva caturdaśe ||
kare pañcadaśe śaktiṃ ṣoḍaśe kuliśaṃ śaye |
cakraṃ ca municandrārke vasucandre parasvadham ||
ekonaviṃśake kanduṃ viṃśake pustakaṃ tv iha |
viṣṭare tv ekaviṃśe vai dvāviṃśe caiva mudgaram ||
camasaṃ tu trayoviṃśe caturviṃśe tv ihārbudam |
pañcaviṃśatime haste loṣṭabhedanam eva ca ||
ṣaḍviṃśe ca turuṣkāsraṃ vāmādye vābhayaṃ śaye |
dvitīye kuṇḍikām atra tṛtīye bījapūrakam ||
[179] turyavāme ghṛtaṃ pātraṃ pañcame sruvam eva hi |
ṣaṣṭhe khaṭvāṅgam eveha saptame ḍamaruṃ śaye ||
aṣṭame prāṅkuṭaṃ pāṇau navame caiva kārmukam |
daśame kheṭakaṃ haste rudre caiva kuṭārakam ||
dvādaśe cāmaraṃ haste kuntam atra trayodaśe |
gadāṃ caturdaśe caiva muśalaṃ tithisaṃmite ||
aṅkuśaṃ ṣoḍaśe haste pāśaṃ saptadaśe kare |
paṭṭiśaṃ vasucandrāke cakraṃ tv ekonaviṃśake ||
kavacaṃ viṃśake caiva dātraṃ caivaikaviṃśake |
dvāviṃśake tu vai ṭaṅkaṃ trayoviṃśe dhavjaṃ tv iha ||
vīrabhadraṃ caturviṃśe pañcaviṃśe tu darpaṇam |
ajinaṃ cātra ṣaḍviṃśe bibhrāṇaḥ śrīvivṛddhaye ||
aindrasya |
vaidhṛtyākhyas tu vai yogaḥ saptaviṃśatimas tv iha |
śubhravarṇo mahāraudro grīvāśoṇaḥ sitānanaḥ ||
jaṭāpañcapralambas tu mecakāruṇakuṇḍalaḥ |
nīlaśoṇasuvarṇotthabhūṣaṇo mecakāmbaraḥ ||
vedavāṇabhujopeto bṛhatkukṣisumantharaḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ yamāditye dvitīye varam eva ca ||
tṛtīye caiva saṃdaṃśaṃ turye śuktiṃ samudrajām |
[180] pañcame paṅkajaṃ pāṇau ṣaṣṭhe cātra śruvaṃ tathā ||
saptame sāyakaṃ pāṇau jñānaṃ khaḍgam ihāṣṭame |
navame caiva kuddālaṃ daśame ca triśūlakam ||
śṛṅgam ekādaśe haste dvādaśe halam eva ca |
trayodaśe tu vai khaḍgaṃ tomaraṃ tu caturdaśe ||
kare pañcadaśe daṇḍaṃ ṣoḍaśe śaktim eva ca |
vajraṃ saptadaśe pāṇau kavacaṃ vasucandraje ||
paraśuṃ nandacandrotthe viṃśake cārbudaṃ kare |
ekaviṃśe śaye caiva loṣṭabhedanam eva ca ||
dvāviṃśe vai turuṣkāstraṃ trayoviṃśe tu śaṅkhakam |
pustakaṃ tu caturviṃśe pañcaviṃśe tu viṣṭaram ||
ṣaḍviṃśe mudgaraṃ pāṇau camasaṃ saptaviṃśake |
vāmādime kare kuṇḍīm abhayaṃ tu dvitīyake ||
mīnaṃ tṛtīyake haste caturthe bījapūraṇam |
pañcame pātram atraiva ṣaṣṭhe caiva śruvaṅkare ||
saptame kārmukaṃ pāṇau ḍamaruṃ cāṣṭame kare |
navame prāṅkuṭaṃ haste khaṭvāṅgaṃ caiva dikkare ||
cāmaraṃ rudraje caiva dvādaśe ‘tra kuṭhārakam |
kheṭaṃ trayodaśe caiva kuntam atra caturdaśe ||
gadāṃ pañcadaśe pāṇau ṣoḍaśe muśalaṃ tv iha |
śṛṇiṃ saptadaśe haste pāśam aṣṭādaśe kare ||
paṭṭiśaṃ nandacandrotthe vīrabhadraṃ tu viṃśake |
ekaviṃśe śaye ṭaṅkaṃ dvāviṃśe cājinaṃ kare ||
[181] trayoviṃśe tu vai cakraṃ kavacaṃ jinahastake |
pañcaviṃśe tu vai pātraṃ ṣaḍviṃśe darpaṇaṃ śubham ||
saptaviṃśe dhvajaṃ haste dhārayan duṣṭaghātakṛt ||
vaidhṛteḥ |
iti yogānāṃ rūpāṇi |
karaṇānām atho vakṣye rūpasaṃbandhilakṣaṇam |
vavābhidhaṃ tu vai pītaṃ jaṭilaṃ ratnakuṇḍalam ||
nīlavastraṃ tu rudrākṣabhūṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhapāṇḍuram |
caturdaśabhujopetaṃ piṅgabhrūlocanatrayam ||
varaṃ yamādime haste dvitīye bāṇam eva ca |
tṛtīye kuliśaṃ pāṇau caturthe caiva paṅkajam ||
mudgaraṃ pañcame caiva ṣaṣṭhe saṃdaṃśam eva ca |
saptame vāṅkuśaṃ divyaṃ pañcaśākhe mahodare ||
prathame vābhayaṃ vāme dvitīye tu śarāsanam |
tṛtīye pustakaṃ haste caturthe mukuraṃ śaye ||
ṭaṅkaṃ tu pañcame pāṇau ṣaṣṭhe kartarikām iha |
kare tu saptame cātra nāgapāśaṃ dadhacchriye ||
bavasya |
vālavākhyaṃ tu vai raktaṃ nīlagrīvaṃ mahodaram |
[182] śvetavastraṃ jaṭābhāraṃ piṅgalaṃ tuṅganāsikam ||
kaṇṭharudrākṣamālaṃ tadbhūtimatkālapāṇḍuram |
rasacandrakaropetaṃ kakṣālagnakaraṇḍakam ||
prathame modakaṃ haste dakṣiṇe sumanohare |
dvitīye ketakīpatraṃ tṛtīye śaktim eva ca ||
caturthe paṅkajaṃ pāṇau pañcame vai sudarśanam |
ṣaṣṭhe sarvāyasaṃ bāṇaṃ saptame kuliśaṃ kare ||
saṃdaṃśam aṣṭame haste pātraṃ vāmādime tv iha |
dvitīye kuṇḍikām atra tṛtīye caiva paṭṭiśam ||
bījapūraṃ kare turye pañcame śaṅkham eva ca |
kodaṇḍam atra vai ṣaṣṭhe saptame kuliśaṃ kare ||
aṣṭame pustakaṃ bibhrad vaśyāya vijayāya ca ||
vālavasya
śvetābjakarṇikābhāsaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kaulavābhidam |
raktakaṇṭhaṃ pikāsyaṃ vai nīlaśvetāruṇāmbaram ||
muktārudrākṣasauvarṇabhūṣaṇaṃ cendranīlakam |
aṣṭādaśabhujopetaṃ kiṅkiṇī kaṭisūtrakam ||
varaṃ yamādime haste dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam |
tṛtīye svarṇajaṃ daṇḍaṃ caturthe caiva pustakam ||
pañcame modakaṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe saṃdaṃśam eva ca |
saptame ḍamaruṃ pāṇau vajram atraiva cāṣṭame ||
[183] navame śṛṅgikām atra śoṇaguñjādyanām imām |
abhayaṃ cādime vāme dvitīye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
tṛtīye vāsavaṃ pātraṃ turye cāmbhojam uttamam |
pañcame cāmaraṃ śubhraṃ ṣaṣṭhe dātraṃ karāmbuje ||
saptame vallakīm atra śṛṇiṃ caivāṣṭame kare |
navame kadalīpatraṃ dadhat saṃpad sukhāya ca ||
kaulavasya |
caturthaṃ taitilaṃ nāma śyāmavarṇaṃ kṛśodaram |
śoṇavastraṃ javāpuṣpamālikaṃ taittirānanam ||
viyatpakṣabhujopetaṃ ghaṇṭāvad vanitambakam |
prathame dakṣiṇe haste śrīphalaṃ sumanoharam ||
khaḍgam atra dvitīye vai tṛtīye caiva pustakam |
akṣasūtraṃ kare turye pañcame bāṇam eva ca ||
ṣaṣṭhe sudarśanaṃ divyaṃ saptame kuliśaṃ tv iha |
aṣṭame tu sruvaṃ pāṇau navame caiva mudgaram ||
daśame cāṅkuśaṃ haste pātraṃ vāmādime kare |
dvitīye kheṭakaṃ caiva tṛtīye vārijaṃ śubham ||
caturthe kuṇḍikām atra pañcame caiva kārmukam |
ṣaṣṭhe manoharaṃ śaṅkhaṃ saptame cāmaraṃ sitam ||
sruvaṃ caivāṣṭame haste navame ṭaṅkam atra hi |
daśame tu kare pāśaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ yajvanaḥ śriye ||
[184] taitilasya |
pañcamaṃ cātra vijñeyaṃ karaṇaṃ tu garābhidham |
gomukhaṃ citritagrīvaṃ dhūmaraṃ lohitāmbaram ||
pakṣapakṣabhujopetaṃ kṛtapadmākṣabhūṣaṇam |
ādime dakṣiṇe śaktiṃ dvitīye cakram eva ca ||
tṛtīye śrīphalaṃ haste caturthe caiva paṅkajam |
pañcame pustakaṃ ramyaṃ ṣaṣṭhe bāṇaṃ manoharam ||
saptame govṛṣaṃ śṛṅgaṃ kuliśaṃ cāṣṭame kare |
navame vallakīm atra daśame vīrabhadrakam ||
ekādaśe tu saṃdaṃśaṃ pañcaśākhe manohare |
abhītim uttarādisthe dvitīye śaṅkham atra hi ||
pātram atra tṛtīye vai caturthe caiva cāmaram |
pañcame ḍamaruṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe caiva śarāsanam ||
saptame kuṇḍikām atra cāṣṭame daśacakrakam |
navame tu kare vaṃśaṃ daśame caiva darpaṇam ||
ekādaśe tu rudrāstraṃ bibhrat kīrtisukhaśriye ||
garasya |
vānarāsyaṃ vaṇik dhūmraṃ pītavastraṃ vṛṣāsanam |
yugabāhuyutaṃ cedaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ kanakabhūṣaṇam ||
varamarkādime haste dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam |
tṛtīye śuktikām atra modakaṃ tu caturthake ||
[185] pañcame kuliśaṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe śaktiṃ karāmbuje |
saptame vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ khaḍgam atraiva cāṣṭame ||
navame pāśam atraiva daśame caiva vai dhvajam |
ekādaśe turuṣkāstraṃ dvādaśe vai sudarśanam ||
saumyādime kare ‘bhītiṃ dvitīye vai kamaṇḍalum |
bījapūraṃ tṛtīye ‘tra pānapatraṃ caturthake ||
pañcame pañcavaktrākhyaṃ ṣaṣṭhe caive tu paṭṭiśam |
saptame cāmaraṃ haste kheṭakaṃ cāṣṭame śaye ||
navame cāṅkuśaṃ pāṇau daśame halam eva ca |
ekādaśe kare ramyaṃ darpaṇaṃ cātinirmalam ||
dvādaśe dhārayan śaṅkhaṃ lakṣmīsaubhāgyavṛddhaye ||
vaṇijaḥ |
vyāghacarmāmbarā bhadrā śvetābhā gardabhānanā |
saptabāhusamopetā tripadā lohabhūṣaṇā ||
kartikām ādime dakṣe dvitīye tu gadām iha |
tṛtīye sāyakaṃ haste caturthe candrahāsakam ||
kheṭam ūrdhvakare vāme tadadhaś caiva kārmukam |
pātram asmād asho vāme dhārayantī ripor bhaye ||
bhadrāyāḥ |
aṣṭamaṃ śakuniprakhyaṃ karaṇaṃ haritaprabham |
[186] pravālabhūṣaṇopetaṃ śakragopanibhāmbaram ||
rasapakṣabhujopetam eṇavaktraṃ vṛkodaram |
ādime ravije cakraṃ dvitīye varam eva ca ||
akṣasūtraṃ tṛtīye tu turye caiva tu paṅkajam |
pañcame modakaṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe vajraṃ karāmbuje ||
saptame tomaraṃ pāṇau śaktim atraiva cāṣṭame |
navame hastijaṃ dantaṃ daśame candrahāskam ||
ekādaśe kare bāṇaṃ dvādaśe vāṅkuśaṃ śaye |
trayodaśe gadām atra śaṅkhaṃ vāmādime kare ||
abhayaṃ tu dvitīye ‘tra tṛtīye vai kamaṇḍalum |
bījapūraṃ kare turye pañcame pātram eva ca ||
ṣaṣṭhe karāmbuje śṛṅgaṃ saptame kuntam eva ca |
parighaṃ vāṣṭame haste daṇḍaṃ tu navame śaye ||
kheṭakaṃ daśame pāṇau dhanur ekādaśe śaye |
dvādaśe pātram atraiva triśūlaṃ tu trayodaśe ||
dadhānaḥ śreyase bhūtyai vijayāya sukhāya ca |
tāpāya caiva śatrūṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa samarcitam ||
śakuniḥ |
catuṣpadābhidhaṃ cātra navamaṃ kathyate jaya |
[187] kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ catuṣpādaṃ caturāsyaṃ jaṭānvitam ||
manuṣyāsyaṃ tu vai pūrvaṃ dakṣīṇaṃ caiva gomukham |
ajāsyaṃ paścimaṃ tasya cottaraṃ śūkarānanam ||
manuṣyākāravat sarvaṃ trikapucchavinirgatam |
pautavastraṃ bṛhatkukṣi nīlamuktāvibhūṣaṇam ||
vasupakṣabhujopetaṃ dīrghanādaṃ mahājavam |
dakṣiṇādye kare śaktiṃ dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam ||
sudarśanaṃ tṛtīye tu caturthe caiva paṅkajam |
pañcame mudgaraṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhe sodakam eva ca ||
saptame tu gadāṃ pāṇāv aṣṭame vāṅkuśaṃ śaye |
navame tu kare bāṇaṃ daśame khaḍgam eva ca ||
ekādaśe kare dantaṃ dvādaśe śaktim atra hi |
trayodaśe śaye cātra tomaraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ śubham ||
caturdaśe tu vai vajraṃ vāmādye bhautim eva ca ¦
kamaṇḍaluṃ dvitīye vai tṛtīye śaṅkham eva ca ||
caturthe bījapūraṃ vai pañcame ṭaṅkam eva ca |
ṣaṣṭhe pātraṃ sudhāpūrṇaṃ saptame ca triśūlakam ||
aṣṭame pātram atraiva navame dhanur eva ca |
daśame kheṭakaṃ haste daṇḍam ekādaśe kare ||
dvādaśe paṭṭiśaṃ pāṇau kuntam atra trayodaśe |
śṛṅgaṃ caturdaśe bibhrad gotravṛddhyai supūjitaḥ ||
[188] nāgākhyaṃ daśamaṃ raktaṃ nīlavastraṃ jaṭādharam |
manuṣyākāram evaitan mastakaṃ nyastatatphalam ||
viyadguṇabhujopetaṃ muktārudrākṣabhūṣaṇam |
prathame modakaṃ dakṣe dvitīye caiva paṅkajam ||
akṣasūtraṃ tṛtīye ‘tra varaṃ turye karāmbuje |
pañcame tu kare cakraṃ ṣaṣṭhe vajraṃ tu vai śave ||
saptame tomaraṃ pāṇau śaktim atraiva cāṣṭame |
navame sojvalaṃ dantaṃ daśame candrahāsakam ||
bāṇam ekādaśē haste dvādaśe cāṅkuśaṃ śaye |
trayodaśe gadām atra turuṣkāstraṃ caturdaśe ||
kare pañcadaśe dātraṃ vāme pātraṃ tu cādime |
bījapūraṃ dvitīye ‘tra tṛtīye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
caturthe cābhayaṃ haste pañcame śaṅkham eva ca |
ṣaṣṭhe karāmbuje śṛṅgaṃ saptame kutam uttamam ||
paṭṭiśaṃ cāṣṭame haste navame daṇḍam atra hi |
daśame kheṭakaṃ caiva dhanur ekādaśe kare ||
dvādaśe pāśam atraiva triśūlaṃ ca trayodaśe |
caturdaśe daśāsyaṃ vai kare pañcadaśe ‘rbudam ||
dadhānaṃ vijayārogyaṃ kurvītābhayadaṃ nṛṇām ||
nāgasya |
ekādaśaṃ tu kintughnaṃ karaṇaṃ kathyate ‘dhunā |
[189] gokṣīradhavalaṃ caitat pītavastraṃ hayānanam ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dvātriṃśadbāhusaṃyutam |
varaṃ caivādime dakṣe dvitīye cākṣasūtrakam ||
tṛtīye sojvalaṃ cakraṃ turye cābjaṃ karāmbuje |
pañcame modakaṃ haste ṣaṣṭhe vai kuliśaṃ śaye ||
sapatame tomaraṃ pāṇau śaktim atraiva cāṣṭame |
navame gajadandaṃ ca daśame khaḍgam uttamam ||
ekādaśe tu vai bāṇaṃ dvādaśe śṛṇim eva ca |
trayodaśe gadām atra ḍamaruṃ ca caturdaśe ||
kare pañcadaśe pustīṃ paraśuṃ caiva ṣoḍaśe |
abhayaṃ cādime vāme dvitīye vai kamaṇḍalum ||
śaṅkham atra tṛtīye vai caturthe bījapūrakam |
pañcame cāsavaṃ pātraṃ ṣaṣṭhe śṛṅgaṃ manoraham ||
saptame kuntam atraiva cāṣṭame paṭṭiśaṃ śaye |
navame vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ daśame kheṭam eva ca ||
cāpam ekādaśe pāṇau dvādaśe pātram atra hi |
trayodaśe triśūlaṃ vai ṭaṅkam atra caturdaśe ||
vīṇām iṣvinduhaste ca dhvajaṃ caiva tu ṣoḍaśe |
dharayd vairiṇāṃ dhvastyai pūjanīyaṃ vipaścitā ||
vidyālābhāya saṃtuṣṭivijayādisukhārthinā |
kintughnasya |
iti karaṇarūpāṇi |
[190] atha rāśirūpāṇi |
meṣavaktro naro rakto dvibhujaḥ paṅkajāsanaḥ |
jñānamudrāṅkaraḥ pītavasanaḥ kanakāṅgadī ||
meṣasya |
vṛṣānano naraḥ śubhro raktavstrākṣakuṇḍikaḥ |
vṛṣasya |
pumān gadī savīṇā vā yoṣic ca mithunaṃ sitam |
mithunasya |
kakaṭaḥ kapilo śvāsyaḥ kūrmamudrādharo naraḥ |
karkaṭasya |
siṃhavaktro ‘ruṇo ‘bjastho dvibhujo ‘bhayapātrayuk |
siṃhasya |
śuklāsibhṛt sitā kanyā dvibhujā paṅkajāsanā |
kanyāyāḥ |
tulādharo naro gauraḥ piṅganetrakajāsanaḥ |
tūlasya |
vṛścikastho naraḥ piṅgo dvibhujo markaṭānanaḥ |
dakṣe vṛścikamālādhṛk vāme pātraṃ surāyutam ||
[191] vṛścikasya |
aśvavaktro naraś cāpī jyākṛṣṭakaradakṣiṇaḥ |
dhanuḥ |
akṣakuṇḍīdharo nīlo mṛgavaktro naro hi saḥ |
makarasya |
makarāsyo sito ‘bhastho riktakumbo naro ghaṭaḥ |
kumbasya |
matsyayugmasthitaḥ śyāmo matsyahasto vṛhodaraḥ |
matsavaktro naro maunī harinmaṇivibhūṣiṇaḥ ||
maunasya | viṣṇudharmottarāt |
kālaḥ karālavadano nityagaś ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
pāśahastaś ca kartavyaḥ sarpavṛścikaromavān ||
kālasya | viśvakarmaśāstrāt |
nimeṣas tu bhaved atra mecakābhordhanīladṛk |
akṣasūtraṃ kare dakṣe jñānamudrām athottare ||
dadhāno yogasaṃsiddhyai pūjanīyo vipaścitā |
[192] nimeṣasya |
nīlavarṇā bhavet kāṣṭhā pītavastrā trilocanā |
aṣṭādaśabhujopetā jñānapustīsamanvitā ||
kāṣṭhāyāḥ |
śuklavarṇā kalā jñeyā nīlavastrā trilocanā |
vyomavajrāṅkarudrākṣakaṇṭhalimbitamālikā ||
muktākṣamālikārkā sā vāmapaṅkajasaṃyutā |
pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa jñān vijñānahetave ||
kalāyāḥ |
kṣaṇābhidho bhavet pītā munipakṣasumauktikaḥ |
jaṭātrimauktikopetaś candanālikapāṇḍuraḥ ||
muktāsūtrārkahastīyaṃ vāme svarṇakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
kṣaṇasya |
muhūrtān adhunā vacmi nāmalakṣapṛthakphalaiḥ |
tatrādim astu raudrākṣaḥ śyāmaśvetāruṇachaviḥ ||
śvetavastro mahātuṅgo dakṣiṇe sarpam ādadhat |
vāme pātraṃ sudhāpūrṇaṃ kṣudrakarmaprasiddhaye ||
raudrasya |
sitābhidho dvitīyas tu śvetavarṇo mahodayaḥ |
[193] śvetaśoṇābhavastro ‘yaṃ śvetamuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe paṅkajaṃ śubhraṃ vāme caiva kamaṇḍalum |
dadhānas tu śriyau pūjyo yogavṛddhyai sukhāya ca ||
sitasya |
tṛtīyo ‘thājapākhyas tu kṛṣṇaḥ śubhro mahātanuḥ |
dakṣiṇe paṅkajaṃ nīlaṃ vāme sarpaṃ mahāphaṇam |
bibhrad vipulabhogāya pūjanīyo mahādhiyā ||
ajapasya |
turyaś cāryabhaṭākhyas tu nīlaḥ śubhro mahodaraḥ |
dakṣiṇe pustakaṃ haste vāme caiva triśūlakam |
dadhānaḥ śreyase bhūtyai vijayāya sukhāya ca ||
āryabhaṭasya |
adhunā caiva sāvitraḥ pañcamaḥ pathyate jaya |
śvetavarṇo ‘śvakatras tu mecakāvasanānvitaḥ ||
pustakaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāme kuṇḍaṃ tu nirvraṇam |
dadhad rogavināśāya pūjanīyo ‘py aharniśam ||
sāvitryasya |
vairājaś cātra vai ṣaṣṭhaḥ śyāmavarṇo jaṭādharaḥ |
dakṣiṇe tu kare daṇḍaṃ vāme caiva sruvaṃ kare ||
bibhrad vṛddhyai ca saukhyāya pūjanīyo ‘tibhaktitaḥ |
[194] vairājasya |
saptamaś cātra gandharvas tāmravarṇaḥ kṛśodaraḥ |
dakṣiṇe vallakīṃ pāṇau vāme śaktiś ca dhārayet |
saukhyavṛddhyai yaśovṛddhyai pūjanīyo vipaścitā ||
gandharvasya |
adhunā cābhijin nāma kathyate hy aṣṭamaḥ śubhaḥ |
pītavarṇo ‘tihrasvas tu tāmravarṇo mahodaraḥ |
tūlahastadvayopetaḥ pūjanīyaḥ sukhāptaye ||
abhijitaḥ |
sa eva kutapo nāma vijñātavyo manīṣibhiḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ supriyaś caiva piṇḍahasto ‘tha cāpy ayam ||
kutapasya |
navamo rauhiṇyeyākhyo muhūrtaḥ kathyate jaya |
śubhravarṇo viśālākṣo nīlavastro ‘bhrakuṇḍalaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe paṅkajaṃ pāṇau vāme modakam eva ca |
dadhānaḥ sukhasaṃpattyai vijayāromyavṛddhaye ||
rauhiṇeyasya |
adhunā kathyate vatsa daśamas tu valābhidhaḥ |
gauravarṇo ‘ruṇaśvetavasanaḥ svarṇakuṇḍalaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe tu kare śaṅkhaṃ vāme paṅkajam ādadhat ||
[195] valasya |
hemavarṇo bṛhadgātraḥ kṛṣṇaśvetāruṇāṃśukaḥ |
akṣasūtraṃ kare dakṣe vāme caiva kamaṇḍalum ||
dadhat prajāsukhātyarthaṃ pūjanīyo vipaścitā |
ekādaśo ‘dhunā jñeyo mahūrto vijayābhidhaḥ ||
vijayasya |
nairṛtākhyo ‘dhunā jñeyo dvādaśas tu muhūrtakaḥ |
nīlavarṇotpalamauliḥ pītavastro mahābalaḥ |
dakṣiṇe tu kare cakraṃ vāme cābhayam ādadhat ||
nairṛtasya |
trayodaśī bhaved atra raktaḥ satamasābhidhaḥ |
tāmravastro mahojasko ratnahemajakuṇḍalaḥ |
śoṇapaṅkajadakṣas tu vāmakuṇḍīsamanvitaḥ ||
satamasasya |
muhūrtaḥ kathyate cātra varuṇākhyaś caturdaśaḥ |
muktāphalanibhaś caiva muktāhāravibhūṣiṇaḥ |
dhanurbāṇadharaś caiva pūjanīyaḥ sukhāptaye ||
varuṇasya |
atha pañcadaśo jñeyaḥ subhagas tu haritprabhaḥ |
[196] subhagasya |
atho niśacarān brūmo muhūrtān tithisaṃkhyakān |
tatrādimo ‘tiraudrākhyaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo ‘ruṇāṃśukaḥ ||
caturbhujo mahākrūraḥ sāsthisaṅghaṭakevalaḥ |
ādime dakṣiṇe bibhrat kauśikaṃ cātibhauṣaṇam ||
dvitīye tu kare sarpaṃ vāmo ‘ṅgatve ‘tha vai kare |
sandaṃśaṃ tadadhaḥ pātraṃ bibhrāṇaḥ sarvavighnahā ||
atiraudrasya |
mahāgandharvarājākhyo dvitīyas tatra caiva hi |
kṛṣṇaśubhrāruṇagrīvo nīlavastro mahābalaḥ ||
caturbhujo viśālākṣo gauravarṇo jaṭādharaḥ |
ādime dakṣiṇe śaṅkhaṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajam ||
vāmorddhvage (?) kare vīṇāṃ tadadhaḥsthe tu pātrakam |
dhārayann iṣṭasaṃpattyai pūjanīyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
mahāgandarvarājasya |
tṛtīyaḥ kathyate cātha rātrijo draviṇābhidhaḥ |
taptacāmīkarābhāsaḥ kṛṣṇanīlāruṇāṃśukaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe prathame padmaṃ hemajaṃ cātiśobhanam |
dvitīye tu kare vīṇāṃ vāmordhve bījapūrakam ||
dadhānaḥ sarvasaṃpattisukhāyuḥ śrīvivṛddhaye ||
[197] draviṇasya |
śrāvaṇākhyas tatas turyo nīlavarṇo ‘rkakuṇḍalaḥ |
nīlāruṇāṃśukopetaḥ kaṇṭhanīlābjamālikaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare khaḍgaṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
vallakīm ūrddhvaje vāme pātram asmād adhisthite |
dadhānaḥ pūjanīyo ‘yaṃ jñānavijñānasiddhaye ||
śrāvaṇasya |
muhūrtaḥ kathyate cātho vāyusaṃjñas tu pañcamaḥ |
haridvarṇo javākarṇaḥ śvetavastro mahābalaḥ ||
kīramarkādime haste dvitīye tu dhvajaṃ śaye |
vāmordhvge kare sīraṃ dvitīye pātram ādadhat ||
vāyoḥ |
agnisaṃjñs tataḥ ṣaṣṭho javākusumasaṃnibhaḥ |
kṛṣṇanīlāṃśukopetaḥ śikhārudrākṣasaṃyutaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare pātraṃ dvitīye śaktim ev ca |
vāmādime kare kīraṃ dvitīye sīram eva ca |
dadhānaḥ kīrtaye bhuktyai vijayāyuḥpravṛddhaye ||
agneḥ |
adhunā kathyate vatsa rākṣasākhyas tu saptamaḥ |
nīlavarṇogradaṃṣṭras tu nīlaśubhrāruṇāṃśukaḥ ||
[198] dakṣiṇādye kare padmaṃ dvitīye tu triśūlakam |
khaṭvāṅgam uttare vāme pātraṃ asmād adhaḥsthite |
dadhad vairavidhātāś ca pūjanīyas tu sādhakaiḥ ||
rākṣasasya |
dhātā caivāṣṭamaḥ pītavarṇaḥ pāṭalabhāṃśukaḥ |
karṇasphoṭikasauvarṇakuṇḍalaḥ kambukandharaḥ ||
pustīmarkādime haste dvitīye caiva viṣṭaram |
vāmādime kare piṇḍaṃ dvitīye svarṇakuṇḍalam |
dadhānaḥ prītaye bhuktyai vijayāya sukhāya ca ||
dhātuḥ |
navamaḥ saumyanāmātha śubhravarṇo viśāladak (-dṛk?) |
pītavastro mahātejā muktāsarvāṅgabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
ādime dakṣiṇe śaṅkhaṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye sīram eva ca |
dadhānas tuṣṭaye bhuktyai pūjanīyas tu muktidaḥ ||
saumyasya |
daśamaś cātra vijñeyo muhūrto brahmasaṃjñakaḥ |
pītavarṇaḥ śuklavastro jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutaḥ ||
kaṇṭharudrākṣamālo ‘yaṃ bhālapāṇḍuracandanaḥ |
suvarṇakuṇḍalopetaḥ kaṭisūtrottarīyavān ||
[199] akṣasūtraṃ yamāditye dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
vāmorddhve tu sruvaṃ haste pustakaṃ tadadhaḥkare |
dadhat sauvarṇamuktālābhāya vijayāya ca ||
brahmaṇaḥ |
ekādaśo ‘dhunā jñeyo vākpatir nāma nāmataḥ |
suvarṇavarṇa evāyaṃkṛṣṇaśubhrāṃśukānvitaḥ ||
kuṇḍī markādihaste tu dvitīye sīram eva ca |
vāmādime kare kīraṃ dvitīye nīrajaṃ dadhat |
prajālābhakaraś caiva kāryaniṣpattisādhakaḥ ||
vākpatiḥ |
dvādaśaś cātra vijñeyo pauṣṇanāmā sulohitaḥ |
pītavastro jaṭāmaulir munipuṣpakṛtaśrutiḥ ||
tundilaḥ sopavītī ca nīlakīlakapāṇḍuraḥ |
arkādime kare bījapūrakaṃ śubhravarṇakam ||
dvitīye vārijaṃ pāṇau pātraṃ vāmādime kare |
saṃdaṃśaṃ tu dvitīye ‘yaṃ dhārayan vairitāpada ||
pauṣṇasya |
jayādhunātra vai kathyo vaikuṇṭhākhyas trayodaśaḥ |
pādajānvantaśubhro ‘yaṃ kaṇṭhān tāruṇavarṇakaḥ ||
alivarṇas ta (?) keśāntakuṇḍalānekaratnajaḥ |
dakṣiṇādye kare pustīm ambujaṃ tu dvitīyake ||
[200] kekīpicchaṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye cātapatrakam |
dadhānaḥ kīrtaye bhuktyai pūjanīyaḥ sitāmbujaiḥ ||
vaikuṇṭhasya |
caturdaśo ‘dhunā jñeyo nāmatas tu samīraṇaḥ |
jalanīlanibhaś caiva śubhamārakatadyutiḥ ||
sitanīlāruṇaprāntavasanaḥ snigdhalocanaḥ |
tālapatraṃ yam āditye dvitīye nīlanīrajam ||
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye nīlarukmajam |
dadhāno yajvano bhūtyai vālavṛddhyai sukhāya ca ||
samīraṇasya |
atha pañcadaśo jñeyo muhūrto nairṛto ‘ruṇaḥ |
mecakābhas trinetras tu daṃṣṭrāvān vasanāruṇaḥ ||
ādime dakṣiṇe bāṇaṃ dvitīye kamalaṃ kare |
vāmādime dhanur haste dvitīye caiva vārijam |
dadhac chāntyai subhogāya balāya vijayāya ca ||
nairṛtamuhūrtasya |
ete niśācarā khyātā muhūrtāḥ sakalās tava |
ahorātrābhidhaś cātra kṛṣṇagrīvādimūrddhajaḥ ||
kaṇṭhapādāntaśubhro ‘yaṃ dvibhujo dīrghagodhikaḥ |
sāmacandrajaṭāmauliḥ piṅgalaśmaśrulocanaḥ ||
[201] nṛmuṇḍamālikopetaḥ kṛṣṇaśubhrāṃśukānvitaḥ |
iṣṭāpūrtaprasiddhyarthaṃ pūjanīyo manīṣibhiḥ ||
ahorātrasya |
śuklapakṣo naraḥ śuklo jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyutaḥ |
śoṇavastro viśālākṣo bhālālitilakānvitaḥ ||
sūryam arke dadhāno yam vāme candrajabimbakam |
pūjanīyo mahābhaktyā pratipakṣaṃ site site ||
asya dvādaś bhedāḥ syur vijñeyā varṇabhedataḥ |
pūjanīyo balātyarthaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu bhedataḥ ||
śuklapakṣasya |
śyāmābhaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣas tu sitaśoṇāmbaro balī |
sūryabimbaṃ yame bibhrad vāme dvīpaṃ samujjvalam ||
pūjanīyo balātyarthaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu bhedataḥ |
ity asyārkaprabhedāḥ syur bhapakṣādijanāmataḥ ||
kṛṣṇapakṣasya |
svanāmatas tu māsaḥ syād dvivarṇas tu dvitor iti |
nābhyurddhvādaḥ śvetakṛṣṇaḥ piṅgalocanam ūrdhvajaḥ ||
sūryacandrānvitaḥ so ‘yaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu pūjyate |
svanāmapūrvakair mantrair homapūjāvasānakaiḥ ||
[202] māsasya |
ṛtuṣaṭkam atho bhrūmo lakṣyanāma pṛthakphalaiḥ |
hemantākhyas tu tatrādyaḥ kapilaḥ piṅgakuṇḍalaḥ |
pītavastrasamopetas trijaṭaḥ kṛṣṇagodhikaḥ ||
godhir lalāṭam |
dhānyam añjarikāḍhyas tu vāmapātrapidhānakaḥ |
pūjanīyo vibhūtyarthaṃ dānyasaṃpattivṛddhaye ||
hemantasya |
śiśirākhyo dvitīyas tu haritpītanibhāruṇaḥ |
pītakuṇḍalakarṇas tu kaṇṭhavidrumamālikaḥ ||
madhudrumaprasūnāṅkapātram arke karāmbuje |
vāme dhānyaśarāvaṃ tu dhārayann iṣṭavṛddhaye ||
śiśirasya |
viṣṇuprakaraṇoktas tu jñātavyo ‘tra vasantakaḥ |
vasantasya |
grīṣmābhidhaś caturthas tu dhūmaro rukṣagātrakaḥ |
akṣasūtrārkahastas tu vāme śubhrātapatrayuk |
rogasantāpanāśāya pūjanīyo ‘ripakṣahā ||
grīṣmasya |
pañcamas todartus tu (?) haridvarṇo ‘ruṇekṣaṇaḥ |
[203] tāmravarṇāṃśukopetaḥ kṛṣṇavidrumakuṇḍalaḥ ||
mīnam arke dadhāno ‘yaṃ toyapūrṇaghaṭaṃ pare |
meghamālāvṛtaś caiva vidyuddahanadīptimān |
haritālidalaiḥ pūjyo puṣṭisaṃtuṣṭivṛddhaye ||
varṣāyāḥ |
śaradṛturatho ṣaṣṭhaś candragauraḥ sulocanaḥ |
kaṇṭhamauktikamālas tu karṇacandrajakuṇḍalī ||
candrabimbaṃ kare dakṣe vāme cāmṛtajaṃ ghaṭam |
dadhānaḥ pūjanīyo ‘yam āyurvṛddhyai sukhāya ca ||
śaradaḥ |
dakṣiṇāyanasaṃjño ‘tha śyāmaḥ somendralocanaḥ |
pītavastro bṛhattuṇḍaḥ karṇikāradalaśrutiḥ ||
bījāṅkuraśarāvārkaḥ khanitrottarahastakaḥ |
pūjitaḥ siddhaye nityaṃ dhanadhānyasamṛddhaye ||
dakṣiṇāyanasya |
uttarāyaṇasaṃjño ‘tha śubhavarṇo viśāladṛk |
māñjiṣṭhavasanopetaḥ svarṇamuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
pustakaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāme tu ravibimbakam |
dadhad bhūktyai (?)mude caiva pūjanīyas tu kīrtaye ||
uttarāyaṇasya |
[204] atha saṃvatsarān bhrūmo nāma lakṣaphalāditaḥ |
prabhavākhyo bhaved ādyaḥ pītavarṇo mahodaraḥ ||
nīlavastrasamopeto dakṣakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ |
vāme sphāṭikavarṇas tu pṛṣṭhalambijaṭātrayaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe prathame śaktiṃ paṅkajaṃ tu dvitīyake |
vāmādime śarāvaṃ tu bījapūrṇaṃ karāmbuje |
dvitīye caiva saṃdaṃśaṃ dadhānaḥ puṣṭivṛddhaye ||
prabhavasya |
vibhavākhyo dvitīyas tu nīlapītāruṇachaviḥ |
pītaśubhrāntavastro ‘yaṃ kaṇṭhe padmākṣamālikaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye śaraṃ pāṇau dvitīye nīlapaṅkajam |
saṃdaṃśam uttarārdhasthe dvitīya caiva kāṛmukam |
dadhad vibhūtaye nityaṃ pūjanīyo vipaścitā ||
vibhavasya |
śuklanāmā tṛtīyas tu śvetapiṅgalasaṃnibhaḥ |
kaṇṭhapadmākṣamālo ‘yaṃ śubhraprāntālivastradhṛk ||
dakṣiṇādye śarāvaṃ tu dvitīye bāṇam eva ca |
darpaṇaś cottarādisthe dvitīye caiva kārmukam |
dadhāno bhūtaye martyaiḥ pūjanīyaḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ||
śuklasya |
pramodākhyaś caturthas tu nīlagrīvo mahodaraḥ |
[205] śvetavastro ‘bjasaṅkāśo yogapattottarīyavān ||
dakṣiṇādye tu saṃdaṃśaṃ dvitīye sīram eva ca |
vāmādime śarāvaṃ tu dvitīye nīlapaṅkajam |
dadhat saukhyya bhogāya vijayāya mahāya ca ||
pramodasya |
prajāpatyākhya evātra pañcamaḥ svarṇasaṃnibhaḥ |
śoṇabhūṣaṇavastrāḍhyās tundilo gaurapāṇḍuraḥ ||
akṣasūtraṃ yamādisthe dvitīye paraśuṃ kare |
śavāvam uttarādisthe dvitīye pustakaṃ dadhat |
prajāvṛddhyai vibhūtyai va pūjanīyo vijānatā ||
prajāpateḥ |
aṅgirākhyas tataḥ ṣaṣṭho varṇaśubhro ‘tilomaśaḥ |
tāmravastro mahātejā dvādaśāṅgaḥ sacandanaḥ ||
pavitradarbhapāṇis tu jaṭāmaṇḍitamastakaḥ |
jñānakhaḍgas tu dakṣādye dvitīye samidhaṃ kare ||
vāmādime śarāvaṃ tu brahmadaṇḍaṃ dvitīyake |
dadhat supūjito bhūtyai śreyase ca sukhāya ca ||
aṅgirasaḥ |
saptamaḥ śrīmukhākhyas tu pītavarṇo viśāladṛk |
pāṭalāvasanopeto dīrghakarṇālakāruṇaḥ ||
suvarṇaratnabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sarvānarthavighātakṛt |
[206] śrīphalaṃ dakṣiṇādisthe dvitīye caiva paṅkajam ||
pusakaṃ corddhvage vāme tadadhas tu śarāvakam |
dadhānaḥ puṣṭaye lakṣmyai candanādibhir arcitaḥ ||
śrīmukhasya |
bhāvābhidho ‘ṣṭamas tatra nīlaśubhrāruṇachaviḥ |
pītakṛṣṇāruṇaprāntavasanaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ ||
muktāvidrumamālo ‘yaṃ jaṭāpiṅgākṣa eva ca |
dakṣiṇe prathame pustam aṃśakaṃ tu dvitīyake ||
vāmorddhvage kare śūlaṃ tadadhaḥ pātram āsavam |
bibhratsaṃpūjanīyas tu dhānyalābhāya vai śriye ||
bhāvasya |
navamo ‘tra yuvākhyas tu pāṭalābho ‘ruṇekṣaṇaḥ |
nīlavastrajaṭottuṅgo ratnamecakakuṇḍalaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe prathamaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dvitīye tu sudarśanam |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye nīlapaṅkajam |
bibhrāṇaḥ kāntaye pūjyo lakṣmīsaubhāgyavṛddhaye ||
yuvākhyasya |
dhātā caiva pravijñeyo daśamaḥ piṅgalocanaḥ |
hastaśubhrāruṇaprāntavasanaḥ śvetakuṇḍalaḥ ||
śarāvam ādime dakṣe dvitīye bījapūrakam |
vāmordhvage kare pustīṃ nīlam indīvaraṃ tv adhaḥ ||
[207] jayāya putrasaṃpattyai pūjanīyaḥ subhaktitaḥ ||
dhātrākhyasya |
īśvarābhidha evātra jñeya ekādaśo ‘py asau |
kairavābhas trinetras tu jaṭākhaṇḍendumaulikaḥ ||
muktāsphāṭikaraudrākṣabhūṣaṇas tuṅganāsikaḥ |
triśūlam ādime dakṣe dvitīye sīram eva ca ||
śarāvam ādime vāme dvitīye caiva pustakam |
bibhrat saukhyāya pūjyo ‘sau yogavṛddhyai sutāptaye ||
īśvarasya |
dvādaśo bahudhānyākhyaḥ pītanīlāruṇacchaviḥ |
pītavastro viśālākṣas tundilo dīrghagodhikaḥ ||
javākusumamālo ‘yaṃ kavacī gamakuṇḍalaḥ |
dakṣiṇādye kare kumbhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ sarvadhānyakam ||
vīrapūr apidhānaṃ tat khacitānekaratnakam |
dvitīye ḍamaruṃ pāṇau corddhve nīlajanīrajam ||
dvitīye tu kare sīraṃ dadhānaḥ sarvadhānyakam |
siddhaye pūjito nityaṃ svanāmādyais tu saṃskṛtaḥ ||
bahudhānyasya |
pramāthisaṃjñakaś cādyaḥ śuklavarṇo mahābhujaḥ |
jaṭātritayasaṃyukto dīrghabhāro ‘rkakuṇḍalaḥ ||
[208] śoṇanīlāmbaropetaḥ kāñcanānekamudrikaḥ |
pikamarkādime haste dvitīya kumbum eva ca ||
pāśaṃ vāmorddhvage haste tadadhaś cāmbupātrakam |
dadhāno vairighātāya svavargasyaiva puṣṭaye ||
pramāthinaḥ |
vikramākhyo dvitīyas tu nīlaśubhro mahodaraḥ |
pītavastro bṛhadmālaḥ kaṇṭhamauktikamālikaḥ ||
ādime dakṣiṇe śaṅkhaṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajm |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ pāśam atra dvitīyake ||
dadhāno ‘pi balātyarthaṃ pūjanīyas tu yatnataḥ ||
vikramasya |
vṛṣābhidhas tṛtīyas tu śvetagauro viśāladṛk |
sthūlaromātisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ ketakīdalakarṇayuk ||
pītaprāntāruṇopetavasanaḥ kaṭighaṇṭikaḥ |
ādime dakṣiṇe pāśaṃ dvitīye śaṅkham eva ca ||
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye mṛgam eva ca |
dhanadhānyapravṛddhyarthaṃ pūjanīyo ‘tisādaram ||
vṛṣasya |
caturthaś citrabhānvākhyaś citragrīvo ‘ruṇāṃśukaḥ |
muktāgarbhanibhaś caiva varadaḥ svarṇakuṇḍalaḥ ||
muktāsrajaṃ tu dakṣādye dvitīye caiva pāsakam |
[209] vāmādime kare kambuṃ dvitīye paṅkajaṃ śubham |
bibhrad ānandasaṃpattyai pratyapārthavivṛddhaye ||
citrabhānoḥ |
pañcamas tu śubhānvākhyaḥ śubhraśoṇaruciḥ śubhaḥ |
kaṇṭhatrirekhaśoṇas tu jaṭākāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ ||
ādime dakṣiṇe padmaṃ dvitīye śaṅkham ujjvalam |
vāmorddhve tu kare pāśaṃ tadadhasthe śaye ‘ṅkuśam |
bibhrāṇaḥ mukhadaḥ śāntyai ripupakṣatrayāya ca ||
subhānoḥ |
atra saṃvatsaraḥ ṣaṣṭhas tāraṇākhyaḥ sitāmbaraḥ |
śvetanīlāruṇaś caiva svarṇakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
prathame dakṣiṇe kumbhaṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
uttarādye kare pāśaṃ dvitīye śaṅkham ādadhat |
durgatyanekanāśāya bhūtaye vijayāya ca ||
tāraṇasya |
saptamaḥ pārthivākhyas tu taptakāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ |
pītaśoṇāmbaraś caiva kṛṣṇagrīvo ‘tisundaraḥ ||
sarvaratnavibhūṣāḍhyaḥ ketakīdalamastakaḥ |
ādime dakṣiṇe bāṇaṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajam ||
kārmukhaṃ cottarādisthe dvitīye śaṅkham eva ca |
dadhad rājyādilābhāya pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
[210] pārthivasya |
avyayākhyo’ṣṭamaś cātra kairavāruṇasaṃnibhaḥ |
kṛṣṇanīlāruṇaśvetavasanaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ ||
kauramarkādime haste dvitīye sīram eva ca |
śaṅkhaṃ vāmādime haste dvitīye pāśam ādadhat |
yajvano bhūtaye nityaṃ vṛddhaye cāyuṣe śriye ||
avyayasya |
sarvajin navamo ‘py atra śvetanīlo ‘sitaprabhaḥ |
nīlavastrajaṭottuṅgaḥ kṛṣṇanīrajakuṇḍalaḥ ||
arkādime kare bāṇaṃ dvitīye caiva pustakam |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye pātram eva ca |
dadhānaḥ pūjanīyo ‘yaṃ vijayāya sukhāya ca ||
sarvajitaḥ |
adhunā kathyate vatsa daśamaḥ sarvadhārakaḥ |
kaṅkapatranibhaś caiva pāṭalāvasanānvitaḥ ||
nīlapaṅkajavarṇas tu muktāhāravibhūṣaṇaḥ |
pāśam arkādime haste dvitīye ketakīdalam ||
śaṅkhaṃ caivottarādisthe dvitīye caiva pustakam |
dadhāno vijayārogyavṛddhaye caiva yajvanaḥ ||
sarvadhāriṇaḥ |
ekādaśo ‘dhunā jñeyo virodhir nāma vatsaraḥ |
[211] kṛṣṇapāṇḍuradehas tu varado nīlakuṇḍalaḥ ||
kṛṣṇaprāntāruṇaś caiva vasanaprāntabhūṣaṇaḥ |
bimbīphalaṃ tu cārkādye dvitīyaṃ śvetapaṅkajam ||
vāmādime kare sarpaṃ dvitīye pāśam ādadhat |
pūjanīyo ‘righātāya balavṛddhyai ca yajvanaḥ ||
virodhinaḥ |
dvādaśo vikṛtākhyas tu dhūmaraḥ piṅgalocanaḥ |
nīlaśubhrāṃśukopeto meṣaśṛṅgajakuṇḍalaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare pāśaṃ dvitīye meṣaśṛṅgakam |
vāmordhvage kare śaṅkhaṃ pāśam asmād adhaḥkare |
dadhāno roganāśāya duṣṭaśatruvidhānakṛt ||
vikṛteḥ |
kharābhidhānas tatrādyo raktavarṇo vṛhodaraḥ |
nīlavastro bṛhadbhālo ghanabarbaramūdhajaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare śaktiṃ dvitīye khaḍgam eva ca |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye cāmaraṃ dadhat |
śatrutāpāya pūjyo ‘sau vijayāyaiva yajvanaḥ ||
kharasya |
nndanākhyo dvitīyas tu pītaśoṇānano balī |
śubhravastro jaṭālambī dīrghakarṇaḥ kajāsanaḥ ||
paṅkajaṃ tu yamādisthe dvitīye śaktim eva ca |
[212] vajram indrādime pāṇau dvitīye cāṅkuśaṃ śaye ||
dadhānaḥ śreyase bhūtyai pūjanīyo mahodayaḥ ||
nandanasya |
vijayākhyas tṛtīyas tu śvetapītāruṇachaviḥ |
kṛṣṇavastraḥ kṛśottuṅgajaṭārudrākṣamālikaḥ ||
akṣasūtraṃ yamādisthe dvitīye kuliśaṃ kare |
śaktiṃ vāmādime haste dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
dadhāno vijayārogyavṛddhaye caiva pūjitaḥ ||
vijayasya |
jayābhidhaś caturtho ‘tra pītaśoṇaḥ śuciḥ sukhī |
pītavastro jaṭaikas tu pītarukvarṇaveṣṭitaḥ ||
pustakaṃ prathame dakṣe dvitīye nīlapaṅkajam |
vāmādime kare vajraṃ dvitīye śaktim eva ca |
dadhānaḥ śubhamāṅgalyavṛddhaye caiva pūjitaḥ ||
jayasya |
pañcamo manmathākhyas tu nīlaśoṇaḥ śuciḥ śubhaḥ |
svarṇakuṇḍalasaṃyuktaḥ kīrapakṣanibhāṃśukaḥ ||
mallikādhanvabāṇas tu mūrvāpuṣpajamālikaḥ |
daṇḍaṃ tu dakṣiṇe haste dvitīye caiva paṅkajam ||
vāmādime kare pustīṃ dvitīye śaktim eva ca |
dadhānaḥ siddhaye bhūtyai yoṣidvargavaśīkṛtau ||
[213] manmathasya |
ṣaṣṭhaś caivātra vijñeyo vatsaro durmukhābhidhaḥ |
śukacañcunibhaś caiva nīlakuṇḍalasaṃbaraḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare śaktiṃ dvitīye vajram eva ca |
śukaṃ vāmādime pāṇau dvitīye sarpam ādadhat ||
pūjanīyo vidhānena bhrūkuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ |
duṣṭaśatruvināśāya sarvarogopaśāntaye ||
durmukhasya |
saptamo hemalambākhyo raktapītanibhachaviḥ |
gṛdhrapakṣāṅkuśaś caiva ratnakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
hemajaṃ paṅkajaṃ dakṣe prathame karapallave |
dvitīye kuliśaṃ pāṇau vamādye pātram uttamam |
dvitīye tu kare śaktiṃ dadhāno bhuktaye jaya ||
hemalambasya |
aṣṭamas tu vilambākhyaḥ pāṭalābhaḥ kṛśodaraḥ |
pītavastro bṛhadmālo jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍanaḥ ||
prathame dakṣiṇe sarpaṃ dvitīye śaktim eva ca |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
dadhānaḥ śatrughātāya pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ ||
vilambasya |
vikārī navamaś cātha kṛṣṇanīlāruṇachaviḥ |
[214] tāmrakuṇḍalavastrāḍhyaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṇatrirekhikaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare bāṇaṃ dvitīye caiva pustakam |
vāmādime dhanur haste dvitīye śaktim ādadhat |
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa sarvarogopaśāntaye ||
vikāriṇaḥ |
daśamaḥ śārvariprakhyaḥ kṛṣṇaśubhrāruṇachaviḥ |
śoṇavastro ‘tidīrghāṅgaḥ sthūlabarbaramūrdhajaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare sarpaṃ dvitīye śālmalīdalam |
kauśikaṃ cottarādisthe dvitīye śaktim eva ca |
dadhānaḥ kīrtaye puṣṭyai śatrubhaṅgāya pūjitaḥ ||
śārvariṇaḥ |
ekādaśaḥ plavākhyas tu śaśakarṇanibhachaviḥ |
dardurābhāmbaropeto lohakuṇḍalasaṃyutaḥ ||
ādime dakṣiṇe haste durduraṃ maṇisaṃyutam |
dvitīye tu kare śaktiṃ pātraṃ vāmādime kare |
dvitīye paṅkajaṃ bibhrat pūjanīyo ‘py amitrahā ||
plavasya |
śubhakṛt dvādaśo ‘py atra nāgajābhaḥ sulocanaḥ |
pāṭalāvasanopetaḥ kṛṣṇakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe bhīṣaṇāṃ śaktiṃ prathame karapallave |
dvitīye hemajaṃ padmaṃ vāmādye caiva darpaṇam |
[215] dvitīye kuliśaṃ haste dadhat saukhyāya saṃpade ||
śubhakṛtaḥ |
śobhakṛt pītadhūmras tu prathamo nīlajāmbaraḥ |
nīlabhūṣaṇasaṃyukto ratnamudrākarāṅguliḥ ||
ghaṭamarkādime haste dvitīye caiva pustakam |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye dhvajam eva ca |
dadhānaḥ śreyase puṣṭyai pūjanīyo jayāya ca ||
śobhakṛtaḥ |
krodhisaṃjño dvitīyas tu nīlaśubhraḥ kṛśodaraḥ |
mecakāmbarasaṃyuktas tuṅganāśālipāṇḍuraḥ ||
padmam arkārdime haste dvitīye dhvajam eva ca |
vāmādime kajaṃ pāṇau dvitīye sīram eva ca |
dadhāno vairināśāya kṛṣṇadravyaiḥ supūjitaḥ ||
krodhinaḥ |
viśvāvasus tṛtīyas tu kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ suloladṛk |
kṛṣṇaśubhrāruṇaprāntavasanaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ ||
dhvajam arkādime pāṇau dvitīye kuliśaṃ śaye |
dadhāno bhuktaye prītyai nānābhogaphalāptaye ||
viśvāvasoḥ |
parābhavaś caturthas tu dhūmaro ‘ruṇajāmbraḥ |
[216] nīlotpalaśrutiś caiva kṣudraghaṇṭikamekhalaḥ ||
nīlotpalaṃ tu dakṣādye dvitīye dhvajam eva ca |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ saṃdaṃśaṃ tu dvitīyake |
dhārayann arighātāya pūjanīyo vipaścitā ||
parābhavasya |
pañcamas tu plavaṅgākhyo hariṇājinasaṃnibhaḥ |
meṣodarābhavastro ‘yaṃ saṃyutakṛṣṇakandaraḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye dhvajaṃ pāṇau dvitīye meṣaśṛṅgakam |
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye pāśam eva ca |
dadhāno bhūtaye bhūtyai pūjanīyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ ||
plavaṅgasya |
kilakākhyas tataḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo ‘tidīrghayuk |
nīlavastro jaṭābhāraḥ kṛṣṇakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
kīlakaṃ dakṣiṇādisthe dvitīye dhvajam eva ca |
vāmādime kare pāśaṃ saṃsaṃśaṃ tu dvitīyake |
dadhāno vijayārogyavṛddhaye caiva pūjitaḥ ||
kilakasya |
saptamaḥ saumyanāmātha kīrtyate vatsaraḥ śubhaḥ |
nīlapītajaṭāyukto rambhādalanibhāṃśukaḥ ||
svarṇapatraśrutiś caiva kaṇṭhapaṅkajamālikaḥ |
candram arkādime haste dvitīye ketakīdalam ||
[217] vāmādime dhvajaṃ haste dvitīye nīrajaṃ śubham |
vibhrat saubhāgyayogāya pūjanīyaḥ subhaktitaḥ ||
saumyasya |
sādhāraṇo ‘ṣṭamo jñeyo nīlagaurāruṇachaviḥ |
pītaśoṇāntavastro ‘yaṃ svarṇakuṇḍalaratnayuk ||
candrahāsaṃ yamādisthe dvitīye caiva kīlakam |
vāmādime dhvajaṃ pāṇau saṃsaṃśaṃ cottare dadhat |
dhanavṛddhyai sukhāptyarthaṃ pūjanīyaḥ sitāmbujaiḥ ||
sādhāraṇasya |
virodhakṛc ca vijñeyo navamo vatsaro jaya |
pikābhaḥ śuklavastro ‘yaṃ piṅgaśmaśrujatekṣaṇaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādye kare śaṅkhaṃ dvitīye caiva vai dhvajam |
candrahāsaṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye paraśuṃ śaye |
bibhrāṇo roganāśāya śatrusaṃtāpakṛt jaya ||
virodhakṛt |
paridhāvī tu vijñeyo daśamaś caiva vatsaraḥ |
indīvarāruṇaśvetaḥ kṛṣṇapītanibhāṃśukaḥ ||
brahmaprasavakarṇas tu kaṇṭhapaṅkajamālikaḥ |
pikam arkādime haste dvitīye dhvajam eva ca ||
ghaṇṭāṃ vāmādime pāṇau dvitīye caiva mudgaram |
dadhāno vṛddhaye caive śreyobhūtisukhāyuṣām ||
[218] paridhāvinaḥ |
pramādī cāpi vijñeyo rudrasaṃkhyo ‘pi vatsaraḥ |
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśo harinīlāruṇāmbaraḥ ||
madaghūrṇitanetras tu tandrībhūta ivālasaḥ |
daṇḍam arkādime haste dvitīye daṇḍam eva ca ||
vāmādime kare pātraṃ dvitīye bisinīdalam |
dadhāno rogavicchiktyai śatrubhaṅgāya yajavnaḥ ||
pamādinaḥ |
ānandākhyaḥ sitaḥ pītavasano dvādaśo ‘tra hi |
muktendranīlasauvarṇabhūṣaṇo nīlakuṇḍalaḥ ||
paṅkajaṃ dakṣiṇādisthe dvitīye ketakīdalam |
vāmorddhvaṃ tu dhvajaṃ pāṇau tadadhaḥsthe tu modakam |
yoṣidvaśyāya sa pūjyo gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
ānandasya |
tāmasānāṃ bhaved ādyo rākṣaso nāma vatsaraḥ |
indīvaradalābhāso hemavastro ‘rkabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
arkam arkādime haste dvitīye śṛṇim eva ca |
nīlotpalaṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye kuliśaṃ śaye |
dadhad rogādināśāya pūjyaḥ sthāṇubhir eva saḥ ||
rākṣasasya |
analākhyo dvitīyas tu nīlaśubhāruṇachaviḥ |
[219] pītaprāntālivastras tu vajrakuṇḍalabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
candrahāsaṃ yamādisthe dvitīye cārkakaṃ kare |
piśitaṃ cottarādisthe pare caiva parasvadham |
dadhat susaṃpade ‘rīṇāṃ vijayāyaiva yajvanaḥ ||
analasya |
piṅgalākhyas tṛtīyo ‘tra kumudāruṇasaṃnibhaḥ |
śvetaprāntāruṇānīlavasanaḥ svarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
ādime piśitaṃ yāmye dvitīye sīram eva ca |
kuliśaṃ caiva vāmādye saṃsaṃśaṃ tu dvitīyake |
bibhrāṇo vijayārogyavṛddhaye caiva pūjitaḥ ||
piṅgalasya |
kālayuktābhidhas turyo nīlakaṇṭho vṛkodaraḥ |
pītāruṇāṃśukopeto nīlasvarṇajabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
yamādime kare sarpaṃ dvitīye sīram eva ca |
sīdhūpātraṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye kīlam eva ca |
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa yajvano vairimṛtyave ||
kālayuktasya |
adhunā kīrtyate vatsa siddhārtho nāma pañcamaḥ |
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśo nīlaśubhrāruṇāṃśukaḥ ||
nīlakuṇḍalasaṃyukto muktāvidrumabhūṣaṇaḥ |
[220] sauvarṇaṃ kalaśaṃ yāmye prathame karapallave ||
indīvaraṃ pare caiva kuliśaṃ cottarorddhvage (?) |
bījapūram adhas tasmād dadhānaḥ śreyase mude ||
siddhārthasya |
raudrābhidhas tataḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ piṅgalaḥ kṛṣṇalohitaḥ |
pāṭalāvasanopeto hrasvabarbaramūrdhajaḥ ||
kīram arkādime haste dvitīye halam ādadhat |
kuṇḍīm idhmādime pāṇau pare kuṇḍalinaṃ śaye |
roganāśāya saṃbhuktyai pūjyo ‘yaṃ paripanthiṣu ||
raudrasya |
saptamaḥ pathyate cāyaṃ mecakābhaḥ sudurmatiḥ |
śaṅkham arkādime haste svarṇamekhalaratnajam ||
sarpam atra dvitīye vai kuṇḍīm indrādime śaye |
dvitīye pustakaṃ pāṇau dadhad vidveṣakṛdripoḥ ||
durmateḥ |
aṣṭame dundubhiprakhyo nīlagrīvo viśāladṛk |
somavarṇaḥ sitāmbhojavasanaḥ kṛṣṇagodhikaḥ ||
jaṭāmukuṭabhāle ‘yaṃ svarṇapatradyutiḥ śubhaḥ |
kadalīphalam arkādye dvitīye śaṅkham eva ca ||
[221] bījapūraṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye sasyamañjarīm |
bibhrāṇo dhanadhānyāya pūjanīyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ ||
dundubheḥ |
navamo rudhirodgārī nīlaśoṇālidevayuk |
kṛṣṇaprāntāruṇaśvetavasano nīlabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
lohitākṣo jaṭāpiṅgaḥ śoṇacandanacarcitaḥ |
raktotpalaṃ yamādisthe dvitīye kuliśaṃ śaye ||
piśitaṃ cottarādisthe dvitīye cāṅkuśaṃ dadhat |
vairibhaṅgāy vai pūjyo vālavṛddhyai hi yajvanaḥ ||
rudhirodgāriṇaḥ |
daśamaś caiva raktākṣī nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kṛśodaraḥ |
pītanīlatanuś caiva nīlaśoṇālikāmbaraḥ ||
śaram arkārdime pāṇau dvitīye caiva paṅkajam |
sīram indrādime haste dvitīye caiva kartarīm |
dadhad vairivighātāya pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
raktākṣī |
ekādaśo ‘dhunā vatsa krodhanākhyo nigadyate |
sajalāmbudasaṃkāśaḥ pītaśoṇāmbarānvitaḥ ||
lohabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktaḥ keśamadhyagapaṅkajaḥ |
dakṣiṇādye kare śūlaṃ palaśuṣkāgrasaṃyutaḥ ||
[222] dvitīye kartarīm atra vāmādye pātram āsavam |
saṃdaṃśaṃ tu dvitīye vai dadhāno vairimṛtyave ||
krodhanasya |
kṣayābhidhau bhaved atra dvādaśo vatsaro jaya |
kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ sunīlāṅgo raktanetro jaṭādharaḥ ||
mecakāruṇavastras tu nīlakāruṇagodhikaḥ |
ādime dakṣiṇe sarpaṃ dvitīye caiva pāśakam ||
viṣakumbhaṃ tu vāmādye dvitīye caiva kaitavam |
kṛṣṇaprasūnakaṃ bibhrad amitrāṇāṃ vighātakṛt ||
kṣayasya |
iti devatāmūrtayaḥ |
atha grahasthāpanavidhiḥ | matsyapurāṇe |
madhye tu bhāskaraṃ vidyāl lohitaṃ dakṣiṇena tu |
uttareṇa guruṃ vidyāt somaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvakam ||
paścime tu śaniṃ vidyād rāhuṃ dakṣiṇapaścime |
paścimottarataḥ ketuṃ sthāpayet śuklataṇḍulaiḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
sūryasya cottare śaṃbhum umāṃ somasya dakṣiṇe |
skṛndam (?) aṅgārakasyaiva dakṣiṇasyāṃ niveśayet ||
[223] saumyapaścimato viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ jīvapūrvataḥ |
indram aindryāṃ sitād viddhi mandāgrer agrato yamam ||
rāhoḥ pūrvottare kālaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham |
ketor nairṛtadigbhāge citraguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||
uttare śanisūryābhyāṃ guruketvoś ca dakṣiṇe |
gaṇādhipaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvadevanamaskṛtam ||
sthānādhidevatānāṃ ca sthāpya pratyadhidevatāḥ |
vināyakādidurgādyā nāntare grahadevayoḥ ||
smṛtyantare |
indraṃ pūrve tu saṃsthāpya preteśaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
varuṇaṃ paścime bhāge kuberaṃ cottare tathā ||
agnyādilokapālāṃś ca koṇabhāgeṣu vinyaset |
indrasya dakṣiṇe pārśve vasūn āvāhayed budhaḥ ||
deveśeśānayor madhye ādityānāṃ tathāyanam |
agneḥ paścimabhāge tu rudrāṇām ayanaṃ viduḥ ||
preteśarakṣomadhye tu mātṛsthānaṃ prakalpayet |
nairṛter uttare bhāge gaṇeśāyatanaṃ viduḥ ||
kuberamarutāṃ sthānam ucyate | atha kalaśotpattis tallakṣaṇaṃ ca | devīpurāṇe |
kalaśān sudṛḍhān kuryāl lakṣaṇāni vadāmi te |
[224] utpattiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mānaṃ kathayāmi yathā mune ||
vārikāḥ kalaśāś caiva yena loke prakīrtitāḥ |
amṛte mathyamāne tu pānārthaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ ||
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ (?) kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim |
utpannam amṛtaṃ tatra mahāvīryaparākramam ||
tasyāyaṃ dhāraṇārthāya kalaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
kalāṃ kalāṃ gṛhītvā vai devānāṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ ||
nirmito ‘yaṃ surair yasmāt kalaśas tena kathyate |
vārayanti grahān yasmāt mātaro vividhāṃs tathā ||
duritāṃś ca tathāghorāṃs tena te vārakāḥ smṛtāḥ |
kalaśasya mukhe brahmā grīvāyāṃ tu maheśvaraḥ ||
mūle tu saṃsthito viṣṇur madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ |
śākhāsu devatāḥ sarvā veṣṭayanti caturdiśam ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni kalaśe niviśanti ha |
gṛhe śāntiś ca puṣṭiś ca prītir gotribhir eva ca ||
ṛgvedo ‘tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedas tathaiva ca |
atharvavedasaṃhitāḥ sarve kalaśasaṃsthitāḥ ||
pūrṇāmṛtena toyena sitās te kāṃcanobjalāḥ (?) |
saritsaraḥkātajena taḍāgādijalena vā ||
vāpīkūpodadivyena sāmudreṇa sukhāvahāḥ |
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyāḥ sarvakilbiṣanāśanāḥ ||
abhiṣeke sadā grāhyāḥ kalaśā idṛśāḥ śubhāḥ |
yātrāvivāhakāle vā pratiṣṭhā yajñakarmaṇi ||
[225] yojanīyā viśeṣeṇa sarvakarmaprasādhakāḥ |
pañcāśāṅgulavaipuṇyam utsedhe ṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ |
kalaśānāṃ pramāṇaṃ hi mukham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet ||
nāradīyanṛsiṃhakhaṇḍāt |
bhṛgur uvāca |
tuṅgā bhadrā ca baginī dve nadyau sahyasaṃbhave |
tayor bhadrā taṭe vatsa tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya keśavam ||
tam ārādhya jagannāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
hṛdi kṛtvendriyagrāmaṃ manaḥ saṃyamya yatnataḥ ||
hṛtpuṇḍarīke deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
dhyāyann ekamanā vatsa dvādaśākṣaram abhyaset ||
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya |
imaṃ mantraṃ hi japato devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ |
prīto bhavati viśvātmā mṛtyuṃ tenopaśāmyati ||
iti dvādaśākṣaraḥ |
nāradīyanṛsiṃhakhaṇḍāt |
śuka uvāca |
kiṃ japan mucyate tāta satataṃ viṣṇutatparaḥ |
saṃsāraduḥkhāt sarveṣāṃ hitāya vada me pitaḥ ||
[226] vyāsa uvāca |
aṣṭākṣaraṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrāṇāṃ mantram uttamam |
yaṃ japan mucyate jantur janmasaṃsārabandhanāt ||
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhyasthaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
ekāgramanasā dhyātvā viṣṇoḥ kuryāj japan naraḥ ||
ekāgre vijane sthāne viṣṇvagre vā jalāntike |
japed aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ citte viṣṇuṃ nidhāya ca ||
aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya ṛṣir nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
chando ‘sya devī gāyatrī paramātmā ca devatā ||
śuklavarṇas tu oṅkāro nakāro rakta ucyate |
mokāro varṇataḥ kṛṣṇo nākāro rakta eva ca ||
rākāraḥ kuṅkumābhāso yakāro pīta ucyate |
ṇākāro mañjanābhas tu yakāro bahuvarṇakaḥ |
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam |
nārāyaṇāt paraṃ kiṃcin neha paśyāmi he dvija ||
tena vyāptam idaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaṃ carācaram |
smaren nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyed dhaste kāye ca vinyaset ||
śeṣe hastatalaṃ yāvat tarjanyāditayor nyaset |
oṃkāraṃ vāmapāde tu nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset ||
mokāraṃ vāmakaṭyāṃ tu nākāraṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
[227] rākāraṃ nābhideśe tu yakāraṃ vāmabāhuke ||
ṇākāraṃ dakṣiṇe pāṇau yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyaset |
adhaś cordhvaṃ ca viśaye pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhato ‘grataḥ ||
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ vidadhyāt kavacaṃ punaḥ |
pūrve māṃ pātu govindo dakṣiṇe madhusūdanaḥ ||
paścime śrīdharo devaḥ keśavaś ca tathottare |
pātu viṣṇus tavāgre vai nairṛtye mādhavo ‘vyayaḥ ||
vyāyavye tu hṛṣīkeśas tatheśāne ca vāmanaḥ |
bhūtale pātu vārāhas tathordhve tu trivikramaḥ ||
kṛtvaivaṃ kavacaṃ paścād ātmānaṃ cintayen naraḥ |
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
evaṃ dhyātvā tadātmānam imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
iti nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣaraḥ |
agnipurāṇe |
muktihetur haraḥ sākṣāt sarvajño jñānabhāvakaḥ |
asyābhidhānamantro ‘yam abhidheyaś ca saṃsmṛtaḥ (?) ||
abhidhānābhidheyatvān mantrāt siddhiprado haraḥ |

iti ṣaḍakṣaraḥ |
śaivī pañcākṣarī vidyā | vāyusaṃhitāyām |
atho paramavidyāyāḥ svarūpam adhunocyate |

śaivī pañcākṣarī vidyā pañcaśrutiśirogatā |

pītaḥ kṛṣṇas tathā dhūmravarṇatorakta eva ca ||
pṛthak prayuktāḥ pañcaite bindunādavibhūṣitāḥ |
ardhacandrākṛtir bindur nādo dīpaśikhākṛtiḥ ||
bījaṃ dvitīyaṃ bījeṣu mantrasyasya varānane |
dīrghaṃ pūrvaṃ turīyasya pañcamaṃ śaktim ādiśet ||
vāmadevo nāma ṛṣiḥ paṅktiḥ chanda udāhṛtam |
devatā śiva evāhaṃ mantrasyāsya varānane ||
[229] gautamo ‘trir varārohe viśvāmitras tathāṅgirāḥ |
bharadvājaś varṇānāṃ kramaśo ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
gāyatry anuṣṭup triṣṭup chandāṃsi bṛhatī virāṭ |
indro rudro harir brahmā skandas teṣāṃ ca devatāḥ ||
mama pañcamukhāny āhuḥ sthānaṃ teṣāṃ varānane |
pūrvādi cordhvaparyantaṃ nakārādi yathākramam ||
udāttaḥ prathamo varṇaś caturthaś ca dvitīyakaḥ |
pañcamaḥ svaritaś caiva madhyamo nihataḥ smṛtaḥ ||
mūlaṃ vidyā śivaḥ śaivaṃ sūtraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ vinā |
sāmāny asyāpi jānīyāc chaivaṃ me hṛdayaṃ matam ||
nakāraḥ śiva ucyeta makāras tu śikhocyate |
śikāraḥ kavacaṃ tadvad vākāro netra ucyate ||
yakāro ‘straṃ namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ vauṣaḍ iti plutaḥ (?) |
phaḍ iti pañcavarṇānāṃ mantrāṅgatvaṃ yadā yadā ||
tadāpi mūlamantro ‘yaṃ kiṃcid bhedasamanvayāt |
atrāsya pañcamo varṇo dvādaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ ||
tasmād anena mantreṇa manovākkāyabhedataḥ |
āvayor arcanaṃ kuryāj japahomādikais tathā ||
iti śivapañcākṣaraḥ |
