śivadhārme |
kalpakoṭisahasrais tu yat pāpaṃ samupārjitam |
ghṛtasnānena tat sarvaṃ dahaty agnir ivendhanam ||
ayutaṃ yogavāṃ dadyād dogdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage |
vastraṃ hemādiyuktānāṃ kṣīrasnanasya tat phalam ||
dadhnā tu snāpayel liṅgaṃ sakṛd bhaktyā tu yo naraḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||
madhunā snāpayitvā tu sakṛd bhaktyā tu yo naraḥ |
pāpakaṅcukam utsṛjya vahniloke mahīyate ||
snānam ikṣurasenāpi yo liṅge sakṛd ācaret |
labhed vidyādharaṃ lokaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam ||
payodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyair anukramāt |
iśādimantraiḥ samsnāpya śivalokam avāpnuyāt ||
yaḥ pumāṃs tilatailena karayantrodbhavena ca |
śivābhiṣekaṃ kurute sa śaivaṃ padam āpnuyāt ||
parimāṇaṃ tu tatraivoktam |
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyam abhyaṅgaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
[236] palānāṃ dve sahasre tu mahāsnānaṃ parkīrtitam ||
liṅgapurāṇāt |
mahāsnānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād ghṛtena madhunā tataḥ |
sa yāti mama sāyujyaṃ snāneṣv eteṣu suvrata ||
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyam abhyaṅgaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
palānāṃ dve sahasre tu mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtitam ||
snāpya liṅgaṃ madīyaṃ ca gavyenaiva ghṛtena vā |
viśodhya sarvadravyais tu toyenāpy abhiṣecayan ||
mahāsnāne prasakte tu snānam aṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam |
jalena kevalenaiva gandhatoyena bhaktitaḥ ||
anunimpec ca tat sarvaṃ pañcaviṃśatpalena vai |
śamīpatraṃ ca vidhinā bilvapatraṃ ca campakam |
athānyāni ca patrāṇi bilvapatraṃ na saṃtyajet ||
daśadroṇais tu naivedyam aṣṭadroṇair athāpi vā |
śatadroṇasamaṃ puṇyam āḍhakena vidhīyate ||
vittahīnasya martyasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
bherīmṛdaṅgamurajakaratālapaṭahādibhiḥ ||
vāditrair vividhaiś cānyair āndolair vividhais tathā |
jāgaraṃ kārayet tatra prārthayec ca yathākramam ||
svabhṛtyaputradāraiś ca tathā saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ |
sārdhaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prārthayel liṅgam aiśvaram ||
ity uktvā caiva rudrañ ca tvaritaṃ śāntim eva ca |
[237] mantra iti mahābījaṃ tathā pañcākṣarasya vai iti ||
iti mahāsnānam |
kālikāpurāṇāt |
kārtikyām atha vaiśākhyām ayanādiṣu parvasu |
datvā dīpān samudbodhya devasyāgre baliṃ tataḥ ||
bhūtānāṃ devadevasya brahmādiṣu bhavet sudhīḥ |
sa vratī devam āmantrya svaped bhūmau hariṃ smaran ||
upalipya gṛhaṃ gatvā nirāhāro niśi svapet |
apare ‘hani pūrvāhne gatvā tatraiva mandire |
kārayet tu mahāsnānaṃ harāya vidhinā śṛṇu ||
pañcaviṃśatpalenaiva abhyaṅgaṃ kārayed atha |
śivasya sarpiṣā snānaṃ proktaṃ palaśatena vai ||
palānāṃ dvisahasreṇa mahāsnānaṃ vidhīyate |
tāvatā madhunā caiva dadhnā caiva tataḥ punaḥ ||
tāvataiva hi kṣīreṇa gavyenaiva bhavet tataḥ |
bhūyaḥ sārdhasahasreṇa phalānām akṣayeṇa tu ||
rasena kārayet snānaṃ bhaktyācekṣvambunā tataḥ |
punaḥ śītāmbunā datvā vastrapūtena mantravit ||
snāpayet bhaktito bhūmo gandhapātrasthitena tu |
vidhinā snāpya bāṇena gorocanayāthālipet ||
kṛṣṇakuṅkumakarpūracandanāguruyuktayā |
[238] kṛṣṇā kastūrī |
lepayitvā tato liṅgam āpīḍāntaṃ ghanaṃ śubham |
nīlotpalasahasreṇa mālāṃ badhvā prapūjayet ||
alābhāt tu sahasrāṇām ardhārdhenaiva pūjayet |
utpalānām alābhe tu patraiś ca śrītaror yajet ||
padmair vā campakair vāpi jātyāpāṭalayāpi vā |
punnāgaiḥ karṇikārair vā śvetamandārajair api ||
madanair marupuṣpair vā śamīśuklārkanāgaraiḥ |
yathālābhaṃ ca patrair vā nirgandhair amalorjitaiḥ ||
prapūjya kārayed bhaktyā sugandhapuṣpamaṇḍapam |
gugguluṃ cājyasaṃyuktam aguruṃ vāsitaṃ dahet ||
saṃpūjya gaurībhartāraṃ gītavāditramaṅgalaiḥ |
śālipiṣṭodbhavaiḥ siddhair ghṛtapūrṇaiḥ samujjvalaiḥ ||
tato nīrājanaṃ dīpaiḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyā tu kārayet |
sarṣapair dadhiyuktaiś ca dūrvāgorocanākṣataiḥ ||
gandhapuṣpodakaṃ dadyād dhūpārthaṃ cintya śāṅkaram |
śātakumbhaṃ tataḥ padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ||
dhyātvā nivedayen mūrdhni liṅgasya kusumaiḥ saha |
sūkṣmavastrayugaṃ gītaṃ śvetaṃ vā padmasaṃnibham ||
cāmaraṃ darṣaṇaṃ caiva dipavartiṃ pradāpayet |
dhūpasaṃcāraṇaṃ caiva saṃkaṭaṃ pūrvam eva ca ||
vināyakadhvajau dadyāt kiṅkiṇīravakānvitau |
[239] athāṣṭabhiḥ kṣitiḥ pīḍyā aṅgair bhaktyā tu daṇḍavat ||
tata uccaiḥ paṭhet stotraṃ śāṅkaraṃ ca śivapriyam |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tato gacchec chanair nirmālyavarjitaḥ ||
praṇamya ca punaḥ paścān naivedyaṃ ca nivedayet |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇāṃś caiva āgatān śivadīkṣitān ||
tarpayed annapānena sarvāṃs (?) tān uktagauravāt |
kuryād etan mahāsnānaṃ vidhinnena dharmavit ||
kārayed yaḥ śive bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
samuddhṛtya śataṃ sārdhaṃ kulānāṃ pāpavarjitaḥ ||
bhuvanaṃ brahmalokāntaṃ bhuktvā bhogān aśeṣataḥ |
vrajet krīḍāyate tasmin vimānastho ‘marair yutaḥ ||
bhogān yathepsitān bhuktvā śivasāyujyatāṃ vrajet |
māyāṃ ca tāṃ samutsṛjya ante yogam avāpnuyāt ||
kevalenātha vājyena dadhnā gavyena caiva vā |
payasā pañcagavyena madhunekṣurasena vā ||
yaḥ kārayen mahāsnānaṃ vidhinānena mantrataḥ |
so ‘pi tenaiva mārgeṇa gamiṣyati paraṃ padam ||
antarā sriyate yas tu apūrṇo niyamena vā |
so ‘pi gacchet padaṃ tat tu śivabhaktyā hy atandritaḥ ||
vidhinānena niḥsvīyaḥ snānaṃ toyena kārayet |
narāṇāṃ viṃśatiṃ yāvat sa yāsyati paraṃ padam ||
evam eva hi śūdrasya sparśamantravivarjitam |
mantrayuktyārcayed yas tu tataḥ puṇyādhiko bhavet ||

iti mahāpūjāvidhiḥ |
vāstusaṃhitāyām |
pūjanīyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ |
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ haimaṃ navaratnair alaṃkṛtam ||
karṇikākesaropatam āsanaṃ parikalpayet |
rājataṃ tadabhāve tu raktasitam athāpi vā ||
padmaṃ tasyāpy abhāve tu kevalaṃ bhāvanāmayam |
tatpadmakarṇikāmadhye kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kanīyasam ||
atha vā sphāṭikopetaṃ pūjayed vistṛtakramāt |
pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānena tal liṅgaṃ kṛtaśodhanam ||
parikalpyāsanaṃ mūrtau pañcavaktraprakārataḥ |
pañcagavyādibhiḥ puṇyair yathāvibhavasaṃśritaiḥ ||
snāpayet kalaśaiḥ pūrṇaiḥ sahasrādyais tu śaṃbhave |
gandhadravyaiḥ sa karpūrairś candanādyaiḥ sa kuṅkumaiḥ ||
savedikaṃ samālipya liṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitam |
bilvapatraiś ca padmaiś ca raktaiḥ śvetais tathotpalaiḥ ||
nīlotpalais tathānyaiś ca puṇyais tais taiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
puṇyaiḥ praśastaiś citraiś ca patrair dūrvākṣatādibhiḥ ||
samabhyarcya tathā lābhaṃ mahāpūjāṃ vidhānataḥ |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā dadyān naivediyaṃ (?) ca viśeṣataḥ ||
nivedayitvā vibhavaṃ kalyānaṃ ca samācaret |
iṣṭāni ca viśiṣṭāni nyāyenopārjitāni ca ||
[241] sarvadravyāṇi deyāni vrate tasmin viśeṣataḥ |
śrīpatrotpalādiphalaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ bilvapatrake ||
puṣpāntareṇa niyamo yathālābhaṃ nivedayet |
aṣṭāṅgam agham uddiṣṭaṃ dhūpadīpau viśeṣataḥ ||
kṛṣṇāgurur aghorākhye vaktre savye manaḥśilā |
candanaṃ vāmadevākhye mukhe kṛṣṇāguruṃ punaḥ ||
pauruṣe gugguluṃ savye saumye saugandhikaṃ mukhe |
īśāne ‘pi tv īśāṇīṃ vā dadyād dhūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
agurumiśraṃ gugguluṃ pradadyād ghṛtasaṃyutam |
candanāgurukuṣṭhādyaṃ sāmānyaṃ tu pracakṣate ||
karpūravartinā deyo dīpo ghṛtavalis tataḥ |
argham ācamanaṃ deyaṃ prativaktram ataḥ param ||
prathamāvaraṇe tilāṃś caiva prathamāvaraṇe ‘rcitāḥ |
dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyā vidyeśāś cakravartinaḥ ||
tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścād aṣṭamūrtir maheśvaraḥ |
mahādevādayas tatra tathaikādaśamūrtayaḥ ||
caturthāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ |
bahir eva tu padmasya pañcamāvaraṇakramāt ||
daśadikpatayaḥ pūjyāḥ śāstrāt sānucarās tathā |
brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrāḥ sarve ‘pi jyotiṣāṅgaṇāḥ ||
sarve devāś ca devyaś ca sarvāḥ sarve ‘pi khecarāḥ |
pātālavāsinaś cānye sarve munigaṇā api ||
[242] yogino marutaḥ pañca pañcagomātaras tathā |
kṣetrapālāś ca sagaṇāḥ sarvaṃ caiva carācaram ||
athāvaraṇapūjāṃ te saṃpūjya parameśvaram |
sājyaṃ savyañjanaṃ hṛdyaṃ harer bhaktaṃ nivedayet ||
sukhāvāsādikaṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ sopadaṃśakam |
alaṃkṛtya ca bhūyo ‘pi nānāpuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
nīrājanāntaṃ vistārya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
varāṅgaṃ sopahāraṃ ca śayanaṃ ca samīrayet ||
yad annaṃ pācitaṃ hṛdyaṃ tat sarvam anupūrvaśaḥ |
kṛtvā ca kārayitvā ca hutvā caiva prapūjanam ||
stotraṃ vyāmohanaṃ japtvā vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet |
datvārgham aṣṭau puṣpāṇi devam uddhāsaliṅgataḥ ||
tāmbūlamukhavāsayor lakṣaṇam uktaṃ ratnakośe |
mahāpippalapatrāṇi kramukasya phalāni ca |
śuktikṣāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ tāmbūlam iti saṃjñitam ||
śvetapatraṃ ca pūrṇaṃ ca kramukasya phalāni ca |
nārikelaphalopetaṃ mātulāṅgasamāyutam |
elākakkolakarpūrair mukhavāsaṃ pracakṣate ||
eteṣām apy alābhe tu tat tad dravyaṃ smared budhaḥ |
tat tad dravyaṃ tu saṃkalpya puṣpair vāpi samarpayet || iti |
iti prakārāntareṇa mahāpūjāvidhiḥ |
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
[243] mahāvartiḥ sadā deyā bhūmipālamahāphalā |
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa tatrāpi ca viśeṣataḥ ||
amāvāsyā ca nirdiṣṭā dvādaśī ca mahāphalā |
āśvayujyām atītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya yā bhavet ||
amāvāsyā mahāpuṇyā dvādaśī ca viśeṣataḥ |
devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve deyā tailatulā nṛpa ||
palāṣṭakayutāṃ rājan vartiṃ tatra prakalpayet |
mahārajataraktena samagreṇa tu vāsasā ||
vāmapārśve tu devasya deyā ghṛtatulā nṛpa |
palāṣṭakayutāṃ puṇyāṃ śuklāṃ vartiṃ ca dāpayet ||
vāsasā tu samagreṇa sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
evaṃ vartidvayam idaṃ sakṛd datvā mahīpate ||
svargalokaṃ ciraṃ bhuktvā jāyate bhūtale yadā |
tadā bhavati lakṣmīvān rūpasaubhāgyasaṃyutaḥ ||
rāṣṭre ca jāyate tasmin deśe ca nagare tathā |
kule ca rājaśārdūla tatra syād dīpavat prabhā ||
atyujjvalaś ca bhavati yuddheṣu kalaheṣu ca |
khyātiṃ yāti sadā loke sajjanānāṃ ca sadguṇaḥ ||
ekām apy atha vā dadyād abhīṣṭām anayor dvayoḥ |
mānuṣye sarvam āpnoti yad uktaṃ te mayānagha ||
sāmānyasya tu dīpasya rājan dānaṃ mahāphalam |
kiṃ punar mahatas tasya phalasyānto na vidyate ||
dīpadānaṃ mahāpuṇyam anyadevasya ca dhruvam |
[244] kiṃ punar devadevasya anantasya mahātmanaḥ ||
giriśṛṅgeṣu dātavyā nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca |
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu brāhmaṇānāṃ ca veśmasu ||
vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca |
dīpadānaṃ mahāmantraṃ mahatphalam upāśnute ||
iti mahādīpavidhiḥ
atha vratārambhakālaḥ | tatra satyavrataḥ |
udavasthā tithir yā hi na bhaved dinamadhyabhāk |
sā khaṇḍā na vratānāṃ syād ārambhe ca samāpane || iti |
etadvyatiriktāyām akhaṇḍāyāṃ prāmbham āha vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
svakhaṇḍavyāpimārtaṇḍā yady akhaṇḍā bhavet tithiḥ |
vrataprārambhaṇaṃ tasyām anaṣṭaguruśukrayuk || iti |
tithir yady anaṣṭaguruśukrayuk anastamitaguruśukrayuktā tasyāṃ vratam ārambhaṇīyam ity arthaḥ, idam upalakṣaṇam | guruśukrayor bālye vārdhakye ‘pi vrataṃ nārambhaṇīyam ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca vṛddhamanubṛhaspatau |
agnyādhānaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca yajñadānavratāni ca |
vedavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalā |
māṅgalyam abhiṣekaṃ ca malamāse vivarjayet ||
bālye vā yadi vā vṛddhe śukre vātaṃgate gurau |
[245] malamāsa ivaitāni varjayed devadarśanam || iti |
gārgyo ‘pi |
nāmānnaprāśanaṃ cauḍaṃ vivāhaṃ mauñjibandhanam |
niṣkramaṃ jātakarmāpi kāmyaṃ vṛṣavisarjanam ||
astige ca gurau śukre bāle vṛddhe malimluce |
udyāpanam upārambhaṃ vratānāṃ naiva kārayet || iti |
lannaḥ |
nīcasye vakrasaṃsthe ‘py abhicaraṇagate bālavṛddhāstage vā
sanyāso devayātrā vratacaraṇavidhiḥ karṇavedhas tu dīkṣā |
mauñjībandho ‘tha cūḍā pariṇayanavidhir vāstudevapratiṣṭhā |
varjyāḥ sadbhiḥ prayatnāt tridaśapatigurau saṃharāśisthite ca || iti |
nīlalakṣaṇaṃ tu jyotiḥśāstre |
sūryādiṣūccamajagomakarāḥ kramāt syuḥ |
strī karkimīnavaṇijostagamaṃ ca nīcam || iti |
uccasthānāt saptamaṃ nīcam ity arthaḥ | tathā ca nīcasthe gurau makaragate ity arthaḥ |
śaunakaḥ |
kīrtyāgāravivāhayāgagamanaṃ kṣīrādyakarṇavyadhaṃ
vidyādevavilokanopanayanaṃ dīkṣāparīkṣāvratam |
snānaṃ tīrthagamaṃ raṇaṃ puramahādānapratiṣṭhāpanaṃ
[246] siṃhasthe vibudhārcite na śubhadaṃ kartur tathā sūryage ||
astalakṣaṇaṃ tu brahmasiddhānte |
raviṇāsattir anyeṣāṃ grahāṇām asta ucyate |
tato ‘rvāk vārdhakaṃ vidyād ūrdhvaṃ bālyaṃ prakīrtitam || iti |
etayor avadhiḥ jyotiḥśāstre ‘nekadhā darśitaḥ |
bālaḥ śukro divasadaśakaṃ pañcakaṃ caiva vṛddhaḥ
paścād ahnas tritaryam uditaḥ pakṣamauḍhyaḥ krameṇa |
jīvo vṛddhaḥ śuśur api sadā pakṣaṃ anyaiḥ śiśū tau
vṛddhau proktau divasadaśakaṃ cāparaiḥ saptarātram || iti |
eteṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ vyavsthā deśāntaraviṣayā āpadviṣayā vā | tathā ca gārgyaḥ |
śukro guruḥ prāk prāk ca bālo
vindhye daśāvantiṣu saptarātram |
vaṅgeṣu hūṇeṣu ca ṣaṭ ca pañca
śeṣe ca deśe tridinaṃ vadanti || iti |
varāhamihiro ‘pi |
bahavo darśitāḥ kālā ye bālye vārdhike ‘pi ca |
grāhyās tatrādhikāḥ śeṣā deśabhedād utāpadi || iti |
atha mudrālakṣaṇāni |
saṃmukhīkṛtya hastau dvau kiṃcit saṃkucitāṅgulī |
mukuṭī tu samākhyātā paṅkajaprasṛtaiva sā ||
[247] mukulī paṅkajamudrayoḥ |
pūrvā ca mukulī yā ca pradeśe nisṛtāṅguliḥ |
vyākośamudrā mukulā padmamudrāṃ pradarśayet ||
padmamudrāyāḥ |
aṅguṣṭhau kuñcitau dvau tu svakīyāṅguliveṣṭitau |
ubhau cābhimukhau hastau yojayitvā tu niṣṭhurā ||
niṣṭhurāyāḥ |
tarjanyau kuñcitau kṛtvā tathaiva ca kanīyasī |
adhomukhā dṛṣṭanakhā sthitā madhye karasya tu ||
catasraś cocchritāḥ pṛṣṭhe aṅguṣṭhāv ekataḥ kuru |
nālaṃ vyavasthitau dvau tu vyomamudrā prakīrtitā ||
vyomamudrāyāḥ |
atha vaidikamantrāṇām ṛṣidaivatachandāṃsi | tatprayojanam āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
ārṣaṃ chando daivataṃ ca viniyogas tathaiva ca |
veditavyaṃ prayatnena brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ ||
aviditvā tu yaḥ kuryād yājanādhyayanaṃ japam |
homam antarjale dānaṃ tasya cālpaphalaṃ labhet ||
tathā |
yo vijānāti mantrāṇām ārṣaṃ chandaś ca daivatam |
viniyogaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca mantrārthaṃ jñānakarma ca ||
[248] ekaikasya ṛṣeḥ so ‘pi vandhyo hy atithivad bhavet |
devatā yāś ca sāyujyaṃ gacchaty atra na saṃśayaḥ ||
pūrvoktena prakāreṇa ṛṣyādīn vetti yo dvijaḥ |
adhikāro bhavet tasya rahasyādiṣu karmasu ||
yena yad ṛṣiṇā dṛṣṭaṃ siddhiḥ prāptā ca yena vai |
mantreṇa yasya yat proktam ṛṣer bhāvas tad ārṣakam ||
chandanāt chanda uddiṣṭaṃ vāsasā iva cākṛtiḥ |
ātmā saṃchādito devair mṛtyor bhītais tu vai purā ||
ādityair vasubhī rudrais tena chandāṃsi tāni vai |
yasya yasya tu mantrasya uddiṣṭā devatā tu yā |
tadākāraṃ bhavet tasya devatvaṃ devatocyate ||
purā devaiḥ samutpannā mantrāḥ karmārtham eva ca |
anena cedaṃ kartavyaṃ viniyogaḥ sa ucyate ||
nairuktyaṃ yasya mantrasya viniyogaprayojanam |
pratīṣṭhāṃ stutiś caiva brāhmaṇaṃ tad ihocyate ||
evaṃ pañcavidhaṃ yogaṃ japakāle hy anusmaret |
home cāntarjale yoge svādhyāye yājane tathā || iti |
tatrādau ṛgvedamantrāḥ | agnim īleti sūktasya madhuchando viśvāmitro ‘gnir gāyatrī | vāyavāyāhīti saptānāṃ madhuchandāḥ | ādyānatisṝṇāṃ vāyuḥ anantarāṇām indravāyū | saptamāyā mitrāvaruṇau | saptānāṃ gāyatrī |
[249] sadasampatim iti mantrasya kāṇvo medhātithiḥ sadasampatir gāyatrī |
ambayoyaṃ tv adhvam ity asya kāṇvo medhātithir āpogāyatrī |
yat siddhisatyasomapā iti ājīgartiḥ śunaḥśepaḥ indraḥ |
adyānāṃ saptānāṃ paṅktir navānāṃ gāyatrī |
yuvānā medhātithiḥ kāṇva ṛbhayo gāyatrī |
syonāpṛthivī medhātithiḥ kāṇvaḥ pṛthvī gāyatrī |
ato deveti dvayor medhātithir devo viṣṇur gāyatrī |
kasya nūnam iti pañcadaśarcasya ājīgartir vaiśvāmitro |
vā śunaḥśephaḥ ṛṣiḥ prathamāyāḥ kaḥ prajāpatis triṣṭup |
dvitīyāyā agnis triṣṭup | abhitveti tisṛṣu savitā |
bhagasyety asyām bhago vā gāyatrī |
nahita ityādyā daśa vāruṇyas triṣṭubhaḥ |
tvam agne prathamo ‘ṅgirā ity aṣṭādaśarcasya |
aṣṭamīṣoḍaśyaṣṭādaśyas triṣṭubhaḥ |
eteti pañcadaśarcasya āṅgirasa hiraṇyas tūpa indras triṣṭup |
kadudroyeti nava ghoraḥ kāṇvo rudraḥ |
tṛtīyāyāṃ rudro mitrāvaruṇau saptamyāditriṣu somaḥ gāyatrī |
yās ta ityantyā anuṣṭup |
[250] udutyaṃ jātavedasam iti trayodaśa antyās triṣṭup praskannaḥ |
sūryaḥ ādyā nava gāyatryaḥ |
daśamyādicatasro ‘nuṣṭubhaḥ antyatryṛco rogaghnaḥ |
antyo ‘rdharcaḥ śatrughanḥ | paśvānaṃ daśarcasya śāktyaḥ pārāśaro ‘gnir
dvipadā virāṭ |
śaunakamate pañca paṅktibhiḥ virāṭ |
rapir natricādaśarcaṃ śāktyaḥ pārāsaro ‘gnir dvipadā virāṭ |
śaunakamate pañca paṅktiḥ virāṭ | vaneṣujāyur daśa śaunakamate pañca | śrīṇannupadaśa śaunakamate pañca | vanemapūrvī ekādśarcaṃ śunakamate ṣaṭ | upaprajinvan daśarcasya śāktyaḥ pārāśaro ‘gnis triṣṭup | nikāvyāvedhasaḥ | daśa śāktyaḥ | parāśaro ‘gnis triṣṭup | rapir nayaḥ pitṛvittaḥ daśarcasya | parāśaro ‘gnis triṣṭup | upaprayanto nava rāhugaṇo gautamo ‘gnir gāyatrī | hiraṇyakeśo rajaso dvādaśarcasya gautamo ‘gniḥ ādyās tisras triṣṭubhaḥ | tāsu madhyasthāno vā śuddho vāgniḥ caturthādyās tisra uṣṇihaḥ | tataḥ ṣaṭ gāyatryaḥ |
tvaṃ soma praciketo manīṣeti trayoviṃśatyṛcasya | gautamaḥ somaḥ ādyacatasṝṇāṃ triṣṭup | tato dvādaśānāṃ gāyatrī | saptamy uṣṇik | tataḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ triṣṭup |
[251] prapandine ekādaśarcasya | āṅgirasaḥ kutsaḥ marutvān indraḥ | ādyāḥ sapta jagatyaḥ ādyā garbhasrāviṇī upaniṣat | tataś catasras triṣṭubhaḥ | imā rudrāyatapase ity ekādaśaracasya | kutso rudraḥ navānāṃ jagatī | daśamyekādaśyos triṣṭup | ubhe punāmīti saptarcasya | pārukṣepa indraḥ ādyā triṣṭup | dvitīyādyās tisro ‘nuṣṭubhaḥ pañcamī gayatrī ṣaṣṭhī dhṛtiḥ saptamy uṣṇik | ye devāsaḥ pārukṣepa viśvadevās triṣṭup | pitunnustoṣaṃ ekādaśarcaṃ agastonnaṃ prathamā anuṣṭhup | garbhoṣṇik | dvitīyacaturthyor gāyatrī tṛtīyā anuṣṭup | pañcamyāditisro ‘nuṣṭubhaḥ tatas tisro gāyatryaḥ antyā bṛhatyanuṣṭubhaḥ | agne nayety aṣṭharcam | agastyo ‘gnis triṣṭup | anarvāṇaṃ vṛṣabham ity aṣṭarcasya | agastyo bṛhaspatis triṣṭup | upemasṛkṣīti pañcadaśarcam | gṛtsada apo naptā | tariṣṭubham | karikradaj januṣam iti tryṛcasya gṛtsamadaḥ śakunta indras triṣṭup | ilāparvatā caturviṃśatryṛcam | ādyāyām indraparvatau | tataś caturdaśīparyantānām indraḥ | tato dvayoḥ sasarparī vāk | saptadaśyādicatasṛṣu rathāṅgāni indraś ca | antyānāṃ catasṝṇām indraḥ | [252] ādyā nava triṣṭubhaḥ daśamī jagatī | ekāsaśī triṣṭup | dvādaśy anuṣṭup | trayodaśī gāyatrī | tato dve triṣṭubhau | śoḍaśī jagatī | saptadaśī triṣṭup | aṣṭādaśī bṛhatī | ekonaviṃśī triṣṭup | viṃśī dvāviṃśī cānuṣṭup | ekaviṃśī trayoviṃśī caturviṃśī ca triṣṭup |
agninendreṇeti caturviṃśadṛcasya sūktasya |
śyāvāśva ātreyaḥ aśvinau upariṣṭāj (?) jyotiṣam |
dvāviṃśicaturviśyyau paṅktī trayoviṃśī mahābṛhatī |
avitāsīti saptarcasya śyāvāśva indraḥ śakvarī |
antyā mahāpaṅktiḥ | agrimas toṣīti daśarcasya | nābhākaḥ | kāṇvognir mahāṃ paṅktiḥ | ime viprasyeti | trayastriṃśadṛcasya sūktasya āṅgiraso virūpāgnir gāyatrī | samidhāgnim iti triṃśadṛcasya virūpāgnir gāyatrī | ādyāyeti | dvicatvāriṃśadṛcasya sūktasya | triśokaḥ kāṇva indro gāyatrī | mahivaḥ | aṣṭādaśarcasya | trita āsyaḥ ādityo devatā | antyāḥ pañca upasthaḥ mahāpaṅktiḥ duḥsvapnaghnam | pratite | pañcarcam | pañcarcam | pṛṣaghnakāṇvaḥ aindraṃ gāyatraṃ āgnisaurī antyā paṅktiḥ | pro asmai dvādaśaḥ pragāthakāṇvaḥ aindraṃ pāṅktam |
[253] saptamyaṣṭamīnavamyo bṛhatyaḥ tyānnukṣatriyān | eka viṃśatrṛcasya | matsyaḥ sāmmadaḥ agastyaḥ | bahavo jālavahā matsyāś ca ṛṣayaḥ ādityo devatā daśamyekadaśīdvādaśīṣvāditiḥ | gāyatrīchandaḥ | yo rājā pañcadaśarcam | puruhanmā āṅgirasaḥ aindraṃ bārhatam | dvitīyā caturthī ṣaṣṭyaḥ sato bṛhatyaḥ trayodaśy uṣṇik | caturdaśy anuṣṭup | pañcadaśī pura uṣṇik | tvanno agne mahobhir iti pañcadaśarcasya sūktasya | sudīti puram īḍāvanyataro vā | agniḥ gāyatrī daśamyādyāḥ samā bṛhatyaḥ ekādaśādyāḥ viṣamāḥ satī bṛhatyaḥ | kanyāvāḥ saptarcasya ātreya indro ‘nuṣṭup ādye dve paṅktī | udvedabhi | catustriṃśat | sūkakṣa indro gāyatrī aindrābhavī anytā | āpohiṣṭeti navarcasya | āmbarīṣaḥ sindhudvīpa āpo gāyatrī | pañcamo vardhamānā saptamī pratiṣṭhā antye dve anuṣṭupbau | parepivāṃsam iti ṣoḍaśarcasya | yamo vaivasvato yamaḥ ṣaṣṭī liṅgoktadevatā | saptamyāditisraḥ pitryā vā yāmyā vā | daśamyāditisṛṣu śvāṇau triṣṭup chandaḥ trayodaśī caturdaśī ca anuṣṭup | pañcadaśī bṛhatī | paramṛtyāv iti caturdaśarcasya [254] saṅkusukoyāmaḥ ādyānāṃ catasṝṇāṃ mṛtyuḥ | pañcamyādhātā | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tvaṣṭā | parāḥ pitṛyajñadevatyaḥ antyā prājāpatyā vā triṣṭup | ekādaśī prastārapaṅktiḥ trayodaśī jagatī | antyānuṣṭup | bhadranna iti daśarcasya | aindro vimadaḥ prājāpatyo vā vasukṛd vā sūktaḥ (?) agnir gāyatrī | ādyaikapadā śāntyarthā dvitīyānuṣṭup navamī virāṭ | antyās triṣṭubhaḥ | pradevatreti pañcadaśarcasya pṛlūṣaḥ kaṃṣavaḥ āpo vā āponaptī vā triṣṭup | prāvepāmām iti caturdaśarcam | maujavānakṣaḥ kavayo vā | ādyā saptamī navavīṣu kṛṣistutiḥ dvādaśyām akṣastutiḥ śeṣāṣv akṣarnidā (?) | traiṣṭubhaṃ ambughnam iti caturdaśarcasya dhānākolūṣo viśvedevā jagatī antye dve tiṣṭubhau | namo mitrasyeti dvādaśarcasya |sauryobhitayāḥ sūryo jagatī daśamī triṣṭup | divaspariddvādaśarcasya | vatsapriragnis triṣṭup antye ‘dhyarcaliṅgoktā devatā | āpragāmeti ṣaḍarcasya | bandhusubandhuśrutabandhuviprabandhava indro gāyatrī | yatteyamam iti dvādaśarcasya bandhvādayaś catvāra ṛṣayo yamādayo manaāvartanam anuṣṭup | idam irtyā iti saptaviṃśatyṛcasya | nābhānediṣṭo māmavo viśvedevās triṣṭup bṛhaspate ity ekādaśarcasya bṛhaspata ity āṅgirasaḥ paramātmā triṣṭup navamī jagatī yas te manyo iti saptarasya | manus tāpaso manyus triṣṭup | prathamā jagatī | rakṣohaṇam iti pañcaviṃśadṛcasya | vāyur bharadvājo ‘gnis triṣṭup |
antyāś catasro ‘nuṣṭubhaḥ | haviṣyāntam ity ekonaviṃśatyṛcasya āṅgiraso vā vāmadevyo vā murdhanvān sūryo vaiśvānaras triṣṭup | sahasraśīrṣā ṣoḍaśrcasya nārāyaṇaḥ paramātmā triṣṭup | [255] yā oṣadhīr iti trayoviṃśadṛcasya | ātharvaṇobhiṣagoṣadhīr anuṣṭup | bṛhaspate pratima iti dvādaśarcasya | devāpi rāṣṭiṣeṇo | vṛṣṭikāmo viśvedevās triṣṭup | ayānaś citraṃ dvādaśarcasya | vaikhānasī candra indras triṣṭup | āśuḥśiśāna iti trayodaśarcasya | aindro ‘pratiratha indras triṣṭup | caturthī bārhaspatyā upāntyā mārutī antyā ca māruty anuṣṭup | vaiśyāgnim iti saptarcasya | krameṇa saptarcāṃjūtir bharadvājaḥ śāsa indro ‘nuṣṭup | muñcāmi pañcarcasya yakṣmanāśanaḥ prajāpati indrāgnī indro vā triṣṭup | antyā bṛhatī vā brahmaṇāgnisaṃvidānaḥ ṣaḍarcasya rakṣohā brāhmo garbhasamādhāno ‘gnir anuṣṭup | apehi pañcarcasya āṅgirasaḥ praceto viśvedevānuṣṭup tṛtīyā triṣṭup | antyā paṅktir duḥsvapnaghnam | devāḥ kapotaḥ pañcarcasya nairṛtaḥ kapoto [256] viśvedevās triṣṭup kapoto padyāte prāyaścittam | tryṛcasya garbhakartā tvaṣṭā prājāpatyo viṣṇur vā viśvedevānuṣṭup | kasyacin mate viṣṇur yonim iti pañcarcam | mahitrīṇām iti tryṛcasya vāruṇiḥ satyadhṛtir gāyatrī | āyaṅgaus tryṛcasya sārparāhnī ātmā sūryo vā gāyatrī | saṃsamit catūṛcasya sambanana āṅgirasaḥ saṃjñānam anuṣṭup tṛtīyā triṣṭup | vāstoṣpate tryṛcasya maitrāvaruṇau vaśiṣṭho vāstoṣpatis triṣṭup | tat savitur navarcasya śyāvāścaḥ savitā gāyatrī prathamānuṣṭup | mātārudrāṇām iti mantrasya jamadagnir bhārgavo gāvas triṣṭup | śannodevīsūktasya vaśiṣṭho viśvedevās triṣṭup | yuvaṃvastrāṇi saptarcasya dīrghatamā mitrāvaruṇau triṣṭup | samudrād ūrmir ity ekādaśarcasya vāmadeva ṛṣīḥ agniḥ | sūryaḥ gāvo ghṛtaṃ vā devatāḥ antyās triṣṭup | upāntyā jagatī | svastidāviśaspatiḥ śāso bharadvāja indro ‘nuṣṭup | sudeva ity asya priyamegha indro ‘nuṣṭup | vāyo ete ekaviṃśatyṛcasya gṛtsamadaḥ ādyayor vāyuḥ tṛtīyāyā indrāvāyū | tatas tisṝṇāṃ mitrāvaruṇau tatas tisṝṇāṃ mitrāvaruṇau | [257] daśamyekādaśīdvādaśīnām indraḥ | tatas tryṛcasya saptarcasya kakṣīvān svanayanastutis triṣṭup | anye dve ‘nuṣṭubau | āvāṃratho aśvinā ity ekādaśarcasya kakṣīvān aśvinau triṣṭup | svādiṣṭayeti daśarcasya madhuchandā viśvāmitraḥ somo gāyatrī | sūryasthā | parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ sūryaḥ | vyāhṛtīnāṃ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ | agni vāyuḥ sūrya prajāpatayaḥ | upaprayanto bṛhadevāgnir gāyatrī | tanūyā agne bṛhadevāgnir gāyatrī | eṣa te rudrabhāga iti dvayor yajuṣoḥ prajāpatī rudraḥ prathamasya bṛhatī sāma paṅktir vā | dvitīyasya yajur bṛhatī | adasvenatvā parameṣṭhī prajā[273]patirājyam | bheṣajam asi prajāpatī | rudraḥ kakup | ambakam iti dvayoḥ prathamāyāḥ vaśiṣṭhaḥ dvitīyāyāḥ prajāpatir ubhayoḥ rudro ‘nuṣṭup | ākūtyai, prayuje, medhāyai | dīkṣāyai, svarasvatyai | ity eteṣāṃ caturṇāṃ maudgabhaṇānāṃ prajāpatir agnir āsurā triṣṭup | yajuḥ paṅktir vā | cid asi manāsīsyaprajāpatiḥ somakrayaṇī gauḥ brāhmī paṅktir atiśakkarī vā | agnes tanupaparameṣṭhī prajāpatir haviḥ | devo vā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatir viṣṇur anuṣṭup | viṣṇor nukam | divo vā | pratadviṣṇuḥ | iti tsṝṇāṃ prajāpatir viṣṇus triṣṭup | ādye yajur ante | viṣṇor arāṭam iti pañcayajuṣāṃ prajāpatir viṣṇur ādyasya daivī jagatī | tataś caturṇāṃ daivī paṅktiḥ | agrevratapā prajāpatir agnir brahmā triṣṭup | ayaṃ naḥ prajāpatir agnir yajus triṣṭup | idaṃ āpaḥ prajāpatir āpo mahāpaṅktis triṣṭubavasānā pāvamānaś cāntyaḥ pādaḥ | devās tv aśukrapā | devās tvā manthipā, ity anayoḥ prajāpatiḥ krameṇa śukrammanthinau havirdhāno ‘gnir yajuḥpaṅktī | ādivyayākuvaktyai | manuḥ sato bṛhatī | yukṣvā hi keśeneti madhcchandā indro 'nuṣṭup | agne pavasva vaikhānaso 'gnir gāyatrī | ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam iti devāḥ sūryo gāyatrī | ud u tyam praskaṇvaḥ sūryo gāyatrī | citraṃ devānāṃ kutsa āṅgirasaḥ sūryas triṣṭup | catvāri śruṅgā parameṣṭhī | yajñapuruṣas triṣṭup devā yajñaṃ prajāpatiḥ sarasvatyaḥ liṅgoktānuṣṭup | pitṛbhyaḥ prajāpatyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ pitaraḥ | vasena kratunā prajāptiḥ sarasvatī liṅgoktānuṣṭup | senā prajāpatir anuṣṭup | agnayeśesapataye [274] dakṣiṇāgnir āsurī paṅktiḥ agneyatteśukram ity asya prajāpatir agnir gāyatrī | suparṇo ‘si garutmānityasya prajāpatir garutmān kṛtiḥ | drupadād iveti | kokilo rājaputro vā drupado vā āpo anuṣṭup | śatavantaḥ ātharvaṇa oṣadhīr anuṣṭup | yā oṣadhīr ityādyānāṃ yo asmaibhidāsatītyantānāṃ saptaviṃśatīnāṃ ātharvaṇaputrobhiṣagoṣadhīr āpo ‘nuṣṭup | aśvāvatīr gomatīḥ vaśiṣṭha uṣā triṣṭup | sīrā yuñjantibhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ sārpir agniḥ prajāpatir anuṣṭup | kṛṇuṣvapāja iti pañcānāṃ devā vāmadevo ‘gnis triṣṭup | kāṇḍāt kāṇḍād iti dvayor agnir iṣṭhikā anuṣṭup | apāṅgam bhan prajāpatir varuṇaḥ paṅktiḥ | imaṃ māhiggaṃ sīritipañcarcā prajāpatir agnis triṣṭup | apātvā oṣadhīr āpo ‘gnir anuṣṭup | namas te rudra manyava iti rudrādhyāyasya prajāpatir vāmadevā vā ṛṣayaḥ | ādyo ‘nuvākaḥ ṣoḍaśarco rudradaivataḥ | prathamā gāyatrī | tato yā te rudra ityādyās tisro ‘nuṣṭubhaḥ | asau yas tāmra ityādyās tisraḥ paṅktayaḥ | namo ‘stu nīlagrīvāyety ādyāḥ saptānuṣṭubhaḥ | tata iti dve jagatī | manomantaṃ mānastoke iti dvayoḥ kutso ‘nyat pūrvavat | dvrāpe andhasaspata ityantānuvāke sapta ṛcaḥ | tatrādyā upariṣṭād bṛhatī dvitīyāyā kutsarṣidṛṣṭā jagatī | tṛtīyānuṣṭup | parito rudrasaya | mīḍhaṣṭameti dve triṣṭubhau | tato dve anuṣṭubhau asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇetyādyāḥ ya etāvanta ityantāḥ daśāvatānasaṃjñakā mantrāḥ bahurudradaivatyāḥ anuṣṭupchandaskāḥ | tatontyābhinamostu rudrebhyo ye devīti [275] trīṇi yajūṃṣi pratyavarohasaṃjñakāni bahurudradaivatāni ghṛtichandaskāni | ādyāntvānuvākayor madhye | namo hiraṇyavāhava ityādīni nama ānirhatebhya ityantāni sarvāṇi yajūṃṣi | teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ tisrośītayo devatāḥ | teṣāṃ madhye | namo hiraṇyavāhave senāṇye diśāṃ ca pataye nama ityādi | namaḥ ebhyaḥ śvapatibhyaś ca vo nama ityantā mantrāḥ ubhayato namaskārāḥ | namo bhavāyetyādayo nama ākhidate ca prakhidate cetyantāḥ anyatarato anyatarato namaskārāḥ | namaḥ sabhābhya ityādayo jātasaṃjñakāḥ rudrāḥ | namo vaḥ kirikebhya ityādyāś catasro vyāhṛtisaṃjñakāḥ bahurudradaivatā agnivāyusūryahṛdayabhūtāḥ | āśuśiśāna iti pañcānāṃ devā vaiśvānaro ‘gnir jagatī | apāṃphena | prajāpatiḥ sarasvatyo ‘gnir gāyatrī agniś ca pṛthivī ca ādityo ‘gniḥ | brahma jajñānaṃ prajāpatir ādityas triṣṭup kayānaś citrāvāmadeva indro jagatī | saṃvatsaro ‘si prajāpatiḥ prajāpatir gāyatrī | ahir iva bhogaiḥ prajāpatir havis triṣṭup | vahnīnāṃ prajāpatir liṅgoktā triṣṭup | yuñjanti vradhnaṃ madhuchandā ādityo gāyatrī | yamena dattaṃ mārgavo jamadagnidīrghatamāśvas triṣṭup | ākṛṣṇena hiraṇyastūpaḥ | savitā triṣṭup | ānomitrāvaruṇā gṛtsamado mitrāvaruṇau gāyatrī | yaj jāgrata iti pañcānāṃ ṣaṇṇām | śivasaṃkalpamanas triṣṭup | pañcanadyaḥ gṛtsamado mitrāvaruṇau gāyatrī | ubhāpibantaḥ praskaṇvāśvinau gāyatrī | yadābandhradakṣo hiraṇyaṃ triṣṭup | śan no mitraḥ dadhyaṅātharvaṇo liṅgoktānuṣṭup [276] agnir jagatī | ud uttamaṃ śunaḥśepho varuṇas triṣṭup | vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo prajāpatir vanaspatis triṣṭup | bhadraṃ karṇebhis tisṛṇāṃ gautamo viśvedevās triṣṭup | śan no śan no mitraḥ dīrghatamā indrāgnis tiṣṭup | devakṛtasyeti ṣaṇṇāṃ prajāpatir agnis triṣṭup | mānastoke saṅkuśiko rudo jagatī | tad viṣṇoḥ medhātithir viṣṇur gāyatrī | kāte | prajāpatiḥ kāmas triṣṭup | namaḥ saṃbhavāyetyādīnāṃ namo vākirebhya ityantānāṃ ṛcāṃ parameṣṭhī rudras triṣṭup | āno niyudbhis tyṛcāṃ rudras triṣṭup | trātāram indraṃ prajāpatir indras triṣṭup | bṛhaspate apratiratha indras triṣṭup | varyasomabandhuḥ sāvitrī vāyur jagatī | idaṃ diṣṇur medhātithir vaiṣṇavo | gāyatrī | irāvatī vāśiṣṭho viṣṇus triṣṭup | devasutāvaśadharau pātrīsyaṅgoṣṭham atra haviḥsthāne | viṣṇor nukam iti tisro vaiṣṇavas triṣṭubhaḥ atha kūṣmāṇḍamantrāḥ |

iva | prajāpatir āpo ‘nuṣṭup | ud vayaṃ tam iti praskaṇvaḥ sūryo ‘nuṣṭup | āpo adyannacāriṣam iti prajāpatir agniḥ paṅktiḥ | edho ‘si | samid asīty ete | śamidaivate yajuṣī | samāvavartīty asyāḥ agnir abhiruktā gāyatrī | vaiśvānara jyotir iti vaiśvānaraṃ yajuḥ | abhyādadhāmīti tryṛcasya | āśvatarāśvir agnir anuṣṭup | aṃśunā | ity asyāḥ sūryo ‘nuṣṭup | siñcati pariṣiñcatīy asyāḥ sūrya indro vā anuṣṭup | dhānāvantam ity asyā viśvāmitra indro gāyatrī | bṛhadindrāya nṛmedha purumedhasāv indrau bṛhatī | naye māyāvakānaḥ sarasvatīty asya tryṛcasya madhucchandāḥ sarasvatīr gāyatrī | āmandor viśvāmitra indro bṛhatī | āno viśāsuhavyaṃ śvāvāśva indro bṛhatī | prasenānīḥ sakuśaskandhaḥ skandas triṣṭup | pavitraṃ te iti dvayor arkapṛṣṭhaskandho jagatī | eṣā skandhasaṃhitā nāma | yad vā [279] upaviṃśati agastyo ‘gnir gāyatrī | sanād agne śrutir yātudhāno gāyatrī akṣaṇṇamīmadantaḥ yama indraḥ pañcapadā paṅktiḥ | avipṛṣṭhaḥ śaṃyur varuṇas triṣṭup akrāt samudraḥ vaikhānasaḥ somas triṣṭup | vāmadevāgnir gāyatrī | paritoṣiñcitā sutam acchidraḥ somo bṛhatī pavasva someti dharma indrokṣarapaṅktiḥ | cakraṃ yad asya bhāradvāja indro bṛhatī | ghṛtavatīti varuṇo dyāvāpṛthivyāvavir jagatī | adyāno devasavitaḥ sa ukṣa savitā gāyatrī | trātāram indraṃ maitra indro bṛhatī | mahitrīṇāṃ paṣṭhoha (?) indro gāyatrī | viśvāmitrasya bṛhadindrāya bṛhatī | yo bhūtānām ity asyāḥ nārayaṇīyakauṇḍilya ṛṣiḥ gṛtdyamāṇagraṃho (?) devatā paṅktiḥ chandra ātmā pravādarūpeyaṃ prāṇayāme | aśinakṛtasyeti dve anuṣṭup parās tāv bṛhatyau liṅoktadaivatye | samiddha indra ity ekādaśānām āprī saṃjñakānām aṅgirasa | acchinnaṃ dvādaśakaḥ |
iti yajurvidhānam |
ath sāmnāṃ ṛṣidaivatachandāṃsu |
[280]
idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pṛcchakasya viṣṇoḥ prakāvyam uśaneva bhūbāṇā iti vāgahabhaṃ puruṣavrate caiṣā vaiṣṇavī nāma | tatra idaṃ viṣṇuḥ prajāpatir gāyatrī | vṛkṣasya viṣṇo viṣṇur viṣṇur jagatī | prakāvyam uśaneva bhruvāṇaḥ varohe viṣṇus triṣṭup | puruṣavrate puruṣau nārāyaṇo ‘nuṣṭup | idaṃ oṃ hyatvojaseti (?) prathame tena yo madhucchandā indro gāyatrī | saptavyomaghonāṃ madhucchandāḥ vimedevā anuṣṭup purāsindhur nuvā kavi duḥmaruta indro ‘nuṣṭup | tavasva somam | madhucchandāḥ pavamānas triṣṭup | surūpakṛt nu madhucchandā gāyatrī | ud uttamaṃ varuṇapāśam iti gautamo varuṇo ‘nuṣṭup | śukraṃ candro śukraś candramāḥ gāyatrī | śuddhāśuddhā śuddho ya indro ‘nuṣṭup | nṛtasūktaṃcaḥ agniḥ śyenas triṣṭup | indras tridhātu indre indro bṛhatī | viśā pṛtanā triśāka indo jagatī | somaṃ rājānaṃ bṛhaspatir agnyādityavaruṇaviṣṇavaḥ | caruṣaṇī ghṛtaṃ vārhakṣṇaḥ sarpa prasarpa utsarpā jagatī | saminyāyanti janidhānam ayāṃ garbham āpas triṣṭup | indrāho nṛpam agnir gāyatrī | sante payāṃsi somavrate somaḥ somas triṣṭup | somavrate ‘pi daivavrate ṛṣivrate rudraḥ | tṛtīye viśvedevā | yajñapad indro ‘nayadane neti pūṣā pūṣā gāyatrī | bhago na citreti sāntanika agnir virāṭ | sāmadvaye ‘pi | imam indreti vargadvayasya vaśiṣṭha indro ‘nuṣṭup | paripriyā kavir iti | karṇāpavaḥ kavir gayatrī | rathantare vaśiṣṭhaḥ | īśāna indro bṛhatī | vāmadaivye vāmadevaḥ sarvadevā gāyatrī | yaśaḥ sameti | yaśā indro bṛhatī | indramihāsināh kaṇva indro bṛhatī |
[281] rathantaraṃ pūrvavad gīrvāṇā pāhi naḥ sutam iti | hariḥ śrīr nidhanaṃ indro gāyatrī | atrāviśantv indavaḥ āśita indro gāyatrī indrohimat sindhavaḥ pūṣā indro gāyatrī | āyantīha trāyanti ye indro bṛhatī | gavyeṣu godvaye śyāvāśva indro gāyatrī | idaṃ moghantv iti madhuchandā indro gāyatrī | bhadrāno agnir āhuta iti | gautamo bhaga indro gāyatrī | vairūpyāṣṭake virūpa indro bṛhatī | atrāṣṭake kramād ṛṣayaḥ | ādyayoḥ śikhaṇḍī | taduttarayor atriḥ | taduttarayoḥ mahāstravetasaḥ | taduttarayoḥ śirīṣaḥ | sarvatrendro devatā jagatī chandaḥ | agne vivasvad uṣasaḥ iḍimāṇḍavyo jātavedānuṣṭup | evaspate soma indras triṣṭup | trir asmai marutāṃ dhanvan dhenavo jagatī svātvāhitveti oṃ sahasra iti indro yajuḥ | dhānāvantaṃ karayanbhaṇam iti abhiṣava indro gāyatrī vāstoṣpate iti prajāpatir vāstu yajuḥ | abhrātuvya iti abhrātuvya iti abhrātuvya indraḥ kakup | vāta āvātu bheṣajaṃ kāśino vāyur gāyatrī pañca nidhānaṃ vāmdevyo vāmadevyaḥ | rāhur gāyatrī | asitvā pūrvapītaya iti | vaṣṭkāraḥ prajāpatir indro bṛhatī | abhi tvā śūra nonuma rahasyena hiśabdena ajiti indro bṛhatī | indram id devatātaye krasuva indro bṛhatī | gavāvrate prajāpatir gāvas triṣṭup | puruṣavrate puruṣo nārāyaṇo ‘nuṣṭup | rātrer vrate prajāpati rātrir anuṣṭup | indra sānasiṃrohit kulāya indro gāyatrī | bhāruṇḍasāmani bhāruṇḍo vrātavedāgniḥ jagatī | gāyatraṃ sāpauṣkalam āgneyagāyatrī | revata kumbhavaraivata indro gāyatrī | trisuparṇe trisuparṇaḥ sūryo gāyatrī | mahāvaiśvānaravrate vaiśvānaro ‘mbis
[282] triṣṭup | ānigeti āniṣaṅgaḥ indraḥ nānāchandāṃsi | bṛhatsāmāni bhāradvāja indro bṛhatī |
iti sāmavidhānam |
atha atharvamantrāṇām ṛṣidaivatachandāṃsi | śāntātīyagaṇasya śāntātīvāśva indraḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | bhaiṣajyagaṇasya bhaiṣajyam āyur uṣṇik | raudragaṇasya brahmā raudraḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi |
atha daśagaṇaḥ | śāntigaṇasya brahmā somo ‘nuṣṭup | kūtpādūṣaṇagaṇasya | śukraḥ kutpādūṣaṇaḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | dhātanagaṇasya dhātāgaṇo ‘gniḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | mātṝṇām gaṇasya mātṛnāmā ṛṣiḥ mātṛnāmadevatā uṣṇik chandaḥ | vāstoṣpatigaṇasya | brahmā ṛṣir vāstoṣpatir devatā sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | pāpmana gaṇasya | brahmā ṛṣiḥ pāpmahā devatā | gāyatry uṣṇik | kakud anuṣṭup | [283] yakṣmanāśanagaṇasya mātṛnāmā ṛṣiḥ yakṣmanāśano devatā sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | duḥkhapranāśanagaṇasya | yama ṛṣiḥ duḥsvapnanāśano devatā sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | āyuṣyagaṇasya brahmā āyur gāyatryādisaptachandāṃsi | sarvasya gaṇasya atharvā ṛṣiḥ bṛhaspatir devatā | anuṣṭup bṛhatī paṅktir anuṣṭup | aṣṭādaśagaṇānāṃ atharvāś candramāḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | śannodevīsūktasya sindhudvīpa āpo gāyatrī | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ atharvābhyuktas triṣṭup | atharvāṇānuvākādīnāṃ atharvāś candraḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi | yā oṣadhīr brahmā bṛhaspatir anuṣṭup | mamāgnevarca ityādīnāṃ caturdaśānāṃ kuberas triṣṭup | nadīpaṃ tv apsarovādarāyaṇīr apsaro jagatī | sodakrāmatsādevānām aparivrata indro ‘tichandāḥ | suparṇo ‘si sauparṇo garutmān anuṣṭup | indrajīvaveti hṛdayasūktasya brahmā indro gāyatrī | yat svaṃ mṛtpurabhyatsva bṛhaspatiḥ mṛtpur anuṣṭup | yaś cedaṃ śūnya aśītisūktam | atharvā bhūmiḥ paṅktiḥ pṛthivyāmantre, agniḥ pṛthivy antarikṣaṃ [284] dyauś candrasamo devatāḥ paṅtyatijagatī chandaḥ | uttamo ‘sīti mantrasya pratisara indro viṣṇuḥ | savitā rudro agniḥ prajāpatir devatā ādyā paṅktiḥ taduttarāṇāṃ saptānām anuṣṭup | udumbareti maṇineti sūktam | brahmā kuberaḥ pañcamādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ triṣṭup | śeṣāṇāṃ trayodaśānām anuṣṭup | yonasva iti brahmā īśvara anuṣṭup | indreṇa vṛttam iti | varuṇa indras triṣṭup | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ brahmā āpas triṣṭup | iyaṃ vedir iti brahmā indras triṣṭup | abhitavyame tātasya atharvā āpaḥ paṅktiḥ | sarasvatī vrateṣu te iti sūktam | brahmā sarasvatī anuṣṭup | saurasāmāni viṣāsahi sahamānam ityādīni ātharvaṇa ādityā jagatī | piśācakṣayo gamaśiyātanaḥ piśācakṣaśau gāyatrī | yamasya lokādadhyā brahmā yamas triṣṭup | agnir vaiśanāyadavāya agnir indras triṣṭup | ūrdho bhavet agnikṛtyā pratiharaṇo ‘nuṣṭup | indra vaya vāṇijaṃ atharvā īśānas triṣṭup | [285] kamomerājantv iti brahmā kāmas triṣṭup | bhadrāyakarṇadarvyeti kauśikāśvināv anuṣṭup | tubhyam eva janisantv iti śāṃyur jarimā triṣṭup | āyātu mitra iti | mitrāvaruṇāv āpo ‘gnayas triṣṭup | āśānām āśāpālebhyaḥ vācaspatir āśapālā anuṣṭup | idaṃ janāso vidatha brahmā dvyāvāpṛthivyāv anuṣṭup | agne gobhir ity etat brahmā agnis triṣṭup | śāntā dyaur iti sūktasya brahmā pṛthivy antarikṣaṃ divo ‘nuṣṭup | ayaṃ te yonir ṛtvijaḥ atharvāgnir anuṣṭup | dhravaṃdhruveṇeti atharvā somanam anuṣṭup | adhute rājann iti catasṝṇām atharva ekas triṣṭup | yayo devīṣv iti brahmā śāstrānuṣṭup yunakti sīrā viyugā | atharvā sītā triṣṭup | suyavasād iti atharvā brahmā triṣṭup | yadādgra iti vākdevatā ekavarca agnir anuṣṭup | arhate bhaga ity etat atharvā sītā triṣṭup | ete panthāḥ panthāṃ panthā atijagatī | avitasta iti | brahmā unmocanaḥ paṅktiḥ | yo nasvo araṇo atharvā īśvaras tiṣṭup | ahannahann iti ṣaḍarcam indras triṣṭup | tvam uttamam iti avarvā somo ‘nuṣṭup | yathā yaśaś candramasi | varuṇaś candramā jagatī | āno agni iti pativedanaḥ somas triṣṭup | yena dehīti ayam apāmaryamā atharvā aryamān anuṣṭup | yat pṛthivyām anāvṛttam | kalpamantra | chandarṣidevatā nāha | śivaḥśivebhir ity et (?) brahmā śivas triṣṭup | kṛtyā [286] dūṣaṇe | brahmā kṛtyādūṣaṇo ‘nuṣṭup | bṛhaspate naḥ paripātum iheti bṛhaspatis triṣṭup | sāmāno vindantīti sūktam brahmā īśvaro ‘nuṣṭup | ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣaḥ kauśiko ‘gnir anuṣṭup | pūṣāṣitasīti tisṝṇāṃ śukro devatā | prathamāyāḥ paṅktiḥ taduttarayor anuṣṭup | antyā gāyatrī | pragonaya iti sūktāni trīṇi prāṇeḥ sarvair anuṣṭup | devā māruta iti brahmā marutas triṣṭup | muñcāmi tvā iti sūktasya yakṣmānāśana indrāgnis triṣṭup | atharvaśirāṃsi | agnir iti bhasmavāyur iti bhasmajalam iti bhasmasthalam iti bhasma sarvaṃ ha vā bhasmeti |
ity atharvaṇo vidhānam |
athoṃkārasya chandarṣidevatāni | yājuṣasarvānukrame | om iti paramākṣarasya yoginām ālambabhūtasya parasya brahmaṇaḥ praṇavākhyasya sthūlādiguṇayuktasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ chando gāyatraṃ paramātmā devatā brahmārambhe virāme ca yāgahomādiṣu śāntiṣu karmasu cānyeṣy api karmasu nityanaimittikādiṣu sarveṣu viniyogasyeti | tathā ca śāṭyāyanaḥ | dānayajñatapaḥsvādhyāyajapādhyānasaṃdhyopāsanaprāṇāyāmahomadaivapitryamantroccāraṇa-brahmārambhād iti praṇaveṣu dhāryam | pravartayed iti mantrāṇāṃ chandarṣidevatājñāṇāvaśyakatvam uktam | yājuṣasarvānukrame ṛṣidaivatachandasāṃ svarūpam uktvā etāny aviditvā yo ‘dhīte ‘nubhrūte japate juhoti yajate yājayate tasya brahmarcaṃ na ciraṃ yātayāmaṃ bhavati sthāṇuṃ varchati pradūyate vā pāpīyān bhavatīti chandogabrāhmaṇe yo ha
[287] vā aviditārṣeyabrāhmaṇena mantreṇa yājayati vādhyāpayati vā sthāṇuṃ varchati gartaṃ vā yajate pracchāmīyate pāpīyān bhavati yātayāmānyasya chandāṃsi bhavanti tasmād etāni mantre mantre vidyād iti |
atha nānādravyadānamantrāḥ | tatra navagrahadakṣiṇādānamantrāḥ |
mātsye |
kapile sarvabhūtānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇi |
sarvatīrthamayī yasmād ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
kapilāyāḥ |
puṇyas tvaṃ śaṅkhapuṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam |
viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
gaṅkhasya |
dharmas tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ |
aṣṭamūrter adhiṣṭhānam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
raktavṛṣasya |
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hemabījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
anantapuṇyaphaladam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
suvarṇasya |
pītavastrayugaṃ yasmād vāsudevasya vallabham |
pradānāt tasya me viṣṇur ataḥ śāntiṃ prayacchatu ||
pītavastrayugmasya |
yasmād viṣṇusvarūpeṇa yasmād amṛtasaṃbhavaḥ |
[288] candrārkavāhanaṃ nityam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
śvetāśvasya |
yasmāt tvaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dhenuḥ keśavasaṃnibhāḥ |
sarvapāpaharā nityam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
kṛṣṇavarṇagoḥ |
yasmād āyasakarmāṇi tvadadhīnāni sarvadā |
lāṅgalādyāyudhādīni tataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
lohasya |
yasmāt tvaṃ chāgayajñānām aṅgatvena vyavasthitaḥ |
yānaṃ vibhāvasor nityam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
chāgasya |
śaraṇyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ lajjāyā rakṣaṇaṃ param |
suveśadhāri tvaṃ yasmād vāsaḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
śvetavastrasya |
raktavastrayugaṃ yasmād ādityasya priyaṃ sadā |
pradānād asya me sūryo hy ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
raktavastrayugmasya |
dharmarājena vidhṛtaṃ kṛṣṇavastraṃ suśobhanam |
sarvakleśavināśāya kṛṣṇavastraṃ dadāmy aham ||
kṛṣṇavastrasya |
annam eva yato lakṣmīr annam eva janārdanaḥ |
annaṃ brahmākhila trāṇam astu me janmajanmani ||
[289] annasya |
candramaṇḍalam adhyasthaṃ candrāmbujasamaprabham |
dadhyannaṃ tasya dānena prīyatāṃ vāmano mama ||
dadhyannaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ ca brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam |
prīyatāṃ dharmarājo hi taddānān mama sarvadā ||
sopadaṃśadadhyannasya |
pānīyasahitaṃ caitat sadadhyodanapātrakam |
samarcitaṃ tat saphalaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ
gṛhāṇa dadhyodanapātrakaṃ mama ||
sapānīyadhadhyannasya |
sarvātmā sarvalokeśaḥ sarvavyāpī sanātanaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ syāt kṛṣarānnapradānataḥ ||
kṛṣarānnasya |
pāyasaṃ parmānnaṃ ca sarvadānottamottamam |
sarvadaivatayogyaṃ ca śreyaḥpuṣṭiṃ prayacchatu ||
pāyasānnasya |
ādityatejasā bhaktaṃ jātiśraiṣṭhakaraṃ param |
tad annaṃ mama priya tvaṃ pratīccha pūpam uttamam ||
apūpānnasya |
prājāpatyā yataḥ proktāḥ śaktavo yajñakarmaṇi |
tasmāt śaktūn prayacchāmi prīyatāṃ me prajāpatiḥ ||
[290] śaktūnām |
asureṣu samudbhūtaṃ rajataṃ pitṛvallabham |
tasmād asya pradānena rudraḥ saṃprīyatāṃ mama ||
rajatasya |
parāpavādapaiśūnyād abhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇāt |
tatprajātaṃ ca yat pāpaṃ tāmrapātraṃ praśāśyatu ||
tāmrapātrasya |
yāni pāpāni kāmyāni kāmotthāni kṛtāni ca |
kāṃsapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu me sadā ||
kāṃsyapātrasya |
deva deva jagannātha vāñchitārthaphalapradaḥ |
tilapātraṃ pradāsyāmi tavāṅge saṃsthiter aham ||
svarṇāditilapātrasya |
darśanena tvam ādarśa nṛṇāṃ maṅgaladāyakaḥ |
śauryasaubhāgyasatkīrtinirmalajñānado bhava ||
darpaṇasya |
tāmraparṇyarṇavotpannā varṇādyā kalpavarṇitāḥ |
muktāḥ śuktyudbhavāḥ santu bhuktimuktipradā mama ||
muktānām |
tvadudbhavo jagatsraṣṭur vedhaso hemapaṅkajaḥ |
padmavāsaharer nābhijātaṃ māṃ pāhi sarvadā ||
[291] suvarṇapadmasya |
kāntāravanadurgeṣu cauravyālākule pathi |
hiṃsakās tu na hiṃsantu siṃhadānaprabhāvataḥ ||
siṃhasya |
hiraṇyagarbhasaṃbhūtaṃ sauvarṇam aṅgulīyakam |
dharmapradaṃ prayacchāmi prīyatāṃ kamalāpatiḥ ||
aṅgulīyakasya |
kāñcanaṃ hastavalayaṃ rūpakāntisukhapradam |
vibhūṣaṇaṃ pradāsyāmi vibhūṣayati māṃ sadā ||
valayasya |
kṣīrodamathane pūrvam udbhūtaṃ kuṇḍaladvayam |
śriyā saha yad udbhūtaṃ dade śrīḥ prīyatāṃ mama ||
kuṇḍaladvayasya |
maṇikāñcanapuṣpāṇi maṇimuktāmayāni ca |
tulasīpatradānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
tulasīpatradānād vā brahmaṇaḥ kāyasaṃbhavam |
pāpapraśamanaṃ yātu sarve santu manorathāḥ ||
tulasīdānamantraḥ |
alakṣmīharaṇaṃ nityaṃ nityaṃ saubhāgyavardhanam |
kṣīraṃ maṅgalam āyuṣyaṃ tataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
dugdhasya |
kāmadhenoḥ samudbhūtaṃ viṣṇos tuṣṭikaraṃ param |
[292] navanītaṃ pradāsyāmi valaṃ puṣṭiṃ ca dehi me ||
navanītasya |
kāmadhenusamudbhūtaṃ devānām uttamaṃ haviḥ |
āyurvivardhanaṃ dātūrājyaṃ pātu sadaiva mām ||
ājyasya |
tailaṃ puṣṭikaraṃ nityam āyuṣyaṃ pāpanāśanam |
amāṅgalyaharaṃ puṇyam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
tailasya |
kaṇṭakocchiṣṭapāṣāṇavṛścikādinivāraṇe |
pāduke saṃpradāsyāmi vipraprītyā pragṛhyatām ||
pādukāmantraḥ |
śaśāṅkakarasaṃkāśaṃ himaḍiṇḍīrapāṇḍuram |
protsārayāśu duritaṃ cāmarāmaravallabham ||
cāmarasya |
candanāvāsamandārasakhe vṛndārakārcitam |
candana tvatprasādān me sāndrānandaprado bhava ||
candanakhaṇḍasya |
śrīkhaṇḍakāṇḍakarpūrakasturīkuṅkumānvitam |
vilepanaṃ prayacchāmi saukhyam atu sadā mama |
candanādyanulepanasya |
[293] samastebhyo ‘pi vastubhyaḥ saṃstutāsi surāsuraiḥ |
vinyastāṅgeṣu kastūrī sukhadās tu sadā mama ||
kastūryāḥ |
kandarpadarpado yasmāt karpūraṃ prāṇatarpaṇam |
śrāddhamatai bhavas tāpas tvaddānād apasarpatu ||
karpūrasya |
yad abhūd aṅgasaṃlagnaṃ kuṅkumādivilepanam |
jalakrīḍāsu gopīnāṃ dvāravatyāṃ jalārpitam ||
gopīcandanam ity uktaṃ munīndraiḥ kilbiṣāpaham |
tasmād asya pradānena viṣṇur diśatu vāñchitam ||
gopīcandanasya |
tvayā surāṇām amṛtaṃ vidhāya
hālāhalaṃ saṃvṛtam eva yasmāt |
tathā surāṇāṃ tripuraṃ ca dagdham
ekeṣuṇā lokahitārtham īśa ||
tvatpradānād aham apy adoṣī
doṣair vimuktas tu gaṇān prapadye |
tathā kuru tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
mayi prabho devavara prasīda ||
śivapratimāyāḥ |
prasīdatu bhavo nityaṃ kṛttivāsamaheśvaraḥ |
[294] pārvatyā sahito devo jagadutpattikārakaḥ ||
umāmaheśvarayoḥ |
śivaśaktyātmakaṃ yasmāj jagad etac carācaram |
tasmād anena sarvaṃ me karotu bhagavan śivam ||
kailāsavāsī gaurīśo bhagavān bhaganetrabhit |
carācarātmako liṅgarūpī diśatu vāñchitam |
liṅgasya |
idaṃ marakataṃ liṅgaṃ raupyapīṭhasamanvitam |
dhānyair dvādaśabhir yuktam ekādaśaphalānvitam |
saṃpradadyād vidhānena yathoktaṃ phalam astu me ||
marakataliṅgasya |
kāśmīraliṅgapakṣe tu indrakāśmīrajaṃ vadet |
kāśmīraliṅgasya |
sarvabhūtāśrayā bhūmir varāheṇa samuddhṛtā |
anantasasyaphaladā ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
sasyabhūmeḥ |
ūrṇāmeṣasamutpannā śītavātabhayāpahā |
yasmāt tuṣārahārīsyād ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha met ||
ūrṇāyāḥ |
aurṇapadam anudhyeyaṃ svarṇabījaṃ tava prabho |
[295] dattaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa pāpaṃ saṃhara satvaram ||
ūrṇāpadasya |
dhānyaṃ karoṣi dātāram iha loke paratra ca |
tasmāt pradīyatāṃ dhānyam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
dhānyasya |
yasmād annamayo jambūdvīpo godhūmasaṃbhavaḥ |
gandharvasaukhyadhanadaḥ ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
godhūmānām |
mudgabījāni vai yasmāt priyāṇi parameṣṭhinaḥ |
tasmād eṣāṃ pradānena prītiḥ siddhyatu me sadā ||
mudgānām |
purā govardhanoddhārasamaye haribhakṣitāḥ |
caṇakāḥ sarvapāpaghnā ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
māṣāṇām |
rasānām agrajaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ lavaṇaṃ balavardhanam |
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ sākṣād ataḥ śāntiṃ prayacchatu ||
lavaṇasya |
dhānyarājāś ca māṅgalyā dvijaprītikarā yavāḥ |
tasmād eṣāṃ pradānena mamāstv abhimataṃ phalam ||
[296] yavānām |
tilāḥ pāpaharā nityaṃ viṣṇor dehasamudbhavāḥ |
tiladānena sarvaṃ me pāpaṃ nāśaya keśava ||
tilānām |
amṛtasya kulotpannāḥ ikṣudhārātiśarvarī |
sūryaprītikarā nityam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
śarkarāyāḥ |
manobhavadhanurmadhyād udbhūtā śarkarā iti |
tasmād asya pradānena mama santu manorathāḥ ||
khaṇḍasya |
praṇavaḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvatī sadā |
tathā rasānāṃ pravaraḥ sadaivekṣuraso mataḥ |
mama tasmāt tvarāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadasva guḍa sarvadā ||
guḍasya |
yasmāt pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhe tvaṃ pītaṃ madhv amṛtodbhavam
tasmāt tava pradānena rakṣa māṃ duḥkhasāgarāt ||
madhanaḥ |
vāripūrṇaghaṭopetaṃ devatrayamayaṃ yataḥ |
prīyatāṃ dharmarājo ‘stu dānenānena puṇyada ||
[297] udakumbhasya |
upānahau pradāsyāmi kaṇṭakādinivāraṇe |
sarvasthāneṣu sukhadāvataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
upānahoḥ |
patrikā sarvajantūnāṃ śaityānandakarī śubhā |
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidā nityam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
vyajanasya |
mahākośanivāsena cakrādair upaśobhitam |
asya devapradānāt tu mama santu manorathāḥ ||
śālagrāmasya |
mahākośanivāsa tvaṃ mahādevo maheśvaraḥ |
prīyatāṃ tava dānena ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
śivanābhasya |
yamadvāre mahāghore yā sā vaitaraṇī nadī |
tāṃ tartukāmo yacchāmi uttāraya sukhena mām ||
vaitaraṇyāḥ |
yasmāt tvaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dhenur vaiṣṇavasaṃnibhā |
sarvapāpaharā nityam ataḥ śāṇtiṃ prayaccha me ||
labdhadhenoḥ |
[298] mṛtykrāntau pravṛttasya sukhakrāntivivṛddhaye |
tubhyaṃ saṃpradade nāmnā gāṃ samutkrāntisaṃjñikām ||
utkrāntidhenoḥ |
vāṅmanaḥkāyajanitaṃ yat kiṃcin mama duṣkṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu tvaddānenopasevitam ||
meṣyāḥ |
bhagavan śūlahasteśa dakṣādyarivināśana |
tavāyudhapradānena śūlaṃ naśyatu me sadā ||
śūlasya |
yāni pāpāny anekāni mayā kāmakṛtāni ca |
lohapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu sarvadā ||
lohapātrasya |
agamyāgamanaṃ caiva paradārābhimarṣanam |
raupyapātrapradānena tāna naśyantu me sadā ||
raupyapātrasya |
tilāḥ sarvā samāyuktā duritakṣayakārakāḥ |
viṣṇuprītikarā nityam ataḥ śāṇtiṃ prayaccha me ||
sahiraṇyatiladānānām |
tilāḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāś ca sarvakāmakarāḥ śubhāḥ |
[299] śuklāś caiva tathā kṛṣṇā viṣṇugātrasamudbhavāḥ ||
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca |
tilapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu me sadā ||
sahiraṇyatilapātrasya |
brahmahatyādipāpaghnaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā |
kuṣmāṇḍabahubijātmam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
kuṣmāṇḍasya |
idaṃ phalaṃ mayā vipra prabhūtaṃ puratas tava |
tena me saphalāvāptir bhavej janmani janmani ||
phalasya |
ādityatejasotpannāḥ sarvamaṅgalakārakāḥ |
maṇḍakāḥ sarvapāpaghnyo ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
maṇḍakānām |
janmāntarasahasreṣu yat kṛtaṃ duritaṃ mayā |
svarṇapātrapradānena śāntiḥ kiṃcid ihāstu me ||
vyatīpātasya |
yā yā lakṣmīr yadaṅgena sarvagātre vyavasthitam |
tat sarvaṃ śamayājyaṃ tvaṃ lakṣmīṃ puṣṭiṃ ca vardhaya ||
ārogyārthājyasya |
ājyaṃ tejaḥ (?) samuddiṣṭam (?) ājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ smṛtam |
[300] ājyaṃ surāṇām āhāra ājye devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
pāpakṣayārthājyasya |
tvaṃ devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ rakṣa mām āyudho hy asi |
yasmāt sarvaprayatnena śāntir bhavatu sarvadā ||
āyudhasya |
keśavaprītidā bhaktyā śambhubrahmārkatuṣṭidā |
pṛthagvidhāpūpakāyāḥ yacchantu balam aurasam ||
bhakṣyāṇām |
somodbhavāni dārūṇi jātavedaḥpriyāṇi ca |
tasmād eṣāṃ pradānena śriyaṃ dehi vibhāvasoḥ ||
kāṣṭānāṃ |
agnivarṇodbhavā nāma balakīrtipravardhanāḥ |
kulatthaḥ sarvapāpaghna ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
kulatthānām |
sadā rohati bījāni kāle kṛṣṭe mahītale |
tava pradānāt sakalā mama santu manorathāḥ ||
kṛṣṇakṣetrasya |
sarvagraharkṣatāreśa sarveśa tvaṃ hi bhāskara |
saṃkrāntiśūladoṣaṃ me nivāraya divākara ||
[301] saṃkrāntiśūlasya |
sarvavidyāśramajānakaraṇaṃ (?) lalitākṣaram |
pustakaṃ saṃprayacchāmi priyā bhavati bhāratī ||
pustakasya |
anena jāyate viśvaprāṇināṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam |
tandulā vaiśvadevatyāḥ pākenānne bhavanti ye ||
pāvanāḥ sarvayajñeṣu praśastā homakarmaṇi |
tasmāt tanduladānena prīyatāṃ viśvadevatāḥ ||
taṇḍulānām |
āśrayanti mano yasmāt tasmāt sumanasaḥ smṛtāḥ |
dattā dadatu me nityam ity āhlādaṃ satīṃ śriyam ||
puṣpāṇām |
jīrāno jāyate yasmān maṇḍalaṃ śubhakarmasu |
tasmāj jīrakadānena prīyatāṃ girajā mama ||
jīrakasya |
tāmbūlaṃ śrīkaraṃ bhadraṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam |
asya pradānād brahmādyāḥ śivaṃ dadantu puṣkalam ||
tāmbūlasya |
pūritapūrāpūreṇa (?) nārāvallodanānvitam |
[302] pūrṇena cūrṇapātreṇa karpūrapūrakeṇa ca ||
sapūgakhaṇḍanaṃ divyaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ priyam |
kaṇṭaka tvaṃ nirāsaktaṃ tvatprasādāt kuru kṣamām ||
tāmbūlakarasya |
lakṣmīpriyā yā lakṣmīdā lakṣmīva vasanapriyā |
saubhāgyakṛd varastrīṇāṃ haridrā śrīmad astu me ||
haridrāyāḥ |
kañcūkīvastrayugmaiś ca tathā karṇāvataṃsakaiḥ |
kaṇṭasūtraiś ca bhūṣābhiḥ prīyatāṃ niminandanī ||
saubhāgyadravyayugmasya |
rāmapatni mahābhāge puṇyamūrte nirāmaye |
gṛhāṇemāni śūrpāṇi mayā dattāni jānaki ||
śūrpasya |
kamaṇḍalur (?) jalaiḥ pūrṇaḥ svarṇagarbhaḥ sulakṣaṇaḥ |
arpitas te mahāsena prasannaś ca sadā bhava ||
kamaṇḍaloḥ|
brahmasūtraṃ mahādivyaṃ mayā yatnena nirmitam |
brāhma janmāstu me deva brahmasūtrasamarpaṇāt ||
yajñopavītasya |
[303] aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākai rudrākṣair yojitā mayā |
arpitā tava haste ca gṛhāṇa surasainyakaḥ ||
akṣamālāyāḥ |
vidhuntuda namas tubhyaṃ siṃhikānandano ‘vyaya |
dānenānena nāgasya rakṣa māṃ vedhajātyayāt ||
svarṇanāgasya |
ikṣudaṇḍaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ rasālaṃ sarvakāmadam |
tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi tenāśu prīyatāṃ parameśvaraḥ ||
ikṣudaṇḍasya |
karpūraḥ kadalībhūto deva deva priyaḥ sadā |
bhāgyottamo nṛpāṇāṃ ca taddānāt sukham aśnute ||
jarāmāṃskabhavaṃ devī maṇenābhisamudbhavām |
bhaktyāhaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi mama santu manorathāḥ ||
gandhadralyasya |
dadāti bhānur bhavate sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
manobhilaṣitāvāptiṃ karotu mama bhāskaraḥ ||
sūryamūrtiḥ |
yamānananti viśveśaṃ viśvnātham umāsutam |
vighneśvaraṃ kṣiprattara (?) tubhyaṃ dāsyāmy abhīṣtadam ||
[304] gaṇeśapratimāyāḥ |
gavām aṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśa |
yasmāt tasmāc chivaṃ me syād iha loke paratra ca ||
godānamantraḥ |
yasmād aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyās tu tasmāj janmani janmani ||
yathā ratneṣu sarveṣu sarve devā vyavasthitāḥ |
tathā śāntiṃ prayacchantu ratnadānena me surāḥ ||
ratnamantraḥ |
yathā bhūmipradānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
dānāny anyāni me śāntir bhūmidānād bhavatv iha ||
bhūdānamantraḥ |
iyaṃ dāsī mayā tubhyaṃ śrivatsa pratipāditā |
tadā karmakarī bhogyā yatheṣṭaṃ bhadram astu me ||
dāsīmantraḥ |
rathāya rathanāthāya namas te viśvakarmaṇe |
viśvabhūtāya nāthāya aruṇāya namo namaḥ ||
[305] rathasya |
ihāmutrobhayatrāṇaṃ kuru keśava me prabho |
chatraṃ tvatprītaye dattaṃ brāhmaṇāya mayā śubham ||
chatramantraḥ |
devadeva jagannātha viśvātman dattayānayā |
prabho śivikayā deva prīto bhava janārdana ||
śivikāmantraḥ |
idaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
tava vipra prasādena mamāstv abhimataṃ phalam ||
gṛhamantraḥ |
samāśrayaṃ prayacchāmi prītyarthaṃ me jagannidhiḥ |
āśrayamantraḥ |
gaurī kanyām imāṃ vipra yathāśakti vibhūṣitām |
gotrāya śarmaṇe tubhyaṃ vipra tvaṃ tāṃ samāśraya ||
kanyāmantraḥ |
candrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā |
mahiṣīdānamāhātmyam astu me sarvakāmadam ||
dharmarājasya sāhāyye yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
mahiṣāsurasya jananī sāstu me sarvakāmadā ||
[306] mahiṣyāḥ |
mahiṣī vatsasaṃyuktāṃ suśīlāṃ ca payasvinīm |
ratnavastreṇa puṣpeṇa datvā mṛtyuṃ jayen naraḥ ||
mṛtyumahiṣyāḥ |
rāgatvaṅmāṃsamajjādyaiḥ sarvopakaraṇaiḥ śubhā |
jagataḥ saṃpradattāsi tvām ataḥ prārthaye śivam ||
meṣasya |
devānāṃ yo mukhaṃ havyavāhanaḥ sarvapūjitaḥ |
tasya tvaṃ vāhanaṃ pūjyaṃ devaiḥ sendrair maharṣibhiḥ ||
agnim ādyaṃ pūrvakarmavipākotthaṃ tu yan mayā |
tat sarvaṃ nāśaya kṣipraṃ jaṭharāgniṃ vivardhaya ||
tvaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ pavitrā bhavatī parā |
tvatprasūtītthitā yajñā tasmāc chāntikarī bhava ||
ajāmantraḥ |
atha ṛtvigādivaraṇavidhiḥ | tatra brahmāṇḍadānam adhikṛtyoktam | padmapurāṇe |
bālāgnihotriṇaṃ vipraṃ surūpaṃ ca guṇānvitam |
sapatnīkaṃ ca saṃpūjya bhūṣayitvā ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
[307] purohitaṃ mukhyatamaṃ kṛtvānyāṃś ca tathartvijaḥ |
caturviṃśadguṇopetān sapatnīkān nimantritān ||
ahatāmbarasaṃchannān sragviṇaḥ śucibhūṣitān |
aṅgulīyakāni tathā karṇaveṣṭān pradāpayet ||
evaṃvidhāṃś ca saṃpūjya teṣām agre svayaṃ sthitaḥ |
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
purohitāya purataḥ kṛtvā vai karasampuṭam |
yūyaṃ vai brāhmaṇā dhātrā mitratvenānugṛhṇatā ||
saumukhyeneha bhavatāṃ bhavet pūto naraḥ svayam |
bhavatāṃ prītiyogena svayaṃ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
tulāpuruṣam adhikṛtyoktam liṅgapurāṇe |
śataniṣkādhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam |
tasyāpy ardhaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ syāt trividhaṃ tatra kalpitam ||
vastrayugmam athoṣṇīṣaṃ kuṇḍale kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam |
aṅgulībhūṣaṇaṃ caiva maṇibandhasya bhūṣaṇam ||
etāni caiva sarvāṇi prārambhe sarvakarmaṇām |
purohitāya dartvārdham ṛtvigbhyaḥ saṃpradāpayet ||
pūrvoktabhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ soṣṇīṣaṃ vastrasaṃyutam |
dadyād etat prayoktṛbhya ācchādanapaṭaṃ tathā ||

agneḥ parigrahaḥ kāryaḥ sarvaśāstrārthavedakaiḥ |
vāmadakṣiṇasiddhāntavedāntagṛhyapāragaiḥ ||

aviditvā yathāvac ca jñātvā sarvasukhāya ca ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vahnyādheyakriyā matāḥ |
kuṇḍāṣṭakaṃ samākhyātaṃ tribhedaṃ tu mayā tava ||
bahuvahnividhānaṃ ca ekasyai vopacārataḥ |
strībālaśūdramūrkhais tu hotavyaṃ pratyahaṃ yathā ||
mahānase tathā vāpi na kumbhe tu kadācana |
saṃskṛtair nāmabhedaiś ca rakṣayitvā hutāśanam ||

śrūyate ca purā vatsa aviditvā vasoḥ sutāḥ ||
saṃskṛte havamānās tu rājyabhraṃśam (?) avāpnuvan |
tathā haviṇi hotā ca acirān mṛtyum āptavān ||
tasmād asthiravahnau tu na hotavyaṃ na vedinā |
vedanaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yena siddhiḥ prajāyate ||
catuṣkoṇe hy ahaṅkuṇḍe kuṇḍale madhusūdanaḥ |
dhanurākṛtike rudraḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ||
caturasre bhaved agni r maṇḍale tu hutāśanaḥ |
ardhacandre nalo hy agnir agnir evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
dvijānāṃ devatā satyam ācāryo yogidaivataḥ |
udake varuṇo devo darbheṣu ca mahoragāḥ ||
sruvāyāṃ ca mahādevo sruve devas trilocanaḥ (?) |
tatsaṃyoge paro devaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ||
praṇītā pṛthivī jñeyā svāhākāre mahāmakhāḥ |
puṣpeṣu kratavo viddhi pātreṣu ca mahodadhiḥ ||
vedīmadhye tu gāyatrī somas tv abhyukṣaṇe sthitaḥ |
randhane maṇimadras tu śikhāṃ vajradharas tathā ||
hotāras tu vijānīyāc camasādiṣu parvatān |
uṣāyāṃ devatā rudras tālavṛnte ca vāyavaḥ ||
mantreṣu ca gaṇāḥ sarve bhasmabhūye ‘pi śaṅkaraḥ |
lokapālās tu sarveṣu koṇeṣu sarvadevatāḥ ||

devānāṃ prātarhomas tu praharārdhena bhūtidaḥ |

rātrau pāpavināśārthaṃ divāsiddhiprasādhane ||

pratyūṣe putradaṃ vatsa udaye sārvakāmikam ||
kṣaṇādau sarvakāryeṣu sarvaprāptipradāyakam |

asidhārāvrataṃ yadvat tadvan niyamaśīlanam ||

devatvaṃ devatā prāptā niyamān niyamānvite ||
tārārūpā jvalanty ete niyamāt tu tapodhane |
niyamena varārohe velān na kramate ‘rṇavaḥ ||
niyamāj jvalate cāgnis tapate niyamād raviḥ |
niyamād vardhate vāyur niyamād dhriyate jagat ||

tapogatir hi bhūtānāṃ tapa eva parāyaṇam |
tapasā vijitā lokās tapasā nirvṛtiḥ satām ||
tapasā pūtapāpmāno nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ |
tapasā paramāyuś ca śāntiṃ vāpi tathāpnuyāt ||
tapasā vindate lokān akhilān api pūruṣaḥ |
tapasā param icchanti nirvāṇam api śāśvatam ||
tapasā caihikīṃ siddhiṃ vipulām api vindati |

kūrmapurāṇe |

svayaṃ putratvam āpede tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ ||
janako nāma rājarṣis tapovratanidhiḥ svayam |
aiśvaryam atulaṃ prāpya yogināṃ gatim āpnyāt ||
evam eva mahārāja rājāno brāhmaṇās tathā |
aiśvaryalakṣaṇaṃ prāpur gatiṃ vai vratavaibhavāt ||
ataḥ kuruṣva satataṃ tapaḥsaṃyamātmavān |
vratopavāsaniratas tīrthāni nṛpasattama ||
tathā |
vinigrahaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ kurvīta niyamātmavān |
upavāsajapadhyānatīrthasnānādikair api ||
vratair yajñena dānena tapasā tīrthasevayā |
anekajanmasaṃsiddhim enaḥ kṣapayati dvijaḥ ||
vratādīnāṃ cāturvarṇasādhāraṇatvābhidhānād dvijagrahaṇam atra varṇamātropalakṣaṇārtham | na caivaṃ sati śūdrasya yajñe ‘nadhikārād yajñaśabdavirodha iti vācyam, yajñair anekārthatvena devatāpūjādyarthasaṃbhavāt |
kāyikaṃ mānasaṃ caiva vācikaṃ ca tridhā matam |
yajño dānaṃ tapaś caiva vadatas tac chṛṇuṣva me ||
ahiṃsā vratacaryā ca tapaḥ kāyikam ucyate |
vācikaṃ satyavacanaṃ bhūtadrohavivarjitam |
mānasaṃ manasaḥ śāntiḥ sarvavairāgyalakṣaṇam ||
ādityapurāṇe |
[324] vratopavāsān khalu yo vidhatte
dāridryapāśaṃ sa bhinatti cāśu |
vratopavāseṣu ratasya puṃsaś
caivāpadaḥ śānti vadanti tajjñāḥ ||
iti śrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakāṇḍe vratapraśaṃsāprakaraṇam |
[325]
atha tṛtīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha vratasāmānyadharmas tadadhikāriṇaś ca nirūpyate | skandapurāṇe |
nijavarṇāśramācāranirataḥ śuddhamānasaḥ |
vrateṣv adhikṛto rājann anyathā viphalaḥ śramaḥ ||
alubdhāḥ (?) satyavādī ca sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
vrateṣv adhikṛto rājann anyathā viphalaḥ śramaḥ ||
śraddhāvān nyāyabhīruś ca madadambhavivarjitaḥ |
varteṣv adhikṛto rājann anyathā viphalaḥ śramaḥ ||
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu śivabhakto jitendriyaḥ |
vrateṣv adhikṛto rājann anyathā viphalaḥ śramaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ niścitya śāstrārthaṃ yathāvat karmakārakaḥ |
adevanidako dhīmān adhikārī vratādiṣu ||
mahābhārate |
śrāddhakarma tapaś caiva satyam akrodha eva ca |
sveṣu dāreṣu saṃtoṣaḥ śaucaṃ nityānasūyatā |
ātmajñānaṃ titikṣā ca dharmaḥ sādhāraṇo nṛpa ||
devalo ‘pi |
[326] vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ śarīrottāpanais tathā |
varṇāḥ sarve ‘pi mucyante pātakebhyo na saṃśayaḥ || iti |
tad evaṃ vacanasaṃdarbhaṇoktaniyamavatāṃ caturṇām api varṇānāṃ strīpuṃsādhāraṇyena vrateṣv adhikāra iti pratipādyate | tathā ca mahābhārate |
mām upāśritya kaunteya ye ‘pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ |
striyo vaiśyāś ca śūdrāś ca te ‘pi yānti parāṃ gatim || iti |
tatrāyaṃ paro viśeṣo yat strīṇāṃ bhartur ājñāṃ vinā na svātantryeṇa vratādiṣv adhikāra iti | tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthag yajño na vrataṃ nāpy upoṣaṇam |
bhartṛśuśrūṣayaivaitā lokān iṣṭān vrajanti hi ||
yad devebhyo yatra pitrādikebhyaḥ
kuryād bhartābhyarcanaṃ satkriyāṃ ca |
tasyārdhaṃ vai sā phalaṃ nānyavittā
nārī bhuṅkte bhartṛśuśrūṣayaiva ||
dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhyai bhaved bhartuḥ sahāyinī ||
ādityapurāṇe |
nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthag yajño na vrataṃ nāpy upoṣaṇam |
patiṃ śuśrūṣate yā tu tena svarge mahīyate ||
patyur abhyadhikaṃ nārī nopavāsavrataṃ caret |
[327] anāyuṣyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha patyus tasyās tad ucyate ||
devatārādhanaṃ kuryāt kāmaṃ vā brāhmaṇottamaḥ |
nārī pativratā nāma prāpyānujñāṃtu bhartṛtaḥ ||
nārī khalv ananujñātā pitrā bhartrā sutena vā |
viphalaṃ tad bhavet tasyā yat karoty aurdhvadehikam ||
pitreti kanyātve | bhartreti saubhāgyadaśāyām | suteneti vaidhavyadaśāyām | aurdhvadehikaṃ vratāni |
atha vā sarvam utsṛjya patipūjanatatparā |
keśavārādhanaṃ kuryāt sādhvī strī puruṣarṣabhā ||
vinaiva sargam āpnoti yat kiṃcin manasecchati |
aphalaṃ sarvam eva syād bhartranujñāṃ (?) vinā kṛtam |
keśavārādhanaṃ yac ca tathāpi saphalaṃ striyaḥ ||
tathā harivaṃśe arundhatīṃ prati pārvatīvacanam |
satītvadharmacaraṇaṃ yasyā nityam akhaṇḍitam |
puṇyakānāṃ vidhis tasyāḥ purāṇe parikīrtitam ||
dānopavāsapuṇyāni sukṛtāny apy arundhati |
niḥphalāny asatīnāṃ hi puṇyakāni tathā śubhe ||
puṇyakāni vratāni |
[328] yā nircayanti bhartāraṃ yoniduṣṭāś ca yāḥ striyaḥ |
yonidoṣāt puṇyaphalaṃ nāśnanti nirayaṃgamāḥ ||
sādhvyo jagad dhārayanti suśīlāḥ patidevatāḥ |
ananyadharmanityāś ca satāṃ panthānam āśritāḥ ||
avāgduṣṭāḥ śaucayuktāḥ ghṛtimatyaḥ śucivratāḥ |
satataṃ sādhuvādinyo dhārayanti jagat khalu ||
vyādhitaḥ patito vāpi nirdhano vā kathaṃcana |
na tyaktavyaḥ striyā bhartā [bhartrā?] dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ||
akāryakāriṇaṃ vāpi nirguṇaṃ strī patiṃ tathā |
tārayaty eva sādhvī sā tathātmānaṃ śubhānane ||
yoniduṣṭastriyo nāsti prāyaścittaṃ hataiva sā |
vāgduṣṭe vihitaṃ sadbhiḥ prāyaścittaṃ purātanaiḥ ||
bhartuḥ chandena kartavyaṃ vratakaṃ sarvadā striyāḥ |
upavāso ‘pi vā satye kāṅkṣantyās tu śubhāṃ gatim ||
kalpāntarasahasreṣu na strī sā labhate gatim |
tiryagyonisahasreṣu pacyate yonivibhramāt ||
yadi syān nāma mānuṣyaṃ strī labhed asatī satī |
caṇḍālayonau durmedhā jāyate kukkurānanā ||
bhartā devaḥ sadā strīṇāṃ strībhir dṛṣṭaḥ sanātane |
yasyā hi tuṣyate bhartā sā satī dharmacāriṇī ||
kautūhalahatānāṃ tu strīṇāṃ loko na śobhanaḥ |
bhartary eva mano yāsāṃ sadbhāvena vyavasthitam ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā patiṃ nāticaranti yāḥ |
[329] tāsāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ saumye puṇyakaiḥ samudāhṛtam ||
puṇyakānāṃ vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ sarvalokaṃ prati śobhane |
nibodha sa hi sarvād dhi dṛṣṭo ‘haṃ tapasā mayā ||
snātvā strī prātar utthāya patiṃ vijñāpayet satī |
upavāsārtham atha vā vratakāryaṃ ghṛtavrate |
spṛṣṭvā karābhyāṃ caraṇau satataṃ sattamasya ca ||
gṛhītvodumbaraṃ pātraṃ sakuśaṃ sākṣataṃ tathā |
gośṛṅgaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ sicyaṃ pratigṛhṇīta taj jalam ||
tato bhartuḥ satī dadyāt snātasya prayatasya ca |
ātmano ‘tha niṣektavyaṃ tataḥ śirasi taj jalam ||
trailokye sarvatīrtheṣu snānam etat udāhṛtam |
upavāseṣu kartavyam etad dhi vatakeṣu ca ||
snānam etad dhi sāmānyaṃ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca bhāmini |
arundhati mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tapasā haratoṣakam ||
aśūnyaṃ viddhi śayanam āsanaṃ ca tathāvidham |
svayaṃ prakṣālaṇaṃ cāpi pādayor anuśabditam ||
anuśabditaṃ vratopayogitayā kathitam |
aśruprapāto roṣaś ca kalahasya kṛtiḥ sati |
upavāsād vrātād vāpi sadyo mriṃśayati striyam ||
śuklam eva sadā vāsaḥ praśastaṃ candrasaṃbhave |
antarvāso ‘paraṃ caiva upavāsavrate tathā ||
pādukārthastaṇaiḥ (?) kāryaḥ sarvadā vratake sati |
[330] upavāse ‘pi ca vidhir eṣa eva prakīrtitaḥ ||
añjanaṃ rocanaṃ cāpi gandhān sumanasas tathā |
vratake copavāse ca nityam eva vivarjayet ||
rocanaṃ kuṅkumādinā, mukhojvalīkaraṇam |
dantakāṣṭhaṃ śiraḥsnānam udvartanam athāpi vā |
vivarjitāṃ mṛdaṃ sarvāṃ śaucārthaṃ tu vidhīyate ||
tilāmalaphalair nityaṃ śrīphalaiś ca samācaret |
prakṣālaṇaṃ ca śirasaḥ sadā mṛnmiśritair jalaiḥ ||
śiraso ‘bhyañjanaṃ saumye naivam etat praśasyate |
na pādayor na gātrasya sneheneti sthitiḥ smṛtā ||
goyānam uṣṭrayānaṃ ca kathaṃcid api nācaret |
kharayānaṃ ca satataṃ vrate cāpy upavāsake ||
nadījalaṃ prasravajaṃ śastaṃ vai somanandini |
śubhe taḍāge vāpy ādau vistīrṇe jalajāplute ||
gatvā snānaṃ praśastaṃ tu sadaiva khalu sarvathā |
alābhe tv avaruddhā strī ghaṭasnānaṃ samācaret ||
navaiś ca kumbhaiḥ snātavyaṃ vidhir eṣa sanātanaḥ |
snātaṃ ca kāryaṃ śirasā tapaḥphalam avāpnuyāt ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
devajāgnivahanaṃ saṃtoṣaḥ steyavarjanam |
sarvavrateṣv ayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśamaḥ sthitaḥ ||
[331] atra kṣamādīnāṃ svatantratayā caturvargasādhanatvena vihitānāṃ vratāṅgatayābhidhānaṃ khādiraṃ vīryakāmasyetyādivat saṃyogapṛthaktvanyāyād upapannam |
matsyapurāṇe |
tasmāt kṛtopavāsena snānam abhyaṅgapūrvakam |
varjanīyaṃ prayatnena rūpaghnaṃ tat paraṃ nṛpa ||
yat tūktaṃ garuḍapurāṇe |
gandhālaṃkāravastrāṇi puṣpamālānulepanam |
upavāse na duṣyanti dantadhāvanam añjanam || iti |
yac ca vyāsoktam |
dantadhāvanapuṣpāṇi vrate ‘pi syān na duṣyati ||
tad etat sabhartṛkopavāsaviṣayam | bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
añjanaṃ ca satāmbūlaṃ sindūraṃ raktavāsasī |
bibhṛyāt sopavāsāpi avaidhavyakaraṃ param |
vidhavā yatimārgeṇa kumārī vā yadṛcchayā ||
padmapurāṇe |
garbhiṇī sūtakādiś ca kumārī vātha rogiṇī |
[332] yadāśuddhā tadānyena kārayet prayatā svayam ||
garbhiṇyādir upavāse kartavye naktaṃ kuryāt | sūtakādibhir aśuddhā anyena vrataṃ kārayet | prayatā śuddhā svayaṃ kuryāt, puṃso (?) py eṣa vidhiḥ | liṅgasyāvivakṣitatvāt tad evaṃ strīṇāṃ kanyādaśāyāṃ pitrāder ājñayā, vinnānāṃ bhartur ājñayā, vidhavānāṃ putrādyājñayaiva vratādhikāro nānyatheti siddham |
agnipurāṇe |
vrīhiṣaṣṭikamudgāś ca kalāyāḥ salilaṃ payaḥ |
śyāmākāś caiva nīvārā godhūmādyā vrate hitāḥ ||
kūṣmāṇḍālābuvārtākīpālaṅkyajyotsnikās tyajet |
carur bhakṣyaṃ śaktukaṇāḥ śākaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu ||
śyāmākāḥ śālinīvārā yāvakamūlatandalam (?) |
haviṣyavratanaktādāv agnikāryādikaṃ hitam ||
madhu māṃsaṃ vihāyānyad vrate ca hitam īritam ||
jyotsnikā kośatakī | chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
haviṣyeṣu yavā mukhyās tadany vrīhayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
māṣakodravagaurādīn sarvābhāve ‘pi varjayet ||
bhaviṣyottare |
[333] haimantikaṃ sitāsvinnaṃ dhānyaṃ mudgā yavās tilāḥ |
kalāyakaṅgunīvārā vāstūkaṃ hilamocikā ||
ṣaṣṭikā kālaśākaṃ ca mūlakaṃ kemuketarat |
kandaḥ saindhavasāmudre lavaṇe madhusarpiṣī ||
payo ‘nuddhṛtasāraṃ ca panasāmraharītakī |
pippalī jīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṅgaṃ ca tintiṭī ||
kadalī lavalo dhātrī phalānyaguḍam aikṣavam |
atailapakvaṃ munayo haviṣyāṇi pracakṣate ||
sarpiḥ payaś cātra gavyam | atailapakvam ity etat kathitahaviṣyāṇam eva viśeṣaṇam idam |
padmapurāṇe |
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyam āhāralāghavam |
agnikāryam adhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī ṣaḍ ācaret ||
agnikāryam atra mahāvyāhṛtimantrair ājyahomaḥ | skandapurāṇe |
aṣṭau tāny avrataghāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ |
havir brāhmaṇakāmyā ca guror vacanam auṣadham ||
payaḥpānādīnām avrataghnatvaṃ strībālātyantapīḍitavraviṣayam (?) |
[334] sarvabhūtabhayaṃ caiva pramādo guruśāsanam |
avrataghāni kathyante sakṛd etāni śāstrataḥ ||
sarvabhūtabhayaṃ sarvabhyo bhūtebhyo sakāśād vratakartur bhayam |
mohāt pramādāl lobhād vā vratabhaṅgo bhaved yadi |
tadā trirātraṃ nāśnīyāt kuryād vā keśamuṇḍanam |
prāyaścittam idaṃ kṛtvā punar eva vratī bhavet ||
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvaraśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakāṇḍe
vratādhikāritaddharmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma prakaraṇam |
[335]
atha caturtho ‘dhyāyaḥ
guṇānām ādhāro malayajarasālepasuhṛdāṃ
prasiddho hemādiḥ spuradamalaśāstrārthanilayaḥ |
sa lokānāṃ kartuṃ sukṛtanipuṇānām upakṛtiṃ
vratavrātaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kathayati tithīnāṃ kramavaśāt ||
vadati saṃprati saṃpratipattaye
sukṛtināṃ kṛtinām api saṃmatam |
vratasamuccayasamuccayaśaskaraṃ
pratipadāśritapadāśritakāmadhuk ||
atha vratāny abhidhīyante | tatra tithivrataprakaraṇe pratipadvratāni tāvad ucyante |
śatānīka uvāca |
dvijaitās tithayaḥ proktāḥ saṃkṣepān na tu vistarāt |
vistareṇaiva me brūhi bhūyo dvijavarottama ||
rahasyaṃ yat tithīnāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca ceṣṭitam |
yānīṣṭāni ca devānāṃ bhojyāni niyamās tathā ||
tāni me vada dharmajña yena pūto bhavāmy aham |
nirdhano ‘pi yathā vipra labhed iṣṭaphalāni ca ||
[336] sumantur uvāca |
rahasyaṃ yat tithīnāṃ ca bhojanaṃ phalam eva ca |
yāvāṃś ca yasya niyamo viśeṣāt strījanasya ca ||
evaṃ tu sarvam ākhyānaṃ rahasyaṃ tan nibodha me |
padmāsanoktaṃ pūrvaṃ tu kathaṃcit svapriyasya tu ||
tat te ‘haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yasya devasya yā tithiḥ |
devatānāṃ rahasyāni vratāni niyamās tathā ||
tān śṛṇuṣva mahābhāga gadato mama mānada |
brahmā nārāyaṇaś caiva sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ samudyatau ||
tābhyāṃ tadānīm akhiladyāvābhūmī ca nirmame |
diśaś ca pradiśaś caiva lokapālāṣṭakāvṛtāḥ ||
tithiṃ pūrvām imāṃ rājan cakārādhipatiḥ svayam |
tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmād brahmaṇā samudāhṛtā ||
pratipāditā pade pūrve pratipat tena kathyate |
asyānte kathayiṣyāmi copavāsavidhiṃ param ||
kārttikyām atha saptamyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ vā yugādiṣu |
niyamopavāsaṃ prathamaṃ grāhayeta vidhānavit ||
kārttike vaiśākhe vā māsi pratipattithivratasyārambhaḥ | saptamīvrate māghe | yugāditithivratasya māghavaiśākhabhādrapadakārttikeṣv anyatame ārambhaḥ |
yā tithir niyamaṃ kartuṃ śakyā samanugacchati |
tasyāṃ tithau vidhānaṃ yat tan nibodha janādhipa ||
[337] niyamopavāsaṃ prathamaṃ grāhayed vidhivan naraḥ |
yadā vai pratipady ādau gṛhṇīyān niyamaṃ nṛpa ||
caturdaśyāṃ kṛtāhāraḥ saṃkalpya parikalpayet |
amāvāsyāṃ na bhuñjīta trikālaṃ snānam ācaret ||
pavitrāṇi japen nityaṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha |
atha vedapavitrāṇi vakṣyāmy aham ataḥ param ||
yeṣāṃ japaiś ca homaiś ca pūyante tamasāvṛtāḥ |
aghamarṣaṇaṃ devakṛtaḥ śuddhavatyas taratsamāḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍyaḥ pāvamānyaś ca durgā sāvitrir eva ca ||
bhāruṇḍāni ca sāmāni gāyatraṃ raivataṃ tathā |
śataparvātharvaśiras trisuparṇaṃ mahāvratam ||
abhiṣaṅgāpadastobhaḥ sāmāni vyāhṛtis tathā |
abliṅgā bārhaspatyaṃ ca vāksūktaṃ madhvṛtas tathā ||
tathā |
puruṣasūktam aghanāśaṃ ca tathā devavratāni ca |
gosūktam aśvasūktaṃ ca aindraśuddhe ca sāmanī ||
trīṇy ājyadohāni rathantaraṃ ca
agnivrataṃ vāmadevyaṃ bṛhac ca ||
etāni japtāni punanti jantūn
jātismaratvaṃ labhate ya icchan ||
arcayitvā vidhānena gandhamālyair dvijottamān |
śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāt tu brahmā me prīyatāṃ vibhuḥ ||
tato bhuñjīta gokṣīram anena vidhinā nṛpa |
eṣa eva vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvāsu tithiṣu nṛpa ||
[338] sarvāsu tithiṣu mārgaśīrṣādipratipatsu |
saṃvatsaragate kāle vratam asya samāpyate |
vratānte yat phalaṃ yasya tan nibodha narādhipa ||
vimuktapāpaśuddhasya divyadehasya dehinaḥ |
brahmā dadāti saṃtuṣṭo vimānam amitaujasam ||
avyāhatagatiṃ divyam apsaraḥkinnarair vṛtam |
ramitvā suciraṃ tatra devataiḥ saha devavat ||
iha cāgatya vipratvaṃ daśajanmāny asau labhet |
vedavedāṅgavid yajñī vidvān dīrghāyur eva ca ||
bhogī dhanapatir dātā jāyate ‘sau kṛte yuge |
kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā brāhmaṇatvam avāpnuyāt ||
haihayais tālajaṅghaiś ca turuṣkair yavanaiḥ śakaiḥ |
upoṣitā ihātraiva brāhmaṇatvaṃ labhanti te ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe kṣīrapratipadvratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
atha tvaṃ pratipatkṛtyaṃ śṛṇu sampatkaraṃ vratam |
yat kurvāṇaḥ śriyaṃ vinded durlabhaṃ mānuṣair iha ||
śālitandulasaṃsiddhe maṇḍale caturasrake |
śrīśaṃ śriyam athāvāhya pūjayet sapuraḥsaram ||
[339] apracchannadasaiḥ [-dalaiḥ] padmair ayutais taṃ prapūjayet ||
apracchannadalaiḥ vikasitaiḥ |
sahasrair vā yathā yogaṃ payasā pāyasena ca |
tataś ca vidhinābhyarcya pārśve devīṃ sarasvatīm ||
athātaḥ pūjayed induṃ guruṃ paścād ananyadhīḥ |
parivāraniyogena tāṃś ca satkārayed atha ||
prārthanamantraḥ |
mama vidyāṃ pradiśa tu devo vāgīśvaro hariḥ |
vidyādhidaivataṃ devī vidyāṃ diśatu mendirā ||
sarasvatī pradiśa tu vāgvṛddhim atiśālinīm |
śītāṃśur api me puṣṭiṃ sarvabhogaprapūriṇīm ||
pūjā praṇavādinamo’ntair nāmamantrair eva kartavyā |
ity evaṃ kārayet sādhyaṃ prasannaḥ pūjito guruḥ |
sādhyaṃ śiṣyam upadeśyam |
vidhinā copavāsaṃ tu kārayen niyamānvitam ||
samabhyarcya dvitīyāyāṃ devadevaṃ śriyaḥ patim |
bhuñjīta payasānnena śucir ācamya saṃnidhau ||
sādhya iti śeṣaḥ |
ācāryāya varaṃ datvā kuryāt suprīṇanaṃ punaḥ |
[340] varaśabdena hiraṇyam abhidhīyate |
anadhītam anārabdhaṃ tadānīm ārabheta ha |
vidyāvratapradaṃ nityaṃ guruṃ daivatam ity api ||
manyeteti śeṣaḥ |
tanmukhād dhi tadā tasya niḥśreyasasamāgamam |
niḥśreyasam atiśayitaṃ śreyaḥ |
tadā taduktakārī syān na syāt tacchāsanātigaḥ ||
tiṣṭhet tiṣṭhatsu guruṣu na cāsīta tadagrataḥ |
na śayīta tadāsīne kurvīta vacanāny api ||
na laṅghayīta vacanaṃ guroḥ kṛcchragatena ca |
nivedya gurave sarvaṃ kuryād ādau hitāhitam ||
evam ācāryaniṣṭhas tu matimān prājñasaṃmataḥ |
utpannajñānavairāgyo dīrgham āyur avāpya ca ||
yaśaś ca vipulaṃ labdhvā sadācārapravartanam |
putrapautraśriyājuṣṭaḥ puṇyāṃ gatim avāpnuyāt ||
evaṃ samāpayed vidvān vidyāvratam udāradhīḥ |
dadyāt phalāni viprebhyo hy utkṛṣṭāni bahūny atha ||
kadalīcūtapanasasaṃbhavāni śucīni ca |
yas tv evaṃ kurute vidvān vidyāvratam ananyadhīḥ |
samastavidyānipuṇo vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ṛcchati ||
[341]
garuḍapurāṇoktaṃ vidyāpratipadvratam |
puṣkara uvāca |
saṃvatsarāvasāne tu pañcadaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
prātaḥ pratipadi snātaḥ kuryād vratam ananyadhīḥ ||
pūjayed bhāskaraṃ devaṃ varṇakaiḥ kamale kṛte ||
śucau sthaṇḍiladeśe nānāvarṇaiḥ kamalaṃ vidhāya tatra bhāskaraṃ dhyātvā pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
śuklena gandhamālyena candanena sitena ca |
tathā kundurudhūpena ghṛtadhūpena bhārgava ||
kunduruḥ sallakīniryāsaḥ |
apūpaiḥ saikatair dadhnā paramānnena bhūriṇā |
saikataiḥ śarkarāvikāraiḥ |
odanena ca śuklena satā lavaṇasarpiṣā ||
satā uttamena |
kṣīreṇa ca phalaiḥ śuklair vahnibrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ |
pūjayitvā jagaddhāma dinabhāge caturthake ||
āhāraṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt saghṛtaṃ manujottama |
sarvaṃ ca manujaśreṣṭha ghṛtahīnaṃ vivarjayet ||
[342] bhuktvā ca sakṛd evānnam āhāraṃ ca samācaret |
pānīyapānaṃ kurvīta brāhmaṇānumate punaḥ ||
prathamam āhāraṃ prathamagrāsam | sarvaṃ prathamam aprathamaṃ cāhāraṃ sakṛd evānnaṃ bhuktvā ekam eva grāsaṃ bhakṣayitvāvaśiṣṭam annaṃ tyajet | brāhmaṇānumatyā punar āhāram avaśiṣṭānnabhojanaṃ punaḥ pānīyapānaṃ ca kuryād ity arthaḥ | brāhmaṇānumatyā bhuñjāno ‘pi ghṛahīnaṃ ca bhuñjīta ghṛtahīnaṃ vivarjayed iti niṣedhāt |
saṃvatsaram idaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sākṣāt trayodaśam |
pūjanaṃ devadevasya tasminn ahani bhārgava ||
saṃvatsaraṃ pratimāsaṃ śuklapratipadi tataḥ sākṣāt trayodaśam iti liṅgadarśanāt |
samāpayet vrataṃ puṇyaṃ rāma ity abhidhīyate |
he rāma, śāstre evam adhidhīyata ity arthaḥ |
sa hiraṇyaṃ savastraṃ ca tathā dadyād dvijottama ||
sūryāyeti śeṣaḥ |
vratenānena dharmajña rogam evaṃ vyapohati |
ārogyam āpnoti gatiṃ tathāgryāṃ
yaśas tathāgryāṃ vipulāṃś ca bhogān |
vratena samyak puruṣo ‘tha nārī
saṃpūjayed yas tu jagatpradhānam ||
[343]
iti viṣṇudharmottare sodyāpanam ārogyapratipadvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
aṣṭapatraṃ tu kamalaṃ vinyased varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu tasya saṃprajayed vibhum ||
tasya kamalasya |
ṛgvedaṃ pūrvapatre tu yajurvedaṃ tu dakṣiṇe |
paścime sāmavedaṃ tu udak cātharvaṇaṃ tathā ||
āgneye ca tathāṅgāni dharmaśāstrāṇi nairṛte |
purāṇaṃ caiva vāyavye īśānye nyāyavistarau ||
evaṃ vinyasya dharmajñaḥ sopavāsas tu pūjayet |
caitraśuklam athārabhya sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
sadā pratipadaṃ prāpya śuklapakṣasya yādava |
saṃvatsaraṃ mahābhāga śuklagandhānulepanaiḥ ||
bhūriṇā paramānnena dhūpadīpair atandritaḥ |
saṃvatsarānte gāṃ dadyād vrate cīrṇe narottamaḥ ||
idaṃ vrataṃ yas tu karoti rājan
sa vedavit syād bhuvi dharmaniṣṭhaḥ |
kṛtvā tadā dvādaśavatsarāṇi
tririñcilokaṃ (?) puruṣaḥ prayāti ||
[344]
iti viṣṇudharmottarokaṃ sodyāpanaṃ vidyāvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
eka eva jagat sarvaṃ prakṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
caitraśuklasamārambhe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
samārambhe varṣārambhe | pūrvavat pañcadaśyām upavāsaḥ |
puruṣaṃ pūjayed viṣṇuṃ sthale vā yadi vā jale |
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ||
pauruṣaṃ tu tathā sūktaṃ japed antarjale naraḥ |
śucau jale viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan gandhādibhiḥ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
tathārcanaṃ pratyṛcaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dadyāj jajāñjalim ||
tathā dhūpāni dharmajña phalāni ca mahābhuja |
dhūpaṃ datvā ca naivedyaṃ japec chaktyā tathaiva tat ||
juhuyāc ca tathājyena dvije dadyāc ca kāñcanam |
āhāraṃ payasā dadyān niśākāle ca bhārgava ||
dadyāt saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā nityavratam atandritaḥ |
pakṣayor ubhayor vīra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
prasādam āsādya ca vāsudevāt
sarveśvarāt sarvagatād acintyāt |
lokeśvarād eva padaṃ prayāti
yāṃ yānti siddhāḥ punar eva siddhim ||
[345] iti viṣṇudharmottare pauruṣapratipadvratam | adhyāpanamantraḥ (?) pūrvavat |
paurṇamāsyupavāsaṃ tu kṛtvā bhaktyā narādhipa |
anena vidhinā yas tu viriñciṃ pūjayen naraḥ ||
paurṇamāsīgrahaṇaṃ pūrvadinopalakṣaṇaṃ tena yadā śuklapratipadi vrataṃ kriyate tadāmāvāsyāyām upavāsaḥ | anena vakṣyamānena |
paripadyāṃ mahābāho snātaś caiva samāhitaḥ |
agnir viśeṣato devo viriñcir vātra devatā ||
kārttike māsi devasya rathayātrā prakīrtitā |
yaḥ kuryānmānavo bhaktyā yāti brahmasalokatām ||
kārttike māsi rājendra paurṇamāsyāṃ caturmukham |
mārgeṇa muditaḥ sarvaṃ nānāvāsaiḥ samanvitam ||
sthāpayed grāmayitvā tu salokaṃ nagaraṃ nṛpa |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu śāṇḍileyaṃ prapūjya ca ||
śāṇḍileyo vaiśvānaraḥ |
āmodayed devadevaṃ brahmavāditranisvanaiḥ |
rathāgre śāṇḍilīputraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
brāḥmaṇān arcayitvā tu kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṅgalam |
[346] devam āropayitvā tu rātrau kuryāt prajāgaram ||
nānāvidhaiḥ prakṣapaiś ca brahmaghoṣaiś ca puṣkalam |
kṛtvā prajāgantvyevaṃ (?) prabhāte brāhmaṇān nṛpa ||
pūjayitvā yathāśaktyā bhakṣyabhojyair anekaśaḥ |
pūjayitvājanaṃ vīra vajreṇa vidhinā nṛpa ||
vājena ca mahābāho payasā pāyasena ca |
vajram ājyam, vājam annam |
brāhmaṇān vācayed rātrau nāgena vidhinā nṛpa |
kṛtvā puṇyāhaśabdena rathaṃ ca bhrāmayet punaḥ ||
caturvedavidair viprair bhrāmayed brāhmaṇo ratham |
bahvṛcā yajuṣā vīra chandogātharvabhis tathā ||
bhrāmayed devadevasya śubhaśreṣṭhasya taṃ ratham |
pradakṣiṇaṃ puraṃ sarvaṃ mārgeṇa susamena ca ||
āroḍhavyaṃ rathaṃ vīra śūdreṇa śubham icchatā |
nārohayed rathaṃ prājño muktakaṃ bhojakaṃ nṛpa ||
brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe pārśve sāvitrīṃ sthāpayen nṛpa |
bhojako brāmapārśve tu purataḥ paṅkajaṃ nyaset ||
evaṃ rūpaṃ ninādaiś ca śaṅkhaśabdaiś ca puṣkalaiḥ |
bhrāmayitvā rathaṃ vīra puraṃ sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇam ||
sthāpayet sthāpayed vīra kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ budhaḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ bhaktyā yaś cāpi paśyati ||
rathaṃ vā karṣayed yas tu dīpaṃ yas tu pradāpayet |
[347] śālāyāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kuryāt samicchet paramaṃ padam ||
pratipad brahmaṇaś cāpi guḍamiśraiḥ prapūjayet |
vāsobhir ahataiś cāpi sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpair navair vastrair ātmānaṃ pūjayec ca yaḥ |
tasyāṃ pratipadāyāṃ tu sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
mahāpuṇyā tithir iyaṃ bahvī rājyapravartinī |
brahmaṇas tu priyā nityaṃ bāleyī sā prakīrtitā ||
brāhmaṇān pūjayed yo ‘syām ātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ ||
caitramāse mahābāho puṇyā pratipadā varā |
tasyāṃ yo ‘śvapadaṃ dṛṣṭvā snānaṃ kuryān naro nṛpa ||
na tasya duritaṃ kiṃcid ādhayo vyādhayas tathā |
bhavanti kuruśārdūla tasmāt snānaṃ hi tailataḥ ||
nārīnīrājanaṃ tatra sarvaroganivāraṇam |
gomahiṣyādi yat kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ bhūṣayen nṛpa ||
tailavastrādibhiḥ puṣpais toraṇāni purā nayet |
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā bhojyaṃ dadyāt kurukulodvaha ||
tisro hy ādyāḥ purā proktās tithayaḥ kurunandana |
kārttike cāśvayugmāse caitre māsi samācaret ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ śataguṇaṃ kārttike yā tithir nṛpa |
balir ājyāt tu śubhadā yāmūlāśubhanāśinī ||
āmūlam aśubhahavvī (?) |
[348]
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇe balipratipadrathayātrāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
brahmeśakeśavādīnāṃ gaur yā gaṇapates tathā |
durgāsomāgnisūryāṇāṃ vratāni madhusūdana ||
śāstrāntareṇa dṛṣṭāni bhaved buddhigatāni ca |
tāni sarvāṇi me devadeva devakinandana ||
pratipatkramayogena vihitā yasya yā tithiḥ |
devasya yasyāṃ tat kāryaṃ tad aśeṣeṇa me vada ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
vasante kiṃśukāśokaśobhite pratipattithiḥ |
śuklā tasyāṃ prakurvīta snānaṃ niyamam āsthitaḥ ||
nārī naro vā rājendra saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ |
nadyās tīre taḍāge vā gṛhe vā tadalābhataḥ ||
piṣṭātakena vilikhed vatsaraṃ puruṣkrtim |
piṣṭātakaṃ paṭavasako gandhadravyacūrṇaviśaṣaḥ |
tataś candanacūrṇena puṣpadhūpādinārcayet ||
māsartunāmabhiḥ paścān namaskārāntayojitaiḥ |
māsartunāmabhiś caitravasantādināmabhiḥ |
pūjayed brāhmaṇo vidvān mantrair vedoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
saṃvatsaro ‘sīti yajurmantraiḥ | brāhmaṇo ‘tra dvijaḥ | mantras tu saṃvatsaro ‘si parivatsaro ‘sīdāvatsaro 'si anuvatsaro 'si udāvatsaro 'si | [349] uṣas te kalpantāṃ ahorātrās te kalpantām ardhamāsās te kalpantāṃ māsās te kalpantām ṛtavas te kalpantāṃ saṃvatsarās te kalpantām |
saṃvatsaro ‘sīti paṭhan mantraṃ vedoditaṃ dvijaḥ |
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa śūdro ‘pi tvāṃ prapūjayet ||
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa saṃvatsaro ‘ītyādinā |
evam abhyarcya vāsobhiḥ paścāt tam abhiveṣṭayet |
kāladravyair mūlaphalair naivedyair modakādibhiḥ ||
tatas taṃ prārthayet paścāt puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāñjaliḥ |
bhavaṃs tvatprasādena varṣāṅke mahimāstu me ||
saṃvatsaropasargā me vilayaṃ yāntv aśeṣataḥ |
evam uktvā yathāśaktyā dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām |
lalāṭapaṭṭe tilakaṃ kuryāc candanapaṅkajam ||
candanapaṅkoghṛṣṭacandanam |
tataḥ prabhṛty anudinaṃ tilakālaṃkṛtaṃ ukham |
dhāryaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvac chaśineva nabhastalam ||
evaṃ naro vā nārī vā vratam etat samācaret |
sadaiva puruṣavyāghra bhogān bhuvi bhunakty asau ||
bhūtapretapiśācādyāḥ durvārā vairiṇo grahāḥ |
nirarthakā bhavanty ete tilakaṃ vīkṣya tatkṣaṇāt ||
pūrvam āsīn mahīpālo nāmnā śatruñjayo jayī (?) |
citralekheti tasyābhūd bhāryā cāritrabhūṣaṇā ||
tayā vratam idaṃ caitre gṛhītaṃ dvijasaṃnidhau |
[350] saṃvatsaraṃ pūjayitvā dhyātvā hṛdi janārdanam ||
hantum ākṣeptukāmo vā samāgacchati yaḥ puraḥ |
prayāti priyakṛt tasyāḥ dṛṣṭvā tu tilakaṃ naraḥ ||
sapatnīdarpāpaharā vaśīkṛtamahītalā |
bhartur dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭā tu mukham āste nirākulā ||
yāvat kariṇābhibhūto bhartā putraḥ savedanaḥ |
śirorttinā saṃprayātaḥ suhṛdāṃ sukhadāyakaḥ ||
śirorttinā saṃprayātaḥ śirovedanāyuktaḥ |
dharmarājapurāt prāptāḥ sarvabhūtāpahārakāḥ |
tasmin kṣaṇe mahārāja āgatya yamakiṅkarāḥ ||
tasya dvāram anuprāptāḥ praviṣṭā gṛham añjasā |
śatruñjayaṃ samānetuṃ kālamṛtyupuraḥsarāḥ ||
pārśvasthitāṃ citralekhāṃ tilakālaṃkṛtānanām |
dṛṣṭvā pranaṣṭasaṃkalpāḥ parāvṛtya gatāḥ punaḥ ||
gateṣu teṣu sa nṛpaḥ putreṇa saha bhārata |
nīrujo bubhuje bhogān pūrvakāmārjitān [pūrvakarmā-?] śubhān ||
akrūreṇa samākhyātaṃ (?) mama pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
etat trilokī tilakākhyabhūṣaṇaṃ
puṇyaṃ vrataṃ sakaladuṣṭaharaṃ paraṃ ca |
icchan samācarati yaḥ sa sukhaṃ vihṛtya
martyaḥ prayāti padam acyutam indumoleḥ ||
[351]
iti bhaviṣyottare caitraśuklapratipadi vihitaṃ tilakavratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
aśvayukśuklapakṣasya prathame ‘hni dinodaye |
aśokaṃ pūjayed vṛkṣaṃ prarūḍhaśubhapallavam ||
prarūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiś ca guṇakair modakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
