phalaiḥ kālodbhavair divyair nārikelaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ ||
dhūpadīpādinā tatra pūjayet tarum uttamam |
aśokaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śokaṃ nāpnoti kutracit ||
pitṛbhrātṛpatiśvaśrūsutajāmātṛṇāṃ tathā |
aśokaśokaśamano bhava sarvatra naḥ kule ||
ity uccārya tato dadyād arghyaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
patākābhir alaṃkṛtya pracchādya ca suvāsasā ||
damayantī yathā svāhā yathā devī ca jānakī |
tathā śokavratād asmāj jāyate pativallabhā ||
vane vasantyā saharmaḥ sītayā saṃpradarśitaḥ |
dṛṣṭvāśokaṃ vane pārtha pallavālaṃkṛtaṃ tarum ||
kṛtvā samīpe bhartāraṃ devaraṃ ca tilākṣataiḥ |
dīpālaktakanaivedyair dhūpasūtraphalārcanaiḥ ||
arcayitvābhyarthito ‘sau (?) raktāśoko yudhiṣṭhira |
maithilī prāñjaliṃ kṛtvā śṛṇvato rāghavasya ca ||
prāñjaliṃ baddham añjalim |
[352] cirañjīvatu me vṛddhaḥ śvasuraḥ kośaleśvaraḥ ||
bhartā me devarāś caiva jīvantu bharatādayaḥ |
kośalyāmayi (?) jīvantī yasyeyam iti maithilī ||
yayā cedaṃ mahābhāgādramaṃvanabhūṣaṇam (?) |
pradakṣiṇam upāvṛtya tataḥ sā prayayau gṛham ||
evam anyāpi yā nārī pūjayed avanīnagam |
tilatandulasaṃmiśrair yavagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ ||
kṣamāpya secayen mūle pādapaṃ raktapallavam |
tadabhāve ca sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vā svaśaktitaḥ ||
varṇakair vā samālikhya pūjitaṃ vidhivat tataḥ |
mantreṇānena praṇamya yā strī kuryāt pativratā ||
mahāvṛṣa mahāśākha makaradhvajamandira |
pārthive tvāṃ mahābhāga sarvakāmaprado bhava ||
evam ābhāṣya taṃ vṛkṣaṃ datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām |
taṃ ca vṛkṣaṃ kṛtaṃ datvā vastrayugmasamanvitam ||
kṛtaṃ suvarṇādighaṭitam |
sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī bhuñjīta brahmacāriṇī ||
yāḥ śokanāśanam aśokataruṃ yuvatyaḥ
saṃpūjayanti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ |
tāḥ pārtha saukhyam atulaṃ bhuvi bhartṛjāta
gaurīpadaṃ pramuditāḥ punar āpnuvanti ||
[353]
iti bhaviṣyottare ‘śokapratipadvratam |
bhagavān uvāca |
jyaiṣṭhe māse śubhe pakṣe prathame ‘hni dinodaye |
devodyānabhavaṃ hṛdyaṃ karavīraṃ samarcayet ||
raktatantuparīdhānaṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
prarūḍhasaptadhānyaiś ca nāraṅgair (?) bījapūrakaiḥ ||
guṇakair badarair bhakṣyair nārikelaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
abhyukṣyākṣatatoyena mantreṇetthaṃ kṣamāpayet ||
karavīra viṣāvāsa namas te bhānuvallabha |
maulimaṇḍana durgādidevānāṃ satataṃ priya ||
ākṛṣṇeneti vedoktamantreṇābhyarcya bhaktitaḥ |
evaṃ bhaktyā samabhyarcya datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet |
etad vrataṃ purā pārtha sūryārādhanakāmyayā ||
damayantyā sarasvatyā gāyatryā gaṅgayā tathā |
anyābhir api nārībhir martyaloke ‘py anuṣṭhitam ||
karavīravrataṃ pārtha sarvasaukhyaphalapradam |
saṃpūjya raktakusumārcitasarvaśākhaṃ
nīlair dalais tatatanuṃ karavīravṛkṣam |
bhuktvā mano’bhilaṣitān bhuvi bhavyabhogān
ante prayānti bhavanaṃ saratāgryabhānoḥ ||
[354]
iti bhaviṣyottare karavīrapratipatvratam |
brahmovāca |
agnim iṣṭvā ca hutvā ca pratipadyām iti smṛtam |
haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyād amṛtaṃ dhanam ||
iṣṭvā pūjayitvā | pratipadyāṃ pratipadi | iti smṛtaṃ kāmānusāreṇa hiraṇyaretaskatayā viditam | haviṣā ghṛtena | sarvadhānyāni hutvety anvayaḥ |
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
mūlamantrāḥ pradhānamantrāḥ | aṅgamantrāḥ parivāradevatāmantrāḥ agnaye hṛdayāya nama ityevamādayaḥ | svasaṃjñābhiḥ oṃ agnaye nama ityādipūjāyām | oṃ agnaye svāhā ityādi home | pūrvavat sūryavratavat | padmamadhyasthaḥ karṇikāyāṃ svamūrtyā patreṣu parivāramūrtyā sthitaḥ | tithīśvaro ‘tra vahniḥ | sa ca jaṭāśmaśrudhārī trilocano raktāṅgaś caturbāhuḥ pradakṣiṇe śūlaṃ tadapare jvālā | utsaṅgagatāyā annapātrahastāyāḥ svāhāyāḥ skandhe ca nyastaparovaraḥ | catvāraḥ śukā rathasya voḍhāraḥ | vāyuḥ sārathir ity evaṃ viṣṇudharmottarābhihito veditavyaḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
aśāḍhyena akapaṭena, śāṭhyenetyādi stutiḥ |
[355] ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homo vihitaḥ śāntacetasā ||
ājyadhārādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pṛthakkṛto homaḥ pūrvoktaphalado dhanadaḥ | mākṣikaṃ madhu | ādau pūjā tato ghṛtāktadhānyahomas tato ājyadhārādihomaḥ |
iti bhaviṣye vaiśvānaravratam |
agastya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhanyavratam anuttama |
yena sadyo bhaved dhanyo ‘dhanyo ‘pi hi yo bhavet ||
mārgaśīrṣe ‘male pakṣe pratipadyā tithir bhavet |
tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakurvīta rātrau viṣṇuṃ ca pūjayet ||
vaiśvānarāy ādau tu agnaye cottaraṃ tathā |
havirbhuje tatoruś ca draviṇodāya vai bhuje ||
samvartāyeti ca śiro jvalanāyeti sarvataḥ |
abhyaryaivaṃ vidhānena devadevaṃ janārdanam ||
tasyaiva purataḥ kuṇḍaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ |
homānte vrataṃ kurvīta etair mantrair vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
etair mantrair vaiśvānarāyetyādiprāguktaiḥ |
tatas tu yāvakaṃ cānnaṃ bhuñjīta ghṛtasaṃyutam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe ‘py evam eva cāturmāsyāṃ tu yāvakam ||
[356] catrādiṣu (caitrādiṣ?) tu bhuñjīyāt pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ budhaḥ |
śrāvaṇādiṣu saktūṃś ca tataś caiva samāpyate ||
samāpte ca vrate vahnikāṃcanaṃ kārayen nṛpaḥ |
vahnirūpaṃ pūrvoktam |
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ raktapuṣpānulepanam ||
kuṅkumena tathā limped brāhmaṇaṃ tv evam eva tu |
sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇaṃ guṇinaṃ priyadarśanam ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena raktavastrayugena ca |
paścāt pradadyāt tat tasya mantreṇānena mantravān ||
dhanyo ‘si dhanyadharmā ca dhanyo ‘smi dhayavān bhavān |
dhanyenānena cīrṇena vratena syāṃ sadā sukhī ||
evam uccārya taṃ vipra (?) nyasya kośam ivātmanaḥ |
sadyo dhanyatvam āpnoti yo ‘pi syād bhāgyavarjitaḥ ||
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ dhanyaṃ dhānyaṃ ca puṣkalam |
anena kṛtamātreṇa jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
vāṅmanaḥsaṃcitaṃ pāpaṃ vahnir dahati tasya vai |
dagdhapāpaḥ sa śuddhātmā amutreha ca vindati ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktaṃ dhanyavratam |
pulastya uvāca |
pratipady ekabhaktāśī samānte kapilāpradaḥ |
[357] vaiśvānarapuraṃ yāti vrataṃ vaiśvānaraṃ tv idam ||
padmapurāṇe vaiśvānaravram iti |
pṛthivīṃ bhājanaṃ kṛtvā yo bhuṅkte pakṣasaṃdhiṣu |
ahorātreṇa caikena trirātraphalam aśnute ||
iti padmapurāṇe pakṣasaṃdhivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
vaidikena vidhānena vrataṃ puṇyaṃ mahattamam |
kasmiṃs tithau tu kartavyaṃ vidhānaṃ tad vadasva me ||
skanda uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade śukle pakṣe ca pratipattithau |
naivedyaṃ tu pacen maunī ṣoḍaśatriguṇāni ca ||
phalāni piṣṭapakvāni dadyād viprāya ṣoḍaśa |
devāya ṣoḍaśaitāni dātavyāni prayatnataḥ ||
bhuñjante ṣoḍaśa tathā vratasya niyamāśrayāt |
sauvarṇaṃ kārayed devaṃ yathāśaktyā hiraṇmayam ||
suvarṇaṃ karṣas tadghaṭitaṃ yathāśaktyā ca kṛtam |
netratrayasamāyuktaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam
pañcavaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ ṣaḍārāñjasya madhyagam |
[358] triśūlaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca vahantaṃ dakṣiṇe kare ||
kapālaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ vāme śikhāyāṃ candradhāriṇam |
pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpayet tataḥ ||
kumbhasyopari deveśaḥ śuklavastrayugānvitaḥ |
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya phalair nānāvidhais tathā ||
prasīda devadeveśa carācarajagadguro |
vṛṣadhvaja mahādeva trinetrāya namo namaḥ ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
devasya ca parīdhānaṃ dadyād dhenuṃ payasvinīm |
anena tu vidhānena yaḥ kuryād vratam uttamam ||
sa rājā labhate deva dīrgham āyus tathaiva ca |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||
bhuktvā tu vividhān bhogān tataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet |
iti skandapurānoktaṃ mahattamavrataṃ sodyāpanam |
śrībhagavān uvāca |
śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe śaṅkaraḥ prathame ‘hani |
triparvaṇā triśalyena trimukhena śareṇa ca ||
mukhāni trīṇi ciccheda yajñasya mṛgarūpiṇaḥ |
taiḥ śirobhis tapas taptaṃ varaḥ prāpto ‘tha śaṅkarāt ||
triśalyena trimukhena śalyarūpatrimukhenety arthaḥ | mṛgarūpiṇas trimukhamṛgarūpiṇa ity arthaḥ |
strībhiḥ pūjyāni tānīti na manuṣyaiḥ kadācana |
[359] mṛgaśīrṣaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā liṅgākāraṃ tu mṛnmayam ||
kṣīreṇa tapanīyaṃ vai pūjanīyaṃ yathāvidhi |
arghyaiḥ puṣpaiś ca dhūpaiś ca naivedyair (?) vividhair api ||
śākaiḥ sauvarcalālābhiś ca kṛtaiḥ piṣṭamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
sauvarcalābhiḥ atasīmiśrapiṣṭavikṛtibhiḥ |
kāṃsyabhājanavādyaiś ca paścāt kāryaṃ ca bhojanam ||
iti śrīhemādivratakāṇe pratipadvrataprakaraṇe
padmapurāṇoktaṃ mṛgaśīrṣavratam
|
[360]
atha pañcamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
śrībhagavān uvāca |
caitre māsi jagad brahmā sasarja prathame ‘hani |
śuklapakṣe samagraṃ tu tadā sūryodaye sati ||
pravartayāmāsa tathā kālasya gaṇanām api |
grahān nāgān ṛtūn māsān vatsarān vatsarādhipān ||
dadau sa bhagavān brahmā sarvadevasamāgame |
brāhmyāṃ sabhāyāṃ brahmāṇam anuddiśya vapus tataḥ ||
yathoktās te namasyantaḥ stuvantaś ca upāsate |
tatas taiḥ kṛtaśuśrūṣās tato gatvā svam ālayam ||
svāni svāny atha karmāṇi te niyuktāś ca cakrire |
brāhmī sabhā kāmarūpā viśeṣeṇa tadā nṛpa ||
dhārayantyam antaṃ rūpam anirdeśyaṃ manoharam |
tataḥ prabhṛti yo dharmaḥ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ kṛtaḥ ||
adyāpi rūḍhaḥ sutarāṃ kartavyo ‘sau prayatnataḥ |
tatra kāryā mahā śāntiḥ sarvakalmaṣanāśinī ||
sarvotpātapraśamaṇī kaliduḥsvapnanāśinī |
āyuḥpradā puṣṭikarī dhanasaubhāgyavardhinī ||
maṅgalyā ca pavitrā ca lokadvayasukhāvahā |
tasyām ādau tu saṃpūjyo (?) brahmā kamalasaṃbhavaḥ ||
[361] pādyādyaiś caiva dhūpaiś ca vastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ |
homair balyuprahāraiś ca tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ ||
tataḥ krameṇa devebhyaḥ pūjā kāryā pṛthak pṛthak |
kṛtvoṅkāranamaskārau kuśodakatilākṣataiḥ ||
puṣpadhūpapradīpādyair bhojanaiś ca yathākramam ||
oṃkāranamaskārau kṛtvā oṃ brahmaṇe nama ityādi | mantraṃ saṃpūjanārthaṃ tu bahurūpaṃ parispṛśet paṭhed ity arthas tathā ca brahmaṇe nama ity upakramya viṣṇave paramātmane nama ityantavākyavṛndopāttadevatānāmāni praṇavādicaturthyantanamonatāni mantratvena grāhyāṇi |
oṃ namo brahmaṇe tubhyaṃ kāmāya ca mahātmane |
namasves (?) tu nimeṣāya triṭaye ca namo ‘stu te ||
lavāya ca namas tubhyaṃ namas te ‘stu kṣaṇāya ca |
namo namas te kāṣṭhāyai kalāyai cātha sarvadā ||
nābhikāyai susūkṣmāyai muhūrtāya namo namaḥ |
namo niśāmyaḥ puṇyebhyo divasebhyaś ca nityaśaḥ ||
pakṣābhyāṃ cātha māsebhyo ṛtubhyaḥ ṣaḍbhya eva ca |
ayanābhyāṃ ca pañcabhyo vatsarebhyaś ca sarvadā ||
namaskṛtya yugādibhyo grahebhyaś ca namo namaḥ |
namaḥ purandarebhyaś ca tatsakhyebhyo namo namaḥ ||
pañcāśate namo nityaṃ dakṣakanyābhya eva ca |
[362] namo devyai suprabhāyai japāyai cātha sarvadā ||
mṛśāstrāya namas tubhyaṃ sarvāstrajanakāya ca |
namas te bahuputrāya patnībhiḥ sahitāya ca ||
namo buddhyai tathā vṛddhyai nidrāyai dhanadāya ca |
nalakūbarayajñāya guhyakasvāmine namaḥ ||
namo ‘stu śaṅkhapadmābhyāṃ nidhibhyām atha nityaśaḥ |
bhadrakālyai namo nityaṃ surabhyai ca namo namaḥ ||
vedavedāṅgavedāntavidyāsaṃkhyābhya eva ca |
nāgayakṣasuparṇebhyo namo ‘stu garuḍāya ca ||
saptabhyaś ca samudrebhyaḥ sāgarebhyaś ca sarvadā |
uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyaś ca namo hairaṇyatāya ca ||
bhadrāśvaketumālābhyāṃ namaḥ sarvatra sarvadā |
ilāvṛtāya ca namo harivarṣāya caiva hi ||
namaḥ kiṃpuruṣebhyaś ca bhāratāya namo namaḥ |
namo bhāratadeśebhyo navabhyaś caiva sarvadā ||
pātālebhyaś ca saptabhyo narakebhyo namo namaḥ |
kālāgnirudraśeṣābhyāṃ haraye krodharūpiṇe ||
saptabhyas tv atha lokebhyo mahābhūtebhya eva ca |
namas te buddhaye caiva namaḥ prakṛtaye tathā ||
puruṣāyābhimānāya namo ‘stv avyaktamūrtaye |
himavatpramukhebhyaś ca parvatebhyo namas tathā ||
paurāṇībhyaś ca gaṅgābhyaḥ saptabhyaś ca namo namaḥ |
namo ‘stv ādyamunibhyaś ca saptabhyaś cātha sarvadā ||
[363] namo ‘stu puṣkarādibhyas tīrthebhyaś ca punaḥ punaḥ |
nimnagābhyo namo nityaṃ vitastādyābhya eva ca ||
caturdaśabhyo dīrghābhyo dhāriṇībhyo namo namaḥ |
namo dhātre vidhātre ca chandobhyaś ca namo namaḥ ||
surabhyai rāvaṇābhyāṃ ca namo bhūtyai namo namaḥ |
namas tathoccaiḥśravase dhruvāya ca namo namaḥ ||
namo ‘stu dhanvantaraye śastrāstrābhyāṃ namo namaḥ |
vināyakakumārābhyāṃ vighnebhyaś ca namaḥ sadā ||
śākhāya ca viśākhāya nigameśāya vai namaḥ |
namaḥ skandagrahebhyaś ca skandamātṛbhya eva ca ||
jvarāya rogapataye bhasmapraharaṇāya ca |
ṛṣibhyo vālakhilyebhyaḥ kaśyapāya namaḥ sadā ||
agastāya nāradāya vyāsādibhyo namo namaḥ |
apsarobhyaḥ somapebhyo devebhyaś ca tathā namaḥ ||
asomapebhyaś ca namas tuṣitebhyo namaḥ sadā |
ādityebhyo namo nityaṃ dvādaśabhyaś ca sarvaśaḥ ||
ekādaśebhyo rudrebhyas tapasvibhyo namo namaḥ |
namo nāsatyadasrābhyām aśvibhyāṃ nityam eva hi ||
sādhyebhyo dvādaśebhyaś ca paurāṇebhyaś ca sarvadā |
ekonapañcāśate ca marudbhyaśca namo namaḥ ||
śilpācāryāya devāya namas te viśvakarmaṇe |
aṣṭabhyo lokapālebhyaḥ sānugebhyaś ca sarvadā ||
āyudhebhyo vāhanebhyo dharmebhyaś ca namaḥ sadā |
[364] āsanebhyo dundubhībhyo devebhyaś ca namaḥ sadā ||
daityarākṣasagandharvapiśācebhyaś ca nityaśaḥ |
pitṛbhyaḥ saptabhedebhyaḥ pretebhyaś ca namo namaḥ ||
susūkṣmebhyaś ca devebhyo bhāvagamyebhya eva ca |
namas te bahurūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane ||
atha kiṃ bahunoktena mantreṇānena cārcayet |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukhān viprān devān uddiśya pūrvavat ||
atha vā kiṃ mantravistāreṇa brāhmaṇān eva devatoddeśena pūjayed ity arthaḥ | pūrvavat mantroktakrameṇety arthaḥ |
arghaiḥ puṣpaiś ca dhūpaiś ca vastrair mālyaiḥ sahṛṣṭakam |
sahṛṣṭakaṃ saromāṃ ca hṛṣṭaromā sann arcayed ity arthaḥ |
dhanadhānyānnavibhavair dakṣiṇābhiś ca sarvadā ||
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ tadvaktṝṃś ca dvijottamān |
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ tatpustakadānenety arthaḥ |
kālajñān vedavedajñān bhṛtyān saṃbandhibāndhavān ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa svāhāntena pṛthak pṛthak |
yaviṣṭhāyāgnaye homaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvatṛptaye ||
vedavic cakṣuṣī datvā sthāne prādhānike sati |
aviṣṭho ‘gnir agniviśeṣaḥ | vedavid vedoktavidhijñaḥ | cakṣuṣī ājyabhāgau | prādhānike sthāne pradhānahomārambhe |
homārambhe tataḥ kuryān maṅgalālambhanaṃ naraḥ ||
bhojayitvā dvijān sarvān suhṛtsaṃbandhibāndhavān |
[365] viśeṣeṇa ca bhoktavyaṃ kāryaś cāpi mahotsavaḥ |
navasaṃvatsarārambhaḥ sarvasiddhipravartakaḥ ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktaḥ saṃvatsarāmbhavidhiḥ |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādripaṇḍitaviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakāṇḍe pratipatvratāni |
[366]
atha ṣaṣṭho ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha dvitīyāvratāni |
brāhmyaṃ tejo dinakarakaraspardhayā vardhamānaṃ
prauḍhaṃ yasya spurati parito rodasīty aśruvānam (?) |
prāṃśur vaṃśo jagati vijayī yasya hemādrināmā
vakti vyaktaṃ kramam upagataṃ sa dvitīyāvratānām ||
śatānīka uvāca |
ṛṣe ‘haṃ tava pṛcchāmi bhagavan brūhi tat vratam |
yathā vrataprabhāvena svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
alpāyasaṃ bahuphalaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
prasādaṃ kuru me deva yena vrataṃ karomy aham ||
ṛṣir uvāca |
asti vrataṃ mahāpuṇyam aśūnyaśayanaṃ nṛpa |
candrodaye cārghadānaṃ pūnajīyo janārdana ||
śatānīka uvāca |
kasmin māse prakartavyaṃ pakṣaś caiva tithiś ca kā |
kiṃ dānaṃ bhojanaṃ caiva kathayasva mahāprabho ||
[367] ṛṣir uvāca |
cāturmāsye bhaved rājan varṣāyāṃ vratam uttamam |
śrāvaṇasya dvitīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe narādhipa ||
śrāvaṇādikārtikāntaṃ kuryāt tat vratam uttamam |
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dīpamālā viśeṣataḥ ||
nānāphalaṃ sanaivedyaṃ nānārasasamanvitam |
mauktikaṃ rajataṃ caiva śaṅkhaṃ dugdhasamanvitam ||
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ pūjanīyo janārdanaḥ |
tato bhādrapade māse yavadānaṃ dadāti ca ||
dugdhaṃ dadyāc ca viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
dadhi caiva phalaṃ caiva bījapūrasamanvitam ||
janārdanaś cātibhaktyā pūjanīyo narādhipa |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājan prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||
tataś cāśvidvitīyāyāṃ śayyādānaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
na tasya śūnyaṃ śayanam aputro na bhaven naraḥ ||
jalamadhye sthito viṣṇuḥ pūjanīyo janārdanaḥ |
śvetapuṣpaiḥ phalair vastraiḥ satāmbūlaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||
viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājan labhate kāñcanīṃ purīm ||
tataś ca kārttike māsi dvitīyāyāṃ narādhipa |
śarkarākhaṇḍādyāni dadhikṣīraghṛtāni ca ||
upahāraṃ bhagavate dadyāt sarvaprayatnataḥ |
[368] puṣpaṃ phalaṃ sanaivedyaṃ gītavādyasamanvitam ||
chatraṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ dadyād upānahau viśeṣataḥ |
caturvarṣaṃ prakurvantu puruṣāś ca tathā striyaḥ ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājann aśūnyaśayanavratam |
na ca duḥkhaṃ na dāridraṃ na ca kaṣṭaṃ bhavet kvacit ||
na tasya śūnyā śayyā syād aputro na bhaven naraḥ |
śokavyādhibhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ na bhavanti kadācana ||
na bhaved vidhavā nārī nirdhanā na bhavet kvacit |
vratasyāsya prabhāvena svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
śatānīka uvāca |
atyudbhutaṃ vrataṃ kṛṣṇa na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ mayā |
aśūnyaśayanaṃ nṛṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ yat prakīrtitam ||
kena cedaṃ purā cīrṇaṃ martyaloke prakāśitam |
phalaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ prāptaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayasva me ||
ṛṣir uvāca |
rājan rūkmāṅgado nāma satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
kadācin mṛgakheṭena gato ‘sau gahanaṃ vanam ||
bhavyaṃ sarovaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ mahoharam |
haṃsasārasasaṃkīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam ||
ālīlaṃ budbudākārair nānāṛṣisamanvitam |
tatra snānaṃ sa kṛtvā tu calito vanagahvarāt ||
[369] dvau karau saṃpuṭau kṛtvā gato ‘sau vāmanāśramam |
ugraṃ vrataṃ carann arghapādyasatkṛtavān ṛṣiḥ ||
namaskāraṃ vidhāyāśu sthito ‘sau vāmanāgrataḥ ||
vāmadeva uvāca |
kiṃ te kāryaṃ samutpannaṃ yena tvam idam āgataḥ |
vanaṃ me gahvaraṃ sthānaṃ parvataṃ cātidurgamam |
kimarthaṃ bhavatā rājan mama pārśve samāgatam ||
rūkmāṅgada uvāca |
bhagavan tvāṃ ca pṛcchāmi vārtām ekāṃ savismayām |
kena puṇyaprabhāvena labdho dharmāṅgadaḥ sutaḥ ||
saṃdhyāvalīsamā bhāryā mama prāṇasya vallabhā |
saptadvīpavatī rājā matputro navakhaṇḍapaḥ ||
kena karmaprabhāvena satyaṃ brūhi mahāmune ||
vāmadeva uvāca |
aho nṛpavaraśreṣṭha satyavādin jitendriyaḥ |
pṛṣṭavān gahanaṃ praśnaṃ durvijñeyam abuddhibhiḥ ||
mano’nukūlā pravaṇā bhāryā putraś ca tādṛśaḥ |
na hy alpapuṇyaiḥ rājendra prāpyate puruṣaiḥ kvacit ||
yena puṇyena sakalaṃ prāpyate bhuvi mānvaiḥ |
tat sarvaṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla yathā rājyaṃ tvam āptavān ||
purājanmani śūdras tvaṃ satyaṃ na vadasi kvacit |
[370] havyaṃ kavyaṃ na jānāsi tava bhāryā pativratā ||
tava samīpe viprāś ca catvāro vedapāragāḥ |
satkarmaniratāḥ kṣāntā vidvāṃsaś ca jitendriyāḥ ||
catvāro vedadharmajñās tava te prativeśinaḥ |
teṣāṃ kṛtavatām etad aśūnyaśayanavratam ||
śrutvā mahāphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvayāpy etad anuṣṭhitam |
arghyaṃ datvā tu candrasya udaye dvitīyādine ||
udakaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ caiva māṣakṣāravivarjitam |
prāśanaṃ te kṛtaṃ datvā brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ ||
caturvarṣasamāyuktaṃ cāturmāsye sadā nṛpa |
vratasyāsya prabhāvena suto labdho ‘bhivāñchitaḥ ||
saṃdhyāvalīsamā bhāryā dharmāṅgadasamaḥ sutaḥ |
anye ye ca kariṣyanti phalaṃ sarvaṃ labhanti te ||
putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamākulaḥ |
vratasyāsya prabhāvena svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
gaccha tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla bhokṣyase sakalāṃ mahīm |
jāyāputrasamāyuktaḥ svargaṃ gacchasi nānyathā ||
śatānīka uvāca |
kathayasva vrataṃ deva prakāreṇa samanvitam |
udyāpanaṃ kathaṃ kuryāt paripūrṇe vratottame ||
ṛṣir uvāca |
candrodaye vrataṃ kuryāc caturvarṣam idaṃ nṛpa |
[371] ācāryaṃ vedaviduṣaṃ dharmajñaṃ varayed atha ||
ṛtvijaiś ca samāyuktaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ |
yajñopavītaṃ vastraṃ ca upānahasamanvitam ||
suvarṇaṃ raupyamudrāṃ ca haimaṃ kṛtvā tu vaiṣṇavam |
sauvarṇī viṣṇumūrtiṃ ca rūkmalakṣmīsamanvitām ||
śayyāṃ ca tulikāṃ caiva saptadhānyasamanvitām |
gopradānaṃ ca dātavyam anujñānī bhaven naraḥ ||
brāhmaṇān bhojanaṃ dadyād ghṛtapūraiḥ saśarkaraiḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam aśūnyaśayanadvitīyāvratam |
bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
bhagavan bhavatā proktaṃ dharmārthādeḥ susādhanam |
gārhasthyaṃ tac ca bhavati dampatyoḥ priyamāṇayoḥ ||
patnīhīnaḥ pumān patnī bhartrā virahitā na ca |
darmārthakāmasaṃsiddhyai tasmāt tu madhusūdana ||
tac chroṣye devadeveśa vidhavā strī na jāyate |
vratena yena govinda patnyā virahito naraḥ ||
[372] kṛṣṇa uvāca |
aśūnyaśayanāṃ nām dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu bhārata |
yām upoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ strī prayāti narādhipa ||
patnīviyuktaś ca naro na kadācit prajāyate |
atropavāsadine na punaraśanaṃ naktaṃ bhuñjītety agre ‘bhidhānāt |
śete jagatpatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ yadā nṛpa ||
aśūnyaśayanā nāma tadā grāhyā tu sā tithiḥ |
upavāsena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi bhārata |
yadā śete tadeyaṃ grāhyā śayanīsaṃnihitā grāhyety arthaḥ | tena śrāvaṇo ‘tra paurṇamāntapakṣeṇa jñeyaḥ |
snānaṃ nadītaḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ||
sthaṇḍilaṃ caturasraṃ ca mṛnmayaṃ kārayet tataḥ |
tatrasthaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīśaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha ||
naivedyaiḥ puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
idam uccārayen mantraṃ praṇamya ca jagatpatim ||
śrīvatsadhārin śrīkānta śrīvāsa śrīpate ‘vyaya |
gārhsthyam āpranāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam ||
śucayo mā praṇasyantu mā praṇaśyantu nirjarāḥ |
yāmyagā mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ ||
śucayo ‘gnayaḥ nirjarāḥ devāḥ yāmyagāḥ pitaraḥ |
lakṣmyā viyujyante deva na kadācid yathā bhavān |
tathā kalatrasaṃbhandho deva mā me viyujyatām ||
[373] lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyās tu tathātra madhusūdana ||
viṣṇurahasye punar ime mantrāḥ |
patnī bhartṛviyogaṃ bhartā bhāryāsamudbhavam |
nāpnuvanti yathā duḥkhaṃ dāmpatyāni tathā kuru ||
yathā śriyāviyuktas tvaṃ lakṣmīr deva tvayā yathā |
prasādāt tava deveśa sthiras astu tathāvayoḥ ||
mātmaputrāḥ praṇaśyantu mā dhanaṃ mākulakramaḥ |
agnayo mā praṇaśyantu gṛhabhaṅgo ‘stu māvayoḥ ||
śeṣo grantho bhaviṣyottareṇa tulyārthaḥ |
evaṃ prasādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyās tathā hareḥ |
phalāni dadyāt śayyāyām apīṣṭāni jagatpateḥ ||
naktaṃ praṇamyāyatane hariṃ bhūjñīta vāgyataḥ |
candrodaye snānapūrvaṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutam ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā svaśaktyā phalasaṃyutam |
hariṃ praṇamya naktaṃ bhuñjītety anvayaḥ |
anena vidhinā rājan yāvan māsacatuṣṭayam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ prāguktavidhinārcaret ||
kārttike tv atha saṃprāpte śayyāṃ śrīkāntasaṃyutām |
sopaskarāṃ sodakumbhāṃ sānnāṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||
pratimāṃsaṃ ca somāya arghaṃ dadyāt samantrakam |
[374] dadhyakṣatair mūlaphalaiḥ ratnaiḥ sauvarṇabhājanaiḥ ||
gaganāṅgaṇasaṃbhūtadugdhābdhimathanodbhava |
bhābhāsitadigābhoga rasānuja namo ‘stu te ||
brāhmaṇāya dvitīye ‘hni śaktyā deyā ca dakṣiṇā |
yāni tatra mahābāho kāle santi phalāni ca ||
phalāni dadyāt śayyāyām ity anena sāmānyenopāttaphalānāṃ yānītyādinā viśeṣābhidhānam |
madhurāṇi na tīvrāṇi na cāpi kaṭukāni ca |
dātavyāni nṛpaśreṣṭha svaśaktyā śayane nṛpa ||
madhurāṇi ca datvā tu manovallabhatāṃ vrajet |
tasmāt kaṭukatīvrāṇi strīliṅgāni ca varjayet ||
kharjūramātulaṅgāni sthitena śirasā saha |
phalāni śayane rājan yajñabhāgaṃ harasva tu ||
sthitena śirasā saha nālikeraṃ yathāsthitaṃ varjayet | antargolaṃ dadyād harasya yajñabhāgaṃ varjayet | rudraprītyarthaṃ katicid avaśeṣya paritas tyajed ity arthaḥ |
etāny eva tu viprāya gāṅgeyasahitāni ca |
dvitīye ‘hni pradeyāni bhaktyā śaktyā ca bhārata ||
vāsodānaṃ tathā dhānyaphaladānasamanvitam |
etāny eva yāni śayane dattāni gāṅgeyam atra suvarṇam |
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyak naro māsacatuṣṭayam |
tasya janmatrayaṃ vīra gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate ||
māsacatuṣṭayaṃ kṛṣṇadvitīyāsv iti śeṣaḥ | [375] bodhinyanantaradvitīyāyāṃ samāptir ity arthaḥ |
tasya janmatrayaṃ yāvad gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate |
aśūnyaśayanaś caiva dharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ ||
bhavaty avyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
nārī ca pārtha dharmajñā vratam eva yathāvidhi ||
yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate |
vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama ||
prāpnoti janmatritayaṃ na sā pāṇḍukulodvaha ||
eṣā hy aśūnyaśayanā nṛpate dvitīyā
khyātā samastakaluṣāpaharā dvitīyā |
enāṃ sadācarati yaḥ puruṣo ‘tha yoṣit
prāpnoty asau śayanam agryamahārhabhogam ||
śaṅkara uvāca |
gītavāditranirghoṣair devadevasya kārayet |
ghaṇṭāvādanaśaktasya sarvadevamayīṃ namaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindam aśnīyāt tailavarjitam |
naktam akṣāralavaṇaṃ yāvat tat syāc catuṣṭayam ||
yām upoṣyeti tu tailādivarjanād divābhojanavarjanāc ca |
tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte lakṣmīpatisamanvitām |
dīpānnabhojanair yuktāṃ śayyāṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
pādukopānahachatracāmarāsanasaṃyutām |
tathābharaṇadhānyaiś ca yathāśaktyā samanvitām ||
[376] avyaṅgāṅgāya viprāya vaiṣṇavāya kuṭumbine |
dātavyā vedaviduṣe na bakavratine kvacit ||
tatropaveśya dāmpatyam alaṃkṛtya vidhānataḥ |
patnyāś ca bhojanaṃ dadyād bhakṣabhojyasamanvitam ||
brāhmaṇasyāpi sauvarṇīm upaskarasamanvitām |
pratimāṃ devadevasya sodakumbhāṃ nivedayat ||
evaṃ yas tu pumān kuryād aśūnyaśayanavratam |
na tasya vittavirahaḥ kadācid api jāyate |
nārī vāvidhavā brahman yāvac candrārkatārakam ||
matsyapurāṇāt |
na virūpaṃ na śokārthaṃ dāmpatyaṃ jāyate kvacit |
na putrapaśuratnāni kṣayaṃ yānti nṛpottama ||
saptakalpasahasrāṇi saptakalpaśatāni ca |
kurvann aśūnyaśayanaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
aśūnyaśayanaṃ tasya dharmakāmārthasādhakam |
bhavaty avyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
nārī ca rājan dharmajñā vratam etad yathāvidhi |
yā karoti na śocyāsau bandhuvargasya jāyate ||
vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama |
nāpnoti janmatritayam etat kṛtvā mahāvratam |
[377] ity eṣā kathitā rājan dvitīyā tithir uttamā |
yām upoṣya naro rājann ṛddhivṛddiṃ svayaṃ vrajet ||
iti aśūnyaśayanadvitīyāvratam |
brahmā uvāca |
brahmāṇaṃ ca dvitīyāyāṃ saṃpūjya brahmacāriṇam |
bhojayitvā tu vidhinā sarvāsāṃ pārago bhavet ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
tithīśvaro brahmā |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśaktyā vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi ca phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipatvratavat vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ brahmavratam |
agastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāntivratam anuttamam |
[378] dvitīyāyām tu rājendra kārttikasya site dine ||
naktaṃ kurvīta yatnena arcayed balakeśavau |
baladevāya pādau tu keśavāya śiro ‘rcayet ||
evam abhyarcya medhāvī vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpam uttamam |
parasvarūpaṃ somākhyaṃ dvikalaṃ taddine ‘rcayet ||
somarūpaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ kṛtvā tasya pādau baladevāyety arcayet | śiraḥ keśavāyeti evam aṅgadvayam abhyarcya śeṣarūpam arcayet | taddine dvitīyādine dvikalaṃ tat dve kale yasya tat dve kale baladevakeśavākhye nigrahānugrahaśaktī vyakte bhavataḥ |
dadyād arghyaṃ ca matimān mantreṇa parameṣṭhinaḥ |
parameṣṭhinaḥ candrarūpasya viṣṇoḥ tam eva mantram āha |
namas tv amṛtarūpāya sarvauṣadhidharāya ca |
yajñalokādhipataye somāya paramātmane ||
anena khalu mantreṇa datvārghyaṃ śaśine nṛpa |
rātrau sa vipro muñjīta yavānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ nṛpa ||
sa vipraḥ sa brāhmaṇas tena brāhmaṇāya bhojanaṃ hutvā svayaṃ bhoktavyam ity arthaḥ
sidhyati |
phālgunādicatuṣkām tu pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ śuciḥ |
tilahomaṃ prakurvīta kārttiādau yavais tathā ||
āṣāḍhādicatuṣke tu ghṛtahomaṃ ca kārayet |
naktaṃ tilānnaṃ bhuñjīta eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ ||
kārttikādicatuṣke yavānnaṃ bhuñjītey arthasiddam |
ataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe somaṃ kṛtvā tu rājatam |
[379] sitavastrayuṣachannaṃ sitapuṣpānulepanam ||
evam eva dvijaṃ pūjya tatas taṃ pratipādayet |
kāntimān aśviloke tu sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ||
tvatprasādāt saumyarūpī nārāyaṇa namo ‘stu te |
anena khalu mantreṇa datvā viprāya vāgyataḥ ||
kṛtamātre tatas tasmin kāntimān jāyate naraḥ |
ātreyeṇāpi somena kṛtam etat purā nṛpa |
tatas vratānte tantuṣṭaḥ [saṃtuṣṭaḥ?] svayam eva janārdanaḥ ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktaṃ sodyāpanaṃ kāntidvitīyāvratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
kathayāmi paraṃ pārtha sarvavighnopaśāntidam |
śruṇuṣvābhinavasyendor arghyadānavidhiṃ param ||
raver dvādaśabhir bhāgair vāruṇyāṃ dṛśyate śaśī |
pradoṣasamaye pārtha arghyaṃ dadyāt tathā vidhoḥ ||
candrād dvādaśabhāgāntarite bhūrye arghyaṃ dadyāt pratipadyutāyāṃ dvitīyāyām ity arthaḥ |
dvitīyāyāṃ site pakṣe saṃdhyākāle hy upasthite |
saṃsthāpyābhinavaṃ candraṃ rūpyaṃ gomayamaṇḍale ||
rohiṇīsahitaṃ devaṃ candanenābhilekhayet |
puṣpacandanakarkandhuphalais tandulamiśitaiḥ [taṇḍula-?] ||
dūrvāṅkurai ratnavaraiḥ phalair vastraiś ca pāṇḍuraiḥ |
mantreṇānena rājendra arghyaṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
[380] karkandhuphalāni badarāṇi |
navo navo ‘si māsānte jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
āpyāyasva samety evaṃ somarāja namo ‘stu te ||
anena vidhinā cārghyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
yaḥ prayacchati somāya māsi māsi samāhitaḥ ||
sarvakāmān avāpnoti dīrgham āyuś ca vindati |
datvārghyaṃ vipra sahitaḥ śālyannaṃ [śālyānnaṃ?] kṣīrasaṃyutam ||
naktaṃ bhuñjīta kaunteya prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ |
yuktaḥ sukīrtyā yaśasā kāntyā puṣṭyā ca mānavaḥ ||
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto godhānyadhanasaṃkulaḥ |
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye mṛtaḥ śaśipuraṃ vrajet ||
tatrāste divi dviyāṃs tu bhogān bhuñjan nṛpottamaḥ |
varastrībhiḥ sahātyarthaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam ||
sarvāṃ samṛddhim atulāṃ yadi vāñchati tvaṃ
māsānumāsam iha madvacanaṃ kuruṣva |
somasya somakulanandana candanādyair
arghyaṃ prayaccha navajātanavoditasya ||
iti bhaviṣyottare navoditacandrārghyadānavidhiḥ |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
imāṃ tathānyāṃ vakṣyāmi dvitīyāṃ sarvakāmadām |
[381] yām upoṣya naraḥ kāmān sarvān āpnoty abhīpsitān ||
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ saṃprāpya nṛpa mānavaḥ |
dināvasāne kurvīta samyak snānaṃ nadījale ||
bālendumaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā pūjayec chvetavarṇakaiḥ |
śvataiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiś caiva paramānnena bhūriṇā ||
ikṣuṇekṣuvikāraiś ca śubhreṇa lavaṇena ca |
dināvasāne deveśaṃ pūjayed vā niśākaram ||
atha vā maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gaganasthaṃ prapūjayet |
ghṛtena havanaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
nāmamantreṇa pūjāhomau tatas tailena pavitaṃ bhakṣayen na sa daivavat (?) | tailapakvaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ varjayet |
etad vrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā samyak saṃvatsaraṃ śuciḥ |
saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnoti svargalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
etat pavitraṃ riupnāśakāri
saubhāgyadaṃ rogaharaṃ ca rājan |
proktaṃ vrataṃ yādavavaṃśamukhya
kāryaṃ prayatnena tathā striyāpi ||
iti viṣṇudharmottare bālendradvitīyāvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
rūpaṃ surūpaṃ yo vāñchet saubhāgyaṃ pravarāḥ striyaḥ |
[382] kārttike śuklapakṣe tu dvitīyāyāṃ narādhipa |
puṣpāhāro varṣam ekaṃ vaset saniyatātmavān ||
kārttikaśuklapakṣadvitīyāyāṃ vratam ārabhyānyāsv api śuklapakṣadvitīyāsv eva varṣaparyantaṃ puṣpāhāro vrataṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
kālaprāptāni yāni syur haviṣyakusumāni tu |
bhuñjīta tāni datvā tu brāhmaṇebhyo nārādhipa ||
haviṣyakusumāni pūjārhāṇi bhakṣaṇe cāviruddhāni | aśvinau cātra nāmamantreṇa pūjanīyau tayoḥ phaladātṛtvena śravaṇāt |
suvarṇasya ca puṣpāṇi gavā saha dadāti yaḥ |
vratānte tasya saṃtuṣṭau devau tribhuvaneśvarau ||
dadyuḥ kāmāṃs tathā divyān vimānam api taijasam |
suciraṃ devanārībhir lokaṃ ramayatāśvinau ||
iha cāgatya kalpānte dvijo viprapuraskṛtaḥ |
vedavedāṅgavidvān syāt saptajanmāntarāṇy asau ||
dātā dāntamatir vāgmī ādhivyādhivivarjitaḥ |
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ saha patnyā ramec ciram ||
madhyadeśe suramye ca dharmiṣṭhe rājyabhāg bhavet |
kathitā te mayā tubhyaṃ dvitīyā puṣyasaṃjñitā ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ puṣyadvitīyāvratam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
santy etās tithayaḥ pārtha dvitīyādyāś ca viśrutāḥ |
māsaiś caturbhiś catasraḥ prāvṛṭkāle mahāmahāḥ ||
[383] gopatās tithayaḥ pārtha na proktāś ca mayā kvacit |
prakāśayāmi tāḥ samyak śruṇu sarvāḥ samāhitaḥ ||
prathamā śrāvaṇe māsi tathā bhādrapade parā |
tṛtīyāśvayuje māsi caturthī kārttike bhavet ||
śrāvaṇe kaluṣā nām tathā bhādre ca gor malā |
āśvine pretasaṃcārā kārttike yāmyakā matā ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kasmāt sā kaluṣā proktā kasmāt sā gor malā matā |
kasmāt sā pretasaṃcārā kasmād yāmyā prakīrtitā ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte prāptarājye purandare |
brahmahatyāpanodārtham aśvamedhe pravartite ||
krodhād indreṇa vajreṇa brahmahatyā nisūditā |
ṣaḍvidhā sā kṣitau kṣiptā vṛkṣatoyamahītale ||
nārī brahmaṇe vahno saṃvibhajya yathākramam |
tat pāpaṃ śrāvaṇe vyūḍhaṃ dvitīyāyāminodaye ||
nārī vṛkṣaṃ nadīṃ bhūmiṃ vahniṃ brahmahaṇaṃ tathā |
nirmalīkaraṇaṃ jātam atīrthaṃ kaluṣā smṛtā ||
madhukaiṭabhayorakte purā magnā hi medinī |
aṣṭāṅgulāpavitrāsmān nārīṇāṃ tu rajomalam ||
nadyo jalamalāḥ sarvā vahner dhūmaśikhāmalam |
kalaṣāṇiṃ caranty asyāṃ tenaiṣā kaluṣā matā ||
[384] caranti kṛtaprāyaścittān parityajya kṛtaprāyaścittān grahītuṃ vicaranti | ata eva tasyāṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kiṃcit prāyaścittaṃ kartavyam |
gīr girāṃ bhāratīvāṇī varā medhā sarasvatī |
gīr malaṃ vahate yasmād dvitīyā gīr malā matā ||
devarṣipitṛdharmāṇāṃ nindakā nāstikāḥ śaṭhāḥ |
teṣāṃ sā vāgmalaṃ vyūḍhā dvitīyā tena gīr malā ||
anadhyāyeṣu śāstrāṇi pāṭhayanti paṭhanti ca |
śābdikās tārkikāḥ śrautās teṣāṃ ye śabdajā malāḥ ||
te ca vyūḍhā dvitīyāyāṃ tato ‘rthaṃ gīr malā ca sā |
astas tasyāṃ sarasvatīpūjā kāryety arthaḥ |
pretās tu pitaraḥ proktās teṣāṃ tasyāṃ tu saṃcaraḥ ||
dvitīyāyāṃ ca lokeṣu tena sā pretasaṃcarā |
agniṣvattā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapās tathā ||
pitṝn pitāmahān pretān saṃcārāt pretasaṃcarāḥ |
putraiḥ pauraiś ca dauhitraiḥ svadhāmantrais tu pūjitāḥ ||
śrāddhadānamakhais tṛptā yānty ataḥ pretasaṃcarā |
atas tasyām api śrāddhaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ |
kārttike śuklapakṣasya dvitīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
yamo yamunayā pūrvaṃ bhojitaḥ svagṛhe sadā |
dvitīyāyāṃ mahotsarge nārakīyāś ca tarpitāḥ ||
pāpebhyo ‘pi vimuktās te muktāḥ sarvanibandhanāt |
[385] bhraṃśitāś cātisaṃtuṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ sarve yadṛcchayā ||
teṣāṃ mahotsavo vṛtto yamarāṣṭrasukhāvahaḥ |
ato yamadvitīyā sā proktā loke yudhiṣṭhira ||
asyāṃ nijagṛhe pārtha na bhoktavyam ato budhaiḥ |
snehena bahinīhastād bhoktavyaṃ puṣṭivardhanam ||
dānāni ca pradeyāni bhaginībhyo vidhānataḥ |
svarṇālaṃkāravastrāṇi pūjāsatkārabhojanaiḥ ||
sarvā bhaginyaḥ saṃpūjyā abhāve pratipannakāḥ |
pratipannakāḥ mitrabhaginya ity arthaḥ |
pitṛvyabhaginīhastāt prathamāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
mātulasya sutāhastād dvitīyāyāṃ tathā nṛpa |
pitur mātuḥ svasuḥ kanye tṛtīyāyāṃ tayoḥ karāt ||
bhoktavyaṃ sahajāyāyāś ca bhaginyā hastataḥ param |
pitṛvyabhaginī pitṛvyasaṃbandhena bhaginī pitṛvyakanyety arthaḥ |
sarvasvabhaginīhastād bhoktavyaṃ balavardhanam ||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ dharmakāmārthasādhakam |
vyākhyātaṃ sakalaṃ pārtha sarahasyaṃ mayā tava ||
yasyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājadevaḥ
saṃbhojitaḥ pratijagatsvasṛsauhṛdena |
tasyāṃ svasṛkaratalād iha yo bhunakti
[386] prāpnoti ratnaśubhagandhanam uttamaṃ saḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottare yamadvitīyāvratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
anantaraṃ dvitīyāyāṃ yat kāryaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva me |
sarvavidyāpradaṃ puṇyaṃ buddhiprabhavadoṣahṛt ||
susnātaḥ kṛtajpayaś ca kṛtapūrvāhnikakriyaḥ |
brahmacārī jitakrodho jitavākkāyamānasaḥ ||
maṇḍalaṃ caturasraṃ tu kuryāt taccheśataṇḍulaiḥ (?) |
tanmadhye ‘ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ vidhāya kusumotkaraiḥ ||
karṇikāyāṃ śriyaṃ devīṃ padmahastāṃ haripriyām |
padmānanāṃ padmanetrāṃ padmakiñjalkasaṃnibhām ||
sarasvatī ratir bhūtir dāntiḥ kāntiś ca sarvadā |
maitrī vidyeti cākhyātā divyās tāś cāṣṭaśaktayaḥ ||
taddaleṣu yathāyogaṃ nyased aṣṭasu yojitāḥ |
tattadādyarṇayuktena nāmamantreṇa pūjitāḥ ||
tattadādyarṇayogeneti tattannāmādivarṇakṛtamantreṇety arthaḥ yathā saṃ sarasvatyai nama iti evaṃ vakṣyamāṇeṣv api jñeyam |
prajñāṃ medhāṃ prabhāṃ satvām uttarasyām iti kramāt |
smared vidikṣu chāyādyā miśravarṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
[387] nandī dakṣo ‘ruṇaḥ siddha iti dikpatayaḥ kramāt |
viṣṇuḥ śeṣo rurūś caṇḍa iti koṇādhipāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
dvārapālā bahiś cāṣṭau dikṣu vai dvandvaśaḥ sthitāḥ |
dvandvaśaḥ diśi dvau dvau |
vakratuṇḍo mahādaṃṣṭro nīlajihvo bṛhacchirāḥ ||
krodhekṣaṇo dīptamukho dīptākṣaḥ kāla ity api |
śaṅkhapadmanidhī dikṣu paṅkajopari saṃsmaret ||
dikṣu pratidiśaṃ nidhidvayam |
vyāsaḥ kratur manur dakṣaś catvāro guravaḥ smṛtāḥ |
dikṣu ity anuvartate |
atrir dyumat kaviḥ kāṇḍa iti dikkoṇataḥ sthitāḥ ||
dikkoṇato vivikṣu (vidikṣu ?) |
vaśiṣṭo vāmadevaś ca jīmūtaś ca parāśaraḥ |
śāṇḍilako haraḥ kānto mitra ity api viśrutāḥ ||
evamādisusaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayet sudhīḥ |
candanāgurudhūpena śvetapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet ||
pāyasaṃ ca payaḥsiddhaṃ nivedya ca yathodayam |
śrīlatāpadmakusumaiḥ śvetapuṣpaiś ca taṇḍulaiḥ ||
phalapuṣpadalair bilvaiḥ nandyāvartaprasūnakaiḥ |
jātikeśarapuṣpaiś ca mallikācampakodbhavaiḥ ||
śrīlatā padminī, padmaṃ tu puṣpaṃ kusumaṃ tu kesaraṃ tayoḥ pṛthak-[388]grahaṇaṃ phalādhikyārtham | sitaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ nadyāvartaṃ tagaraṃ keśaro balukaḥ, mallīkā muhurakaḥ |
śrīvījena yathāyogam arcayed īśvarapriyām |
dvārapālān bahiś cāṣṭau dikṣu vai dvādaśasthitāḥ ||
vakratuṇḍo mahādaṃṣṭro nīlajihvo bṛhacchirāḥ |
krodhekṣaṇo dīptimukho dīprākṣaḥ kāla ity api ||
śaṅkhapadmanidhī dikṣu paṅkajopari saṃsmaran |
vyāsaḥ kratur munir dakṣaś catvāro guravaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
śaktīś ca tattanmantreṇa sarvatraivaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
prātar evaṃ vidhiḥ kāryo nāparāhne kadācana ||
evam abhyarcya vidhinā devīṃ śaktyādisaṃyutām |
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskārān stotrālāpādi kārayet ||
śrīsūktam anyasūktāni vaiṣṇavāni ca kīrtayet |
śrīsūktaṃ hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīm ityādi prasiddham | anyasūktāni puruṣasūktāni |
evaṃ samāpya vidhivat saparyām athānanyadhīḥ ||
gām aghanyām udakumbhaṃ ca gurubhyaḥ pratipādayet |
gām aghnyām iti gaur vṛṣaḥ, aghnyā dhenuḥ, vṛṣadhenū pratipādayed ity arthaḥ |
lājāpūrṇāni pātrāṇi tilapūrṇāni pañca ca ||
haridrācūrṇapūrṇāni yoṣid vā pratipādayet |
dadyāt kuṭumbine hema annaṃ hi kṣudhitāya ca ||
[389] atha vidyāpradaṃ śiṣyam ācāryam abhivādya ca |
dehi vidyāṃ prapannāyety arthayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
evam abhyarcitaḥ pūrvam ācāryo devasaṃnidhau |
vidyām upadiśet tasmai śiṣyāya vratacāriṇe ||
niyamo vidyādhigatikāraṇam |
samyag ukto mayā brahman yena pāramyam ṛcchati |
pāramyaṃ paramatā |
yo vidyā vā kulabhūtim uccaiḥ
prāptuṃ paraṃ vā paramasya puṃsaḥ |
itthaṃ dvitīyāniyamaprabhāva-
prāptātmavidyaḥ sa paraṃ sameti ||
iti gāruḍapurāṇoktaṃ vidyāvratam |
dadyāt sitadvitīyāyām indor lavaṇabhojanam |
samāpte goprado yāti viprāya śivamandiram ||
viprāya lavaṇabhojanaṃ dadyād ity anvayaḥ | somaś cātra devānāṃ somavratam idaṃ smṛtim iti somasya devatātvaṃ gamyate |
kalpānte rājarājasya somavratam idaṃ smṛtam |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ somavratam |
puṣkara uvāca |
pauṣaśukladvitīyāyāṃ gavāṃ śṛṅgodakena tu |
[390] snātvā śuklāmbaro bhūtvā sūryottas tam upāgate ||
bālendoḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
dīpadhūpanamaskārais tathā caivānnasaṃpadā ||
dadhnā ca paramānnena guḍena lavaṇena ca |
pūjanair brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjayitvā niśākaram ||
somarūpaṃ kāntidvitīyāyāṃ nāmamantreṇa pūjā yāvad astaṃ na yātīndus tāvad eva samācaret |
āhāraṃ gorasaprāyam adhaḥśāyī niśāṃ nayet |
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe somye māsi dvijottama ||
evam iti pratimāsaṃ śukladvitīyāyāṃ sūryacandrapūjanaṃ vidhinety arthaḥ | saumyo mārgaśīrṣaḥ |
bālendoḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvasmṛtiviśeṣataḥ |
vāsasī rasakuṃbhaṃ ca kāṇcanaṃ ca dvijātaye ||
datvā tu pūrvavad bhaktyā vratapāragato bhavet ||
pūjā bhojanaṃ pūjayet | vratārambha iti gorasaḥ kṣīrādi |
vratenānena dharmajño rogam evaṃ vyapohati |
saubhāgyam āpnoti tathā puṣṭiṃ ca manujottama ||
kāmaṃ samāpnoty atha caikam iṣṭaṃ
yaśas tathāgryaṃ pracuraṃ ca dharmam |
[391] abhyāsatas tasya samastakāmān
naras tathāpnoty atha vāpi nārī ||
iti viṣṇudharmotarārogyadvitīyāvratam
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
puruṣaḥ prakṛtiś cobhau jagat sarvaṃ prakīrtitam |
agnīṣomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ tathā tac ca prakīrtitam ||
vāsudevaś ca lakṣmīś ca tāv eva parikīrtitau |
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
puruṣeṇa ca sūktena vahniṃ saṃpūjayennaraḥ |
sopavāsa iti pratipadi kṛtopavāso dvitīyāyāṃ vahniṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ | upariṣṭāc ca kṣīraghṛtabhojanasya vihitatvāt |
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā ||
lakṣmīṃ ca varadaṃ devaṃ pūjayed udakaṃ harim |
śrīsūktena ca dharmajaña tathārcan manujottamam ||
harisomau vahniṃ jalakumbhaṃ ca pratihāpya puruṣam agniṃ vāsudevaṃ caikopari pūjayet |
kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām |
prāṇayātrāṃ budhaḥ kuryāt kṣīreṇa saghṛtena ca ||
prāṇayātrām iti prāṇanirvahaṇam |
saṃvatsaram idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ samyag upoṣitaḥ |
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati ||
[392] kāmān avāpnoty atha vāñchitāṃś ca
lokāṃś ca puṇyān vasudhāṃ samagrām |
virūpavān rūpam athāpi vāgryaṃ
yaśas tathāgraṃ tanayāṃś ca mukhyān ||
iti śrīviṣṇudharmottaroktaprakṛtipuruṣadvitīyāvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
nāsatyau devabhiṣajāv aśvinau parikīrtitau |
tāv eva kathitau loke sūryatārādhipau nṛpa ||
aśvayānaratau yasmād aśvinau parikīrtitau |
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
nāsatyau devabhiṣajau pūjayet prayataḥ śuciḥ |
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampradā ||
kṛtvā ca rūpanirmāṇaṃ nāsatyau pūjayen naraḥ |
nāsatyamūrtis tu viśvakarmoktā |
dvibhujau devabhiṣajau kartavyāv aśvavāhanau |
tayor oṣadhayaḥ kāryā divyā dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ||
vāmadoḥ pustakau kāryau darśanīyau tathā dvijāḥ |
dīpamālāṃ tathā dadyāt tayor niśi viśeṣataḥ ||
kanakaṃ rajataṃ cobhe dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām |
sa pūjya tatra yugalaṃ viṣṇoḥ saṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ ||
[393] pradīptatejā bhavati cakṣuṣmāṃś caiva jāyate |
prāṇayātrāṃ tu kurvīta dadhnā ghṛtayutena ca ||
netravrataṃ dvādaśa vatsarāṇi
kṛtvā bhaved bhūmipatiḥ pratītaḥ |
tataḥ surūpo ‘rigaṇapramāthī
dharmābhirāmo nṛpavargamukhyaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottare netravratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
vratakāṇḍe dvitīyāvratāni |
[394]
atha saptamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha tṛtīyāvratāni |
paropakārāya gṛhītasṛṣṭiḥ
sarvatra bhūteṣu samānadṛṣṭiḥ |
hemādrir ākyātipurāṇadṛṣṭaṃ
kṛtī tṛtīyāvratajātam iṣṭam ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
caitre bhādrapade māghe rūpasaubhāgyasaukhyadam |
tṛtīyātrayam etan me kṛṣṇa kasmān na kīrtitam ||
kim ahaṃ bhaktirahitaḥ trayīmārgātigo ‘tha vā |
suprasiddhaṃ jagaty etad gopitaṃ kena hetunā ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhavān dharmārthakuśalaḥ sarvajña iti me matiḥ |
vrataṃ caitaj jagatkhyātaṃ nākhyātaṃ tena te mayā ||
yady asti śravaṇe buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ kurunandana |
ko vā śrotā jagaty asmin bhavatā sadṛśo mama ||
[395] jayā ca vijayā caiva umāyāḥ paricārike |
āgatya munikanyābhiḥ pṛṣṭo ‘bhīṣṭaphalecchayā ||
bhavatyai sarvadā devyāś cittavṛttividau kila |
kena vratopavāsena kasminn ahani pārvatī ||
pūjitā toṣam āyāti mantraiḥ kaiścid varānane |
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jayā provāca sadaram ||
vratam utsavasaṃyuktaṃ naranārīmanoramam |
śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
caitre māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ dantadhāavanapūrvakam |
upavāsasya niyamān gṛhṇīyād bhaktibhāvataḥ ||
añjanaṃ ca satāmbūlaṃ sindūraṃ raktavāsasī |
bibhṛyāt sopavāsāpi avaidhavyakaraṃ param ||
vidhavā yatimārgeṇa kumārī ca yadṛcchayā |
kuryād āryārcanavidhiṃ śrūyatām atra ca kramaḥ ||
netrapadapaṭīvastraiḥ vastramaṇḍayikāṃ śubhām |
kārayet kusumāmodavāsitāṃ bhūṣitāṃ śūbhām ||
pravālālambitaprotām antardivyavitānakam |
vinyastapūrṇakalasāṃ pīṭhasaṃviṣṭasadvijām ||
purataḥ kārayet kuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ samekhalam |
yataḥ snātvā śucir bhūtvā paridhāya suvāsasī ||
devān pitṝn samabhyarcya tato devīgṛhaṃ vrajet |
[396] nāmāṣṭakena saṃpūjya gaurī gobhartṛvallabhān ||
nāmāṣṭakena vakṣyamāṇena, gobhartṛvallabhān vṛṣadhvajavallabhān |
tatkālaprabhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ gandhādalikulākulaiḥ |
kuṅkumena samālabhya karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat sudhūpenādhivāsayet |
pārvatī lalitā gaurī gāyatrī śaṅkarī śivā ||
umā satī samuddiṣṭaṃ nāmāṣṭakam idaṃ sadā |
laḍḍūkaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiś ca guṇakaiḥ siṃhakeśaraiḥ ||
somālaṅkaiś cekṣurasaiḥ dadhibhaktaiḥ sapūpakaiḥ |
ghṛtapakvair bahuvidhaiḥ śucibhiḥ parikalpayet ||
dṛṣṭiprāṇapriyair hṛdyair naivedyaiḥ pūjayed umām |
siṃhakesaraiḥ siṃhakesaravad valitākṛtibhiḥ |
dhānyakaṃ jīrakaṃ bhavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ lavaṇaṃ guḍam |
kusumbhaṃ vekṣukāṇḍaṃ ca haridrāṃ ca puro nyaset ||
bhavyam utkṛṣṭam |
nālikerasanāraṅgaṃ bījapūraṃ ca dāḍimam |
kuṣmāṇḍaṃ trapusaṃ vṛttaṃ dadhitthaṃ panasaṃ tathā ||
vṛttaṃ vṛttavat nātipakvam ity arthaḥ | trapusam karkaṭīphalaṃ dadhitthaṃ kapittham |
kālodbhavāny athānyāni phalāni purato nyaset |
yantrakolūkhalaśilāsūrpāṇāntatibhiḥ saha ||
[397] netrāñjanaṃ śalākāṃ ca nakhasādhanakāri ca |
darpaṇaṃ vimalaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ bhavānyai vinivedayet ||
śaṅkhatūryaninādaiś ca gītamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ |
bhaktyā śaktyā ca saṃpūjya devīṃ śaṅkaravallabhām ||
tato ‘stasamaye bhānoḥ kumāryaḥ karakair navaiḥ |
snānaṃ kuryur mudāyuktāḥ saubhāgyabhāgyavṛddhaye ||
kumārya iti vracārilīnām upalakṣaṇam |
yāme yāme gate snānaṃ devīpūjanam eva ca |
tair eva nāmabhir homas tilājyena praśasyate ||
padmāsanasthitā sādhvī tenaivārdreṇa vāsasā |
gaurīvaktrekaṇaparā tāṃ rātrim ativāhayet ||
kāścid gāyanti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ kāścin nṛtyanti harṣitāḥ |
kathayanti kathāḥ kāścid dharmakāmārthasaṃśrayāḥ ||
gītatālānusaṃbaddham anuddhatam anākulam |
nṛtyanti ca puro devyāḥ kāścid vintusitabhruvaḥ (?) ||
nṛtyena tuṣyanti haro gaurī gītena tuṣyati |
sadbhāvenātha vā sarve gṛṇanti tridivaukasaḥ ||
suvāsinībhyas tāmbūlaṃ kuṅkumaṃ kusumāni ca |
pradeyaṃ jāgaravatām anyeṣām atha vāritam ||
naṭair viṭair bhaṭaiś ceṭaiḥ preraṇaiḥ prekṣaṇotsavaiḥ |
sakhībhiḥ saha tāṃ rātriṃ gītanṛtyasahair nayet ||
evaṃ prabhātasamaye snātvā saṃpūjya pārvatīm |
[398] śaktyā tulāṃ samārohed vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitām ||
tolayet śitayātmānaṃ sitena lavaṇena ca |
śitayā śarkarayā |
kuṅkumenātha vā śaktyā karpūrāgurcandanaiḥ |
parvatānām apīcchanti dānaṃ kecic ca sūrayaḥ ||
kuṇḍamaṇḍapasaṃbhāramantrair atraivam eva tat |
lavaṇena sahātmānaṃ tolayantyā guḍena ca ||
kayāpi śaktiparayā saubhāgyam atulīkṛtam |
evaṃ devīṃ praṇamyātha kṣamāpya gṛham āviśet ||
āmantrya dvijadampatyaṃ vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā |
saṃpūjya bhojayitvā ca dadyāt tebhyo ‘pi dakṣiṇām ||
yad yad ātmābhīṣṭatamaṃ śayanaṃ yānam eva ca |
vastram ābharaṇaṃ gāvaḥ sarvaṃ tebhyo nivedayet ||
haimaṃ patraṃ ratnaphalaṃ muktācūrṇāvacūrṇitam |
tāmbūlaṃ kecid icchanti dīyamānaṃ sakhījane ||
patrasthāne suvarṇaṃ patrāṇi, pūgaphalasthāne ratnāni | cūrṇasthāne muktāphalāni evaṃvidhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ sakhījane deyam |
anamlaṃ madhuraprāyaṃ bhojayitvā suvāsinī |
svayaṃ bhuñjīta sahitā jñātibandhujanaiḥ svakaiḥ ||
yac ca devyāḥ puro dattaṃ naivedyādi suśobhanam |
pratigehaṃ nayet sarvaṃ vibhajyāśrāntamānasā ||
[399] dantavāyanakaṃ divyaṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavet tataḥ |
vāyanakaṃ vāyanam iti loke |
vidhir bhādrapade hy eṣa sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ ||
saptadhānyavidhibhyaś ca sūrpasthāṃ pūjayed umām |
pūrṇakalaśasthāne sūrpam iti śeṣaḥ |
gomūtraṃ prāśanaṃ yasmāt tasmād gomūtrasaṃjñitā ||
māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ śrūyatāṃ mayā |
pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte yavasaṃstare ||
sthāpayitvā kundapuṣpaiḥ pūjayet sasutām umām |
etena kāraṇenoktā caturthī kundasaṃjñitā ||
pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛtvā prabhāta iti caturthidivase | sasutāṃ vināyakasahitām umāṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
umārūpaṃ tu kartavyaṃ saudhāsanagataṃ śubham |
sauvarṇaṃ ca mahārāja sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalum ||
vināyakaś ca kartavyo gajavaktraś caturbhujaḥ |
tṛtīyātrayam etat te kathitaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
jayayā munikanyānāṃ yat purā samudāhṛtam |
evaṃ vā kāpi kurute nārī vratam idaṃ śubham ||
sā rūpasaubhāgyayutā mṛtā svarge mahīyate |
na durbhagā kule tasyāḥ kācid bhavati bhārata ||
[400] na durvinītaś ca suto na bhṛtyo vighnakṛd bhavet |
na dāridraṃ gṛhe tasmin na vyādhir upajāyate ||
yatra sā ramate nārī dhautacāmīkaraprabhā |
anyāś ca yāś cariṣyanti brāhmaṇānumate vratam ||
saṃpūjya vācakaṃ bhaktyā bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ |
tās tāḥ syuḥ sukhasaṃpannā avipannamanorathāḥ ||
bhaviṣyanti kuruśreṣṭha kulajyeṣṭha namo ‘stu te |||
māghe mahārhamaṇimaṇḍitapādapīṭhām
caitre vicitrakusumotkaracarcitāṅgīm |
sūryaprarūḍhanavaśaṣyamayīṃ nabhasye
saṃpūjya śambudayitāṃ prabhavanti nāryaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottare caitrabhādramāghatṛtīyāvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bahunātra kim uktena kiṃ bahvakṣaramālayā |
vaiśākasya sitām ekāṃ tṛtīyām akṣayāṃ śṛṇu ||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam |
dānaṃ ca kriyate kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ syād ihākṣayam ||
ādiḥ kṛtayugasyeyaṃ yugādis tena kathyate |
sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvasaukhyapradāyinī ||
[401] purā mahodaye pārtha vaṇig āsīt sunardhanaḥ |
priyaṃvadaḥ satyavṛttir devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ ||
puṇyākhyānaikacitto ‘bhūt kuṭumbavyākulo ‘pi san |
tena śrutā vācyamānā tṛtīyā rohiṇīyutā ||
yadā syād budhasaṃyuktā tadā sā sumahatphalā |
tasyāṃ yad dīyate kiṃcid akṣayaṃ syāt tad eva hi ||
iti śrutvā sa gaṅgāyāṃ saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ |
gṛham āgatya karakān sānnān udakasaṃyutān ||
apsu pūrṇān bṛhatkumbhān jalena vimalena ca |
yavagodhūmacaṇakān saktudadhyodanaṃ tathā ||
ikṣukṣīravikārāṃś ca sahiraṇyāṃś ca śaktitaḥ |
śuciḥ śuddhena manasā brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vaṇik ||
annodakābhyāṃ udakena annena ca pūrṇān kalaśān apsu jalamadhye pūrṇān na tūddhṛtodakena |
bhāryayā vāryamāṇo ‘pi kuṭumbāsakticittayā |
tāvat tasthau sthite sā ca matvā sarvaṃ vinaśvaram ||
dharmāsaktamatiḥ pārtha kālena bahunā tataḥ |
jagāma pañcatvam asau vāsudevam anusmaran ||
tataḥ sa kṣatriyo jātaḥ kuśāvatyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
babhūva cākṣayā tasya samṛddhir dharmasaṃyutā ||
iyāja sa mahāyajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ |
sadā dau gohiraṇyādidānāny anyāny aharniśam ||
bubhuje kāmato bhogān dīnāndhāṃs tarpayañ chanaiḥ |
[402] tathāpy akṣayam evāsya kṣayaṃ yānti na taddhanam ||
śraddhāpūrvaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ yad dattaṃ vibhavaṃ vinā |
ity etat te samākhyātaṃ śrūyatām atra yo vidhiḥ ||
tṛtīyāntāṃ samāsādya snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ |
ekabhaktaṃ tadā kuryād vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ||
udakumbhān sakanakān sānnān sarvarasaiḥ saha |
graiṣmakaṃ sarvam evātra śasyaṃ dāne praśasyate ||
chatropanatpradānaṃ vai gobhūkāñcanavāsasām |
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ cānyat tad deyam aviśaṅkayā ||
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ kim anyac chrotum icchasi |
anākhyeyaṃ na me kiṃcid asti svasty astu te ‘nagha ||
asyāṃ tithau kṣayam upaiti hutaṃ na dattaṃ
tenākṣayeti kathitā munibhis tṛtīyā |
uddiśya yat surapitṝn kriyate manuṣyais
tac cākṣayaṃ bharatabhārata sarvam eva ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam akṣayatṛtīyāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kena dharmeṇa nārīṇāṃ vratena niyamena ca |
saubhāgyaṃ jāyate ‘tīva putrāś ca bahavaḥ śubhāḥ ||
[403] dhanadhānyam hiraṇyaṃ ca vastrālaṃkāram eva ca |
aviyonaś ca satataṃ bhartṛputraiḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ ||
samyag ākhyāhi me kṛṣṇa dayātīva hi te mayi ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi vrānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yac cīrtvā subhagā nārī bahvapatyā ca jāyate ||
dhanadhānyahiraṇyādidāsīdāsaiḥ samanvitā |
loke hitārthaṃ pārvatyā umāmāheśvaravratam ||
samākhyātaṃ purā pārtha nādyāpi prathitaṃ bhuvi |
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ samāhitā ||
kṛtopavāsā rājendra sarvabhogavivarjitā |
saṃveṣṭya śvetavastreṇa śivaṃ raktena cāmbikām ||
paścād dhūpaṃ dahen nārī bhaktibhāvena bhāvitā |
bhojayec chivabhaktāṃś ca brāhmaṇān vedapāragān ||
bhaktebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād bhaktyā śāṭhyaṃ vinā kṛtām |
kṛtopavāsā saṃkalpitopavāsā |
snātvā saṃpūjya lalitāṃ harakāyārdhavāsinīm |
gītavādyādikaṃ kṛtvā kṣapayitvā kṣitau kṣaṇam ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye snānaṃ cākṛtrime jale |
dhṛtvā śuklāmbaraṃ nārī vākyam etad udīrayet ||
namo namas te deveśa umādehārdhadhāraka |
mahādeva namas tubhyaṃ harakāyārdhavāsinīm ||
[404] hṛdi kṛtvā śivaṃ devī japet yāvad gṛhaṃ vrajet |
pūjayed devam īśānaṃ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhaves tataḥ ||
vāmapārśve sthitāṃ devīṃ dakṣiṇe tu maheśvaram |
dhūpaṃ sagugguluṃ cāgne dahed dhyānaparāyaṇā ||
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtapakvaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
kārayed vaiśvadevaṃ tu tilājyena susaṃskṛtam ||
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya havyaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyatā |
evaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃs tu pūjayitvā maheśvarau ||
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā |
śivaṃ raupyamayaṃ kuryād umāṃ hemamayīṃ tathā ||
ārūḍho (?) vṛṣabhe gaurī sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā |
candanena śivaṃ carcya (?) kuṅkumena tu pārvatīm ||
arcayet kuśumaiḥ paścāt sugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mantram etad udīrayet ||
umāmāheśvarau devau sarvalokapitāmahau |
vratenānena suprītau bhavatāṃ mama sarvadā ||
evam uktvā jitakrodhā brāhmaṇe vedapārage |
vrataṃ nivedayed bhyaktyā vācake vā guṇānvite ||
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī maheśārpitamānasā |
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devī śivapriyā ||
tatraiva sā vaset tāvad yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtā kinnarobhis tathaiva ca ||
[405] yadā mānuṣatāṃ yāti jāyate vimale kule |
nṛpa saukhye samāpnoti putrapautrasutādibhiḥ ||
mṛtā śivapuraṃ yāti śivayā saha modate |
haimīm umāṃ rajatapiṇḍamayaṃ maheśam
rapye surūpavṛṣabhe samupasthitau tau |
saṃpūjya raktasitavastrayugopagūḍho
nārī bhavaty avidhavā sutasaukhyayuktā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam umāmāheśvaravratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāsu bahavaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ |
ānantaryavrataṃ brūhi tṛtīyobhayasaṃyutā ||
hitāya vrataśīlānāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
nāmaprāśananaivedyaṃ māsi māsi pṛthagividham ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyair yan noktaṃ surasattamaiḥ |
apūrvasarvatantrāṇām ānantaryavrataṃ śṛṇu ||
mārgaśīrṣe mahārāja vratam etat samārabhet |
naktaṃ kuryād dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyām upoṣitā ||
[406] umāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ kramāt |
śarkarāputrikāṃ dadyād yathāśāktyā ca bhaktitaḥ ||
dadhi saṃprāśayed rātrau svaped ekākinī bhuvi |
prabhāte vidhivad vipra mithunaṃ bhojayen nṛpa ||
aśvamedhaphalāvāptir jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
yajet kātyāyinīṃ nāma nārikelaṃ nivedayet |
kṣīraṃ prāśya svaped rātrau kāmakrodhavivarjitā ||
bhojayed dvijadāmpatyaṃ gomedhaphalam āpnuyāt |
pauṣamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
gorīṃ nāmnā tu saṃpūjya khaṇḍavartiṃ nivedayet |
kaṇḍavartiḥ śarkarā (?) nirmito valitākṛtir bhakṣaḥ |
tataḥ kuśodakaṃ prāśya svaped bhūmau jitendriyaḥ |
prabhāte rūpasaṃpannaṃ mithunaṃ bhojayet tataḥ ||
kṣamāpya taṃ namaskṛtya bahusvarṇaphalaṃ labhet |
punar eva tulāmāghe kṛṣṇapakṣe yatavratā ||
āryāṃ nāmnātha saṃpūjya svādyakaṃ ca nivedayet |
svādyakaṃ svatikādi |
madhuṃ pṛāpya svaped rātrau sarvabhogavivarjitā |
mithunaṃ bhojayitvā tu vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ||
tathaiva phālgune māsi sopavāsā śucivratā |
[407] bhavyāṃ nāmnā prapūjyātha kāsāṅkhaṃ vinivedayet |
śarkarāṃ prāśayitvā tu svaped rātrau vimatsarā ||
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ labhet |
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ phālgunasyaiva bhārata ||
viśālākṣīṃ samabhyarcya pūrikāṃ vinivedayet |
saṃprāśya taṇḍulajalaṃ svaped rātrau manasvinī ||
bhojayen mithunaṃ prātar agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
caitrasyāditṛtīyayāṃ suciḥ snātā jitendriyā ||
śriyaṃ nāmnā tu saṃpūjya vaṭakān vinivedayet |
bilvapatraṃ tataḥ prāśya svaped dhyānaparāyaṇā ||
tataḥ prabhātre vimale dvijadāmpatyapūjanāt |
praṇipātāc ca tasyaiva rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ caitre samyag upoṣitā |
kālīṃ nāmnā tu saṃpūjya piṣṭaṃ prāśya svaped niśi ||
pūpakān vinivedyātha kuryād janmakathāṃ śubhām |
bhaktyā saṃbhojya mithunam atirātraphalaṃ labet ||
evaṃ vaiśākhamāsaṃ tu sopavāsā jitendriyā |
pūjayec caṇḍikāṃ devīṃ madhukāryā nivedayet ||
madhukāryā madhukapūraṇapūrikāḥ |
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ niśhi saṃprāśya svaped devyagrato bhuvi |
bhojayitvā ca dapyatvaṃ cāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ labet ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā vimatsarā |
[408] pūjayet kālarātriṃ tu puṣpadhūpair manoramaiḥ ||
guḍāḍhyaṃ yāvakaṃ datvā tilān prāsya svapen niśi |
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyam atikṛcchraphalaṃ labhet ||
jyaiṣṭhe sitatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā yatavratā |
skandamāteti saṃpūjya indrajyoti nivedayet ||
prāśayet pañcagavyaṃ ca devīṃ dhyātvā svapen niśi |
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya kanyādānaphalaṃ labhet ||
āṣāḍhamāse saṃprāpte tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
nāmnā yaśodharāṃ devīṃ pūjayed bhaktitatparaḥ ||
karambhakaṃ ca naivedyaṃ gośṛṅgābhiḥ piben niśi |
karambhakaṃ dadhimiśrā śaktavaḥ |
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ kuṣmāṇḍīṃ nāma pūjayet |
saktūn khaṇḍājyasaṃyuktān purato vinivedayet ||
kumbhodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya svaped devyāḥ puraḥ kṣitau |
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya gopradānaphalaṃ labhet ||
śrāvaṇe sopavāsātha caṇḍaghaṇḍāṃ prapūjayet |
kulmāṣāṃs tatra naivedyaṃ pibet puṣpodakaṃ niśi ||
kulmāṣāḥ ardhasvinnāni dhānyāni |
prabhāte bhaktito vipra mithunaṃ bhojayen nṛpa |
dvijānām aviduṣāṃ prāṇatrāṇaphalaṃ labhet ||
[409] tadvat kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ rudrāṇīṃ nāma pūjayet |
siddhapiṇḍāni divyāni naivedyaṃ saṃpradāpayet ||
siddhapiṇḍāni piṇḍīkṛtāḥ saktavaḥ |
piṇyākaṃ prāśayitvā tu svaped rātrau vimatsarā |
saṃpūjya dvijadāmpatyam iṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ labhet ||
tathā bhādrapadasyādau tṛtīyāyām upoṣitā |
puṣpair nānāvidhair havyaiḥ pūjayet kamalāmayām ||
karṇāvartaṃ tato devyā naivedyaṃ palalācitam |
karṇāvartaṃ varṇyākṛtibhakṣaḥ palalaṃ tilapiṣṭam |
gandhodakaṃ tataḥ prāśya svapet saṃhṛṣṭamānasā ||
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya grāmadānaphalaṃ labhet |
tadvat kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ durgāṃ devīṃ samarcayet ||
dadyān nandīphalaṃ devyā guḍājyaparipūritam |
nandīphalaṃ nandīvṛkṣaphalam |
prāśayitvā ca gomūtraṃ svapet kāntena cetasā ||
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya sadā satraphalaṃ labhet |
māsi cāśvayuje bhaktyā nāmnā nārāyaṇīṃ yajet ||
sopavāsā khaṇḍakhādyaṃ naivedyaṃ parikalpayet |
khaṇḍakādyaṃ śarkarānirmitaṃ khādyam |
saṃprāśya candanaṃ raktaṃ naktaṃ svapyāt tadāgrataḥ ||
prabhāte dvijadāmpatyaṃ bhojayitvā pativratā |
nidādhe nirjale mārge prapādānaphalaṃ labhet ||
[410] tathā kṛṣṇa tṛtīyāyāṃ svasti tāmrā (?) prapūjayet |
śālyodanaṃ guḍopetaṃ naivedyaṃ vinivedayet ||
kusumbhabījayoyaṃ ca saṃprāśya prayataḥ svapet |
saṃbhojya mithunaṃ prātar agnihotraphalāptaye ||
kārttikasya tṛtīyāyāṃ svāhā nāma prapūjayet |
pāyasaṃ ghṛtakhaṇḍādyaṃ naivedyam upakalpayet ||
svaped rātrau jitakrodhā prāśya kuṅkumajaṃ jalam |
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
atīva durdhare varṣe navāhnikaphalaṃ labhet |
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā kṛtavratā ||
vijñāpya svaguruṃ bhaktyā dharmaśāstrārthakovidam |
maṇḍalaṃ ca tato likhya navanābhaṃ varapradam ||
sauvarṇaṃ kārayed devam umayā sahitaṃ śivam |
tebhyo netreṣu dātavyaṃ mauktikaṃ tilam eva ca ||
pravālam oṣṭhayor dadyāt karṇayor eva kuṇḍale |
upavītaṃ tu devasya devyā hāraṃ samujjvalam ||
raktāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ sitavastraṃ maheśvaram |
candanena samālabhya puṣpair dhūpaiḥ samarcayet ||
maṇḍalaṃ pūjayitvā ca homaṃ kuryāt tato guruḥ |
tatrāparājitāṃ nāmnā devīṃ bhaktyā prapūjayet ||
madhūdakaṃ ca saṃprāśya kuryād rātrau ca jāgaram |
jayayādyutsavopetaṃ vīṇāveṇamanoharam ||
[411] māṅgalyagītaninadaiḥ prekṣaṇair atiśobhitam |
tāmbūlāśanasindūrapuṣpakuṅkumadīpakaiḥ ||
sakhījanaiḥ suveśaś ca samantāt paripūjitam |
utsavaṃ kārayitvetthaṃ nayed rātriṃ vimatsarā ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛtakautukamaṅgalā |
kṛtvā tu nūnanāṃ tūlīṃ kandukādisamanvitām ||
maṇḍale devam uddhṛtya paryaṅkopari vinyaset |
vitānadhvajamālābhiḥ kumbhadarpaṇaśobhanā ||
puṣpamaṇḍayitāṃ kṛtvā dhūpagugguluvāsitā |
tasyāgre bhojayed bhaktyā mithunāni yathecchayā ||
prīṇayed bhakṣyabhojyaiś ca pakkānnair [pakvānnair?] madhurai rasaiḥ |
tato datvā kṛtaṃ haste tāmbūlaṃ candanaṃ tathā ||
idam uccārayen nāmnā devasya ca puro guroḥ |
prīyatāṃ me umākāntaḥ pārvatyā sahitas tadā ||
ucchiṣṭaṃ śodhayitvā ca tato bhojyasamanvitām |
raktavarṇāṃ suśīlāṃ ca surūpāṃ supayasvinīm ||
śṛṅgābhyāṃ dattakanakāṃ rājatakhurasaṃyutām |
kāṃsyadohanakopetāṃ raktavastrāṃ ca guṇṭhitām ||
ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ sitacandanacarcitām |
pūjitāṃ puṣpamālābhiḥ devasya purataḥ sthitām ||
pādukopānahachatrabhakṣyabhojanasaṃyutām |
tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guroḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet ||
punaś codāhared devaṃ guror agre kṛtavratā |
[412] umāmaheśvaraṃ yadvad aviyogaṃ surārcitam |
aviyogaḥ svabhartā me tadvad astu susaṃpadā ||
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau kṣamasveti guruṃ vadet |
evaṃ samāpyate samyag ānantaryavratottamam ||
yaḥ kuryāt puruṣaḥ strī vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
gandharvayakṣasiddhānāṃ vidyādharamahoragaiḥ ||
devadaityamunīnāṃ ca kanyābhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
kāmagena vimānena krīḍayitvā yathepsitam ||
samuddhṛtya kulaṃ bhartuḥ pituś cāmarapūjitā |
brahmādibhir anukrāntā viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam ||
prayāti puruṣo vāpi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
bhuktvā bhogāṃs tato divyān puṇyaśeṣeṇa pārthiva |
pārthivo jāyate bhūmau śārvabhaumo ‘parājitaḥ ||
nārī vā mahiṣī rājñaḥ sarvabhaumasya jāyate |
taretarpaṃ yathā devī bhogāṃś ca patinā saha |
trailokyapatinā bhuṅkte tathā svapatinā tu sā ||
hariḥ śacyā harir lakṣmyā samaṃ patnyā yathāsukham |
bhuṅkte nirantaraṃ tadvat tayā sārdhaṃ nareśvara ||
muninārundhatī yad vasatāṃ sannā hṛdi sthitā |
tadvad bhunakti saubhāgyaṃ nairantaryeṇa pāṇḍava ||
yenaiva patinā sārdhaṃ karoty etad vratottamam |
saptajanmani tenaiva na viyogam avāpnuyāt ||
etat te samyag ākhyātam ānantaryavrataṃ mahat |
[413] bhakto ‘si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayā ||
nāvinītāya dātavyaṃ nābhaktāya kathaṃcana |
nāstike haituke pāpe dātā bhavati kilbiṣī ||
eṣā viśeṣavidhinā sahasā tṛtīyā
yāno karoty avidhavābhir udāhṛtoccaiḥ |
etām upoṣya vidhivat pratipakṣayogān
naivāntaraṃ sutasuhṛtsvajanair upeiti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam ānantarytṛtīyāvratam |
udhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kimarthaṃ madhuvṛkṣastham arcayanti varastriyaḥ |
gaurīṃ jagadguror bhāryāṃ bhgavaṃs tad bravīṣi me ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā kṣīrodamathane madhuvṛkṣo vinirgataḥ |
sa ihāropito martyair madhunā munikāraṇāt ||
viṣadarthopahārāya vyādhisaṃghavadhāya ca |
strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadānāya yatra puṣpaphalārcitaḥ ||
śobhitastavakai ramyaiḥ dṛṣṭo lalitayā vane |
tatrāśritā mahādevī pārvatī śaṅkarapriyā ||
vijayā jayā gaṇeśena saṃyutā parvatātmajā |
tatrasthā devatābhiḥ sā pūjitā kusumaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
bhakṣair bahuvidhai rājan manasepstitakāraṇāt |
[414] svayaṃ lakṣmyā sarasvatyā sāvitryā gaṅgayā tathā ||
rohiṇyā rambhayā rājan arundhatyā suśīlayā |
strībhir etābhir āgatya pūjitā mūlaśaṅkarī ||
tāsāṃ prasannā varadā dadāv abhimataṃ phalam |
phālgunasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyām upoṣitā ||
snātā sthitā brahmacarye tato ‘nyasmin dine punaḥ |
vrajen madhuvanaṃ gaurīṃ pūjayed yatamānasā ||
mantreṇānena dhyāyantī pārvatīpratimāṃ śubhām |
mṛgājināvṛtakucāṃ jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitām ||
godhārathagatāṃ devīṃ rudradhyānaparāyaṇām |
pūjayet gandhakusumair dīpālaktakacandanaiḥ ||
kesarair madhuradravaiḥ svarṇamāṇikyasaṃyutaiḥ |
ambikā ṛṣikā devī mūṣikā lalitā umā ||
tapovanaratā gaurī saubhāgyaṃ me prayacchatu |
kālī kāsī satī devī rudrāṇī pārvatī śivā ||
aṣṭāṅgaiḥ praṇatā bhaktyā patiputrān prayacchatu |
saubhāgyaṃ me prayacchantu suprasannānanāḥ sadā ||
avaidhavyakule janma dadātu pratijanmani |
aṅgapratyaṅgadeśeṣu pratiparvasthitāmṛtā ||
sukhadṛṣṭisparśarasaṃ gaurī saubhāgyam ṛcchatu |
evam uccārya mantreṇa nārī jñānavatī satī ||
pūjayed brāhmaṇīnāṃ ca bhavyā mukhyāḥ suvāsinī |
[415] kusumbair jīrakaiś caiva lavaṇair guḍasarpiṣā ||
adyai rāgaiḥ phalaiś cūrṇair manojñaiś ca sucandanaiḥ |
adyaiḥ bhakṣaiḥ cūrṇapakvaiḥ, rāgaiḥ puṣpacandanaiḥ campakādipuṣpavāsitaiś candanaiḥ | kāleyaṃ pītacandanaṃ candanam, śvetacandanam |
sindūreṇābhiraktena vastrair nānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
pavitrakaiḥ pītavarṇaiḥ pūpakais tilatandulaiḥ ||
aśaukavartiguṇakaiḥ ghṛtapūraiḥ maladrukaiḥ ||
aśaukavartir bhakṣaviśeṣaḥ pūjayitvā mahādrumaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām |
etad vrataṃ samākhyātaṃ kāṃsyāyena purā nṛpa ||
yāś cariṣyanti sarvās tā bhaviṣyanti nirāmayāḥ |
aṅgapratyaṅgasugabhā loke dṛṣṭimanoharāḥ ||
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye tato rudrapuraṃ śubham |
yāsyanti haṃsayānena kiṅkīṇīśabdanādinā ||
tatra gatvā ramiṣyanti kalpam ekaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
punar abhyāgatā martye sarvasaukhyakabhājanā ||
nāryo bhavanti saṃpūjyā madhuvṛkṣaṃ suśobhanam |
arghyaṃ mahārghyamaṇikuṅkumakesarāḍhyam ||
paryaṅkaṃ lubdhaḥ sukharālikulopagītam ||
datvā phalākṣatayutaṃ madhupādapasya
gaurīva kāmasadṛśā bhavatīha nārī |
[416]
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ madhūkavratam ¦
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
meghapālīvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kadācit kriyate nṛbhiḥ |
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kum anuṣṭhānaṃ kīdṛd (?) vallī smṛtā tu sā ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
āśvayukśuklapakṣe ca tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
meghapālī pradātavyā bhaktyā strībhir nṛbhis tathā ||
arceḥ virūḍhair godhūmaiḥ saptadhānyasamanvitaiḥ |
tilataṇḍulamiśraiś (?) ca dātavyā dharmalipsubhiḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kīdṛśīṃ sā bhaved vallī meghapālī janārdana |
lakṣaṇaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasyāḥ ko mantra iti me vada ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
tāmbūlasadṛśaiḥ patrai raktāvallī samañjarī |
vāṭīṣu yā na margeṣu prekṣitā parvateṣu vā ||
yata vā dṛśyate rājan śucau deśe samutthitā |
meghapālo samabhyarcya phalaiḥ puṣpais tathākṣataiḥ ||
kharjūrair nālikeraiś ca nāraṅgair daḍimais tathā |
bījapūraiḥ kapitthaiś ca saptadhānyair virūḍhakaiḥ ||
[417] trapusīrvyācīnakais tu piṇḍais tu tilapiṣṭajaiḥ |

trapusambālakam īrvā, karkaṭī cīnakaṃ prasiddham ||
tatas taiḥ prathame pātre dūrvādadhisamanvitam |
tilataṇḍulamiśraṃ tu candanena sugandhinā ||
sugandhair jātipuṣpaiś ca phalair karkandhukar api |
kṛtvārcanaṃ pradātavyaṃ mantreṇānena bhārata ||
anena bhadrā iti japen mantraṃ vedoktam ādarāt |
strīśūdraiḥ pūjayet tāṃ ca namaskāreṇa bhārata ||
ity evaṃ pūjayitvā tāṃ meghapālīṃ pumāṃs tataḥ |
nārī vā puruṣavyāghra prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ||

anyajāni apaṇyajāni, avikreyajāni |

yo ‘rghaṃ phalāt śubhatanur nanu meghapālyai |
unmādakūṭakapaṭāni kṛtāni yāni
pāpāni hanti svateva bhavapradoṣāt ||
iti bhaviṣuottaroktameghapālīyatṛtīyāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
[418] aham anyac ca pṛcchāmi vrataṃ dvādaśamāsikam |
lalitārādhanaṃ nāma kīdṛkmāsakrameṇa tu ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pāṇdava yat tena yathā vrataṃ purātanam |
śaṅkarasya mahādevyāḥ saṃvādaṃ puṇyavardhanam ||
kailāsaśikhare ramye bahupuṣpaphalākule |
tatra devī svabhartāraṃ jagadbhartāram abravīt ||
devy uvāca |
svāmin lokopakārāya mama prītivivṛddhaye |
kathayasva prayatnena tṛtīyāvratam uttamam ||
bhaktās trayo hi māṃ devaṃ pūjayanti sadā bhivi |
durbhāgā niraparyāś ca puruṣā nirdhanās tathā ||
ārtiṃ tāsāṃ paricchettum ataḥ pṛcchāmy ahaṃ vibho |
yena tāḥ sukhasaṃyogarūpalāvaṇyasaṃpadā ||
putrasaubhāgyavittaughaiḥ prayuktāḥ surasattama |
tan me kathaya yatnena nūnaṃ nārīsukhavratam ||
īśvara uvāca |
māghamāse site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ yatavratā |
pādau prakṣālya hastau ca mukhaṃ caiva samāhitaḥ ||
upavāsaṃ ca niyamaṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
[419] madhyāhne tu nadīṃ gatvā tilair āmalakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
snātvottīrya jalāt śukle vāsasī paridhāya ca |
sugandhaiś ca supuṣpaiś ca manojñaiḥ kuṅkumādibhiḥ ||
arcayīta tathā devīṃ tvāṃ bhaktyā bhaktivatsale |
karpūrādyaiḥ sugandhaiś ca naivedyaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ ||
yathā vibhavasaṃpannair gītavādyair manoramaiḥ |
īśānī nāma jalpantī praticched ghaṭikājalam ||
pātraṃ tāmramayaṃ śubhraṃ jalākṣatasamanvitam |
sahiraṇyaṃ dvijasyāgre kuryād vāñjalibhis tathā ||
dvijo ‘bhiṣekaṃ tenaiva kuryāt tasyaiva samantrakam |
jalena darbhapūtena śivadhyānaṃ paraṃ paṭhan ||
nārī ca dhyāyamānā tvāṃ śubhābhidhyānatatparā |
rāgādīn dūratas tyaktvā pratīcchec chirasā jalam ||
brahmāvartāt samāyāte brahmayonisamudbhave |
bhadreśvari mahādevi lalite śaṅkarapriye ||
gaṅgādvārarate mātar gaṅgājalaviśodhite |
saubhāgyārogyaputrāṃś ca tathaivārthān manepsitān (?) ||
prayacchāsyai suprasannā bhavadevi namo namaḥ ||
abhiṣekamantraḥ |
abhiṣiktā tato bhaktyā prīyamāṇena cetasā |
datvā hiraṇyaṃ tat tasmai prāśayīta kuśodakam ||
ācamya prayatā bhūtvā būśayyāṃ kṣapayet kṣapām |
īśānī dhyāyamānā ca āttesā darbhasaṃstare ||
[420] dvitīye ‘hni tataḥ snātvā tathaivābhyarcya pārvatīm |
yathāśaktyā dvijāḥ pūjyā bhojayitvā suvāsinīm ||
tataḥ kuṭumbaṃ śeṣānnaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyatā |
evaṃ hi prathame māsi īśānīṃ nāma pūjayet ||
dvitīyaṃ pārvatī nāma tṛtīye śaṅkarapriyā |
bhavān yathā caturthe tu skandamātā tu pañcame ||
dakṣasya duhitā ṣaṣṭhe mainākī saptame smṛtā |
aṣṭame lalitā nāma satī ca navame tathā ||
daśame māsi vikhyātā devī saubhāgyadāyinī |
umā tv ekādaśe māsi gaurīti dvādaśe smṛtā ||
kuśodakaṃ payaḥ sarpir gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ phalam |
nimnapatraṃ kadambaṃ vā gavāṃ śṛṅgodakaṃ dadhi ||
pañcagavyaṃ tathā śākaṃ prāśanāni hy anukramāt |
pratimāsam upoṣyaiva yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇām ||
dadāti śraddhayopetā vācake brāhmaṇottame |
kusumbham ārdralavaṇaṃ jīrakaṃ guḍam eva ca ||
sindūraṃ ca haridrāṃ ca śūrpasthaṃ devam ādiśet |
māsi māsi bhaven mantro gakāro dvādaśākṣaraḥ ||
oṃkārapūrvikāṃ devī namaskārāntayojitām ||
oṃ gaṃ īśānyai namaḥ go pārvatyai namaḥ oṃ guṃ śaṅkarapiryāyai nama
ityādi ebhis tu pūjitair mantrais tuṣyati brāhmaṇaiḥ priye |
[421] tuṣṭa tv abhīpsitān kāmān dāsyāmi prītipūrvakān |
samāpte tu vrate hy asmin brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
sahitaṃ bhāryayābhyarcya gandhadhūpādibhis tathā ||
dvijaṃ maheśvaraṃ viddhi bhāryāṃ gaurīṃ tathaiva ca |
iti datvā brāhmaṇānāṃ dampatyoḥ (?) pūjayet priye ||
annaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ deyaṃ tathā śukle ca vāsasī |
brāhmaṇyai raktavāsāṃsi deyāni mama vallabhe ||
evaṃ cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ samyag yat phalaṃ labhate śṛṇu |
bhuktvā bhogān samastāṃś ca vrajed bhūpatinā saha ||
śatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ prāpya lokān parāvarān |
modate bhartṛsahitā yathendreṇa śacī tathā ||
mānuṣatvaṃ punaḥ prāpya tena bhartrā sahaiva sā |
puṇye kule śriyāyukte nirajā svaśrusatkṛtā ||
saptajanmāni yāvac ca na vaidhavyam avāpnuyāt |
putrān bhogān tathā rūpaṃ saubhāgyārogyam eva ca ||
ekapatnī tathā bartuḥ prāṇebhyo ‘bhyadhikā bhavet |
śṛṇuyād vācyamānaṃ tu bhaktāya lalitāvratam ||
mayā snehena kathitaṃ sāpi saubhāgyam ṛcchati ||
saṃpūjyapūjyapūjyalalitāṅgayaṣṭiṃ
gandhodasaṃbhṛtaghaṭāṃ śirasi kṣiped yā |
sā sabhyamartyalalanāsu lalāmabhūtā
bhūtādhipaṃ patim avāpya bhuvaṃ bhunakti ||

iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ lalitāvratam |
bhīṣma uvāca |
saubhāgyārogyaphaladaṃ vipakṣakṣapaṇaṃ vibho |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ kiṃcid vrataṃ brūhi mahāmune ||

yad umāyāḥ purā devaḥ provācāsurasūdanaḥ |
kathāsu saṃpravṛttāsu lalitārādhanaṃ prati |
tad idānīṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ||
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā devi tathaivānantapuṇyakṛt |
narāṇām atha nārīṇām ārādhanam uttamam ||
nabhasye vātha vaiśākhe mārgaśīrṣe ‘tha vā punaḥ |

gorocanātha gomūtraṃ mustā goḥ śakṛtaṃ dadhi |
candanena ca saṃmiśraṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ nyaset ||
saubhāgyārogyakṛd yasmāt sadā ca lalitāpriyam |
pratipakṣatṛtīyāsu pumān vātha suvāsinī |
dhārayed raktavastrāṇi kusumāni sitāni ca ||
matsyapurāṇe puruṣasya raktavastradhāraṇam uktam |
pratipakṣatṛtīyāyāṃ pumān vai pītavāsasau |
[423] ity anena yat tu puruṣasya raktavastradhāraṇam uktam atas tayoḥ puruṣe vikalpaḥ |
vidhavā śuklavasanam (?) ekam eva hi dhārayet |
kumārī sūkṣmasūkre (?) ca vāsasī paridhāya vai ||
devyarcāṃ pañcagavyena tataḥ kṣīreṇa kevalam |
snāpayen madhunā tadvat puṣpagandhodakena tu ||
pūjayet śuklavastrais tu phalair nānāvidhair api |
dhānyakājājilavaṇaguḍakṣīraghanānvitaiḥ |
śuklākṣatais tilair arcāṃ lalitāyai sadārcayet ||
dhānyakaṃ kustuvurum | ajā jīrakam | arcā pratimā |
āpādād arjanaṃ kuryāt pratipakṣaṃ samādhinā |
varadāyai namaḥ pādau śivāyai gulphaye namaḥ ||
aśokāyai namo jaṅghe bhavānyai jānunī tathā |
guhyaṃ maṅgalakāriṇyai vāmadevyai tathā kaṭīm ||
padmodarāyai jaṭharam uraḥ kāmaśriye namaḥ |
karau saubhāgyaṃ dāyinyai bāhū śaśimukhapriye ||
mukhaṃ darpaṇavāsinyai pārvatyai ‘nusmitaṃ tathā |
gauryai namas tathānāsāṃ sunetrāyai ca locane ||
tuṣṭyai lalāṭaphalakaṃ kātyāyanyai śiras tathā |
namo gauryai namas tuṣṭyai namaḥ kāntyai namaḥ śriye ||
[424] rambhāyai lalitāyai va vāsudevyai namo namaḥ |
iti sarvāṅgapūjāmantraḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad agrataḥ padmam ālikhet |
patrair dvādaśabhir yuktaṃ kuṅkumena sakarṇikam ||
pūrveṇa vinyased gaurīm aparṇāṃ ca tataḥ param |
bhavānīṃ dakṣiṇe tadvad rudrāṇīṃ ca tataḥ param ||
vinyaset paścime saumyaṃ tato madanavāsinīm |
vāyavye pāṭalām ugrām uttareṇa tato hy umām ||
lakṣmīṃ svāhā svadhāṃ tuṣtiṃ maṅgalāṃ kumudāṃ satīm |
rudrāṇīṃ madhyataḥ sthāpya lalitāṃ karṇikopari ||
atardanacatuṣkoṇe goryādyaṣṭadiśo likhet |
bahirdalāṣṭake umām emekam (?) ekaśo likhet ||
kusumair akṣataiḥ śubhraiḥ namaskāreṇa vinyaset |
gītamaṅgalaghoṣāṃśca kārayitvā suvāsinī ||
pūjayed raktavāsobhir araktamālyānulepanaiḥ |
sindūramālikāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vāsaḥ śirasi dāpayet ||
sindūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ snānam iṣṭaṃ devyāḥ sadā yataḥ |
nabhasye pūjayed gaurīm utpalair asitaiḥ sadā ||
bandhujīvair āśvayuje kārttike śatapatrakaiḥ |
māghe tu pūjayed devīṃ kundapuṣpaiḥ subhaktitaḥ ||
sindhuvāreṇa jātyā vā phālgune pūjayed umām |
kṣetre tu mālikāśākaiḥ vaiśākhe gandhapāṭhalaiḥ ||
[425] sinduvārāṇi guṇḍimallikā mahūvakaḥ |
jyaiṣṭhe kamalamandārair āṣāḍhe ca javārcanam |
kadambair atha mālatyā śrāvaṇe pūjayed umām ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam |
bilvapatrārkakusumaṃ yavagośṛṅgavāri ca ||
tilodakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prāśayet kramaśas tadā |
etad bhādrapadādy annaprāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam
pratipakṣaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ kartavyaṃ cārulocane |
brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva śivaṃ gaurīṃ prakalpayet ||
bhojayitvārcayed bhaktyā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ |
puṃsaḥ pītāmbare dadyāt striyaḥ kauśuṃbhavāsasī ||
niṣpāvājājilavaṇam ikṣudaṇḍaguḍānvitam |
striyai dadyāt phalaṃ puṃse suvarṇotpalakaṃ tathā |
yathā na devi deveśas tvāṃ parityajya gacchati |
tathā māṃ saṃparityajya patir nānyatra gacchatu ||
kumudā vimalā nandā bhavānī vasudhā śivā |
lalitā kamalā gaurī satī rambhātha pārvatī |
nabhasyādiṣu māleṣu prīyatām ity udīrayet ||
vratānte śayanaṃ dadyāt suvarṇakamālānvitam |
mithunāni caturviṃśat tadardhaṃ vātha śaktitaḥ ||
aṣṭāv aṣṭau ca māsānte cāturmāsye ‘tha vārcayet |
tathopadeṣṭāram api pūjayec ca tato gurum ||
na pūjyate gurur yatra sarvās tatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ |
[426] uktānantatṛtīyaiṣā sutānandaphalapradā ||
sarvapāpaharā devī saubhāgārogyavardhanī |
na caināṃ vittaśāṭhyena kadācid api laṅghayet ||
naro vā yadi vā nārī yataḥ śāṭhyāt pataty adhaḥ |
garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī vātha rogiṇī ||
yadā śuddhā tadānyena kārayet prayatā svayam |
imām anantaphaladāṃ yā tṛtīyāṃ samācaret ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ seyaṃ gaurīloke mahīyate |
vittahīnāpi kurvīta varṣatrayam upoṣaṇaiḥ ||
puṣpamantravidhānena sāpi tat phalam aśnute ||
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ
giritanayāvratamaṇḍale lokasaṃsthaḥ |
matam api ca dadāti so ‘pi daivī
mamaravadhūjanakinnaraiś ca pūjyaḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇoktam anantatṛtīyāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
strīṇāṃ saṃpadyate yena martyaloke gṛhe śubham |
[427] sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ sukhasaubhāgyavṛddhimat ||
sapatnīrahitaṃ kāntaṃ mahimānam anuttamam |
etad ācakṣa me kṛṣṇa prasādāt sumukho bhava ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
kailāśaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite |
śaṅkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha kiṃ tvayā sadvrataṃ kṛtam |
yena saubhāgyam atyantaṃ (?) priyāsi varavarṇiṇī ||
devy uvāca |
purāhaṃ deva tiṣṭhāmi kumārī pitur antike |
tatra pṛṣṭā mayā nātha jananī mukham āsthitā ||
kathayasvāmba me kiṃcid vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam |
evam uktvā mayā devī jananī mām athābravīt ||
bhadre kuruṣva yatnena rambhāvratam anuttamam |
mano’bhilaṣitaṃ kāmaṃ yena prāpnoṣi śaṅkara ||
jyaiṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snātā niyamatatparā |
kuru pārśveṣu pañcāgnīn jvālamālān jvalāhutīn ||
gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgniṃ sabhyakāhavanīyakam |
pañcamaṃ bhāskaraṃ teja ity ete pañca vahnayaḥ ||
ity eṣāṃ madhyamā bhūtvā tiṣṭha pūrvāmukhī bhavat |
caturmukhaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ paṅkajoparisaṃsthitam ||
mṛgājinachatrakucāṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇīm |
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ devīm abhimukhaṃ kuru ||
[428] mahākālī mahālakṣmīr mahākāyā mahāmanāḥ |
mahāmāyā mahādevī mahāmahiṣanāśinī ||
sarasvatī vataraṇī saiva proktā mahāsatī |
tadāsya prekṣaṇaparā bhavato bhāvabhāvitā |
homaṃ kuryur mahātmāno brāhmaṇāḥ sarvatodiśam ||
devyāḥ pūjā ca kartavyā puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ |
bahuprakāraṃ naivedyam anindyaṃ ghṛtapācitam ||
dāpayed agrato devyāḥ saubhāgyāṣtakam eva ca |
kustumbarīṃ jīrakaṃ ca kusumbhaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā ||
niṣpāvāḥ pañcamī putri lavaṇaṃ śarkarā guḍam |
puṣpamaṇḍayikā kāryā gandhadhūpādivāsitā ||
padmāsaneti saṃtiṣṭhed yāvat pariṇato raviḥ |
tataḥ praṇamya rudrāṇīṃ mantram etad udīrayet ||
vedeśu sarvaśāstreṣu divi bhūmau rasātale |
dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaś ca bahuśo na bhaktyā rahitaḥ śivaḥ ||
tvaṃ śaktis tvaṃ svadhā svāhā tvaṃ sāvitrī sarasvatī |
patiṃ dehi gṛhaṃ dehi sutān dehi namo ‘stu te ||
evaṃ kṣaṃāpya tāṃ devīṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ |
dehi śaktyā gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ vicitraṃ bahubhūmikam ||
chādya kahlārakedārapratolībhir alaṃkṛtam |
kuḍyaṃ stambhagavākṣāḍhyaṃ maṇimaṇḍitatoraṇam ||
padmarāgamahānīlamaṇivaidūryaśobhitam |
gṛhadhānāvidhānena brāhmaṇāya yaśasviṇe ||
[429] sapatnīkāya saṃpūjye sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
prayaccha praṇatā bhūtvā manovāñchitadāyakam ||
suvāsinībhyas tad deyaṃ naivedyaṃ sūrpasaṃsthitam |
nivartya vidhinānena tataḥ paścāt kṣamāpayet |
dampatyāni ca saṃpūjya sampatyā madhuraiḥ rasaiḥ ||
devy uvāca |
ity uktayā mayā cīrṇaṃ deva rambhāvrataṃ purā |
vratānte devadattasya dattaṃ gṛhavaraṃ mayā ||
lopāmudrā sabhartṛkā cāsmin veśmani pūjitā |
vratena tena deveśa bhartā labdho ‘smi śaṅkara ||
ardhakāye sthitā te ‘haṃ saubhāgyabalagarvitā |
evam etan mayākhyātaṃ yan mātrā kathitaṃ mama |
nīlakaṇṭha namas tubhyaṃ mamārtihara śaṅkara ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
pūrvam eva mayā cīrṇaṃ yāś cariṣyanti yoṣitaḥ |
puruṣās tv atha kaunteya khyātaṃ rambhāvrataṃ bhuvi ||
bhāryāputragṛhaṃ bhogān kulavṛddhim avāpnuyuḥ |
strīṇāṃ cārulasaubhāgyam gārhastyaṃ sārvakāmikam ||
bālamadhyasthavṛddhānāṃ rūpalāvaṇyabṛṃhaṇam ||
anena vratadharmeṇa paraloke yudhiṣṭhira |
kāmayānavimānena vāñchitārthapradena tu ||
[430] rudraloke mahābhogān bhuktvā pāṇḍavanandana |
martyaloke śubhe deśe dhanadhānyasamākule ||
himavadvindhyayor madhye āryāvarte mahohare |
kule ca dharmaśīlānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca pāṇḍava ||
utpatsyate na saṃdeho rūpasaubhāgyasaṃyutaḥ |
nārī vetthaṃ mahābhāgā prāpnoty avikalaṃ phalam ||
vratasyāsya prabhāvena śivadharmaparo bhavet |
bhuktvā bhogān suvipulān rudaikagatamānasaḥ ||
mṛto ‘tra karmanirmukto rudrasyānucaro bhavet |
bhadraṃ bhaved bhavabhayāpaharaṃ nṛloke
gauryā svamātṛbhavanasthitayā ca cīrṇam |
yā strī vrataṃ bhuvi karoti ratā svadharme
brahmeśakeśavasamaṃ patim ālabhet sā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ pañcāgnisādhanarambhāvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
rambhātṛtīyāṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm |
sukhasaubhāgyaphaladaṃ sarvāmayanivāriṇīm ||
sarvaduḥkhaharāṃ puṇyāṃ putrapautrapradāṃ tathā |
sapatnīdarpadalanāṃ rūpaiśvaryakarīṃ śubhām ||
śaṅkareṇa purākhyātā pārvatyāḥ priyakāmyayā |
tām imāṃ śṛṣṇu bhūpāla bhūtānāṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
[431] upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyāt bhaktibhāvitā |
devī saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat tṛtīyāyām upoṣitā ||
pratimāsaṃ kariṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ cāpare ‘hani |
tad avighnena me yātu samāptiṃ vratam uttamam ||
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapannāsmi daurbhāgyād uddharasva mām |
evaṃ saṃkalpya vidhivat kaunteya kṛtaniścayā ||
bhaktyā nārī dhyānaparā snānaṃ kṛtvā jitendriyā |
nadyāṃ taḍāge vāpyāṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatendriyā ||
pūjayet pārvatīṃ nāmnā rātrau prāśya kuśodakam |
prabhāte bhojayed viprān śivabhaktān viśeṣataḥ ||
sahiraṇyaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ datvā teṣāṃ tu dakṣiṇām |
gaurīṇyāś ca yathā śaktyā bhojayet prayatā satī ||
gaurīṇyāḥ suvāsinīḥ |
anena vidhinā rājan yaḥ kuryāt pārvatīvratam |
sā kulānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ tārayen nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā śivaloke mahīyate |
pauṣe māse tṛtīyāyāṃ girijāṃ nāma pūjayet ||
gomūtraṃ prāśayed rātrau prabhāte bhojayed dvijān |
hiraṇyaṃ jīrakaṃ caiva svaśaktyā dāpayet tataḥ ||
śakraloke vaset kalpaṃ tataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet |
māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ sudevīṃ nāma pūjayet ||
gomūtraṃ prāśayed rātrau svaped rātrau vimatsarā |
[432] hiraṇyaṃ ca kuśumbhaṃ tu divā dadyād dvijātaye ||
viṣṇuloke ciraṃ sthitvā prāpnoti śivamandiram |
gaurīti phālgune nāma gokṣīraṃ prāśayen niśi ||
prabhāte bhojayed viprān yathāśaktyā suvāsinīm |
kustumburīḥ sakanakās tebhyo datvā visarjayet ||
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāptā divaṃ vrajet |
caitre rājan viśālākṣīṃ pūjayed bhaktitatparā ||
dadhi prāśya svapet prātar dadyād hemasakuṅkumam |
śubhasaubhāgyasaṃpannā mṛtā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīmukhīṃ nāma pūjayet |
ghṛtaṃ ca prāśayed rātrau punar dadyād dvijātaye ||
kanakaṃ śarkarāṃ caiva pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti mṛtā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
jyaiṣṭhe nārāyaṇīṃ nāma pūjayet puṣpadīpakaiḥ |
prāśayel lavaṇaṃ rātrau tataś caikā niṣi svapet ||
śivabhaktān dvijān prātar bhojayitvā yathepsitān |
svavāsinīr yathāśaktyā bhakṣyabhojyaiś ca bhojayet ||
tāmbūlaṃ kanakaṃ dadyāt pranipatya visarjayet |
ghṛtaṃ ca prāśayed rātrau punar dadyād dvijātaye ||
kanakaṃ śarkarāṃ caiva pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti mṛtā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ narādhipa |
śuklāyāṃ prātar utthāya dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
[433] antakāle sukhaṃ yāti yatra devī maheśvaraḥ |
āṣāḍhe mādhavīṃ nāma prāśayitvā tilodakam ||
prabhāte bhojayed viprān hemayuktaṃ guḍaṃ dadet |
sarvasaṃpatsukhaṃ bhuktvā devyāś cānucarī bhavet ||
śrāvaṇe tu śriyaṃ pūjya pibed gośṛṅgajaṃ jalam |
prabhāte brāhmaṇaṃ bhojyaṃ dadyād dhematilaiḥ saha ||
bhogān bhuktvā mahīpṛṣṭhe golokam adhigacchati |
tathā bhādrapade māsi subhadrāṃ nāma pūjayet ||
bilvapatrarasaṃ prāśya svapet tu brahmacāriṇī |
prabhāte vipramukhyāya dadyād dhemaphalaiḥ saha ||
sarvalokeśvarī bhūtvā bhuktvā bogān anekadhā |
prāpnoti brahmasadanaṃ vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
āśvinasya tṛtīyāyāṃ pūjayitvā śivapriyām |
prāśayet taṇḍulajalaṃ prātar viprāṃś ca bhojayet ||
dakṣiṇā cātra nirdiṣṭā candanaṃ ca sakāñcanam |
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya gaurīloke mahīyate ||
padmodbhavāṃ kārttike ca pañcagavyaṃ piben niśi |
vāditrair jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prabhāte bhojayed dvijān ||
sapatnīkān śubhācārān (?) mālyavastrair vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
bhūṣayed bharataśreṣṭha gauriṇīr bhojayet tathā ||
umāmāheśvaraṃ haimaṃ samāpte kārayet śubham |
umāmāhreśvaraṃ rūpaṃ viṣṇudharmottaroditam ||
vāmārdhe vārvati kāryā śivaḥ kāryaś caturbhujaḥ |
[434] akṣamālāṃ triśūlaṃ ca darpaṇaṃ ca kare dadhat ||
ekavaktras trinetraś ca vāmārdhadayitātanuḥ |
yathā vibhavasāreṇa vitānaṃ pañcavarṇakam ||
śayyā cātra vinirdiṣṭā sarvopaskarasaṃyutā |
savatsāṃ śīlasaṃpannāṃ gāṃ ca dadyāt payasvanīm ||
āsanaṃ ca mṛduṃ dadyāt śvetachatraṃ kamaṇḍalum |
pādukopānahau divye vastrayugmaṃ ca pāṇḍuram ||
pītayajñopavītaṃ ca paṭṭasūtrasamudbhavam |
śaṅkhaśuktisamopetaṃ darpaṇaṃ ca samujjvalam ||
raktaṃ sakambukaṃ deyaṃ striyāś ca paridhānakam |
umāmāheśvaraṃ sthāpya āsane tāmraje nṛpa ||
pūjāṃ viracayed bhaktyā dhyāyamānā maheśvaram |
nānādivyaiḥ sugandhaiś ca puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalais tathā ||
ghṛtapakvaiś ca naivedyair dīpamālāvibhūṣitaiḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍair nālikeraiś ca dāḍimair bījapūrakaiḥ ||
jīrakair lavaṇaiś caiva kusumbhaiḥ kuṅkumais tathā |
rasapātraiḥ sumṛṣṭaiś ca gītavādyair anekadhā ||
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ sapatnīkaṃ kṣamāpayet |
tato dvijaṃ samāhūya vedavedāṅgapāragam ||
vedadhvanisamāyuktam upaveśya varānane |
sapatnīkaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha divyacandanacarcitam ||
paridhāpayitvālaṃkṛtya sarvaṃ tasmai nivedayet |
[435] evaṃ kṛte phalaṃ yat syāt tan na śakyaṃ (?) mayeritum ||
sarvoktaphalasaṃyuktā sarvadevaiḥ supūjitā |
jātā jātā mahakalye sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
tadante śivasāyojyaṃ nārī prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
puruṣo vā nṛpaśreṣṭha śivabhaktiś ca suvrata ||
so ‘pi tatphalam āpnoti nānyathā śivabhāṣitam |
saubhāgyārthaṃ purā cīrṇaṃ rambhayā rājasattama ||
