tena rambhātṛtīyeyaṃ paraṃ saubhāgyadāyinī |
yo ‘haṃ sa eva bhūteśo gaurī saiva na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti matvā mahābhāga śaraṇaṃ vraja pārvatīm |
eṣā himādriduhitur dayitā tṛtīyā
rambhābhidhānam abhavad bhuvi matkṛteti |
saṃprāśanair ucitanāmayutām upoṣya
prāpnoti vāñchitaphalāny abalā bahūni ||
iti bhaviṣyottarottaraṃ [ttaroktaṃ?] nāmavratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
bhagavan harikālīti kā devī procyate bhuvi |
ārdradhānye sthitā kasmāt pūjyate strījanena sā |
pūjitā kiṃ dadātīha sarvaṃ me brūhi keśava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
pārtha paurāṇikīṃ divyāṃ mattaḥ śṛṇu kathām imām |
[436] āsīd dakṣasya duhitā kālī nāma sukanyakā ||
varṇenāpi ca sā kṛṣṇā navanīlotpalaprabhā |
tryambakāya ca sā dattā mahādevāya śūline ||
vivāhitā vidhānena śaṅkhatūryanināditā |
yajñayātrāṃ gatair devaiḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ ||
nirvartite vivāhe tu kanyāsārdhaṃ trilocanaḥ |
krīḍate vividhaiḥ kāmair manasaḥ prītivardhanaiḥ ||
atha devasamāje tu kadācid vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
āsthānamaṇḍape ramye āśte viṣṇusadāyavān ||
tatrasthān āhvayāmāsa narmaṇā tripurāntakaḥ |
kālī nīlotpalaśyāmāṃ gaṇamātṛgaṇānvitām ||
ehy ehi tvaṃ matiḥ kālī bhinnakṛṣṇāñjanaprabhe |
kālam apy atisaundaryāt tava rūpaṃ mama priyam ||
ity evam uktvā sā devī vrīḍitā krodhamānasā |
niśvāsocch[v]āsatāmrākṣī bāṣpagadgadayā girā ||
ruroda sasvanaṃ bālā provāca sphuritādharā |
kiṃ deva nāmnā yā gorī sā gorīty abhidhīyate ||
yasmān mamopamā dattā bhinnakṛṣṇāñjanaṃ vibho |
samāje devasiddhānāṃ vāsudevasya saṃnidhau ||
tasmād deham imaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ juhomi jvalite ‘nale |
ity uktvā vāryamāṇāpi harikālī ruṣānvitā ||
mumoca haritachāyāṃ kāntiṃ harati śādvale |
[437] cikṣepa dehaṃ roṣeṇa jvalite havyavāhane ||
punaḥ parvatarājasya gṛhe gaurī babhūva sā |
mahādevasya dehārdhe sthitā saṃpūjyate suraiḥ ||
yā muktā śādvale devyā kālī kāntiḥ svadehajā |
sā babhūva māhavīryā devī kātyāyanī punaḥ ||
tathā kṛtāni bhūrīṇi devakāryāṇi pāṇḍava |
tuṣṭair devagaṇair datto varas tasyai śṛṇuṣva me ||
yac ca śāhalasaṃsthā vai kālīti varadāyinī |
pūjayiṣyanti puruṣā nāryo vāpi viśeṣataḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sukhasaubhāgyagarvitāḥ |
cirāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti bhartṛputrasamanvitāḥ ||
evaṃ sā harikālīti gaurī śasye vyavasthitā |
pūjanīyā mahārāja mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
harer nāmnaḥ samutpanne harikāli haripriye |
sarvadā śasya mūrtisthe praṇatārtihare namaḥ ||
itthaṃ saṃpūjya tāṃ devīṃ datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām |
tato jalāśaye ramye mantreṇaivaṃ visarjayet ||
arcitāsi mayā bhaktyā gaccha devi surālayam |
mama daurbhāgyanāśāya punar āgamanāya ca ||
evaṃ yaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha harikālīvrataṃ caret |
prativarṣaṃ vidhānena nārī vā bhaktitatparā ||
nītvā yat phalam āpnoti tadanyena na labhyate |
martyalokāc ciraṃ jīvet sarvakāmaiḥ supūritā ||
[438] putrapautrasuhṛnmitranaptṛdauhitrasaṃkulam |
sārdhaṃ varṣaśataṃ jīved bhogān bhuktvā mahītale |
tato ‘vasāne dehasya śivaloke mahīyate ||
vīrabhadramahākālanadīśvaravināyakāḥ |
sarve prasādasumukhā bhavanti vratayogataḥ ||
saṃpūjya śūrpagatasaptanirūḍhaśasyāṃ
devīṃ himādritanayāṃ harikālikākhyām |
naivedyajānarasamudyatagītavādyaiḥ
saṃprāpnuvanti manujāḥ suciraṃ sukhāni ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śuklabhādrapadsyaivaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ samācaret |
ratnadhānyaiḥ sa vairūḍhaiḥ kṛtvā vihitaśādvale ||
kharjūrair nārikelaiś ca phalaiś ca madhurais tathā |
mātulāṅgakusumbhaiś ca dhānyakair jambikais tathā ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalair dhūpair naivedyair modakādibhiḥ |
prīṇayitvā samāsādya padmarāgeṇa bhāvitā ||
ghaṇṭāvādyādibhir gītaiḥ śubhair divyaiḥ kathānakaiḥ |
pūjanīyā mahārāja mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
harer nāmnaḥ samutpanne harakāli harapriye |
sarvadā śasyamūrtisthe praṇatārtikare namaḥ ||
itthaṃ saṃpūjya tāṃ devīṃ dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām |
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte kiṃcid udgate ||
[439] rātrau suvāsinībhiś ca sā neyā tu jalāśaye |
tato jalāśaye ramye mantreṇaiva visarjayet ||
arcitā ca mayā bhaktyā gaccha devi surālayam |
mama daurbhāgyanāśāya punar āgamanāya ca ||
evaṃ yaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha harikālīvrataṃ caret |
prativarṣaṃ vidhānena nārī vā bhaktitatparā ||
nītvā yat phalam āpnoti tadanyena na labhyet |
martyaloke ciraṃ jīvat sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ ||
putrapautrasuhṛnmitranaptṛdauhitrasaṃkulam |
sāgraṃ varśaśataṃ jīved bhogayuktā mahītale ||
tato ‘vasāne dehasya śivaloke mahīyate |
vīrabhadramahākālanandīśvaravināyakāḥ ||
sarve prasādasumukhā bhavanti vratayogataḥ ||
saṃpūjya śūrpagatasaptavirūḍhaśasyāṃ (?)
devīṃ himādritanayāṃ harikālikākhyām |
naivedyajāgarasamudgatagītavādyaiḥ
saṃprāpnuvanti manujāḥ suciraṃ sukhāni ||
iti bhaviṣyotttaroktaṃ harikālivratam |
tṛṇavindur uvāca |
yenāviyogam āsādya vratena niyamena vā |
sadā nārī sutān tena vrajed yena padaṃ ca tat ||
[440] vidhavā ca pare loke bhartraiva munipūjyate (?) |
sukhenāpi sadā brahman vada yena dhanena ca ||
anilāda uvāca |
umayā caritaṃ yac ca bhavānyā lalitāvratam |
bālye himavato janma dakṣakopād vimucyayā ||
mahāsaubhāgyasaṃdohaṃ dṛṣṭvā devyā mahātmanā |
arundhatyā vaśiṣṭhena kathitaṃ tat vrataṃ śṛṇu ||
vaśiṣṭha uvāca |
arundhati śṛṇuṣvedaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam |
avaidhavyapadaṃ strīṇām aviyogavrataṃ tv idam ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe snātā śuklāmbarapriyā |
dṛṣṭaṃ (?) candraṃ dvitīyāyāṃ naktaṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam ||
ācamya ca śucir bhūtvā daṇḍavac chaṅkaraṃ namet |
mudānvitā namaskṛtya vijñāya parameśvaram ||
oṃ udumbaramayaṃ vṛkṣaṃ grāhyam aṣṭāṅgulaṃ śubham |
uttarāśāgataṃ sāgraṃ satvacaṃ nirvraṇaṃ dṛḍham ||
vāgyatā prāṅmukhī bhūtvā bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam |
dvitīyāyāṃ tataḥ svapyād bhūmau tadvratamānasā ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ samutthāya muhūrte brahmaṇaḥ śubhe |
kṛtakāryā ca susnātā śuklamālyāmbarā tataḥ ||
śālipiṣṭamaye kṛtvā strīpuṃsaḥ pratime śubhe |
veṇupātre tu saṃsthāpya pūjayed bhaktitatparā ||
[441] upavāsaṃ ca kurvīta sarvabhogavivarjitam |
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpaṃ kṛtvā snātā vivarjayet ||
tato niśāyāṃ śuśroṇi kṛtapūjāṃ kṛtotsavām |
kṛtavāditranirghoṣāṃ jāgaraṃ tatra kalpayet ||
vidhivat pūjayitvā tat paiṣṭikaṃ putrikādvayam |
suprabhāte dvijāgrāya sahiraṇyaṃ pradāpayet ||
yathāśaktyā mahābhāge vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
umāmāheśvaraṃ hy etat kalpayitvā tu cetasi ||
brāhmaṇo ‘pi jale ‘gādhe paiṣṭaṃ tan mithunaṃ kṣipet |
evaṃ kṛte svastyayanā mithunāni tu bhojayet ||
śivabhaktān dvijān bhojya miṣṭānnena svaśaktitaḥ |
pratimāsaṃ prakurvīta vividhānnena saṃyutam (?) ||
mārgaśīrṣe punar māsi kārttikānte samudyate |
nāmāni te pravakṣyāmi pratimāsakrameṇa tu ||
pūjājapanimittaṃ ca siddhyarthaṃ cintitasya ca |
śaṅkaraṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu nāma gaurīsamanvitam ||
gaurīṃ vā pārvatīṃ caiva puṣyamāse tu pūjayet |
bhavaṃ caiva bhavānīṃ ca māghamāse prapūjayet ||
phālgune tu mahādevam umayā sahitaṃ yajet |
caitre trilocanaṃ devaṃ lalitāṃ ca prapūjayet ||
sthāṇuṃ vaiśākhamāse tu lolanetrā samanvitam |
rudrāṇyā sahitaṃ rudraṃ jyaiṣṭhe māse jayet ca ||
āṣāḍhe paśunāthaṃ ca satyā sārdhaṃ sucismite |
[442] śrīkaṇṭhaṃ śrāvaṇe devaṃ subhadrāṃ parameśvarīm ||
bhīmaṃ bhādrapade tadvat kālarātrisamanvitam |
śivam āśvayuje bhaktyā gaṅgayā sahitaṃ yajet ||
īśānaṃ kārttike māsi śivāṃ devīṃ prapūjayet |
pratimāse vinā nāmnā vratasiddhir na vidyate ||
pratimāseṣu puṣpāṇi yāni pūjāsu yojayet |
tāni te saṃpravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ prītikarāṇi vai ||
ādau nīlotpalaṃ yojyaṃ tadabhāve ‘parāṇy api |
pavitrāṇi sugandhīni yojayed bhaktito vane ||
karavīraṃ bilvapatraṃ kiṃśukaṃ kuñjamallikām |
pāṭalīṃ ca kadambaṃ ca taragandroṇamālatīm ||
aśuṃ kuṅkumaṃ droṇaṃ kuravakaḥ |
etāny uktakrameṇaiva māseṣu dvādaśeṣv api |
bhaktyā yojyāni rambhoru devasya priyakāmyayā ||
tathā ca pañcagavyaṃ tu prāśanaṃ pratimāsikam |
nānyad dhi pāvanaṃ kiṃcit pañcagavyāt paraṃ smṛtam ||
evaṃ vrate kṛte bhadre śivabhaktisamanvitā |
vatsarānte vitānaṃ ca dhvajaṃ kiṅkiṇimālikam ||
ghaṇṭāṃ (?) dīpaṃ vastrayugmaṃ śivabhaktyā nivedayet |
tāpayitvānuliptā ca sauvarṇaṃ viddhia paṅkajam ||
yathā vibhavato deyaṃ devadevasya tuṣṭaye |
raupyaṃ ca rūpayugalaṃ devasya purato nyaset ||
[443] bahuprakāranaivedyaṃ gītavādyasamanvitam |
kuryān nīrājanaṃ śambhoḥ snātvā gacched gṛhaṃ svakam ||
caturasraṃ mahādevam umāṃ caiva trikoṇikīm |
snātvācāryāya tadyugmaṃ mauktikādiyutaṃ dadet ||
vratino bhojayet paścād dvādaśaiva dvijottamān |
mithunāni ca yāvanti bhaktyā śaktyā ca dakṣayet ||
karṣaikaikapramāṇena śātakumbhamayaṃ śubham |
umāmāheśvaraṃ caiva kārayitvā suśobhanam ||
umāmāheśvaraṃ rūpaṃ rambhātṛtīyāvratoktaṃ veditavyam |
mauktikāni catuḥṣaṣṭis tāvanto ‘pi pravālakāḥ |
tāvanti puṣparāgāṇi tāmrapātropati nyaset ||
vastraṇa (?) veṣṭayitvā ca gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
etat sarvaṃ sārayuktam ācāryāya nivedayet ||
vratināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vā mithunānām (?) athāpi vā |
aśakto niṣkrayaṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
datvā hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
catvāriṃśat tathāṣṭau ca kumbhān chatram upānahau ||
sahiraṇyāt kṛtān sarvān dadhipuṇyodakārcitāt |
dīnāndhabadhirādīnāṃ taddine vānivāritam ||
kalpayed annapānaṃ ca sumṛṣṭaṃ rucyam ātmanaḥ |
nyūnādhikaṃ na kartavyaṃ svavittaparimāṇataḥ ||
[444] saṃpūrayet kalpanayā yadi vittaṃ na vidyate |
aviyogakaraṃ caitad rūpasaubhāgyavittadam |
āyuḥ putrapradaṃ kāmyaṃ śivalokapradāyakam ||
iti kālikāpurāṇoktam aviyogatṛtīyāvratam |
matsya uvāca |
tathaivānyat pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradam |
saubhāgyaśayanaṃ nāma yat purāṇavido viduḥ ||
purā dagdheṣu lokeṣu bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmahādiṣu |
saubhāgyaṃ sarvalokānām ekastham abhavat tadā ||
tac ca vaikuṇṭham āsādya viṣṇuvakṣasthale sthitam |
tataḥ kālena mahatā punaḥ sargavidhau nṛpa ||
ahaṃkārāvṛte loke pradhānapuruṣānvite |
vivāde saṃpravṛtte ca kamalāsanakṛṣṇayoḥ ||
liṅgākārā samudbhūtā jvalatīvograrūpiṇī |
tayābhitaptadehasya viṣṇor vakṣasthalāśritam ||
saubhāgyād yad dravībhūtaṃ nyāyatat [s?] tasya vakṣasaḥ |
rasarūpaṃ na tad yāvat prāpnoti vasudhātalam ||
utkṣiptam antarikṣasthaṃ brahmaputreṇa dhīmatā |
dakṣeṇa pītamātraṃ tu rūpalāvaṇyakārakam ||
balaṃ tajo mahaj jātaṃ dakṣasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
[445] śeṣaṃ tad apatad bhūmāv aṣṭadhā tad ajāyata ||
ikṣavas tarurājaṃ [tavarājam?] ca niṣpāvājājidhānyakam |
vikāravac ca gokṣīraṃ kuśumbhaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā |
lavaṇaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tatra saubhāgyāṣṭakam ucyate ||
tavarājam atyuttamā śarkarā | vikāravat vikārasahitam |
pītaṃ yad brahmaputreṇa yogajñānavidā tathā |
duhitāsyābhavat tasmād yā satīty abhidhīyate ||
lokānān atītya lalitā lalitā tena cocyate |
trailokyasundarī rājan upayeme pinākadhṛk ||
yā saubhāgyaikaniṣpannā bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
tām ārādhya pumān bhaktyā nārī vā kiṃ na vindati ||
manur uvāca |
katham ārādhanaṃ tasyā jagaddhātryā janārdana |
tadvidhānaṃ ca jagato jāyate tad vadasva naḥ ||
matsya uvāca |
vasantamāsam āsādya tṛtīyāyāṃ janapriyām |
śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhṇe tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
tasminn ahani sā devī kila viśvātmanā satī |
pāṇigrahaṇakaiḥ mantrair udūḍhā varavarṇinī ||
tayā sahaiva deveśaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayet |
[446] phalair nānāvidhair dhūpair dīpair naivedyasaṃyutaiḥ ||
pratimāṃ pañcagavyena tathā gandhodakena ca |
snāpayitvārcayed gaurīm induśekharasaṃyutām ||
pratimām ity aviśeṣoktāv api gaurīśayoḥ sauvarṇam eva pratimādvayaṃ kartavyam, sauvarṇapratimādvayaṃ pratipādayed ity agre vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
namo’stu pāṭalāyai tu pādau devyāḥ śivasya tu |
śivāyeti ca saṃkīrtya jayayai gulphayor dvayoḥ ||
triguṇāyeti rudrasya bhavānyai jaṅghayor yugam |
śivaṃ rudreśvarāyeti jayāyai iti jānunī ||
saṃkīrtya harikeśāya tathorū varade namaḥ |
īśāyai śaṅkaṭiṃ ratyai śaṅkarāyeti śaṅkhake ||
kukṣidvaye ca koṭivyai śūlinaṃ śūlapāṇaye |
maṅgalāyai namas tubhyam udaraṃ vāpi pūjayet ||
sarvātmane namo rudram īśānyai ca kucadvayam |
śivaṃ vedātmane tadvad bhadrāṇyai kaṇṭham arcayet ||
tripuraghnāya viśveśam anantāyai karadvayam |
trilocanāyeti haraṃ bāhū kālānalapriye ||
saubhāgyabhavanāyeti bhūṣaṇāhiṃ samarcayet |
bhūṣaṇādhiṃ śivam |
svāhāsvadhāyai ca mukham īśvarāyeti śūlinaḥ ||
āsokamadhuvāsinyai pūjyā cauṣṭau ca kāmadau |
[447] sthāṇave ca haraṃ tadvad āsyaṃ candramukhapriye ||
namo ‘rdhanārīśaharam asitāṅgīti nāsikam |
ardhanārīśāya nama iti haraṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
nama ugrāya lokeśaṃ laliteti punarbhravau |
śarvāya purahantāraṃ vāsudevyai tathālakam ||
namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya śivaṃ keśāṃs tathārcayet |
tathā alakapūjāmantrābhyām umeśayoḥ keśān arcayed ity arthaḥ |
bhaumograsaumyarūpiṇyai śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ |
śivam abhyarcya vidhivat saubhāgyāṣṭakam agrataḥ ||
sthāpayed ghṛtaniṣpāvakusumbhakṣīrajīrakam |
tavarājekṣulavaṇaṃ kustumburum athāṣṭakam ||
dattaṃ saubhāgyakṛd yasmāt saubhāgyāṣṭakam ity ataḥ |
atra ghṛtakṣīrayor ekakoṭitā | vikāravac ca gokṣīram iti saubhāgyāṣṭakamadhye matsyapurāṇa eva pūrvatrābhidhānāt | kustumburuṃ dhānyakam | tavarājaḥ śarkarāviśeṣaḥ |
evaṃ nivedya tat sarvam agrataḥ śivayoḥ puraḥ |
caitre śṛṅgodakaṃ prāśya svaped bhūmāv ariṃdama ||
punaḥ prabhāte utthāya kṛtasnātajapaḥ śuciḥ |
saṃpūjya dvijadāmpatyaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
[448] saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ suvarṇapratimādvayam |
prīyatām atra lalitā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat tṛtīyāyāṃ sadā mano |
prāśane dānamantreṇa viśeṣo ‘yaṃ nibodha me ||
gośṛṅgodakam ādyaṃ syād viśākhe gomayaṃ punaḥ |
jyaiṣṭhe mandārakusumaṃ bilvapatraṃ śucau smṛtam ||
śrāvaṇe dadhi saṃprāśya nabhasye ca kuśodakam |
kṣīram āśvayuje māsi kārttike pṛṣadājyakam ||
pṛṣadājyaṃ dadhimiśraṃ ghṛtam |
mārgaśīrṣe tu gomūtraṃ pauṣe saṃprāśayed ghṛtam |
māghe kṛṣṇatilāṃs tadvat pañcagavyaṃ ca phālgune ||
lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śivā |
vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī ||
umā ca dānakāle tu prīyatām iti kīrtayet |
mallikāśokakamalakadambotpalamālatīm ||
kulatthaṃ karavīraṃ ca bāṇam amlānakuṅkuma |
sinduvāraṃ ca sarveṣu māseṣu kramataḥ smrtam ||
bāṇaṃ nīlakuraṇṭakam, amlānaṃ mahāsahāpuṣpam, sinduvāraṃ nirguṇīpuṣpam |
japākusumbhakusumamālatīśatapatrikāḥ |
yathālābhaṃ praśastāni karavīraṃ ca sarvadā ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad upoṣya vidhivan naraḥ |
[449] strī vā bhaktyā kumārī vā śivāv abhyarcya śaktitaḥ |
vratānte śayanaṃ dadyāt sarvopaskarasaṃyutam ||
umāmāheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha |
sthāpayitvā ca śayene brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
upaskaram upadhānādi | gomithunam api haimam eva mukhyasya śayane sthāpanāsaṃbhavāt |
anyāny api yathāśaktyā mithunāny ambarādibhiḥ |
dhānyālaṃkāragodānair abhyarcya dhanasaṃcayaiḥ ||
vittaśāṭhyena rahitaḥ pūjayed gatavismayaḥ |
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyak saubhāgyaśayanavratam ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti padam ānantyam aśnute |
phalasyaikasya ca tyāgam etat kurvan samācaret ||
yatra kīrtiṃ samāpnoti pratimāsaṃ narādhipa |
saubhāgyārogyarūpāyurvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
na vimuktā bhaved rājann abdārbudaśatatrayam |
yas tu dvādaśavarṣāṇi saubhāgyaśayanavratam ||
karoti sapta vāṣṭau vā śrīkaṇṭhabhavane ‘maraiḥ |
pūjyamāno vaset samyak yāvat kalpāyutatrayam ||
nārī vā kurute vāpi kumārī vā nareśvara |
sāpi tatphalam āpnoti devyānugrahalālitā ||
śṛṇuyād api yaś caiva pradadyād atha vā matim |
so ‘pi vidyādharo bhūtvā svargaloke ciraṃ vaset ||
[450]
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ saubhāgyaśayanavratam |
gaurīvratam atho vakṣye strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam |
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīvrataṃ samācaret ||
upoṣya tu prayatnena vidhānam idam ācaret |
raktāmbaradharo bhūtvā krodhalobhavivarjitaḥ ||
sthaṇḍile hastamātre tu kartavyaṃ gandhamaṇḍalam |
kuṅkumenduśītena vartulaṃ parivartayet ||
induḥ karpūram, śītaṃ candanam |
tatra madhye pūjitavyā pratimā hemasaṃbhavā |
madhujā tadabhāve tu purā kenāpi nirmitā ||
raktacandanajā vātha kartavyā sā pramāṇataḥ |
pañcāmṛtātha vā pūjyā tatra māsaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
pañcāmṛtā pañcāmṛtajā |
raktapuṣpais tu saṃpūjyā jātīcampakasaṃyutaiḥ |
pāṭalākaravīraiś ca raktapadmair yathā tathā ||
pārijair mallikākñjais tathā raktotpalair alam |
sthalapadmaiḥ kiṃśukaiś ca sumanotpalaketakaiḥ ||
evaṃ puṣpais tathānyaiś ca pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ |
indunā kuṅkumenaiva bhūyo bhūyaḥ samālabhet ||
nānāvidhāni ratnāni mukuṭāṅgadakāni ca |
kuṇḍalābharaṇāny atra raśanādīni dāpayet ||
[451] bhakṣyāṇi yatnāt kalpyāni ghṛtakuṇḍayutāni ca |
śītalaṃ ca ghanaṃ dugdhaṃ mugdhaṃ ca dadhi picchilam ||
karambhaṃ navanītaṃ ca tathā śikhariṇīṃ punaḥ |
pānakaṃ caiva pānīyaṃ sacandraṃ dāpayet tataḥ ||
raktavastrāṇi deyāni saṃbhārādīni cāgrataḥ |
ācāryaś caiva pūjānte pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
hemavastrānnapānaiś ca vittaśāṭhyaṃ (?) vinā tataḥ |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kumārīr bhojayet tathā ||
devīnāmāni vakṣyāmi māsi māsi yathākramam |
prāśanaṃ tu viśeṣeṇa yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
gaurī umā ca lalitā subhagā bhagamālinī |
manonmanī bhavānī ca kāmadā bhogavardhanī ||
ambikā ca tathā kṛṣṇā rudrāṇī pūjayet kramāt |
ity etāḥ sitapakṣe tu kṛṣṇapakṣe tathā śṛṇu ||
ratir dhṛtir (?) buddhir matiḥ puṣṭiś ca parikīrtitāḥ |
prajñā medhā tathā caryā śrīraktā kīrtir eva ca ||
sitāsitābhyāṃ pañcābhyāṃ vrataṃ yatrātmam ācaret |
aśaktatvād abhāvāc ca dravyāṇāṃ tu sthitaṃ hitam ||
prāśanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śāstroktenaiva vartmanā |
tattanmāsoktadrayasyālābhe rogādijanakatvena prāśanāśaktau ca krameṇa krameṇa dvādaśeṣu māleṣu yat sthitaṃ labdhaṃ yatra hitaṃ tat prāśanīyam ity aśaktatvāditvāder arthaḥ |
pratimāsi pravakṣyāmi śuklapakṣe krameṇa tu |
[452] kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva gomūtraṃ ca kuśodakam ||
bilvapatrodakaṃ caiva tathānyac candanodakam |
jātīpatrodakaṃ caiva padmakesaram eva ca ||
nāgakesarasajñaṃ ca lavaṅgaṃ candram eva ca |
śuklapakṣe tu kathitaṃ caitrāt prabhṛti ṣaṇmukha ||
prāśanaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu kathyamānaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat |
balākaṃ kolakaṃ caiva prāśayet tu śatāvarīm ||
vanaṃ laghusuraṃ dāru sārivāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpikām |
śirīṣaṃ surabhīyuktaṃ raktaṃ ca mauktikaṃ tathā ||
bhārodakaṃ dvādaśamaṃ prāśanaṃ kathitaṃ tava |
iti gaurīvrataṃ khyātaṃ saubhāgyaṃ strīṣu putradam ||
āyurārogyadaṃ strīṇām iha loke paratra ca |
idaṃ vratavaraṃ tyaktvā strīṣu nānyad vrataṃ hitam ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gaurīvratam upācaret |
añjanaṃ raktavastraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā ||
darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ chatram āsanaṃ yānam uttamam |
gṛhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ hemajaṃ vātha tāmrajam ||
vratānte caiva dātavyam ācāryāya prayatnataḥ |
strīṇāṃ caiva kumārīṇāṃ vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca ||
dātavyāni prayatnena yadīcched bhūtim ātmanaḥ |
ity etat sarahasyaṃ tu gaurīvratam udāhṛtam ||
[453]
iti kālottaroktaṃ gaurīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
maṇḍalatritayaṃ kuryād varṇakena pṛthak pṛthak ||
tathā maṇḍalaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge śvetaṃ kuryāt tato naraḥ |
raktaṃ madhye raveḥ kuryāt tādṛk śvetaṃ dhruvasya tu ||
viṣṇoḥ padatrayaṃ teṣu pūjyaṃ syān maṇḍalena tu |
bhūmau tu prathamaṃ pādaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūryamaṇḍale ||
tṛtīye tu dhruve deve pūjayet prayataḥ śuciḥ |
homamantreṇa pūjā |
yathā maṇḍalavarṇoktagandhamālyādibhir dvija |
tad viṣṇoḥ param ity eva homamantro vidhīyate ||
trivikramāyeti tathā strī śūdraś ca dvijottama |
akṣatāni tilān ājyaṃ homayet saṃyutatrayam ||
tāmrarūpyasuvarṇāni śaktyā dadyāt tu dakṣiṇām |
bhojanaṃ ca trimadhuraṃ bhojayed brāhmaṇottamān ||
prāṇayātrāṃ tu kurvīta trigavyena tu taddine |
taddine vratadine vratino upavāsitvam itarānnavarjanāt | [454] dvitīyāyām upoṣya tṛtīyāyām trigavyaprāśanaṃ gavyam iti dadhikṣīraghṛtam |
evaṃ varṣatrayaṃ kṛtvā vratānte ca trihāyanīm |
brāhmaṇāya tu gāṃ datvā sarvakāmān (?) avāpnuyāt ||
trihāyanīṃ trivarṣām (?) |
bhumau tathāntarikṣe ca divi caiva narottama |
gatis tasyāpratihatā bhavaty arinisūdana ||
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi trivikramavratacāriṇī |
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ ca vimuñcati ||
sarvapāpaṃ mahābhāga manuṣyo jāyate tathā |
kule dhanāḍhye mahati rūpadraviṇasaṃyutaḥ ||
virogaḥ sarvasiddhārthas trivargasya ca sādhakaḥ |
kṛtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
tatrāpi nityaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ
lakṣmīsahāyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam |
pśyaty āmoghaṃ vibhum apratarkyaṃ
sanātanaṃ duḥkhavināśahetum ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ trivikramatṛtīyāvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
dvitīyaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu traivikramaṃ vratam |
bhūmis tu prathamaḥ pādaḥ antarikṣaṃ tathā paraḥ ||
[455] tṛtīyādividhir jñeyo devadevasya cakriṇaḥ |
bhuvaḥ patiḥ smṛto vahnir atiriktasya cānalaḥ ||
diśāṃpatis tathā sūryas tava viṣṇoḥ padatrayam |
jyaiṣṭhe śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
kalee kūpajalaṃ snāto vahniṃ saṃpūjayen naraḥ |
sopavāso dvitīyyāṃ kṛtopavāsaḥ kalyaṃ prātaḥkālaḥ |
gandhamālyanamaskāraṃ dīpadhūpānnasaṃpradā |
nadījale tataḥ snātvā madhyaṃ prāpte divākare ||
vāyoḥ saṃpūjnaṃ kṛtvā saktūn datvā dvijātaye |
snātvā tusāratoye ca sāyaṃ sūryaṃ samarcayet ||
tataś ca naktaṃ prāśnīyād dhaviṣyaṃ vāgyataḥ śuciḥ |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ rājan kṛtvā vratam anuttamam ||
samāpayitvā vaiśākhe dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām |
tāmraṃ rūpyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca trīṇi lohāni yādava ||
vāsoyugaṃ tathoṣṇīṣaṃ trīṇi caitāni bhaktitaḥ |
etat saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā naras traivikramaṃ vratam ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute |
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā ||
devareṇa guṇāḍhyena vīṇāmurajavādinā |
svargalokam avāpnoti kāmacārī vihaṃgamaḥ ||
kāmatrayam upāsādya varatrayam upāśnute |
annam āyuḥ śrutaṃ caiva prasanne garuḍadhvaje ||
ākrāntakokatritayasya pūjyaḥ
[456] padatrayaṃ dharmabhṛtāmbariṣṭham |
saṃprāpya kāmān danujātahartur
gatir yatheṣṭāṃ puruṣaḥ prayāti ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ trivikramatṛtīyāvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
vakṣyatas te mahābhāga tava traivikramavratam |
tṛtīyaṃ nṛpaśārdūla tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||
jyaiṣṭhe śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ naraḥ samyag upoṣitaḥ |
bhuvaḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kuryād dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
dīpaiḥ ratnaiś ca vividhair dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām |
bījapūrṇāni pātrāṇi sahiraṇyāni bhaktitaḥ ||
pūjaivam antarikṣasya māsy āṣāḍhe vidhīyate |
dakṣiṇā tatra dātavyā tathā vāsoyugaṃ dvijaḥ ||
divaḥ pūjā ca kartavyā śrāvaṇe prāgvad eva tu |
chatraṃ copānahaṃ yugmaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tatra dāpayet ||
evaṃ māsatrayeṇeha pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet |
māsatrayeṇa cānyena tato māsatraye punaḥ ||
tato māsatraye cānyad evam anyan na cānagha |
vijñeyaṃ nityadharmasya pāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam ||
prathamapāraṇanyāyenaiva devatāpūjanam | dakṣiṇādānādinā sarvapāraṇasamāpanam |
[457] prathamaṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
atirātraphalaṃ rājan dvitīyapāraṇe tathā ||
tṛtīye pāraṇe viśvaṃ vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet |
caturthe pāraṇe proktaṃ rājasūyasya yat phalam ||
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkinījālamālinā |
haṃsayuktena divyena vīṇāmurajavādinā ||
varāpsarogaṇāḍhyena kāmagenāpi cāruṇā |
yatheṣṭakāmī bhavati bahukālam asaṃśayam ||
mānuṣyajanma cāsādya trīṇi śuktāny avāpnuyāt |
śuktāni pariśuddhāni |
vidyā janma tathā karma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
trivikramasyāpratimasya tasya
carācareśasya padatraye tu |
yaḥ pūjayet tasya bhavanti kāmāḥ
sarve samṛddhir na hi saṃśayo ‘tra ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ trivikramavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
jyaiṣṭhe śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ nirāhāro naraḥ śuciḥ |
trimūrtipūjanaṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyāyāṃ yathāvidhi ||
[458] trimūrtipūjanaṃ tisṝṇāṃ mūrtināṃ vāyusūryacandramasāṃ pūjanam |
kūpanadataḍāgādyair miśraiḥ prātaḥ śucir jalaiḥ |
pratyūṣe pūjayed vāyum anulipte śubhasthale ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasampadā |
homaṃ kuryād yavair mukhyair vastraṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||
madhyāhne pūjayed vahnau dadyād vipreṣu kāñcanam |
sūryāstamanavelāyāṃ (?) jale candraṃ ca pūjayet ||
jale candramasam abhidhyāya pūjayed iti yāvat | vahnāv abhidhyāya madhyāhne sūryaṃ prapūjayed iti yāvat |
ghṛtena homaṃ kurvīta rajataṃ dakṣiṇā smṛtam |
naktaṃ bhuñjīta dharmajñaḥ tailahīnaṃ tato naraḥ ||
pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratam etad atandritaḥ |
svargalokam avāpnoti sahasraṃ parivatsaram ||
mānuṣyam āsādya tato rājā bhavati bhūtale |
vrataṃ kṛtvā mahābhāga pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaratrayam ||
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate |
mānuṣyam āsādya tato rājā bhavati bhūtale ||
virogo darśanīyaś ca subhato dhanavān naraḥ |
kṛtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi vratam etad anuttamam ||
vratāvasāne viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ bhojayet tataḥ |
bhojyaṃ trimadhuraprāyaṃ dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
[459] tataḥ svargam āpnoti varṣāṇāṃ ca daśāyutam ||
tato mānuṣam āsādya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
pradīptacakro dhanavān darmarājo janapriyaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudhamottaroktaṃ rājyavratam |
rambhovāca |
devaloke mahādevi gaṇikāḥ saukhyasaṃyutāḥ |
martyaloke tathā sarvāḥ striyaḥ saubhāgyavarjitāḥ ||
kathaṃ bhāgyaṃ ca bhogāṃś ca labhante parameśvari |
janmajanmani saubhāgyaṃ yathā bhavati pārvati ||
tathā me sarvam ākhyāhi kāruṇyād bhaktavatsale |
upavāse vrate caiva tathā niyama eva ca |
etat sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ brūhi me parameśvari ||
pārvaty uvāca |
śṛṇu bhadre paraṃ guhyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
durbhagānāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ param ||
lakṣeśvarīti vikhyātaṃ tataḥ koṭīśvarīvratam |
tṛtīyā śuklapakṣe tu māsi bhādrapade bhavet ||
tasyāṃ vrataṃ tu saṃgrāhyaṃ yāvad varṣacatuṣṭayam |
upavāsena kartavyaṃ varṣe varṣe tu sundari ||
akhaṇḍānāṃ tandulānāṃ tilānāṃ vā sulocane |
lakṣam ekaṃ viracyātha kṣipet payasi śobhane ||
[460] kṣīrasaṃmiśritaiḥ kāryā devyā mūrtiḥ sulocanā |
kṛtvā tu puṣpaprākāraṃ puṣpamālābhimaṇḍitam ||
saṃsthāpya pārvatīṃ devīṃ pūjayed bhaktiśaktitaḥ |
pūjayed vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ ||
gandhair dhūpaiś ca puṣpaiḥ kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ |
gandhair dhūpaiś ca naivedyaiḥ phalaiś ca vividhais tathā ||
vastreṇa catureṇaiva pūjayet parameśvarīm |
namo namas te deveśi lakṣeśvari namo ‘stu te ||
koṭīśvari namas tubhyaṃ namas te haravallabhe |
umādevi namas tubhyaṃ kātyāyani namo ‘stu te ||
namaḥ kāli mahākāli śivadurge namo ‘stu te |
namaḥ sarvāṇi rudrāṇi aparṇe śaṅkarapriye |
sarvabhūtahite devi trāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
namo lakṣeśvarī devi kōtīśvari namo ‘stu te |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ śaṅkareṇa samaṃ mama ||
arghamantraḥ |
purā vratam idaṃ bhadre indrāṇyā ca kṛtaṃ śubham |
saṃdhyāvalyā ca sāvitryā. arundhatyā kṛtaṃ purā ||
damayantyā ca rohiṇyā kṛtaṃ vratavaraṃ śubhe |
gauriṇīr bhojayed chaktyā ijyānte ca mudīkṣitāḥ ||
gauriṇīḥ suvāsinīḥ |
evaṃvidhavidhānena karoti niyatā vratam |
[461] tato ‘syāḥ syāc ca dāridryaṃ na ca iṣṭaviyojanam ||
aṣṭaputrā bhaven nārī bhartāraṃ ca guṇādhikam |
surūpaṃ guṇinaṃ kāntaṃ paṇḍitaṃ priyadarśanam |
īśvaraṃ caiva rājānaṃ bhaved dīrghāyuṣaṃ priyam ||
bhavet prāpnuyāt |
dātāraṃ caiva bhoktāraṃ samastajanavallabham |
suśīlaṃ dhārmikaṃ śūraṃ candravat priyadarśanam ||
surūpā subhagā (?) sādhvī bhartṛrājyapradarśinī |
dharmaśīlā sucaritā vācayāmṛtabhāṣiṇī ||
dayāpradā ca sarvasya saubhāgyam atulaṃ bhavet |
saha patyā varārohā kurute rājyam uttamam ||
antakāle samaṃ tena modate tridive tathā |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca ||
idaṃ kṛtvā purendrāṇīndraṃ lebhe patim uttamam |
rohiṇī patim ālebhe candravrataniṣevaṇāt ||
raṇyā devī subhartāram ādityaṃ prāpya satpatim |
idaṃ te kathitaṃ bhadre vrataṃ koṭīśvaraṃ cara |
lakṣeśvarīti vikhyātaṃ kuru rambhe manoharam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ koṭīśvarīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
anyām api pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāṃ pāpanāśanīm |
[462] rasakalyāṇinīm etāṃ purākalpavido viduḥ ||
māghamāse tu saṃprāpya tṛtīyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ |
prātar gavyena payasā tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
snāpayen madhunā devīṃ tathaivekṣurasena ca |
gandhodakena ca punaḥ pūjanaṃ kuṅkumena vai ||
dakṣiṇāṅgāni saṃpūjya tato vāmāni pūjayet |
lalitāyai namo devyāḥ pādau gulphaṃ tato arcayet ||
jaṅghājānu tathā śāntyai tathaivoruṃ śriye namaḥ |
madālasāyai tu kaṭiṃ maṅgalāyai tathodaram ||
stanaṃ madanavāsinyai kumudāyai ca kandharam |
bhujaṃ bhujāgraṃ mādhavyai kamalāyai mukhasmite ||
bhrūlalāṭaṃ ca rudrāṇyai śaṅkarāyai tathālakān |
mukuṭaṃ vindhyavāsinyai punaḥ kālyai tathālakān ||
madanāyai lalāṭaṃ tu mohanāyai punar bhruvam |
netre candrārdhadhāriṇyai tuṣṭyai ca vadanaṃ punaḥ ||
utkaṇṭhinyai namaḥ kaṇṭham abhayāyai namaḥ stanam |
rambhāyai vāmabāhuṃ ca viśokāyai namaḥ karam ||
hṛdayaṃ madanagāminyai pāṭalāyai tathodaram |
kaṭiṃ suratavāsinyai tathōrū campakaśriye ||
jānujaṅghe namo gauryai gulphaṃ gāyatrikai (?) namaḥ |
dharādharāyai pādaṃ tu viśokāyai namaḥ śiraḥ ||
namo bhavānyai kāminyai kāmadevyai jagatśriyai |
ānandāyai sunandāyai śubhadrāyai namo namaḥ ||
[463] evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad dvijadampatyam arcayet |
bhojayitvānnapānena madhureṇa vimatsaraḥ ||
salaḍḍukaṃ vārikumbhaṃ śuklāmbarayuga dvayam |
datvā suvarṇakamalaṃ gandhamālyair athārcayet ||
prīyatām atra kumudā gṛhṇīyāl lavaṇavratam ||
kumudā prīyatām iti mantreṇa kumbhatrayaṃ suvarṇakamalaṃ datvā māsaṃ lavaṇaṃ na bhakṣayāmīti vrataṃ hṛhṇīyāt |
anena vidhinā devīṃ māsi māsi sadārcayet |
lavaṇaṃ varjayen māghe phālgune ca guḍaṃ punaḥ ||
tava rājaṃ tathā caitre varjaṃ ca madhumādhave |
pānakaṃ jyaiṣṭhamāse tu tathāṣāḍhe ca jīrakam ||
śrāvaṇe varjayet kṣīraṃ dadhi bhādrapade tathā |
ghṛtam āśvayuje tadvad ūrṇe varjyātha marjikā ||
ūrṇe kārttike, marjikā rasālā loke śikhariṇīti prasiddhā |
dhānyakaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe varjyātha śarkarā |
vratāne karaṇaṃ pūrṇam eteṣāṃ māsi māsi ca |
dadyād vikālavelāyāṃ bhakṣyapātreṇa saṃyutam ||
vratānte karaṇam ityādi | eteṣāṃ lavaṇaguḍādīnām madhy yasmin māse yat tyaktaṃ tan māsavratāne tena lavaṇādinā pūrvaṃ karaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇalaḍḍukādi bhakṣapātrayuktaṃ dadyād ity arthaḥ |
laḍḍukān śvetavartīś ca saṃyāvam atha pūrikāḥ |
pārikāghṛtapūrāś ca piṣṭhāpūpāṃś ca maṇḍakān ||
[464] kṣīraśākaṃ ca dadhyannam indurtho śokavartikam (?) |
māghādikramaśo dadyād etāni karakopari ||
kumudā mādhavī gaurī rambhā bhadrā jayā śivā |
umā ratiḥ satī tadvan maṅgalā ratilālasā ||
kramān māghādisarvatra prīyatām iti kīrtayet |
sarvatra pañcagavyaṃ tu prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
upavāsī bhavan nityam aśaktau naktam iṣyate |
punar māghe tu saṃprāpte śarkarā karakopari ||
kṛtvā tu kāñcanīṃ gaurīṃ pañcaratnasamanvitām |
haimīyāṅguṣṭhamātrāṃ ca sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalum ||
caturbhujām induyutāṃ sitanetrapaṭāvṛtām |
tadvad gomithunaṃ śuklaṃ suvarṇāḍhyaṃ sitāmbaram ||
savastraṃ bhojanaṃ dadyād bhavānī prīyatām iti |
anena vidhinā yas tu rasakalpāṇinīvratam ||
kuryāt sa sarvapāpebhyas tatkṣaṇād eva mucyate |
bhavārbudasahasraṃ tu na duḥkhī jāyate kvacit ||
agniṣṭomasahasreṇa yat phalaṃ tad avāpnuyāt |
nārī ca kurute yā tu kumārī vā varānane ||
vidhavā ca varākī vā sāpi tatphalabhāginī |
saubhāgyārogyasaṃpannā gaurīloke mahīyate ||
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṅgāt
[465] sakalakaluṣamuktaḥ pārvatīlokam eti |
matim api ca janānāṃ yo dadāti vratārtham |
vipulagatijanānāṃ nāyakaḥ syād amoghaḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ rasakalpāṇinīvratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahābhāga kartavyaṃ ca vrataṃ śṛṇu |
yenānantabhavārabdham enaḥ kṣapayati dvijaḥ ||
grahapīḍādikair anyair upasargaiḥ prapīḍitaḥ |
asyāṃ śāntiṃ prakurvīta yatavākkāyamānasaḥ ||
sthaṇḍilaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryād asvinnasitataṇḍulaiḥ |
cakrāñjaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryād asvinnasitataṇḍulaiḥ ||
tatra cāvāhayed devaṃ narasiṃhākṛtivibhum |
prasannamadhurodāravīkṣaṇakṣapitārtikam ||
aśeṣabhayavidhvaṃsacaturaṃ puruṣaṃ harim |
abhayaṃ bhayataptānāṃ dadatāṃ dadatāṃ varam ||
prapannārtimuṣāṃ tatra prasādaparameṇa ca |
vadanena ca susroṇi nayanena virajitam ||
vipakṣapakṣavikṣodacaturānantabāhukam |
vidyunmālāvṛtottuṅgarajatādrim ivāparam ||
kirīṭahārakeyūravanamālāvibhūṣitam |
[466] śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅganandanādyair alaṃkṛtam ||
jātiprasūnakaiś citraiḥ sitān bhojair akhaṇḍitaiḥ |
acūtair mallikādyaiś ca nandyāvartaprasūnakaiḥ ||
akṣatair bilvapatraiś ca tatphalaiś ca tadaṅkuraiḥ |
tilaiḥ sataṇḍulaiḥ siddhaiḥ tulasīśrīlatāṅkuraiḥ ||
nilotpalaiḥ kuvalayaiḥ kumudaiś ca sakesaraiḥ |
kāśmīracandanakṣodakarpūrāgurumiśritaiḥ ||
citraiḥ apūrvagandhaiś ca asvapiṇḍitaiḥ saṃvṛtaiḥ akṣatair anupahataiḥ nandyāvartaṃ tagaram akṣatair apṛthakkṛtaiḥ siddhaiḥ sādhitaiḥ śrīlatā padminī kuvalayair utpalaiḥ kesaraṃ vakulam | kāśmīraṃ kesaraṃ kṣodaś cūrṇam |
payasā pāyasānnena guḍatraimadhurolbaṇaiḥ |
śrāvyagītipadaiś cārunṛtyavādyapradarśanaiḥ ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskārastotrādyair bhaktibhāvitaiḥ |
samyag abhyarcya deveśaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
nānauṣadhisamāyuktaṃ nānātīrthodakānvitam |
nānārasasamāyuktaṃ nānākusumasaṃśritam ||
nānābījoparikṣiptaṃ nānāvastrasamanvitam |
nānākūrcayutaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ saṃsthāpayet puraḥ ||
tasminn āvāhayed devaṃ sudarśanam ananyadhīḥ |
pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa samyag abhyarcya śaktitaḥ ||
pūrvādikramayogena saṃsthāpya caturo ghaṭān |
koṇeṣu ca tathā teṣu kramād etāṃś ca saṃsmaret ||
[467] teṣu aṣṭakuṇḍeṣu, tān nandakādīn |
nandakaṃ muśalaṃ padmaṃ gadā śārddhaṃ ca śaṅkhakam |
pāśaś ca śaktir ity ete tadbhāhye ‘pi tathaiva ca ||
lokapālapratiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtvā sarvatra pūjayet |
tathā ca madhyame kumbhe tathānyeṣv apy alaṃkṛtam ||
evaṃ samāpya vidhivat pūjāṃ tatra vicakṣaṇaḥ |
japed daśasahasraṃ ca sudarśanam ananyadhīḥ ||
japet sahasram anyatra pratikumbhaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
atha kuṇḍapratiṣṭhānam agnyādhānaṃ yathāvidhi ||
vidhāya saṃskṛte cāgnau juhuyāt sarvaśāntaye |
trimadhvaktais tilaiḥ śuddhair ājyena payasāpi ca ||
śrīlatākusumāpāṇibilvapatraprasūnakaiḥ |
dūrvāṅkurais trimadhvaktaiḥ bījataṇḍulasarṣapaiḥ ||
āyuḥ kāmas tu darvābhiḥ śrīkāmo bilvasabhavaiḥ |
saubhāgyakāmo lakṣmīvān śrīlatāparṇasūtrakaiḥ ||
lakṣmīvān lakṣmīkāmaḥ |
ārogyakāmaḥ payasā gavyājyena tathā tilaiḥ |
puṣṭikāmas tv apāmargair apamṛtyur gadrūcibhiḥ ||
apamṛtyuḥ apamṛtyuyuktaḥ |
padmaiś cāvyāhatā lakṣmīḥ puṣṭiś ca kumudair api |
jātipuṣpair dharālābho nandyāvartaprasūnakaiḥ ||
ekapatraiḥ sitaiḥ padmair adhirājaṃ samṛcchati |
rajataṃ makṣikādyaiś ca suvarṇacampakodbhavaiḥ ||
[468] bījānnataṇḍulādyaiś ca tattallābho bhaviṣyati |
eteṣv anyatamair dṛṣṭair yamyaṃ kāmayate varam ||
daśasāhasrayogena tantaṃ vindaty asaṃśayam |
homāc ca dviguṇaṃ prāhus tarpaṇaṃ mantraniścayaḥ ||
tasya taddviguṇaṃ prāhur japa eṣa vidhikramaḥ |
niyogārambhasamaye niyamān pratipālayet ||
trayaṃ vāhar ahaḥ kurvan naktakālaṃ samāpayet |
niyogā maṇḍale khanayaḥ, niyamān maunādīn |
trayaś cāhar ahaḥ pūrvaṃ nakakālān samāpayet ||
trayaṃ homatarpaṇajapān | ahar ahaḥ pratidinaṃ saṃkhyā ca saṃkalpitahomasaṃkhyāpekṣayā |
haviṣyāśī jitakrodho yatavākkāyamānasaḥ |
nityaṃ triḥsavaṇaṃ snāyāt sadācārarato muniḥ ||
na cānṛtakatho ‘nagnir brahmacārī jitaśramaḥ |
gaurī vimatsarī nityaṃ svādhyāyanirataḥ śuciḥ ||
anaśnan vātha śākāśī phalasya gurulāghavam |
matvādadīta niyamān āsamāpteḥ prayatnataḥ ||
niyamān haviṣyānnāśanam | śākāśanam anaśanaṃ ca | tathā saṃkhyā samutkarṣaḥ phalagauravahetukaḥ |
ayutaṃ ca varaṃ vāhus tadbuddhis tatphalānugā |
kṛtvaivaṃ samyag ācāryaṃ samānīya ca sādhakam |
madhyamaṃ kumbham ādāya snāpayed devasaṃnidhau ||
[469] sādhakaṃ yajamānam |
sudīpitamahājvālā vidīpitadigantaram |
trāyasva cainam āpadbhyo bhadraṃ pradiśate namaḥ ||
anyair api yathāyogaṃ kuryāt tasyābhiṣecanam |
tattanmantreṇa vācāryas tatsamakṣaṃ mahāmatiḥ ||
oṃ daiteyanikarābhogaśailanirbhedadīkṣitaḥ |
padmaśaṅkhamanonanda trāhy enam api nandaka ||
oṃ vipakṣakāthamathana tacchirolulitānana |
kamalākāntadayita pāhy enaṃ muṣalāyudha ||
viśvodbhavabhayatrāṇalīlasya paramātmanaḥ |
līlāravindasubhaga pāhy enam api paṅkajaḥ ||
kaumodakī gadā sā vai devī diśatu maṅgalam |
yā mukundakarāmbhojavilasadbhūṣaṇāyate ||
oṃ svaviṣphārahṛtāśeṣarakṣodanujajīvitam |
yenāsau rakṣatād enaṃ viṣṇoḥ śārṅgaṃ dhanurvara ||
daityasīmantinīgarbhanirbhedacaturasvana |
sravadvyaktaraktāñjamadhupūrṇamukha svarāṭ ||
daityarakṣodhipaprāṇavasārudhirabhojana |
enaṃ sarvatra rakṣantu śārṅgapāṇeḥ śarotkarāḥ ||
arātihetipramukhaśaktyojaḥkṣapaṇakṣamā |
āpadbhyo (?) rakṣatād enaṃ śaktiḥ śrīḥ savarāyudha ||
evaṃ snātvā hatair vastrair bhūṣaṇādyair alaṃkṛtam |
[470] nīrājanavidhir deyo dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām ||
gurave ca varaṃ datvā bandhubhyo dakṣiṇādikam |
anyathāpi tadārthibhyo dadyād bhūri yathodayam ||
dvijamadhyam athānīya taiḥ snāto maṅgalākṛtiḥ |
tilacandanalājāñjaśvetasarṣapacandanaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ svastim āvācyam āśīr api ca kārayet |
kūrcodakena cācāryaḥ kuryād bhadravacaḥ kṛtī ||
oṃ āyuś ca vipulaṃ deva śriyaṃ ca vipulāṃ bhuvi |
akṣayyam api cārogyaṃ manaḥśāntim athākṣayām ||
vidyāmānakulabuddhirogādyair apy anāhatam |
vidyādhikaṃ tathātyarthaṃ śrīśo diśatu maṅgalam ||
svasti cāstu śivaṃ cāstu bhadram astu sadā tava |
āpadbhyaś ca bhayebhyaś ca rakṣantu tvāṃ śriyaḥpatiḥ ||
iti rakṣāvidhiṃ kṛtvā lokapālabaliṃ kṣipet |
pūrvatra tandulaiḥ kāryaḥ kṛśarānnena dakṣiṇā ||
paścime pāyasenaiva śuddhānnena tathodare |
koṇeṣu śaktibhiḥ kuryād guḍamiśrais tato bahiḥ ||
sarvārthe ca baliṃ dadyāt sarvair dvavyair mahāmatiḥ |
iti śāntivrataṃ proktaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāmate ||
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvarogavināśanam |
sarvasaukhyapradaṃ strīṇām annakāmaphalapradam ||
sarvārtiśamanaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
[471] yas tv etat kurute martyaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ |
sa sarvārtivinirmukto śāntim āpnoti naiṣṭhikīm ||
duḥsvapne vāmayagrāse ugrapīḍādyupadrave |
viṣādyupanipāte ca putranāśadhanakṣaye ||
rājyanāśe janakṣobhe durbhikṣe śatrupīḍane |
jvarākṣirogārtighoraplīhakuṣṭhabhagandaraiḥ ||
kṣayāpasmaraṇādyaiś ca tīvraduḥkhacaye sati |
snānam etat prakurvīta prajñāsāras tu pūruṣaḥ ||
mukāvāraktapuruṣaḥ prajñāvāñ chāstrasaṃmataḥ |
atyupadravasāhasram atītya sukham edhate ||
iti garuḍapurāṇoktaṃ śāntivratam |
pulastya uvāca |
tathaivānyāṃ pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāṃ pāpanāśinīm |
loke tu nāmlā vikhātāṃ sāndrānandakarīm imām ||
yadā śuklatṛtīyāyām āṣāḍharkṣaṃ bhavet kvacit |
brahmarkṣaṃ vātha vāpyaṃ vā hasto mūlam athāpi vā ||
āṣāḍharkṣa uttarāṣāḍhā, brahmarkṣa abhijit, āpyaṃ pūrvāṣāḍhā |
darbhagandhodakaiḥ snānaṃ tadā samyak samācaret |
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ ||
[472] bhavānīm arcayed bhaktyā śuklapuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
bhavena sahitāṃ rājan upaviṣṭāmbarāsane ||
vāsudevyai namaḥ pādau śaṅkarāya tato haram |
jaṅghe śokavināśinyai ānandāya namaḥ prabho ||
rambhāyai pūjayed ūrū (?) śivāya ca pinākine |
ānandinyai kaṭiṃ devyāḥ śūline śūlapāṇaye ||
mādhavyai ca tathā nābhiṃ tathā śambhor bhavāya ca |
stanāv ānandakāriṇyai śaṅkarāyendudhāriṇe ||
utkaṇṭhinyai namaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhāya vai haram |
karāv utpaladhāriṇyai rudrāya yajatāṃ patau ||
bāhū ca parirambiṇyai nṛtyaśīlāya vai haram |
devyā mukhaṃ vināśinye vṛṣeśāya punar vibho ||
smitaṃ ca smaraśīlāyai viśvavaktāya tatpare |
netre damanavāsinyai viśvadhātryai triśūline ||
bhruvau netṛpriyāyai ca tāṇḍaveśāya vai vibho |
devyā lalāṭam indrāṇyai havyavāhāya vai vibho ||
svāhāyai mukuṭaṃ devyāḥ śambhor gaṅgādharāya vai |
viśvakāyau viśvamukhyau viśvapādakarau śivau ||
prasannavadanau vande pārvatīparameśvarau |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad agrataḥ śivayoḥ punaḥ ||
padmotpalāni rajasā nānāvarṇāni vā likhet |
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ svastikaṃ ca tathā caivārdhanāṇakam ||
[473] yāvantaḥ pāṃśavas tatra rajasaḥ patitā bhuvi |
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
catvāri ghṛtapātrāṇi sahiraṇyāni bhaktitaḥ |
dadyād dvijāya karakam udakena samanvitam ||
pratipakṣaṃ caturmāsaṃ yāvad etān nivedayet |
tatas tu caturo māsān pūrvavat karakopari ||
catvāriṃśat tu pātrāṇi tilapātrāṇi tatparam |
pūrvavat sahiraṇyāni karakoparidhāya dadyāt |
gandhodakaṃ puṣpavāri candanaṃ kuṅkumodakam |
apakvaṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ vā gośṛṅgodakam eva ca ||
piṣṭodakaṃ tathā vāri kuṣṭhacūrṇānvitaṃ punaḥ |
uśīrasalilaṃ tadvad yavavallyudakaṃ tathā ||
tilodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapen mārgaśirādiṣu |
māseṣu pakṣadvitaye prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
sarvatra śuklapuṣpāṇi praśastāni śivārcane |
dānakāleṣu sarveṣu mantram etam udīrayet ||
gaurī me prīyatāṃ nityam anaghā sarvamaṅgalā |
saubhāgyāya sulalitā bhavānī sarvasiddhaye ||
saṃvatsarānte lavaṇaṃ guḍakumbhasamanvitam |
candanaṃ netrapaṭṭaṃ ca sahiraṇyāmbujaṃ tathā ||
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ tadvad ikṣuphalair yutam |
suśuklām āstṛtāṃ śayyāṃ sopadhānāṃ nivedayet ||
[474] sapatnīkāya viprāya gaurī me prīyatām iti |
ārdrānandakarī nāma tṛtīyaiṣā sanātanī ||
yām upoṣya naro yāti śambhos tat paramaṃ padam |
iha loke sadānandaṃ prāpnoti ca na saṃśayaḥ ||
āyurārogyasaṃpanno na kvacit śokam āpnuyāt |
nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vidhavā tathā |
sāpi tat phalam āpnoti prasādāc chūlapāṇinaḥ ||
pratipakṣam upoṣyaivaṃ mantrārcanavidhānataḥ |
rudrāṇīlokam āpnoti punar āvṛttidurlabham ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śrāvayed vāpi mānavaḥ |
rudrāṇīlokam āpnoti punarāvṛttir durlabham ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śrāvayed vāpi mānavaḥ |
śakralokaiḥ sagandharvaiḥ pūjyate ‘bdāyutāvadhi ||
ānandadāṃ sakaladuḥkhaharāṃ tṛtīyām
yā strī karoti vidhavā sadhavātha vā vā (?) |
sā sve gṛhe sukhasukhāny anubhūya bhūyo
gaurīpuraṃ sadayitā muditā prayāti ||
iti padmapurāṇoktam ārdrādānavratam |
sumantur uvāca |
pativratā patiprāṇā patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā |
[475] evaṃvidhā piryāyuktā śucisaṃbhojanā satī ||
sopavāsā tṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ parivarjayet ||
sopavāseti vratārambhe dvitīyāyṃ kṛtopavāsā tṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ parivarjayet |
sā vai gṛhṇātu vai bhaktyā vratam āmaraṇāntikam |
gaurī dadāti saṃtuṣṭā rūpasaubhāgyam eva ca ||
lāvaṇyalavaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ ślāghyaṃ puṃsāṃ manonugam (?) |
puṃsāṃ manoramā nārī bhartā bhāryāmanoramaḥ ||
gaurīvratena labhate rājan lavaṇavarjanāt |
umayā ca purā proktaṃ yad vā tac ca nibodhata ||
iti vrataṃ prati vibho dharmarājasya śṛṇvataḥ |
mayānantam idaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ nṛṇām ||
martye tu niyatā nārī vratam etac cariṣyati |
saha modiṣyate bhartrā yāvad bhartā haro mama ||
yā vai kalyāṇabhartāraṃ vindate śobhanā satī |
sātvidaṃ (?) vratam uddiśya bhaved akṣārabhojanā ||
maccittā manmanā kuryān madbhartā matparigrahā |
gaurīṃ saṃsthāpya sauvarṇīṃ gandhālaṃkārabhūṣitām ||
vastraiḥ susūkṣmaiḥ saṃvītāṃ puṣpamaṇḍanamaṇḍitām |
lavaṇāmṛtaṃ guḍaṃ tailaṃ devyāḥ śukle nivedayet ||
kadukhaṇḍaṃ jīrakaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ patraṃ ca bhārata |
śukle pakṣe iti śeṣaḥ | kadukhaṇḍam ārdrakam |
[476] guḍapūpās tathāpūpāḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭās tathā nṛpa |
brāhmaṇe vedasaṃpanne pradeyāḥ subahuśrute ||
śukle śukle sadā deyā yathāśaktyā hiraṇmayī |
dhanahīnais tu śaktyā vai madhukṣīramayī nṛpa ||
akṣāralavaṇaṃ rātrau bhuṅkte vīra suvāgyatā |
gaurī saṃnihitā nityaṃ bhūmau saṃstaraśāyinī ||
bhartāraṃ labhate kanyā yā vāñchati manonugam |
suciraṃ saha bhartrā vai krīḍayitvā sa haiva sā ||
santatiṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya saha tenaiva gacchati |
iha lokān pare loke bhogaś citraśikhaṇḍinām ||
vidhavā tu mahārāja devyā vrataparāyaṇā |
bhartāraṃ niyatā nityaṃ sadārcanaparāyaṇā ||
iha votsṛjya dehasya datvā harapure priyam |
ākṛṣya yamadūtebhyaḥ sā bhartāraṃ ramed divi ||
varṣakoṭiṃ śataguṇāṃ parītyā punarāgatā |
bhartrā sahaiva pūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam īpsitam ||
ity eṣā tithir ity evaṃ tṛtīyā lokapūjitā |
sadā viśeṣataḥ puṇyā vaiśākhe māsi vā bhavet ||
puṇyabhādrapade māsi māghasyaiva na saṃśayaḥ |
māghabhādrapade vāpi strīṇāṃ dhanyāṃ pracakṣate ||
sādhāraṇā tu vai pūrvā sarvalokasya bhārata |
māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ guḍasya lavaṇasya ca ||
dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ rājan strīṇāṃ ca puruṣasya ca |
[477] guḍena tuṣyate devī lavaṇena ca śaṅkaraḥ ||
guḍapūpās tu kartavyā māsi bhādrapade tu yā |
tṛtīyā yākṣayā loke gīrvāṇair upaśabdyate ||
yo ‘syāṃ dadāti karakān vāridhārāsamanvitān |
sa yāti puruṣo vīra lokān vai hetimālinaḥ ||
vāridānaṃ praśastaṃ vai modakānāṃ ca bhārata |
vaiśākhe māsi rājendra tṛtīyā candanasya ca ||
vāriṇā tuṣyate devī modakair bhava eva hi |
dānāt tu candanasyeha narayonāv asaṃbhavaḥ ||
yāty eṣā kuruśārdūla vaiśākhe māsi yā tithiḥ |
tṛtīyā sākṣayā loke gīrvāṇair iha śamyate ||
yo ‘syāṃ dadāti karakān vāridhānyasamanvitān |
sa yāti puruṣo vīra lokān vai hetimālinaḥ ||
ity eṣā kathitā vīra tṛtīyā tithir uttamā |
yām upoṣya naro rājan buddhivṛddhiṃ śriyaṃ vrajet ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam alavaṇatṛtīyāvratam |
brahmovāca |
gaurī kālī umā bhadrā durgā kāntiḥ sarasvatī |
[478] maṅgalā vaiṣṇavī lakṣmīḥ śivā nārāyaṇī kramāt ||
mārgatṛtīyām ārabhya pūjayet svargabhāg bhavet |
mārgaśīrṣatṛtīyām ārabhya pratimāsam ekaikena nāmnā pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
ardhanārīśvaraṃ rudram atha vā umāśaṅkaram |
pūjayed vidhivan nārīm aviyogam avāpnuyāt ||
yathā vā viṣṇurūpeṇa pūjayed īśvaraṃ sadā |
īśasya vāmabhāgasthāṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
ardhanārīśvaramūrtim umāmaheśvaraṃ vā suvarṇādimayaṃ vidhāya vāmabhāgasthām devīṃ gauryādibhiḥ pūjayet | atha vā viṣṇurūpeṇa saṃyutaṃ īśvaram iti | hariharamūrtiṃ kṛtvā vāmārdhasthakeśavādināmabhiḥ pratyekaṃ pūjayet | keśavanārāyaṇamādhavagovindaviṣṇu-madhusūdanaśrīdharahṛṣīkeśapadmanābhadāmodarākhyān devān dhūpasragdīpādyair upoṣya pūjya dakṣiṇābhir nāmabhiḥ | aśvamedhādisarvamakhānāṃ golakṣadānasyāpi nityasarvanāmasmaraṇād abhimataphalam āpnoti |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nām tṛtīyāvratam |
brahmovāca |
tṛtīyāyāṃ tu vitteśaṃ vittāḍhyo jāyate dhruvam |
pūjayitveti śeṣaḥ |
krayādivyavahāre ca lābho divyaguṇo bhavet ||
[479] mūlamantrāḥ svajñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvataḥ padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāṃ samidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homo bhavec chantena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ kuberavratam |
agastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ mahārāja saubhāgyakaraṇam vratam |
śṛṇu yenāśu saubhāgyaṃ strīpuṃsām abhijāyate |
phālgunasya tu māsasya tṛtīyā śuklapakṣataḥ ||
upoṣitena naktena śucinā satyabhāṣiṇā |
saśrīkaṃ ca hariṃ pūjya rudraṃ vā umayā saha ||
atra devatāyā iti pratimālakṣaṇavidhānaṃ tatas taṃ brāhmaṇe dadyād iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | sā ca prādhānyena suvarṇamayī prāpnoti |
gabhīrāyeti pādau tu subhagāyeti vai kaṭim |
udaraṃ devadeveti śrīkaṇṭheti ca vai uraḥ ||
trilocanāyeti śiro rudrāyeti samantataḥ |
evam abhyarcya medhāvī viṣṇuṃ lakṣmīsamanvitam ||
viṣṇupūjāyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavamantraprayogaḥ |
[480] haraṃ vā gaurīsaṃyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
tatas tasyāgrato homaṃ kārayen madhusarpiṇā ||
tilaiḥ saha mahārāja saubhāgyapatayeti ca |
tatas tv akṣārasaṃyuktaṃ niḥsnehaṃ dharaṇītale ||
godhūmānnaṃ tu bhuñjīta kṛtvāpy evaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
āṣāḍhādidvitīyā tu pāyasaṃ tatra bhojayet ||
yavānnaṃ tu tataḥ paścāt pātrabhūte vicakṣaṇe |
anaṅgahīne vedānāṃ pārage sādhuvartini ||
sadācārayute dadyād alpacitte ‘pi bhūpate |
khaḍgaiḥ pātrair upetaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
ekaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ pātraṃ dvitīyaṃ ghṛtapūritam |
tṛtīyaṃ tilatailasya caturthaṃ guḍasaṃyutam ||
pañcamaṃ lavaṇāparṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ gokṣīrasaṃyutam |
etān datvā rasān rājan saptajanmāntare bhavet |
subhago darśanīyaś ca nārī vā puruṣo ‘pi vā ||
iti śrīvarāhapurāṇoktaṃ saubhāgyatṛtīyāvratam |
nārada uvāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
saubhāgyajananaṃ caiva abhīṣṭaphaladāyakam ||
[481] brahmocāca |
śṛṇu vipra vidhānena tṛtītāṃ praharātmikām |
yā yoṣito vidhānena svargasaubhāgyadā bhavet ||
māghe śuklatṛtīyāyām upavāsaṃ tu kārayet |
rātrau saṃbhāram āhṛtya gaurīyāgasya maṇḍape ||
aṣṭapatraṃ likhet padmaṃ maṇḍape munipuṅgava |
umāmaheśvaraṃ tatra pūjayet susamāhitaḥ ||
pūrvapatre nyased gaurīm āgneyyāṃ lalitāṃ nyaset |
dakṣiṇe tu umānāma nairṛtye ca svadhāṃ tathā ||
paścime vāmadevīṃ tu vāyavyāṃ mūlagaurikām |
uttare tu śubhagāṃ tu aiśānyāṃ girijāṃ tathā ||
umāmaheśvaraṃ madhye gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet |
bhṛṅgāraṃ caiva saṃsthāpya taṇḍulaiḥ paripūrayet ||
bhṛṅgāraḥ kalaśaḥ |
tatas tasyāgrataḥ kuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ samekhalam |
ghaṇṭāṃ koṇe tu saṃsthāpya catvāro vārisaṃbhṛtāḥ ||
ghṛtenājyāhutīr hutvā tilahomaṃ tu kārayet |
āhutīnāṃ śataṃ hutvā gāyatryā tu samāhitaḥ ||
atha vā gaurīnāmnā tu juhuyād brāhmaṇo mune |
kuṇḍasya cottare bhāge vratī snānaṃ samācaret ||
āgneyyāṃ diśi saṃsthena ghaṭena prathame vibho |
yāme vai dvijaśārdūla tato homaṃ samācaret ||
[482] evaṃ yāmānuyāmaṃ tu snānaṃ homaṃ tu kārayet |
prabhāte vimale jāte sapatnīkaṃ dvijottamam ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
raktavastre guroḥ patnyai gurave sitavāsasī ||
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mune varṣacatuṣṭayam |
ārādhanaṃ tu devyāś ca saubhāgyajananaṃ param ||
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tasminn eva tato dine |
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ svacchande mañcake sthitam ||
vastrair gandhaiś ca dūpaiś ca dīpamālādibhis tathā |
bhakṣair nānāvidhaiḥ samyak pūjya bhaktyā tato mune ||
tadvad guruṃ sabhāryaṃ ca pūjayed dvijam uttamam |
gāṃ caiva gurave tadvad vastrālaṅkārasaṃyutām ||
mithunānīha catvāri bhojayet susamāhitā |
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ datvā bhaktyā kṣamāpayet ||
yā cared vidhinā samyak saubhāgyārogyabhāg bhavet |
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ mṛtā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
vidhihīnā na kartavyā tṛtīyā phalam icchatā |
vyarthaḥ pariśramas tasya parvate khananaṃ yathā ||
nārī vā naraśārdūla naro vā vidhinā mune |
phalaṃ yathoktaṃ prāpnoti satyam uktaṃ mayā dvijāḥ ||
[483]
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ haratṛtīyāvratam |
phālgunāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yas tu varjayet |
samānte śayanaṃ dadyād gṛhaṃ sopaskarānvitam ||
samānte vatsarānte |
saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatām iti |
gaurīlokapradaṃ nityaṃ saubhāgyavratam ucyate ||
iti garuḍapurāṇoktaṃ saubhāgyavratam |
kārttikāditṛtīyāyāṃ prāśya gomūtrayāvakam |
naktaṃ cared abdam ekaṃ tadante goprado bhavet ||
gaurīloke vaset kalpaṃ tato rājā bhaved iha |
etad bhadrāvrataṃ nāma sarvakalyāṇakārakam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ bhadrāvratam |
ālepanaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt tṛtīyāyāṃ śivālaye |
śivā pārvatī |
samānte dhenudoyāni bhavānīvratam ity uta ||
[484[
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ bhavānīvratam |
anagnipakvam aśnāti tṛtīyāyāṃ tu yo naraḥ |
gāṃ datvā śivam abhyeti punar āvṛttidurlabham |
bṛhadānandakṛt puṃsāṃ śīlavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ śīlavratam |
māghe māsy atha vā caitre puḍadhenuprado bhavet |
guḍavratas tṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīloke mahīyate ||
guḍavataḥ guḍavarjī |
mahāvratam idaṃ nāma paramānandakārakam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ mahātṛtīyāvratam |
tṛtīyāyāṃ tu śuklāyāṃ likhed vastrayuge śubhe |
rocanāsitakarpūraiḥ śivomāṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||
hemaratnasrajair vatsa mantrayugmam udīrayet |
samastakāmaphaladaṃ yat tat pūrvam udāhṛtam ||
tad eva mantradvayaṃ likhyate |
namaḥ samastabhuvanasargasthityantakāraṇa |
[485] īśāna dhyānaparama yogigamyāyate śiva ||
namaḥ śivāyai viśveśaśarīrārdhāpahāriṇi |
satyaṃ carācarasyeha jananyai kāmadāyini ||
tato japārcanaṃ homaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijasattama |
aviyogāya nārīṇāṃ vratarājaṃ sadā hitam ||
sahema puṣparatnāḍhyaṃ savastraṃ dāpayet tu tam |
mahāpuṇyaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam ||
sutabhrātṛviyogas tu nabhavettena bho dvija |
na vyādhir nopasargāś ca yāvat tanturojo bhavet |
tāvatkālam umāloke rājate modate ciram ||
iti śrīdevīpurāṇoktaṃ vratājatṛtīyāvratam |
sūta uvāca |
atra yaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam |
yadvat taṃ kāśirājasya bhāryāyā dvijasattama ||
kāśyāṃ rājaḥ purā hy āsīj jayamena iti smṛtaḥ |
tasya bhāryāsahasraṃ tu āsīd rūpasamanvitam ||
tathaivānyā priyā tena labdhā bhāryā suśobhanā |
sutā madrādhirājasya viśvakonasya dhīmataḥ ||
sā svapnāt prātar utthāya gatvā gaṅgātaṭaṃ śubham |
[486] pañcapiṇḍātmikāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā kardamasambhavām ||
yadā tu prabhayā bhāvo tadātmānaṃ karoty asau |
pṛthivyāś ca tejaś ca vāyur ākāśam eva ca ||
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sṛjatīty eṣā tatas tatpañcapiṇḍikā |
tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa mantraiḥ pañcabhir eva ca ||
tato gandhaiḥ phalair mālyair dhūpair vastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
naivedyaiḥ paramānnaiś ca gītair nṛtyaiḥ pracoditaiḥ ||
tato visṛjya tāṃ devīṃ taduddeśena vai tataḥ |
datvā dānāni bhūrīṇi gauriṇīnāṃ dvijanmanām ||
tataś ca gṛham abhyetya bhūrivāditranisvanaiḥ |
yathā yathā satīpūjāṃ tasyā gauryāḥ karoti yā ||
tathā tathā tu saubhāgyaṃ tasyāḥ pratyashikaṃ bhavet |
atha tasyāḥ sapatnyo yāḥ sarvā duḥkhasamanvitāḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā saubhāgyavṛddhiṃ tāṃ tasyā eva dine dine |
ekāḥ procur vārcya caināṃ yad eṣā kurute sadā ||
mṛnmayīṃ ca samādāya pūjayet pañcapiṇḍikām |
anyā procur mantrasiddhāṃ tāṃ vadanti maharṣayaḥ ||
anyā vadati puṇyāni nāsyāḥ pūrvakṛtāni ca |
evaṃ tāsāṃ suduḥkhena mahākālo jagāma ha ||
kasyacit kṣaṇakālasya sarvāḥ saṃmantrya tā mithaḥ |
tasyāḥ saṃnidhim ājagmus tasminn eva jalāśaye ||
yatra sā pūjayed gaurīṃ kṛtvā tāḥ pañcapiṇḍikām |
[487] sā ca sarvāḥ samālokya tyaktvā gaurīprapūjanam ||
saṃmukhī prayatī tūrṇaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭasthitā |
svāgataṃ nivedya tāṃ śīghraṃ yenāśu prakaromy aham |
sapatnya ūcuḥ |
vayaṃ sarvāḥ samāyātāḥ kautukena tavāntikam |
daurbhāgyavahninā dagdhās tava saubhāgyaje na ca ||
tasmād vada mahābhāge mṛnmayīṃ pañcapiṇḍikām |
nityam arcayasīti tvaṃ saubhāgyasya vivardhanam ||
kiṃ te kāraṇam etad dhi kiṃ vā mantrasamudbhavaḥ |
prabhāvo ‘yaṃ mahābhāge guhyaṃ cet tat vadasva naḥ ||
padmāvaty uvāca |
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ yat pṛṣṭāsmi śubhānanāḥ |
avyaktavyaṃ vadiṣyāmi bhavatīnāṃ tathāpi ca ||
gaurīpūjanakāle tu yasmāc caiva samāgatāḥ |
sarvā mama bhaginyas tu īrṣyā dharmo na me ‘sti vā ||
aham āsaṃ purā kanyā pure kusumasaṃjñte |
vīrasenasya śūdrasya vaṇikputrasya dhīmataḥ ||
tena dattāsmi dharmeṇa vivāhārthaṃ mahātmanā |
tato vivāhasamaye mama dattāni vṛddhaye ||
pañcākṣarāṇi śreṣṭhāni yoṣitāṃ dīkṣayā saha |
gaurīpūjā tathā caiva proktā cāhaṃ tataḥ param ||
[488] yāvat tu putri gaurīṃ tvam etaiḥ pūjayase ‘kṣaraiḥ |
jalapānaṃ na kartavyaṃ tāvac caiva kathaṃcana ||
yena saṃprāpsyase ‘bhīṣṭaṃ tatprabhāvād yathepsitam |
tatheti ca mayā proktaṃ tasmāt prītā śubhānanāḥ ||
tato vivāhe nirvṛtte gatāhaṃ patinā saha |
śvaśuras tiṣṭhate yatre śvaśrūś caiva sudāruṇā ||
gaurīpūjākṛte māṃ ca nivārayati sarvadā |
tato ‘haṃ bhayasaṃtrastā gaurībhaktiparāyaṇā ||
jalārthaṃ yatra gacchāmi tasmiṃś caiva jalāśaye |
tatra kardamam ādāya mantraiḥ pañcabhir eva ca ||
pañcapiṇḍātmikāṃ gaurīṃ vinirmāya tataḥ punaḥ |
tair eva pūjayāmy etāṃ gaurībhaktiparāyaṇā ||
prakṣipāmi punas toye tato gacchāmi mandiram |
kalpacit tv atha kālasya bhartā me prathitaḥ śubhāḥ ||
deśāntaraṃ vaṇigvṛttyā so ‘pi mārgaṃ samāśritaḥ |
sa gacchan marumārgeṇa māṃ samādāya snehataḥ ||
saṃprāpto nirjalaṃ deśaṃ suraudraṃ marumaṇḍalam |
tathā raudratame kāle vṛṣasthe divasādhipa ||
tataḥ sārthaḥ samagraś ca viśrāntaḥ sthalam adhvagaḥ |
kūpam ekaṃ samāśritya gambhīraṃ dūratoyakam ||
etasminn eva kāle tu mayā dṛṣṭaṃ samīpagam |
toyākāraṃ marudeśaṃ tatas toyaṃ vicintitam ||
[489] etac ca dṛśyate toyaṃ samīpasthaṃ tathā bahu |
tatra snātvā śucir bhūtvā gaurīm abhyarcya bhaktitaḥ ||
pibāmi salilaṃ paścāt susvādu surasī bhavet |
tataḥ saṃprasthitā yāvat prayacchati padāt padam ||
tato dūrataraṃ yāti kṣaṇena mṛgatṛṣṇikā |
etasminn antare prāpte nabhomadhyaṃ divākaraḥ |
vṛṣasthas tena dagdhāsmi upariṣṭāt śubhānanāḥ ||
adhobhāge tu taptābhir vālukābhiḥ samantataḥ |
bhramamāṇā tatas tsamin marudeśe samākulā ||
tataś ca patitā bhūmau viṣphoṭakasamāvṛtā |
tato mayā smṛtā citte kathā bhāratasaṃbhavā ||
etena tu purā pañcavālukābhir vinirmitā |
kūpe tu kṣipyamāṇena bandhubhyāṃ toyavartite ||
bhaktigrāhyās tato devās tuṣṭās tasya mahātmanaḥ |
tad evaṃ vālukābhiś ca pūjayāmi haripriyām ||
tena tuṣṭā tu sā devī mama rājyaṃ prayacchati |
anyadehataraṃ saṃsthe manye ‘bhīṣṭham anantakam ||
tatas tu pañcabhir mantrais tair eva smṛtim āgataiḥ |
pañcabhir muṣṭibhir devī vālukotthaiḥ prapūjitā ||
tataḥ pañcatvam āpannā tatkāle ‘haṃ varāṅganāḥ |
daśārṇādhipater jātā sadane lokaviśrute ||
jātismaraṇasaṃyuktā tasyā devyāḥ prabhāvataḥ |
[490] bhavatīnāṃ kaniṣṭhāsmi jyeṣṭhā saubhāgyataḥ sthitā ||
etasmāt kāraṇād gaurīṃ kṛtvaitāṃ pañcapiṇḍikān |
kardamena vidhāyātha pūjayāmi dine dine ||
etad guhyaṃ samākhyātaṃ bhavatīnām asaṃśayam |
samenānena me gaurī mano’bhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu ||
lakṣmīr uvāca |
tataḥ sarvāḥ sapatnyas tāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭasthitāḥ |
tām ūcur dīnayā vācā praṇipatya muhur muhuḥ ||
prasādaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ dīyatāṃ mantrapañcakam |
tad eva yena te gaurī saṃtuṣṭā parameśvarī ||
tvayā proktā ca yaṃ sarvāḥ prārthayadhvaṃ yathecchayā |
ahaṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi tat satyaṃ vacanaṃ kuru ||
tato deva mayā proktaṃ tāsāṃ tan mantrapañcakam |
śiṣyatvaṃ gamitānām tu vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ ||
viṣṇur uvāca |
mamāpi vada deveśi kīdṛk tan mantrapañcakam |
yat tvayānuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ tāsāṃ gauryā niveditam ||
lakṣmīr uvāca |
namaḥ pṛthivyai kṣāntyai te nama āpomaye śubhe |
tejasvini namas tubhyaṃ namas te vāyurūpiṇi ||
ākāśarūpasaṃpanne pañcarūpe namo namaḥ |
ebhir mantrair mayā pūrvaṃ pūjitā parameśvarī ||
tena rājyaṃ purā prāptaṃ sarvastrīṇāṃ (?) sudurlabham |
[491] tataḥ svasthāpitāṃ devīṃ kṛtvā ratnamayīṃ śubhām ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayā tatra sureśvara |
tāṃ yā pūjayate nārī sā cāpi pativallabhā |
jāyate nātra saṃdehaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitā ||
lakṣmīr uvāca |
evaṃ rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ gauryāḥ pūjākrte vibho |
saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ sarvayoṣitām |
na cāpatyaṃ mayā labdhaṃ tathāpi parameśvara ||
tādṛśe ‘pi ca saubhāgye tāruṇye tādṛśe sthite |
tathāpi tena duḥkhena divānaktaṃ sukhena me ||
kascyacit tv atha kālasya durvāsā munipuṅgavaḥ |
ānartādhipate īrme saṃprāpte gauravāya saḥ ||
cāturmāsīkṛte caiva mṛttikāgrahaṇāya ca |
tataḥ saṃpūjio rājñā ānartena yathākramam ||
datvārghaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tataḥ proktaḥ praṇamya ca |
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te ||
nānyo dhanyatamo loke bhūpo ‘sti sadṛśo mayā |
yat te pādau rajograstau keśair me nirmalīkṛtau ||
tad brūhi kim karosy adya gṛhāyātasya te mune |
api rājyaṃ prayacchāmi kā vārtānyeṣu śuśruvuḥ (?) ||
durvāsā uvāca |
cāturmāsīvidhānaṃ te kariṣye nṛpa mandire |
[492] mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ yāvat śuśrūṣā kriyatāṃ mama ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya mām ūce pārthivottamaḥ |
śuśrūṣā cāsya kartavyā sarvadaiva varānane ||
cāturmāsīkṛtaṃ yāvad devatārcanapūrvakam |
bāḍham ity evam uktvātha mayā sarvam anuṣṭhitam ||
śuśrūṣārthaṃ ca yat karma duhitrā tu pitur yathā |
cāturmāsyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yadā saṃprasthito muniḥ |
tadā proce sa māṃ tuṣṭaḥ putri kiṃ karavāṇi te ||
tataḥ sa bhagavān proktaḥ praṇipatya mayā guruḥ |
apatyaṃ nāsti me brahman tena dagdhāsmy aharniśam ||
tādṛśe phalite rājye yauvane ‘pi mahattare |
tan me vada muniśreṣṭha yena syān mama satkṛtiḥ ||
vratena niyamenātha dānena ca hutena vā |
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā mām uvāca smayann iva ||
anyadehāntare putri tvayā gaurī prapūjitā |
taptābhir vālukābhiś ca mṛtyukāla upasthite ||
tadbhaktyā labdharājyo ‘pi tāpena paribhūyase |
gaurī yattāpasaṃyuktā vālukābhiḥ kṛtā tvayā ||
na devo vidyate kāṣṭhe pāśāne mṛttikāsu ca |
bhāveṣu vidyate devo mantrasaṃyogatas tataḥ ||
tava bhaktisamāyuktā. mantrasaṃyojanena ca |
devī tatra samāyātā tvayā vālukayārcitāḥ ||
[493] taptayānena santāpā (?) bhavatyāh sarvadā sthitāḥ |
tasmād ratnamayīṃ kṛtvā devīṃ tvaṃ pañcapiṇḍikām ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃsthāpaya śubhānane |
vṛṣasthe bhāskare paścāt tasyā upari srāvi yat ||
jalayantraṃ divānaktaṃ dhārayasva prayatnataḥ |
tato yathā yathā tasyāḥ śaityabhāvo bhaviṣyati ||
tathā tathā ca te dehaḥ śāntiṃ yāsyaty asaṃśayam |
dehāt te bhavitā garbhas tataḥ putram avāpsyasi ||
rājyabhārakṣayaṃ śraiṣṭhaṃ suralokeṣu viśrutam |
anyāpi kāminī yātra evaṃ tāṃ pūjayiṣyati |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tathā sāpi yathā tvaṃ prabhaviṣyasi ||
lakṣmīr uvāca |
tato mayā punaḥ prokto bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ |
mānuṣatve ca me rāgaviraktir mahatī sthitā ||
nadīvegopamaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃ sarvadehinām |
tan me vada mahābhāga kiṃcid vratam anuttamam ||
mānuṣatvaṃ na yena syāt samyak cīrṇena sa dvijaḥ |
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā sā yāhi parameśvari ||
asti putri vrataṃ puṇyaṃ gaurītuṣṭikaraṃ param |
yena cīrṇena vai samyak yoṣid devatvam āpnuyāt ||
gomayākhyā mahādevī kṛtā gomātṛbhiḥ punaḥ |
tato golokam āpannāḥ sarvās tā varavarṇini ||
tāṃ ca kuruṣva kalyāṇi tato devatvam āpsyasi |
[494] tato mayā punaḥ proktaḥ sa muniḥ surasattama ||
kasmin kāle prakartavyā vidhinā kena sanmune |
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi yena tāṃ prakaromy aham ||
durvāsā uvāca |
nabhasye ca site pakṣe tṛtīyādivase sthite |
prātar utthāya paścāc ca bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam ||
tataś ca niyamaṃ kuryād upavāsasamudbhavam |
gaurīnāma samuccārya śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
tato niśāgame prāpte kṛtvā gaurīcatuṣṭayam |
mṛnmayaṃ yādṛśaṃ caiva tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ||
ekā gaurī prakartavyā pañcapiṇḍā yathocitā |
prahare prahare prāpte tāsu pūjāṃ samācaret ||
yair mantrais tān nibodha tvam ekaikasyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
himācalagṛhe jātā devi tvaṃ śaṅkarapriyā ||
menāgarbhasamudbhūtā pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te |
dhūpaṃ dadyāt tataś caiva karpūraṃ śraddhayā saha ||
raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca ghṛtena parikalpayet |
jātīpuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya naivedyaṃ modakān nyaset ||
raktavastraṃ ca saṃpādya arghyaṃ dadyāt tataḥ param |
yasya vṛkṣasya vihitaṃ tasya syād dantadhāvanam ||
mātulaṅgena cārghyaṃ tu mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ |
śaṅkarasya priye devī himācalasute śubhe ||
arghyaṃ tena mayā dattaṃ parigṛhya namo ‘stu te |
[495] tad eva prāśanaṃ kāryaṃ tataḥ kāyaviśuddhaye ||
tad eva mātulaṅgam eva |
dvitīye prahare prāpte ardhanārīśvaraṃ tataḥ |
surabhyā pūjayed bhaktyā mantreṇānena pārvatīm ||
ramād vārāhiṇī caivaṃ yā harasya vyavasthitā |
sā me pūjāṃ pragṛhṇātu tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
aguruṃ ca tato dadyād dhūpaṃ dadyāt tadā sute |
naivedyaṃ guṇakāś caiva nālikereṇa cārdhakam ||
mantreṇānena dātavyaṃ tad eva prāśanaṃ smṛtam |
ardhanārīśvarau yau ca saṃsthitau parameśvarau ||
ardhaṃ me tu pragṛhṇānāṃ syātāṃ sarvasukhapradau |
tṛtīya prahare prāpte śatapatryā prapūjayet ||
umāmāhreśvarau devau yau tau sṛṣṭilayātmakau ||
tau gṛhṇītām imāṃ pūjāṃ mayā dattāṃ prabhaktitaḥ |
guggulūtthaṃ tato dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ dhārikātmakam ||
jātīphalena cārghaṃ ca tad eva prāśanaṃ smṛtam |
tataś cārghaiḥ pradātavyo mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ |
umāmaheśvarau devau sarvakāmasukhapradau ||
gṛhītvā dattam arghaṃ me dayāṃ kṛtvā maheśvarau |
caturthe prahare prāpte gaurīṃ pañca ca piṇḍikām ||
bhṛṅgarājena saṃpūjya mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ |
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni yāni proktāni pañca ca ||
[496] pañcarūpāṇi deveśi pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te |
naivedyaṃ gṛtapūraṃ ca dadyād devyāḥ prabhaktitaḥ ||
granthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca arghyaṃ madanajaṃ phalam |
tad eva praśamaṃ kāryam arghyamantra iti smṛtaḥ ||
pañcabhūtamayī devī pañcadhā yā vyavasthitā |
arghyam enaṃ mayā dattaṃ sā gṛhṇātu sureśvarī ||
evaṃ sarvāṃ niśāṃ vāspi gītavādyādiniḥsvanaiḥ |
tāsāṃ caivāgrato neyā neva nidrāṃ samācaret ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale |
snātvā saṃpūjayed vipraṃ saha patnyā subhaktitaḥ ||
vastrair ābharaṇaiś caiva svaśaktyā nṛpanandini |
gaurībhakte ca dātavyaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca śucismite ||
tataḥ kareṇum ānīya vaḍavāṃ vā sumadhyame |
gaurīcatuṣṭayaṃ tac ca samāropya tadopari ||
gītavāditraśabdena vedadhvaniyutena ca |
nadyṃ vātha taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ vātha parikṣipet ||
mantreṇānena sadbhaktyā tat te ‘haṃ pacmi sundari |
āgatāsi mahādevi pūjitāsi mayā śubhe ||
mama saubhāgyadānāya yatreṣṭaṃ tatra gamyatām ||
lakṣmīr uvāca |
evaṃ mayā kṛtā deva sā tṛtīyā yathoditā |
nabhasye māsi saṃprāpte bhaktyā paramayā vibho ||
dvitīye tu yathā prāpte tṛtīye tu viśeṣataḥ |
[497] tāvad vyomagatā vāṇī samuttasthau sureśvara |
mā putri jalamadhye tvaṃ mama mūrticatuṣtayam ||
parikṣipādya madvākyaṃ śrutvā caivaṃ vidhīyatām |
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sthāpayaitat sadākṣayāt ||
akṣayaṃ jāyate yena sarvastrīṇāṃ hitāya ca |
tvaṃ prārthaya yadābhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ sarvaṃ dadāmy aham ||
tataḥ sā praṇipatyoccair mayā proktā sureśvarī |
yadi yacchasi me devī varaṃ tuṣṭā sureśvari ||
tad ahaṃ mānuṣe garbhe mā bhūyāsaṃ kathaṃcana |
bhartā bhavatu me viṣṇuḥ śāśvato ‘bhīṣṭadaḥ sadā ||
nānyat kiṃcid abhīṣṭaṃ me ced rājyaṃ tridaśodbhavam |
anyāpi kurute yā tu vratam etat samāhitā ||
sarvavratair yadā tuṣṭis tava devi prajāyate |
tathā tasyāḥ prakartavyā ekenānena pārvati ||
evaṃ bhaviṣyatīty uktvā tataś cādarśanaṃ gatā |
svadevī ca mayā tatra tac ca devīcatuṣṭayam ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayā saṃsthāpitā prabho |
tatprabhāvān mayā labdho bhartāyaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||
śāśvataś cākṣayaś caiva sukhaprekṣyaś ca sarvadā ||
iti padmapurāṇīyanāgarakhaṇde pañcapiṇḍikāgaurīvratam |
guḍena tuṣyate devī pārvatī sarvamaṅgalā |
yāvat paśyāmi (?) pratyūṣaṃ tāvad gaurīcatuṣṭayam ||
[498] jātaratnamayaṃ tac ca mayā tatparivarjitam |
prasthitā tat samādāya parikṣeptuṃ jalāśaye ||
guḍapūpās tu dātavyā māsi bhādrapade tu yā |
tṛtīyā pāyasenāpi vāmadevasya prītaye ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ guḍatṛtīyāvratam |
sādhyā dvādaś proktāḥ brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt |
mano’numantā prāṇaś ca narayānaś ca vīryavān |
vittir hayo nayaś caiva haṃso nārāyaṇas tathā ||
prabhavo viṣṇur viśvaś ca sādhyā dvādaśa yajñire |
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahābhāga pūjayet tān upoṣitaḥ ||
pratitṛtīyāyāṃ yāvad varṣaṃ sopavāsa iti śeṣaḥ |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktadvādaśāhayajñaphalāvāptitṛtīyāvratam |
tṛtīyāyāṃ tathābhyarcya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān |
pṛthak pṛthak nāma mantrair naivedyādi nivedayet ||
trīn lokāṃś ca tadā nāma samyak saṃpūjayen naraḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ mahad āpnoti gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
[499]
iti viṣṇudharmoktam aiśvaryatṛtīyāvratam |
tṛtīyā śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇā yā syāt śravaṇasaṃyutā |
śrāvaṇe ‘tra paurṇamāsyanto māso grāhyaḥ ataḥ śrāvaṇakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāḥ śravaṇayuktatvaṃ na durghaṭam |
tasyāṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ tuṣṭim agyām avāpnuyāt |
pūjādipraṇavādinamo’ntair nāmamantraiḥ |
iti viṣṇudharmoktatuṣṭiprāptitṛtīyāvratam |
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe (?) tu tṛtīyāyām upoṣitaḥ |
akṣayaṃ phalam āpnoti sarvasya sukṛtasya tu ||
sā tathā kṛtikopetā viśeṣeṇa ca pūjitā |
tatra dattaṃ ca japaṃ ca sarvam akṣayam ucyate ||
akṣayā sā tithis tasmāt tasyāṃ sukṛtam akṣayam |
akṣataiḥ pūjito viṣṇus tena sāthākṣatā smṛtā ||
akṣatais tu naraḥ snāto viṣṇor datvā tathākṣatān |
śaktūn susaṃskṛtāṃś caiva hutvā caiva tathākṣatān ||
vipreṣu datvā tān eva tathā śaktūn susaṃskṛtān |
pakvānnaṃ tu mahābhāga phalam akṣayam aśnute ||
ekām apy uktāṃ yaḥ kṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ bhṛgunandana |
etāvat tu tṛtīyānāṃ sarvāsāṃ tu phalaṃ labhet ||
[500]
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam akṣayaphalāvāpti akṣayatṛtīyāvratam |
īśvara uvāca |
phalatṛtīyāṃ yā nārī kurute tatra bhāvitā |
varṣam ekaṃ site pakṣe devīṃ pūjya vidhānataḥ ||
phalāni brāhmaṇe dadyād abhīṣṭāni ca yāni tu |
phalāni varjayen naktam atrātti surasundari ||
niṣpāvānāḍhakīṃ mudgān māṣāṃś caiva kulatthikān |
masūrān rājamāṣāṃś ca godhūmāṃs tripuṭāṃs tathā ||
caṇakān vartulān vāpi mukuṭāṃ bhaktito ‘ttijaḥ |
naro vā yadi vā nārī yāvad gaurīvrataṃ caret ||
tasyāḥ puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye kathyamānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhe tasya na kadācit kṣayaṃ vrajet ||
duḥkhitā durbhagā dīnā sadā janmani no bhavet |
kathānakaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ devyā māhātmyasaṃyutam ||
kṛtapātakanāśāya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||
iti padmapurāṇīyaprabhāsakhaṇḍoktaṃ phalatṛtīyāvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya sakalakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
vratakhaṇḍe tṛtīyāvratāni |
[501]
atha caturthīvratāni
anāthalokoddharaṇaikabandhur
agaṇyapuṇyāmṛtasārasindhuḥ |
hemādrir ajñānasamudrasetuṃ
brūte caturtho vratam iṣṭahetuḥ
skanda uvāca |
kena bhogān avāpnoti nirvighnaṃ purasūdana |
putrapautrāṃs tathārogyaṃ vratenāpnoti śaṅkara ||
īśvara uvāca |
purā devāsure yuddhe asurair nirjitā raṇe |
śakrādyā devatāḥ sarvās tripurāvāsibhir yadā ||
tadā vivarṇavadanās te sarve mām upāgatāḥ |
trāhi trāhi vadantas te mayāpy āśvāsitās tadā ||
vighnair upahatānāṃ ca samādiṣṭaṃ vrataṃ mayā |
tat kṛtaṃ tais tadā skanda teṣāṃ tuṣṭo gaṇādhipaḥ ||
gaṇeśena tu tuṣṭena vighnānāṃ saṃkṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
skanda uvāca |
vidhinā kena deveśa vram etan mahāphalam |
kṛtaṃ bhavati deveśa tan me brūhi vṛṣadhvaja ||
īśvara uvāca |
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi site pakṣe tu ṣaṇmukha |
[502] caturthyāṃ niyamaṃ gṛhya vighneśaṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
puṣpair gandhaiś ca naivedyaiḥ laḍḍukaiś ca susaṃskṛtaiḥ |
palalais tilapiṣṭaiś ca tathā sohālakaiḥ prabhum ||
palalaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ṣaḍ ete piṣṭādimayāḥ |
pūjayitvā vidhānena prārthayet tatra mānavaḥ ||
tvatprasādena deveśa vrataṃ vratacatuṣṭayam |
nirvighnena tu me yā tu pramāṇaṃ tu khagdhvaja ||
saṃsārārṇavadustāraṃ sarvavighnasamākulam |
tasmād dhyānajagannātha trāhi māṃ gaṇanāyaka ||
evaṃ prārthya gaṇādhyakṣaṃ bhuñjīyād vāgyatas tataḥ |
evaṃ krameṇa saṃpūjya ekabhakto narottamaḥ ||
gaṇeśaṃ manasā dhyāyaṃs tato rātrau svaped budhaḥ |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā caturthīvrataṃ ṣaṇmukha ||
tato mārgaśire māsi vidhinā tasya pūjanam |
naktāśī ca bhavet tadvad yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ punaḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe tu saṃprāpte tathaivāyācito bhavet |
ayācitenābdam ekaṃ tato mārgaśire punaḥ ||
ārabhyopavased abdam ekaṃ tadvac ca pūjanam |
evaṃ krameṇa vidhivac catvāry abdāni mānavaḥ ||
samāpya tu tato hy ante vratasnato mahāvrata |
kārayed dhemaghaṭitaṃ svaśaktyākhurathaṃ śubham ||
[503] ākhurathaṃ gaṇeśam | tadrūpaṃ viṣṇudharmottarāt |
vināyakas tu kartavyo gajavaktraś caturbhujaḥ |
śūlarkṣaṃ cākṣamālā ca tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ||
pātraṃ codakapūrṇaṃ ca paraśuṃ caiva vāmataḥ |
dambhaś cāsya na kartavyo vāmo ripuniṣūdana ||
pādapīṭhakṛtaḥ pādodakaś cāmanago bhavet |
lambodaras tathā kāryas tantukarṇaś ca yādava ||
vyāghracarmadharaḥ sarpavyālayajñopavītavān |
kārayed varṇakaiḥ śubhrair aravindaṃ sapatrakam ||
tasyopari ghaṭaṃ sthāpya tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam |
pūrayet śubhraśāleyais tandulair eva vā khaga ||
tasyopari nyased devaṃ vāsobhir veṣṭya suvrata |
pūjayet puṣpadhūpādyair naivedyair vividhais tathā |
modakaiś ca tataḥ śubhraiḥ pakvānnair gṛtapācitaiḥ ||
naivedyaṃ kalpayet tatra gaṇeśaḥ prīyatām iti |
jāgaraṃ kārayed vidvān gītavāditranisvanaiḥ |
purāṇākhyāpanaṃ caiva tāṃ rātriṃ kṣapayed budhaḥ ||
prabhāte vimale snāto homakāryāṇi kārayet |
tilavrīhiyavaiś caiva tathā siddhārthakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
oṃ gaṇeśāya svāhā | oṃ gaṇapataye svāhā | oṃ meghavarṇāya svāhā | oṃ kūṣmāṇḍāya svāhā | oṃ tripurāntakāya svāhā | oṃ ekadantāya svāha | oṃ lambodarāya svāhā | oṃ rukmadaṃṣṭrāya [504] svāhā | oṃ vighneśvarāya svāhā | oṃ brahmaṇe svāhā | oṃ indrāya svāhā | oṃ yamāya svāhā | oṃ varuṇāya svāhā | oṃ somāya svāhā | oṃ gaṇeśaparameṣṭhine svāha | gaṇapatimantreṇa homayet |
aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ hutvā tato vyāhṛtibhir hunet |
yāvat śakyaṃ mahābāho tato homaṃ samāpyate ||
tatas tam arcayed vidvān ācāryaṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ |
vastrair ābharaṇair divyaiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet ||
tatpatnyai puruṣo bhaktyā ratnair ābharaṇaiḥ subhaiḥ |
śayyā deyā tato rājan sopadhānāṃ saluḍḍukām ||
gāṃ savatsāṃ tato dadyāt sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām |
prīyatāṃ gaṇanātho ‘tra iti mantram udāharet ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhyaktyā caturviṃśatisaṃkhyayā |
tebhyas tu karakān dadyāt tilapātrasamanvitān ||
anena vidhinā yas tu karoti vratam uttamam |
na vighnair abhibhūyeta gaṇanāthaprasādataḥ ||
yaḥ karoti samārambhaṃ nirvighnaṃ tatphalapradam |
pūrvaṃ tathā kṛtaṃ sarvair indrādyais tridaśair vibho ||
rudreṇa brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ viṣṇunā ca purā kṛtam |
anyaiś caiva mahīpālai rājabhir bahubhiḥ kṛtam ||
etad eva vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ manuṣyair bhūtale mune |
anena kriyamāṇena na vighnair abhibhūyate |
svargalokāt paribhraṣṭas tato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
[505]
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ sopadhānaṃ kṛcchracaturthīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tadā |
caitrasyāmalapakṣe tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
caturthyāṃ vāsudevasya kṛtvā saṃpūjanaṃ śubham |
kāñcanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād dvijāya brahmacāriṇe ||
tathā saṅkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā jagadgurum |
vaiśākhe tu gṛhasthāya dadyāc chayyāṃ susaṃskṛtām ||
saṃpūjya devaṃ pradyumnaṃ jyaiṣṭhe māsi yathāvidhi |
vanasthāya tadā dadyāt phalamūlaṃ tu gorasam |
aniruddhaṃ yathāṣāḍhe pūjayitvā jagadgurum ||
dadyād alābupātraṃ tu yogasthāya dvijāya tu |
ity eva pāraṇaṃ proktaṃ svargaloke mahīyate ||
dvitīye pāraṇe prāpte śakraloke mahīyate |
sālokam āyāty atha keśavasya
prāpte tṛtīye tv atha pāraṇā syāt |
pāraṇatrayavidhānād vratāvṛttiḥ |
ity āśramāṇāṃ vratam uttamaṃ te
mayeritaṃ kalmaṣanāśakāri |
[506]
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam āśramavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
caturātmā hariḥ proktaś catvāraś ca hutāśanāḥ ||
āhitāgnir dvijo yasya vidyate ‘gnicatuṣṭayam |
sopavāsaś caturthyāṃ tu śuklapakṣasya phālgune ||
abhyarcya caturātmānaṃ vāsudevam atandritam |
tasmai dadyād dvijendrāya tilapasthāni ṣoḍaśa ||
suvarṇasya suvarṇaṃ ca vastraṃ ghṛtatulām api |
suvarṇaṃ karṣonam |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratam etad atandritaḥ |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute ||
vimānenārkavarṇena svargalokaṃ ca gacchati |
manuṣyo dīptatejāḥ syād dīptāgniḥ pramadāpriyaḥ ||
ripūn jayati saṃgrāme dhanavāṃś ca tathā bhavet |
ye tv agnayo vai caturapraviṣṭāḥ
sa vāsudevaḥ kathitaś caturdhā |
yaḥ pūjayed brāhmaṇam āhitāgnir
devaḥ sa tenāpy atha pūjitaḥ syāt ||
[507]
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam agnivratam |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ||
vāsudevāṃśakāj jātāḥ sarve devagaṇā nṛpa |
adhikena tu deśena sādhyā jātās tathā surāḥ ||
tatrāpi vādhikāṃśena caturātmā hariḥ smṛtaḥ |
naro nārāyaṇaś caiva hariḥ kṛṣṇaś ca vīryavān ||
caturātmā harir jāto gṛhadharmasya yādava |
ādityeṣu tu yāv uktau mitrāvaruṇasaṃjñakau |
tāv eva nānyau jānīhi harikṛṣṇau ca yādava ||
ādityeṣu tu yāv uktau śakraviṣṇū surottamau |
tāv eva siddhasādhyeṣu naranārayaṇau punaḥ ||
caitraśuklacaturthyāṃ tu sopavāsas tu pūjayet |
deveśaṃ caturātmānaṃ vittaśaktyā narādhipa ||
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā pūrṇadvādaśavatsaram |
na durgatim avāpnoti mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati ||
tataḥ samāsādya vaniprabhutvaṃ
pareṇa puṃsā samasatvam eti |
sarveśvaraś cāpratimaprabhāvo
vimuktaduḥkho bhuvanasya goptā ||
[508]
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ caturmūrtivratam |
śuka uvāca |
caturthyaṅgārakadine yadā bhavati bhārata |
mṛdā snānaṃ tadā kuryāt padmarāgavibhūṣitaḥ ||
agnir mūrdhā divo mantraṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhed udaṅmukhaḥ |
śūdras tūṣṇījapaṃ bhaumam āste bhogavivarjitaḥ ||
athāstamita āditye gomayenopalipya ca |
prāṅgaṇaṃ puṣpamālābhir akṣatābhiḥ samantataḥ ||
abhyarcyābhilikhet padmaṃ kuṅkumenāṣṭapatrakam |
kuṅkumasyāpy abhāve tu raktacandanam iṣyate ||
catvāraḥ karakāḥ kāryā bhakṣyabhojyasamanvitāḥ |
taṇḍulai raktaśāleyaiḥ padmarāgaiś ca saṃyutāḥ ||
catuḥkoṇeṣu tān kṛvā phalāni vividhāni ca |
gandhamālyādikaṃ sarvaṃ tathaiva vinivedayet ||
suvarṇaśṛṅgī kapilām athārcya
raupyaiḥ khuraiḥ kāṃsyadohāṃ savastrām |
dhurandharaṃ raktam atīva saumyaṃ
dhānyāni saptāvarasaṃyutāni ||
sapta dhānyāni, yavagodhūmadhānyakam |
kaṅguśyāmā caṇakacīnakāni
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ tathaiva |
[509] sauvarṇam atyāyatabāhudaṇḍam
caturbhujaṃ hemamaye viviṣṭam |
pātre guḍasyopari sarpiṣāyutam ||
sāmasvarajñāya jitendriyāya
pātrāya śīlatrayasaṃbhavāya |
dātavyam etat sakalaṃ dvijāya
kuṭumbine naiva ca dambhayukte ||
bhūmiputra mahātejaḥ svedodbhava pinākinaḥ |
rūpārthī tvāṃ prapanno ‘haṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo ‘stu te ||
mantreṇānena datvārghyaṃ raktacandanavāriṇā |
tato ‘rcayed vipravaraṃ raktamālyāmbarādibhiḥ ||
dadyān mantreṇa tenaiva bhaumaṃ gomithunānvitam |
śayyāṃ ca śaktito dadyāt sarvopaskarasaṃyutām ||
yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ loke yac cāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe |
tat tad guṇavate deyaṃ tad evākṣayam icchatā ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā visarjya dvijapuṅgavaḥ |
naktam akṣāralavaṇam aśnīyād ghṛtasaṃyutam |
śaktyā yas tu pumān kuryād evam aṅgārakāṣṭakam ||
aṅgārakāṣṭakam iti aṅgārakacaturthyaṣṭakam |
caturo vātha vā tasya yat puṇyaṃ tad vadāmi te ||
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpannaḥ punar janmani janmani |
vaiṣṇavo ‘tha śivo bhaktaḥ saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ||
suptakalpasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate |
[510]
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ aṅgārakacaturthīvratam |
brahmovāca |
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kuryāc caturthyāṃ sarvakarmasu |
avighnaṃ suraloke ca gatim iṣṭāṃ prayacchati ||
karmasv aviduṣaṃ vighnaṃ kuryāc caiva na saṃśayaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ karmaṇām ādau tataḥ pūjyo gaṇādhipaḥ ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
tithīśvaro ‘tra gaṇeṣaḥ | tadrūpaprakāras tu kṛcchracaturthīvrate vilokanīyaḥ
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homo yas tu śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ gaṇeśavratam |
sūta uvāca |
caturthyāṃ na tu bhuñjīta snātvā nadyāṃ nṛpottama |
[511] raktāmbaradharo bhūtvā raktagandhānulepanaḥ ||
raktacitto gaṇādhīśaṃ vināyakam athārcayet |
raktacandanatoyena snānapūrvavidhānataḥ ||
vilipya raktagandhena raktapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet |
tato ‘sau dattavān bhūyaḥ sājyayuktaṃ ca candanam ||
naivedyaṃ caiva hāridraguḍakhaṇḍaṃ ghṛtaplutam |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ pūjyaṃ vināyakam atha stuvan ||
namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ stoṣye ‘haṃ tvāṃ vināyakam |
mahāgaṇapatiṃ śūram añcitaṃ jayavardhanam ||
ekadantaṃ dvidantaṃ ca caturdantaṃ caturbhujam |
akṣatriśūlahastaṃ ca raktanetraṃ varapradam ||
āvikeyaṃ śaṅkuvarṇaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ daṇḍanāyakam |
āraktaṃ daṇḍinaṃ caiva vahnivaktraṃ hutapriyam ||
anarcito vighnakaraḥ sarvakāryeṣu yo nṛṇām |
taṃ namāmi gaṇādhyakṣaṃ bhīmam ugram umāsutam ||
madamattaṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhavavaktasamudbhavam |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ rakāñjanasamaprabham ||
budhaṃ suniścalaṃ śāntaṃ namasyāmi vināyakam ||
namo ‘stu brahmarūpāya viṣṇurūpāya te namaḥ |
namo ‘stu gajarūpāya gajānāṃ pataye namaḥ |
merumandararūpāya namaḥ kailāsavāsine ||
namo vighnavināśāya namas te brahmacāriṇe |
[512] bhaktastutāya devāya namas tubhyaṃ vināyaka |
tvayā purāṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye ||
gajarūpaṃ samākhyāya trāsitāḥ sarvadānavāḥ |
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtāḥ sarve manorathāḥ ||
yatas tataḥ surair agryaiḥ pūjyase tvaṃ bhavātmaja |
tvām ārādhya gaṇādhyakṣaṃ sarvajñaṃ kāmarūpiṇam ||
kāryārthaṃ raktakusumaiḥ raktacandanavāribhiḥ |
raktāmbaradharo bhūtvā caturthyām arjayej japan ||
trikālam ekakālaṃ vā niyato niyatātmanāḥ |
rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā rājamantriṇam eva ca ||
rājyaṃ vā sarvavighneśo vaśī kuryāt sarāṣṭrakam |
avighnaṃ kuru me nityaṃ kuru vighnavināyaka ||
mayā tvaṃ saṃstato bhaktyā pūjitaś ca viśeṣataḥ |
tat phalaṃ sarvam āpnoti stutvā devaṃ vināyakam |
viṣamaṃ na bhavet tasya na ca gacchet parābhavam ||
na ca vighno bhavet tasya jāto jātismaro bhavet |
ya idaṃ paṭhati stotraṃ ṣaḍbhir māsair varaṃ labhet ||
saṃvatsareṇa siddhiṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti narasiṃhapurāṇoktaṃ gaṇeśacaturthīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
śivā śāntāsu strī rājan caturthī trividhā smṛtā |
[513] māsi bhādrapade śuklā śivā lokeśapūjitā ||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tathā dānam upavāso japas tathā |
kriyamāṇaṃ śataguṇaṃ prasādād dantino nṛpa ||
guḍalavaṇaghṛtānāṃ tu dānaṃ śubhakaraṃ smṛtam |
guḍapūpās tathā vīra puṇyaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
caturthyāṃ naraśārdūla pūjayeta sadā striyaḥ (?) |
guḍalavaṇapūjābhiḥ śvaśruśvaśuramātaraḥ ||
tāḥ sarvāḥ subhagāḥ syur vai vighneśasyānumodanāt |
kanyakāś ca viśeṣeṇa vidhinānena pūjayet ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śivācaturthīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
māghamāsi tathā śuklā yā caturthī mahīpate |
sā sarvaśāntidā nityām śāntiṃ kuryāt sadaiva hi ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ baliḥ karma sarvam asyāṃ kṛtaṃ vibho |
bhavet sahasraguṇitaṃ prasādād dantinaḥ sadā ||
kṛtvopavāsaṃ yas tasyāṃ pūjayed vighnanāyakam |
tasyāṃ homādikaṃ karma bhavet sāhasrikaṃ nṛpa ||
lavaṇaṃ guḍapūrṇaṃ ca ghṛtāktaṃ tac ca bhārata |
datvā bhakte tu vighneśaṃ phalaṃ sāhasrikaṃ labhet ||
[514] viśeṣataḥ striyo rājan pūjayet svaguruṃ nṛpa |
guḍalavaṇaghṛtair vīra sadāsyāṃ kurunandana ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śānticaturthīvratam |
sumanatur uvāca |
sukhāvahāṃ śṛṇu sukhāṃ saubhāgyakaraṇīṃ śubhām |
caturthīṃ kuruśārdūla rūpasaubhāgadāṃ śūbhām ||
sukhavrataṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ rūpārogyapradāyakam |
susūkṣmaṃ sukaraṃ dhanyam idaṃ puṇyaṃ sukhāvaham ||
paratra phaladaṃ vīra divyarūpapradāyakam |
vilāsaṃ vibhram ākṣepaṃ hasitaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ śubham ||
sukhavratena sarvaṃ syāt śubhaṃ kurukulo haha (?) |
kṛtapūje tu deveśe vipreśaśivayoḥ sute ||
yadā śuklacaturthyāṃ tu vāro bhaumasya bhāg bhavet |
tadā sā sukhadā jñeyā caturthī vai sukheti ca ||
purā maithunam āśritya sthitābhyāṃ tu hinācale (?) |
bhīmomābhyāṃ mahābhāho ravir induś cyutaḥ kṣitau ||
medinyā suprayatnena sukhena tu bhṛto yathā |
[515] jātas tasyāṃ mahāvīra rakto raktasamudbhavaḥ ||
umayā ārtavotpannas tasmād aṅgārako hy ayam |
aṅgado ‘ṅgārakāntiś ca aṅgānāṃ tu sadā nṛpa ||
saubhāgyādikaro yasmāt tasmād aṅgārako mataḥ |
bhaktyā caturthīṃ naktena yo vai śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
upoṣyati naro rājan nārī vānanyamānasā |
pūjayec ca kujaṃ bhaktyā raktapuṣpavilepanaḥ ||
aṅgārakasvarūpaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇamatsyapurāṇoktāṅgārakacaturthīvrate draṣṭavyam |
gaṇeśaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
sa tu tuṣṭaḥ prayaccheta saubhāgyaṃ rūpasaṃpadam ||
pūrvaṃ tu kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi |
gṛhītvā mṛttikāṃ vande mantreṇānena bhārata ||
iha tvaṃ vanditā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇenoddharatā kila |
tasmān me daha pāpmānaṃ yan mayā pūrvasaṃcitam ||
imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan vīra ādityāya pradarśayet |
ādityaraśmibhiḥ pūtāṃ gaṅgājalakaṇocitām ||
datvā mṛdaṃ śirasi tāṃ sarvāṅgeṣu niyojayet |
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta mantrapūrvaṃ jale śubhe ||
yūyam āpaḥ stha sarveṣāṃ daityadānavasaṃcitāḥ |
svedāṇḍajodbhidānāṃ ca jarāyūṇāṃ ca yonayaḥ ||
[516] snāto ‘haṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvapraśravaṇeṣu ca |
tathā kāśyāditīrtheṣu mānasādisaraḥsu ca ||
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu snāto ‘haṃ teṣu teṣu vai |
dhyāyan paṭhann imaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
tataḥ snātaḥ śucir bhūto gṛham āgatya ca spṛśet |
darvāśvatthaśamīḥ spṛṣṭvā gāṃ ca mantreṇa mantravit ||
dūrvāṃ namontamantreṇa aśvatthaśamayas tathā |
gāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tato devīṃ vandyād vīra pradakṣiṇam ||
samālabhya tu hastena tato mantram udīrayet |
sarvadevamayī devī nirṛtis tvaṃ prapūjitā |
tasmāt spṛśāmi vande tvāṃ vanditā pāpahā bhava ||
nato maunena cāgacchad vanditā gṛhadevatā |
prakṣālya ca mṛdā pādāv ācānto ‘gnigṛhaṃ viśet ||
homaṃ tatra prakurvīta etair mantrapadair varaiḥ |
sarvāya sarvaputrāya pārvatīyasutāya ca ||
kujāya lohitāṅgāya graheśāṅgārakāya ca |
oṃkārapūrvakair mantraiḥ svāhākārasamanvitaiḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vīra ardhamātrārdham eva ca |
etair mantrapadair bhaktyā kāmato ‘kāmato nṛpa ||
khādirībhiḥ samadbhiś ca ājyadigdhair (?) yavais tilaiḥ |
bhakṣyair nānāvidhaiś cānyaiḥ śaktyā bhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
[517] kṛtvā homaṃ tato vīra devaṃ saṃsthāpayet kṣitau |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ bhadradārumayaṃ nṛpa ||
devadārumayaṃ vāpi śrīkhaṇḍaghaṭitaṃ tathā ||
bhadradāruḥ śaralaḥ |
gāṅgeyapātre raupye vā arcyaḥ kuṅkumakesaraiḥ |
anyiar vā lohitair bhavyaiḥ patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalair api ||
raktaiś ca vividhair vīra atha vā bhaktitaś caret |
yāvad dhi vibhṛtaṃ vittaṃ cittaṃ ca vīra śaktitaḥ ||
tāvad vivardhate puṇyaṃ dātuḥ śatasahasrakam |
yad vā tāmramaye pātre vaṃśaje mṛnmaye ‘tha vā |
pūjayeta naro bhaktyā śaktyā kuṅkumakesaraiḥ ||
oṃ aṅgārakāya namaḥ pādau | oṃ kuñjarāya namaḥ vadanam | oṃ bhīmāya namaḥ skandhayoḥ | oṃ maṅgalāya namaḥ bāhvoḥ | oṃ vajrāya namaḥ ūrvoḥ | oṃ svedajāya namaḥ jaṅghayoḥ | namaḥ nikhāyām |
