puruṣākṛtiṃ kubjapātre etair mantrapadair yajet |
bhūmiputra mahādeva svedodbhava pinākinaḥ |
rūpārthī tvāṃ prapanno ‘haṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo ‘stu te ||
arghamantraḥ |
mahādevāṅgasaṃbhūta medinīgarbhasaṃbhava |
aṅgāraka mahārāja lohitāṅga namo ‘stu te ||
[518] prārthanāmantraḥ |
sugandhapuṣpadhūpādyair brāhmaṇo yaḥ prapūjayet (?) |
guḍodanaghṛtakṣīragodhūmān śālitaṇḍulān ||
apekṣya śaktiṃ dravyād vai brāhmaṇebhyo yatendriyaḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta vidyamāne dhane nṛpa |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca kurvāṇo nāmutra phalabhāg bhavet ||
śatānīka uvāca |
aṅgārakeṇa saṃyuktā caturthī naktabhojanaiḥ |
upoṣyāḥ katisaṃkhyās tu utāho sakṛd eva hi ||
sumantur uvāca |
caturthī tu caturthī tu yadāṅgārakasaṃyutā |
upoṣya tatra tatraiva pradeyo vidhivat kujaḥ ||
upoṣya naktena vibho catasraḥ kujasaṃyutāḥ |
caturthyāṃ tu caturthyāṃ tu vidhānaṃ śṛṇu yādṛśam ||
ekaś caturthīśabdaḥ tithiviśeṣavacanaḥ, aparas tatsaṃkhyāpara iti |
daśasauvarṇike mukhyaṃ daśārdhārdhaṃ yathāpi vā |
sauvarṇapātre raupye vā bhaktyā tāmramaye ‘pi vā ||
viṃśatpalāni pātrāṇi viṃśatyarthapalāni ca |
viṃśatkarṣāṇi vā vīra ato hīnaṃ na kārayet ||
śaktyā vittasya bhaktyā ca pātre tāmramaye ‘pi vā |
pratiṣṭhāpya kuñjapātre raktavastreṇa veṣṭayet ||
[519] puṣpamaṇḍayikāṃ kṛtvā divyair dhūpais tu dhūpitām |
tattatstham arcayed devaṃ pūrvamantraiḥ krameṇa tu ||
bakṣyabhojyair anekaiś ca phalair anyaiś ca saṃmataiḥ |
vastraiḥ prāvaraṇaiḥ pātraiḥ śayyopānadvarāsanaiḥ ||
chatraiḥ puṣpair gandhavaraiḥ śaktyā vittānusārataḥ |
brāhmaṇāya ca taṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ nṛpa ||
vācakāya mahābāho guṇine śreyasena ca |
aṅgārakena saṃyuktāṃ dhenuṃ śīlasamanvitām ||
anena vidhinā datvā yathoktaphalabhāg bhavet |
iti te kathitā purāṇa purāṇa (?) tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
yām upoṣya naro rūpaṃ divyam āpnoti bhārata |
kāntyātreyasamaṃ vīra tejasā ravisaprabham ||
prabhayā harituḷyaṃ ca sarvato valasasmitaḥ |
īdṛgrūpaṃ varaṃ prāpya yāti sīmasado nṛpa ||
prasādād vighnarājasya gaṇeśasy gaṇāyate |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan karvatāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ |
brahmahatyādipāpāni kṣīyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || iti |
iti bhaviṣtatpurāṇoktaṃ sukhavratam |
caturthyāṃ tu mahārāja nirāhāro vratānvitaḥ |
datvā tilānnaṃ bhuṅkte yaḥ svayaṃ bhuṅkte tilodanam ||
[520] divā nirāhāro rātrau bhuṅkte iti virodhaparihāraḥ |
varṣadvaye samāsiddhir vrātasya tu yadā bhavet |
vināyakaṃ tasya tuṣṭo dadāti phalam īpsitam ||
iti bhaviṣtatpurāṇoktaṃ gaṇapaticaturthīvratam |
skanda uvāca |
kena vratena bhagavan saubhāgyam atulaṃ bhavet |
putrapautradhanaiśvaryaṃ manujaḥ sukham edhate ||
tan me vada mahādeva vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yena cīrṇena deveśa naro rājyaṃ ca vindati ||
rājñīva jāyate nārī api dāsīkulodbhavā |
rājaputro jayec śatrūn garuḍaḥ pannagān iva ||
brāhmaṇo brahmavarcastvaṃ prāpya sarvārcako bhavet |
varṇāśramavihīno ‘pi so ‘pi siddhiṃ ca vindati ||
īśvara uvāka |
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
apūrvaṃ gaṇapater vrataṃ yat trailokyaviśrutam ||
bhagavatyā purā cīrṇaṃ pārvatyā padmayā saha |
sarasvatyā mahendreṇa viṣṇunā dhanadena ca ||
anyaiś ca devair munibhir gandharvaiḥ kinnarais tathā |
[521] cīrṇam etad vrataṃ sarvaiḥ purākalpe ṣaḍānana |
caturthī yā bhaved uktā nabhomāsasya puṇyadā ||
tasyāṃ vratam idaṃ kuryāt kārtikyāṃ vā ṣaḍānana |
gajānanaṃ caturbāhum ekadantaṃ vipāṭinam ||
vipāṭinaṃ madadārāsrāviṇam | āyudhāni kṛcchracaturthī vratavad vidhāya hemnā vighneśaṃ hemapītāsanasthitam |
tathā haimīm atho dūrvyāṃ tadādhāre vyavasthitām |
tadādhāre vighneśāsane |
saṃsthāpya vighnahantāraṃ kalase tāmrabhājane |
veṣṭitaṃ raktavastreṇa sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ||
pūjayec chuklakusumaiḥ patrikābhiś ca pañcabhiḥ |
bilvapatram apāmārgaśamīdarvyaharipriyā ||
haripriyā tulasī | etā eva pañcapatrikāḥ |
anyaiḥ sugandhakusumaiḥ patrikābhiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
phalaiś ca modakaiḥ paścād upahāraṃ prakalpayet |
yathāvad upacāraiś ca pūjayed girijāsutam ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
umāsuta namas tubhyaṃ viśvavyāpi sanātana |
vighnaughaṃ chindi sakalam arghyaṃ pādyaṃ dadāmi te ||
[522] arghyamantraḥ |
gaṇeśvarāya devāya umāputrāya vedhase |
pūjām atha prayacchāmi gṛhāṇa bhagavan namaḥ ||
gandhamantraḥ |
gaṇeśvarāya devāya varadāya gajānane (?) |
umāsutāya devāya kumāragurave namaḥ |
lambodarāya vīrāya sarvavighnavihāriṇe ||
puṣpamantraḥ |
umāmaṅgalasadbhūtai (?) dānavānāṃ vadhāya vai |
anugrahāya lokānāṃ sa devaḥ pātu vaiśvadhṛk ||
dhūpamantraḥ |
paraṃjyotiḥprakāśāya sarvasiddhipradāya ca |
dīpaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi mahādevātmane namaḥ ||
dīpamantraḥ |
gaṇānāṃ ca gaṇapatim iva mahākaviṃ kavīnām |
upamantravaśravaṃ jyeṣṭha rāgaṃ brahmaṇāṃ brahmaṇasyātiśrāṇaṃ śṛṇvan jyotibhiḥ siddhadasādanam |
upahāramantraḥ |
gaṇeśvara gaṇādhyakṣa gaurīputra gajānana |
vrataṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu tvatprasādādim ārthinā ||
[523] prārthanāmantraḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vighneśaṃ yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ |
sopaskaraṃ gaṇādhyakam ācāryāya nivedayet ||
gṛhāṇa bhagavan brahman gaṇarāja pradakṣiṇam |
vrataṃ tadvacanād adya saṃpūrṇaṃ yātu suvrata ||
dānamantraḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ pañcavarṣāṇi kṛtvodyāpanam ācaret |
īpsitāṃl labhate kāmān dedānte śāṅkaraṃ padam ||
atha vā śuklaprajñasya caturthyāṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
kuryād varṣatrayaṃ caivaṃ sarvasiddhim avāpnuyāt ||
udyāpnaṃ vināyakasya karoti vratam uttamam |
tena śuklatilaiḥ kāryaṃ prātaḥsnānaṃ ṣaḍānana ||
hemnā vā rajatenāpi kṛtvā gaṇapatiṃ budhaḥ |
pañcagavyais tu saṃsnāpya dūrvābhiḥ saṃprapūjayet ||
mantrais tu daśabhir bhaktyā dūrvāyuktaiḥ śikhidhvaja |
dūrvāyuktaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snapanaṃ dūrvāyuktair daśabhir mantraiḥ pūjā ekasya mantrasya daśatvam |
ity evaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham |
vrataṃ dūrvāgaṇapateḥ kim anyac chrotum icchasi ||
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ dūrvāgaṇapativratam |
bharaṇyāṃ tu caturthyāṃ tu śanaiśvaradine yamam |
[524] pūjayan saptajanmotthair mucyate pātakair naraḥ ||
iti kūrmapurāṇoktaṃ yamavratam |
agastyaḥ |
atha vighnaharaṃ rājan kathayāmi tavānagha |
yena samyak kṛteneha na vighnam upajāyate ||
caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi grahītavyaṃ vrataṃ tv idam |
naktāhāreṇa rājendra tilānnaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam ||
pāraṇaṃ naktabhojanam |
tad eva vahnau hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca tad bhavet |
divyāya śūrāya gajānanāya
daṃṣṭrākarālāya namaḥ śivāya |
nagātmajādehamalodbhavāya
kumārahastāya nabhaścarāya ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya manubhir homaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi |
manubhir mantraiḥ |
ekasyaiva vṛthā bahutvaṃ bravīmi tat homaṃ bravīmi homamantro homadravyaṃ ca tad eva vahnau hotavyaṃ ityādinoktaṃ vartamānasamīpe vartamānavadihātīte laṭ |
caturmāsavrataṃ caiva kṛtvetthaṃ pañcame tathā |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi kṛtvā viprāya dāpayet ||
[525] tāmrapātre pāyasādyaiś caturbhiḥ sahitaṃ nṛpa |
pañcamena tilaiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṇaśāntikareṇa ca ||
mṛṇmayāni haridrais tu vidhinānena kārayet |
homaṃ ca rājataṃ śaktyā vidhinānena dāpayet ||
itthaṃ vratam idaṃ kṛtvā sarvavighnāt sa mucyate |
hayamedhasya yajñe tu saṃjāte sagaraḥ purā ||
etad eva haraś cakre tripuraṃ yena hanti ca |
mayā samudramathane tv etad eva vrataṃ kṛtam ||
anyair api mahīpālair etad eva purā kṛtam |
tato nirvighnasiddhyarthaṃ vighnopaśamanaṃ param ||
anena kṛtamātreṇa sarvavighnaiḥ pramucyate |
tato rudrapuraṃ yāti vārāhavacanaṃ yathā ||
vighnāni tasya na bhavanti gṛhe kadācit |
dharmārthakāmasukhasiddhivighātakāni |
yaḥ saptamīnduśakalākṛtikāntadṛptaṃ (?)
vighneśam arcayati naktaṃ kṛtī caturthyām ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktam avighnavināyakavratam |
brahmovāca |
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte caturthī kundasaṃjñitā |
[526] sopoṣyā tu suraśreṣṭha tato rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
sarvopahārasaṃpannaṃ sarvopaskaram āharet |
kandupakvaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ lavaṇaṃ guḍaśarkarā ||
khaṇḍaṃ kustumbarī jīraṃ dhānyāni vividhāni ca |
dātavyāni raghuśreṣṭha kanyakānāṃ tu bhaktitaḥ ||
khaṇḍaṃ śarkarābhedaḥ |
sūryapātraṃ tathā bhāṇḍaṃ mṛṇmayāni viśeṣataḥ |
uddiśya dāpayed devīṃ prīyatāṃ me sadā iti ||
anena vidhinā śakra saubhāgyaṃ putrasantatiḥ |
vardhate nātra saṃdeho nānyathā mama bhāṣitam ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ kundacaturthīvratam |
ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ |
nirvighena tu kāryāṇi kathaṃ sidhyanti sūtaja |
aprasiddhiḥ kathaṃ nṝṇāṃ putrasaubhāgyasaṃpadām ||
dampatyoḥ kalahe caikyaṃ bandhubhede tathā nṛṇāṃ |
udāsīneṣu lokeṣu kathaṃ saṃmukhatā bhavet ||
vidyārambhe tathā nṝṇāṃ vaṇijyāyāṃ kṛṣau tathā |
nṛpateḥ paracakrasya jayasiddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||
kāṃ devatāṃ namaskṛtya pūjāsiddhikarī nṛṇām |
[527] sūta uvāca |
sannaddhayoḥ purā viprāḥ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ |
pṛṣṭavān devakīputraṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
nirvighnena jayo hy eṣāṃ vada deva kathaṃ bhavet |
kāṃ devatāṃ namaskṛtya samagrāṃ hy alabhan mahīm ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
pūjayasva gaṇādhyakṣaṃ vighneśaṃ siddhidāyakam (?) |
tasmin saṃpūjite rājan sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
deva kena vidhānena pūjanārho gaṇādhipaḥ |
pūjitaś ca tithau kasyāṃ siddhido gaṇapo bhavet ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
gajavaktraṃ tu śuklāyāṃ caturthyāṃ pūjayen nṛpa |
yadā votpadyate bhaktir māse pūjyo gaṇādhipaḥ ||
prātaḥ śuklatilaiḥ snātvā madhyāhne pūjayen nṛpa |
svaśaktyā gaṇanāthasya svarṇaraupyāṃ yathākṛtim ||
kṛtvā pūjāṃ prayatnena snāpya pañcāmṛtaiḥ pṛthak |
gaṇādhyakṣeti nāmnā vai gandhaṃ dadyāc ca bhaktitaḥ ||
vināyaketi puṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ comāsuteti ca |
dīpaṃ rudrapriyāyeti naivedyaṃ vighnanāśana ||
vastraṃ sarvaprade raktaṃ puṣpaṃ dadyāt śubhāvṛtam |
tato dūrvāṃ kuśān gṛhya viṃśatiṃ caikam eva ca ||
[528] pūjayeta prayatnena ebhir nāmapadaiḥ pṛthak |
gaṇādhipa namo te ‘stu (?) umāputrāghanāśana ||
vināyakeśaputreti sarvasiddhipradāyaka |
ekadantebhavaktreti namo maṣikavāhana ||
kumāraguravety antaṃ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ |
dūrvāyugmaṃ grahītvā tu gandhayuktaṃ prapūjayet ||
ekaikena ca nāmnā vai pūjya ekena sarvataḥ |
ekena dūrvāṅkureṇa yugmenāvaśiṣṭena | sarvataḥ sarvair nāmabhiḥ pūjā kāryā |
tathaikaviṃśatir gṛhya modakān ghṛtapācitān |
sthāpayitvā gaṇādhyakṣaṃ samīpe kurunandana ||
daśa viprāya dātavyā svayaṃ cādyāt tathā daśa |
ekaṃ gaṇādhipe dadyāt sanaivedyaṃ nṛpottama ||
viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyād bhuñjīyāt tailavarjitam |
kṛtvā naimittikaṃ karma pūjayed iṣṭadevatām ||
evaṃ kṛte dharmarāja vighnanāthasya pūjane |
vijayas te bhaven nyūnaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditaḥ ||
vidyākāmo labhed vidyāṃ dhanakāmo dhanaṃ yathā |
jayaṃ vijayakāmas tu putrārthī vindate sutān ||
patikāmā ca bhartāraṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca suvāsinīm |
vidhavā pūjayitvā tu vaidhavyaṃ nāpnuyāt kvacit ||
vaiṣṇavādyāsu dīkṣāsu ādau pūjyo gaṇādhipaḥ |
yasmin saṃpūjite viṣṇur īśo bhānus tathā umā ||
[529] havyavāhamukhā devāḥ pūjitāḥ syur na saṃśayaḥ |
caṇḍikādyā mātṛgaṇāḥ parituṣṭā bhavanti ca ||
yasmin saṃpūjite bhaktyā viprāḥ siddhivināyake |
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śrāvayed vā samāhitaḥ ||
siddhyanti sarvakāryāṇi siddhidasya prasādataḥ |
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ siddhivināyakavratam |
athāsyām eva bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ kṛtyāntaram |
māsi bhādrapade śuklā śivaloke prapūjitā |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tathā dānam upavāso ‘rcanaṃ tathā |
kiryamāṇaṃ śataguṇaṃ prasādād dattino nṛpa || iti |
caturthīty atrānuṣaṅgaḥ | asyāṃ candradarśanaṃ na kartavyam | ata evoktaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena |
siṃhāditye śūklapakṣe caturthyāṃ candradarśanam |
mithyābhidūṣaṇaṃ kuryāt tasmāt paśyen na taṃ tadā || iti |
parāśarasmṛtāv api |
kanyāditye caturthyāṃ tu śukle candrasya darśanam |
mithyābhidūṣaṇaṃ kuryāt tasmāt paśyen na taṃ tadā ||
atra siṃhādityakanyādityaśabdābhyāṃ cāndro bhādrapad upalabhyate,
[530] sauramāsagrahaṇe śiṣṭācāravirodhaprasaṃgāt | doṣasya śāntaye siṃhaḥ prasenam iti vai paṭhet | sa ca śloko viṣṇupurāṇe |
siṃhaḥ prasenam avadhīt siṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ |
sukumārakam ārodīs tava hy eṣa syamantakaḥ || iti |
atha kārtikaśuklacaturthyāṃ kūrmapurānoktaṃ nāgavratam |
kārttikaśuklapakṣaṃ upakramya |
tithau yugāhvayāyāṃ tu samupoṣya yathāvidhi |
śaṅkhapālādināgānāṃ śeṣasya ca mahātmanaḥ ||
pūjā kāryā puṣagandhakṣīrapyāyanapūrvakam iti | yugāhvayāyāṃ caturthyāṃ prātar madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ ca kartavyam | tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
prātar madhyandine tatra tatropoṣya phaṇīśvarān |
kṣīreṇāpyāyya pañcamyāṃ pārayet prayatā naraḥ |
viṣāṇi tasya naśyanti na taṃ hi santi pannagāḥ ||
iti nāgavratam |
atha mārgaśīrṣaśuklacaturthyām ārabhya skandapurāṇoktaṃ varacaturthīvratam |
caturthyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu śuklapakṣe nṛpottama |
prārabhya pratimāsaṃ ca caturthyāṃ gaṇanāyakam ||
saṃpūjya vidhinā kuryād ekabhaktaṃ samāhitaḥ |
akṣāralavaṇaṃ tv evaṃ pūrṇasaṃvatsare tataḥ ||
[531] dvitīye vatsare cātha naktaṃ praticaturthi ca |
kuryād gaṇeśam abhyarcya tṛtīye ‘yācitaṃ tathā ||
evam eva prakurvīta caturthe syād upoṣaṇam |
tataś caturthaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ tad udyāpanam ācaret |
idaṃ varacaturthyākhyaṃ vrataṃ sarvārthasādhakam ||
iti skandapurāṇokaṃ varacaturthīvratam |
athāsyām eva brahmapurāṇoktaṃ gaurīcaturthīvratam |
umācaturthyāṃ māghe tu śuklāyāṃ yoginīgaṇaiḥ |
prāg bhakṣayitvā sṛṣṭvā ca bhūyaḥ svāṅgāt svakair guṇaiḥ ||
tasmāt sā tatra saṃpūjyā naraiḥ strībhir viśeṣataḥ |
kundapuṣpaiḥ prayatnena samyag bhaktyā samāhitaiḥ ||
kuṅkumālaṃktakābhyāṃ ca raktasūtraiḥ sakaṅkaṇaiḥ |
arghaiḥ puṣpais tathā dhūpair dīpair valibhir eva ca ||
guḍārdhakābhyāṃ panasalavalībhyāṃ ca pālakaiḥ |
pūjyā striyaś ca vidhavās tathā viprāś ca śobhanāḥ ||
saubhāgyavṛddhaye paścād bhāktavyaṃ bandhubhiḥ saha || iti
pālakaiḥ kuṇḍalair mṛdbhāṇḍaviśeṣair ity arthaḥ |
iti gaurīcaturthīvratam |
lavaṇair dhānyakair yuktaṃ jīrakaṃ marīcāni ca |
hiṅguṃ (?) śūṇṭhīṃ haridrāñ ca sarvaṃ parikaraṃ tathā ||
caturthyām ekabhaktāśī sakṛd datvā kuṭumbine |
gṛheṣu saptasu tathā śilāyuktāni bhārata ||
[532] śilā manaḥśilā |
etac chilāvrataṃ nāma lakṣmīlokapradāyakam |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ śilāvratam |
caturthyāṃ naktabhug dadyād abdānte hemavāraṇam |
vāraṇaḥ karī |
vrataṃ vaināyakaṃ nāma sarvavighnopaśāntidam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ vaināyakavratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
vināyakacaturthyākhyaṃ vrataṃ vakṣyāmi te ‘nagha |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ samīhitaphalapradam ||
vighnopaśamanāyālaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam |
priyaṃ gaṇapater nityam ṛṣibhiś cāpy upāsitam ||
mārgaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu grāhyaṃ vratam idaṃ mahat |
naktāhāreṇa viprendra tilānnaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam ||
tad eva vahnau hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadet sadā |
nadyāṃ nade vā naivedyaṃ vighnarājāya saṃyamī ||
pūjayed gaṇapatiṃ rātrau gandhaiḥ puṣpair yathākramam |
sthāpitaṃ kumbhasaṃsthaṃ taṃ sthāpitaṃ kuṅkumāmbhasā ||
[533] sumārgādiṣv atho tais tu nāmabhiś cārcayet tataḥ |
vināyakaś caikadantaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgo gajānanaḥ ||
lambodaro bālacandro (?) herambo vikaṭas tathā |
vakratuṇḍaś cākhuratho vighnarājo gaṇādhipaḥ ||
ity evaṃ māsanāmnā tu japahomam athārcanam |
kṛtvaivaṃ prārthayet paścān mantreṇānena bhaktimān ||
dvaimāturāya vīrāya paraśuhastāya vai namaḥ |
vighneśāyaikadaṃṣṭrāya namo lambodarāya ca ||
namas te gajavaktrāya sarvajñāyāṣṭamūrtaye |
samīhitārthasaṃprāptau nirvighnaṃ kuru me sadā ||
bhojayitvā tato viprān yathāśaktyā vimatsaraḥ |
bhuñjīta ca svayaṃ naktaṃ vāgyato ‘nnam akutsayan ||
sāyaṃ prātaś ca sarveṣāṃ bhojanaṃ śruticoditam |
ekabhaktaṃ punas tasmād upavāsas tato ‘dhikaḥ ||
upavāsāt paraṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyāt param ayācitam |
ayācitāt paraṃ naktaṃ tasmān naktaṃ tapo bhavet ||
devaiś tu bhuktaṃ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne mānuṣais tathā |
aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ pretarākṣasaiḥ ||
velāś caitā atikramya naktabhojī ca yo bhavet |
sa tais tu tarpitaiḥ sarvair yat puṇyaṃ tad avāpnuyāt ||
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānam āhārasya ca lāghavam |
adhikārtham adhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte vrate pūrṇe gajānana |
[534] atrāpi kṛcchracaturthyām uktarūpaṃ nirmāṇam |
sauvarṇaraupye vāropyam adhivāsya prayatnataḥ |
tāmrapātrair dvādaśabhir mṛṇmayair vātha vaiṇavaiḥ ||
tilasaṃmodakabhṛtaiḥ prātar viprāya dāpayet |
dadyāc ca vidhivad bhaktyā vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha ||
aṣṭāṅgapadasaṃyuktasaptadhānyasamanvitam |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān paścād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
itthaṃ vratam idaṃ cīrtvā sarvavighnaiḥ pramucyate |
vidyāṃ śriyaṃ yaśaḥ saukhyaṃ prāpnoty avikalaṃ sadā ||
aputro labhate putraṃ daridras tūttamaṃ dhanam |
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim ||
śrūyate ‘tra purāvṛttaṃ puṣpadhūpādisādhanam |
mallikāraktasaṃbhojajātitagaram eva ca ||
puṣpikāṃ ketakīṃ vānasuvarṇakusumāni ca |
pratimāsaṃ tu kāryāṇi puṣpāṇy etāni nārada ||
phalānām apy abhāve tu bījapūraṃ praśasyate |
alābhe tūktapuṣpāṇāṃ śatapatraṃ viśiṣyate ||
nārikelaṃ bījapūraṃ nāraṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ tathā |
sārvāṃ panasaṃ caiva sahakāraṃ tathaiva ca ||
kṣīrīphalaṃ vāmalakaṃ kuṣmāṇḍaṃ trapuṣaṃ tathā |
bhūmīphalaṃ kramāc cātra arghakāle prayojayet ||
[535] ekadanta mahādanta gaurīsuta gaṇādhipa |
caturthīvratapūjārtham arghaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te ||
arghamantraḥ |
śatapatraṃ tathā kuṇḍaṃ marukaṅkaṇavīrakam |
sphāravindaṃ vakulāśokān ādāya pūjayet tataḥ ||
arthān saṃvardhayati vardhayatīha dhamaṃ
kāmaṃ prasādhayati tasya pinaṣṭi pāpam |
yaḥ pūjayan nikhilalokanutāṅghripadmam
gaurīsutaṃ phaṇitanūdaram ādidevam ||
vighnāś ca tasya na bhavanti gṛhe kadācid
dharmārthakāmasukhasiddhividhāyakāya |
yaḥ saptamīṃ duśakalākṛtikāntidantam
vighneśam arcayati taṃ sukṛtī caturthyām ||
ānandadāṃ sakalapāpaharāṃ caturthīṃ
yā strī karoti vidhavā sadhavā ca kanyā |
sā sve gṛhe sukhaśatāny anubhūya bhūyo
herambamātṛbhavanaṃ muditaḥ prayāti ||
evaṃ ca yaḥ prakurute varadāṃ caturthīṃ
vaināyakīṃ vividhaputrasukāntikīrtiḥ |
śambhoḥ śaśāṅkakalikāṅkitaśekharasya
sthānaṃ prayāti paramaikasukhasvarūpam ||
[536] sthaviragaṇapatiṃ pūjayantu yajjayanyāṃ
sakṛd api samupetya dhvastadoṣās tu martyāḥ |
dviradavadanam ādyaṃ te prayāntīha dhanyāḥ
suranagarapurandhrīlocanaiḥ prīyamānāḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ naktacaturthīvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājamahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
vratakhaṇḍe caturthīvratāni |
[537]
atha navamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha pañcamīvratāni |
ceto lakṣmīramaṇacaraṇadvandvarājībalīnam |
harṣotkarṣād atirasalasadbhṛṅgabhaṅgīm upati (?) ||
yasya sphārasphuritamatinā tena hemādriṇeha |
prastūyante vipulaphalakṛt pañcamīṣu vratāni ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kathaṃ sā prāpyate lakṣmīr durlabhā yāmarair vibho |
dānena tapasā vāpi vratenāpi vadasva tat ||
japahomanamaskāraiḥ saṃskārair vā pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
etad vada yaduśreṣṭha sarvavittvaṃ matir mama ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhṛgoḥ khyātā samutpannā pūrvaṃ strī śrīpateḥ śubhā |
vāsudevāya dattā sā munināṃ mama vṛddhaye ||
vāsudevo ‘pi tām prāpya pīnonnatapayodharām |
padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanām ||
bhābhāsitadigābhogām arkād bhānoḥ prabhām iva |
[538] nitambāḍambaravatīṃ mattamātaṅgagāminīm |
reme saha mayā rājan vibhramodbhrānticintayā ||
sā ca viṣṇuṃ jagacjiṣṇuṃ patiṃ śrījagatāṃ patim |
prāpya kṛtārtham ātmānaṃ mene mānayaśodharā ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa jagat sarvaṃ bhagavan dhāritaṃ tvayā |
lakṣi māṃ pāla pañcabhyāṃ sadvṛṣṭyeva mahītalam ||
kṣemaṃ subhikṣam āropyam anākrandam anāmayān |
rasāj jalaṃ jāyate ‘smād havir vahṇau hunet tataḥ ||
cāturvarṇyaṃ sasaṃkīrṇaṃ pālyate pārtha pārthivaiḥ |
virocanaprabhṛtibhir dṛṣṭvaiva daityasattamaiḥ ||
tapasas tam athābhyarcyam agnim āśritya saṃyamaiḥ |
somasaṃsthā haviḥ saṃsthā pākasaṃsthādibhir makhaiḥ ||
samācāraiḥ samabhyarcya yeṣu bhiktiprakāribhiḥ (?) |
pañcadharmapradhānais tair devadānavarākṣasaiḥ ||
jagad āsīt samākrāntaṃ vikramena krameṇa ca |
lakṣmī vilāsaprabhavo devānāṃ ca sadā madaḥ ||
śīlaṃ śarma ca satyaṃ ca sadyo lakṣmīś ca sadgṛhe |
satyaśaucavihīnāṃs tān devān saṃtyajya cañcalā ||
jagāma dīnā vākūlaṃ kudevānurāgataḥ |
lakṣmyā bhāvitadehais taiḥ punar uddhatamānasaiḥ ||
vyavahartuṃ samāraṃ dāmanyāyena madoddhataiḥ |
vayaṃ devā vayaṃ yajñāḥ vayaṃ viprā vayaṃ jagat ||
brahmaviṣṇū saśakrādyā vayaṃ sarvadivaukasaḥ |
[539] ahaṃkāravimūḍhāṃs tān jñātvā dānavasattamān ||
sāgare salile pārthaṃ bhrāntacittā bhṛgoḥ sutā |
kṣīrodamadhye gatayā labdhaḥ kṣīṇārthasambhayam ||
nirāmadaṃ gataśrīkam abhavad bhuvanatrayam |
gataśrīkam athātmānaṃ matvā śambarasūdanam ||
papracchāṅgirasaṃ vipraṃ brūhi kiṃcid vrataṃ mama |
yena saṃprāpyate lakṣmīr labdhā na calate punaḥ ||
niścalāpi suhṛnmitrabhogyā bhavati sā mune |
na sā strīty abhimantavyā kanyā sā pālyate gṛhe ||
parārthaṃ yā suhṛnmitrabhṛtyair naivopamucyate |
śakrasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā bṛhaspatir udāradhīḥ |
kathayāmāsa saṃcitya śubhaṃ śrīpañcamīvratam ||
yat purā kasyacin noktaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
tad ahaṃ kathayāmāsa sarahasyam aśeṣataḥ ||
tac chrutvā kartum ārabdhaṃ śubhaṃ naravaraiḥ saha |
daityadānavagandharvair yajñaiḥ pakṣīṇakalmaṣaiḥ ||
siddhaiḥ prasiddhacaritair viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
brāhmaṇair brahmatattvajñaiḥ samarthaiḥ pārthivaiḥ saha |
kaiścit sātvikabhāvena rājasenāparair api ||
tāmasena tathā kaiścit kṛtaṃ vratam idaṃ tathā |
vrate samāsabhūyiṣṭhe niṣṭhayā parayā prabho ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yudhi cāsīd amoghatā |
nirmathya bhujavīryeṇa sāgaraṃ saritāṃ patim |
[540] samāharāmo hy amṛtaṃ hitvā yatidivaukasaḥ ||
ity etat samayaṃ kṛtvā mamanthur varuṇālayam |
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim ||
maghyamāne jalāj jātaś candraḥ śītāṃśur ujjavalaḥ |
anantare samutpannā lakṣmīḥ kṣīrābdhimadhyataḥ ||
tayā cālokitāḥ sarve daityadānavasattamāḥ |
ālokya tān janāmāsau viṣṇor vakṣasthalaṃ śubham |
vidhinā viṣṇunā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tenābdhisaṃbhavā ||
śarīrasthā babhūvāsya vibhramodbhrāntalocanā |
kiṃ ca rājasabhāvena śakreṇaiva kṛtaṃ yataḥ ||
tena svargabalaiśvaryaṃ prāpyate sma maharddhimat |
tamasāvṛtacittais tu saṃcīrṇaṃ daityadānavaiḥ ||
tena teṣām athaiśvaryaṃ daṣṭanaṣṭam abhūt kila |
evaṃ sa śrīkam abhavat sadaivāsuramānuṣam ||
jagati jagatāṃ śreṣṭha vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
katham etad vrataṃ kṛṣṇa kriyate manujaiḥ kadā |
prārabhyate pārtha kasmin sarvaṃ vada janārdana ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
yad indreṇa purā cīrṇaṃ śrīviyuktena pārthiva |
śrīsamṛddhikaraṃ tad dhi śṛṇu śrīpañcamīvratam ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ pannagotsave |
[541] upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryāt padmāṃ smared dhṛdi ||
svarṇaraupyāṃ yathāśaktyā tāmrāṃ mṛtkāṣṭhajām atha |
citrapaṭṭagatāṃ devīṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣmāpāla kārayet ||
padmāsanāṃ padmahastāṃ padmāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām |
diggajendraiḥ snāpyamānāṃ kāñcanaiḥ kalasauttamaiḥ ||
lakṣmīrūpanirmāṇaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ veditavyam | tad yathā |
samutthitā śrīḥ kartavyā śaṅkhāmbujakarā śubhā |
sukhasthitā mahābhāga padme padmakarā śubhā ||
dvibhujā cārusarvāṅgī sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇā |
dvau ca mūlakaro mūrdhni karyau vidyādharau śubhau || iti
tato yāmatraye yāte nimnagāyāḥ mṛdātha vā |
snānaṃ kuryād asaṃbhrāntaḥ śaktimad upacārataḥ ||
devān pitṝṃś ca saṃtarpya tato devagṛhaṃ vrajet |
tatrasthāṃ pūjayed devīṃ puṣpais tatkālasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
capalāyai namaḥ pādau cañcalāyai ca jānunī |
kaṭīṃ kamalavāsinyai nābhiṃ khyātyai namo namaḥ ||
stanau manmathavāsinyai lalitāyai bhujadvayam |
utkaṇṭhitāyai kambuṃ ca mādhavyai mukhapaṅkajam ||
namaḥ śriyai śiraḥ pūjya dadyān naivedyam ādarāt |
phalāni ca yathālābhaṃ virūḍhaṃ dhānyasaṃcayam ||
tataḥ svavāsinī pūjyā kuṅkumaiḥ kusumena ca |
bhojayen madhurānnena praṇipatya visarjayet ||
[542] tatas tu taṇḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam |
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ sā śrīr me prīyatām iti ||
nirvartyaitad aśeṣeṇa tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
māsānumāsaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhinānena bhārata ||
śrīr lakṣmīḥ kamalā saṃpat padmā nārāyaṇī tathā |
padmadhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ puṣṭis tuṣṭiḥ siddhiḥ kṣamā kramāt ||
māsānumāsaṃ rājendra prīyatām iti kīrtayet |
tato dvādaśame māsi saṃprāpte pañcamīdine ||
vastramaṇḍayikāṃ kṛtvā puṣpagandhādivāsinām |
śayyāyāṃ sthāpayel lakṣmīṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām ||
saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktāṃ netrapaṭṭāvṛtastanīm |
saptadhānyasamopetāṃ rasadhātusamanvitām ||
pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanasaṃskṛtām |
devīṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
vyāsāya vedaviduṣe yasmai vā rocate svayam |
sopaskarāṃ savatsāṃ ca dhenuṃ datvā kṣamāpayet ||
kṣīrābdhimathanodbhūte viṣṇor vakṣasthalālaye |
sarvakāmaprade devi siddhiṃ yaccha namo ‘stu te ||
tataḥ svavāsinīḥ pūjyā vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
bhojayitvā svayaṃ paścād bhuñjīta saha bandhubhiḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha bhaktyā śrīpañcamīvratam |
tasya śrīr bhavane bhāti kulānām ekaviṃśatim ||
[543] nārī vā kurute yā tu prāpyānujñāṃ svabhartṛtaḥ |
subhagā darśanīyā ca bahuputrā ca jāyate ||
yaḥ pañcamīvratam idaṃ dayitaṃ murārer
bhaktyā samācarati pūjya bhṛgos tanūjām |
rājyaśriyaṃ sa bhuvi bhavyajanopabhogyaṃ
bhuktvā prayāti bhavanaṃ madhusūdanasya ||
iti śrībhaviṣyapurāṇoktaṃ śrīpañcamīvrataṃ saṃpūrṇam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
māhātmyam (?) abhivakṣyāmi pañcamyās tava bhārata |
jayeti yā ca vikhyātā vratināṃ jayadāyinī ||
yasmāj jayājayāśabdaṃ kurvanti vratino budhāḥ |
paripūrṇaṃ vrataṃ yasyāṃ sā jñeyā jayapañcamī ||
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī pāpanāśinī ||
jayā kārttikaśuklapañcamī |
keśavo bhagavān śambhūr gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā |
prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni jambūdvīpasarāṃsi vā ||
prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ gaṅgāṃ gayākṣetraṃ kuruṣv atha |
etāny anyāni tīrthāni vratinaḥ snāpayantvata (?) ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena snānaṃ kuryāj jayādine |
snehenodvartanenaiva dvijān saṃsnāpayed bahūn ||
tīrthe prasravaṇe gatvā snāpayet svayaṃ harim |
[544] jayāsahitam ity arthaḥ |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ vāmabhāge jayāṃ sthitām |
varadābhayahastāṃ ca śvetāṃ haṃsoparisthitām ||
pūjayed vividhaiḥ puṣpair dhūpanaivedyājādibhiḥ |
ebhir mantrais tu taṃ devaṃ jayāṃ ca pratipūjayet ||
pādau vai padmanābhāya jānubhyo mādhavīti ca |
ūrū vai nārasiṃhāya madhye vai manmathāya vā ||
dāmodarāyety udaraṃ cakṣuḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe |
śrīkaṇṭhāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ vā bāhū sarvāstradhāriṇe ||
mukhaṃ padmamukhāyeti śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ |
anena vidhinā caiva pūjayed garuḍadhvajam ||
anantaraṃ tu tāṃ devīṃ veṇupātroparisthitām |
jātīlatādhobhāgasthitāṃ devīṃ prapūjayet ||
namaḥ puṣṭhai (puṣṭyai?) pādayugme jānubhyāṃ ca śriye namaḥ |
nadāyai ca kaṭīdeśe vijayāyai ca vakṣasi ||
śiraḥ sarvārthadāyinyai sarvāṅge vijayāṃ tathā |
vidhinānena saṃpūjya arcayed vijayāṃ harim ||
oṃ jayāyai jayarūpāya jaya govindarūpiṇe |
jaya dāmodarāyeti jaya sarva (?) namo ‘stu te ||
arghyamantraḥ |
veṇupātrāṇi sarvāṇi saptadhānyabhṛtāni ca |
raktasūtreṇa saṃpūjya saphalāni nivedayet ||
tathā veṇuphalaṃ dṛṣṭā tuṣyate madhusadanaḥ |
[545] tathā me aśubhaṃ sarvaṃ veṇupātrapradānataḥ ||
veṇupātradānamantraḥ |
anena vidhinā caiva datvā pātrāṇi gosure |
gosure brāhmaṇe |
rakṣābandham ataḥ kuryāt suhṛtsvajanabandhuṣu |
akṣatāḥ sarṣapā dūrvā rakṣāmadhye ca rocanā ||
oṃ yena baddho balīrājā dānavendro mahābalaḥ |
tena tvām āśu badhnāmi rakṣe mācala mācala ||
rakṣābandhanamantraḥ |
rakṣābandhaṃ naro yas tu kuryād bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
na tasya grahapīḍā syān na ca mṛtyubhayaṃ bhavet ||
bhūtavetālarakṣādyaiḥ piśācair nābhibhūyate |
rakṣāyābandhanaṃ kṛtvā saṃgrāme praviśet tu yaḥ ||
jayate sa ripūn sarvān jīyate na sa kenacit |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena rakṣābandhaṃ tu kārayet ||
yas tu vai bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ snānaṃ kuryāj jayādine |
kutas tasyaiva pāpāni māghamāsaplave yathā ||
yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthaṃ tādṛśaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
jalāñjalis tu vratinā kṣipyate tasya mūrdhani ||
brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
aputro labhate putrān vandhyā garbhaṃ vivindati ||
[546] rogī rogair vimucyeta prayāti harimandiram ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ jayāpañcamīvratam |
bharadvāja uvāca |
ācakṣato vidhiṃ brahman pañcamyāḥ paramaṃ vratam |
sa eṣa mahimā yasya sarvān kāmān pravarṣati ||
sanatkumāra uvāca |
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bhagavan pañcamyāḥ paramaṃ vidhim |
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate ||
śravaṇena yadā yuktā śuklapakṣe tu pañcamī |
uttarāphālgunau yasyām induvārasamāgamaḥ ||
ārabheta naras tasyāṃ vrataṃ pūrvam upoṣitaḥ |
caturthyām ekabhaktāśī brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ ||
ghṛtimān kṛtasaṃkalpo bhaven niyamavān naraḥ |
tataḥ kalyaṃ samutthāya snātvā niyatamānasaḥ ||
dhṛtasaṃkalpayā patnyā kuryād bilvasya cārcanam |
bilvamūle tataḥ kuryād vediṃ puṣpākṣatair yutām ||
sthāpayet kalaśān aṣṭau tasyām aṣṭasu dikṣu vā |
tanmandhye bilvamūlaṃ tu sthāpayec ca mahāghaṭān |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmramārtikaṃ vā subhānvitam ||
[547] vastrayugmena saṃchannaṃ navaratnasamanvitam |
kalaśāṃś (?) ca tathā kuryāt tīrthodakasamanvitān ||
dūrvā ca viṣṇuparṇī ca śrīlatā paṅkajaṃ sitam |
śālapatram apāmārgas tulasī jātir ity api ||
viṣṇuparṇī praśniparṇī, śrīlatā padminī | śālapatraṃ śālavṛkṣapatram |
bilvāmratālatindūkadhātrorambhāphalāny atha |
tindukaṃ ṭiburuṇīphalam |
jambūpanasajātāni buddhiḥ śaktiḥ sarasvatī |
śraddhā lakṣmīr dhṛtis tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭir ity aṣṭa śaktayaḥ |
elāsarṣapakakkolatilakarpūrapadmakāḥ ||
padmako vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ |
lodhramāṃsīsamāyuktān iti sarvān vinikṣipet |
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ kalaśeṣu mahāmatiḥ ||
madhyame tu kṣipet sarvaṃ darvyādi yad udīritam |
atha tatra śriyaṃ devīm aṣṭaśaktisamanvitām ||
śrībījena samāvāhya tatra pūjādi sādhayet |
evaṃ sarvatra śaktīnāṃ bījenāvāhanaṃ viduḥ ||
svanāmādyākṣaraṃ bījam anusvārasamanvitam |
tatra tatra ca tatpūjāṃ vidhinā samyag ācaret ||
śrīlatājātibakulair nandyāvartaprasūnakaiḥ |
[548] nandyāvartaṃ tagaram |
elāpatrasitān bhojaiḥ (?) mallikākusumānvitaiḥ |
śrīśūktena śriyaṃ devīm arcayet pratyṛcaṃ (?) sudhīḥ ||
śrīsūktaṃ hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīm ityādi |
guḍānnapāyasāpūpamudgānnadadhisamyutaiḥ |
śālyannaiḥ kṣīramadhuraiḥ śriyaṃ devīṃ samarcayet ||
buddhyādiśaktyarcanaṃ nāmamantraiḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā yathāyogaṃ tataḥ saṃvṛṇuyād varam |
devi padmapalāśākṣi namas te śrīdharapriye ||
siddhārthaṃ māṃ vṛṇuṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
bodhyaṃ buddhyā ca bhūtānāṃ bodhayanti hṛdi sthite ||
siddhārthaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
śaktiḥ satī satī devi veṣṭayanty aniśaṃ prajāḥ ||
siddhārthaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
siddhāśaye ‘mṛtakale padmavāse sarasvatī ||
suddhārhaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
śraddhe śraddhāvatīśāni sattvāni kurvatīvaśe ||
suddhārhaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
lakṣitāsi sati lakṣmīr dīvyantī svastimaj jagat ||
suddhārhaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
ghṛtyaimāṃ vṛṃhati (?) dhātrī mandire divase śubhe ||
[549] suddhārhaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
satī toṣayatāṃ tuṣṭipradātrī kamale ‘male ||
suddhārhaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
sandhukṣyasi susaṃpṛṣṭamaṅgalāyatanaṃ jagat ||
suddhārhaṃ māṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ vratenānena suvrate |
iti mannītasakalāḥ saṃpūrṇā me manorathāḥ ||
indirāyāḥ prasādena vratenāsam ahaṃ sukhī |
tataḥ parisamāpyaivaṃ śriyaḥ pūjāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
madhyamasya samīpe tu sahitaṃ sthāpayed ghaṭam |
tasminn āvāhayed devaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīpatiṃ prabhum ||
vastrayugmena saṃchannaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitam |
vidhāya vidhinā kumbhaṃ tatra pūjāṃ samācaret ||
athāvasthāpite pūrvaṃ devam āvāhya pūjayet |
samāpya vidhivat pūjāṃ tataś ca śṛṇuyād varam ||
bhagavan śrīpate śrīśa śrīnivāsa jaganmaya |
prasādāt tava te santu saṃpūrṇā me mahorathāḥ ||
atra saṃpūjayed vidvān brāhmaṇān vedapāragān |
navakaṃ mithunaṃ kṛtvā tatra mantreṇa vaiṣṇavān ||
tebhyo dadyād yathāyogyaṃ bhūṣaṇāni dhanaṃ bahu |
vardhitas tattadāśīrbhir visṛjya dvijasattamān |
tatas tu lokapālānāṃ baliṃ dikṣu vinikṣipet ||
upavāsaś ca kartavyaḥ saha vadhvā vareṇa vā |
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpo na kartavyaḥ kathaṃcana ||
[550] yadi syāt patanaṃ gacchen nirayaṃ cāpy adhomukhaḥ |
vṛthājalpaparo na syād vṛthārambho vṛthāmatiḥ ||
na svapet tu divārātrau nādyād api kathaṃcana |
na krīḍāṃ nopahāsaṃ ca na mithyābhāṣaṇaṃ kvacit ||
śrīdharāya namo nityaṃ śriyai nama itīrayet |
evam eva dinaṃ nītvā tataḥ ṣaṣṭyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
samabhyarcya śriyaṃ devīṃ tathā devaṃ yathā purā |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād vidhivat saparigrahāt ||
datvā dhanādikam atha snātvā kumbhodakena vā |
patnyā saha haviḥśeṣaṃ tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
tathā dānaṃ daridrebhyo yoṣidbhyaś cānnam uttamam |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pitṛbhyaś ca svadhām api |
bilvaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā praṇamet tadagre praṇato vrajet ||
na kuryāt tāḍanaṃ tasya tathā pādābhimarśanam |
na laṅghayīta tacchāyāṃ nādyāt tasya phalādikam ||
praśastaṃ bilvapātrāṇāṃ vāraṇaṃ mūrdhni nityaśaḥ |
śatapatraṃ caikapatraṃ śrīlatākusumāny api |
dūrvāṃ ca kūrcakusumaṃ tilasarṣapataṇḍulān ||
śirasā dhārayen nityaṃ śriyam icchann anākulaḥ |
āyur vidyāṃ śriyaṃ tuṣṭim ārogyaṃ kāntim uttamām ||
saubhāgyaṃ kṣemasaṃpattiṃ vratenāpnoti mānavaḥ |
vindate vratakṛd rājā rājyaṃ śriyam anuttamām ||
[551] deśe ca labhate vittaṃ śūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt |
kanyā ca labhate saumyaṃ patiṃ hṛdayahāriṇam ||
vandhyā vābhimataṃ (?) putraṃ vindetāśu na saṃśayaḥ |
yoṣit paramamāṅgalyaṃ prāpnuyād vratasaṃpadā |
apatyaṃ garbhiṇī nārī yāvad bahusutārthinī ||
pāyasena śriyaṃ devīṃ deveśaṃ ca samarcayet |
śriyaṃ kāmayamānena pūrvoktavidhinārcanam |
saubhāgyam icchatā kāryaṃ ghṛtānnena samarcanam ||
haviṣyaphalamūlādyaṃ kāryaṃ rājanyapārthivaiḥ ||
vidyārthinā ca devāni havīṃṣi madhurāṇi ca |
āyuḥkāmena vidhinā payasā kāryam arcanam ||
evam eva ca varṣāṇtam anutiṣṭhet tu pañcamīm |
atha vā sakṛd uktena na vidhinā kāryam iṣyate ||
atha yāvat phalaprāptiḥ kāryam etad vrataṃ matam |
sarvaṃ bhāgyavaśād eva phalaṃ bhuṅkte naro bhuvi ||
tadyogāt tatkṣaṇāt tāvad aciraṃ syāc ciraṃ phalam |
api ca kṣīṇabhāgyānām asatām api saṃpadaḥ ||
bhaveyuḥ sarvasattvānāṃ vratenānena vai dhruvam |
evam uktena vidhinā vrataṃ ca vratināmbaraḥ ||
sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṃsām uktam etan mahāvratam |
[552]
iti śrīgaruḍapurāṇoktaṃ śrīpañcamīvratam |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcamūrtis tathārcanam |
pṛthivy āpas tathā tejo vāyur ākāśam eva ca ||
etā vai devadevasya kathitāḥ pañcamūrtayaḥ |
caitre tu pañcamīṃ śūklāṃ (?) samāsādya vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
sopavāso hariṃ devaṃ pañcātmānaṃ samarcayet |
pañcamaṇdalakāḥ kāryāḥ pañcabhir varṇakaiḥ pṛthak ||
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ karyaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ mahīpate |
vāruṇaṃ ca tathā śvetaṃ raktam āgneyam iṣyate ||
pītaṃ bhavati vāyavyaṃ kṛṣṇam ākāśadaivatam |
samānavarṇagandhaiś ca puṣpais tān arcayet pṛthak ||
śaktyā ca dhūpadīpānnair yathālābham ariṃdama |
yavair māṣais tilaiś caiva sarṣapaiś ca ghṛtena ca ||
pañcabhir juhuyān mantraiḥ sarveṣāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak |
hutvā oṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśebhyaḥ svāheti sarveṣāṃ miśrair juhuyāt |
talliṅgair eva mantraiś ca atha vā nṛpa nāmabhiḥ |
oṃkārapūrvakair hutvā śaktyā viprāṃśca bhojayet ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇasaṃvatsare tataḥ |
[553] datvā vipreṣu vastrāṇi devaraṅgasamāni tu ||
mahābhūtavratam idaṃ yaḥ karoty atha pañcakam |
pañcayajñān avāpnoti kramaśo ye tu kīrtitāḥ ||
bahūny abdasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate |
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavaty arogo
balānvito vairigāṇādihantā |
śrutena rūpeṇa dhanena yukto
janābhirāmaḥ pramadāpriyaś ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ pañcamahābhūtavratam |
śrībhīṣma uvāca |
madhurā bhāratī kena vratena madhusūdana |
tathaiva janasaubhāgyaṃ sarvavidyānukauśalam ||
abhedaś cāpi dampatyos tathā bandhujanaiḥ saha |
āyuś ca vipulaṃ puṃsāṃ tan me kathaya sattama ||
pulastya uvāca |
samyak pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājan śṛṇu sārasvataṃ vratam |
yasya saṃkīrtanād eva tuṣyatīha sarasvatī ||
yo yadbhaktaḥ pumān kuryād etad vratam anuttamam |
tadvāsarādau saṃpūjya viprān etat samārabhet ||
atha vādityavāreṇa grahatārābalena ca |
[554] pāyasaṃ bhojayitvā tu kuryād brāhmaṇavācanam ||
śuklavastrāṇi dadyāc ca sahiraṇyāni śaktitaḥ |
gāyatrīṃ pūjayed bhaktyā śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
ebhir mantarpadaiḥ paścāt sarvaṃ kuryāt kṛtāñjaliḥ |
yathā na devi bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
tvāṃ parityajya samtiṣṭhet tathā bhava varapradā |
vedāḥ śāstrāṇi sarvāṇi nṛtyagītādikaṃ ca yat ||
na vihīnaṃ tvayā mātas tathā me santu siddhayaḥ |
lakṣmīr medhā dharā puṣṭi gaurī tuṣṭiḥ prabhā matiḥ ||
etābhiḥ pāhi tanubhir aṣṭābhir māṃ sarasvatī |
evaṃ saṃpūjya gāyatrīṃ vīṇākṣamaṇidhāriṇī ||
śuklapakṣe ‘kṣatair bhaktyā sakamaṇḍalupustakām |
maunavratena bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātaś ca dharmavit ||
pañcamyāṃ pratipakṣe ca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ |
tasyāṃ tu taṇḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ||
kṣīraṃ dadyād hiraṇyaṃ ca gāyatrī prīyatām iti |
saṃdhyayoś ca tathā māunam etat kurvan samārabhet ||
nāntarā bhojanaṃ kuryād yāvan māsās trayodaśa |
samāpte tu vrate dadyād bhājanaṃ śubhataṇḍulaiḥ ||
pūrṇaṃ savastrayugmaṃ tu gāṃ savatsāṃ suśobhanām |
viprāya vedaviduṣe vācakāyātha pārthiva ||
[555] devyai vitānaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca sitacāmarasaṃyutām |
candanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ (?) ca dadhy annaṃ śikharaṃ tathā ||
śikharaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtānāṃ santānikā śivā, śikaraṃ cirasaṃsthasya dravasyoparipīḍikety āyurvedasmṛteḥ |
tathopadeṣṭāram api bhaktyā saṃpūjayed gurum ||
vittaśāṭhyena rahito vastramālyānulepanaiḥ |
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryāt sārasvataṃ vratam ||
vidyāvān dhanayuktaś ca raktakaṇṭhaś ca jāyate |
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena vyāsavatsakavir bhavet ||
nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatphalabhāginī |
brahmaloke vaset tāvad yāvad yugaśatatrayam ||
sārasvataṃ vrataṃ yas tu śṛṇuyāc chrāvayet tathā |
vidyādharapuraṃ so ‘pi prāpnoti gatakalmaṣaḥ ||
sārasvatavratavareṇa sarasvatīṃ ye
saṃpūjayanti vidhivaj jagato janitrī |
vidyovadātahṛdayā madhurasvarās te
rūpānvitā bahuguṇāḥ kuśalā bhavanti ||
atra vrate śuklapakṣe sveṣṭadevatātithau | ravidine śubhadine vā ārambhaḥ pratidinaṃ samdhyayor bhojane ca maunaṃ śuklapañcamyāṃ sarasvatīpūjā suvāsinī pṛjā (?) ca |
[556]
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ sārasvataṃ vratam |
agastya uvāca |
śāntivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa |
yena cīrṇena śāntiḥ syāt sarvadā gṛhamedhinaḥ ||
pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārttike māsi pārthiva |
ārabhya varṣam ekaṃ tu bhuñjīyād amlavarjitam ||
naktaṃ tu pūjayed devaṃ hariṃ śeṣoparisthitam |
devapratimā śeṣoparisuptā caturbhujā lakṣmyutsaṅgagatas tatraikapādaḥ śeṣoparisthita evāparo, jānūpari tasyaikaḥ karo nābhideśastho aparaḥ, śīrṣadharaḥ santānamañjarīdharaś cānyaḥ nābhau padmam, pārśve ‘strāṇīti |
anantāyeti pādau tu dhṛtarāṣṭāya vai kaṭīm |
takṣakāyeti jaṭharam uraḥ karkoṭakasya tu ||
padmāya kaṇṭhaṃ saṃpūjya mahāpadmāya doryugam |
śaṅkhapāpāya vaktraṃ tu kulikāyeti vai śiraḥ ||
viṣṇuṃ sarvāṅgam apy evaṃ pṛthak caiva prapūjayet |
pṛthak caiveti anantādyān aṣṭau nāgān pṛthag api pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kuryād dharim uddiśya vāgyataḥ |
nāgān api haribhuddhyā snāpayet |
tadagnau homayet kṣīraṃ tilaiḥ saha nṛpottama |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kuryād brāhmaṇatarpaṇam ||
[557] nāgaṃ tu kāñcanaṃ kṛtvā svakarṇena vidhārayet |
gāṃ savatsāṃ vastrayugāṃ kāṃsyapātrāṃ payasvinīm ||
hiraṇyaṃ ca yathā śaktyā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratam etan narādhipa |
tasya śāntir bhaven nityaṃ nāgebhyaś cābhayaṃ tathā ||
śeṣāhibhogaśayanastham apāṃ prasūtiṃ
saṃpūjya yajñapuruṣaṃ patagendraketum |
ye ‘śranty anamlamadhuraṃ sitapañcamīṣu
teṣāṃ na nāgajanitaṃ bhayam asti kiṃcit |
iti varāhapurāṇoktaṃ śāntivratam |
sumantur uvāca |
pañcamī dayitā rājan nāgānāṃ nandavardhinī |
pañcamyāḥ kila nāgānāṃ bhavatīty utsavo mahān ||
vāsukis takṣaś caiva kāliyo manibhadrakaḥ |
dhṛtarāṣṭuś cairāvataḥ karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau ||
ete prayacchanty abhayaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇadāḥ sadā |
pañcamyāṃ snāpayantīha nāgān kṣīreṇa ye narāḥ ||
teṣāṃ kule prayacchanti abhayaṃ prāṇadakṣiṇām |
śastā nāgā yadā mātrā dahyamānā divāniśam |
[558] nirvāpitā gavāṃ kṣīrais teṣāṃ kṣīraṃ tu durlabham ||
śatānīka uvāca |
mātrā trāsāḥ kathaṃ nāgāḥ kim uddiśya ca kāraṇam |
kathaṃ śāpasya śāvasya vināśo vai mahāmune ||
sumantur uvāca |
uccaiśravo ‘śvarājā ca śvetaparṇo ‘mṛtodbhavaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhavalaṃ kadrur nāgānāṃ jananīsvasā ||
uvāceti śeṣaḥ |
aśvaratnam idaṃ śvetaṃ paśya paśyāmṛtodbhavam |
kulasya yasya te bālāḥ sarvaśvetayutās tathā ||
sarvaśvetākṛtivaro nāyaṃ kṛṣṇo na lohitaḥ |
kathaṃ tvaṃ yasya kṛt kṛṣṇaṃ vinatovāca tat svamām (?) ||
kadrur uvāca |
yasyāham ekanayanaṃ kṛṣṇatvacasamanvitam (?) |
dvinetrā tvaṃ savinate yadi paśya paṇaṃ kuru ||
vinatovāca |
ahaṃ dāsī bhavitrī te kṛṣṇe keśapradarśitam |
na ca darśayase kadrur mama dāsī bhaviṣyasi ||
evaṃ te ca paṇaṃ kṛtvā gate krodhasamanvite |
śapite prāk pradevo ‘pi kadrur jihmam acintayat ||
āhūya putrān provāca vālo bhūtvā hayottame |
[559] tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vipaṇaṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ vinatāṃ jayavardhinīm ||
procus te jiṣṇubuddhīnāṃ nāgamātāṃ vigṛhya ca |
svadharmapṛṣṭhaḥ sumahān na kariṣyāmi taṃ vacaḥ ||
evaṃ putravacaḥ śrutvā kadrūḥ krodhasamākulā |
śaśāpa putrān sakalān vacakīśaṃ pradhakṣyati ||
gate bahutithe kāle pāṇḍavo janamejayaḥ |
sarpasattraṃ ca kartā vai yad anyair buvi duṣkaram ||
tasmin yajñe pāvako vai dahiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
evam uktvābhavat tūṣṇīṃ kadruḥ krodhaparāyaṇā ||
tān uvāca tadā sarvān brahmalokapitāmahaḥ |
pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu sattraṃ coparamiṣyate ||
tatra vo bhavitā nandas tenānando bhaviṣyati |
ity uktvā pannagān sarvān devadevapitāmahaḥ |
jagāma tridivaṃ bhūyo nāgāḥ svasthānam āsthitāḥ ||
tasmād iyaṃ mahārāja pañcamī dayitā satām |
nāgānāṃ harṣajananīṃ dattā vai brahmaṇā purā ||
aparaṃ te pravakṣyāmi niyamaṃ pañcamīṃ prati |
yaṃ kṛtvā na bibheti sma naro nāgakulāt kvacit ||
nāgān sauvarṇaraupyān vā atha vā mṛṇmayān nṛpa |
nāgān vāsuks takṣakaś caivetyādiprathamaślokapaṭhitān |
karavīraiḥ śatapatraiḥ jātīpatraiś ca suvrata ||
tathā gandhapradhūpaiś ca pannagān pūjya cottamān |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ ||
[560] kṛtvā tu bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kāmataḥ |
visṛjya nāgā prīyantāṃ ye kecit pṛthivītale ||
himācale tu ye vindhye ye ‘ntarikṣe divisthitā |
ye nadīṣu samudreṣu hradeṣu ca saraḥsu ca ||
ye vāpīṣu taḍāgeṣu tebhyaḥ sarveṣu vai namaḥ |
nāgān iti namaskṛtya viprān pūjya visarjayet ||
tataḥ svayaṃ ca bhuñjīyāt saha bhṛtyair narādhipa |
prathamaṃ madhuraṃ bhojyaṃ svecchayā tadanantaram ||
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yat phalaṃ tan nibodha me |
mṛto nāgapuraṃ yāti pūjyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ ||
vimānavaram ārūḍho ramate sūryaparyayam |
iha vāgatya rājāsau maṇḍalādhipatir bhavet ||
sarvaratnasamṛddhas tu vāhanādyaiś ca jāyate |
pañcajanmāni bhūpālo dvāpare dvāpare bhavet ||
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ putrapautrasahāyavān |
tasmāt pūjyāś ca mānyāś ca ghṛtapāyasaguggulaiḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam ānandapañcamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
nāgadaṣṭo naro rājan prāpya mṛtyuṃ vrajaty adhaḥ |
adhogatyā bhavet sarpo nirviṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
[561] śatānīka uvāca |
nāgadaṣṭaḥ pitā yasya bhrātā ca duhitāpi vā |
mātā putro ‘tha vā bhāryā kartavyaṃ tad vadasva me ||
maunāya tasya viprendra dānaṃ vratam upoṣitam |
brūhi me dvijaśārdūla yena tad vai karomy aham ||
sumantur uvāca |
upoṣya pañcamīṃ samyaṅ nāgānāṃ balavardhanam |
svam ekam ekaṃ yāvac ca vidhānaṃ śṛṇu bhārata ||
svam ekaṃ saṃvatsaram |
māsi bhādrapade rājan śuklapakṣe tu pañcamī |
sāpi puṇyatamā proktā grāhyāsau gatikāmyayā ||
caturthyām ekabhaktaṃ ca tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam |
tasyāṃ pañcamyām upoṣyeti divā bhojanavarjanāt |
kuryāc cāndrasamaṃ nāgam atha vā kaladhautajam ||
atha dārumayaṃ bhavyaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāpy aśaktitaḥ |
cāndrasamaṃ sauvarṇam, kaladhautajaṃ rūpyamayam |
pañcamyām arcayed bhaktyā nāgaṃ pañcapaṇaṃ tathā ||
karavīrais tathā padmaiḥ jātīpuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
gandhair dhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ snāpya kṣīrādibhir nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ |
anantaṃ vāsukiṃ śaṅkhaṃ padmaṃ kambalam eva ca ||
tathā karkoṭakaṃ nāgaṃ nāgam aśvataraṃ nṛpa |
[562] dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ śaṅkhapālaṃ kāliyaṃ (?) takṣakaṃ tathā ||
piṅgalaṃ ca mahānāgaṃ māsi māsi kramād yajet |
pūjayitvā prayatnena pañcamyāṃ naktabhug bhavet ||
evaṃ dvādaśa kṛtvā vai māsi bhādrapade nṛpa |
vatsarānte yathāśaktyā mahābhājyaṃ tu kārayet ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca nāgān uddiśya bhaktitaḥ |
itihāsavede nāgaṃ kāñcanaṃ ratnacitritam ||
gāṃ ca dadyāt savatsāṃ vai sarvopaskarasaṃyutām |
dānakāle paṭhed etat smaran nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum ||
sarvagaṃ sarvadhātāram anantam aparājitam |
ye kecin me kule sarpaiḥ daṣṭāḥ prāptā hy adhogatim ||
vratadānena govinda muktibhājo bhavantu te |
ity uccāryākṣatair yuktaṃ tilacandanamiśritam ||
vāsudevāgrato bhūyas toyaṃ toye vinikṣipet |
anena vidhinā sarve ye ‘rcayiṣyanti cāmṛtāḥ ||
sarpatas te ‘pi yāsyanti svargatiṃ nṛpasattama |
kṛtvā sarvān samuddhṛtya kulajān kulanandana ||
prayāti viṣṇusāṃnidhyaṃ sevyamāno ‘psarogaṇaiḥ |
vittaśāṭhyavihino yaḥ sarvam etat phalaṃ labhet ||
naktena bhaktisahitāḥ sitapañcamīṣu
ye pūjayanti bhujagān kusumopacāraiḥ |
teṣāṃ gṛheṣv abhayadā hi bhavanti sarpād
arthānvitā maṇimayūkhavibhāvitāṅgāḥ ||
[563]
iti bhaviṣyottarapurāṇoktaṃ nāgadaṣṭoddharaṇapañcamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
tadvad bhādrapade māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ |
yas tāl likhya naro nāgān kṛṣṇavarṇādivarṇakaiḥ ||
pūjayed gandhadhūpais tu sarpir guggulapāyasaiḥ |
tasya tuṣṭiṃ samāyānti pannagās takṣakādayaḥ ||
āsamāsakulāt tasya na bhayaṃ nāgato bhavet |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena na nāgān saṃpūjayed budhaḥ ||
tathā vāśvayuje māsi pañcamyāṃ kurunandana |
kṛtvā kuśamayān nāgān indrāṇyā saha pūjayet ||
nāgān pūrvavratoktān anantādīn |
śacī dvibāhuḥ santānamālāhastā gajasthitā |
ghṛtodakābhyāṃ payasā snāpayitvā viśāṃpate ||
godhūmaiḥ payasā svinnair bhakṣyaiś ca vividhais tathā |
yas tasyāṃ vidhivan nāgān śucir bhaktyā samanvitaḥ ||
pūjayet kuruśārdūla tasya śeṣādayo nṛpa |
nāgāḥ prītā bhavantīha śāntim āpnoti vā vibho ||
praśāntilokam āsādya modate śāsvatīḥ samāḥ |
yatrāyaṃ kathyate mantraḥ sadā viṣaniṣedhataḥ ||
oṃ kurukulle huṃ phaṭ svāhā |
nakte na bhaktim ahitaṃ sitapañcamīṣu
[564] ye pūjayanti bhujagān kuśumopahāraiḥ |
teṣāṃ gṛheṣv abhayadā hi bhavanti nāgāḥ |
sarve phaṇāmaṇimarīciruco bhavanti ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śāntipañcamīvratam |
īśvara uvāca |
yo naraḥ pūjayed divyaṃ pañcamyāṃ phālgune site |
pañcopacāravidhinā mitāhāro jitendriyaḥ ||
na taṃ daśanti phaṇito daśavarṣāṇi pañca ca |
viṣaṃ na kramate tasya kule mātṛkule ‘pi ca ||
tasmāt taṃ pūjayed yatnāt pañcamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
iti skānde prabhāṣakhaṇḍoktam anantapañcamīvratam |
īśvara uvāca |
śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śūklapakṣe varānane |
ārabhyobhayato lekhyāḥ gomayena viṣolvanā ||
kṛtvā ca kaustubhān nāgān nidrālī ca prapūjayet |
ghṛtodakābhyāṃ payasā snāpayitvā varānane ||
godhūmaiḥ payasā pūjya lājabhir vividhais tathā |
pūjayed vidhivad devi didhidūrvāṅkuraiḥ kramāt ||
[565] gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇam |
atha vā śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
yaś cālekhya naro nāgān kṛṣṇavarṇādivarṇakaiḥ |
gurukalpān tathā vīthyāṃ svagṛhe vilikhed budhaḥ ||
pūjayed gandhadhūpaiś ca payasā pāyasena ca |
tasya tuṣṭiṃ samāyānti padmakās takṣakādayaḥ ||
āsaptamāt kulaṃ tasya na bhayaṃ nāgato bhavet |
pramucyate mantraḥ sarpaviṣaṃ ca pratiṣevakaḥ ||
tasya prajapamātre tu na viṣaṃ kramate sadā |
oṃ kukulaṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā|
ity evaṃ kathitaṃ (?) devi nāgavratam anuttamam |
yat śrutvā ca paṭhitvā ca mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
iti skānde prabhāṣakhaṇḍoktaṃ sarpaviṣāpahapñcamīvratam |
īśvara uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade yāpi śuklapakṣe tu pañcamī |
sā tu puṇyatamā proktā khyātā svargatikāmyayā ||
yā ca dvādaśavarṣais tu pañcamyāṃ ca varānane |
caturthyām ekabhaktaṃ tu tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam ||
tasyāṃ pañcamyām |
bhūricandramayaṃ nāgam atha vā kaladhautajam |
[566] kṛtvā dhātumayaṃ vāpi atha vā mṛṇmayaṃ priye ||
pañcamyām arcayet śaktyā nāgaṃ pañcaphaṇaṃ smṛtam |
karavīraiḥ śatapatraiḥ jātīpuṣpaiś ca śobhanaiḥ ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiś ca dhūpaiś ca pūjayen nāgam uttamam |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ ||
anantaṃ karkoṭakaṃ nāma nāgam aśvataraṃ naraḥ |
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ śaṅkhapālaṃ kālikaṃ takṣakaṃ tathā ||
piṅgalaṃ ca mahānāgaṃ māsi māsi prakīrtitam |
vratasyāne pāraṇaṃ syāt kṣīrair brāhmaṇabhojanaiḥ ||
suvarṇatāraniṣpannaṃ nāgaṃ dadyāc ca gāṃ tathā |
tathā vastrāṇi deyāni viprāyāmitatejase ||
pūjayet pannagān sarvān sadā bhaktyā samanvitaḥ |
viśeṣatas tu pañcamyāṃ pañcamyāṃ pāyasena ca ||
iti skānde prabhāṣakhaṇḍe nāgapañcamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
pañcamī sā tithir dhanyā sarvapāpaharā śubhā |
etasyāṃ sarvato yas tu karmāṇi parivarjayet ||
kṣīreṇa snāpayen nāgān te ca yāsyanti mitratām |
[567]
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe nāgamaitrīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
tathā bhādrapade māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddayānvitaḥ |
yas tv ālekhya naro rājan kṛṣṇavarṇādivarṇakaiḥ ||
pūjayed gandhadhūpaiś ca sarpibhiḥ phalapāyasaiḥ |
pāyasena ghṛtāḍhyena pūjayitvā dvijottamam ||
nakaṃ svayaṃ tad aśnīyād yatavāg vītamatsaraḥ |
tasya tuṣṭiṃ samāyānti pannagās takṣakādayaḥ ||
āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ tasya na bhayaṃ nāgato bhavet ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam ālekhyapañcamīvratam |
payovrataṃ tu pañcamyāṃ datvā nāgaṃ dvijātaye |
sauvarṇaṃ sarpajanitaṃ bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate |
etat sarpavrataṃ proktaṃ sarvamaitrīkaraṃ param ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ sarpapañcamīvratam |
tilapiṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā gajaṃ haimavibhūṣitam |
kakṣāṅkuśayutaṃ tadvad ārohakasamanvitam ||
tadvad iti nirantaravratoktamantragajasvarūpaṃ gṛhyata (?) |
[568] nakṣatramālāsahitaṃ cāmarāpīṭhadhāriṇam |
daśanāgrabaddhanetraṃ raktavastrayugāvṛtam ||
tāmrapātryāṃ kuṇḍake vā kṛtadantāgramodakam |
pradadyād dvijadampatyoḥ pūjya mālāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
karṇābharaṇakam dadyād vastraṃ ca malavarjitam |
kāntāratarurataṃ hy etat kathitaṃ hi yudhiṣṭhira ||
kāntāragiridurgeṣu tārayaty api duḥkhitān |
iha loke pare caitan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā (?) ||
ye kurvanti dine puṇye vrataṃ paurandarāhvayam |
teṣāṃ paurandare loke vāsaḥ syāt suciraṃ nṛpa ||
dine puṇye pañcamyāṃ prakaraṇavaśāt |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ paurandaravratam |
lakṣmīm abhyarcya pañcamyām upavāsī bhaven nṛpaḥ |
samānte hemakamalaṃ dadyād dhenusamanvitam ||
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti lakṣmīr janmani janmani |
etal lakṣmīvrataṃ nāma duḥkhaśokavināśanam ||
iti yamapurāṇoktaṃ lakṣmīvratam |
sitāśva uvāca |
śrutāni devadeveśa (?) vratāni subahūni ca |
sāṃprataṃ me samācakṣa vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||
[569] brahmovāca |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
ṛṣipañcamīti vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param ||
yena cīrṇena rājendra narakāni vyapohati |
atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam ||
vaidehe ‘tra dvijavara utaṅko nāma nāmataḥ |
tasya bhāryāṃ suśīleti pativrataparāyaṇā ||
tasyā apatyayugalaṃ patnī hi suvibhūṣaṇam |
adhītavān sutas tasya vedān sāṅgapadakramāt ||
samāne ca kule tena sutā vāpi vivāhitā |
vivāhitaiva sā daivād vaidhavyaṃ prāpa satvaram ||
tāṃ pālayati hy āste sā sutāṃ nijapitur gṛhe |
tasyā duḥkhena saṃtaptaḥ sutaṃ saṃsthāpya veśmani ||
gaṅgātīre vanaṃ prāptaḥ sakalatras tayā saha |
sa tatrādhyāpayāmāsa śiṣyān vedān dvijottamaḥ ||
sutā bahumataṃ tasya pituḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratā |
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pariśrāntā kadācana ||
niśīthe kila saṃsuptā kṛmirāśir ajāyata |
tathāvidhāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vivastrāṃ prastaraṃ vinā ||
śiṣyā nivedayāmāsus tanmātuḥ karuṇānvitāḥ |
na jānīmo vayaṃ kiṃcid devīṃ sādhvīṃ tathāvidhām ||
kṛmirāśir atho jātā mātaḥ saṃprati dṛśyate |
bajapātasadṛkṣaṃ tat śrutvā śiṣyair udīritam ||
[570] saṃbhrāntamanasā śīghraṃ tatsamīpam upāgatā |
sā tāṃ tathāvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa suduhkhitā |
uraś ca tāḍayāmāsa sutarāṃ mā moham āpa ca ||
kṣaṇena prāpya caitanyaṃ tām utthāpya pramṛjya ca |
samālambya ca bāhubhyāṃ ninye tatpitur antikam ||
svāmin kathaya me sādhvī kena duṣkṛtakarmaṇā |
niśīthe saṃprasupteyaṃ jāyate kṛmisaṃkulā ||
etat śrutvā tato vākyam ṛṣir dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ |
jñātvā nivedayāmāsa tasyāḥ prāg janmaceṣṭitam ||
ṛṣir uvāca |
prāg iyaṃ saptame ‘tīte janmani brāhmaṇī hy abhūt |
tad abhāgā drapade (drupade?) saṃjātā ca rajasvalā ||
asyās tatpāpabhāvena jāyate kṛmivad vapuḥ |
rajasvalā ca bhāvena yuktā bhavati sānagha ||
prathame ‘hanit cāṇḍālī dvitīye grāmaśūkarī |
tṛtīye rajakī proktā caturthe ‘hani śudhyati ||
tathānayā sakhīsaṃgād gataṃ dṛṣṭāvamānitam |
dṛṣṭavrataprabhāvena jātā dvijakule ‘male ||
avamānād vratasyāsya kṛmirāśibhayādhunā |
etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kanyakākṛte ||
suśīlovāca |
darśanenāpi yasya syād viprāṇāṃ nirmal kule |
[571] janmabhuk madvidhānāṃ hi jāyate brahmatejasām ||
ayajñayā prajāyante vigrahe kṛmirāśayaḥ |
mahāścaryakaraṃ nātha tad vrataṃ kathayasva me ||
ṛṣir uvāca |
suśīle śṛṇu tat samyag vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yena cīrṇena sahasā pāpād asmād vimucyate ||
duḥkhacayābhighātaś ca jāyate sātra (?) saṃśayaḥ |
kalyāṇāni vivardhante saṃpadaś ca nirāpadaḥ ||
nabhasye śuklapakṣe tu yadā bhavati pañcamī |
nadyādiṣu tadā snānaṃ kṛtvā niyamam eva ca ||
vidhāya nityakarmādi gatvā dvāravatīm ṛṣīn |
snāpayed vidhivad bhaktyā pañcāmṛtarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
dvāravatīṃ agnihotraśālāṃ dhūmanirgamadvārair bahubhir yutatvāt |
candanāgurukarpūrair vilipya ca sugandhibhiḥ|
pūjayed vividhaiḥ puṣpair gandhadhūpādidīpakaiḥ ||
samācchādya śubhair vastraiḥ sopavītair yathāvidhi |
tato naivedyasaṃpannam arghyaṃ dadyāc chubhaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
arghyamantraḥ |
kaśyapo ‘trir bharadvājo viśvāmitras tu gautamaḥ |
jamadagnir vasiṣṭhaś ca saptaite ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
śrotavyam idam ākhyānaṃ śākāhāraṃ prakalpayet |
sthātavyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣidhyānaparāyaṇaiḥ ||
[572] anena vidhinā samyag vrataṃ caitat samācaret |
yasya yaj jāyate puṇyaṃ tad vṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ ||
sarvavrateṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yat phalam |
sarvadāneṣu datteṣu tad asya vratapāraṇāt ||
kurute yā vrataṃ caitat sā nārī sukhabhāginī |
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktā putrapautrādisaṃyutā ||
iha loke sadaiva syāt paratrāpy akṣayā gatiḥ |
vratasyāsya prabhāvena jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm ||
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇoktam ṛṣipañcamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
nāgān iṣṭvā tu pañcamyāṃ na viṣair abhibhūyate |
striyaṃ ca labhate putraṃ paramāṃ śriyam āpnuyāt ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
tithīśvaro ‘tra nāgaḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjā śāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homo yataḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
[573]
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nāgavratam |
aśvarāḍ amṛtāj jāto vātaraṃhā manojavaḥ |
uccaiḥśravāḥ pūjanīyaś caitraśuklasya pañcamī ||
tatraiva pūjyā gandharvās turaṅgāṇāṃ tu bāndhavāḥ |
patravāṇadharāḥ kecit kecit patraiś ca saṃyutāḥ ||
bhīmaś citrarathaś caiva vikhyātaḥ sarvaviddaṣam |
tathā sāliśirāḥ śrīmān pradyumnaś ca mahāyaśāḥ ||
nāradaś ca kalindaś ca gandharvaś ca hāhā huhuḥ |
suvāhus tumburuś caiva tathā citrarathaḥ prabhuḥ ||
citrāṅgadaś ca vikhyātaś citrasenaś ca vīryavān |
siddhapūrṇaś ca badarī parṇāśaś ca mahāyaśāḥ ||
brahmacārī ratiguṇaḥ suparṇo ‘tivalas tathā |
viśvāvasuḥ surendraś ca gandharvo ‘tiparākramaḥ ||
ity ete pūjanīyāḥ syur gītair uccāvacaiḥ (?) subhaiḥ |
godakaiḥ pīlikābhiś ca paramānnena cākṣataiḥ ||
dadhnā guḍena payasā śālipiṣṭena bhūriśaḥ |
dhūpair mālyais tathā dīpair dvijānāṃ svastivācanaiḥ ||
evaṃ hi pūjitāḥ samyak turagāṇāṃ hi bāndhavāḥ |
balam āyuḥ prayacchanti saṃgrāmeṣv aparājayam ||
ārogyaṃ paramāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca vidhīyate |
[574] iti śālihotrahayapañcamīvratam |
sarvoṣadhyudakasnātaḥ pañcamyāṃ pūjya padmajam |
sarvopaskaradānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti gṛhāśrame ||
gṛhāṭodūkhalaṃ śūrpaṃ śilāṃ sthālīṃ ca pañcamīm |
gṛhāṭaḥ peṣaṇayantram, udūkhalaṃ dhyānyakaṇḍanam |
udakumbhaṃ ca pūrṇaṃ ca eteṣām anugaṃ ca yat |
etāni gṛhiṇāṃ gehe prasthāpya puruṣottama ||
upaskarakṛte nārī na sīdati kadācana |
etad gṛhavrataṃ nāma sarvasaukhyapradāyakam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ gṛhapañcamīvratam |
pañcamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tathā candrasamo naraḥ |
āyuś ca vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ yaśaś cāgryaṃ ca vindati ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ saubhāgyavratam |
pañcamyāṃ pṛthivīṃ devīṃ tathā saṃpūjayen naraḥ |
tam evāpnoti (?) yatnena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ pṛthivīvratam |
viśvedevāś ca ye proktāḥ pūrvam eva mayā daśa |
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā pañcamyāṃ divam āpnuyāt ||
[575] vāyupurāṇāt |
kratur dakṣo vasuḥ satyaḥ kālakāmau virocanau |
purūravā bhādravāś ca viśvedevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rūpāvāptivratam |
vāruṇaiḥ puskarasthāṃ yaḥ pūjāṃ caiva samācaret |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya tu phalaṃ labhet ||
vāruṇaiḥ puṣyaiḥ | puṣkaram uttamaṃ tathā pūjām api kuryāt |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śrīprāptivratam |
caitraśuklasya pañcamyāṃ pūjayitvā yathāśriyam |
sakṛd evāpnuyād etat phalaṃ saṃvatsaroditam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śrīvratam |
umāṃ medhāṃ bhadrakālīṃ tathā kātyāyanīm api |
dhṛtiṃ svāhāṃ svadhām ṛddhim anasūyāṃ tathā kṣamām ||
surabhīṃ devasenāṃ ca velāṃ jyotsnāṃ tathā śacīm |
gaurīṃ varuṇapatnīṃ ca dhūmrāṇīṃ ca tathaiva ca ||
[576] abhīṣṭadevajananīṃ devapatnīṃ tathaiva ca |
pūjayan kāmam āpnoti vītaśoko na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmotaroktaṃ kāmātrivratam |
airāvaṇaṃ vāyatuṇḍam uccaiḥśravasam eva ca |
tadā saṃpūjayan rājan vijayaṃ samupāśnute ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ vijayavratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājamahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
vratakhaṇḍe pañcamīvratāni |
[577]
atha ṣaṣṭhīvratāni |
adhyāste satataṃ yadīyarasanā siṃhāsanaṃ bhāratī
yasyotphullamanaḥsarojanilayaṃ kṣīrodaśāyī vibhuḥ |
ślāghyaṃ dakṣiṇapāṇipallavatalaṃ yasyāpi kalpadrumo
hemādriḥ sa nirūpayaty abhimataṃ ṣaṣṭhīvratānāṃ gaṇam ||
vikrānta uvāca |
rūpasaṃpadam ārogyaṃ svargavāsaṃ ca puṣkalam |
prāpnuvanti narā yena niyamaṃ taṃ vadasva me ||
agastya uvāca |
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña yat pṛṣṭo ‘haṃ tvayānagha |
tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tataḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati ||
śṛṇu pārthiva vakṣyāmi sarvamokṣapradaṃ nṛṇām |
yac ca guptaṃ purā rājan brahmaviṣṇvindradevataiḥ ||
asurāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ tathaiva ca |
śaṅkareṇa purā caitat ṣaṇmukhāya niveditam ||
ṣaṇmukhena samākhyātaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam |
[578] yat kṛtvā brahmahā goghnaḥ surāpo gurutalpagaḥ ||
agāradāhī garadaḥ sarvapāparato ‘pi vā |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo vrataṃ śrutvā narottama ||
sarvapuṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca nṛṇām adbhutanāśanam |
upakārāya lokānāṃ tathā tava nṛpottama ||
śṛṇu bhūpa mahāpuṇyaṃ vratamāhātmyam uttamam ||
proṣṭhapadāsite pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī bhaumena saṃyutā |
vyatīpātena rohiṇyā sā ṣaṣṭhī kapilā smṛtā ||
proṣṭhapado bhādrapadaḥ | sa cātra darśānto grāhyaḥ, rohiṇīyogasya (?) tatraiva saṃbhavāt |
dvitīyā tu mahāpuṇyā durlabhā vratinaḥ kvacit |
ṣaṣṭhī saṃvatsarasyānte sā punas tena saṃyutā ||
caitravaiśākhayor madhye site pakṣe śubhodayā |
vaiśākhe ‘pi ca rājendra dvāravatyāṃ parā smṛtā ||
yadi haste sahasrāṃśus tadā kāryaṃ vrataṃ budhaiḥ |
asyāṃ caiva hutaṃ dattaṃ yat kiṃcit pratipāditam ||
tasya sarvasya puṇyasya saṃkhyāṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate |
yasmin kāle bhaved etair guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī yutā tadā ||
pañcamyām ekabhaktaṃ tu kuryāt tatra vicakṣaṇaḥ |
ṣaṣṭyāṃ prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtvādau dantadhāvanam ||
jalapūrṇāñjaliṃ kṛtvā imaṃ mantram udīrayet |
nirāhāro ‘dya deveśa tvadbhaktas tvatparāyaṇaḥ ||
[579] pūjayiṣyāmy ahaṃ bhaktyā śaraṇaṃ bhava bhāskara |
arghyaṃ datveti saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā tatra śucis tataḥ ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena nadyāṃ tīrthe ‘tha vā hrade |
taḍāge dīrghikāyāṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ||
devadāru tathośīrakuṅkumailāmanaḥśilāḥ (?) |
patrakaṃ padmakaṃ yaṣṭī madhu gavyena peṣayet ||
kṣīreṇāloḍya kalkena snānaṃ kuryāt samantrakam |
oṃ āpas tvam asi deveśa jyotiṣāṃ patir eva ca ||
pāpaṃ nāśaya me deva vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmajam |
pañcagavyakṛtasnānaṃ pañcabhaṅgais tu mārjayet ||
pañcabhaṅgaiḥ pañcapallavaiḥ |
ānayen mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ snānārthaṃ tu prayatnataḥ |
mṛttike brahmapūtāsi kāśyapenābhimantritā ||
pavitraṃ kuru māṃ nityaṃ sarvapāpāt samuddhara |
mantreṇānena varuṇaṃ pūjayed buddhimān naraḥ ||
pāśāgrahasta varuṇa sarvavārīśvara prabho |
adyāhaṃ prārthayāmi tvaṃ pūtaṃ kuru sureśvara ||
ādityo bhāśkaro bhānū raviḥ sūryo dvākaraḥ |
prabhākaro ‘si timiro devaḥ sarveśvaro hariḥ ||
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmyāṃ vai kuṅkumena tu |
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadram ālikhed buddhimān naraḥ ||
tatra madhye liket padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sukarṇikam |
[580] pūrvapatre nyaset sūryam āgneye tapanaṃ nyaset |
suvarṇaretasaṃ yāmye nairṛtye ca nyased ravim ||
ādityaṃ vāruṇe patre vāyavye ca divākaram |
saumye prabhākaraṃ tatra sūram īśānapatrake ||
tīvraraśmidharaṃ devaṃ brahmānaṃ caiva vinyaset |
ādhārarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ madhyaṃ tu varuṇaṃ nyaset ||
sahasraraśmiṃ sūryaṃ ca sūkṣmasthūlaguṇānvitam |
sarvagaṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca madhye bhāskaram eva ca ||
saptāśvaratham ārūḍhaṃ padmahastaṃ divākaram |
akṣasūtradhanuḥpāṇiṃ kuṇḍalair mukuṭena ca ||
ratnair nānāvidhair yuktaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tatra kārayet |
śaktitas tu palād ūrdhvaṃ tadardhaṃ karṣato ‘pi vā ||
sauvarṇaṃ mārutaṃ kuryād raukyaṃ caiva tathā ratham |
saptāśvair bhūṣitaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ tasyāgrataḥ sthitam ||
aruṇaṃ vinatāputraṃ gṛhītāśvam anūrukam |
evaṃ rūpaṃ rasaṃ kṛtvā padmasyopari vinaset ||
tasyopari nyased devaṃ raktavastravibhūṣitam |
raktacandanamālyādimaṇḍitaṃ vātiśobhitam ||
agrataḥ sārathiṃ kṛtvā pūjayed aruṇaṃ śuciḥ |
raktapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiś ca tathānyair api śaktitaḥ ||
oṃ vinatātanayo devaḥ karmasākṣī tamonudaḥ |
saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuś ca aruṇo me prasīdatu ||
mantreṇānena saṃpūjya sārathiṃ tadanantaram |
[581] devasya vācanaṃ kalpya prabhūtādikapañcakam ||
prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ sāram ārādhyaṃ paramaṃ śubham |
dīptābhiḥ śaktibhiś caiva tato bhānuṃ prapūjayet ||
dīptā sūkṣmā tathā bhadrā vinatā vimalānaghā |
amoghā vaidyutā ceti navamī sarvatomukhī ||
apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato ‘pi vā |
yaḥ smared bhāskaraṃ devaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ||
śikhāyāṃ bhāskaraṃ nyasya lalāṭe sūryam eva ca |
cakṣurmadhye nyased bhānuṃ mukhe tatra raviṃ nyaset ||
kaṇṭhe nyased bhānumantaṃ padmagarbhaṃ dvihastayoḥ |
timiraṃ kṣayakṛd devaṃ stanayor eva vinyaset ||
jātadevobhidhaṃ nābhyāṃ kaṭyāṃ bhānuṃ tathā nyaset |
ugrasūryaṃ guhyadeśe tejorūpaṃ dvijaṅghayoḥ ||
pādayoḥ sarvarūpaṃ tu sūkṣmasthūlaguṇānvitam |
evaṃ yathoktaṃ vinyasya pātraṃ gṛhya tathārcayet ||
karavīrārkakusumai raktacandanacampakaiḥ |
puṣpaiḥ sugandhair dhūpaiś ca kuṅkumair upaśobhitam ||
mārtaṇḍaṃ bhānum ādityaṃ bhāskaraṃ tapanaṃ ravim |
haṃsaṃ divākaraṃ ceti pādato mukuṭāvadhi ||
pādau jaṅghe tathā jānudvayam ūruṃ kaṭiṃ tathā |
nābhivakṣasthalaṃ śīrṣam eteṣv aṅgeṣu pūjayet ||
ānayed arghyapātraṃ tad raupyaṃ vā tāmram eva ca |
arghyārthaṃ daivataṃ pātram udakena prapūrayet ||
[582] pūjayet tatra prāgādi devatās tāḥ samāhitaḥ |
digdevatās tataḥ pūjya gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
pātre toyaṃ samādāya sapuṣpaṃ phalacandanam |
jānubhyām avanīṃ gatvā sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet ||
vedagarbha namas tubhyaṃ vedagarbha namo ‘stu te |
avyaktamūrtaye tubhyam arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te ||
brahmamūrtidharmomeśa caturvaktra sanātana |
sṛṣṭisthitau saṃsthitāya gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo ‘stu te ||
viṣṇurūpadharo devaḥ pītavastraś caturbhujaḥ |
prabhavaḥ sarvalokānām arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te ||
yaṃ rudrarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ bhagavantaṃ triśūlinam |
yo dahec ca triloke vai arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te ||
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ ca viṣṇuś ca rudras tvaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ |
tvam eva sarvabhūtātmā arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te ||
kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā vedātmā sarvatomukhaḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāśokasaṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ ||
dāridryavyasanadhvaṃsī śrīmān devo divākaraḥ |
suvarṇasphaṭiko bhānuḥ svarṇaretā devākara ||
haridaśvo ‘ṃśumālī ca arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te |
caturbhir mūrtibhiḥ saṃsthām aṣṭābhiḥ parigīyate ||
caturbhir mūrtibhiḥ saṃsthām aṣṭābhiḥ parimīyate |
sāmadhvanisrayo yajñe arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te ||
atha gandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca tathā dhūpaṃ ca dīpakam |
[583] naivedyaṃ ca yathāśaktyā prārthayet sūryadevatām ||
agnim īḷe namas tubhyaṃ namas te jātavedase |
īṣe caiva namas tubhyam agne caiva namo namaḥ ||
śan no devī namas tubhyaṃ jagajjanma namo namaḥ |
ātmarūpin namas tubhyaṃ viśvamūrtte namo namaḥ ||
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ ca vai viṣṇus tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ hutāśanaḥ |
muktikāmam abhīpsyāmi prārthayāmi sureśvara ||
viśvataś cakṣur ākhyāto viśvataś caraṇānana |
viśvātmā sarvato devaḥ prārthayāmi sureśvara ||
iti mantraṃ samuccārya namas kurvīta bhāskaram |
saṃvarcaseti pāṇibhyāṃ toyena visrajen (?) mukham ||
haṃsaḥ śuciṣād ity ṛcā sūryasyaivāvalokanam |
ud u tyaṃ citram ity etat sūktaṃ devāgrato japet ||
prathame caiva koṇe tu phalaṃ caiva ca kārayet |
phalaiḥ puṣpair akṣatādibhakṣyair nānāvidhair api ||
śayyāṃ tatra ca devasya śubhe deśe prakalpayet |
ṣaṭdhānyaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ devaṃ raupyaṃ caiva mahāprabhum ||
puruṣaṃ khaḍgahastaṃ ca kārayec caiva buddhimān |
vastrayugmena saṃchannaṃ lavaṇopari vinyaset ||
anenaiva ca mantreṇa snānam arghārcanaṃ tataḥ |
namas te krodharūpāya khaḍgahastajighāṃsave ||
jighāṃsakāmas tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā juhuvuḥ sarvadevatāḥ |
tvayā vyāptaṃ merupṛṣṭhaṃ caṇḍabhāskarasuprabham ||
[584] atas tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo ‘stu te |
kṣapayitvā tato rātriṃ gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
tatas tv abhyudite sūrye homaṃ kuryāt svaśaktitaḥ |
pūjayet tatra śaktyā ca devāṃś ca vidhivad gurum ||
homo ‘rkasya samidbhiś ca ghṛtamiśrais tilais tathā |
saṃsiddhacarukaṃ caiva ghṛtaṃ ca juhuyād dvijaḥ ||
ākṛṣṇeneti mantreṇa śatam aṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
homo vyāhṛtibhiś cātha sviṣṭakṛt tadanantaram |
kapilāṃ pūjayed devīṃ savatsāṃ pāpanāśinīm ||
vastrayugmāṃ saghaṇṭāṃ ca svarṇaśṛṅgavibhūṣitām |
suvarṇāsyāṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakalpitām ||
mantreṇānena tāṃ dadyād brāḥmaṇāya ca śaktitaḥ |
kapile sarvadevānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇī ||
sarvato’rthamayī yasmād ataḥ śāṇtiṃ prayaccha me |
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvadevānāṃ yā ca deveṣv avasthitā ||
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama śāntiṃ prayacchatu |
dehasthā yā ca rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkarasya ca yā priyā ||
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
viṣṇor vakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ (?) svāhā caiva vibhāvasoḥ ||
candrārkānalaśaktir yā dhenurūpās tu sā śriye |
caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīr yā lakṣmīr dhanadasya ca ||
[585] lakṣmīr yā lokapālānāṃ sā dhenur varadās tu me ||
svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujām api |
vaṣaṭ yā procyate loke sā dhenus tuṣṭidās tu me ||
gāvo me agrataḥ santu gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
gāvo me hṛdaye santu navāṃ madhye vasāmy aham ||
gopūjanamantraḥ |
gāvaḥ spṛṣṭvā namas kṛtya yo vai kuryāt pradakṣiṇam |
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā ||
namas te kapile devi sarvapāpapraṇāśini |
saṃsārārṇavamagnaṃ māṃ gomātas trātum arhasi ||
godānamantraḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhas tvaṃ hemabījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
anantapuṇyaphaladam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
alaṃkāradānamantraḥ |
raktavastrayugaṃ yasmād ādityasya ca vallabham |
pradānāt tasya me sūrya ataḥ śāntiṃ prayacchatu ||
vastradānamantraḥ |
suvarṇaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca paridhānaṃ ca kāryet |
suvarṇam alaṃkāraṃ paridhānaṃ yathāsthānadhṛtaṃ kārayet parigrāhakeṇa |
etaiḥ prakāraiḥ saṃyuktāṃ dadyād dhenuṃ dvijātaye |
bhānuṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dadyān mantreṇānena yatnataḥ ||
bhāskaro vidhito jāto dravyastho bhāskaraḥ svayam |
bhāskarasya pradātā ca tena vai bhāskaro mama ||
dānamantraḥ |
bhāskaraṃ pratigṛhṇāmi bhāskaro vai dadati ca |
bhāskaras tārakobhābhyāṃ tena vai bhāskaro mama ||
pratigrahamantraḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt pāyasena guḍena ca |
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tebhyaś caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
alpavitto ‘pi yaḥ kaścit so ‘pi kuryād imaṃ vidhim |
ātmaśaktyanusāreṇa so ‘pi tat phalam āpnuyāt ||
ācāryasya tato bhaktyā sarvaprāṇair vinikṣipet |
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi vrīhayo lavaṇaṃ tilāḥ ||
etat sarvaṃ pradatvā ca kapilāṃ prārthayet tataḥ |
kapile puṇyakarmāsi niṣpāpe puṇyakarmaṇi ||
māṃ samuddhara dīnaṃ vādadato hy abhayaṃ kuru ||
adadato adātur api |
divyavāditraśabdaiś ca sevyase kathitā sadā |
tathā vidyādharāḥ siddhā bhūtanāgagaṇā grahāḥ ||
kapilā romasaṃkhyātās tatra devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pramuñcanti nityam ākāśam āsthitāḥ ||
brahmanotpāditā devī agnikuṇḍā tu suprabhā |
namas te kapile puṇye sarvadevanamaskṛte ||
[587] jaya nityamahāsatve sarvatīrthādimaṅgale |
dātāraṃ svajanopetaṃ brahmalokaṃ nayāśu vai ||
dātāraṃ vratāṅgānām |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā natvā brāhmaṇapuṅgavān |
āśīrvādān vadeyus te putrapautradhanāgamān ||
ārogyaṃ rūpasaubhāgyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ |
ante golokam āsādya virāyuḥ sukhabhāg bhavet ||
yadā svargāt prapatati rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
saptadvīpavatīṃ bhuṅkte bhuktvā rājyam akaṇṭakam ||
aho vratam idaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhapraṇāśanam |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānasya phalam uttamam ||
mahāvedamaye pātre sadvṛtte sākṣayaṃ bhavet |
vrataṃ sarvavrataśreṣṭham idam agryaṃ mahāphalam ||
tārayiṣyati dātāraṃ nūnam akṣayam avyayam |
evaṃ devagaṇāḥ sarve bhūtasaṃghāś ca harṣitāḥ ||
ākāśasthāḥ pranṛtyanti puṇye ‘smin divasāgame |
pātrabhūtāya ṛṣaye śrotriyāya kuṭumbine ||
evaṃ yaḥ kapilāṃ dadyād vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yāvan na cyavate punaḥ ||
skānde prabhāsakhaṇḍe tu viśeṣaḥ |
upalipte śubhe deśe puṣpākṣatavibhūṣite |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ candanodakapūritam ||
[588] pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam |
raktavastrayugachatraṃ tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam ||
ratho raukmaphalasyaiva ekacakraḥ sucitritaḥ |
sauvarṇaphalasaṃyuktāṃ mūrtiṃ sūryasya kārayet ||
kumbhasyopari saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpais tathārcayet |
ādityaṃ pūjayed devaṃ nāmabhiḥ svair yathoditaiḥ ||
āditya bhāskara rave bhāno sūrya divākara |
prabhākara nama tubhyaṃ saṃsārān māṃ samuddhara ||
bhuktimuktiprado yasmāt tasmāc chāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
prārthanamantraḥ |
namo namas te varada ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ pate |
namas te viśvarūpāya viśvadhāmne namo ‘stu te ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad devadevaṃ divākaram |
pūjayet kapilāṃ dhenuṃ vastramālyānulepanaiḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
divyamūrtir jagaccakṣur dvādaśātmā divākaraḥ |
kapilāsahito devo mama muktiṃ prayacchatu ||
tasmāt tvaṃ kapile puṇyā sarvalokasya pāvanī |
pradattā saha sūryeṇa mama muktipradā bhava ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ kapilāṣaṣṭhīvratam |
īśvara uvāca |
caitraśuklāt samārabhya vratārtham adhunocyate |
upoṣya vidhinā ṣaṣṭhīṃ viśeṣāt ṣaṇmukhaṃ yajet ||
[589] mṛṇmayīṃ pratimāṃ ramyāṃ tadā kuryād viśeṣataḥ |
ṣaṇmukhaṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ bālavat kāñcanaprabham ||
mayūravāhanaṃ devaṃ saumyaṃ lāvaṇyapūritam |
śaktighaṇṭāpatākāstrapāśakukkuṭabhūṣitam |
daṇḍābhayaṃ savaradaṃ khaḍgeṣudhiśarāsanam |
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā śuklapuṣpopacārakaiḥ ||
naivedyaṃ gandhavastrāṇi sūklāny eva pradāpayet |
brāhmīrasaṃ samādāya kapilājyaphalaṃ tathā||
sārasvaṇmanunāmantrya sahasrāṣṭottareṇ atu ||
sārasvaṇmanunā sarasvatīmantreṇa |
ācāryaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā vastrahemānnavāhanaiḥ |
brāhmīrasaghṛtaṃ paścād vratānte prāśanaṃ hitam ||
māsi māsi prakartavyaṃ yāvat saṃvatsarāvadhi (?) |
brahmacaryeṇa śucinā abdam ekaṃ samācaret ||
mahākavir bhavet so ‘pi bhuvi vācaspatir yathā |
sakṛd gṛhṇāti śāstrāṇi vādināṃ mūrdhni tiṣṭhati ||
rakṣovināyakās tasya na hiṃsanti kadācana |
skandagrahā mahāghorās tathāpasmāradurgrahāḥ ||
na hiṃsanti mahāsenavratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
idaṃ vratottamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtivardhanam ||
ṣaṇmukhaṃ pārvatīputraṃ guhaṃ skandaṃ kumārakam |
kārtikeyaṃ tathā bālaṃ tathā krauñcanisudanam ||
tārakārātisaṃjñaṃ ca tathānyaṃ kṛttikāsutam |
[590] vaiśākhaṃ ca viśākhaṃca māsi māsi prapūjayet ||
sūryaṃ sūryakalāyuktaṃ śiśinā mūrdhni bhūṣitam |
krameṇa mantrā boddhavyā dvādaśānāṃ śikhidhvaja ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ kumāraṣaṣṭhīvratam |
skanda uvāca |
prāptarājyaṃ ca rājānaṃ dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram |
kadācid āyayau draṣṭuṃ durvāsā munisattamaḥ ||
taṃ papraccha mahātejā dharmasūnuḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ |
tad vrataṃ (?) śrotum icchāmi kartuṃ ca munisattama ||
durvāsā uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
astīha yac cīrṇamātrāt sarvakāmāṃs tu pūrayet ||
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kuryād akhaṇḍitavrato hy api |
yadi labhyeta jīve ‘hni daivena nṛpasattama ||
ṣaṣṭhī bhādrapade śuklā vaidhṛtena samanvitā |
viśākhā bhaumayogena sā campetīha viśrutā ||
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ durlabhā ṣaṣṭihāyanī |
kṛte tretāyāṃ pañcāśaddhāyanī dvāpare punaḥ ||
catvāriṃśat kalau triṃśaddhāyanī durlabhā tataḥ |
ādau kṛtayuge pūrvaṃ yā cīrṇā viśvakarmaṇā ||
tatphalād viśvakartṛtvaṃ prājāpatyam avāptavā |
[591] pṛthunā kārtavīryeṇa bhuvā nārāyaṇena ca ||
īśvareṇomayā sārdham itaretaralipsayā |
yaś caināṃ vidhivat kuryāt so ‘nantaṃ phalam aśnute ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
tadvidhiṃ śrotum icchāmi vistarād gadato mune |
ke mantrāḥ ke ca niyamāḥ sāpi kiṃlakṣaṇā bhavet ||
durvāsā uvāca |
dvidaivatyarkṣabhaumena vaidhṛtena sumanvitā |
nabhasye vāsitā ṣaṣṭhī sā campeti nigadyate ||
dvidaivatyarkṣaṃ viśākhā |
pañcamyāṃ niyamaṃ kuryād upavāsasya ca vrati |
upavāsasyāṅgabhūtaniyamam ekabhaktaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
campāṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ kuryād yathoktavacanād guroḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
kṛtvā samyag vrataṃ tasya saṃkalpaṃ kurute naraḥ |
samyak kṛtvā sarvāṅgopetavrataniṣpādanaśaktiṃ nirdhārya |
nirāhāro ‘dya deveśa tvadbhaktas tatparāyaṇaḥ |
pūjayiṣyāmy ahaṃ bhaktyā śaraṇaṃ bhava bhāskara ||
saṃkalpamantraḥ |
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta nadyādau vimale jale |
mṛdam ālabhya mantraiś ca tilaiḥ śuklaiś ca mantravit ||
sāvitraḥ paramas tvaṃ hi paraṃ dhāma jale mama |
tvattejasā paribhraṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ yātu sahasradhā ||
[592] prārthanamantraḥ |
āpas tvam asi deveśa jyotiṣāṃ patir eva ca |
pāpaṃ nāśaya me deva vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ kṛtam ||
snānamantraḥ |
tataḥ saṃtarpayed devān ṛṣīn pitṛgaṇān api |
tataś cetya gṛhaṃ maunī pāṣaṇḍālāpavarjitaḥ |
sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayec chubhraṃ caturasraṃ suśobhanam |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam ||
raktavastrayugachannaṃ raktacandanacarcitam |
tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ sauvarṇaṃ tāmram eva vā ||
kuṅkumena likhet padmaṃ dvādaśāraṃ sakarṇikam |
tasyopari nyaset sūryaṃ sauvarṇaṃ sarathāruṇam ||
śaktyā vā vittasāreṇa vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
tam arcayed gandhapuṣpair vidhimantrapuraḥsaram ||
pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kuryād arkasya saṃyataḥ |
tatas tu gandhatoyena parāṃ pūjāṃ samācaret ||
gandhair nānāvidhair divyaiḥ karpūrāgurukuṅkumaiḥ |
phalais tad anusaṃbhūtair anekaiś ca sugandhibhiḥ ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tatra puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam |
yathāśobhaṃ prakurvīta adhaś coparisarvataḥ ||
tatas tu pūjayed devaṃ bhāskaraṃ kamalopari |
ādityāya namaḥ | tapanāya namaḥ | puṣṇe namaḥ | bhānumate namaḥ | bhānave namaḥ | aryamne namaḥ | viśvavaktāya namaḥ | aṃśumate namaḥ | [593] sahasrāṃśave namaḥ | khanāyakāya namaḥ | mukarāya namaḥ | sūryāya namaḥ | khagāya namaḥ|
eṣu prathamena mantreṇa madhye pūjanam itarair dvādaśabhiḥ pūrvādidalakrameṇa pūjanam |
ādityappūjāmantraḥ |
janmāntarasahasreṇa duṣkṛtaṃ yan mayā kṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyātu divākara tavārcanāt ||
prārthanamantraḥ |
vinatātanayo devaḥ karmasākṣī tamonudaḥ |
saptāśvaḥ (?) saptarajjuś ca aruṇo me prasīdatu ||
rathapūjāmantraḥ |
tataḥ saṃpūjayed devam acyutaṃ tadrathasthitam |
aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ||
aṣṭākṣaro ghṛṇimantraḥ saṃpradāyād avagantavyaḥ |
kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā vedātmā viśvatomukhaḥ |
janmamṛtyujarārogasaṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ ||
sūryodaye arghyamantraḥ |
tataḥ saṃpūjayec chuklāṃ savatsāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm |
savastrakaṇṭhābharaṇāṃ sṛgghaṇṭābhir (?) alaṃkṛtām ||
brahmaṇotpādite devi sarvapāpavināśini |
saṃsārārṇavamagnaṃ māṃ gomātas trātum arhasi ||
[594] surūpā bahurūpāś ca mātaro lokamātaraḥ |
gāvo mām upasarpantu saritaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ||
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvadevānāṃ yā ca deveṣu saṃsthitā |
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
yā lakṣmīr lokapālānāṃ yā lakṣmīr dhadasya ca |
candrārkaśakraśaktir yā sā dhenur varadās tu me ||
dhenupūjāmantraḥ |
tilahomaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sāvitryāṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
tatas tāṃ kalpayed dhenum arko me prīyatām iti ||
ācāryāya tato dadyād ādityaṃ sarathāruṇam |
sakumbharatnavastraiś ca sarvopaskaraṇaiḥ saha ||
dadāmi bhānuṃ bhavate sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
mano’bhilaṣitāvāsaṃ karotu mama bhāskaraḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
gṛhṇāmi bhāskara rave ananta viśvatomukha |
mano’bhilaṣitāvāptim ubhayoḥ kartum arhasi ||
pratigrahamantraḥ |
sarvato’rthamayīṃ dhenuṃ sarvayajñamayīṃ śubhām |
sarvadānamayīṃ devīṃ brāhmaṇāya dadāmy aham ||
godānamantraḥ |
gṛhṇāmi surabhiṃ devīṃ sarvayajñamayīṃ śubhām |
[595] ubhau punīhi varade ubhayos tārikā bhava ||
pratigrahamantraḥ |
tatas tu bhojayed viprān dvādaśaiva svaśaktitaḥ |
dadyāc ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet ||
avaikalyaṃ vrataṃ tasya sā dhenur dvijasattamaḥ |
abhinandatu hy āśīrbhir abhiramyeraninditā (?) |
tatas tu svayam aśnīyād dvijānāṃ śeṣam iṣṭavān ||
saha putraiḥ kalatraiś ca anyair bahujanair vṛtaḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute campāṃ so ‘tyantaṃ phalam aśnute ||
prabhūṇāṃ ca vidhiḥ proktas tatprabhūṇāṃ ca gocaraḥ |
sarvair hy etad vrataṃ kāryaṃ svaśaktyā duḥkhabhīrubhiḥ ||
prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo ‘nukalpena vartate |
viphalaṃ tasya tatra syād anīśas tv anukalpikaḥ ||
pañcamyāṃ niyamaṃ kuryād ācāryavacanād vratī |
ṣaṣṭyāṃ snānaṃ prakurvīta saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
abhyetya svagṛhaṃ maunī sūryaṃ manasi cintayet |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ mṛtpātraṃ ca tathopari ||
tasyopari nyaset sūryaṃ palaikena vinirmitam |
sauvarṇaṃ bhaktisaṃyuktaṃ vittasāraṃ tathāruṇam ||
tam arcayej jagannāthaṃ gṛhītvājñāṃ guroḥ svayam |
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa gandhapuṣpānusaṃbhavam ||
[596] oṃ namaḥ sūryāyeti mantraḥ |
saṃpūjya vidhivad devaṃ phalapuṣpādikaṃ ca yat |
sūryāyāvedayet sarvaṃ sūryo me prīyatām iti ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale gatvā gurugṛhaṃ vratī |
sarvopakaraṇaiḥ sūryam ācāryāya nivedayet ||
dhānyaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vastraṃ ratnaṃ gavādikaṃ ca yet |
gavāṃ koṭisahasreṇa kurukṣetre ‘rkaparvaṇi ||
campādānasya rājendra kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
sarvatīrthapradānāni tathānyāny api ṣoḍaśa ||
campāyās tulanā pārtha campaikā tv atiricyate |
ādityas tapanaḥ pūṣā bhānumān bhānur aryamā ||
viśvavaktro ‘ṃśumān devaḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ khanāyakaḥ |
sūraḥ sūryaḥ khagaḥ pūjyaḥ pūrvapatrādiṣu kramāt ||
deva ity aṃśumato viśeṣaṇam | āsidityo madhye pūjyas tapanādayaḥ pūrvapatrādiṣu pūjyā ity arthaḥ | pañcamyām ityādinā punar vratavidhir dhanahīnaviṣayaḥ |
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ campāṣaṣṭīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī bharatasattama |
puṇyā pāpaharā jñeyā śivā śītā guhapriyā ||
[597] nihatya tārakaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ guhas tārakarājavat |
rarāja tena dayitā kārttikeyasya sā tithiḥ ||
snānadānādikaṃ karma tasyām akṣayam ucyate |
ye ‘syāṃ paśyanti gāṅgeyaṃ dakṣiṇāśāṃ samāśritam ||
brahmahatyādipāpais te mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tasmād asyāṃ sopavāsaḥ kumāraṃ svarṇasaṃbhavam ||
rājataṃ ca mahārāja mṛṇmayaṃ cātha dārujam |
kārayitvārthasāreṇa kāmāmarṣavivarjitaḥ ||
aparāhṇe tataḥ snātvā samyag ācamya buddhimān |
padmāsanasthaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ dhyāyaṃs tiṣṭhec ca śaktitaḥ ||
brāhmaṇas tu tato vidvān gṛhītvā karakan navaṃ |
dakṣiṇāsyaḥ svaśirasi dhārāṃ caiva nipātayet ||
dandramaṇḍālasaṃbhūtā bhavabhūtipavitritā |
gaṅgākumāra dhāreyaṃ pātitā tava mastake ||
evaṃ dhyātvā samabhyarcya mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ divaḥ |
puṣpadhūpādinā paścāt pūjayet kṛttikāsutam ||
deva senāpate skanda kārttikeya bhavodbhava |
kumāra guha gāṅgeya śaktihasta namo ‘stu te ||
ebhir nāmapadaiḥ pūjya naivedyaṃ vinivedayet |
phalāni panasādīni dakṣiṇāśābhavāni vai ||
candanaṃ malayodbhūtaṃ karpūraṃ svāmivallabham |
pārśvasthau pūjayec chāgakukkutau sarvadā priyau ||
[598] sakalāpan (?) mayūraṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ hemajaṃ tathā |
kṛttikā śakaṭaṃ pārśve saṃpūjya skandavallabham ||
tair eva nāmabhir homaḥ kāryaḥ sājyais tilais tataḥ |
evaṃ nirvartya vidhivat palam ekaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
prāśayitvā svaped rātrau kṣitisthe darbhasaṃstare |
nālikeraṃ mātulaṅgaṃ nāraṅgaṃ panasaṃ tathā ||
jambīraṃ dāḍimaṃ drākṣāṃ śrīphalāmalakaṃ tathā |
kadalyāś ca phalaṃ hṛdyaṃ trapuṣaṃ kramaśo nṛpa ||
pratimāsaṃ prāśayitvā māsam ekaṃ vivarjayet |
alābhe deśakālotthaiḥ phalair dvādaśabhiḥ kramāt ||
saṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate rājan naktabhuktasya nānyathā |
pratyakṣo hemaghaṭitaḥ chāgo vā kukkuṭo ‘tha vā ||
prātar dadyād vācakāya senānīḥ priyatām iti |
senānīśvarasaṃbhūtaḥ krauñcāriḥ ṣaṇmukho guhaḥ ||
gāṅgeyaḥ kārttikeyaś ca svāmī bālo grahāgraṇīḥ |
chāgapriyaḥ śaktidharaḥ kumāro dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ||
prīyatām iti sarveṣu kramān māseṣu kīrtayet |
brāḥmaṇān bhojayitvādau paścād bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kārttike māsi bhārata |
kārttikeyaṃ samabhyarcya vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā ||
pratimāsam aśakto yaḥ sakṛd etat samācaret |
saṃatsaravidhānena pūjāhomapuraḥsaram ||
dadyāt sarvaṃ dvijendrāya vācakāya viśeṣataḥ |
[599] pārite ‘smin grate pārtha tīrṇaḥ syād bhavasāgarāt ||
ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā naro yoṣid athāpi vā |
saṃprāpyeha śubhān kāmān gacchatīndrasalokatām ||
sadaiva pūjanīyas tu kārttikeyo mahābhujaḥ |
kārttikeyād ṛte nānyo rājñāṃ pūjyaḥ pracakṣate ||
saṃgrāme gacchamāno yaḥ pūjayet kṛttikāsutam |
sa jayec chatrusaṃghātān yathendro dānavān raṇe ||
tasmāt pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā kārttikeyasya śobhanām |
dakṣiṇāśāsthitasyeva samyag vīkṣya vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
hemādikāṃ yathāśaktyā gṛhe saṃsthāpya pūjayet |
pūjyamānas tu tāṃ bhaktyā sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
yas tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sadā naktaṃ kuryād uddiśya taṃ vibhum |
sarvapāpavinirmukto gāṅgeyasya priyo bhavet ||
triḥkṛtvo dakṣiṇām āśāṃ gacchet śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
yaḥ paśyed devadeveśaṃ putraṃ paśupateḥ svayam ||
vihāya durmatiṃ sadyaḥ praśāntātmā sa jāyate |
vimukto duḥkhadaurgatyā sukham āste cirāyuṣā ||
mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ gatvā modate skandavac ciram |
tataḥ kule dvijāgryāṇāṃvedavedāṅgapārage ||
samṛddhe dharmaśīle ca yajvanāṃ dānaśīlinām |
guṇair yuktaḥ samastais tu vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||
sarvabhūtadayāluś ca skandaikagatamānasaḥ |
[600] jāyate bharataśrṣṭha purāṇārthaikaniṣṭhitaḥ |
vimuktakarmabandhaś ca prayāti paramaṃ padam ||
iti sarvaṃ mayā khyātaṃ skandamāhātmyam uttamam |
yaḥ paṭhet śṛṇuyād bhaktyā so ‘pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
yaḥ pūjayec caravaṇodbhavam ādidevaṃ
śambhoḥ sutaṃ ca dayitaṃ girirājaputryāḥ |
svarge nirargalasukhāny anubhūya bhūyaḥ
senāpatir bhavati rājyaduraṃdharo ‘sau ||
iti bhaviṣyottare kārttikeyaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
ṣaṣṭhīvidhānam adhunā kathayasva janārdana |
sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
śrutaṃ mayā pūjyamāno bhānuḥ kāmān prayacchati |
divākarārādhanaṃ me tasmāt kathaya keśava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
viśokaṣaṣṭhīm adhunā vakṣyāmi manujottama |
yām upoṣya naraḥ śokaṃ na kadācid iha spṛset ||
māghe kṛṣṇatilaiḥ snānaṃ pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ |
kṛtāhāraḥ kṛśarayā dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
kṛśarayā tilataṇḍulānnena |
upavāsavrataṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī bhaven niśi |
[601] tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnānatapaḥ śuciḥ ||
kṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ padmam arko ‘yam iti pūjayet |
karavīreṇa raktena raktavastrayugena ca ||
yathā viśokaṃ bhuvanam udite tvayi jāyate |
tathā viśokatā me syāt tvadbhaktaiḥ pratijanmani ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya ṣaṣṭyāṃ tu dvijān śaktyā prapūjayet |
supyāt saṃprāśya gomūtraṃ samutthāya tataḥ śuciḥ ||
saṃpūjya viprān dānena guḍapātreṇa saṃyutam |
vastreṇācchādya gurave sarvam etan nivedayet ||
atailalavaṇaṃ bhuktvā saptamyāṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ |
tataḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
anena vidhinā sarvam ubhayor api pakṣayoḥ |
kuryād yāvat punar māghaśuklapakṣasya saptamī ||
