vratānte kalaśaṃ dadyāt suvarṇakamalānvitam |
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tadvat kapilāṃ ca payasvinīm ||
yas tv anena vidhānena vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
viśokaśaṣṭhī nāmnīyaṃ kṛtvā yāti parām gatim ||
iha loke samāyātaḥ śokabhāgī na jāyate |
janmadvādaśakaṃ yāvan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam |
niḥkāmaḥ kurute yas tu sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
yaḥ paṭhet śṛṇuyād vāpi ṣaṣṭhī śokavināśinī |
[602] so ‘pi pāpavinirmuktaḥ sukhī syād bhānubhaktitaḥ ||
ye bhāskaraṃ karakadambhakapūritāśaṃ
saṃpūjayanti manujāś ca kṛtopavāsāḥ |
te duḥkhaśokarahitāḥ svajanaiḥ suhṛdbhir
bhūmau vihṛtya ravilokam avāpnuvanti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ viśokaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
anyām api pravakṣyāmi phalaṣaṣṭhīṃ śubhāṃ tathā |
yām upoṣya naraḥ pāpair vimuktaḥ phalabhāg bhavet ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ niyamasthitaḥ |
kṛtvā tu dantadhāvanaṃ svaped rātrau vimatsaraḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kārayitvā tu kāñcanam |
kamalaṃ ca phalaṃ tv ekaṃ svaśaktyā śāṭhyavarjitaḥ ||
tatas tu saṅgame snāto madhyāhne kṛtanityakaḥ |
āgatya bhavanaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā jagadgurum ||
kṛtvā tu kamalaṃ pātre saphalaṃ śarkarānvitam |
auḍumbare mṛṇmaye vā yathāśaktyā nṛpottamaḥ ||
pūjayet puṣpadhūpādyair naivedyair vividhaiḥ phalaiḥ |
gītanṛtyotsavair yuktaṃ kārayitvā tu jāgaram ||
snātvā prātaḥ śucir bhūtvā kṛtakṛtyas tv anāturaḥ |
guruṃ saṃpūjya yatnena vastramālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
[603] devaṃ tat sakalaṃ tasmai bhānur mr prīyatām iti |
bhaktyā viprāṃs tu saṃbhojya svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
saptamyāṃ kuruśārdūla yad abhīṣṭaṃ svadevatāḥ |
tāvad varjyaṃ phalaṃ tv ekaṃ yāvat kṛṣṇā tu pañcamī ||
punaḥ prāk kathitaṃ hutvā phalapañcakasaṃyutam |
ṣaṣṭyām upoṣya dātavyaṃ saptabhyāṃ tadvidhānataḥ ||
punar anyat phalaṃ tyājyaṃ yāvac chuklā tu pañcamī |
evaṃ ṣaṣṭhyor dvayo rājan varṣam ekaṃ yatavrataḥ ||
upoṣya datvā kramaśaḥ sūryamantram udīrayet |
sopaskaraṃ yathāśaktyā tāmravarṇāṃ payavinīm ||
tadvarṇāni ca dampatyor vāsāṃsy ābharaṇāni vā |
bhānur arko ravir brahmā sūryaḥ śakro hariḥ śivaḥ ||
śrīmān vibhāvamus (?) tvaṣṭā varuṇaḥ prīyatām iti |
pratimāsaṃ ca saptamyām ekaikaṃ nāma kīrtayet ||
yathā na viphalāḥ kāmās tvadbhaktānāṃ sadā rave |
tathānantaphalāvāptir astu me pratijanmani ||
imām anantaphaladāṃ phalaṣaṣṭīṃ karoti yaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
iha cāgatya rājāsau putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
sarvatra saphalārambho jāyate natra saṃśayaḥ ||
kriyamāṇaṃ tu yaḥ paśyed yad tathā cānuvartayet |
[604] śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed vāi so ‘pi kalyāṇabhāg bhavet |
haimaṃ phalaṃ sakalaśaṃ kalaśaṃ vitānaṃ
ṣaṣṭyān upoṣya vidhivaddvijapuṅgavāya |
dadyāt surāsuraśiromaṇighṛṣṭapādam |
bhānuṃ praṇamya phalasiddhim upait martyaḥ ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottaroktaṃ phalaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
ṣaṣṭyāṃ phalāśano rājan viśeṣān kārttike mṛpa |
rājyacyuto viśeṣeṇa svarājyaṃ labhate ‘cirāt ||
ṣaṣṭhītithir mahārāja sarvadā sarvakāmadā |
upoṣyā sā prayatnena sarvakālaṃ jayārthinā ||
kārttikeyasya dayitā ekā ṣaṣṭhī mahātithiḥ |
devasenādhipatyaṃ hi prāptam asyāṃ mahātmanā ||
asyāṃ hi śrīsamāyukto yasmāt skando bhavet purā |
tasmāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ na bhuñjīta prāpnuyād bhārgavīṃ sadā ||
bhārgavī lakṣmīḥ |
datvārghyaṃ kārttikeyāya sthitvā vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
dadhnā ghṛtodakaiḥ puṣpair mantreṇānena suvrata ||
saptarṣidāraja skanda senādhipa mahābala |
rudromāgnija ṣadvaktra gaṅgāgarbha namo ‘stu te ||
prīyatāṃ deva senānīḥ saṃpādaya suhṛdvṛtam |
datvā viprāya vāmānnaṃ yac cānyad api vartate ||
[605] paścād bhuṅkte tv asau rātryāṃ bhūmiṃ kṛtvā tu bhājanam. |
evaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvratasthasya uktaṃ skandena yat phalam ||
tan nibodha mahārāja procyamānaṃ mayākhilam |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano yas tu naktāhāro bhaviṣyati ||
śuklāyām atha kṛṣṇāyāṃ brahmacārī samāhitaḥ |
tasya siddhir ghṛtiḥ puṣṭiḥ rājyam āyur nirāmayam ||
pāratrikaṃ caihikaṃ ca dadyāt skando na saṃśayaḥ |
aśakto hy upavāsasya sa naktena vratī bhavet ||
tailaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ na bhuñjīta na divā kurunandana |
yas tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naro naktaṃ kuryād bharatasattama ||
sarvapāpair vinirmukto gāṅgeyasya sadā vrajet |
gāṅgeyo ‘tra svāmikārtikeyaḥ |
svarge ca niyataṃ vāso bhavate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iha cāgatya kālena yathoktaphalabhāg bhavet |
devānām api vandyo ‘sau rājarājo bhaviṣyati ||
iti bhaviṣyottarapurāṇoktaṃ skandaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
brahmovāca |
saṃpūjye kārttikeyaṃ tu dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ prajāyate |
medhāvī rūpasampanno dīrthāyuḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
[606] tithīśvaro ‘tra kārttieyaḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi ca phalapradā ||
ājyadhārā samiddhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrmoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etat vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ kārttikeyavratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm |
sarvakāmapradāṃ puṇyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ mandārasaṃjñitām ||
māghasyāmalapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ laghubhuk naraḥ |
dantakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā svaped bhūmau jitendriyaḥ ||
sarvabhogavihīnas tu ṣaṣṭhīm upavasen naraḥ |
prāpyānujñāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ mandāraṃ prārthayen niśi ||
mandāro rājārkaḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte utthāya kṛtasnātaḥ punar dvijān |
saṃpūjya saṃhataṃ kṛtvā mandāraṃ kuṅkumānvitam ||
sauvarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ tadvat padmahastaṃ suśobhanam |
padmaṃ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kṛtvā tāmrapātre dalāṣṭakam ||
[607] pūjyamandārakusumaiḥ bhāskarāyeti pūrvataḥ |
namaskāreṇa tadvac ca sūryāyety ānale dale ||
dakṣiṇe tadvad arkāya yajñeśāya ca nairṛte |
paścime vasudhāmneti vāyavye caṇḍabhānave ||
kṛṣṇety uttarataḥ pūjya ānandāyety ataḥ param |
karṇikāyāṃ ca puruṣaṃ pūjya sarvātmanā harim ||
śuklavastraiḥ samāveṣṭya bhakṣamālyaphalādibhiḥ |
evam abhyarcya tat sarvam upādhyāye nivedayet ||
bhuñjītātailalavaṇaṃ vāgyataḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sthitaḥ |
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ saptamyāṃ māsi māsi ca ||
kuryāt saṃvatsaraṃ yātvad vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
etad eva vratānte tu nidhāya kalaśopari ||
raviyuktaṃ dvijendrāya dātavyaṃ (?) bhūtim icchātā |
raviyuktam iti sauvarṇaraviyuktam ity arthaḥ |
namo mandāranāthāya mandārabhavanāya ca |
tvaṃ rave tārayasvāsmān asmāt saṃsārasāgarāt ||
vidhinānena tat kuryāt ṣaṣṭhīṃ mandārasaṃjñitāṃ |
vipāpmā sasukhī dhanyo mṛtaḥ svarge mahīyate ||
imāṃ saṃmohapaṭaladhvāntodvāsanadīpikām |
pragṛhya gacchan saṃsāragartāyāṃ na skhalen naraḥ ||
mandāraṣaṣṭhīṃ vikhyātām īpsitārthaphalapradām |
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
ṣaṣṭhīm upoṣya tilapaṅkajakarṇikāyāṃ
[608] saṃpūjya bhāskaram ahas karavṛkṣapuṣpaiḥ (?) |
ye prāpnuvanti puruṣā na hi tat kadācid
gobhūhiraṇyatiladāḥ phalam āpnuvanti ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottaroktaṃ mandāraṣaṣṭhīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
ārogyarūpasaubhāgyavipakṣakṣayakārakam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ vrataṃ me brūhi keśava ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
yad umāyāḥ purā deva uvāca tripurāntakaḥ |
kathāsu suvṛttāsu bhāskarārādhanaṃ prati ||
tad idānīṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmakāmārthasiddhidam |
narāṇām atha nārīṇāṃ samārādhanam uttamam ||
śṛṇuṣvāvahitao bhūtvā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
māsi bhādrapade śukle ekabhaktāśano bhavet ||
dantadhāvanapūrvaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyām upavasen naraḥ |
gaurasarṣapakalkena snāyāt kāyaviśuddhaye ||
rocanākṛṣṇagomūtramustācandanagosakṛt |
dadhikālāguruṃ caiva lalāṭe tilakaṃ nyaset ||
śilāruṇadalaiś caiva saubhāgyārogyakṛd yataḥ |
srajaṃ kuṅkumatāmbūlaṃ sindūraṃ raktavāsasī ||
vitaret sopavāsād dhi nārīmaṅgalyavardhanam |
[609] vidhavā tu viviktāni kumārī śuklavāsasī |
tataḥ svabhavane bhānuṃ pūjayet śītalaudakaiḥ ||
aparāhṇe tataḥ snātvā sumaunī niyatavrataḥ |
pratimāṃ sthāpayed bhānoḥ pañcagavyena vāriṇā ||
raktacandanapaṅkena kuṅkumena samālabhet |
agastyakusumai raktaiḥ karavīraiḥ prapūjayet ||
dadyāt tu guggulaṃ dhūpaṃ tathā kundurukeṇa ca |
raktāṃśukair alaṃkṛtya kālāguruvibhūṣitaiḥ ||
tatra tāmramayaṃ pātraṃ puṣpākṣatajalānvitam |
karavīrotpalai raktair miśraṃ koraṇḍakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
raktāgastyajavāpuṣpair mālatīkundamudgaraiḥ ||
mucukundair athānyaiś ca śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
gorocanā kuśāgrāṇi siddhārthatilapaṅkajaiḥ |
yathāsaṃbhavasaṃlabdhair dadhikuṅkumakesaraiḥ ||
ebhir arghyaḥ pradātavyaḥ uccaiḥ kṛtvā karau nṛpa |
devadeva jagannātha sahasrāṃśo divākara ||
pūjeyaṃ paripūrṇāstu gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo ‘stu te |
bhakṣyair nānāvidhair yuktaṃ pāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣā ||
naivedyaṃ vinivedyātha tato nīrājayed ravim |
dhātāram iti saṃpūjya praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ ||
puṣpamaṇḍayikāṃ kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā |
[610] śravaṇaṃ ca purāṇasya vācanaṃ vāsya śasyate ||
śrotavyaṃ brāhmaṇād etad vācakād anyataḥ kvacit |
gītanṛtyaiś ca vādyaiś ca kṣapayet sakalāṃ niśām ||
evam āśvayuje māsi aryameti prapūjayet |
mitreti kārttike pūjyo vāruṇo mārgaśīṣake ||
puṣye ‘ṃśumān susaṃpūjyo māghe pūjyo bhageti ca |
indreti phālguṇe māsi vivasvān iti caitrake ||
pūṣeti pūjyo vaiśākhe jyeṣṭhai paryyaṇyam[parjanyam?] arcayet |
pūjyas tvaṣṭeti cāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe viṣṇum arcayet ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale saptamyāṃ snānam ācaret |
devaṃ saṃpūjayed bhūmau gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ sarvāṅgeṣv adhipūjayet |
pādau dhātre tataḥ pūjyo namaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ vivasvate ||
pūṣṇe nama iti ghrāṇaṃ paryy[j?]anyāyeti locane |
namas tvaṣṭre lalāṭaṃ tu viṣṇaveti śiro ‘rcayet ||
vācakaṃ pūjayet paścād vratamārgopadeśakam |
bhūmyā hiraṇyavāsobhir (?) vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||
vācake pūjite caiva sadā tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjayed yāvad vatsaraṃ māsi māsi ca ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt pāyasaṃ sarpiṣā saha |
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā bhāskaraḥ praṇīyatām [?] api ||
tato haviṣyam aśnīyāt svayaṃ bandhujanaiḥ saha |
[611] athodyāpanam ākhyāmi śrūyatām atra ca kramaḥ ||
netrapaṭṭaiḥ śubhair vastraiḥ kṛtvā maṇḍayikāṃ śubhām |
kuṅkumāmodditāṃ (?) kuryād divyābharaṇabhūṣitām ||
kṛtvā deyaṃ vimānaṃ tu prāntalambitapallavam |
tanmadhye raktakalaśīṃ pañcaratnasamanvitām ||
ghaṭasyopari vinyasya tāmrapātrasamanvitām |
padmaṃ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ||
sauvarṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ kṛtvā padmahastaṃ rathe sthitam |
karṇikāyāṃ nyaset taṃ tu snāpayitvā ghṛtādibhiḥ ||
tataḥ snāto ‘nuliptaś ca paridhāya suvāsasī |
devān pitṝṇ samabhyarcya tato devagṛhaṃ vrajet ||
pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya nāmadvādaśakena ca |
pūjayitvārcayet paścān naivedyaṃ parikalpayet ||
tarpayet pāyasaiḥ sājyaiḥ laḍḍukaiḥ khaṇḍahārakaiḥ |
somālakaiḥ kokarasaiḥ śīghraghrāṇapriyaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
śrīphalair mātulaṅgaiś ca nārikelaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ karkaṭair vṛttair nāraṅgapanasādibhiḥ ||
kālodbhavāni sarvāṇi phalāni vinivedayet |
śaṅkhatūryaninādena gītanṛtyaiḥ samarcayet ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye bhāskaraṃ kalaśair navaiḥ |
snāpayitvā vratopetaḥ saubhāgyārogyakṛd yataḥ ||
[612] tair eva nāmabhir homas tilājyena praśasyate |
tataḥ sūryasya purataḥ sūryayāgaṃ samācaret ||
raktacandanapaṅkena vilikhet samabhūtalam |
hastamātraṃ dvihastaṃ tu caturhastam athāpi vā ||
manaḥśilābhiḥ sindūraiḥ sūryamaṇḍalam ālikhet |
raktapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiś ca dhūpaiḥ kuṅkumakādibhiḥ ||
saṃpūjya dadyān naivedyaṃ vidhivad ghṛtapāyasam |
purataḥ sthāpayet kumbhaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ savāsasam ||
dadyāt kanthābhyas tāmbūlaṃ kuṅkumaṃ kusumāni ca |
vastraiś caiva suhṛdbhiś ca bandhubhis tāṃ kṣamāpayet ||
evaṃ ṣaṣṭyāvasāne tu saptamyām uṣasi vratī |
dravyaiḥ prākvihitaiḥ snātvā dvijair homaṃ ca kārayet ||
ākṛṣṇeneti mantreṇa samidbhiś cārkajādibhiḥ |
tilair ājyaguḍopetair dadyād aṣṭaśatāhutīḥ ||
tatas tu dakṣinā deyā brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira |
bhojayitvā dvijān vastrair vividhaiḥ praidhāpayet ||
dvādaśtra praśaṃsanti gāvo vastrānvitāḥ śubhāḥ |
chatropanadyugaiḥ sārdhaṃ dadyād vipreṣu saṃyataḥ ||
yadāśaktas tadaikāṃ tu dadyād dhenuṃ payasminīm |
tataḥ saṃpūjya gandhadyair brāhmaṇaṃ sīlasaṃyutam ||
tasmai tāṃ pratimāṃ dadyān mante khānena pāṇdava ||
oṃ namo ‘rkāya sakaladhyāntavicchittikāriṇe |
tvaddānena raveḥ santu mama sarve manorathāḥ |
[613] rathavastrayutāṃ gāṃ ca bhūmiṃ sasyocitām api ||
hiraṇyasahitāṃ dadyād bhāskaraḥ prīyatām iti |
chatropānadyugaṃ caiva maṇḍalasyāgrato nyaset ||
aruṇaṃ tatpuro nyasya tasyāgre saptavājinaḥ |
tadantare tu revantaṃ tat paścād aśvinau nyaset ||
tad dakṣiṇe śaniṃ vindyādikkālāṃś [-dikpālāṃś] ca yathākramam |
dānāni ca predeyāni śayanāni gṛhāṇi ca ||
śrāddhāni pitṛdevānāṃ śāśvatīṃ tṛptim icchatām |
evam eṣā tithiḥ prājña sarvakāmapradā nṛṇām ||
varā sukhapradā saumyā bhānulokapradāyinī |
alpavitto ‘pi kurvīta ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyām upoṣaṇam ||
saptamyāṃ bhojayed vipraṃ yāvat saṃvatsarāṣṭakam |
vratānte surabhiṃ yacched viprāyojvalavṛttaye ||
akhaṇḍakaraṇād rājan so ‘pi tatphalam āpnuyāt |
utpadyate sadā bhaktir bhānor upri śāśvatī ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha vratam etad anuttamam |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ ||
apsarogaṇasaṃpannair devagandharvasevitaiḥ |
haṃsasārasasaṃyuktair vādyagītaravākulaiḥ ||
godhūmamānacamarair nānārasasamanvitaiḥ |
sarvaiḥ suhṛdbhiḥ saṃyukto nānākinnarabhāskaraiḥ ||
[614] vimānavaram ārūḍho vidyādharagaṇaiḥ saha |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatrāste ravir aṃśumān ||
yāvac candrārkatārāṇi yāvac ca kuśasaptatiḥ |
tāvad yugasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyet ||
tribhis tu puruṣaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogān bhuktvā tathepitān |
brahmaviṣṇuharādīnāṃ loke sthitvā sukhī ciram ||
puṇyakṣayād gotā rājñāṃ rājā caiva dhruvaṃ bhavet |
paścāc ca kīrtayuktaś ca lodanānandakārakaḥ ||
putrapautrasamāyukto yajñadāakriyārataḥ |
prajñāvān dhārmikaḥ śūraḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ||
brahmaṇyaḥ satkaviś caiva satyavaktā jitendriyaḥ |
vaktā śaraṇyaḥ sumanā dīnānāthadayāparaḥ ||
bhunakti vasudhāṃ cīrṇāṃ vigrahe vājitaḥ paraiḥ |
nārī vā kurute pārtha sāpi tatphalabhāginī ||
bhavitavyā hataiśvaryā mahiṣī cakravartinaḥ |
sapatnī dalanīcaiva saubhāgyārogyaputriṇī ||
modate suciraṃ kālaṃ sukhena vasate gṛhe |
yo dāso vā bhavet kaścid vratam etat samācaret ||
tasya śrīr vijayaś caiva trivargaś ca pravardhate |
mṛtaḥ svargam avāpnoti vimānavaram āsthitaḥ ||
sūryalokeṣu nivaset sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ |
[615] sevitaḥ suranārībhiḥ siddhagandharvasevitaḥ ||
vāditrageyaninadair manvantaragaṇān bahūn |
jñānayogaṃ tu saṃprāpya sūryamaṇḍalam āviśet ||
etāṃ narendra samupoṣya nabhasyā māse
ṣaṣṭhīṃ sitāntaraṇim arcayituṃ yadīcchet |
gobhūhiraṇyavasanair dvijapuṅgavānāṃ
prītiṃ vidhāya sa raver bhavanaṃ prayāti ||
iti bhaviṣyottare sodyāpanasūryaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
agastya uvāca |
kāmavrataṃ mahārāja śṛṇu me gadato ‘dhunā |
yena kāmāḥ samṛdhyanti manasā cintitā api ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano yas tu varṣam ekaṃ vrataṃ caret |
māghamāse site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ naktabhojanaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu prāśayed dhīmān phalam ekaṃ tu pārthivam |
tato bhuñjīta yatnena vāgyataḥ śuddhamodanam ||
brāḥmaṇaiḥ saha rājendra atha vā kevalaṃ phalam |
tam ekaṃ divasaṃ sthitvā saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ nṛpa ||
agnikāryaṃ ca kurvīta guhrūpeṇa keśavam |
pūjayitvā vidhānena varṣam ekaṃ vrataṃ caret ||
guharūpeṇa keśavam iti kārttikeyarūpaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
[616] vaiṣṇavapurāṇeṣu sarve devā viṣṇor ekarūpā iti nirūpaṇād iyaṃ muktiḥ |
ṣaṭvaktraḥ kārttiko guhaḥ senānī pāvakātmajaḥ ||
kumāraḥ skanda ity evaṃ pūjyo viṣṇuś ca nāmabhiḥ |
samāptau tu vratasyāsya kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
ṣaṇmukhaṃ sarvasauvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
sarvai. kāmāḥ samṛdhyantāṃ mama deva ṣaḍānan ||
tvatprasādād idaṃ bhaktyā gṛhyatāṃ vidhinā ciram |
anena datvā mantreṇa brāhmaṇāya sayugmakam ||
vastrayugmasahitam |
tataḥ kāmāḥ samṛdhyante sarva eveha janmani |
aputro labhate putrān adhano labhate dhanam ||
bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti varāhapurānoktaṃ kāmaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
brahmovāca |
bhājanaṃ yatra saṃpūrṇaṃ madhunā ca samanvitam |
dadyāt kṛṣṇatilānāṃ tu prastham ekaṃ tu māgadham ||
triguṇaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ ca pṛthak prasthaṃ ca kārayet |
bhājanaṃ prasthacatuṣṭayapūraṇīyaṃ pātram, triguṇaṃ prathatrayam | pṛthag iti ghṛtamadhutilataṇḍulapātrāṇi pṛthak kuryāt | māgadhaṃ prasthaparimāṇaṃ paribhāṣāyām uktam ||
[617] gandhapuṣpais tathā dhūpair nānāvādyair viśeṣataḥ |
tataḥ saṃpūjayet sūryaṃ nānāvādyasamanvitam ||
sūryaṃ gaganastham |
pūjayec ca tato vyoma baliṃ dikṣu prapūjayet |
vyomadevagṛhe caiva sarvabhūtāni yojayet |
vyomadevagṛhe tatra yatra vyoma pratiṣṭhitam ||
vyomanirmāṇaṃ viṣṇudharmottarāt |
caturasraṃ bhaven mūle tatra vṛttaṃ mahābhujam |
tato ‘nyac caturasraṃ ca prathame saṃsthitaṃ śubham ||
bhadrapīṭhamaye prokto vyomabhāgas turīyakaḥ |
stambe vaiśvānaro ‘thāstu madhyabhāgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
bhadrapīṭhavad anyac ca tatra padmaṃ niveśayet |
śubhāṣṭapatraṃ tanmadhye karṇikāyāṃ divākaraḥ ||
patrāṣṭake nyaset tasya dikkālān sarvatodiśam || iti |
ya evaṃ kurute ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃdhyākāle baliṃ raveḥ ||
sa sūryalokam āsādya modate śāśvatīh samāḥ |
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya samṛddhe jāyate kule ||
medhāvī subhagaḥ śrīmān puṇyavān dānaśīlavān |
punar lokam avāpnoti bhāskarasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ vyomaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bādrabādrapade māsi śukle ṣaṣṭhyāṃ susaṃyatā |
[618] nārī snātvā prabhāte ca śuklamālyāmbarapriyā ||
suveṣābharaṇopetā bhūtvā saṃgṛhya vālukāḥ |
nave veṇumaye pātre gṛhaṃ gacched avāṅmukhī ||
sopavāsā prayatnena tatra devīṃ prapūjayet |
kṛtvā vastrayugaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpamālāvicitritam ||
tatra saṃsthāpya tāṃ devīṃ puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayed dharim |
tāṃ devīm iti jalāntaragatāṃ vālukām ānīya vaṃśapātre pañcapiṇḍākṛtiṃ vālukāmayīṃ devīṃ pūjayed iti |
dhyātvā tu lalitāṃ devīṃ tapovananivāsinīm |
paṅkajaṃ karavīraṃ ca nepālīṃ mālatīṃ tathā ||
nepālī puṣpaviśeṣam, gṛhītvā pūjayed ity śeṣaḥ |
nīlotpalaṃ ketakīṃ ca saṃgṛhya tagaraṃ varam |
ekaikāṣṭaśataṃ grāhyam aṣṭāviṃśatir eva vā ||
akṣatāḥ kalikā gṛhya tābhir devīṃ samarcayet |
prārthayeta vratī bhūtvā girijāṃ giriśapriyām |
gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nīlaparvate |
snātvā kanakhale tīrthe hatiṃ padmāvatīpatim ||
lalite lalite devi saukhyasaubhāgyadāyini |
anantaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ bhavatv aghaharaṃ param ||
mantreṇānena kusumaiś campakasyātiśobhanaiḥ |
evam abhyarcya vidhinā naivedyaṃ purato nyaset ||
trapuṣaivālukuṣmāṇḍanālikeraiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ |
bījapuraiḥ satuṇḍīraiḥ kāravellaiḥ savarvaṭaiḥ ||
[619] phalais tatkālasaṃbhūtaiḥ kṛtvā śobhāṃ tadagrataḥ |
trapuṣaṃ vālukam | ekavāluḥ karkaṭī | tuṇḍīraṃ vṛkṣabhedaḥ |
virūḍhair nānyasambhūtair dīpālībhiḥ samantataḥ ||
sārdhaṃ saguṇakair dhūpaiḥ somālakakaraṅkakaiḥ |
gandhapuṣpaiḥ karṇaveṣṭair modakairūpamodakaiḥ |
bahuprakārair naivedyair yathāvibhavasārataḥ ||
evam abhyarcya vidhivad rātrau jāgaraṇotsavā |
gītavādyanaṭair nṛtyaiḥ prekṣaṇīyair anekadhā ||
sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tāṃ rātriṃ praśayan nayet |
na ca saṃmīlayen netre nārī yāmacatuṣṭayam ||
durbhagā durgatā vandhyā netrasaṃmīlanād bhavet |
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ saritaṃ nayet ||
gandhadhūpair athābhyarcya gītavādyapuraḥsaram |
tac ca dadyād dvijendrāya naivedyādi narottama ||
snātvā gṛhaṃ samāgatya hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ kramāt |
devān pitṝn manuṣyāṃś ca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ ||
kanyakāś caiva saṃbhājyā brāhmaṇyo daśa pañca ca |
bhakṣyabhojyair bahuvidhair datvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ ||
lalitā me ‘stu suprītā ity uktvā tu visarjayet |
yaḥ kaścid ācared etad vrataṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadam ||
lalitāṣaṣṭhīsaṃjñaṃ ca sarvapāpanibarhaṇam ||
naro vā yadi vā nārī tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
yad alabhyaṃ vrataiś cānyair dānair vā nṛpasattama ||
[620] tapobhir niyamair vāpi tad etena hi labhyate |
iha caivātulaṃ saṃpat saubhāgyam anubhūya ca ||
kṛtvā mūrdhni padaṃ pārtha sapatnīnāṃ yaśasvinī |
mṛtā śivapuraṃ prāpya devair asurapannagaiḥ ||
prāpnoti darśanaṃ devyā tayā tu saha modate |
puṇyaśeṣād ihāgatya puṇyā saubhāgyabhāvanā ||
satyatretāyuge nārī sīteva priyavallabhā |
idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyāt pārtha paṭhed vā sādhusaṃsadi |
so ‘pi pāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jalāntaragatāṃ varavaṃśapātre
saṃgṛhya pūjayati yā sikatāṃ krameṇa |
naktaṃ ca jāgaram anuddhataveṣaśīlā
kuryād asau tribhuvane saliteva bhāti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ lalitāṣaṣṭhīvratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
atha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu rājanyaḥ samupoṣya yathāvidhi |
cakrābjamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikāyāṃ sudarśanam ||
[621] daleṣu lokapālānām āyudhāni samarcayet |
cakrājyaṃ cakranābhighaṭitāñjam |
svāny āyudhāni purataḥ pratiṣṭhāpya prapūjakaḥ |
raktacandanasiddhārtharaktapadmāṅkurair api ||
raktavastraiḥ sugandhāṭyair bhūṣaṇādibhir arcayet |
apūpaphalasaṃyuktaṃ guḍānnaṃ ca nivedayat ||
sudarśana mahācakra jvālāvyāptadigantaram |
daityāricakronmathana vidviṣo me nibarhaya ||
aniśaṃ lokapālānāṃ sarvapraharaṇāṇy api |
abhayaṃ vijayaṃ yuddhe maṅgalaṃ pradiśaṃ tu naḥ ||
yathā viṣṇur varaḥ puṃsāṃ yathā lakṣmīś ca yoṣitām |
tathā śatruharaṃ cakraṃ vijayaṃ me karotv alam ||
cakrapratimarūpāṇi śastrāny avyākulāny api |
āyudhāni samastāni bhavantu mama sarvadā ||
mattamātaṅganikararathavājiyutaṃ mama |
hṛṣṭapuṣṭapadātyoghaṃ balaṃ rakṣa sudarśana ||
iti saṃprārthya tadbhaktyā sālabhetāyudhaṃ svakam |
tataś purato vṛttamaṇḍalaṃ kārayet sudhīḥ ||
taṇḍulena samāyuktān tilabījena pūritān |
avraṇān vastrasaṃchannān sarvauṣadhisamanvitān ||
caturaḥ sthāpayed dikṣu kalasāṃś ca caturṣv api |
madhye sarvauṣadhiyutaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam ||
vastrayugmena saṃchannaṃ kumbhaṃ tatra nidhāpya ca |
[622] tasminn āvāhayed devaṃ sudarśanam ananyadhīḥ ||
śaṅkhaś ca nandakaṃ caiva śārṅgaṃ kaumodakīṃ gadām |
nyaset prācyādikumbheṣu tatra tatra prapūjayet ||
pāyasaṃ ca guṣānnaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ dadhisaṃbhavam |
nivedayed yathāyogaṃ madhame sakalaṃ matam ||
atha vā pañcakumbheṣu pūjyā vai pañca hetayaḥ |
cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ tathā padmaṃ śārṅgaṃ ca nandakaṃ gadāṃ ||
bahis tu lokapālānām āyudhāni nyased yugam | iti |
yugam iti pratikumbhaṃ dve dve |
tadagre mahatīṃ yaṣṭiṃ pītakauśeyasaṃvṛtām ||
saṃsthāpya tārkṣyasaṃsthānaṃ dhvajam agre nibadhya ca |
tārkṣyaṃ saṃpūjayet paścād gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
apūpaphalamūlānnaṃ bhūri tatra nivedayet |
pradakṣiṇanamaskārastotrālāpādi kārayet ||
ghanaṃ ghanānāṃ paṭalaṃ drāvayann anilo yathā |
tathā mayi ca vidveṣṭṝn vidrāvayatu pakṣirāṭ ||
iti saṃprārthya vidhivat pūjāṃ parisamāpya ca |
lokapālabaliṃ dadyāt kṛśarānnena sādhakaḥ ||
kṛśarānnena tilataṇḍulānnena |
tadagre vayam ānīya sauvarṇaṃ siṃhaviṣṭaram |
siṃhaviṣṭaraṃ siṃhāsanam |
tasmin nṛpaṃ samāropya sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutam ||
sauvarṇapātram ānīya tasmin devaṃ sudarśanam |
[623] tanmantreṇa samāvāhya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet ||
vartiṃ siddhārthasaṃyuktāṃ raktavastreṇa veṣṭitām |
siddhārthāḥ sarṣapāḥ |
prajvālya tatra saṃsthāpya pūjāṃ kuryād yathāvidhi ||
mūrdhni triḥ parivṛtyātha prācyāṃ yoṣid vinikṣipet |
parivṛtya nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā |
āyudhānāṃ pradānaṃ ca hetirājasya mantrataḥ ||
hetirājasya sudarśanasya |
tattanmantreṇa vāvāhya vāhanādisamarpaṇam |
tatraivaṃ bhūṣaṇādīnām eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
yuddhārambhe mahotpāte parasenāprapīḍane |
rājyabhraṃśaparikleśe śokavyādhyādipīḍite ||
iṣṭadāraviyoge ca sutanāśe balakṣaye |
snānam eva prakurvīta śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
nimitte lakṣite vāsyāj janmarkṣe vā tv ayaṃ vidhiḥ |
tārkṣyadhvajaṃ ca saṃpūjya yuddhārambhe ca bhūpatiḥ ||
raṇapramukhataḥ kṛtvā sudhvajatrayam āvahet |
dhvajasya calanād ādau phalāphalaviniścayaḥ ||
jayaṃ śakracalād brūyur dakṣiṇe ca parājayam |
paścime parasainyānām uttare ca palāyanam ||
āgneyyām adhipo naśyen nairṛtyāṃ balanāśanam |
vāyavye vājimaraṇaṃ aiśānyāṃ dhanasaṃkṣayam ||
[624] anyad vidiśi lābhaḥ syād dhvajasyeti parīkṣaṇam |
chinne bandhe smaraṇaṃ yaṣṭicchede parasya vā ||
tat kṛtaṃ ca svadehasthaṃ vidyādevaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
ādau sarvaṃ parīkṣyaiva kurvīta raṇapaṇḍitaḥ ||
kāryāntare ‘py evam eva bhāvo bhavaviniścayaḥ |
brāhmaṇaiḥ svastivacanaṃ paścād brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
evaṃ nāmnā tataḥ kuryāt pūjāṃ caivāpare ‘hani |
vipraśeṣeṇa tat kuryād aśanaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha ||
vipraśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇabhojanāvaseṣeṇa |
gurave dakṣiṇām dadyād ṛtvigbhyo bhūridakṣiṇām (?) |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yāvad vrataṃ samāpayet ||
na brūyād anṛtaṃ kuryād brahmacaryasya dakṣiṇām |
etat svastyayanaṃ proktaṃ sarvarogavināśanam ||
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvasya vijayāvaham |
etad vrataṃ puṣṭikaraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kurvatām api ||
etat sarvādhikāraḥ syād rājñāṃ śreyo dadāty alam |
ṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ samākhyātaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
iti śrīgāruḍapurāṇoktaṃ sudarśanaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
āditya uvāca |
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prayatnena kṛtvā naktaṃ vidhānataḥ |
māsi mārgaśirasy ādāv aṃśumān iti pūjayet ||
[625] vidhivat prāśya gomūtram anāhāro niśi svapet |
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
puṇye ‘py evaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ bhānumantam uśanti vai |
vājapeyaphalaṃ tatra prāptavrate labhen naraḥ ||
māghe divākaraṃ nāma kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ niyojayet |
niśīthe cātti gomūtraṃ gomeghaphalam āpnyuāt ||
tilais tu phālgune māsi pūjayed bhakṣayet tilān |
rājasūyasya yajñasya tulyaṃ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
caitre ca haṃsanāmānaṃ kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prapūjayet |
śuklapuṣpaṃ naraḥ prāśya aśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||
vaiśākhe sūryanāmānaṃ kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prapūjayet |
pītvā kuśodakaṃ puṇyaṃ jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ ||
mahāmedhasya yajñasya vainateyaphalaṃ labhet |
jyaiṣṭhe divaspatiṃ pūjya gavāṃ śṛṅgodakaṃ pibet |
gavāṃ koṭipradānasya nikhilaṃ phalam aśnute ||
āṣāḍhe arkanāmānam iṣṭvā prāśya ca gomayam |
prayāty arkasalokatvaṃ varṣāṇāṃ dviśataṃ śatam ||
śrāvaṇe ‘ryamanāmānaṃ pūjayitvā payaḥ pibet |
varṣāṇām ayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate bhāskarālaye ||
māsi bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhāskaraṃ nāma pūjayet |
dūrvāṅkuraṃ sakṛt prāśya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||
āśvine devadevasya saptāśvam iti pūjayet |
dadhi saṃprāśya vidhivat puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ||
[626] māse tu kārttke ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śakrākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet |
gomūtraphalam aśnīyād aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
gomūtrabhāvitaphalaṃ gomūtraphalam |
varṣānte bhojayed viprān sūryabhaktiparāyaṇān |
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktam ājyena supariplutam ||
śaktyā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi bhaktyā tebhyo nivedayet |
nivedayet tu sūryāya gāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ payasvinīm ||
varṣam ekaṃ cared evaṃ nairantaryeṇa yo naraḥ |
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ |
modate sūryaloke tu sa naraḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
ṣaṣṭhīnāmatithir yājyā sāmānyā daivatair api |
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca ||
upavāsena dānena tailakṣāravivarjitaḥ |
ayaṃ hi bhagavān devo bhāskaraś ca paradyutiḥ ||
yena śīghreṇa dṛśyeta tad guhyaṃ kathayāmy aham |
gopanīyaṃ vrataṃ divyam iha loke phalapradam ||
yasmin kṛte vrate caiṣa daridro na bhavet kule |
ṣaṣṭhītithiṃ samuddiśya brāhmaṇasya ca bhojanam ||
[627] śālyodanaṃ ca payasi kṛtvā ca śarkarāyutam |
bāhulyaghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ varṣam ekaṃ pradāpayet ||
kule tasyaiva ye jātā ye bhaviṣyanti mānavāḥ |
iha tasyaiva ye santi tān dāridryaṃ na gacchati ||
iti skandapurāṇoktam adāridryaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
stutijapyopahāreṇa pūjayā ca vivasvataḥ |
upavāsena ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvratam |
kṛtopavāsaḥ pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ yo ‘rcayate ravim |
niyamavratacārī ca raver bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
saptamyāṃ vā mahābhāga so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvratam |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca śuklapakṣasya ye narā bhaumavāsare |
vrataṃ carati yatnena tathā tāsāṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcid bhaviṣyati surottama |
dviyoge hi guṇaṃ teṣāṃ phalaṃ skanda bhaviṣyati ||
triyoge pūjanaṃ kṛtvā māseṣu surasattama |
[628] akṣayaṃ jāyate puṇyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ ṣaṣṭhīvratam |
vaiśākhamāsād ārabhya pañcamyāṃ ya upoṣitaḥ |
bhavantaṃ pūjayet ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃvatsaram atandritaḥ ||
putrārthī prāpnuyāt putrān dhanakāmo dhanī bhavet |
svargārthi prāpnuyāt svargam api tuṣṭo mamātmajaḥ ||
stotreṇa ca madīyena ye stoṣyanti naraḥ prabhoḥ |
lokadvaye ‘pi te kāmān prāpnoti tamasaḥ priyān ||
kumāraś ca tathā skando viśākhaś ca guhas tathā |
caturātmā vinirdiṣṭo bhagavān krauñcasūdanaḥ ||
tam abhyarcya naraḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ putrān prāpnoty abhīpsitān |
bālakānāṃ gṛhe śreyo naraḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ putraprāptivratam |
ṛṣīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sukham avāpnuyāt ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sukhavratam |
skandapārśve carān rājan rudrapārśve caranagha |
yamapārśve carāṃś caiva rogamuktim avāpnuyāt ||
[629]
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rogamuktivratam |
kālapāśaṃ tathābhyarcya jvaravyādḥīśam eva ca |
rogamokṣam avāpnoti vāyuvahnidavāṃs tathā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rogaharaṣaṣṭhīvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājasamastakaraṇādhīśvara
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe ṣaṣṭhīvratāni |
[630]
atha ekādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha saptamīvratāni |
ācāraiḥ prathamayuvā yugena sārghaṃ
na spardhāṃ kalir api sāṃprataṃ vidhatte |
yasyoccaiḥ svaritam avāpya sādhu so ‘yaṃ
hemādriḥ kathayati saptamīvratāni ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
pārtha śrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ śāṇḍilyād vratam uttamam |
guhyād guhyatamaṃ puṇyaṃ tapaś caraṇasaṃjñitam ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kathaṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ deva tapaścaraṇacaṃjñitam |
savistaraṃ mama brūhi sarahasyaṃ samantrakam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yudhiṣṭhira tapovratam |
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu kartavyaṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
tasmiṃs sthito varat vipro bahvṛco vedapāragaḥ |
brahmavit kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ dadyād arghyaṃ mahītale ||
ṛgvedavargatritayaṃ paṭhitā sūryavallabham |
[631] pādakrameṇa kaunteya kanikṛd aditiśrutam ||
pādakrameṇātipratipādanam arghyadānam |
ekabhaktena naktenāyācitena tathā sudhīḥ |
dvijo vedoktamantrais tu prāguktaiḥ pāṇḍavāgraja ||
arghyaṃ dadyur vinā mantraiḥ śūdrāḥ sūryaparāyaṇāḥ |
caturthyantena mantreṇa nāma cādau vyavasthitam ||
śūdrāṇāṃ paramo mantraḥ sarvaśāśtreṣu paṭhyate |
kṛtvā tāmramaye pātre sārdrapuṣpākṣatair nṛpa ||
raktacandanasaṃmiśraṃ dūrvāpallavaśobhitam |
raktāni karavīrāṇi tathā raktotpalāni ca ||
koraṇṭakavimiśrāṇi javāśokānvitāni ca |
kiṃśukāgastyakusumakaravīrāṇi mālatīḥ ||
mucakundaṃ ca kundaṃ ca śatapatraṃ samallikam |
etāni ca yathālābhaṃ tāmrapātre vinikṣipet ||
gorocanākuśāgrāṇi śrīkhaṇḍakuṅkumaṃ tathā|
tilataṇḍulasiddhārtha dadhikuṅkumakesaram ||
kuṅkumakesaraṃ kusumbhaṃ |
ebhir arghyavaraṃ dadyād uccaiḥ kṛtvā bhujau nṛpa |
vyomamudrāṃ punar vadhvā namaskṛtya samāpayet ||
[632] vyomamudrāṃ tu viṣṇudharmottarāt |
karayoḥ saṃpuṭo ‘nyonyamaṇibandhasthitāṅguliḥ |
sāntarālāntaro yatra vyomamudreti tāṃ jaguḥ || iti |
atra pratimānukteḥ pratyakṣasyaiva sūryabimbasyārghyadānam iti |
evaṃ māsakrameṇaiva yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa |
samāpte tu vrate dadyād viprebhyaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
dvādaśa praṇītāḥ pārtha pāyasena prapūritāḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ paṅkajaṃ śaktyā viprebhyo dakṣiṇā smṛtā ||
vastrayugmaṃ ca kāṣāyaṃ dadyād devāya dānava |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyak tapaścaraṇasāṃjñitam ||
vrataṃ naro vā nārī vā sūryabhaktyā subhāvitaḥ |
sa yāti bhavanaṃ tatra yatra devo divākaraḥ ||
pūjyamāno ‘psorovṛndaiḥ vṛndāraka ivāparaḥ |
saṃprāpya janma caivāgryaṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyavarjitaḥ ||
ādityasya prasādena bhaktiḥ syāt tatra niścalā |
audumbaraiḥ phalayugaiḥ samam ācitaṃ ca
darbhānvitaṃ ca kusumākṣatapūritaṃ ca |
arghyaṃ vidhāya vidhivan nṛpa yaḥ pradadyā l
lokaṃ prayāty amaladīdhitināsita saḥ ||
iti bhaviṣottaroktaṃ tapaścaraṇavratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
munīndro lomaśo nāma mathurāyāṃ gataḥ purā |
[633] so ‘rcito vasudevena devakyā ca yudhiṣṭhira ||
upaviṣṭaḥ kathāḥ puṇyāḥ kathayitvā manoramāḥ |
tataḥ kathayituṃ bhūpa. kathām etāṃ pracakrame ||
kaṃsena te hatāḥ putri putrā jātāḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
mṛtavatsā devaki tvaṃ putraduḥkhena duḥsthitā ||
yathā candramukhī dīnā babhūva nahuṣapriyā |
paścāc cīrṇavratā saiva babhūvākṣatavatsakā ||
tvam eva devaki tathā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ||
devaky uvāca |
kā sā candramukhī brahman babhūva nahuṣapriyā |
kiṃ ca cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ tathā santativardhanam |
sapatnīdarpadalanaṃ saubhāgyārogyadaṃ vibho ||
śomaśa uvāca |
ayodhyāyāṃ purā rāja nahuṣo nāma viśrutaḥ |
tasyāsīd rūpasaṃpannā devī candramukhī priyā ||
tathā tatraiva nagare viṣṇugupto ‘bhavad dvijaḥ |
āsīd guṇavatī tasya patnī bhadramukhī tathā ||
tayor āsīd dṛḍhā prītiḥ spṛhanīyā parasparam |
atha te dve ‘pi sakhyau vai snānārthaṃ śarayūtaṭe ||
prāpte prāptāś ca tatraiva vānyāś ca nagarāṅganāḥ |
tāḥ snātvā maṇḍalaṃ cakrus tanmadhye vyaktarūpiṇam ||
lekhayitvā śivaṃ śāntam umayā saha śaṅkaram |
gandhapuṣpākṣatair bhaktyā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||
[634] praṇamya gantukāmās tāḥ papracchato varastriyaḥ |
tā ūcuḥ śaṅkaro ‘smābhiḥ pārvatyā saha pūjitaḥ ||
badhvā sūtramayaṃ tantuṃ śivasyātmā niveditaḥ |
dhāraṇīyam idaṃ tāvad yāvat prāṇavidhāraṇam ||
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sakhyāv ete ‘pi devaki |
kṛtvā ca samayaṃ tatra baddhvā dorbhyāṃ suḍorakam ||
tatas tāḥ svagṛhaṃ jagmuḥ svasakhībhiḥ samāvṛtāḥ |
kālena mahatā tasyās tad vrataṃ vismṛtaṃ śubham ||
candramukhyāḥ pramattāyāḥ vismṛtaḥ sa ca ḍorakaḥ |
bhadramukhyā tathā bhadre vismṛtaṃ sarvam eva tat ||
mṛte kaiścid ahorātraiḥ sā babhūva plavaṅgamī |
bhadrā syāt kukkuṭī jātā vratabhaṅgāc chubhānane ||
kālena pañcatāṃ prāpte sakhībhāvasya hetave |
adaivamātṛke deśe jāte gokulasaṃkule ||
brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇī jātā kṣatriyā kṣatriyī tathā |
rājñī jāyā babhūvātha pṛthvīnāthasya vallabhā ||
īśvaro nāma vikhyātā yāsīc candramukhī purā |
nāmnā bhadramukhī yāsīd bhūṣaṇā nāma sābhavat ||
agnimīlasya sā dattā pitrā tasya purodhasā |
atīvavallabhā āsīd bhūṣaṇā bhūṣaṇapriyā ||
bhūṣitā bhūṣitavarai rūpeṇālaṃkṛtā svayam |
tasyā babhūva rasyāś ca putrāḥ sarvaguṇānvitāḥ ||
mātṛvad rūpasaṃpannāḥ pitṛvad dharmaśīlinaḥ |
[635] sakhyau te caiva tadvac ca jāte jātismare kila ||
punar nirantarā prītis tayor āsīd yathā purā |
kāle bahutithe yāte tyaktvā sā satyavallabhā ||
madhye vayasi sā rājñī putram ekam ajījanat |
īśvarī rogiṇaṃ mūkaṃ prajñāhīnaṃ ca visvaram ||
tādṛśo ‘pi mahābhāge mṛto ‘sau navavārṣikaḥ |
tatas tāṃ bhūṣaṇabhraṣṭām īśvarīṃ putradukhitām ||
sakhībhāvād atisnehāt putraiś ca parivāritā |
amuktābharaṇā bhadrā svarūpeṇaiva bhūṣitā ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sadṛśīṃ bhāryāṃ prajajvāleśvarī ruṣā |
tato gṛhaṃ preṣayitvā brāhmaṇī tīvramatsarā ||
cintayāmāsa sā rājñī tasyāḥ putravadhaṃ prati |
niścitya cetasā krūrā yātayāmāsa tatsutān ||
hatāhatāś ca te putrāḥ punar jīvanty anāmayam |
tad adbhūtataraṃ dṛṣṭvā satīm āhūya bhūṣaṇām ||
upaveśyāsane śreṣṭhe bahumānapuraḥsaram |
apṛcchad vismayāviṣṭā rājñī sā mṛtavatsakā ||
brūhi tathyaṃ mahābhāge kiṃ tvayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam |
dānavrataṃ tapo vāpi śuśrūṣaṇam upoṣitam ||
yena te nihatāḥ putrāḥ punar jīvanty anāmayāḥ |
tathā hi bahuputrā ca jīvavat sā śubhānane ||
amuktābharaṇā nityaṃ bhartuś cetasy avasthitā |
atīva śobhase devi vidyud gharmātyaye yathā ||
[636] bhūṣaṇovāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi janmāntaraviceṣṭinam |
kiṃ tarhi vismṛtaṃ sarvam ayodhyāyāṃ ca yat kṛtam ||
āvābhyāṃ vratavaikalyaṃ pramattābhyāṃ varānane |
yena tvaṃ plavagī jātāhaṃ sā ca kukkuṭī tathā ||
tathāpi vratavaikalyaṃ tvayā ca nānyataḥ kṛtam |
mayā tu sarvabhāvena cetasāshyāya śaṅkaram ||
tiryagyonyaṃ gatā yena manovṛttyā svanuṣṭhitam |
etad dhi kāraṇaṃ bhadre nānyat kiṃcit karomy aham ||
lomaśa uvāca |
ity ākarṇya ca saṃgṛhya pūrvajanmani ceṣṭitam |
īśvarī ca tayā sārdhaṃ punaḥ samyak cakāra ha ||
vratasyāsya prabhāvena putrapautrādisaṃbhavaiḥ |
bhuktvā ca saukhyam atulaṃ mṛtā śivapuraṃ gatā ||
tasmāt tvam api kalyāṇi vratam etat samācara |
prārabdhe ‘smin vrate divye jīvatputrā bhaviṣyati ||
devaky uvāca |
brahman nāsyāddhi te samyag vratam etat sukhapradam |
santānavṛddhikaraṇaṃ śivaloke sthitipradam ||
lomaśa uvāca |
bhādra bhādrapade māsi saptamyāṃ salilāśaye |
snātvā śivaṃ maṇḍalake lekhayitvā tathāmbikām ||
[637] bhaktyā saṃpūjya samayaṃ kuryād baddhvā kare guṇam |
yāvajjīvaṃ mayātmā tu śivasya viniveditaḥ ||
ity evaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā śivasya viniveditaḥ |
ity evaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prabhṛti ḍorakam ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ cāpi sautraṃ vā dhārayet kare |
maṇḍakān veṣṭikān adyād aśvapatre ‘tha vā dvija ||
svayaṃ tāś caiva bhoktavyā vratabhaṅgabhayāc chubhe |
pārite mudrikā vāso haimīraupyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ ||
tāmrapātropari sthāpya brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet |
ācāryāya viśeṣeṇa kartavyaṃ cāṅgulīyakam ||
puṣpakuṅkumasindūratāmbūlāñjanasūtrakaiḥ |
evaṃ tat pārayitvā tu vrataṃ santativardhanam ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktā kṛtvā saukhyaṃ manoramam |
santānaṃ vardhayitvā ca śivaloke mahīyate ||
etat te sarvam ākhyātam ākhyānasahitavratam |
kuru devaki yatnena jīvaputrā bhaviṣyasi ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ity uktvā sa muniśreṣṭhas tatraivāntaradhīyate |
cakāra sarvayatnena yad uktaṃ tena dhīmatā ||
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa devakī mām ajījanat |
tasmāt pārtha naraiḥ kāryaṃ strībhiḥ kāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
vrataṃ pāpaharaṃ bhavyaṃ sukhasantatidaṃ sadā |
idaṃ ca śṛṇuyād bhaktyā yaś caitat pratipādayet ||
[638] vratam ākhyānasahitaṃ so ‘pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
sāntānakaṃ vratam idaṃ sukhamokṣakāmā
yā strī cariṣyati śivaṃ hṛdaye nidhāya |
vihāya duḥkham atulaṃ gatakalmaśaughā
sā strī vratād bhavati śobhanajīvavatsā ||
iti bhaviṣyottare amuktābharaṇasaptamīvratam |
bhīṣma uvāca |
bhagavan durgasaṃsārasāgarottārakaṃ tathā |
kiṃcid vrataṃ samācakṣva svargārogyasukhapradam ||
pulastya uvāca |
sauradharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi pārtha kalyāṇasaptamīm |
vidhānaṃ tasyā vakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
yadā tu śuklasaptamyām ādityasya dinaṃ bhavet |
sā tu kalyāṇinī nāma vijayā ca nigadyate ||
prātar gavyena payasā snānam asyāṃ samācaret |
śuklāmbaradharaḥ padmam akṣataiḥ parikalpayet ||
prāṅmukho ‘ṣṭadalaṃ madhye tadvṛttaṃ ca sakarṇikam |
sarveṣv api daleṣv īśaṃ vinyaset pūrvataḥ kramāt ||
pūrveṇa tapanāyeti mārtaṇḍāyeti vai tataḥ |
yāmye divākarāyeti vidhātre iti nairṛte ||
paścime varuṇāyeti bhāskarāyeti cānile |
[639] saumye vikartanāyeti racayed aṣṭame dale ||
ādāv ante ca madhye ca namo ‘stu paramātmane |
mantrair ebhiḥ samabhyarcya namaskārāntadīpitaiḥ ||
śuklavastraiḥ phalair bhakṣyair dhūpair mālyānulepanaiḥ |
sthaṇḍile pūjayed bhaktyā guḍena lavaṇena ca ||
tato vyāhṛtimantreṇa visṛjed dvijapuṅgava |
śaktitas tarpayed bhaktyā guḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ ||
tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca gurave vinivedayet |
evaṃ tu niyamaṃ kṛtvā prātar utthāya mānavaḥ ||
kṛtasnānajapair vipraiḥ sahaiva ghṛtapāyasam |
bhuktvā ca vedavidvadbhir baiḍālavratavarjitaḥ ||
ghṛtapātraṃ sakanakaṃ sodakumbhaṃ nivedayet |
prīyatām atra bhagavan phalam āha divākaraḥ ||
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsi māsi samācaret |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kṛtvaitad akhilaṃ nṛpa ||
udyāpayed yathāśaktyā bhāskaraṃ saṃsmaran hṛdi |
tatas trayodaśe māsi gāvo dadyāt trayodaśa ||
vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktā hemaśṛṅgīḥ payasvinīḥ |
ekām api pradadyād gāṃ (?) vittahīnaś ca (?) niḥkriyaḥ ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta tato lobhāt pataty adhaḥ |
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryāt kalyāṇasaptamīm ||
śrutveti paṭhanād vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
kartā śivapure sthitvā kalpam ekam ihāgataḥ ||
[640] rājā bhavati rājendra tretāyāṃ rāghavo yathā |
pañcāṣṭapatrakamalodarakarṇikāyāṃ
saṃpūjayet kusumadhūpavilepanādyaiḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pare ‘hani janārtiharaṃ dineśaṃ
kalyāṇabhājanam asau bhavatīha nūnam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kalyāṇasaptamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ kamalasaptamīm |
yasya saṃkīrtanād eva tuṣyatīha divākaraḥ ||
vasantāmanasaptamyāṃ snātaḥ san gaurasarṣapaiḥ |
tilapātre tu sauvarṇaṃ nidhāya kamale ravim ||
vastropavītābharaṇagandhapuṣpair athārcayet |
namas te padmahastāya namas te viśvadhāriṇe |
divākara namas tubhyaṃ prabhākara namo ‘stu te ||
tatas tu kālavelāyām udakumbhasamanvitam |
viprāya dadyāt saṃpūjya vastramālyādibhūṣitam ||
raviṃ sakamalaṃ dadyād alaṃkṛtya vidhānataḥ |
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta paraṃ niyamam āsthitaḥ ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryām aṣṭamyāṃ bhojayed dvijān |
[641] yathāśaktyā svayaṃ paścād bhuñjīta māṃsavarjitam ||
anena vidhinā śuklasaptamyāṃ māsi māsi tu |
sarvaṃ samācared bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
vratānte śayanaṃ dadyāt suvarṇakamalānvitam |
gāṃ ca dadyād yathāśaktyā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām ||
vyajanāsanadīpāṃś ca yac cānyat kalpitaṃ gṛhe |
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryāt kamalasaptamīm ||
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ sukhasaubhāgyabhājanaḥ |
bhuktvā bhogāṃś ciraṃ martye mṛto ravipuraṃ vrajet ||
kalpānekaṃ tataḥ sthitvā āgatyātra narādhipaḥ |
sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhe ca kule bhavati bhūbhujām ||
tatrāpi bhānunirato vrataiḥ saṃtoṣya bhāskaram |
upary upari saṃprāpya janma bhaktī raves tathā ||
saptajanmāni rājendras tato yāti paraṃ padam |
yadarthair munayaḥ siddhāḥ surāś cendrapurogamāḥ ||
nirvinnā bharataśreṣṭha prāpnuvanty akṣatodyamam |
evaṃ vrataṃ mahendrasya samākhyātaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ||
tenaiva nāradasyoktaṃ nāradena svayaṃ mama |
ākhyānaṃ vijayaṃ kṛtvā yato guhyataraṃ nṛpa ||
yaḥ paśyatīdaṃ śṛṇuyān muhūrtaṃ
paṭhec ca bhaktyātha matiṃ dadāti |
so ‘py atra lakṣmīm acalām avāpya
gandharvavidyādharalokam eti ||
[642]
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kamalasaptamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
śarkarāsaptamīṃ vakṣye sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm |
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ yayānantaṃ prajāyate ||
mādhvasya site pakṣe saptamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ |
prātaḥsnātas tilaiḥ śuklaiḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
sthaṇḍile padmam ālikhya kuṅkumena sakarṇikam |
tasmin namaḥ savitreti dhūpaṃ puṣpaṃ niveśayet ||
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ śarkarāpātrasaṃyutam |
śuklavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
sahiraṇyaṃ yathāśaktyā mantreṇānena pūjayet |
viśvedevamayo yasmād vedavādīti paṭhyate ||
tvam evāmṛtasarvasva ataḥ pāhi sanātana |
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā svapet tatpārśvataḥ kṣitau ||
saurasūktaṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhet purāṇaśravaṇena ca |
ahorātre gate paścād aṣṭamyāṃ kṛtanityakaḥ ||
tat sarvaṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
bhojayec chaktito viprān śarkarāghṛtapāyasaiḥ ||
bhuñjītātailalavaṇaṃ svayam asyātha vāgrataḥ |
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsi māsi samācaret ||
vatsarānte punar dadyād brāhmaṇāya samāhitaḥ |
śayanaṃ vastrasasvītaṃ śarkarākanakānvitam ||
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ tathaikāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm ||
[643] gṛhaṃ ca śaktito dadyāt samastopaskarānvitam |
sahasreṇātha niṣkāṇāñ kṛtvā dadyāc chatena vā ||
daśabhir vā tribhir niṣkair niṣkenaikena vā punaḥ |
padmaṃ svaśaktito dadyād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
padmaṃ sauvarṇapadmam |
amṛtaṃ pibato vaktrāt sūryasyāmṛtabindavaḥ |
niṣpetur ye tadutpannāḥ śālimudgekṣavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
śarkarā ca paraṃ tasmād ikṣusārāmṛtopamā |
iṣṭā raver ataḥ puṇyāḥ śarkarā havyakavyayoḥ ||
śarkarāsaptamī caiṣā vājimedhaphalapradā |
sarvaduḥkhopaśamanī putrasantativardhanī ||
yaḥ kuryāt parayā bhaktyā sa vai sadgatim āpnuyāt |
kalpam ekaṃ vaset svarge tato yāti paraṃ padam ||
idam anaghaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ smared vā
paṭhati sa yāti sureśvarasya lokam |
matimati ca dadāti yo janānām
amaravadhūjanakinnaraiḥ sa pūjyaḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ śarkarāsaptamīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa supuṣṭenāpi kiṃ phalam |
māghasnānavihīnena tvayoktaṃ yadunandana ||
[644] prātaḥsnānasamarthānṃ śarīraṃ yasya dehinaḥ |
kiṃ tena vada kartavyaṃ māghe saṃsārabhīruṇā ||
kāyakleśasahā nāryo na bhavanti yadūttama |
saukumāryāc charīrasya abalātvāt tathaiva ca ||
kathaṃ ca tāḥ surūpāḥ syuḥ subhagāḥ suprajās tathā |
svakṛtasyaiva puṇyasya sarvam etat phalaṃ yataḥ ||
alpāyāsena sumahat kena puṇyam avāpyate |
strībhir māghe bhaved brūhi snānaṃ tad dhi jagadguro ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha rahasyaṃ munibhāṣitam |
yan mayā kasyacin noktam acalāsaptamīvratam ||
veśyā cendumatī nāma rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā |
āsīt kurukulaśreṣṭha magadhasya vilāsinī ||
tanumadhyā sujaghanī pīnonnatapayodharā |
samyagvibhaktāvayavā pūrṇacandranibhānanā ||
saundaryaṃ sukumāryaṃ ca tasyāḥ kāmena gīyate |
yasyāḥ sudarśanād eva kāmaḥ kāmāturo bhavet ||
mūrtiḥ śaśadharasyeva nayanānandakāriṇī |
vaśīkaraṇavidyeva sarvalokamanoharā ||
ekasmin divase prātaḥ saṃmukhasthitayā tayā |
cintitā hṛdaye rājan saṃsārasyānavasthitiḥ ||
saṃnimajjaj jagad idaṃ viṣavelāyasāgare |
jarāmṛtyujvaragrāhe na kaścid avabudhyate ||
[645] akūpārabhūtabhāṇḍo dhātṛśilpivinirmitaḥ |
svakarmaghanasaṃvītaḥ pacyate kālavahninā ||
ye yānti divasāḥ puṃsāṃ dharmakarmārthavarjitāḥ |
na te punar ihāyānti harabhaktanarā yathā ||
pūjāsnānatapohomasvādhyāyapitṛtarpaṇam |
yasmin dine na kriyate vṛthā tad divasaṃ nṛṇām ||
putrāṇāṃ dāragṛhake samāsaktaṃ hi mānavam |
vṛkīvoraṇam āsādya mṛtyur ādāya gacchati ||
ity evaṃ cintayitvā tu veśyā cendumatī tataḥ |
vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ jagāma gajagāminī ||
vasiṣṭham ṛṣim āsīnaṃ praṇamya vinayānvitā |
kṛtāñjalipuṭau kṛtvā idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
indumaty uvāca |
mayā na dattaṃ na hutaṃ nopavāsakṛtaṃ vratam |
bhaktyā na pūjitaḥ śambhuḥ svāmin śārṅgadhano na ca ||
sāṃprataṃ tapyamānāyā vrataṃ kiṃcid vadasva me |
yena duḥkhāmbupaṅkaughād uttarāmi bhavārṇavāt ||
etat tasyāḥ subahuśaḥ śrutvātikaruṇaṃ vacaḥ |
kāruṇyāt kathayāmāsa vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ ||
māghasya sitasaptamyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
rūpasaubhāgyajananaṃ snānaṃ kuru varānane ||
kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhyām ekabhaktaṃ saptamyāṃ niścalaṃ jalam |
rātryante cālayethās tvaṃ datvā śirasi dīpakam ||
[646] māghasya sitasaptamyām acalaṃ cālitaṃ ca yat |
jalaṃ malānāṃ sarveṣāṃ smaran tat kṣālanaṃ tataḥ ||
vasiṣṭhavacanaṃ śrutvā tasminn ahani bhārata |
cakārendumatīsnānaṃ dānaṃ samyag yathāvidhi ||
snānasyāsya prabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān |
indraloke ‘psaraḥsaṅghe nāyakatvam avāpa sā ||
acalāsaptamīsnānaṃ kathitaṃ te viśāṃpate |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sukhasaubhāgyavardhanam ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
saptamīsnānamāhatmyaṃ śrutaṃ niravaśeṣitam |
sāṃprataṃ śrotum icchāmi vidhiṃ mantrasamanvitam ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
ekabhaktena saṃtiṣṭhet ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃpūjya bhāskaram |
saptamyāṃ tu vrajet prātaḥ sugambhīrajalāśayam ||
sarit saras taḍāgaṃ va devakhātam athāpi vā |
sukhāvagāhasalilaṃ duṣṭasatvair adūṣitam ||
vyālāmbupakṣibhiś caiva jalagair matsyakacchapaiḥ |
na kena cālyate yāvat tāvat snānam samācaret ||
sauvarṇa rājate pātre bhaktyā tāmramaye ‘tha vā |
tailavarttiḥ pradātavyā mahārajatarañjitā ||
mahārajataṃ kusumbham |
[647] samāhitamanā bhūtvā datvā śirasi dīpakam |
bhāskaraṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
namas te rudrarūpāya rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ |
varuṇāya namas te ‘stu harivāsa namo ‘stu te ||
jalopari tared dīpaḥ snātvā samtarpya devatāḥ |
candanena likhet padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ||
madhye śivaṃ sapatnīkaṃ praṇavena ca saṃyutam |
śakre dale raviḥ pūjyo bhānuś caivānale tathā ||
yāmye vivasvān nairṛtye bhāskaraṃ pūjayed budhaḥ |
paścime savitā pūjyaḥ pūjyo ‘rkaś cānile dale ||
saumye sahasrakiraṇaṃ śaive sarvātmane namaḥ |
pūjyāḥ praṇavapūrvās tu namaskārāntayojitāḥ ||
puṣpaiḥ sugandhadhūpaiś ca pṛthaktvena yudhiṣṭhira |
visarjya vastrasaṃvītaṃ svasthānaṃ gamyatām iti ||
visarjane sahasrāṃśau samāgamya svam ālayam |
tāmrapātre yathāśaktyā mṛṇmaye vātha śaktimān ||
sthāpayet tilapiṣṭaṃ ca saghṛtaṃ saguḍaṃ tathā |
kāñcanaṃ tailakaṃ kṛtvā aśaktas tilapiṣṭajam ||
tailakaṃ dīpapātram |
saṃcchādya raktavastreṇa puṣpair dhūpair athārcayet |
tatas tān vācayed viprān dadyān mantreṇa tālakam ||
ādityasya prasādena prātaḥsnānaphalena ca |
duṣṭadaurbhāgyaduḥsvapnaṃ (?) mayā dattaṃ tu tālakam ||
[648] tālakaṃ tālapatraṃ karṇābharaṇaviśeṣaḥ |
pūjayitvopadeṣṭāraṃ viprān anyāṃś ca pūjayet |
tato dinaṃ samagraṃ ca bhāskaradhyānatatparaḥ ||
tā eva ca kathāḥ śṛṇvann anyā vā dharmasaṃhitāḥ |
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpadarśanasparśanādikam ||
varjayet kṣapayet prājñas tato bandhujanaiḥ saha |
naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca naro dīnān saṃbhojya śaktitaḥ ||
etat te kathitaṃ pārtha rūpasaubhāgyakārakam |
acalāsaptamīsnānaṃ sarvakāmakalapradam ||
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṅgāt
kalikaluṣavināśaṃ saptamīsnānam etat |
matim api ca janānāṃ yo dadāti prayatnāt
surabhavanagato ‘sau sevyate vānarobhiḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ acalāsaptamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
anyām api pravakṣyāmi śobhanāśubhasaptamīm |
yām upoṣya naro rogāt śokaduḥkhāt pramucyate ||
śukle cāśvayuje māsi kṛtasnānajapaḥ śuciḥ |
vācayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhān ārabhec chuklasaptamīm ||
kapilāṃ pūjayed bhaktyā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
[649] namāmi sūryasaṃbhūtām aśeṣabhuvanālayām ||
tvām ahaṃ sarvakalyāṇaśarīrāṃ sarvasiddhaye |
athāhṛtya tilaprasthaṃ tāmrapātre kṛtaṃ navam ||
kāñcanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tadvad vastramālyaguḍānvitam |
phalair nānāvidhar bhakṣyaiḥ sarvopaskarasaṃyutaiḥ ||
dadyād vikālavelāyām aryamā prīyatām iti |
pañcagavyaṃ tu saṃprāśya svaped bhūmau vimatsaraḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte susnāto bhaktyā saṃtarpayed dvijān |
anena vidhinā dadyān māsi māsi tadā naraḥ ||
vāsasī vṛṣabhaṃ haimaṃ tadvac chandośvapūjanam |
vatsarānte ca śayanam ikṣudaṇḍaguṇānvitam ||
sopadhānakaviśrāmabhājanāsanasaṃyutam |
tāmrapātre tilaprasthaṃ sauvarṇavṛṣabhair yutam ||
dadyād vedavide sarvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatām iti |
anena vidhinā rājan kuryād yaḥ śubhasaptamīm ||
tasya śrīr vijayaḥ saukhyaṃ bhavec janmani janmani |
apsarogaṇdagandharvaiḥ pūjyamāno harālaye ||
vased gaṇādhipo bhūtvā caturyugaviparyaye |
tataḥ punar ihāgatya sārvabhaumo bhaviṣyati ||
samānīto devalokāt surāṇāṃ nāradena tu |
[650] śubhākhyā saptamī ceyaṃ śatakoṭipravistarā ||
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ vināśāya dayālunā |
samākhyātā nāradena mayā ca kathitā tava ||
imāṃ paṭhed yaḥ śṛṇuyāc ca bhaktyā
paśyet prasaṅgād api dīyamānām |
so ‘py atra sarvāghaviyuktadehaḥ
prāpnoti vidyādharanāyakatvam ||
yāvat samā vratam idaṃ karoti
yaḥ saptamī saptavidhānayuktaḥ |
sa saptalokādhipatiḥ krameṇa
bhūtvā padaṃ yāti padaṃ murāreḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ śubhasaptamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm |
sarvakāmapradāṃ puṇyāṃ nāmnā mandārasaptamīm ||
māghasyāmalapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ laghubhuk naraḥ |
dantakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhim upavasen naraḥ ||
viprān saṃbhojayitvā tu mandāraṃ prāśayen niśi |
tataḥ prabhāte utthāya kuryāt snānaṃ punar dvijān ||
bhojayec chaktitaḥ kṛtvā mandārakusumāṣṭakam |
mandāro rājārkaḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ puratas tadvat padmahastaṃ suśobhanam |
[651] padmaṃ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kṛtvā tāmrapātre ‘ṣṭapatrakam |
haimaṃ mandārakusumaṃ sthāpya madhye ca pūjayet ||
namaskāreṇa tadvac ca sūryāyety anale dale |
aiśānyāṃ mitranāmānaṃ namaskāreṇa pūjayet |
dakṣiṇe tadvad arkāya athāryamneti nairṛte ||
paścime vedadhāmneti vāyavye caṇḍabhānave |
pūrṇe cottarataḥ pūjya ānandāyety ataḥ param ||
karṇikāyāṃca puruṣaṃ sthāpya sarvātmaneti ca |
śuklavastraiḥ samāveṣṭya bhakṣyair mālyaphalādibhiḥ ||
evam abhyarcya tat sarvaṃ dadyād vedavide punaḥ |
bhuñjītātailalavaṇaṃ vāgyataḥ prāṅmukho gṛhī ||
anena vidhinā sarvasaptamyāṃ māsi māsi vā |
kuryāt saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
etad eva vratānte tu vidhāya kalaśopari |
gobhir vibhavataḥ sārdhaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
namo mandāranāthāya mandāraśayanāya ca |
tvaṃ vai tārayasvāsmān asmāt saṃsārasāgarāt ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryān mandārasaptamīm |
vihāryātisukhī loke kalpaṃ ca divi modate ||
imām aghaughapaṭalabhīṣaṇadhvāntadīpikām |
gacchan pragṛhya saṃsāraśarvaryāṃ na skhalen naraḥ ||
mandārasaptamī nāma īpsitārthaphalapradā |
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi so ‘pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
[652]
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ mandārasaptamīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kathaṃ sā kriyate kṛṣṇa manuṣyair atha saptamī |
cakravartitvaphaladā yā vikhyātā tvayā mama ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
āsīt kāmbojaviṣaye yaśodharmanarādhipaḥ |
vṛddhe vayasi tasyāsīt sarvavyādhiyutaḥ sutaḥ ||
tatkarmapākaṃ so ‘pṛcchad vinīto dvijapuṃgavān |
sa cāha rājan vaiśyo ‘yaṃ kṛpaṇaḥ pūrvajanmani ||
dadarśa rathasaptamyāṃ kriyamāṇavrataṃ nṛpa |
vratadarśanamāhātmyāḍ utpanno jaṭhare tava ||
adātā vibhave tasmāt tenāyaṃ vyādhito ‘bhavat |
tataḥ sa rāja papraccha kiṃ me tat saṃvidhīyatām ||
yasya saṃdarśanāt prāpto lābhas tava niketanam |
tad eva kriyatāṃ rājan rathasaptamisaṃjñitam ||
vrataṃ pāpaharaṃ yena cakravartitvam āpyate ||
rājovāca |
brūhi vipra vrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ savidhānaṃ samantrakam |
īśvarāṇāṃ daridrāṇāṃ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakam ||
dvija uvāca |
śuklapakṣe tu māghasya ṣaṣṭhyām āmantrayed gṛhī |
[653] snānaṃ śuklatilaiḥ kāryaṃ nadyabhāve tu kutracit ||
vimale salile rājan vidhivad varṇadharmataḥ |
devādīn pūjayitvā tu gatvā sūryālayaṃ tataḥ ||
sūryaṃ samyaṅ namaskṛtya puṣpadhūpākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ |
āgatya bhavanaṃ paścāt pañcayajñāṃś ca nirvapet ||
saṃbhojyātithibhṛtyāṃś ca bālavṛddhāśritān svayam |
vidyamāne dine ‘śnīyād vāgyatas tailavarjitam ||
rātrau vipraṃ samāhūya vidhijñaṃ vedapāragam |
saṃpūjya niyamaṃ kuryāt sūryam ādhāya cetasi ||
saptamyāṃ tu nirāhāro bhūtvā bhogavivarjitaḥ |
bhokṣye ‘ṣṭamyāṃ jagannetra nirvighnaṃ tatra me kuru ||
ity uccārya nṛpaśreṣṭha toyaṃ toyeṣu nikṣipet |
tato visarjya taṃ vipraṃ svaped bhūmau jitendriyaḥ ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtāvaśyaḥ śucir naraḥ |
kārayitvā rathaṃ divyaṃ kiṅkiṇījālamālinam ||
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ (?) ratnaiḥ sarvāṅgacitritam |
kāñcanaṃ rājataṃ cātha hayasārathisaṃyutam ||
tato madhyāhnasamaye kṛtasnānādiko vratī |
atīryag (?) vīkṣamāṇas tu pāṣaṇḍālāpavarjitaḥ ||
saurasūktaṃ japan prājñaḥ samāgacchet svam ālayam |
nirvartya nityakāryaṃ tu kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam ||
vastramaṇḍayikāmadhye sthāpayet taṃ rathottamam |
kuṃkumena sugandhena cārcayitvā samantataḥ ||
[654] mālābhiḥ puṣpadīpānāṃ samantāt pariveṣṭayet |
dhūpenāgurumiśreṇa dhūpayitvā rathopari ||
rathasya snāpayed bhānuṃ sarvasaṃpūrṇalakṣaṇam |
vittānurūpaṃ haimaṃ ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
śāṭhyād vrajati vaikalyaṃ vaikalyād vikalaṃ phaṇam |
tato devaṃ samabhyarcya sarathaṃ sahasārathim ||
puṣpair dhūpais tathā gandhair vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
phalair nānāvidhair bhakṣyair naivedyair ghṛtapācitaiḥ ||
pūjayed bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā mantrair ebhis tribhiḥ kramāt |
bhāno divākarāditya mārtaṇḍa jagatāmpate ||
apāṃnidhe jagadrakṣa bhūtabhāvana bhāskara |
praṇatārtiharācintya viśvavittāmaṇe vibho ||
viṣṇo haṃsātibhūteśa ādimadhyāntakāraka |
bhaktihīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ jagatpate ||
prasādāt tava saṃpūrṇam arcanaṃ yad ihāstu me |
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ prārthayec ca manogatam ||
dadāti prārthitaṃ bhānur bhaktyā saṃtoṣito naraiḥ |
vittahīno ‘pi vidhinā sarvam etat prakalpayet ||
rathaṃ sasārathiṃ sāśvaṃ varṇakair bhittilekhitam |
sauvarṇaṃ ca tathā bhānuṃ yathāśaktyā vinirmitam ||
prāguktena vidhānena pūjayitvā suvistaram |
jāgaraṃ kārayed rātrau gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
prokṣaṇīyair vicitraiś ca puṇyākhyānakathādibhiḥ |
[655] rathayātrāṃ prapaśyeta bhāgor āyatanaṃ śritaḥ ||
animīlitanetras tu nayet tāṃ rajanīṃ budhaḥ |
prabhāte vimale snātaḥ kṛtakṛtyas tato dvijān ||
tarpayed vividhaiḥ kāmair dānair vāsovibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
aśvamedhena tulyaṃ tad idaṃ brahmavido viduḥ ||
ato deyāni dānāni yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
rathaṃ tu gurave deyaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam ||
rakthaṃ ca vastrayugalaṃ raktadhenusamanvitam |
evaṃ cīrṇavrato rājan kiṃ nāpnoti jagattraye ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kuru tvaṃ rathasaptamīm |
yenārogyo bhavat putraḥ svadīpo nṛpasattama ||
vratasyāsya prabhāvena prasādād bhāskarasya ca |
bhaviṣyati mahātejā mahābalaparākramaḥ ||
muktvā bhogān suvipulān kṛtvā rājyam akaṇṭakam |
datvāsau rathasaptamyāṃ mṛte tv api mahābhujaḥ ||
utpādya putrān pautrāṃś ca sūryalokaṃ sa yāsyati |
tatra sthitvā kalpam ekaṃ cakravartī bhaviṣyati ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
iti sarvaṃ samākhyāya viparito dvijottamaḥ |
yathāgataṃ jagāmāsau nṛpaḥ sarvaṃ cakāra ha ||
yad ādiṣṭaṃ dvijendreṇa tat tat sarvaṃ babhūva ha |
evaṃ sa cakravartitvaṃ prāptavān nṛpanandana ||
śrūyate yas tu māndhātā purāṇeṣu paraṃtapa |
[656] ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā yo vāpi parikīrtayet ||
tasyaiva tuṣyate bhānur yaḥ śrutvaivābhayaṃ sadā |
evaṃvidhaṃ rathavaraṃ rathavājiyuktaṃ
haimaṃ ca haimaśatadīdhitinā sametam |
dadyāc ca māghasitasaptamivāsareṣu
so saṅgacakragatir eva mahīṃ bhunakti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ rathasaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
māghe māsi mahādeva site pake jitendriyaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyām upoṣito bhūtvā gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ ||
pūjayitvā dinakaraṃ rātrau tasyāgrataḥ svapet |
vibuddhas tv atha saptamyāṃ bhaktyā bhānuṃ samarcayet ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
khaṇḍaveṣṭair modakaiś ca tathekṣuguḍapūpakaiḥ ||
prathamaṃ vatsare pūrṇe saptamyāṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
devadevasya vai yātrāṃ pūrvoktavidhinācaret ||
pūrvoktavidhineti nānātithiprakaraṇasthitarathayātrāvidhinety arthaḥ |
kṛcchrapādaṃ vrataṃ kuryād rathārūḍhaṃ vrataṃ ravim |
[657] paśyed bhaktyā jagannāthaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
tṛtīyāyām ekabhaktaṃ caturthyāṃ naktam ucyate ||
athācitaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva upoṣitaḥ |
saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryād dṛṣṭvā devaṃ rathe sthitam ||
pūjayitvā ca vidhinā bhaktyā devaṃ trilocanam |
sauvarṇaṃ tu rathaṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātroparisthitam ||
rathamadhye nyased vyomaṃ (?) pūjitaṃ maṇibhir navam |
vyomanirmāṇaṃ tu vyomaṣaṣṭhīvrata eva vyākhyātam veditavyam |
padmarāgaṃ nyasen madhye mauktikaṃ pūrvato nyaset |
indranīlam atho yāmyā vāruṇyāṃ makaradhvajam ||
pravālam uttare rudre sarvajñaṃ vinyased budhaḥ |
śvetaṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ cāpi raktaṃ cāndhakasūdana ||
etāni navavastrāṇi dikṣu sarvāsu vinyaset |
patākā rathasaṃsthāne ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣite ||
puṣpadāmnā svalaṃkṛtvya rathaṃ vyomasamanvitam |
yathānyāyaṃ pūjayitvā bhāskarāya nivedayet ||
bhojayitvātha vā vipram ācāryāya nivedayet |
yo ‘dhīte saptamīkalpaṃ sopākhyānaṃ ca śāṅkaram ||
ācāryaḥ sa dvijo jñeyo varṇānām anupūrvaśaḥ |
saurāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śaivānāṃ pārvatīpatiḥ ||
alābhe tu suvarṇasya rathaṃ rājatam ādiśet |
[658] tadalābhe tāmramayaṃ rathaṃ vyomaṃ ca kārayet |
alābhena ca tāmrasya rathaḥ piṣṭamayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sahiraṇyaṃ mahādevaṃ tāmrabhājanam āsthitam |
kāṣāyayugmasahitaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
pūrvoktena mahādeva vācakāya mahādyute |
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ (?) śubhāṅgaprāvṛtaṃ sitam ||
svaśaktyā tu virūpākṣaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā rathāṅkā saptamī hara ||
kathitā te mayā rudramahatīyaṃ prakīrtitā |
snānaṃ dānam atho homaḥ pūjanaṃ grahanāyakam ||
śatasāhasrikaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūtyai bhūdhara vidyate |
evam eṣā puṇyatamā mādhe prāptā tu saptamī ||
yām upoṣya naro bhaktyā sūryasyānucaro bhavet |
brāhmaṇo yāti devatvaṃ kṣatriyo vipratāṃ vrajet ||
vaiśyas tu kṣatratāṃ yāti vaiśyatvam eti vai |
vidyāvinayasaṃpannaṃ bhartāraṃ kanyakā labhet ||
aputrā strī sutaṃ vindyāt saubhāgyaṃ ca narādhipa |
vidhavā cāpy upoṣyainām uttamaṃ lokam aśnute ||
nānyajanmasu vaidhavyaṃ prāpnuyāt pārvatīpriya |
bahuputrā bahudhanā bhartur vallabhatāṃ vrajet |
yāvadbhiḥ saptajanmāni nārī vā puruṣas tathā ||
[659]
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ rathāṅkasaptamīvratam |
vāsudeva uvāca |
māghasya śuklapakṣe tu añcamyāṃ (?) ca kurūdvaha |
ekabhaktaṃ samākhyātaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktam udāhṛtam ||
saptamyām upavāsaṃ ca kecid icchanti suvrata |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kecid uśantīha saptamyāṃ rādhanaṃ kila ||
kṛtopavāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu pūjayed bhāskaraṃ budhaḥ |
raktacandanamiśrais tu karavīraiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ ||
guggulena mahābāho sugandhena ca suvrata |
pūjayed devadevśaṃ graheśaśaṅkaraṃ ravim ||
śaṅkaraṃ sukhakaram ity arthaḥ |
evaṃ hi caturo māsān māghādīn pūjayed ravim |
ātmanaś cāpi śuddhyarthaṃ prāśanaṃ gomayasya ca ||
snānaṃ ca gomayeneha kartavyaṃ cātmaśuddhaye |
brāhmaṇān divyabhogāṃś ca bhojayec cāpi śaktitaḥ ||
divi devakule bhavāḥ divyā itare bhaumāḥ |
jyaiṣṭhādiṣv api māseṣu śvetacandanam ucyate |
śvetāni cāpi puṇyāṇi śubhagandhānvitāni vai ||
kṛṣṇāguru tathā dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ smṛtam |
tenaiva brāhmaṇān sādhūn bhojayec ca mahāmate ||
prāśayet pañcagavyaṃ tu snānaṃ tenaiva suvrata |
[660] kārttikādiṣu māseṣu agastikusumaiḥ smṛtam |
pūjanaṃ kuruśārdūla dhūpaś caivāparājitaḥ ||
naivedyaṃ brāhmaṇān snāto bhojayec ca svaśaktitaḥ ||
kuśodakaṃ prāśayec ca snānaṃ ca kuru siddhaye |
tṛtīyapāraṇasyānte māghe māsi mahāmate ||
bhojanaṃ tatra dānaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ samudāhṛtam |
devadevasya pūjā ca kartavyā śaktito budhaiḥ ||
rathasya cāpi dānaṃ tu rathayātrā ca suvrata |
rathasya prāptihetor vai kartavyā vibhave sati ||
dānaṃ sarvarathasyeha yathokaṃ vibhave sati |
ity eṣā kathitā putra rathāṅkasaptamī śubhā ||
saptamīti mahākhyātā mahāpuṇyā mahodayā |
yām upoṣya dhanaṃ putrān kīrtiṃ vidyāṃ samaśnute ||
iti bhaviṣatpurāṇoktaṃ mahāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī cāparājitā |
mahājayā ca nandā ca bhadrā vāmā prakīrtitā ||
śuklapakṣasya saptayāṃ nakṣatraṃ pañcatārakam |
yadā bhavet tadā jñeyā jayānāmeti saptamī ||
pañcatārakam iti rohiṇy aśleṣā maghā hastāś ca |
tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tarpaṇaṃ devapūjanam |
[661] sarvaṃ śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ pūjāṃ cāpi divākarīm ||
haṃse hastasamārūḍhe śuklā yā saptamī parā |
haṃsaḥ sūryaḥ |
varṣam ekaṃ tu kartavyā vidhinānena bhāskaram ||
sauvarṇaṃ kārayed bhaktyā dvibhujaṃ padmadhāriṇam |
pāraṇatritayaṃ tasyāṃ kriyate gopate purā ||
prathamaṃ caturo māsān pāraṇaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ |
kathitāny atra puṣpāṇi karavīrasya suvrata ||
candanaṃ ca tathā raktaṃ dhūpārthaṃ guggulaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kāsāraṃ tu sitāsāraṃ (?) naivedyaṃ bhāskarāya vai ||
kāsāro godhūmacūrṇaikṣavaghṛtair bhṛṣṭvā nirmito loke prasiddhaḥ sitātāraḥ (?) śarkarābahulaḥ |
anena vidhinā pūjya mārtaṇḍaṃ vibudhādhipam |
pūjayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā bhakṣyabhojyair yathāvidhi ||
kāsāraṃ bhojayed viprān pāraṇaṃ phaladaṃ bhavet |
svayam eva tathāśnīyād adṛto maunam āsthitaḥ ||
pañcamyām ekabhaktaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ tu kīrtitam |
kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
siddhārthakaiḥ snānam atra prāśanaṃ pāyasena tu |
bhānur me prīyatām atra dantakāṣṭhaṃ tathārkajam ||
dvitīyaṃ śrūyatāṃ karma pāraṇaṃ gadato mama |
mālatīkusumānīha śrīkhaṇḍaṃ candanaṃ tathā ||
[662] naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ bhānor dhūpaṃ vijayam āviśet |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi samaśnīyāt svayaṃ vibho ||
ravir me prīyatām atra nāma devasya kīrtayet |
prāśayet pañcagavyaṃ tu khādiraṃ dantadhāvanam ||
dvitīye pāraṇe cāpi vidhir ukto mayādhunā |
tṛtīye pāraṇe caiva vidhānaṃ tu nibodha me ||
agastyakusumair atra bhāskaraṃ pūjayed budhaḥ |
svam ālambhanamātroktaṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā ||
sihlakaṃ dhūpanirdiṣṭaṃ sūryaprītikaraṃ param |
śālyodanaṃ tu naivedyaṃ rasāloparisaṃyutam ||
rasālaḥ śikhaṇḍinī |
brāhmaṇānām atho dānaṃ bhojayec ca tathātmanā |
kuśodakaprāśanaṃ ca badaryā dantadhāvanam ||
vikartanaḥ prīyatāṃ me nāma devasya kīrtayet |
varṣānte devadevasya pūjā kāryā vidhānataḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca nānāprokṣaṇakais tathā |
godānabhūmidānaiś ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||
itthaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ devasya purataḥ sthitam |
kārayet paramaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmapustakavācanam ||
vastrair gandhais tathā dhūpair vācakaṃ pūjya yatnataḥ |
devasya purataḥ sthitvā tato mantram udīrayet ||
devadeva jagannātha sarvavyādhivināśana |
[663] graheśa lokatapana vikartana tamopaha ||
kṛteyaṃ devadevasya jayā nāmeti saptamī |
mayā tava prasādena dhanyā pāpaharā śivā ||
anena vidhinā vīra yaḥ kuryāt saptamīvratam |
tasya snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavec chataguṇaṃ vibho ||
kṛtvemāṃ saptamīṃ vīra puruṣaḥ prāpnuyād yaśaḥ |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca putrān āyur balaṃ smṛtam ||
prāpyeha naraśārdūla svargalokaṃ ca gacchati |
tasmād etya punar bhūmau rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
ity eṣā kathitā vīra jayā nāmeti saptamī |
kṛtāśrutā smṛtā yā tu haṃsalokapradāyinī ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ jayāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovācā |
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ sūryavāro bhaved yadi |
saptamī vijayā nāma tatra dattaṃ mahāphalam ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homa upavāsas tathaiva ca |
sarvaṃ vijayasaptamyāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
pañcamyām ekabhaktaṃ syāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ pracakṣate |
upavāsas tu saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
upavāsaparaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ abjasthaṃ pūjayed ravim |
upavāsaparaḥ vijayasaptamyām upavāsaṃ kariṣyan |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
[664] prakalpya pūjābhūmau ca devasya purataḥ svapet ||
japamānas tu gāyatrīṃ saurasūktam athāpi vā |
tryakṣaraṃ vā mahāśvetaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram athāpi vā |
vibuddhas tv atha saptamyāṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ gaṇādhipam ||
graheśaṃ pūjayitvā tu homaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād bhaktyā ca gaṇanayakam ||
śālyodanam apūpāṃś ca khaṇḍaveṣṭāś ca śaktitaḥ |
datvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā tato viprān visarjayet ||
ity eṣā kathitā deva puṇyā vijayasaptamī |
yām upoṣya naro gacchet paraṃ vairocanaṃ padam ||
karavīrāṇi raktāni kuṅkumaṃ ca vilepanam |
vijayaṃ dhūpam asyāṃ tu bhānos tuṣṭakarāṇi vai ||
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā mahāpātakanāśinī |
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ cāpi akṣayaṃ ca gaṇādhipa ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ vijayāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
māghasya śuklapakṣe tu saptamī yā trilocanā |
jayantī nāma sā proktā puṇyā pāpaharā tathā ||
upoṣya yena vidhinā śṛṇu taṃ pārvatīpriya |
pāraṇāni tu catvāri kathitāni ca paṇḍitaiḥ ||
pañcamyām ekabhaktas tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam |
[665] upavāsas tu saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
māghe ca phālgune māse (?) tathā caitra ca suvrata |
arkapuṣpāṇi dhanyāni kuṅumaṃ ca vilepanam ||
naivedyaṃ modakaṃ cānnaṃ dhūpādyam udāhṛtam |
prāśanaṃ pañcagavyasya pavitrīkaraṇaṃ param ||
modakair bhojayed viprān yathāśaktyā gaṇādhipa |
śālyodanaṃ ca bhūteśa dadyād bhaktyā dvijeṣu vai ||
itthaṃ saṃpūjayed yas tu bhāskaraṃ lokapūjitam |
sarveṣu pāraṇeṣv evaṃ so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
dvitīye pāraṇe pūjya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet |
vaiśākhe tv atha jyaiṣṭhe tu āṣāḍhe māsi suvrata ||
pūjārghamantre bhānor vai śatapatrāṇi yojayet |
śvetaṃ ca candanaṃ bhaumaṃ dhūpo guggulur ucyate ||
naivedyaṃ guḍapūpāś ca prāśanaṃ gomayasya ca |
bhojanaṃ cāpi viprāṇāṃ guḍapūpāś ca kīrtitāḥ ||
dvitīyam idam ākhyānaṃ pāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam |
tṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu deveśa pūjārthaṃ bhāskarasya tu ||
śrāvaṇe māsi deveśa tathā bhādrapade vibho |
āśvine cāpi māse tu raktacandanam iṣyate ||
mālatīkusumānīha dhūpo vijaya iṣyate |
naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūpāś ca bhojane tu dvijātiṣu ||
kuśodakaprāśanaṃ tu kāyaśuddhikaraṃ param |
tṛtīyam api tv ākhyātaṃ pāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
[666] rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phaladaṃ bhāskarapriyam |
caturtham apy ahaṃ vacmi pāraṇaṃ śreyase nṛpa ||
māsi kārttikake vīra mārgaśīrṣe tathāpi ca |
pauṣe ca naraśārdūla śṛṇu puṣpāṇy aśeṣataḥ ||
karavīrāṇi raktāni tathā raktaṃ ca candanam |
amṛtākhyaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā ||
arjunīyaṃ tathā vajraṃ prāśanaṃ paramaṃ matam |
aguruṃ candanaṃ mustāṃ sihlakaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ tathā ||
samabhāgaṃ tu kartavyaṃ dhūpaṃ cāmṛtasaṃbhavam |
arjunīyaṃ gavyaṃ vajraṃ ghṛtam |
nāmāni kathitāny atra bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ ||
citrabhānus tathā bhānur ādityo bhāskaras tathā |
prīyatām iti sarveṣu pāraṇeṣv evam ādiśet ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryāt pūjāṃ vibhāvasoḥ |
asyāṃ tithau mahādeva sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
kṛtvaivaṃ saptamīṃ bhīma sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
putrārthī labhate putrān dhanārthī labhate dhanam ||
sarogo mucyate rogāt śubhaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam |
pūrṇe saṃvatsare bhīma kāryā pūjā divākare ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ |
nānāvidhaiḥ prokṣaṇakaiḥ pūjayā vācakasya ca ||
itthaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca prapūjayet |
vācakaṃ dvijaṃ saṃpūjya idaṃ vākyam udīrayet ||
[667] dharmakāryeṣu me deva arthakāryeṣu nityaśaḥ |
kāmakāryeṣu sarveṣu jayo bhavati sarvadā ||
tadā visarjayed viprān vācakaṃ ca dvijottamam |
itthaṃ kuryād idaṃ paścāt sa jayaṃ prāpnuyāt sadā ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati |
vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ kavijodbhavam uttamam ||
tejasā kavisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā patagottamaḥ |
kavijaṃ kavir agnis tajjaṃ suvarṇam | patagaḥ sūryaḥ |
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktaṃ jayantīvratam |
brahmovāca |
māsi bhādrapade śuklā saptamī yā gaṇādhipa |
aparājiteti vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī ||
caturṇām ekabhaktaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ naktam ādiśet |
upavāsas tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
pāraṇaṃ yatra catvāri kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ |
puṣpāṇi karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca candanam ||
dhūpakriyā guggulunā naivedyaṃ guḍapūpakāḥ |
nabhasyādiṣu māseṣu vidhir eṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
tathāśubhagapuṣpāṇi kuṅkumaṃ ca vilepanam |
dhūpārthaṃ sihlakaṃ proktam atha vā bilvasaṃbhavam ||
śālyodanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ rasālāḥ phālgunādiṣu |
[668] raktotpalāni bhūteśa agurucandanaṃ tathā ||
anantadhūpam uddiṣṭaṃ naivedyaṃ guḍapūpakāḥ |
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ granthasahitam aguruḥ sihlakaṃ tathā ||
mustā tathenduṃ bhūteśa śarkarāś ca dahet tryaham |
ity eṣo ‘nantadhūpaś ca kathito devasattama ||
granthir granthiparṇī, induḥ karpūraḥ |
jyaiṣṭhādiṣu tathā hy eṣa vidhir ukto manīṣibhiḥ |
śṛṇu nāmāni devasya prāśanāni ca suvrata ||
bhago ‘ṃśumān aryamā ca savitā tripurāntakaḥ |
pāraṇeṣu ca sarveṣu prīyatām iti kīrtayet ||
gomūtraṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca ghṛtam uṣṇaṃ ca vai payaḥ |
yas tv imāṃ saptamīṃ kuryād anena vidhinā naraḥ ||
aparājito bhavet so ‘pi sadā śatrubhir āhave |
hanyāc chatrūn jayec cāpi trivargaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
trivargam atha saṃprāpya bhanoḥ puram avāpnuyāt |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca purāṇaśravaṇena ca ||
aśvadānena ca vibho bhrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ |
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhāskarasya priyaṃ sadā ||
sa parājitasya vai śatrūn yāti haṃsasalokatām |
śukrajodbhavayānena āpageyapatākinā ||
āpagādhipasaṃkāśo hy āpagādhipatir bhavet |
śukrajaṃ suvarṇam, āpageyam api suvarṇam eva, āpagādhipo varuṇaḥ |
[669]
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam aparājitāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
mahājayā tadā syād vai saptamī bhāskarapriyā ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam |
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ tapanena mahaujasā ||
yas tv asyāṃ mānavo bhaktyā ghṛtena snāpayed ravim |
so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya tataḥ sūryapadaṃ vrajet ||
payasā snāpayed yas tu bhāskaraṃ bhaktimān naraḥ |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sa yāti sūryaloktām ||
sthitvā tatra ciraṃ kālaṃ rājā bhavati saṃjaya |
mahājayāiṣā kathitā saptamī tripurāntaka ||
yām upoṣya naro bhaktyā acalāṃ svargatiṃ labhet |
tato yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ mahājayāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
yā tu mārgaśire māsi śuklapakṣe tu saptamī |
nandā sā kathitā vīra sarvānandakarī śubhā ||
pañcamyām ekabhaktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam |
[670] saptamyām upavāsaṃ ca kīrtayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
mālatīkusumānīha sugandhaṃ candanaṃ tathā |
karpūrāgurusaṃmiśraṃ dhūpaṃ cātra vinirdiśet ||
dadhyodanaṃ sakhaṇḍaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhāskarapriyam |
tad eva dadyād viprebhyo hy aśnīyāc ca svayaṃ tathā ||
pūjārthaṃ bhāskarāsyaiṣa prathame pāraṇe vidhiḥ |
pālāśapuṣpāṇi vibho yajñacandanam eva ca ||
karpūraṃ sihlakaṃ kuṣṭham uśīraṃ candanaṃ tathā |
sagranthivṛṣaṇaṃ bhīma kuṅkumaṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā |
harītakī tathā bhīma eṣa yajñāṅka ucyate ||
gṛñjanaṃ palāṇḍubhedaḥ |
dhūpaṃ prabodham ādiṣṭaṃ naivedyaṃ khaṇḍakhādyakam |
kṛṣṇāguruḥ sihlakaṃ ca cāṇakyaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ tathā ||
candanaṃ tagaraṃ mustā prabodhaḥ śarkarānvitaḥ |
cāṇakyaṃ mūlakabhedaḥ |
bhojayed brāhmaṇāṃś cāpi khaṇḍādyair gagaṇādhipa ||
bilvapatraṃ tu saṃprāśya tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
vāraṇasya dvitīyasya vidhir eṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
nīlotpalāni puṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ guggulum āharet |
naivedyaṃ ca pāṃśumukhāḥ prītaye bhāskarasya tu ||
pāṃśumukhāḥ śarkarācūrṇapūrṇavadanā bhakṣyāḥ |
[671] vilepanaṃ candanasya mustāprāśanam ucyate |
tṛtīyasyāpi he vīra kathito vidhir uttamaḥ ||
śṛṇu nāmāni devasya pāvanāni nṛṇāṃ sadā |
viṣṇur bhagas tathā dhātā prīyatām uccayed budhaḥ ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryān nandāṃ varaḥ sadā |
sa kāmān iha (?) saṃprāpya vidhātāram avāpnuyāt ||
putrakāmo labhet putraṃ dhanakāmo labhed dhanam |
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ yaśo’rthī ca yaśas tathā ||
sarvakāmas (?) tathā prāpya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
tataḥ sūryasado gatvā nandate nandavardhanam ||
ity eṣā nandajananī nandā khyātā mayā dvija |
yām upoṣya tathā śrutvā nandate ‘rkam avāpya vai ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ nandāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ savitur bhavet |
yadā prāpyam aśeṣeṇa tadā sā bhadratāṃ vrajet ||
savitṛnakṣatraṃ hastā |
caturthyām ekabhaktas tu pañcamyāṃ naktam ādiśet |
ṣaṣṭhyām ayācitaṃ proktam upavāsas tataḥ param ||
[672] tarpaṇaṃ devadeveśo ghṛtena kathitaṃ budhaiḥ |
kṣīreṇa ca tathā vīra punar ikṣurasena ca ||
snāpayitvā tu deveśaṃ candanena vilepayet |
dadyāc ca guggulaṃ tasmai dadyād vyoma tathāgrataḥ ||
godhūmacūrṇaniṣpannaṃ vimalaṃ śaśisaṃnibham |
suvarṇaṃ saguḍaṃ caiva raktapuṣpopaśobhitam ||
yad atra śṛṅgam īśānaṃ tatra vai mauktikaṃ nyaset |
yadagre tatra māṇikyaṃ nyased vā rohitaṃ maṇim ||
nairṛte marakataṃ dadyād vāyavye yajñarāgakam |
sarojaṃ vāpy uttarataḥ svaśaktyā vinyased budhaḥ ||
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān baiḍālavratikān tyajet |
saptamyāṃ bhojayed rājño divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryād vai bhadrasaptamīm |
bhadrā dadāti saptamyāṃ bhadraṃ tasya vrataṃ bhavet ||
tasya bhadrāḥ sarva eva gacchanti jñatayaḥ sadā |
tadaśaktaḥ phalaṃ tasyāṃ vidhinā kena dīyate ||
vyomabhadram iti proktaṃ devacihnaṃ manoramam |
śālipiṣṭamayaṃ proktaṃ catuḥkoṇaṃ manoramam ||
gamyena sarpiṣā yuktaṃ khaṇḍaśarkarasānvitam |
caturjātakacūrṇena drākṣābhiś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
caturjātakacūrṇeneti elālavaṅgapatrakanāgakesaracūrṇenety arthaḥ |
nālikelaphalaiś caiva śubhagandhair gaṇādhipa |
[673] madhyendranīlaṃ bhadrasya nyaset prājñaḥ svaśaktitaḥ ||
puṣparāgaṃ marakataṃ padmarāgaṃ tathaiva ca |
atoyame ca māṇikyaṃ kramāt koṇeṣu vinyaset ||
prasthamātraṃ bhaved bhadraṃ prasthārdhaṃ syāc ca vā vibho |
anena vidhinā kṛtvā devasya purato nyaset ||
vācakāyātha vai dadyād atha vā bhojake svayam |
anena vidhinā yas tu kṛtvā bhadraṃ prayacchati ||
sa hi bhadrāṇi saṃprāpya gacched gopatimandiram |
brahmalokaṃ tato gacched yānārūḍho na saṃśayaḥ ||
tejasā ravisaṅkāśaḥ kāntyātreyasamas tathā |
ātreyaḥ candraḥ |
prabhayā gopates tulyas tejasā śaṅkarasya ca |
tasmād etya punar bhūmau gopatiḥ syān na saṃśayaḥ ||
prasādād gopater vīra bhadravān abhijāyate |
ity eṣā kathitā vīra bhadrānām eti saptamī ||
yām upoṣya naro vīra brahmalokam avāpnuyāt |
śṛṇvanti ca paṭhantīha kurvanti ca gaṇādhipa ||
te sarve candram āsādya yānti tad brahma śāśvatam |
[674]
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktaṃ bhadrāsaptamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
sūryabhaktā tu yā nārī dhruvaṃ sā puruṣo bhavet |
strī caivāpy uttamaṃ nāthaṃ yat kṛtvā śṛṇu sāṃpratam ||
nikṣubhārkavrataṃ bhānoḥ sadā prītivivardhanam |
aviyogakaraṃ vīra dharmakāmārthasādhakam ||
saptamyām atha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā saṃkrāntu bhānave dine |
haviṣā haviṣā homaṃ sopavāsaḥ samācaret ||
nikṣubhārkasya devārcāṃ kṛtvā svarṇamayīṃ śubhām |
rājatīṃ vātha vārcāṃ vā sthāpayec ca ghṛtādibhiḥ ||
nikṣubhā sūryāpatnī tayā sahito ‘rkaḥ | haviṣa haviṣā gavyaghṛtena |
rūpanirmāṇaṃ viṣnudharmottarāt |
kartavyo nikṣubhārkas tu vārīkavacabhūṣitaḥ |
raśmayas tasya kartavyā vāmadakṣiṇadastayoḥ (hastayoḥ?) ||
karayor anyayos tasya kamale kamalāsanaḥ |
ekacaktre rathe caiva ṣaḍāre nikṣubhaktitaḥ ||
caturbāhur mahātejā rasanābhir vibhūṣitaḥ |
upaviṣṭas tu kartavyaḥ sa devo ‘ruṇasārathiḥ ||
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya vastrayugmaiś ca śobhanaiḥ |
mantrabhojyair aśeṣaiś ca vimānadhvajacāmaraiḥ ||
[675] bhojayet sūryabhaktāṃś ca bhojakāṃś ca tathā nṛpa |
bhaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād bhāskaraḥ prīyatām iti ||
tāmrapātre ca kāṃśye vā śuklavastrāvaguṇṭhitam |
kṛtvāyatanamadhye tu pratimām upakalpayet ||
kṛtvā śirasi tat pātraṃ vitānacchadaśobhitam |
dhvajachatrādibhiś caiva bradhnaṃ tv āyatanaṃ vrajet ||
nikṣubhārkadineśasya vratam etan nivedayet |
tatpīṭhe sthāpayet pātraṃ puṣpaśobhāsamanvitam ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya raviṃ praṇipatya prasādayet |
saṃprāpyaitad (?) vrataṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu yat phalam āpnuyāt ||
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśair mahāyānair nagopamaiḥ |
yatheṣṭaṃ vai raver loke sauraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate ||
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi koṭivarṣaśatāni ca |
nandate ca mahābhāgair viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
tataḥ karmaviśeṣeṇa sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ |
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya paraṃ sukham avāpnuyāt ||
brahmalokāt paribhraṣṭaḥ śrīmān sadbhiḥ prapūjitaḥ |
prajāpatitvam āpnoti surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ||
bhogān iha ciraṃ bhuktvā somaloke mahīyate |
somāc cāndraṃ punar lokam āsādyendrasamo bhavet ||
indralokāc ca gāndharvalokaṃ prāpyas a modate |
gandharvarājapatinā saha bhogair vaset sukham ||
[676] mahāratnaprabhāvena upaśobhitam adbhutam |
yakṣalokam api prāpto yathākāmaṃ pramodate ||
yakṣalokāt paribhraṣṭaḥ krīḍate merumūrdhani |
sthānāni lokapālānāṃ kramād āgatya modate ||
lokālokāṃs taparyante (?) sarvasmin kṣitimaṇḍale |
yatra tatra sukhī nityaṃ tad aśeṣam avāpnuyāt ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃś ca rājyaṃ prāpya pramodate |
ādityāt prāpyate bhogaḥ subhago nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nikṣubhārkasaptamīvratam |
sumatur uvāca |
yā tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu saptamyāṃ niyatā vratacāriṇī |
varṣam ekaṃ tu kṛtvaivaṃ mahālokajigīṣayā ||
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā nikṣubhārkātiviśrutām |
nikṣubhārkarūpanimāṇaṃ niyatavratoktaṃ veditavyam |
snānādyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kṛtvā nikṣubhārketi viśrutam |
pūrvoktāṃl labhate kāmān pūrvoktān labhate guṇān ||
jāmbūnadamayair yānaiḥ svargena ramate ciram |
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ nikhilaṃ vindate phalam ||
saurādisarvalokeṣi bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān |
kramād (?) āgatya loke ‘smin rājānaṃ patim āpnuyāt ||
[677] iti prathamam |
yā nāry upavased evaṃ kṛṣṇām ekāṃ tu saptamīm |
sā gacchet paramaṃ sthānaṃ bhānor amitatejasaḥ ||
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā śālipiṣṭamayīṃ subhām |
pītānulepanair mālyaiḥ pītavastraiḥ prapūjayet ||
pūrvoktaṃ nikhilaṃ kṛtvā bhāskarāya nivedayet |
sarvabhūmau mahīpālo dhātucāmīkaraprabhaḥ ||
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate |
saurādisarvalokeṣu bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān ||
kramād āgatya loke ‘smin janeśaṃ vindate patim |
kulīnaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam ||
iti dvitīyam |
saptamyāṃ yā nirāhārā bhaved abdaniyantritā |
gajaṃ piṣṭāmayaṃ kṛtvā varṣānte vinivedayet ||
vidhāya rājataṃ padmaṃ suvarṇakṛtakarṇikam |
bhaktyā vinyasya tatpṛṣṭhe sarvaṃ pūrvavad ācaret ||
kāmato ‘pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyādi yad bhavet |
tat sarvaṃ gajadānena kṣīyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
mahāpadmavimānena naro nārāyaṇānvitaḥ |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ pūrṇaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
saurādisaptalokeṣu bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān |
[678] kramād āgatya loke ‘smin janeśaṃ vindate patim ||
kulīnaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam ||
mahotsāhaṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahāsandhaṃ mahābalam ||
iti tṛtīyam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya saptamyāṃ yā dṛḍhavratā |
varṣaikam upavāsena sarvabhogavivarjitā ||
varṣānte sarvagandhotthaṃ nikṣubhārkaṃ nivedayet |
suvarṇamaṇimukāḍhyaṃ bhojayitvā dvijottamam ||
itihāsavidam prājñaṃ vācakaṃ bhāryayā saha |
suvicitrair mahāyānair divyagandharvaśobhitaiḥ ||
krīḍed yugaśataṃ sārdhaṃ sūryaloke narādhipa |
prabhayā sūryaśaṅkāśas tejasā harisaṃnibhaḥ ||
yatheṣṭaṃ mānave loke bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān |
kramād agatya loke ‘smin rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute rājan vrataṃ pāpabhayāpaham |
nikṣubhārkam idaṃ puṇyaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
varṣam ekaṃ mahābāho śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ |
varṣāṇte bhojayed vīra vācakaṃ bhāryayā saha ||
bhojayitvā tu dāmpatyaṃ mahābhāratavācakam |
pūjayed gandhamālyaś ca vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā ||
[679] kṛtvā tāmramaye pātre vajrapūrṇeṣv alaṃkṛte |
nikṣubhārkaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ dadyāt tābhyāṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
nikṣubhā bhrāmaṇī jñeyā vācako ‘rkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nikṣubhārkacatuṣṭayam |
saptāśvatilaka uvāca |
vainateya śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ vidhānaṃ saptamīvratam |
etad dhi paramaṃ guhyaṃ raver ārādhanaṃ param ||
siddhārthakais tu prathamā dvitīyā cārkasaṃpuṭaiḥ |
tṛtīyā maricaiḥ kāryā caturthī nimbasaptamī ||
ṣaṭyutā pañcamī kāryā ṣaṣṭhī ca phalasaptamī |
saptamy nodanā vīra saptamī parikīrtitā ||
ṣaṭyutā iti siddhārthakādiṣaḍbhiḥ prakārair yutā |
ity etāḥ saptasaptamyaḥ kartavyā bhūtim icchatā |
tathā cānukrameṇāsaṅkaraṇaṃ kathayāmy aham ||
māghe vā mārgaśīrṣe vā kāryā śuklā tu saptamī |
na ca ssyān niyamabhraṃśaḥ pakṣamāsakṛto bhavet ||
ārtivaśād anyasmin māse pakṣe ca kāryety arthaḥ |
ardhapraharaśeṣe tu kuryād vai dantadhāvanam |
ardhapraharaśeṣe pūrvaṃ dine ‘vaśiṣṭārdhaprahare |
[680] tatraiva dantakāṣṭhānāṃ phalaṃ tava vadāmy aham ||
madhuke putralābhaḥ syād rājavṛkṣāj jayaṃ labhet |
gurutāṃ yāti sarvatra āḍharūpakasaṃbhave ||
aśokena viśokaḥ syād aśvatthavadare yaśaḥ |
śriyaṃ prāpnoti vipulāṃ śirīṣasya niṣevaṇāt ||
priyaṅguṃ sevamānasya saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ bhavet |
abhīpsitārthasiddhiḥ syān nityaṃ plakṣaniṣevaṇāt ||
badaryāṃ ca bṛhatyāṃ ca kṣipraṃ rogāt pramucyate |
bṛhatī ḍorako |
aiśvaryaṃ ca bhaved viṇve khadire dhanasaṃcayaḥ |
śatrukṣayaṃ kadambe ca arthalābho ‘timuktake ||
atimuktaḥ kārāṅgudī |
cūtena nṛpavaśyaṃ syāt saubhāgyaṃ panasena tu |
āyuḥ syāt paṅkajaṃ caiva arthalābho ‘vimuktaye ||
avimuktaḥ rāpaśālaḥ |
na pāṭhitaṃ samaśnīyād dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca savraṇam |
na cārdhaśuṣkaṃ sukraṃ vā na caiva tvagnivarjitam ||
vitastimātram aśnīyād dīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ vivarjayet |
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā sukāsīno ‘tha vāgyataḥ ||
[681] kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā samabhimantrya ca |
mantreṇānena matimān aśnīyād dantadhāvanam ||
varaṃ datvābhijānāmi kāmadaṃ ca vanaspate |
siddhiṃ prayaccha me nityaṃ dantakāṣṭha namo ‘stu te ||
trīn tathā parijapyaiva bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam |
paścāt prakṣālya tat kāṣṭhaṃ śucau deśe vinikṣipet ||
ūrdhe nipatite siddhis tathā vābhimukhasthite |
atho ‘nyathā nipatite ānīya punar utsṛjet ||
punas tathā nipatitaṃ tad yathā dantadhāvanam |
asiddhiṃ tu vijānīyān na grāhyā sā tu saptamī ||
brahmacārī tu tāṃ rātriṃ svapyān maṅgalyasevayā |
bibhrad vāso ‘nupahataṃ śucir ācārasaṃyutaḥ ||
tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prātar utthāya vai khaga |
prakṣālayen mukhaṃ dhīmān aśnīyād dantadhāvanam ||
upaviśya śucir bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā ravim |
japaṃ yatheṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā tu juhuyāc ca hutāśanam ||
tato ‘parāhnasamaye snātvā śṛṅgodbhavāmbubhiḥ |
vidhipūrvam upaspṛśya maunī śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ ||
pūjayitvā tu vidhinā bhaktyā devaṃ divākaram |
svaped devasya purato gāyatrījapatatparaḥ ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yair yair yat phalam ādiśet |
svapnair dṛṣṭais tu saptamyāṃ puruṣo niyatavrataḥ ||
[682] samāpya vidhivat sarvāñ japahomādikāṃ kriyām |
bhūmau śayyāṃ samāsthāya devadevaṃ vicintayet ||
atra supto yadi naraḥ paśyed udyaddivākaram |
śakradhvajaṃ vā candraṃ vā tasya sarvāḥ samṛddhayaḥ ||
vṛṣabhaṃ gajagovatsavīṇāṃ lokān anāmayān |
śṛṅgāram amalādarśaṃ karakāptau sukhotsavaḥ ||
rudhirasya śrutiḥ sekaḥ paramaiśvaryakārakaḥ |
saptavṛkṣādhirohaś ca kṣipram aiśvaryam āvahet ||
dohane mahiṣīṃ siddhīṃ godhenūnāṃ kariśvakaḥ |
gandharvānāṃ rājyalābho lābhas tu dyumaṇer gatiḥ ||
abhipatya svayaṃ khādet siṃhaṃ gāṃ bujagān api |
svāṅgam asthi hutāśambā surāpānaṃ tathā khaga ||
haime vā rājate cāpi yo bhuṅkte pāyasaṃ naraḥ |
pātre tu padmapātre vā tasyaiśvaryaṃ paraṃ bhavet ||
dyūte cāpi ca vāde vā vijayo hi mukhāvahaḥ |
gātrasya ca prajvalanaṃ śirovedhaś ca bhūtaye ||
mālyāmbarāṇāṃ śuklānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ paśupakṣiṇām |
sadālābhaṃ praśaṃsanti tathā viṣṭhānulepanam ||
hayayāne bhavet kṣemaṃ rathayāne prajāgamaḥ |
nānāśirobhakṣaṇāc ca hastasthāṃ kurute śriyam ||
agamyāgamanaṃ labdhaṃ vedādhyayanam uttamam |
