devā dvijavarā vīrā guruvṛddhatapasvinaḥ ||
yad vadanti naraṃ svapne satyam eveti tad viduḥ |
[683] praśastaṃ darśanaṃ teṣām āśīrvādaḥ khagādhipa ||
rājyaṃ syāt svaśiraḥcchede dhanaṃ bahutaraṃ bhavet |
rudite bhakṣyasaṃprāptau rājyaṃ nigaḍabandhanaiḥ ||
parvataṃ turagaṃ siṃhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ gajam eva his |
mahad aiśvaryam āpnoti vimānaṃ yo ‘dhirohati ||
grasamānā grahās tārā mahīṃ ca parivartayet |
unmūlayaṇ sarvatāṃś ca rājā bhavati bhūtale ||
dehalīkrāntaratnānāṃ veṣṭanaṃ ca khagādhipa |
yānaṃ cāmbudhiṃ vāpi tīrtvā pāraṃ prayāti yaḥ ||
tasmai phalaṃ bhaved vīraḥ sakalaṃ kamalopamam |
adriṃ laṅghayataś cāpi bhavaty artho jayas tathā ||
māṃsam āmaṃ tathā viṣṭhāṃ phalaṃ nānāvidhaṃ khaga |
bhavaty arthāgamaḥ śīghraṃ kṛmir vā yadi bhakṣayet ||
aṅganānāṃ kurūpāṇāṃ lābho dharśanam eva ca |
saṃyogaś caiva māṅgalyair ārogyaṃ dhanam eva ca |
aiśvaryaṃ rājyalābho vā yasmin svapta udāhṛtam ||
tatra syān nātra saṃdehas tair tair dṛṣṭair vihaṃgama |
dṛṣṭvā tu śobhanaṃ svapnaṃ na bhūyaḥ śayanaṃ vrajet ||
prātaś ca kīrtayet svapnaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ khagādhipa |
prājñe bhojakaviprebhyaḥ suhṛdāṃ devatāsu vā ||

durgandhaṃ yac ca kad uktam atyamlaṃ bhāskarasya ca ||
vimiśrāṃs tadulāṃś [taṇḍulāṃś?] cāpi no dadyād bhāskarāya vai |
itthaṃ bhojya dvijān sarvān bhakṣayet sarvasaṃpuṭam ||
praṇamya śirasā devam udakena samanvitaḥ |
niṣkramya nagarād rājan gatvā pūrvottarāṃ diśam ||
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ śucau deśe ‘rkam uttamam |
jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāho pūjayitvā kakholkataḥ ||
khakholkata iti khakholkamantreṇa | tad yathā khakholkāya namaḥ iti pūrvottaragatāyāṃ vai tasya sābhibhūmīyāyāṃ śākhāyām [695] agragate patre susūkṣmapallavāśrite saṃśliṣṭe pṛthagbhūte gṛhītvā gṛham āvrajet | dvivacanaprayogāt patradvayāyatanaṃ pratīyate |
snātaḥ pūjya vivasvantam arkapuṣpaiḥ khakholkataḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu arko me prīyatām iti ||
prāśya mantreṇārkapuṭaṃ tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
devasya purato vīra āspṛśan daśanaiḥ puṭam ||
oṃ arkaṃ saṃputābhadraṃ te subhadraṃ me stuvai sadā |
mamāpi kuru bhadraṃ vai prāśanād vittado bhava ||
imaṃ mantraṃ japed rājan japann arkaṃ mahīpate |
sthitvā pūrvamukhaḥ prahvo vāriṇā sahitaṃ nṛpa ||
prāśya bhuṅkte ca yo rājan sa yāti paramaṃ padam |
anena vidhinā bhaktyā kartavyā saptamī sadā ||
varṣaṃ yāvan mahābāho prītaye ‘rkasya śraddhayā |
yaś cemāṃ (?) saptamīṃ kuryād bhāskaraprītaye nṛpaḥ ||
tasyākṣayaṃ bhaved vittam acalaṃ prāptapauruṣam |
kṛtvemāṃ siddhim āyātaḥ kauthumiḥ sāmagaḥ purā ||
kuṣṭharogāc ca vai mukto japan sāma māhāmatiḥ |
bṛhadvalko ‘tha janako yājñavalkyo ‘tha kṛṣṇaja||
kṛṣṇajaḥ śāmbaḥ |
anayā hy arkam ārādhyāgataurkasātmanāṃ nṛpa |
iyaṃ dhanyatamā puṇyā saptamī pāpanāśinī ||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan kurvatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
[696] tasmād eṣā sadā kāryā vidhivac chreyase nṛpa ||
arkapriyā mahābāho mahpātakanāśinī ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktārkasaṃpuṭasaptamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
tathā saṃpūjya deveśaṃ bhānuṃ kāmapradaṃ nṛpa |
bhojayitvā yathāśakti brāḥmaṇāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
saptamyāṃ prāśayec cāpi marīcaṃ manujādhipaḥ |
gṛhītvā marīcaśatam avraṇaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ param ||
marīcaṃ prāśayed rājan mantreṇānena vāspṛśan ||
oṃ khakholkāya svāhā |
prīyatāṃ priyasaṃgado bhava svāhā |
iti samprārthya marīcaṃ tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
priyasaṅgamam āpnoti tatkṣaṇād eva nānyathā ||
itīyaṃ saptamī puṇyā priyasṅgam adāyinī |
yaḥ kuryād utsavaṃ vīra viyogaṃ sa na gacchati ||
putrādibhir naraśreṣṭha prajāpatir abhāṣata |
kuru tasmān mahābāho tām etāṃ priyadāyinīm ||
upoṣya indro vidhivat purā māricasaptamīm |
saṃyogaṃ gatavān vīra sahasrāṃś cādhipaḥ purā ||
rāmapatryānalasyāpi damayantyā sahāpi ca |
rāmo ‘pi sītayā sārdhaṃ upoṣyaitāṃ narādhipa ||

oṃ khaṅkolyāya namaḥ | mūlamantraḥ vidi viva śiraḥ | śrī jvala ṭhaṭha śikhā | oṃ sahasradhāmneva kavaram | oṃ sarvatejo’dhipataye astrāḥ sahasrakiraṇojvalāya vavajaghanaṃ oṃ bhūtabhavye bhūtabhāvinyai vava bhūtavandhaḥ | oṃ jvala netra jvala prajvalata ṭhaṭha agniprakāraḥ | oṃ ādityāya vidmahe viśvabhāvāya dhīmahi tan naḥ sūryaḥ pracodayāt | gāyatrī sakalīkaraṇam idam | oṃ dharmātmane namaḥ pūrvataḥ | yamāya namaḥ dakṣiṇataḥ | oṃ kāladaṇḍanāyakāya namaḥ paścimataḥ | oṃ raivatāy anamaḥ| oṃ uttarataḥ |

oṃ budhāya somaputrāya namaḥ dakṣiṇe | oṃ namo vāgīśvarāya sarvavidyādhipataye naiṛtyāṃ | oṃ śukrāya maharṣaye bhṛtusutāya namaḥ paścimataḥ | oṃ śanaiśvarāya ravisutāya namo vāyavyām | oṃ rāhave namaḥ uttarataḥ | ketave nama īśānyām | bhagavann aparimitamayūkhamālin sakalajagatpate saptāśvavāhanacaturbhujaparamasiddhipradaṃ viṣphuliṅgavāvo ehy ehi idam arghaṃ mama śirasi gataṃ gṛhāṇ tejo'gratūpa anantajvalana ṭhaṭhaḥ |
arghyāvāhanamantraḥ |

ācāryo vidhivad rājan mantrapūtena vāriṇā |

aiśānyāṃ śira saṃsthāpya nairṛtyāṃ vinyasec chivam |
paurandaryāṃ nyaset padmam ekāgrasthitim ātmanaḥ ||
aiśānyāṃ sthāpayet somaṃ pauradaṃ cātiohitam |
vāyavyāṃ caiva kavacaṃ vāruṇyām astram eva ca ||
āgneyyāṃ somatanayaṃyāmyāṃ caiva bṛhaspatim |
nairṛtyāṃ dānavaguruṃ vāruṇyāṃ tu śanaiśvaram ||
vāyavyāñ ca tathā rāhuṃ kauveryāṃ ketum eva ca |
dvitīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāṃ devatejaḥsamudbhavān ||
sthāpayed dvādaśādityān kāśyaveyān mahābalān |
bhagaḥ sūryo ‘ryamā caiva mitro vai varuṇas tathā ||
savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvaṃś ca mahābalaḥ |

jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī vāparājitā |

kharjūraṃ nārikelaṃ ca mātulaṅgaphalāni ca ||

mantreṇa bharataśreṣṭha tataḥ śeṣāṇi bhakṣayet |

ākaṇṭhaṃ tat kuruśreṣṭha na cānyat kiṃcid eva hi |
phalāhāro bhaved evam aṣṭamyāṃ kurunandana ||
iti saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat kartavyā phalasaptamī |

iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ phalasaptamīvratam |

oṃ prajvatane svāhā | oṃ agniprakāraḥ | oṃ namaḥ sahasrakiraṇojvalāya (?) svāhā | oṃ yaṃ vaḥ | oṃ pṛthivyai sarvopadhiruṣiṇyai (?) svāhā | pṛthivyas tvaṃ namaḥ sakalīkaraṇamantraḥ | ātmano devaśarīre vā oṃ dharmātmane namaḥ pūrvataḥ | oṃ dharmāya namo dakṣiṇataḥ | oṃ revantāya namaḥ paścimataḥ | oṃ satatajjvālārūpāya namaḥ uttarataḥ | oṃ śyāmapiṅgalohitāya namaḥ [703] aiśānyām | nīlalohitāya namaḥ āgneyyām | īśāneśvarāya namo nairṛtyām | vajrapāṇaye namo vāyavyām | oṃ namo haradehāya mahābalaparākramāya sarvatejo’dhipataye svāhā |
uttaraśaktidharāya namaḥ |

sumantur uvāca |

anye ca rogāḥ śāmyanti paṭhataḥ śṛṇvatas tathā |

dharmārthibhir dharmalabdhai sukhāya ca sukhārthibhiḥ || 12 ||

vidyāvahaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ jayāvaham || 13 ||
paśvāvahaṃ tu vaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ dharmavardhanam |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatām etad bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||

oṃ viśvavid viśvajit kartā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ |
viśveśvarī viśvayonir niyatātmā jitendriyaḥ || 16 ||
kālāśrayaḥ kālakartā kāmahā kāmanāśanaḥ |
mahāyogī mahābuddhir mahātmā sumahābalaḥ || 17 ||
prabhur vibhūr (?) bhūtanātho bhūtātmā bhuvaneśvarah |
bhūtabhavyabhāvitātmā bhūtāntakaraṇaḥ śivaḥ || 18 ||
śaraṇyaḥ kamalānando nandano nandivardhanaḥ |
varaṇo varado yogī susaṃyuktaḥ prakāśanaḥ || 19 ||
prāptayānaḥ paraḥ prāṇaḥ prītātmā prayataḥ priyaḥ |
sahasrapāt suṣṭhusādhur divyakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ || 20 ||
avyaṅgadhārī dhīrātmā savitā vāyuvāhanaḥ |
samāhitamatir dhātā vidhātā kṛtamaṅgalaḥ || 21 ||
kapardī kalpakṛd rudraḥ sumetā dharmavatsalaḥ |

homārcanaprāśanāni śatenāṣṭottareṇa ca ||
homaḥ sājyatilaḥ kāryaḥ prāśanam candanodakam |
pūjāṃ tatkālasaṃbhūtaiḥ supuṣpaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ ||
evaṃ pūrṇe vrate paścāt suvarṇena ghaṭāyitam |
svaśaktyā bhāskaraṃ pārtha rukmapātram upasthitam ||
ādityarūpanirmāṇaṃ (?) tu nikṣubhārkasaptamīvratoktaṃ veditavyam |
kaṣāyavāsasā yuktāṃ gāṃ ca dadyāt sadakṣiṇām |
mantreṇānena viprāya vācakāya guṇānvite ||
bhāskareṇa namas tubhyaṃ yaśaskara namo ‘stu te |
[720] śreyaskara prasīda tvaṃ vāñchitaṃ dehi me vibho ||
dānāny atra pradeyāni gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca |
śraddayā śraddhayā pārtha śāśvatīṃ prītim icchatā ||
yātrā praśaṃsyā yātṝṇāṃ rājñāṃ vijayam icchatām |
vijayī jāyate ‘vaśyaṃ gatānāṃ tu nṛṇāṃ tadā ||
ato ‘rthaṃ viśrutā pārtha loke vijayasaptamī |
evam eṣā tithiḥ sadyaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradā ||
iha vāmutra phaladā sūryalokapradāyinī |
tadanuṣṭhānato vidvān dīrghāyur nīrujaḥ sukhī ||
ihāgatya bhaved rājā hastyaśvarathasaṃkulaḥ |
nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatphalabhāginī ||
nityaṃ mahītalajayapratipādayitrī
yā saptamī munivaraiḥ pravarā tithīnām |
sā bhānupādakamalārcanacintakānām
puṃsāṃ sadaiva vijayā vijayaṃ dadāti ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottaroktaṃ vijayasaptamīvratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
athānyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi saptamīkalpam uttamam |
māghamāsāt samārabhya śuklapakṣe yudhiṣṭhira ||
saptamyāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpo varṣam ekaṃ vratī bhavet |
[721] varuṇaṃ māghamāse tu bhānuṃ saṃpūjya kārayet ||
brahmakūrcavidhānena yathāśaktyā nṛpottama |
aṣṭamyāṃ bhojayed viprān tilapiṣṭaguḍodanaiḥ ||
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ kṛtsnam avāpyate |
tapanaṃ phālgune māsi sūryam ity abhipūjayet ||
vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti durlabham |
saptamyāṃ caitramāse tu vedāṃśur iti pūjayet ||
uñchādhvarasamaṃ puṇyaṃ naraḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
vaiśākhasya tu saptamyāṃ dhātā ity abhipūjayet ||
paśubandhādhvaraṃ puṇyaṃ samyak prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
saptamyāṃ jyaiṣṭhamāsasya indram ity abhipūjayet ||
aśvamedhaphlāvaptir jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tathāṣāḍhasya saptamyāṃ pūjayitvā divākaram ||
bahusvarṇasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam |
śrāvaṇe māsi saptamyām ātapānāṃ prapūjayet ||
sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ pārtha naraḥ prāpnoti bhaktitaḥ |
raviṃ bhādrapade māsi saptamyām arcayec chuciḥ ||
tulāpuruṣadānasya guḍena phalam āpnuyāt |
aśvayuk suklasaptamyāṃ savitāraṃ prapūjayet ||
gosahasrapradānasya phalam āpnoti bhaktitaḥ |
[722] kārttike śuklasaptamyāṃ saptāśvaṃ nāma pūjayet ||
yo ‘bhyarcayati puṇyātmā pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet |
mārgaśīrṣe tathā bhānuṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalam āpnoti vai naraḥ |
bhāskaraṃ puṣyamāse tu pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
caturṇām api vedānāṃ svādhyāyasya phalaṃ labhet |
tathaiva kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ nāmapūjādikaṃ tu yaḥ ||
sopavāsaḥ prayatnena varṣam ekaṃ samācaret |
pārite niyame pārtha sūryayāgaṃ samārabhet ||
śuddhabhūmau same deśe (?) raktacandanalepite |
ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastam athāpi vā ||
sindūreṇātirāgeṇa sūryamaṇḍalam ālikhet |
raktapuṣpaiś ca padmaiś ca dhūpaiḥ kundurukādibhiḥ ||
saṃpūjya dadyān naivedyaṃ vicitraṃ ghṛtapācitam |
purataḥ sthāpayet kumbhān jalapūrṇān sadakṣiṇām ||
dvādaśātra nṛpaśreṣṭha raktavarṇān sucarcitān |
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ samyak-hutahutāśanaḥ ||
ākṛṣṇeneti mantreṇa samidbhiś cārkavṛkṣajaiḥ |
tilair ājyaguḍopetair dadyād aṣṭaśatāhutīḥ ||
dakṣiṇā ca tato deyā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
[723] deyāni raktavāsāṃsu śānāṃ dvijadvādanmanām (?) ||
dvādaśātra praśaṃsanti gāvo vastravibhūṣitāḥ |
chatropanadyugaṃ caivam ekaikāya pradāpayet ||
vittahīno na śaknoti dānaṃ dvādaśdhenukam |
ekā hy api suśīlā ca raktavarṇā payasvinī ||
upadeṣṭre pradātavyā vittaśāḍhyam akurvataḥ |
tato visṛjya tān viprān svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha saptamīvratam ādarāt |
nirujo rūpavān vāgmī dīrghāyuś caiva jāyate ||
vimukto dīrgharogaiś ca grastaḥ kuṣṭādinā tu yaḥ |
tena kāryaṃ prayatnena vratam etad rujāpaham ||
nehāsti bhāskarād anyad auṣadhaṃ rogahānidam |
bhāskaraikagatir yas tu sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ||
tasya saṃdarśanasparśād rogahāniḥ prajāyate |
kathaṃ vā sūryabhaktānāṃ rogadairgatyasaṃbhavaḥ ||
jāyate bharataśreṣṭha pratyakṣe parameṣṭhinam |
saptamyāṃ pratimāsaṃ tu janmavratacaro hi yaḥ ||
upavāsī raver bhaktaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ viprasahito haviṣyaṃ bhojayen naraḥ ||
ekādaśasamā yasya divyarūpā ca saptamī |
sūryasya maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā yāti brahma sanātanam ||
vratam etan mahārāja sarvāśubhavināśanam |
[724] sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ śarīrārogyadāyakam ||
sūryalokapradaṃ cānte prāhedaṃ nārado muniḥ ||
ye saptamīm upavasanti sitāsitāṃ ca
nāmākṣarair amitadīdhitim arcayanti |
ye sarvarogarahitā sukhinaḥ sadaite
bhūtvā raver anucarā suciraṃ vasanti ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ dvādaśasaptamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
yaḥ kṣiped gomayāhāraḥ śuklāḥ dvādaśasaptamīḥ |
rājendra yācakāhāraḥ śīrṇaparṇāśano ‘pi vā ||
kṣīrāśī vaikabhakto vā bhikṣāhāro ‘tha vā punaḥ |
jalāhāro ‘tha vā bhūtvā pūjayitvā divākaram ||
puṣpopahārair vividhaiḥ padmasaugandhikotpalaiḥ |
nānāprakārair gandhais tu dhūpair guggulacandanaiḥ ||
śarkarāpayasādyaiś ca vicitraiś ca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
arcayitvā naraśreṣṭha hiraṇyānnādibhir naraḥ ||
yathoktaphalam āpnoti kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
tad atra prāpyate vīra saptamyāṃ kevalaṃ raveḥ ||
vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate |
[725] tataḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ rājan kule mahati jāyate ||
evaṃ bhaktyā vivasvantaṃ pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ |
pūjayed vidhivad bhaktyā nāmāny etāni kīrtayet ||
maghau māse viṣṇur iti mādhave cāryameti ca |
śukre vivasvān māse ca śucau māse divākaraḥ ||
parjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi nabhasye taraṇis tathā |
mitraś cāśvayuje māsi kīrtanīyo divākaraḥ ||
mārtaṇḍeti ravir jñeyaḥ kārttike kāñcanaprabhaḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe raviḥ proktaḥ sarvapāpavināśanaḥ ||
puṣyamāse ca pūṣeti vijñeyaḥ kāñcanaprabhaḥ |
māghe bhagaś ca vijñeyaḥ tvaṣṭā vai vātha phālgune ||
evaṃ krameṇa nāmāni kīrtayet prītaye raveḥ |
dhūpārcanavidhānaṃ tu saptamyāṃ tu vidhānataḥ ||
yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
tejasā harisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā ravisaṃnibhaḥ ||
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ śṛṇu tat pāpanāśanam |
na vadec ca hy aśiṣyāya nābhaktāya kadācana ||
na ca pāpakṛte deyaṃ nātaptatapse ‘pi ca |
na kṛṣṇenāstike vīra na deyaṃ krūrakarmaṇe ||
[726]
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ (?) gomayādisaptamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
udakaprabhṛtiṃ pītvā kriyate yā tu saptamī |
sā jñeyā sukhadā vīra sadaivodakasaptamī ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam udakasaptamīvratam |
yā kācit saptamī proktā tato vakṣyāmi śobhanam |
varāṭikātrayakrītaṃ yat kiṃcit prāśayen naraḥ ||
anena dehī mūlyena yal labdhaṃ tac ca bhakṣayet |
abhakṣyaṃ vāpi bhakṣyaṃ vā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā (?) |
anena vidhinā kāryā varākāhvayasaptamī ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktavarāṭikāsaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyā nāma saptamī |
pavitrā hi pavitrāṇāṃ mahāpātakanāśinī ||
saptamī kṛtamātreyaṃ naras tārayate bhavāt |
saptāparān saptapūrvān pitṝṃś cāpi na saṃśayaḥ ||
rogāṃś chinatti duścedyān durjayān jayate ripūn |
arghaṃ prāpnoti duḥprāpyaṃ sakṛt kṛtvāpi saptamīm ||
[727] kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam |
putrārthī labhate putrān dharmārthī dharmam āpnuyāt ||
samayān pālayan sarvān kuryāc cemāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
śṛṇuyāt śṛṇu bhūteśa śreyase gadato mama ||
ādityabhaktaḥ puruṣaḥ saptamyāṃ gaṇanāyakam |
maitrī sarvatra vai kuryād bhāskaraṃ vāpi cintayet ||
saptamyāṃ na spṛśet tailaṃ nīlavastraṃ na dhārayet |
na ca vāmalake snānaṃ na kuryāt kalahaṃ kvacit ||
tathaivānnamalaṃ madyaṃ na dadyān na pibed budhaḥ |
na drohaṃ kasyacit kuryān na pāruṣyaṃ samācaret ||
na ca bhāṣeta cāṇḍālaṃ vacanaiḥ strīṃ rajasvlām |
sa cāpi saṃspṛśet sthānaṃ mṛtakaṃ nāvalokayet ||
na nṛtyed atirāgeṇa na ca vādyāni vādayet |
na svapec ca striyā svārdhaṃ (sārdhaṃ?) na seveta durodaram ||
na roded asrupātena na cādyāt pañcaśākikam |
pañcaśākikaṃ kandamūlaphaladalapuṣpāṇi pañcaśākāni |
nākarṣec ca śiroyūkān na vṛthā vādam ācaret |
parasyāniṣṭakathanam atiśokaṃ vivarjayet ||
nāsphoṭayec cāpi hased gāyec cāpi na gītakam |
na kiṃcit tāḍayej jantuṃ na kuryād atibhojanam ||
na caiva hi divāsvapnaṃ dambhaṃ śāṭhyaṃ ca varjayet |
rathyāyam aṭanaṃ cāpi yatnataḥ parivarjayet ||
[728] athāparo vidhiś cātra śrūyatāṃ tripurāntaka |
caitrāt prabhṛti kartavyā sarvadā nāma saptamī ||
dhāteti madhumāse tu pūjanīyo divākaraḥ |
aryameti ca vaiśākhe jyaiṣṭhe mitraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
āṣāḍhe varuṇo jñeya indro nabhasi kathyate |
vivasvāṃś ca nabhasye tu parjanyo ‘śvayuji smṛtaḥ ||
pūṣā kārtikamāse ca mārgaśīrṣe tu kathyate |
bhagaḥ pauṣe vivasvāṃś ca tvaṣṭā māghe tu kathyate ||
viṣṇus tu phālgune māsi pūjyo vandyaś ca bhāskaraḥ |
saptamyāṃ caiva saptamyāṃ bhojayed bhojakān budhaḥ ||
saghṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ deyaṃ bhojayitvā vidhānataḥ |
bhojakāya pradeyā tu dakṣiṇā svarṇamāṣakam ||
saghṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ deyaṃ raktavastrāṇi caiva hi |
alābhe bhojakānāṃ tu dakṣaṇīyā dvijottama ||
tathaiva bhojanīyāś ca śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ |
viśeṣataḥ pūjanīyāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ kalpacit sadā ||
ity etā kathitā tubhyaṃ saptamī gaṇanāyaka |
śrutā satī pāpaharā sūryalokapradāyinī ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nāma saptamīvratam |
pitāmaha uvāca |
phālgunāmalapakṣasya saptamyāṃ ca ghanāghana |
[729] upoṣitā naro nārī samabhyarcya tamopaham ||
sūryanāma japan bhaktyā bhāvayukto jitendriyaḥ |
uttiṣṭhann upaviśaṃś caiva sūryam evānukīrtayet ||
tato ‘nyadivase prāpte aṣṭamyāṃ niyato ravim |
snātvā samyak samabhyarcya dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām ||
ravim uddiśya caivāgnau kṛtahomaḥ kṛtakriyaḥ |
praṇipatya raviṃ devam iti vākyam udīrayet ||
yam ārādhya purā devā sāvitrī kāmam āpa vai |
sa me dadātu deveśaḥ sarvān kāmān vibhāvasūḥ ||
samabhyarcya ditiḥ prāptā kṛtsnān kāmān yathepsitān |
dadātu sakalān kāmān prasanno me divaspatiḥ ||
bhraṣṭarājyaḥ sa devendro samabhyarcya divākaram |
kāmārtham āptavān rājyaṃ sa me kāmān prayacchatu ||
evam abhyarcya pūjāṃ ca niṣpādyeha viśeṣataḥ |
bhuñjīta ca tataḥ samyak haviṣyaṃ patagadhvaja ||
phālgune caitravaiśākhe jyaiṣṭham antyaṃ tathā param |
caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsair ebhir niṣpādya saṃbhavet ||
karavīraiś caturo māsān tathā saṃpūjayed ravim |
kṛṣṇāguruṃ dahed dhūpaṃ prāśya gośṛṅgajaṃ jalam ||
naivedyaṃ khaṇḍaveṣṭāṃś ca dadyād viprebhya eva ca |
tanas tu śrūyatām anyac cāṣāḍhādiṣu yā kriyā ||
jātīpuṣpāṇi śastāni dhūpo guggulur ucyate |
[730] kutapodakam aśnīyān naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ matam ||
svayṃ tad eva cāśnīyāt śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret |
kutapodakaṃ kuśodakam |
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam |
mahāṅgaṃ dhūpam uddiṣṭaṃ pūjāraktotpalais tathā ||
mahāṅgadhūpo bhaviṣyatpurāṇa ukto tathā |
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ mustām aguruṃ sihlakaṃ tathā |
vyajanaṃ śarkarā kṛṣṇa mahāṅgaṃ sihlkaṃ tathā |
mahāṅgo ‘yaṃ smṛto dhūpaḥ priyo devasya sarvadā ||
kutapodakam aśnīyān naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ matam |
kāsāraṃ caiva naivedyaṃ pradadyād bhāskarāya vai |
pratimāsaṃ ca viprāya dadyāc chaktyā tu dakṣiṇām ||
prīṇanaṃ svecchayā bhānoḥ pāraṇaṃ pāraṇe gate |
yathāśakti yathāyogaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||
sadbhāvenaiva saptāśvaḥ pūjitaḥ prītaye mataḥ |
pāraṇānte yathāśaktyā pūjitaḥ snāpito raviḥ ||
prīṇītaś cepsitān kāmān dadyād avyāhatān raviḥ |
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā saptamī sarvakāmadā ||
yathābhilaṣitān kāmān dadāti garuḍadhvaja |
aputraḥ putram āpnoti adhano dhanam āpnuyāt ||
rogābhibhūtaś cārogyaṃ kanyā vindati satpatim |
samāgamaṃ pravāsebhyaupoṣyaitad avāpnuyāt ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti gogataś cāpi modate |
[731] gogata iti svargataḥ |
punar etya mahīṃ kṛṣṇa dhanādhanasamo nṛpa |
dhanādhanasamaḥ śakratulyaḥ |
kṣmātale syān na samdehaḥ prasādād gopater naraḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ kāmadāsaptamīvratam |
sumantur ucāva |
atha bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe mahāmate |
upoṣyā prathamā tatra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu yad bhavet ||
ayācito caturthyāṃ tu pañcamyām ekabhojanam |
upavāsaparaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ ||
arcayitvā dinakaraṃ gandhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ |
purataḥ sthaṇḍile rātrau svaped devasya putraka ||
pradhyāyan manasā devaṃ sarvabhūtārtināśanam |
sarvadoṣapraśamanaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||
vibuddhas tv atha saptamyāṃ kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam |
pūjayitvā dinakaraṃ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
naivedyaṃ tatra devasya phalāni kathayanti hi |
kharjūraṃ nālikeraṃ ca tathaivāmraphalāni ca ||
mātulaṅgaphalānīha kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ |
bhojajitvā tato viprān ātmanā caiva bhojayet ||
[732] tathaiṣāṃ cāpy abhāve tu śṛṇu vānyāni suvrata |
śāligodhūmapiṣṭena kārayed gaṇanāyakam ||
guḍagarbhakṛtānīha ghṛtagarbhāṇi pācayet |
jātujīrakamiśrāṇi ādityāya nivedayet ||
jātujīrakamiśrāṇi elāpatranāgakeśarāṇi |
śarkarākhādyamiśrāṇi ādityāya nivedayet ||
agnikāryam atho kṛtya brāhmaṇān bhojayt tataḥ |
itthaṃ dvādaś vai māsān kāryaṃ vratam anuttamam ||
māsi māsi phalāhāraḥ phaladāyī bhaven nṛpa |
vratam etat tu kurvīta bhaktyā brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
snānaprāśanayoś cāpi vidhānaṃ śṛṇu suvratam |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ||
tilāḥ sarṣapajaṃ kalkaśvetamṛd vāpi suvrata |
dūrvākalkaghṛtaṃ cāpi gośṛṅgakṣālanaṃ jalam |
jātīgulmaviniryāsaḥ praśastaṃ snānakarmaṇi ||
dūrvākalkaghṛtaṃ dūrvākalkaghṛtayutam | gośṛṅgakṣālanaṃ yena gośṛṅgaṃ kṣālyate | jātīgulmaviniryāsaṃ samūlaśākhajātīpallavm |
prāśane cāpy athaitāni sarvapāpaharāṇi vai |
ādau kṛtvā bhādrapade yathāsaṃkhyaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
itthaṃ varṣāntam āsādya bhojayitvā dvijottamān |
divyān bhaumān mahādeva tatas tebhyo nivedayet ||
[735] devakule bhavā divyā, itare bhaumāḥ |
phalāni cātha haimāni yathāśaktyā kṛtāni tu |
savatsām atha vā dhenuṃ bhūmiṃ śasyānvitām atha |
prāsādam atha vā bhaumaṃ sarvadhānyasamanvitam ||
bhaumaprāsādaṃ rājagṛhatulyaṃ gṛham |
dadyād raktāni vastrāṇi tāmrapātraṃ savidrumam |
śaktiyuktasya caitāni daridrasya ca me śṛṇu ||
phalāni puṣpāṇi ca tathā tilacūrṇāni tāni tu |
bhojayitvā dvijān dadyād rājatāni phalāni ca ||
dhātūraktaṃ vastrayugmam ācāryāya nivedayet |
sahiraṇyaṃ mahādevaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam ||
itthaṃ samāpyate samyag abdānte tāta pāraṇam |
ity eṣā vai puṇyatamā saptamī duritāpahā ||
yām upoṣya narā sarve yānti sūryasaokatām |
pūjyamānāḥ sadā devair gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
anayā mānavo yas tu pūjayed bhāskaraṃ sadā |
dāridryaduḥkhaduritair mukto yāti divākaram ||
brāhmaṇo mokṣam āyāti kṣatriyaś candratāṃ vrajet |
vaiśyo dhanadasālokyaṃ śūdro vipratvam āpnuyāt ||
aputro labhate putraṃ durbhagā subhagā bhavet |
vidhavā yā satī bhaktyā anayā pūjayed ravim ||
[734] nānyajanmani vaidhavyaṃ nārī prāpnoti mānada |
cintāmaṇisamā hy eṣā vijñeyā phalasaptamī |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bhaktyā sarvakāmapradā smṛtā ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ phalasaptamīvratam |
agastya uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade prāpte śuklapakṣe sureśvaraḥ |
saptamyām upavāsena putraprāptipradaṃ vratam ||
ṣaṣṭyāṃ caiva susaṃkalpya saptamyāṃ pūjayed dharim |
hariṃ viṣṇuṃ nāmamantraiḥ pūjā | devair brahmādibhiḥ tadrūpāṇi puṣpābhiṣeke |
devair yamagataṃ devaṃ mātṛbhiḥ parivāritam ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale aṣṭamyāṃ prayato harim |
prāgvidhānena govindaṃ arcayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
prāgvidhānena vaiṣṇavamārgeṇa govindam iti viśeṣeṇa gopālamantreṇa homapūjā |
tasyāgrataḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ saghṛtair homam ācaret |
brāḥmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇām ||
tataḥ svayaṃ tu bhuñjīta prathamaṃ bilvam ekakam |
bilvaprāśane phalasaptamīṣūkto mantraḥ |
paścād yatheṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta snehādyaṃ ṣaḍrasānvitam ||
pratimāsam anenaiva vidhinopoṣya mānavaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīm aputro ‘pi labhet putraṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
[735] vatsarānte ca goyugmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ deyaṃ dvijātaye |
idaṃ putravrataṃ nāma mayā te parikīrtitam ||
etat kṛtvā naraḥ pāpaiḥ sarvair eva pramucyate ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ putrasaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya sarvāptiṃ saptamīṃ śṛṇu |
yām upoṣya samāpnoti sarvān kāmān dharādhara ||
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpam akurvan bhānutatparaḥ |
pūjayet praṇato devam ekāgramatir aṃśugam ||
māghādipāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śucyantakaṃ smṛtam (?) |
śucyantakaṃ āṣāḍhyantikam |
mārtaṇḍaṃ prathamaṃ nāma dvitīyo ‘rkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
tṛtīyaṃ citrabhānuś ca vibhāvasur ataḥ param |
bhageti pañcamo jñeyaḥ ṣaṣṭho haṃsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
pūrveṣu ṣaṭsu samāseṣu snānaprāśanayos tilāḥ |
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu pañcagavyam udāhṛtam ||
snāne ca prāśane caiva praśastaṃ pāpanāśanam |
pratimāsaṃ tu devasya kṛtvā pūjā yathāvidhi ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt śraddadhānaḥ svaśaktitaḥ |
pāraṇānte ca devasya prīṇanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam ||
kurvīta śaktyā vidhivad raviṃ bhaktyā divaspatim |
[736] naktaṃ bhuñjīta vai viṣṇoḥ tailākṣāravivarjitam ||
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyām upoṣyaivaṃ saptamyām atha vā dine |
etām uṣitvā dharmajñaḥ haṃsaprīṇanatatparaḥ ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti yad yad icchati cetasā |
svato lokeṣu vikhyātā sarvāptir iti saptamī ||
kṛtābhilaṣitā hy eṣā prārabdhā karmatatparaiḥ |
pūrayaty akhilān kāmān āśritānām dine dine ||
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ sarvāptisaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu phālgunyāṃ yo yajen naraḥ |
japed balīti devasya nāma bhaktyā punaḥ punaḥ ||
devārcanaṃ vāṣṭaśataṃ kṛtvaivaṃ tu japec chuciḥ |
snātaḥ prasthānakāle tu utthāne skhalite kṣute ||
pāṣaṇḍān patitāṃś caiva tathaivāntyāvaśāyinaḥ |
nālāpayet tathā bhānum arcayec chraddhayānvitaḥ ||
idaṃ coccārayed bhānuṃ manasā dhyānatatparaḥ |
haṃsa haṃsa kṛpālo tvaṃ agatīnāṃ gatir bhava ||
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ trātā bhava divākara |
evaṃ prasādyopavāsaṃ kṛtvā niyatamānasaḥ ||
pūrvāhṇa eva vānyedyuḥ sakṛt prāśyārjunīyakam |
ārjunīyakaṃ sakṛd gomayam |
snātvārcayitvā haṃseti punar nāma prakīrtayet |
[737] vāridhārātrayaṃ caiva nikṣiped devaprādayoḥ ||
caitravaiśākhayoś caiva tadvaj jyeṣṭhe ca pūjayet |
martyaloke gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā prāpnoti vai naraḥ ||
utkrāntaś ca vrajet kṛṣṇa divyahaṃsamayaṃ śubham |
dharmadhvajaprasādād vai saṃkrandanasamo bhavet ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā |
māsi cāśvayuje caivam anena vidhinā naraḥ ||
upoṣya saṃpūjya tathā mārtaṇḍeti ca kīrtayet |
gomūtraprāśanāt sūryapuraṃ gatvā mahīyate ||
ārādhitasya jagatām īśvarasya kṛtātmanaḥ |
uktāntikāle smaraṇaṃ bhāskarasya tathā śrute ||
kṣīrasya prāśane kṛṣṇa vidhir eṣa mayoditaḥ |
kārttikādi yathānyāyaṃ kuryān māsacatuṣṭayam ||
tenaiva vidhinā kṛtvā bhāskareti prakīrtayet |
sa yāti bhānusālokyaṃ bhāskarānuratiḥ kṣaye ||
pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo dadyād dānaṃ yathecchayā |
cāturmāsye tu saṃpūrṇe kuryāt pustakavācanam ||
kathāmbā bhāskarasyeti tatkīrtanam athāpi vā |
dharmaśravaṇam iṣṭaṃ tu sadā dharmadhvajasya ca ||
dharmadhvajaḥ sūryaḥ |
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu tasmāt kāryaṃ ca śraddhayā |
[738] śrāddham annena pakvena homena ca dvijena tu ||
divyena ca tathā śukram abhīṣṭaṃ bhāskarasya hi |
evan ante gatiśreṣṭha devanāmānukīrtayet ||
prāpnoti trividhān kṛṣṇa trilokān mānavaḥ sadā |
kathitaṃ pāraṇaṃ yat te yathemaṃ godharādhara ||
ādhipatyaṃ tathā bhogāṃs tena prāpnoti mānuṣaḥ |
dvitīyena tathā bhogān gotrāreḥ prāpnuyān naraḥ ||
gotrārir indraḥ |
sūryalokaṃ tṛtīyena pāraṇena tathāpnuyāt |
evam etat samākhyātaṃ gatiprāpakam uttamam ||
vidhānaṃ devaśārdūla yad uktaṃ saptamīvratam |
yas tv etāṃ saptamīṃ kuryāt trigatiṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
tathā bhaktyā ca vai nārī prāpnoti trividhāṃ gatim |
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā trigatiḥ samudāhṛtā ||
ārādhanāya śāstreṇa sadā bhānor gatipradā |
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃś caiva sarvapāpabhayāpahā ||
tathā karmasu puṇyeṣu trivargā jyeṣṭhadā sadā |
trivargajyeṣṭhadā dharmāḥ | atra vrate helinām cāturmāsyatrayasādhāraṇyāṃ haṃsamārtaṇḍabhāskaranāmāni prātisvikāni |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ trigatisaptamīvratam |
āditya uvāca |
māghamāse tu śuklāyāṃ saptamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
[739] pūjayed yas tu māṃ bhaktyā tasyāhaṃ prabhutāṃ vrajet ||
samupoṣitaḥ ṣaṣṭhyām |
evaṃ cobhayasaptamyāṃ māsi māsi śurottama |
yas tu māṃ pūjayed bhaktyā svam ekam ekam ādarāt ||
svam ekaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ |
prayacchāmi sutān tasya hy ātmano hy aṅgasaṃbhavān |
vittaṃ yaśas tathā putrān ārogyaparamaṃ sadā ||
māghamāse tu yo brahman śuklapakṣe jitendriyaḥ |
pāṣaṇḍān patitān antyān jalpann avijitendriyaḥ ||
upoṣya vidhivat ṣaṣṭyāṃ śvetamālyavilepanaiḥ |
pūjayitvā tu māṃ bhaktyā niśi bhūmau svaped budhaḥ ||
punar utthāya saptamyāṃ kṛtvā snānādikakriyām |
pūjayitvā tu māṃ vīrahomaṃ brahman samācaret ||
pūjayitvā hariṃ bhaktyā haviṣa padmalocanam |
vīrahomam agnihomaṃ hariviṣṇurūpam |
dadhyodanena payasā pāyasena dvijāṃs tathā |
tasyaiva kṛṣṇapakṣasya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ samyag upoṣitaḥ ||
tasyaiveti māghamāsasya |
raktotpalaiḥ sugandhāḍhyai raktapuṣpais tu pūjayet |
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayed bhaktyā naro māṃ vidhivat sadā ||
ubhayor api devendra sa putraṃ labhate phalam |
[740]
ity ādityapurāṇoktaṃ putrasaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ yadā ṛkṣaṅkaro bhavet |
tadā puṇyatamā proktā saptamī pāpanāśinī ||
karo hastaḥ | ayaṃ hi yogo bahule śrāvaṇe māsi saṃbhavati |
tasyām saṃpūjya deveśaṃ citrabhānuṃ jagadgurum |
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yaś copavāsaṃ kurute tasyāṃ niyatamānasaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
dānaṃ yad dīyate kiṃcit samuddiśya divākaram |
homo vā kriyate tatra tat sarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet ||
ekā ṛgvedapurato japtvā śraddhāpareṇa tu |
ṛgvedasya samas tasya yacchate tat phalaṃ dhruvam ||
sāmavedaphalaṃ sāma yajurvede phalaṃ yajuḥ |
atharvaṇo ‘tharvaṇaś ca nikhilaṃ yac chate phalam ||
yataḥ pāpam aśeṣeṇa nāśayaty atra bhāskaraḥ |
kararkṣā saptamī kṛṣṇā tenoktā pāpanāśinī ||
asyām samabhyarcya raviṃ yāti saumanasaṃ puram |
vimānavaram āruhya karpūrodbhavam uttamam ||
saumanasaṃ puram devalokaṃ karpūraṃ durvarṇam |
tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā kavisaṃnibhaḥ |
[741] kāntyātreyasamaḥ kṛṣṇa śaurye harisamaḥ sadā |
modate tatra suciraṃ vṛndārakagaṇaiḥ saha ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ pāpanāśinīvratam |
brahmovāca |
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ māsi bhādrapade ‘cyuta |
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ pūjayet saptvāhanam ||
puṣpadhūpādibhir vīra kutapānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ |
kutapānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnām |
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpam akurvan niyatātmavān |
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
tiṣṭhan bruvan prasthitaś ca kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu |
ādityanāmasmaraṇaṃ kuryād uccāraṇaṃ tathā ||
anenaiva vidhānena māsān dvādaśa vai kramāt |
upoṣya pāraṇe pūrṇe samabhyarcya jagadgurum ||
puṇyena śravaṇeneha praṇayet puṣṭhim āpnuyāt |
evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kuryād ādityārādhanaṃ śuciḥ ||
nārī vā svargam abhyetya sānantyaṃ phalam aśnute ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam anantaphalasaptamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
śuklapakṣe samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śuciḥ |
[742] śrāvaṇe māsi saptavyāṃ devāgraṃ saptivāhanam ||
prāpyeha vipulaṃ devaṃ dharmānantaram akṣayam |
amutra lokam āyāti divyaṃ khagapateḥ śubham ||
dharmānanta(ta?)ram arthaṃ khagapatir atrādityaḥ |
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpam akurvan niyatātmavān |
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
abhyaṅgaṃ devadevasya varṣe varṣe niyojayet ||
avyaṅgam (?) ekavarṇaḥ śobhanakārpāsasūtranirmitasarpanirmokākṛtir antaḥsucito dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatāṅgulaparimitamadhyamoṣṭottaraśatāṅgulaparimito hrasva iti boddhavyam | etat sarvaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe eva sāmbopākhyāne vistareṇoktam |
saptamyām atra devāgraṃ śubhaṃ śuklaṃ navaṃ tathā |
khabhaveṣu yathānyeṣu pavitrāṇy atra vai viduḥ ||
tathā devasya māse ‘sminn avyaṅgaḥ parigīyate |
khabhaveṣu deveṣu |
yas tv āropayate bhaktyā bhāskarasya naro ‘cyuta |
avyaṅgaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā bhaktyā brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
śaṅkhatūryaninādaiś ca brahaghoṣaiś ca puṣkalaiḥ |
sa divyaṃ yānam ārūḍho lokam āyāti helinaḥ ||
anenaiva vidhānena māsān dvādaś vai kramāt |
upoṣya pāraṇe pūrṇe datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ||
evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kuryād ādityārādhanaṃ śuciḥ |
[743] sa gacchet tu paraṃ lokaṃ samuddiśya divākaram ||
homārcā kriyate tatra tat sarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet ||
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam avyaṅgasaptamīvratam
pulastya uvāca |
anyām api pravakṣyāmi nāmnā tu phalasaptamīm |
yām upoṣya naraḥ pāpair vimuktaḥ svargabhāg bhavet ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi pañcamyāṃ niyatavrataḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyām upoṣya kamalaṃ kārayitvā tu kāñcanam ||
śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine |
rūpaṃ tu kāñcanaṃ kṛtvā phalasyaikasya dharmavit ||
dadyād vikālavelāyāṃ bhānur me prīyatām iti |
bhaktyā tu viprān saṃpūjya saptamyāṃ kṣīrabhojanam ||
kṛtvā kuryāt phalatyāgaṃ yāvat syāt kṛṣṇasaptamī |
tām upoṣya vidhiṃ kuryād anenaiva krameṇa tu ||
tadvad dhemaphalaṃ dadyāt suvarṇakamalānvitam |
śarkarāpātrasaṃyuktaṃ vastramālāvibhūṣitam ||
saṃvatsaram anenaiva vidhinobhayasaptamīm |
upoṣya dadyāt kramaśaḥ sūryamantram udīrayet ||
bhānur arko ravir brahmā sūryaḥ śakro hariḥ śivaḥ |
śrīmān vibhāvasus tvaṣṭā varuṇaḥ prīyatām iti ||
pratimāsaṃ ca saptamyāṃ ekaikaṃ nāma kīrtayet |
[744] pratipakṣaṃ phalatyāgam ekaṃ kurvan samācaret ||
vratānte vipramithunaṃ pūjayed vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
śarkarākalaśaṃ dadyād dhemapuṣpasamanvitam ||
yathā na viphalāḥ kāmās tvadbhaktānāṃ sadā rave |
tathānantaphalāvāptir me ‘stu janmani janmani ||
imām anantaphaladāṃ yaḥ kuryāt phalasaptamīm |
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā śūryaloke mahīyate ||
surāpānādikaṃ pāpaṃ yad yad daśapurākṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti yaḥ kuryāt phalasaptamīm ||
kurvāṇaḥ saptamīm etāṃ satataṃ rogavarjitaḥ |
bhūtān bhavyāṃś ca puruṣāṃs tārayed ekaviṃśatim ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ phalasaptamīvratam |
viṣṇur uvāca |
kule janma tathārogyaṃ dhanaṃ caiveha durlabham |
tṛtīyaṃ prāpyate yena tan me vada jagatpate ||
brahmovāca |
yo mārgaśīrṣaṃ sitasaptame ‘hni
hastarkṣayoge jagataḥ prasūtim |
saṃpūjya bhānuṃ vidhinopavāsi
sraggandhadhūpānnavanopahāraiḥ ||
gṛhītagavyaṃ pratiyavyapūjā
dānādiyuktaṃ vratam abdam ekam |
[745] yavyo māsaḥ |
dadyāc ca dānaṃ dvijapuṅgavebhyas
tat kathyamānaṃ vinibodha vīra ||
vajraṃ yathā vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ
yavānnam ambhaḥkarakānnapātram |
chatraṃ payo ‘nnaṃ guḍaphāṇitāḍhyaṃ
dadyāt tathā vastram anukrameṇa ||
gavye ca yavye vidhicodite ca
tasyāṃ tithau lokaguruṃ prapūjya |
karakānnapātram annapūrṇapātrapihita udakapūrṇakalasaṃ | guḍaphāṇitāḍhyaṃguḍānnam annam |
aśnītadhānyāni viśuddhihetoḥ
saṃprāśanānīha nibodha tāni ||
gomūtram ambho ghṛtam āmaśākam
dūrvādadhivrīhiyavāṃs tilāṃś ca |
sūryāṃsutaptaṃ jalam ambujāni
kṣīraṃ ca māsakramaśo ‘pi yojyam ||
kule pradhāne dhanadhānyapūrṇe
padmāvṛte dhvastasamastaduḥkhe |
prāpnoti janmāvikalendriyaś ca
bhavaty arogī matimān sukhī ca ||
padmāvṛte lakṣmyāvṛte |
[746]
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktaṃ nayanapradasaptamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
viśokasaptamī tadvad vakṣyāmi munipuṅgava |
yām upoṣya naraḥ śokaṃ na kadācid ihāśnute ||
māghe kṛṣṇatilaiḥ snātaḥ pañcamyāṃ śūklapakṣataḥ |
kṛtāhāraḥ kṛśarayā dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
upavāsavrataṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī bhaven niśi |
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtasnānajapaḥ śuciḥ ||
kṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ padmam arko ‘yam iti pūjayet |
karavīraiś ca puṣpaiś ca raktavastrayugena ca ||
yathā viśokaṃ bhuvanaṃ tathaivāditya (?) sarvadā |
tathā viśoko me evāstu tvadbhakteḥ prati janmani ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu bhaktyā saṃpūjayed dvijān |
suptvā saṃprāśya gomūtram utthāya kṛtanityakaḥ ||
saṃpūjya vipraṃ yatnena guḍapātrasamanvitam |
susūkṣmaṃ vastrasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
atailalavaṇaṃ bhuṅkte saptamyāṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ |
tataḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
anena vidhinā sarvam ubhayor api pakṣayoḥ |
kuryād yāvat punar māghaśuklapakṣasya saptamīm ||
vratānte kalasaṃ (-śaṃ) dadyāt suvarṇakamalānvitam |
[747] śayyām sopaskarāṃ dadyāt kapilāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm ||
anena vidhinā yas tu vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
viśokasaptamīṃ kuryāt sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
yāvaj janmasahasrāṇi sārdhakoṭiśataṃ bhavet |
tāvan na śokam abhyeti rogadaurgatyavarjitaḥ ||
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam |
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yas tu sa paraṃ brahma gacchati ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ viśokasaptamīvratam |
agastya uvāca |
athāparaṃ mahārāja vratam ārogyasaṃjñitam |
kathayāmi paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
tasyaiva māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
pūjayed bhāskaraṃ devaṃ viśvrūpaṃ sanātanam ||
āditya bhāskara rave bhāno sūrya divākara |
prabhākareti saṃpūjyo devaḥ sarveśvaro vibhuḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva kṛtāhāraḥ saptamyām upavāsakṛt |
aṣṭamyāṃ caiva bhuñjīta eṣa eva vidhiḥ kramaḥ ||
anena vatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ vidhinā yo ‘rcayed ravim |
tasyārogyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyam iha janmani jāyate ||
paratra ca sukhaṃ sthānaṃ yad gatvā na nivartate |
[748]
iti varāhapurāṇoktam ārogyasaptamīvratam |
sumatur uvāca |
hanta te saṃpravakṣyāmi sūryavratam anuttamam |
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ pratipādakam uttamam ||
pauṣe māsi ca saptamyāṃ yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
jitendriyaḥ satyavādī snāti gomūtragorasaiḥ ||
pakṣayoḥ saptamīṃ yatnād upavāsena yo nayet |
trisaṃdhyam arcayed bhānuṃ śāṇḍileyaṃ ca suvrata ||
śāṇḍileyo ‘gniḥ |
adhaḥśāyī bhaven nityaṃ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ |
māsi pūrṇe tu saptamyāṃ ghṛtādibhir arindama ||
kṛtvā snānaṃ mahāpūjāṃ sūryamantreṇa bhārata |
naivedyam odanaprasthaṃ kṣīrasiddhaṃ nivedayet ||
bhojayitvā dvijān aṣṭau sūryabhaktāṃs tu sāmagān |
gāṃ ca dadyān mahārāja kapilāṃ bhāskarāya ca ||
ya evaṃ kurute puṇyaṃ sūryavratam anuttamam |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vacmi sarvakāmasamanvitam ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ |
apsarogaṇasaṃpūrṇair mahāvibhavasaṃyutaiḥ ||
saṃgītanṛtyanirdyoṣair gandharvagaṇaśobhitaiḥ |
dodhūyamānaś camaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
[749] sahasrakiraṇād bhānor dhanaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatrāste ravir aṃśumān ||
romasaṃkhyātayā tasyās tatprasūtikule yuvā |
tasyāḥ kapilāyāḥ |
tāvad yugasahasrāṇi śūryaloke mahīyate |
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān ||
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya sūryasya nilayaṃ vrajet |
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
piṇyākaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ |
upavāsaś ca saptamyāṃ bhaved ubhayapakṣayoḥ ||
ghṛtābhiṣekam aṣṭamyāṃ kuryād bhānor narādhipa |
gāṃ ca dadyād dineśāya taruṇīṃ nīlasaṃnibhām ||
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ bhogān bhuṅkte yathepsitān |
phālgune māsi rājendra yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
śyāmākaiḥ kṣīranīvāraiḥ jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāpy atha saptamyām upavāsaparo bhavet ||
aṣṭamyāṃ tu mahāsnānaṃ pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ |
valmīkāgrādimṛdbhiś ca gomūtrasakṛtādibhiḥ ||
tvagbhiś ca kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ snāpayitvā prapūjayet |
saurabheyīṃ tato dadyād raktābhāṃ raśmimāline ||
saurabheyī gauḥ |
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
[750] māsi caitre tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
śālyannaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
bhānave pāṭalāṃ dadyād vaiṣṇavīṃ taruṇīṃ nṛpa ||
vaiṣṇavī gaur eva |
puṣparāgamayair yānair nānāhaṃsānuyāyibhiḥ |
gacchet sūryapuraṃ ramyaṃ duṣprāpam akṛtātmabhiḥ ||
vaiśākhe māsi rājendra yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
dadhyodanaṃ ca bhuñjāno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ ||
goṣṭheśayo hy adhaḥśāyī niśāyām ekavastradhṛk |
niyamaṃ ca yathoddiṣṭaṃ sāmānyaṃ sarvam ācaret ||
sāmānyo niyamaḥ pāṣaṇḍādyasaṃbhāṣaṇādiḥ |
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kuryāt snānaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ |
sūryāyālaṃkṛtāṃ tv ekāṃ dadyād gāṃ taruṇīṃ nṛpa ||
śaṅkhakubdenduvarṇābhair (?) mahāyānair alaṃkṛtaiḥ |
śvetair garuḍasaṃyuktair gacched arkasya mandiram ||
sarvātiśayarūpābhir nārībhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
nīlotpalasugandhābhir modate kālam akṣayam ||
māsi jyeṣṭhe mahābāho yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
bhuñjānaḥ pāyasaṃ vīra sarpiṣā madhunā saha ||
vīrāsano niśāyāṃ syād ahar gāḥ samanuvrajet |
vīrāsanam anupaviśyāvasthānam |
hitakārī gavāṃ nityaṃ gavāṃ hiṃsāvivarjitaḥ ||
ubhayor api saptamyāṃ kuryāt saṃdhyādikaṃ vidhim |
[751] ubhayoḥ pakṣayor iti śeṣaḥ |
sūryāya dhenuṃ dadyāc ca dhūmravarṇām alaṃkṛtām ||
nīlotpalasamaprakhyair mahāyānair anūpamaiḥ |
mahāsiṃhanibaddhaiś ca modate kālam akṣayam ||
āṣāḍhe māsi yaḥ kuryāt saṃyato naktabhojanam |
ṣaṣṭikodanasaṃmiśraṃ sakṛd aśnīta gorasam ||
gāṃ dadyāc ca mahārāja bhāskarāya śubhānanām |
sāmānyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryāt (?) prāgukto yomayānagha (?) ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśair yānair barhiṇavāhanaiḥ |
aṇimādiguṇair yuktaḥ sūryavad vicared divi ||
saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
kṣīraṣaṣṭhikayuktānnaṃ sarvasattvahite rataḥ ||
pītavarṇāṃ ca gāṃ dadyād bhāskarāya mahātmane |
sāmānyam akhilaṃ kuryād vidhānaṃ yat prakīrtitam ||
suvicitrair mahāyānair haṃsasārasayāyibhiḥ |
gatvādityapuraṃ śrīmān pūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam ||
vīra bhādrapade māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
hutaśeṣaṃ hi viśvātman vṛkṣamūlam upāśritaḥ ||
svapyād āyatane rātrau sarvabhūtānukampayā |
dadyād gāṃ taruṇīṃ vīra bhāskarāya mahātmane ||
niśākarasamaprakhyair vajravaidūryacitritaiḥ |
cakravākasamāyuktair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ sasurāsuravanditaḥ |
[752] modate sa mahāyānair yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
śrīmān aśvayuje māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
ghṛtāśanaṃ ca bhuñjāno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ ||
dadyād gāṃ padmavarṇābhāṃ bhānor amitatejase |
pṛṣṭhābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ taruṇīṃ ca payasvinīm ||
svacchamauktikasaṃkāśair indranīlopaśobhitaiḥ |
jīvañjīvakasaṃyuktair vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ ||
gacched bhānusalokatvaṃ tejasā ravisaṃnibhaḥ |
kāntyā vidhusamo rājan prabhayā bhṛgusaṃnibhaḥ ||
rājendra kārttike māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
kṣīrodanaṃ ca bhuñjānaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ ||
divākarāya gāṃ dadyāj jvālanārkasamaprabhām |
pūrvoktaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryāt sūryatulyo bhaven nṛpa ||
kānānalaśikhāprakhyair mahāyānair nagopamaiḥ |
mahāsiṃhakṛtoddhūtair sūryavat modate sukhī ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
yavānnaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
prayacched gāṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām |
sūryāya kuruśārdūla vidhiṃ vāpi samācaret ||
sitapadmanibhair yānaiḥ śvetāśvarathasaṃyutaiḥ |
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ prabhayā parayānvitaḥ ||
ahiṃsā satyavacanam asteyaḥ kṣāntir ārjavam |
triṣavaṇāgnihavanaṃ bhūśayyā naktabhojanam ||
[753] pakṣayor upavāsena saptamyāṃ kurunandana |
etān guṇān samāśritya kurvāṇo vratam uttamam ||
saptamy ubhayam ākhyātaṃ sarvarogabhayāpaham |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
ityevamādiniyamaiś caret sūryavrataṃ sadā |
ya icched vipulaṃ sthānaṃ bhānor amitatejasaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam ubhayasaptamīvratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
athānyad api te vacmi dānaṃ pāpavināśanam |
ādityamaṇḍakaṃ nāma samīhitaphalapradam ||
yavacūrṇena śubhreṇa kuryād godhūmajena vā |
supakvaṃ bhānubimbābhaṃ guḍaṃ gavyājyapūritam ||
saṃpūjya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā tadagre maṇḍalaṃ śubham |
raktacandanajaṃ kṛtvā kauṅkumaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ ||
maṇḍakaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya raktapuṣpaiḥ prapūjitam |
sahiraṇyaṃ savastraṃ ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ mantreṇānena pāṇdava |
ādityatejasotpannaṃ rājñaḥ karavinirmitam ||
śreyase mama vipra tvaṃ pratīcchāpūpam uttamam |
brāhmaṇo ‘pi paṭhen mantraṃ gṛhṇīyād bhāskarapriyam ||
dattaṃ bhāskarabhaktena svayaṃ tadbhaktibhāvataḥ |
kāmadaṃ dhanadaṃ dharmyaṃ putradaṃ sukhadaṃ tathā ||
[754] ādityaprītaye dattaṃ pratigṛhṇātu maṇḍakam |
evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhātmā bhūtātmā bhaktavatsalaḥ |
ādityārādhanaparas tataḥ svarge mahīyate ||
iha cāgatya rājendra nijapuṇyasya saṃkṣayāt |
sarvakāmasamṛddhārtho maṇḍalādhipatir bhavet ||
dātavyo rathasaptamyāṃ mahādānasamo nṛpa |
dātavyaḥ prativarṣaṃ ca phalam atyantam īpsatā ||
ekenāpi pradattena bālyayauvanavārddhakaiḥ |
pāpaṃ praṇāśam āyāti bahubhiḥ puṇyabhāg bhavet ||
godhūmacūrṇajanitaṃ yavacūrṇajaṃ vā
ādityamaṇḍakam akhaṇḍam adīnasattvaḥ |
kṛtvā dvijāya vidhivat pratipādayed yo
nūnaṃ bhavaty amitamaṇḍalamaṇḍano ‘sau ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam (?) ādityamaṇḍakavratam |
brahmovāca |
mārtaṇḍasaptamīṃ kṛṣṇa athānyāṃ vacmi te ‘nagha |
pauṣamāse site pakṣe saptamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ ||
samyak saṃpūjya mārtaṇḍaṃ mārtaṇḍa iti vai japan |
pūjayet kutapaṃ bhaktyā śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ ||
kutapaḥ sūryaḥ |
pūṣadhūpopahārādyair upavāsair samāhitaḥ |
[755] mārtaṇḍeti japan nāma punas tadgatamānasaḥ ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāśaktyā khagadhvaja |
svapan vibuddhaḥ skhalito mārtaṇḍeti ca kīrtayet ||
pāṣaṇḍibhir vikarmasthair ālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ vāpi dadhikṣīram athāpi vā ||
godehataḥ samudbhūtaṃ prāśnīyād ātmaśuddhaye |
dvitīye ‘hni punas tāta(s?) tatraivābhyarcanaṃ raveḥ ||
tenaiva nāmnā saṃbhūya datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām |
tato bhuñjīta godehasamudbhūtasamanvitam ||
evam evākhilān māsān upoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ |
dadyād gavāhnikaṃ vidvān pratimāsaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ||
pārite ca punar varṣe yathā pūrvaṃ gavāhnikam |
datvā paragave bhūyaḥ śṛṇu yat phalam aśnute ||
svarṇaśṛṅgyaḥ pañcagāvaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ naraḥ |
pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo datvā yat phalam aśnute ||
tadāpnoty akhilaṃ samyag vratam etad upoṣitaḥ |
taṃ ca lokam avāpnoti mārtaṇḍo yatra tiṣṭhati |
śāṇḍileyasamaḥ kṛṣṇa tejasā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
śāṇḍileyasamaḥ agnisamaḥ |
[756]
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ mārtaṇḍasaptamīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yām upoṣya naraḥ kāmān āpnoti manasaḥ priyān |
tām ekāṃ vada me deva saptamīṃ pāpanāśinīm ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhānor dine site pakṣe atīte cottarāyaṇe |
puṃnāmadheyanakṣatre gṛhṇīyāt saptamīvratam ||
savrīhakās tilayavān saha māṣamudgair
godhūmamāṃsamadhumaithunakāṃsyapātraiḥ |
abhyañjanāñjanaśilātalacūrṇitāni
ṣaṣṭhīvratī parihared ahanīṣṭasiddhyai ||
devān pitṝn munigaṇān sajalāñjalībhiḥ
saṃtarpya pūjya gaganāṅganahastadīpam |
hutvānale tilayavān bahuśo ghṛtāktān
bhūmau svaped hṛdi nidhāya dineśavisvam ||
yāni trayodaśadinair iha varjitāni
dravyāṇi tāni parihṛtya dine ca ṣaṣṭyāṃ |
saṃprāśya śuddhacaṇakāni ha varṣam ekaṃ
prāpnoti bhārata pumān manasepsitāni ||
caṇakagrahaṇaṃ vivarjitāntaropalakṣaṇārtham anyathā vrīhyādivarjanam anarthakaṃ syāt |
[757]
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ trayodaśapadārthavarjanasaptamīvratam |
vasudeva uvāca |
naimittikān tato vakṣye yajñāṃś cātra samāhitaḥ |
saptamyāṃ grahaṇe caiva saṃkrāntiṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
naimittikān tato vakṣye ity anena ślokena grahaṇasaṃkrāntiṣu sādhāraṇyena yajñapratijñā kṛtā satrasaptamīyajña tāvad āha śuklapakṣasyetyādinā |
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ haviṃ bhuktvaikadā divā |
samyag ācamya saṃdhyāyāṃ varuṇaṃ praṇipatya ca ||
varuṇotra sūryaḥ |
indriyāṇi tu saṃyamya sa taṃ dhyātvā svaped budhaḥ |
darbhaśayyāgato rātrau prātaḥ snātaḥ susaṃyutaḥ ||
sarvasyādau tathaivānte pūrvavad varuṇaṃ yajet |
juhuyād bahvṛcas tv agniṃ sūryāgniṃ parikalpya vai ||
sūryāgnikaraṇaṃ vakṣye tarpaṇaṃ ca samāsataḥ |
astreṇoṅkāram ullikhya sāvitryābhyukṣya vānale ||
astreṇa astramantreṇa sāvitryā sūryagāyatryā | etac ca sarvaṃ nikṣubhā saptamyām evābhihitaṃ veditavyam |
prakṣipyāstīrya darbhāṃś ca deśe bhūmī yathepsite |
prāgagrair udagagraiś ca pātrāṇy ālabhya cakravat ||
pavitraṃ dvikuśaṃ kṛtvā sāgraṃ prādeśasaṃmitam |
[758] tena pātrāṇi saṃprokṣya saṃśodhya ca vilopya ca ||
udagbhāgasthite pātre sāgninā colmukhena ca |
paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tataś cotpavanaṃ tridhā ||
parimṛjya srucādīṃś darbhaiḥ saṃprokṣītaiś ca taiḥ |
juhuyāt prokṣite vahnau tatrārkaṃ pūrvavad yajet ||
bhūmau sthitena pātreṇa vistareṇa tu pāṇinā |
vāmena yaduśārdūla nāntarikṣe tu pūyate ||
antarikṣe trikādau |
dakṣiṇena śucau gṛhya juhuyāt pāvakaṃ budhaḥ |
hṛdayena kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kartavyāḥ pūrvacoditāḥ ||
hṛdayena hṛdayamantreṇa |
anena hutvā saṃtarpya dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ |
varuṇāyādarān māghe saptamyāṃ varuṇaṃ yajet ||
yathāśaktyā tu viprebhyaḥ pradadyāt khaṇḍaveṣṭakān |
dadyāc ca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā prāpyate yāgajaṃ phalam ||
evaṃ ca phālgune sūryaṃ caitre ṭe (?) vāṃśumālinam |
vaiśākhe māsi dhātāram indraṃ jyeṣṭhe yajed ravim ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi bhagaṃ bhādrapadaṃ tathā |
āśvine cāpi parjanyaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ kārttike yajet ||
mārgaśīrṣe tu mitraṃ ca pauṣe viṣṇuṃ yajd yadi |
saṃvatsareṇa yat proktaṃ phalam iṣṭvā dine dine ||
tat sarvaṃ prāpnuyāt kṣipraṃ bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kṛtvā vai kāñcanaṃ ratham ||
[759] saptabhir vājirbhir yuktāṃ nānāratnopaśobhitām |
ādityapratimāṃ madhye śuddhahemnā kṛtāṃ śubhām ||
ratnair alaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā hemapadmoparisthitām |
tasmin rathavare kṛtvā sārathiṃ cāgrataḥ sthitam ||
vṛtaṃ dvādaśabhir vipraiḥ kramān māsādhipātmabhiḥ |
sarvakalpajñaṃ ācāryaṃ pūjayitvā rathāgrataḥ ||
māsādhipāḥ pratimāsoktāḥ sūryāḥ | atas tadbhaktibhāvitair dvādaśabhir viprair vṛtam ācāryaṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
saṃcinyādityavartaṃ vai vasuratnādinārcayet |
evaṃ māsādhipān viprān saṃpūjyātha nivedayet ||
ācāryāya rathaṃ cakraṃ grāsaṃ vāso mahīṃ śubhām |
mādhān māsādhipebhyaś ca dvādaśebhyo nivedayet ||
evaṃ bhaktyā yathāśaktyā hemaratnādibhūṣaṇam |
datvā tasya namaskṛtya vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ nivedayet ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ na doṣo ‘sti vratasya karaṇād iha |
evam astv iti viprendraiḥ sahācāryaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
vaddhṛcair [bahvṛcair?] āśiṣo datvā pravadet prīyatām iti |
ādityo yena kāmena yas tvayārādhito vrataiḥ ||
tubhyaṃ dadātu taṃ kāmaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ bhavatu vratam |
viprebhyo guṇavadbhyaś ca nisvebhyaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaś ca śaktyā datvā ca dakṣiṇām |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu vratam etat samāpayet ||
[760] kṛtvaivaṃ saptamīm abdaṃ rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ |
puruṣaś ca bhaved dātā bhāskarasyātivallabhaḥ ||
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ niḥsapatnam akaṇṭakam |
triḥśataṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuṅkte sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ sukhī ||
vittahīno ‘pi yo bhaktyā kṛtvā tāmramayaṃ ratham |
dadyād vratopavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathoditam ||
sāśītiyojanaṃ bhuṅkte vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍālaṃ bhuvaḥ |
evaṃ piṣṭhamayaṃ yo ‘pi vittahīno daded ratham ||
āṣaṣṭiyojanaṃ bhuṅkte sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ sukhī |
sūryalokaṃ ca kalpānte sakṛd vedam avāpnuyāt ||
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ vijayāyajñasaptamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
sūryapūjāgnivahanaṃ saṃtoṣaḥ steyavarjanam ||
sarvavrateṣv ayaṃ vatsa sāmānyena sadā sthitiḥ |
gṛhītvā saptamīkalpaṃ jñānato yas tu tāmasaḥ ||
tyajet kāmād bhayād vāpi sa jñyehaḥ patito budhaiḥ |
saptamyāṃ sopavāsas tu rātrau bhuṅkte tu yo naraḥ ||
kṛtopavāsaḥ ṣaṣṭyāṃ tu pañcamyām ekakālabhuk |
[761] datvā tu saṃskṛtaṃ śākaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ susaṃskṛtam ||
devāś ca brāhmaṇebhyaś ca rātau bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
yāvajjīvaṃ naraḥ kaścid vratam etac cariṣyati |
tasya śrīr vijayaś caiva trivargaś ca vivardhate |
mṛtaḥ svargam avāpnoti vimānavaram āsthitaḥ ||
sūryaloke ca ramate manvatarabahūn atha |
iha cāgatya kālānte ripūn śāsti samantataḥ ||
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto dātā syān niyatavrataḥ |
sa bhunakti parān rājan vigrahair ajitaḥ paraiḥ ||
yānena rājaśārdūla śākāhāreṇa saptamīm |
upoṣya labdham tat tīrthaṃ paityaṃ vai gayasaṃjñitam ||
kurūṇāṃ tatra pūrveṇa śākāhāreṇa vai tathā |
dharmakṣetraṃ kurukṣetraṃ smṛtaṃ tena vivasvatā ||
saptamī navamī ṣaṣṭhī tṛtīyā pañcamī tathā |
kāmadās tithayo hy etā itaratra na yoṣitām ||
saptamī māghamāsasya navamy aśvayuje tathā |
ṣaṣṭhī bhādrapade dhanyā vaiśākhe tu tṛtīyakā ||
puṇyā bhādrapade jñeyā pañcamī nāgapañcamī |
ity etāḥ sveṣu māseṣu viśeṣās tithayaḥ śubhāḥ ||
śākaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣyabhojyasamanvitam |
datvā vipre yathāśaktyā paścād bhuṅkte niśi vratī ||
kārttike śuklapakṣasya grāhyo ‘yaṃ kurunandana |
[762] caturbhir api māsais tu pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam ||
agastikusumaiś cātra pūjā kāryā vibhāvasoḥ |
vibhāvasor iti sūryasya |
vilepanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca dhūpaiś cāivāparājitaḥ ||
snānaṃ tu pañcagavyena tad eva prāśayet tathā |
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ cātra pūjā kāryā vibhāvasoḥ ||
tadaiva deyaṃ viprāṇāṃ śākaṃ bhakṣyam athātmanaḥ |
śubhaśākasamāyuktaṃ bhakṣyapeyasamanvitam ||
śubhaṃ śākaḥ aniṣiddhaśākaḥ |
dvitīyapāraṇe rājan śubhagandhāni yāni vai |
puṣpāṇi tāni devasya tath śvetaṃ ca candanam ||
aguruś cāpi dhūpo ‘tha naivedyaṃ guḍapūpakāḥ |
snānaṃ kuśodakenātra prāśanaṃ gomayena tu ||
tṛtīye karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca candanam |
dhūpānāṃ gugguluś cātra priyo devasya sarvadā ||
śālyodanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadhimiśraṃ mahāmate |
tam eva brāhmaṇānāṃ tu bhakṣyalehyasamanvitam ||
kālaśākena ca vibho yuktaṃ datvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
gaurasarṣapakalkena snānaṃ cātra vidur budhāḥ ||
tasyaiva prāśanaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham |
tṛtīyapāraṇasyānte brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ||
śrāvaṇaṃ ca purāṇasya vācanaṃ cāpi śasyate |
devasya purataḥ snāto brāhmaṇānāṃ tadagrataḥ ||
[763] brāhmaṇād vācakāc chrāvyaṃ nānyavarṇasamudbhavāt |
śrāvayed brāhmaṇān sarvān śaktyā bhaktyā prapūjayet ||
vācakasyāmale rājan vāsasī saṃnivedayet |
vācake pūjite devaḥ sadā tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ ||
karavīraṃ yatheṣṭaṃ tu tathā raktaṃ ca candanam |
yatheṣṭaṃ guggulaṃ tasya yatheṣṭaṃ caiva bhājanam ||
yatheṣṭaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ tasya yatheṣṭo vacakaḥ sadā |
pāraṇaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ vai savituḥ kurunandana ||
ity eṣā saptamī puṇyā supriyā (?) gopateḥ sadā |
yām upoṣyeha puruṣo daurgatyena ca yujyate ||
kṣīrapratipadiviśeṣo ‘vagantavya iti | śākasaptamīvratam |
kārttikaśuklasaptamyām ārabhya pratimāsaṃ kurvatā punar māsacatuṣṭayam yāvat śuklasaptamī tasyāṃ tasyāṃ ca pāraṇaṃ kāryam | ekasmin varṣe vāratrayaṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavati evam eva varṣāntareṣu tādṛśaṃ vrataṃ yāvajjīvaṃ kartavyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śākasaptamīvratam |
nārada uvāca |
kim uroge ‘dbhute kṛtyam alakṣmīḥ kena hanyate |
mṛtavatsābhiṣekādikārye kiṃ nu vidhīyate ||
[764] śaṅkara uvāca |
purākṛtāni pāpāni phalaṃ tatra tapodhana |
rogadaurgatyarūpeṇa tathaiveṣṭavadhena ca ||
tadvighātāya vakṣyāmi tadā kalyāṇakārakam |
saptamīsnapanaṃ nāma vyādhipīḍāvināśanam ||
bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ yatra kṣīrapānāṃ ca dṛśyate |
tadvad vṛddhetarāṇāṃ ca yauvanaṃ vāpavartinām ||
śāntaṃ yat tat pravakṣyāmi mṛtavatsābhiṣekataḥ (?) |
etad evādbhute vege cittavibhramanāśanam ||
bhaviṣyati mahābāho yadā kalpas tapodhana |
vivasvataś ca tatrāpi yadā manur anuttamaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati ca tatrāpi pañcaviṃśatimaṃ yadā |
kṛtaṃ nāma yugaṃ tatra haihayānvayavardhanam ||
bhavitā tu patir vīraḥ kārttivīryaḥ pratāpavān |
sa saptamo ‘yam akhilaṃ pālayiṣyati bhūtalam ||
yāvad varṣasahasrāṇi saptasaptāni nārada |
jātamātraṃ ca tasyāṃ ca yāvat putraśataṃ tadā ||
cyavanasya tu śāpena vināśam upayāśyati |
sahasrabāhuś ca yadā bhavitā tasya vai sutaḥ ||
kṛtavīryaḥ samārādhya sahasrāṃśuṃ divākaram |
upavāsair vratair divyaḥ vedasūktaiś ca nārada ||
putrasya jīvanāyāsantrasnānam avāpsyati ||
kṛtavīryeṇa vai dṛṣṭa idaṃ ca katibhāskaraḥ |
[765] aśeṣaduṣṭaśamanaṃ sadā kalmaṣanāśanam ||
alaṃ kleśena mahatā putras tava narādhipa |
bhaviṣyati ciraṃjīvī kiṃ nu kilbiṣanāśanam ||
saptamīsnapanaṃ vakṣye sarvalokahitāya vai |
jātasya mṛtavatsāyāḥ saptame māsi nārada ||
atha vā śuklasaptamyām etat sarvaṃ praśasyate |
grahatārābalaṃ labdhvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam ||
alaṃ kleśena mahatā putras tava narādhipa |
bālasya janmanakṣatraṃ varjayet tāṃ tithiṃ budhaḥ ||
tadvad vṛddhāturāṇāṃ tu kṛtvā taditareṣu ca |
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmāv eva tu saṃsthitaḥ ||
taṇḍulai raktaśālyannaiś caturaḥ kṣīrasaṃyutam |
nirvapet sūryarudrābhyāṃ mātṛbhyaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
kīrtayet sūryadaivatyaṃ sūktaṃ pūrvaṃ ghṛtāhutīḥ |
juhuyād rudrasūktena tadvad rudrāya nārada ||
hotavyā samidhaś cātra tathaivārkapalāśayoḥ |
yavaiḥ kṛṣṇatilair homaḥ kartavyo ‘ṣṭaśataṃ punaḥ ||
vyāhṛtibhir athājyena tathaivāṣṭaśataṃ budhāḥ |
hutvā snānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mantrais tair eva dhīmatā ||
vipreṇa vedaviduṣā vidhivad darbhapāṇinā |
sthāpayitvā tu caturaḥ kumbhān koṇeṣu śobhanān ||
pañca pañca punar madhe dadhyakṣatavibhūṣitān |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ saureṇaivābhimantritam ||
[766] pūrayet tīrthatoyena svarṇaratnasamanvitam |
sarvān sarvauṣadhiyutān pañcabhaṅgajalānvitān ||
pañcaratnaphalair yuktaṃ vāsobhiḥ pariveṣṭitān |
gajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamavrajagokulam ||
saṃgatya mṛdam ānīya sarveṣv eva vinikṣīpet |
saṃgatya ekīkṛtya |
caturṣv api kumbheṣu toyagarbheṣu madhyamam ||
gṛhītvā brāhmaṇas tatra saurān mantrān udīrayan |
nārībhiḥ saptasakhyābhir avyaṅgāṅgībhir atra ca ||
pūjitābhir yathāśaktyā mālyavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
savastrābhiś ca kartavyaṃ mṛtavatsābhiṣecanam ||
dīrghāyur uktabālo ‘yam jīvaputrās tv iyaṃ tathā |
ādityaś candramā sārdhaṃ grahanakṣatratārakaiḥ ||
śakraḥ salokapālo vai brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
ete cānye ca devaighāḥ sadā pāntu kumārakam ||
na śanir nātra rāhuś ca nātra vālagrahāḥ kvacit |
pīḍāṃ kurvantu vālasya samātur janakasya ca ||
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharā kumārī patisaṃyutā |
tryambakaṃ pūjayet strīṇām ācāryaṃ saha bhāryayā ||
kāñcanīyāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tāmrapātropariṣṭhitām |
pratimāṃ dharmarājasya gurave vinivedayet ||
dharmarājas tu mahiṣastho dakṣiṇakare sampuṇḍadaṇḍadharas tadupari khaḍgaṃ vāme phalakam aparāś ca dhūmravarṇā aṣṭausavat sāḥ saṃgatā vāme bhavā dad dakṣiṇakare yamapāśaś ca lekhanīyaḥ |
[767] patrakaraḥ śvaśrūdhāro citraguptaḥ prakartavyaḥ |
vastraiḥ kāñcanaratnādyair bhakṣyaiḥ saghṛtapāyasaiḥ ||
pūjayed brāhmaṇāṃs tatra vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
bhuktvā ca guruṇā caivam uccāryā mantrasantatiḥ ||
dīrghāyur uktacālo ‘yaṃ yāvad varṣaśataṃ sukhī |
yat kiṃcid asya duritaṃ tat kṣiptaṃ vaḍavāmukhe ||
brahmā rudro vasuḥ skando viṣṇuḥ śakro hutāśanaḥ |
rakṣantu sarve duṣṭebhyo varadāḥ santu sarvaśaḥ ||
evamādyāni caitāni vadantaṃ pūjayed ravim |
śaktitaḥ kapilāṃ caiva praṇipatya visarjayet ||
guruṃ ca putrasahitaṃ paṇamya raviśaṅkarau |
hutaśeṣaṃ samaśnīyād ādityāya namo ‘stv iti ||
idam evādbhute vege duḥsvapneṣu ca dṛśyate |
kartur janmadinarkṣaṃ ca hitvā saṃpūjayet sadā ||
śāntyarthaṃ śuklasaptamyām etat kurvan na sīdati |
puṇyaṃ vidhattam āyuṣyaṃ saptamīstavanaṃ raveḥ ||
kathayitvā dvijaśreṣṭha tathaivāntaradhīyata |
savānena vidhānena dīrghāyur abhavan nṛpa ||
saṃvatsaraprasūto ‘pi sasasyāṃ pṛthivīm imām |
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ saptamīsnānam uttamam ||
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ bālānāṃ paramaṃ hitam |
ārogyaṃ bhāskarād icched dhanam icched dhutāśanāt ||
śaṅkarāj jñānam navicched gatim icchej janārdanāt |
[768] etan mahpātakanāśanaṃ syāt paraṃ hitam, vālavivardhanaṃ ca |
śṛṇoti yaś caivam ananyacetā
tasyāpi siddhiṃ munayo vadanti |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ saptamīsnapanam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
maṅgalyaṃ param icchanti maṅgalāyatanaṃ harim |
arcayed vinatā devaṃ saptamyāṃ samupoṣitā ||
maṇḍalaṃ catursraṃ ca vidhāyākṣatasaṃyutam |
tasminn āvāhayed devaṃ śrīśamindrirayā saha ||
paṅkajair jātikusumair nandyāvartaprasūnakaiḥ |
ekapatrair bilvadalair dūrvātaṇḍulakesaraiḥ ||
madhuraiḥ phalamūlaiś ca pāyasena samarcayet |
mṛṇmayaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca catuṣṭayam ||
pātram avraṇam icchan na (?) droṇapūrṇaṃ ca kārayet |
caturaḥ kalaśāṃs tatra mṛṇmayāṃś ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
catuḥprasthapramāṇena sahitān vastrasaṃyutān |
lavaṇaṃ ca tilaṃ caiva haridrācūrṇadhānyakaiḥ ||
mṛt kṣiptā rājate ‘thaivaṃ (?) śāntikumbhe nidhāpayet |
sarpiṣā madhunā dadhnā payasā ca prapūritān ||
sthāpayet kalaśān agre pātrāṇy api mahāmatiḥ |
[769] yoṣitaḥ pūjayed aṣṭau saputrāḥ patidevatāḥ ||
sarvamaṅgalasaṃyuktāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
tābhyo dadyād yathāyogaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
tās tataḥ pūjayet tāsāṃ dakṣiṇāś ca pradāpayet |
tataś ca saṃnidhau tāsāṃ prārthayante śriyaḥ patim ||
māṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ dehi maṅgalāyatane namaḥ |
indirākāntanayane śrīkāntanayanapriye ||
śrīpate śrīlatāśleṣapriyacāturbhujadvaye |
māṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ dehi maṅgalāyatalocane ||
atha tābhiś ca vanitā yoṣidbhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalā |
anujñāpya hareḥ pūjāṃ samāpya ca visṛjya tāḥ ||
ācāryo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyo dhanañjaya (?) |
saṃkalpyādau vidhis tasyāḥ suto vā janako ‘pi vā ||
kurvīta svapure vā vai gurur vā nṛpatiḥ kvacit |
kāryaḥ pūjāvidhir ayaṃ mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tu ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca tataḥ kuryāt pūrvavad devapūjanam |
aṣṭābhiḥ saha yoṣidbhiḥ kuryān mantreṇa pāraṇam ||
upavāsaś ca kartavyaḥ patinā ca sukhārthinā |
aṣṭamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryād dadyād brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
ācāryo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vrataṃ caiva samāpayet |
itaś cārogyajananam āyuḥ puṣṭiḥ sukhāvaham ||
māṅgalyaprabhavaḥ strīṇāṃ putrapautrapradaṃ tathā |
sutārthinī sutaṃ vinded āyuś cāpi tadarthinī ||
[770] māṅgalyaṃ param icchantī vratenānena cāpnuyāt |
pumān api yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ balam āyuś ca vindati ||
rājñām āyur dvijāgryāṇāṃ vidyāṃ ca vipulam api |
vaiśyānāṃ vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca sukhaṃ bhavet ||
vratam etat sadā kāryam ātmano jayam icchatā |
yuddhāni cehamānānām ādau kāryam idaṃ vratam ||
kanyakāpi patiṃ vindet kurvantī vratam uttamam |
evam eva paraṃ proktaṃ saptamīvratam uttamam |
sarvapuṇyapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvapuṣṭipradaṃ bhuvi ||
iti garuḍapurāṇoktaṃ maṅgalyaṃ vratam |
atha sūryavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
caitre śuklasya pakṣe tu samyak ṣaṣṭhyām upoṣitaḥ |
saptamyām arcanaṃ kuryād devadevasya bhūpate ||
bahiḥsnānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā gomayenopalepitaḥ |
lepayet sthaṇḍilaṃ samyak tato gauramṛdā nṛpa ||
tatrāṣṭadalakamalaṃ varṇakais tu samaṃ likhet |
karṇikāyāṃ nyaset tatra devadevaṃ vibhāvasum ||
pūrvapatre nyased devau rājan dravyānucārakau |
[771] āgneye ca nyaset patre gandharvau ṛtukārakau ||
dakṣiṇe ca nyaset patre tathaivāṅgārakau śubhau |
nairṛtye dvau mahārāja patrinairṛtakau nyaset ||
kādraveyau mahābhāgau paścime ṛtucārikau |
vāyavye yātudhānau dvau tathaiva nṛpasattama ||
uttare ca tathā patre vinyasec ca ṛṣidvayam |
īśānyāṃ vinyaset patre graham ekaṃ dvijottama ||
ete ca devādayo vasantādiṛtukrameṇa darśitāḥ |
yasmin yasminn ṛtau brahman anuyānti raviṃ prabhum |
ye ye devaprabhṛtayas tan me tvaṃ vaktum arhasi ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
dhātāryamna (?) ca rājendra vasante devatādvayam |
oṃ tumburur nāradaś caiva gandharvau gāyatāmbarī ||
kṛtuvelāpsarāś caiva tathā yā puñjikasvalā |
hotṛprahotṛś ca tathā rakṣogrāmaṇipuṅgavau ||
urago vāsukiś caiva tathaiva ṛṣisattamau |
anuyāti sitaś caiva grīṣmadevau vasantikau ||
ṛṣir atrir vasiṣṭhaś ca tathā dvau dakṣatakṣakau |
menakā sahajanyā ca gandharvau ca hahā huhuḥ ||
rathaś calaś ca grāmaṇyau rathakṛśnaś (?) ca tāv ubhau |
pauruṣādau vadhaś caiva yātudhānau ca tau smṛtau ||
anuyāti kujaś caiva nidāghe ca tathā grahaḥ |
ye ‘nuyānti raviṃ devaṃ prāvṛṭkāle nibodha me ||
[772] indraś caiva vivasvāṃś ca aṅgirā bhṛgur eva ca |
elāpatras tathā sarpaḥ śaṅkhapālaś ca pannagaḥ ||
śuciḥ senograsenaś ca vrataś caivāruṇiḥ saha |
pramlocanty apsarāś caiva nimlocantīha te ubhe ||
yātudhānas tathā sarpau vyāghraś ca manujeśvara |
prāvṛṭkāle tu yāty enaṃ graho devapurohitaḥ ||
ataḥ paraṃ nibodha tvaṃ śaratkāle narādhipa |
parjanyaś caiva pūṣā ca bharadrājaś ca gautamaḥ ||
citrasenaś ca gandharvas tathā ca sukaviḥ saha |
viśvāsī ca ghṛtācī ca tathā devāpsarodvayam ||
nāgas tv airāvataś caiva viśrutaś ca dhanaṃjayaḥ |
senajitc ca suṣeṇaś ca rākṣasau bhūmavikramau ||
yātau dvau tau ca tathā yātudhānau mahābalau |
grahaḥ śanaiścaraś caiva anuyāti divākaram ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hemante tava pārthiva |
aṃśobhagaś ca dvāv etau kaśyapaś ca kratuḥ saha ||
bhujaṅgaś ca mahāpadmaḥ sarpaḥ karkoṭakas tathā |
citrasenaś ca gandharva ūrṇāyuś ca mahābalaḥ ||
apsarāḥ pūrvavittaś ca gandharvā ūrvaśīvaśāḥ |
tārkṣyaś cāriṣṭanemiś ca rākṣasau bhīmavikrasau ||
visphūrjatas tathaivāgrau yātudhānau mahābalau |
anuyāti budhaś caiva graho rājan divākaram ||
ataḥ paraṃ ca dharmajña śiśire gadataḥ śṛṇu |
[773] tvaṣṭā viṣṇur jamadagnir viśvāmitras tathaiva ca ||
kādraveyo tathā nāgau kambalaś caturāv ubhau |
tilottamāpsarāś caiva devī rambhā manoramā ||
grāmaṇīratijāś caiva satyajic ca mahāyaśāḥ |
brahmopetaś ca vairakto yajñopetas tathaiva ca ||
gandharvo dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca sūryavarcās tathāparaḥ |
candramā graharājaś ca anuyāti divākaram ||
sūryam āpyāyayanty ete taijasā teja uttamam |
evaṃ hi śiśire rājann anuyānaṃ prakurvate ||
sthānān imāni nohyete saptadvādaśakā gaṇāḥ |
gaṇaṣaṭkas tathaivaikam anuyāti divākaram ||
sūryam āropayat tejas tejasāṃ teja uttamam |
tathaitais tair vacobhiś ca kurvanti ṛṣayas tava ||
gandharvāpsarasaś caiva sugītādyair upāsate |
vidyāgrāmaṇinaś caiva kurvanty atrābhipugraham (?) ||
sarpā vihante vaisūryaṃ yātudhānānuyānti ca |
paricārāgrahāś caiva nayantaś ca yathāvidhi ||
eteṣām eva devānāṃ yathārcāyāṃ tathā tapaḥ |
yathāyogaṃ yathadharmaṃ yathāsatyaṃ yathābalam ||
yathāsatvam asau sūryas teṣāṃ siddhis tu tejasā |
bhūtānām aśubhaṃ karma vināśayati tejasā ||
grīṣme hime ca varṣāsu vimucyamānī
dharmaṃ himaṃ ca varṣaṃ ca niśādinaṃ ca |
[774] gacchaty asāv ṛtuvaśāt paricartum asmin
devān pitṝṃś ca manujāṃś ca sa tarpayanti ||
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
dhūpadīpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pṛthak pṛthag arindama ||
evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā sarveṣāṃ tadanantaram |
ghṛtena homaṃ kurvīta sūryasyāṣṭaśatena tu ||
anyeṣāṃ ca tathā dadyād aṣṭāv aṣṭau narottama ||
anyeṣāṃ kamalāvinyastadevānāṃ aṣṭāv aṣṭau āhutaya ity śeṣaḥ |
nāmnā (?) tathaiva sarveṣām ekaikaṃ bhojayed dvijam |
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt teṣām eva yadūttama ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratam etan narottama |
paurāṇikāya viprāya vratasyānte payasvinīm ||
vidhivac ca tato dadyāt susuvarṇaṃ yadūttama |
sarvakāmapradaṃ hy etad vratam uktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ||
vratenānena cīrṇena sūryalokam avāpnuyāt |
atha dvādaśavarṣāṇi karoty enaṃ mahāvratam ||
bhittvārkamaṇḍalaṃ rājan viṣṇoḥ sāyujyatām vrajet |
etad vrataṃ pāpavināśakāri
dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśakāri |
loke tathāsmiṃś ca pare ca rājan
svargaṃ tathā mokṣakaraṃ tathaiva ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sūryavratam |

ṛtaś ca ṛtavādaś ca vidagdhaś cāraṇo dhruvaḥ |
satyo dhātā vai caturthyāṃ śreṇyāṃ ca pārthivaṃ nyaset ||

krīḍitaḥ saptavṛkṣaś ca sarabhaś ca mahāyaśāḥ ||
vinyaset pañcamaśreṇyāṃ saptadevān narādhipa |
dhartā duryodhanir bhīmo aniyuktaḥ kṣayaḥ saha ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca vinyaset śreṇyāṃ saptadevān yathākramam |
dhṛtir vapur anādhṛṣyo vāsaḥ kāmo jayo virāṭ ||
saptabhyāṃ ca tathā śreṇyāṃ vinyaset sapta pārthiva |
prathamā tu bhavet śreṇī yuktā pārthiva saptamī ||
dvitīyā padmapatrābhā tṛtīyā rudhiropamā |
pītavarṇā caturthī syāt pañcamī śuklasaṃnibhā ||
ākāśasaṃnibhā ṣaṣṭhī kṛṣṇavarṇā ca saptamī |
mālyānulepanaṃ deyaṃ tāsāṃ varṇasamaṃ dvija ||
ekonās tatra dātavyā dīpāḥ pañcāśad eva tu |
pṛthak pṛthag devatānāṃ naivedyādi nivedayet ||
ghṛtaṃ ca juhuyād vahnau nāmabhiś ca pṛthak pṛthak |
bhojayed brāḥmaṇāṃś cātra surasiddhasamanvitān ||

paurāṇikāya viprāya vratāne vinivedayet ||
vratasyāsa tu rājendar samyag vipro vidhānavit ||

atha sauravratam |
yaś copavāsī saptamyāṃ samānte hemapaṅkajam |
gāvaś ca śaktito dadyād dhomānte ghaṭasaṃyutāḥ |
etat sauravrataṃ nāma sūryalokapradāyakam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ sauravratam |
atha dhānyasaptamīvratam |
saṃpūjya sitasaptamyāṃ bhānuṃ dhānyāni sapta ca |
dadāti naktabhug gārhyaṃ lavaṇena samanvitam ||
[788] gārhyaṃ (?) gṛhasyopakaraṇam |
saṃtārayati saptānyān kullyān ātmānam eva ca |
etad dhānyavrataṃ nāma vrataṃ dhānyasukhapradam ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ dhānyasaptamīvratam |
atha bhāskaravratam |
kṛtopavāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu saptamyāṃ yas tu mānavaḥ |
karoti vidhitaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhāskaraḥ prīyatām iti |
sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ svargalokam avāpnuyāt ||
iti kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ bhāskaravratam |
atha tapovratam |
māghe niśārdhavāsāḥ syāt saptamyāṃ goprado bhavet |
svargalokam avāpnoti tapovratm ihocyate ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ tapovratam |
athārkasaptamīvratam |
arkasaṃpuṭasaṃyuktam udakaprabhṛtiṃ pibet |
kramād **** [letters broken] caturvaṃśaṃ ekaikaṃ kṣipate punaḥ ||
[789] dvābhyāṃ saṃvatsarābhyāṃ tu samāpya niyamo bhavet |
sarvakāmapradā hy eṣā prasīdaty arkasaptamī ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktam arkasaptamīvratam |
atha putrīyasaptamīvratam |
puṣkara uvāca |
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śuklapakṣe dvijottama |
putrīyāṃ saptamīṃ rāma gṛhṇīyāt prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
atha vā putrakāmaś ca vidhinā tena yat śṛṇu ||
putrīyāṃ putradām |
haviṣyāśī śiraḥsnātaṃ kṛtvā bhāskarapūjanam |
adhaḥśāyī dvitīye ‘hni govṛṣāṇodakena tu ||
snātvā ca lipya ca tathā śubhe deśe tu maṇḍalam |
tatrāṣṭapatrakamalaṃ vinyased varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
tasyaiva karṇikāmadhye bhāśkaraṃ candanena tu |
raktena pūjayed devaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
bhakṣyair bhojyais tathā peyair dhūpair dīpaiś ca bhāskaram |
evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāmapradasya tu ||
naktaṃ bhuñjīta sarvajña (?) sarvakāmavivarjitaḥ |
dantodūkhalako bhūtvā kṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ vratam ||
vratāvasāne dātavyā śaktyā brāhmaṇadakṣiṇā |
tathā trimadhuraprāyaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijabhojanam ||
[790] adhaḥśāyī niśānte ca bhūya eva tathā bhavet ||
putrīyam etad vratam utamaṃ te
mayoditaṃ kalmaṣanāśakāri |
ārādhanaṃ devavarasya rāma
sarvāmayaghnaṃ ca tathaitad uktam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ putrīyasaptamīvratam |
atha kāmavratam |
saptamyāṃ ca tathābhyarcya sūryapatnīṃ suvarcasām |
iṣān kāmān avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ kāmavratam |
atha śailavratam |
iṣṭasya pūjāṃ śailasya tadā pūjya sukhī bhavet |
pūjāṃ tu nāma mantreṇa |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śailavratam |
atha saridvratam |
pūjayitvā sadābhīṣṭaṃ saritaṃ puṇyabhāg bhavet |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ saridvratam |
[791]
atha vahnivratam |
vahisaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā vahniṣṭomam avāpnuyāt |
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ vahnivratam |
atha vāyuvratam |
vāyoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ vāyuvratam |
atha saptarṣivratam |
saṃpūjya ca ṛṣīn sapta sōmasaṃsthā tathā smṛtā |
sapta prāpnoti te evam atimārṣyaṃ ca vindati ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ saptarṣivratam |
atha munivratam |
saptamyāṃ muniśārdūla iṣṭam abhyarcayen munīn |
svādhyāyaphalam (?) āpnoti taddhāmaphalam aśnute ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ munivratam |
atha abhīṣṭasaptamīvratam |
pūjayitvā samudrāṃś ca dīpān nava tadā naraḥ |
pātālāṃś ca mahābhāga bhuvam āpnoty abhīpsitam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam abhīṣṭasaptamīvratam |
[792]
atha saptamīlokavratam |
saptalokāṃs tava bhūpa pūjayitvā sukhī bhavet |
tathaiva mahatīṃ prajñāṃ gatim apratimāṃ bhavet ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ saptamīlokavratam |
atha nadīvratam |
maṅgāḥ (?) saptaprakārāś ca tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm |
saptajñānāny avāpnoti naraḥ pūjayate dhruvam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ nadīvratam |
atha sugativratam |
surendrapūjanaṃ kṛtvā gatim agryāṃ tu vai bhavet |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sugativratam |
atha jayantavratam |
jayantaṃ śakratanayaṃ pūjayec ca sukhī bhavet |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ jayantavratam |
atha vidhānadvādaśasaptamīvratam |
niruktasaptamīnāṃ tu śṛṇu nārada nirṇayam |
yaḥ śāntim adhigaccheta smaraṇāt sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
[793] śātanā sarvapāpānāṃ śātanāṃ namatāṃ viduḥ |
tatropavāsavidhinā dhātāraṃ ya upāgate ||
caitramāse tu saptamyām atirātraphalaṃ labhet |
vaiśākhamāse saptamyāṃ parjanyaṃ yas tu pūjayet ||
cāturmāsasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti tatra vai |
vibhā vibhāvasor dṛṣṭvā bhāśabdo vyāptidīptiṣu ||
vibhā nāma niruktaṃ ca svayam eva vibhāvasuḥ |
saptamyāṃ jyaiṣṭhamāsaṃ tu varuṇaṃ yaḥ samarcayet ||
āptoyāmadaśānāṃ tu phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ |
amṛtārthe yadā devā jayaśabdena niryayuḥ ||
pūjayanti jayāṃ devāmṛtam asyāś ca tat smṛtam |
āṣāḍhamāse sūryaṃ tu saptamyāṃ pūjayen naraḥ ||
aśvamedham avāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet |
saptamyāṃ nirjitā devair asurā dānavās tathā ||
samārādhya suraiḥ sendraiḥ saṃgrāme tārakābhaye |
trailokyaṃ vijayaprāpte tasmād vijayasaptamī ||
yaḥ pūjayati māṃ bhaktyā tasminn ahani mānavaḥ |
snātvā samyag upaspṛśya śuklavāsāḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
sadā yajñopavītī ca brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ |
akrodhano hy acapalaḥ sthiracittaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
dhyānamānaṃ tathā sāmbaṃ matparaḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ |
na ca rajasvalāś caiva sūtikāṃ nāma na spṛśet ||
strīvṛndaṃ nābhibhāṣeta sukhabandhaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
[794] tathā mūtrapurīśaṃ ca niṣṭhīvaṃ ca na laṅghayet ||
mantrpūtenodakena prābhyukṣya vidhivat tadā |
mṛttikām upalimpeta yajamāno varārthikaḥ ||
yathākāloditaiḥ puṣpair dhūpaiś cāpi ravipriyaiḥ |
dīpair lājair yavair mudgais tilaiḥ siddhārthakais tathā ||
candanair hṛdyagandhaiś ca maṇḍalair hy arcayed budhaḥ |
prathame piṇḍikāsthāne bhūrlokaś ca prakīrtitaḥ ||
dvitīye tu bhuvarlokaḥ svas tṛtīya pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
saharlokaś (?) caturthe tu janalokas tu pañcame ||
tapolokas tu vai ṣaṣṭhe satyalokas tu saptame |
maṇḍalaṃ hy arcayed yas tu śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
saptalokāvṛtā devā bhaveus tena pūjitāḥ |
upakrīḍācāhalābhyāṃ yo ‘rcayen mitramaṇḍalam ||
so ‘pi svargasadaiḥ sārdhaṃ modate vigatajvaraḥ |
śīlācāradayāvanto damaśaucasamanvitāḥ ||
maṅgalācārasaṃpannā vedaśāstrāthacintakāḥ |
tebhyo ‘vanitale vipra nādyāmbā vividhas tathā ||
yajanair upahāraiś ca balipātraiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥ |
pāyasaiḥ kṛśarair bhakṣyair māṃsaiś ca vividhais tathā ||
phalamūlais tathā śreṣṭhaiḥ śākaiś cāpi munipriyaiḥ |
dadhnā pūrṇaṃ payaḥpūrṇaṃ guḍapūrṇaṃ tathaiva ca ||
lājāpūrṇaṃ ca dātavyaṃ mantraṃ japyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
[795] saṅgave pūjayed bhaktyā daivajñān śīlasaṃmitān ||
tais tuṣṭais tuṣyate devaḥ sarvān kāmān dadāti ca |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ caiva śṛṇu kīrtayato mama ||
putrapautraiḥ samṛddhanti dhanadhānyagaveḍakaiḥ |
aśvā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi dāsīdāsaś ca labhyate ||
yā nāryaḥ pūjayiṣyanti saptamyāṃ bhaktito ravim |
tā bhāsyayuktāḥ śrīmatyaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ||
priyās tā hi bhaviṣyanti bhartṝṇāṃ svajanasya ca |
sūryaloke ca modante bhartṛbhiḥ sahitāḥ sukham ||
mānuṣyaṃ punar āgatya mahādhanaparigrahe |
mahākule hi jāyante madbhaktā vai bhavanti ca ||
prīṇayet tu prayacchantī śuklā vijayasaptamī |
gāvo hiraṇyavāsāṃsi maṇimuktās tato dhanam ||
arcayetopahāraiś ca bhaktyā nānāvidhais tathā |
pūrṇakāṇi surādīni vyañjanāni madhūni ca ||
śālyodanaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ śākāni vividhāni ca |
phalāni ca yathākālaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtaṃ madhu ||
yat kiṃcid dīyate dānaṃ saptamyām akṣayaṃ tataḥ |
trailokyavijayaprāptis tasmād vijayasaptamī ||
saptamyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi bhāskaraṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
śrāvaṇe māsi saptamyāṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
agniṣṭomam avāpnoti vindate ca mahatśriyaḥ ||
[796] tapaḥ santapanaṃ nāma tāvataḥ proktavān ṛṣiḥ |
marīcasya tu yogena proktā marīcasaptamī ||
phalaṃ tasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ tathāpi ca |
brahmaṇām āditaḥ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
yakṣagandharvapakṣāś ca maharṣipannagā nagāḥ |
vidhyādharāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sahitāś cāpsarogaṇaiḥ ||
udīkṣante bhagavata udayaṃ bhāskarasya ca |
candanānāṃ yathā tādṛk kāṣṭhakūṭair mahojasaḥ ||
hutāśanaś ca bhagavān saptasaptir divākaraḥ |
nirdhūmāṅge samāruhya sarathe ‘ruṇasārathiḥ ||
samuttiṣṭhati dīpāṃśur aṃśubhir bhāsayan nabhaḥ |
jayaśabdena sahitaḥ pūjyamānas tathāsuraiḥ ||
tathāntare vanaṃ yac ca tadādityavanaṃ smṛtam |
śatayojanavistāram āyāmadaśaśo guṇaiḥ ||
tatra te bahavo vṛkṣāḥ viṣayaiḥ pṛthuśākhinaḥ |
tasmād vāyuḥ prabhavati sarvo viṣayasāśrayaḥ ||
prāṇināṃ yojayed vyādhiṃ nityaṃ nānāvidhākṛtam |
yathāmadhyasthasattvās te ṣaṇṇavatyā divākaram ||
śaraṇaṃ devadevasya pṛthivyās tāpaśāntaye |
sa nāśayati sattvānāṃ rogaṃ dehasamudbhavam ||
kuṣṭhadadrūsapiṭakau kaṇḍuṃ śvitrāṇi ślīpadam |
jalodaraṃ tathā gulmam atisāraṃ ca vidrudhim ||
[797] hṛdrogaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca ānāhaṃ sagalagraham |
śiraḥśūlaṃ pārśaśūlam akṣiśūlaṃ visūcikām ||
ādhmākhyaṃ vātamayyambā sāmaṃ vātākhyam eva ca |
kṣayādvitīyakāśaś ca sānnipātika eva ca ||
nityaṃ balakṣayaṃ vyādhiṃ pātrasya yad apācakam (?) |
etāṃś cānyāṃś ca subahūn rogān kramapraṇāśakān ||
sattvanāśāya iti ca āyurdīrghaṃ dadāti ca |
ājñānimeṣamātreṇa samatikramya bhāskaraḥ ||
udayaṃ girim āruhya bhāsayan sarvato diśaḥ |
bhagavān saviṣāgraiś ca muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭhate raviḥ ||
tasminn uditamātre (?) tu śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ vrataṃ dvādaśamāsikam ||
gṛhṇīyān niyataḥ snātaḥ sarvasattvānukampakaḥ |
pūrvāmukhaḥ śucir bhūtvā mihirāya mahātmane |
puṣpopahāraṃ datvā tu dhūpaṃ dadyāt tu veṣṭataḥ ||
praṇatya devaṃ jānubhyāṃ (?) maricaṃ prakṣipen mukhe |
upaspṛśya dinaṃ samyak rātriṃ vopavasen naraḥ ||
tataḥ kalyaṃ samutthāya śuciḥ snātaḥ suvastradhṛk |
prāṅmukhaḥ prayato bhūtvā hṛdi kṛtvā divākaram ||
pūjayed gandhamālyaiś ca dhūpena tu sugandhinā |
pūrvoktena vidhānena bhāskarāya nivedayet ||
upahārais tathā bhakṣyair balipātraiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥ |
mantreṇa caiva dātavyaṃ japtavyaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
[798] mantraḥ oṃ namaḥ sūryāyeti |
vardhamānas tu marīcāny evaṃ māsāṃs tu dvādaśa ||
saptamīṃ śuklapakṣasya yaś cariṣyati mānavaḥ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ caiva śṛṇu kīrtayato mama ||
suvāsā darśanīyaś ca sugandhaś ca svalaṃkṛtaḥ |
suveṣaś ca surūpaś ca bhūtvā sūryaprabho naraḥ ||
iha loke ca dīrghāyuḥ prāpya bhogāṃś ca puṣkalān |
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto dāsīdāsasamanvitaḥ ||
itas tataḥ svargaloke mahat sukham avāpnuyāt |
tasmāc ca punar āvṛtya kule mahati jāyate ||
āḍhyāś ca bahuputraś ca bhogavāṃś ca bhaven naraḥ |
dīkṣitaś cāpi puruṣo bhaven māsāṃs tu dvādaśa ||
marīcasya tu nāmnā ca proktā marīcasaptamī |
yas tu bhādrapade māsi saptamyām indram arcayet ||
upoṣya vidhivat tatra pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet |
maharṣibhis tu bhṛgvādyair dharmalubdhais tapodhanaiḥ ||
ādityas tv arcito yas tu śākamūlapayaḥphalaiḥ |
pratyakṣaṃ darśayāmāsa sahasrākṣas tu gopatiḥ |
vareṇa chandayāmāsa prīto ‘smīti tapodhanāt ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
asmākaṃ vara evāstu prīto yadi divākaraḥ |
īrṣyān na vismayāt krodhāt tapo na kṣayatāṃ vrajet ||
[799] evam astv iti tān uktvā tatraivāntaradhīyata |
phalair yasmāt sahasrāṃśus tuṣṭo ‘smākaṃ mahādyutiḥ. ||
phalena mahatā yuktā nāmāsyāḥ phalasaptamī |
phalasaptamī tu yā caiva vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi tac chṛṇu ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena udayantaṃ divākaram |
snātaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ prāṅmukhaḥ prayataḥ sthitaḥ ||
śvetasrajā samāyukto bhūmo datvānulepanam |
sragbhiḥ puṣpasugandhābhir abhyukṣyārkaṃ nirīkṣya ca ||
jānubhyāṃ patito bhūtvā vāgbhiḥ stutvā divākaram |
dattopahārapuṣpais tu puṣpaiḥ surabhigandhibhiḥ ||
dhūpaṃ datvā tu aguruṃ phalānāṃ puñjam agrataḥ |
yathālābhena saṃbhṛtya bhāskarāya nivedayet ||
āmrāmrātakajambūnāṃ bilvatindukaśākhinām |
parūṣakovidārāṇāṃ kharjūrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||
phalāni caiva deyāni chinnaṃ mlānaṃ vivarjayet |
vratī bhuñjīta niyataḥ prayataḥ syād viśeṣataḥ ||
evaṃ dvādaśasāmānyaiḥ phalavallīcayo naraḥ |
bhavaty arogo dyutimān varṇarūpaśriyānvitaḥ ||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ putrapautraparivṛtaḥ (?) |
bhuktveha mānuṣān bhogān sūryaloke mahīyate ||
tasmāt tu punar āvṛtya māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate |
bahuyogibahudhane kule mahati jāyate ||
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvadevaḥ syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet |
[800] vaiśyo ‘pi labhate bhogān śūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt ||
kṛṣiṃ kuryād yadi naras tv abhyarcya phalasaptamīm |
yavān māṣān kulatthāṃś ca śāligodhūmam eva ca ||
yad dhānyaṃ vapate kṣetre tat tad bahuphalaṃ bhavet |
vāṇijyaṃ kurute digbhyas tathā svaviṣaye punaḥ ||
akleśenaiva paṇyāni vikrīṇīte sukhaṃ naraḥ |
lābho bahuphalaṃ tasya bhavatīha yataḥ phalam ||
yadi prayuñjīta dhanaṃ lābhārthe mānavaḥ kvacit |
bahulābhaṃ bhavet tasya yat prayuṅkte tad āpnuyāt ||
nārībhiḥ phalam āpnoti putrān duhitaraṃ tathā |
eṣā te kathitā tuṣṭā phaladā phalasaptamī ||
tataś cāśvayuje māsi vivasvantam upāsate |
bhakṣyabhojyānnapānaiś ca phalamūlarasais tathā ||
etaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāyuktaṃ śakaṭaṃ dāpayed budhaḥ |
ataḥ śakaṭam ity uktaṃ dhātur eṣo ‘bhipadyate ||
ato ‘nnam arhate yasmāt tasmāt sā tu anodanā |
vājapeyam avāpnoti āsaptakulam uddharet ||
sarvabījauṣadhīḥ sarvā āpātālāgamāś ca yāḥ |
pṛthī rānānurūpeṇa kāle tatra dadāti vai ||
puṣṭyartham auṣadhīnāṃ ca narāṇāṃ balavṛddhaye |
anodanā ca yā caiva śṛṇu tasyāpi nirṇayam ||
saṃvatsaraṃ prayatnena pakṣau cobhau ca mānavaḥ |
pūrvoktena vidhānena bhāskaraṃ cārcayen naraḥ ||
[801] upavāsakṛtāñ caiva teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
tac cāpi parihartavyaṃ tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||
maithunaṃ madhumāṃsaṃ ca gavyam añjanam eva ca |
anṛtaṃ kulasākṣyaṃ ca paradravyaṃ ca varjayet ||
sūtakaṃ mṛtakaṃ caiva varjayec ca rajasvalām |
dvāviṣe māsi rakṣed yaḥ piteva svasutān yathā ||
paripālya prayatnena iha loke paratra ca |
anena vidhinā yena ye kurvanti ca saptamīm ||
labhante nikhilān kāmān patīṃ ca prāpnyān naraḥ |
nadyādiśatruśamanaṃ bhogān prāpnoti puṣkalān ||
tasmāc ca punar āvṛttaḥ kule mahati jāyate |
ratnavaidūryarucirair veṇuvīṇāvinoditaiḥ ||
upagīyamāno ‘psarobhiḥ sukhaṃ vai śāśvataṃ labhet |
divyalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
tasmin tapasi kṣīne ca naraḥ kṣitim avāpya ca |
bahubhoge bahudhane kule mahati tejasā ||
sūryasaṅkāso lokānāṃ bālacandra iva priyaḥ |
tenaivābhyāsayogena tv abhyasyati punaḥ punaḥ ||
yo māṃ mitrasya divase yajed vai mitratejasā |
upavāsī śucir bhūtvā hy abhyarcanaparāyaṇaḥ ||
brāḥmaṇān bhojakāṃś caiva yathāśaktyā ca pūjayet |
[802] sa tais tu tuṣyate devaḥ sarvakāmaprado bhavet ||
īpsitān labhate kāmān viśeṣeṇa tu mānavaḥ |
mihire trividhaṃ yac ca pratimāvyōmamaṇḍalam ||
sarvākṛti bhaved vyoma catuḥśṛṅgasamanvitam |
caturasraṃ samaṃ sāraṃ tanmadhye vyomamaṇḍalam ||
ucchayādyatribhāgena dvau bhāgau madhyataḥ kṣipet |
vistāraṃ ca caturbhāgaṃ catuḥśṛṅgonnataṃ śubham ||
caturdaśaṃ tu ye lokā brahmāṇḍasya ca madhyataḥ |
gamāgame nivarteta kriyākāraṇasaṃśrayāt ||
kalpito ‘yaṃ yadā madhye merulokanibandhanaḥ |
nābhībandhanasaṃbhūtā merulokāntare ‘bdhayaḥ ||
divyadhātumayaś citraḥ sarvadevair abhiṣṭutaḥ |
abje caturdale dikṣu karṇikety abhiśabditaḥ ||
caturvarṇaḥ sasauvarṇaś caturjātisamanvitaḥ |
sthitā tasyāpsaraḥ siddhā munividyādharādayaḥ ||
śakro yamo ‘tha varuṇaḥ kubero ‘gnipuraḥsaraḥ |
lokapālāgrahānāgās tārakāś cānyadevatāḥ ||
devapatnyo mātaraś ca tridevādyāḥ smṛtās tathā |
ātodyanṛtyagītais tu muditaś ca tathā bhavet ||
svayaṃbūr bhagavān meruḥ pūjito nātra saṃśayaḥ |
rasān dadāti yasmād vai rasād anne nabhaḥ smṛtā ||
khageṣu dātā sa proktaḥ pūjyate hy aryamā tataḥ |
nārcayiṣyanti ye mohān mauḍhyopahatacetasaḥ ||
[803] daivatas tatra yat pāpaṃ bhāgyatas tu labhed iti |
tasyāṃ tithau tu yaḥ kaścid ādityārcanatatparaḥ ||
sarvatīrthe bhavet snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet |
tathā mārgaśire māsi saptamī kīrtitā śubhā ||
tasmiṃl layaṃ yāti jagat samastaṃ
trailokyasaṃrakṣaṇa-udyato yaḥ |
sphītāsamasyā vasudhā samagrā
mitraprasādād bhavate hy arogāḥ ||
paryāyanāmnā tu tathopadiṣṭā
sūryasya sā saptamipūjanīyā |
vratopavāsaṃ kurute tu kaścit
dāridryapāśaṃ sa chinatti cāśu ||
daśāśvamedhā khalu tena iṣṭā
vidhānato vai munayo vadanti ||
pauṣe pūṣaṇam abhyarcya saptamyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ |
jātismaratvaṃ labhate naramedhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
pauṣe prāpuḥ supuṣṭiṃ te pitaro devamānavāḥ |
pūṣṇivotpāditā yoṣit puṣṭis tena tavocyate ||
māghamāse tu saptamyāṃ trirātraṃ niyato bhavet |
japet ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ nābhimātrajalāntataḥ |
japec cāṣṭasahasrāṇi viṣṇor abhimukhasthitaḥ ||
oṃ namaḥ sūryāyeti ṣaḍakṣaramantraḥ |
īpsitān labhate kāmān sarvān saṃpādayed raviḥ |
[804] īpsitā sā samākhyātā lokānāṃ viṣṇunā svayam ||
phalaṃ bahusuvarṇasya naraḥ prāpnoti sarvadā |
māse tu dvādaśe yas tu saptamyāṃ bhagam arcayet ||
rājasūyam avāpnoti gacchec cārkasalokatām |
phālgune caiva saptamyāṃ siddhārthāḥ siddhasaṃpadaḥ ||
varaṃ me siddhaval lokasiddhasaṃkalpajāḥ smṛtāḥ |
jahyād yathoragaḥ kṛttiṃ timiraṃ bhāskaro yathā |
vyādhidāridryapañcatvaṃ tathaiva tyajate naraḥ ||
dvādaśasaptamīṣu sūryaḥ pūjyaḥ tadrūpam ārogyaṃ pratipadyate pūjā tu nāma mantreṇa |
evaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃs tu hy arcayet satataṃ ravim |
aṣṭau kratusahasrāṇi tena sarvasadakṣiṇāḥ ||
sarvatīrthe bhavet snātaḥ sarvadānāni yacchati |
pakṣe pakṣe hy upavaset saptamyām arkapūjane ||
strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti vaśyāś cāpi bhavanti vai |
rājasūyam avāpnoti gacched arkasalokatām ||
mokṣadvāram avāpnoti bhānuvac carate divi |
vidhidṛṣṭo rahasyena nāradena maharṣiṇā ||
ity ādityapurāṇoktāni vividhāni dvādaśasaptamīvratāni |
[805]
atha puraścaraṇasaptamīvratam |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
puraścaraṇasaṃjñāṃ tu saptamīṃ vada sūtaja |
vidhinā kena kartavyā kasmin kāle upasthite ||
sūta uvāca |
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi rohitāśvasya bhūpateḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyena purā proktaṃ pṛcchamānena bhaktitaḥ |
saptakalpasmaro vipro mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ |
