rohitāśvena pṛṣṭaḥ sa haritaś candrātmajena ca ||
rohitāśva uvāca |
ajñānāj jñānato vāpi yat pāpaṃ kurute naraḥ |
upāyaṃ cāsya nāśāya kiṃcin me vada sanmune ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ ca tṛtīyakam |
trividhaṃ pātakaṃ loke narāṇām iha jāyate ||
paścāttāpe kṛte tasya tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati |
mānasaṃ caiva yat pāpaṃ yaduktaiḥ saṃprajāyate ||
gurūṇāṃ vacanāt tac ca sarvam eva praṇaśyati |
[806] puraścaraṇakāryevaṃ satyam etan mayoditam ||
naivedyaṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ tad uktaṃ sa samācaret |
prāyaścittaṃ yathoktaṃ tu tataḥ śuddhim avāpnuyāt ||
atha vā pārthivo jñātvā kurute tasya nigraham |
tena śuddhim avāpnoti yady api syāc ca kilbiṣī (?) ||
lajjayā brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ yo na brūte kathaṃcana |
na ca rājā vijānāti śarīrasthena yo mriyet ||
tasya vigrahakartā ca svayaṃ vaivasvato yamaḥ |
tasmāt pāpaṃ prayatnena kṛtvā pāpaṃ vijānatā ||
prāyaścittaṃ tu kartavyaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmaṇoditam |
sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ vihitānāṃ munīśvara ||
kiṃcid vrataṃ samācakṣva dānaṃ vā homam eva vā |
pipāpmā [vipāpmā?] jāyate yena puraścaraṇasevanāt ||
vratāni kurute yo vai naraḥ sūkṣmāṇi sarvataḥ |
prāyaścittāni sarveṣāṃ kartuṃ śaktaḥ kathaṃcana ||
mārkaṇḍaye uvāca |
asti rājan vrataṃ puṇyaṃ puraścaraṇasaṃjñitam |
puraścaraṇasaṃjñāṃ ca saptamīṃ sūryavallabhām ||
yathā sarvātmanā rājan kāyastho yamasaṃbhavaḥ |
vicitro mārjayaty atra śataṃ pāpasya lekhanam ||
tasmāt kuru mahārāja yathāvad vacanaṃ mama |
yena vā mucyate pāpāt sarvasmāt kāyasaṃbhavāt ||
[807] rohitāśva uvāca |
puraścaraṇasaṃjñāṃ tu saptamīṃ munisattama |
vidhinā kena kartavyā kasmin kāle vadasva me ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
māghamāse vare pakṣe makarasthe divākare |
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa vratam etat samācaret ||
pāṣaṇḍaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ sārdhaṃ tasminn ahani varjayet |
bhakṣayitvā nṛpaśreṣṭha prabhāte dantadhānavam ||
mantreṇānena paścāc ca kartavyo niyamo nṛpa |
puraścaraṇakṛt pāpāt saptamyāṃ divasādhipa ||
upavāsaṃ kariṣyāmi adya tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ mama |
tato ‘parāhṇasamaye snātvā dhautāmbaraḥ śuciḥ ||
pratimāṃ pūjayed bhaktyā dinādhipasamudbhavām |
raktaiḥ puṣpair mahāvīra pādau saṃpūjayet tataḥ ||
pataṅgāya namaḥ pādau mārtaṇḍāya ca jānunī |
guhyaṃ divasanāthāya nābhiṃ divasamūrtaye ||
bāhuṃ ca padmahastāya hṛdayaṃ tīkṣṇadīdhite |
kambuṃ padmadalābhīṣṭaśiśnaṃ (?) tejomayāya ca ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad rūpaṃ karpūram ādahet |
guḍodanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ raktavastrābhiveṣṭitam ||
raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca tathaivāratrikaṃ nṛpa |
śaṅkhe toyaṃ samādāya raktacandanamiśritam ||
saphalaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā ardhyaṃ dadyāt tataḥ param |
[808] duṣkṛtaṃ yat kṛtaṃ kiṃcid ajñānāj jñānato ‘pi vā ||
prāyaścitte kṛte deva mamārghyaś ca pragṛhyatām |
tataḥ saṃpūjitaṃ vipraṃ gandhadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
datvā tu bhojanaṃ tasmai dakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ |
prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ pañcagavyaṃ samācaret ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā samudīkṣya divākaram |
divākaraṃ nataś (?) caiva mantram etaṃ samuccaret ||
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva gṛhītaṃ puratas tava |
avighnasiddhim āyātu prasādāt tava bhāskara ||
tatas tu phālguṇe māsi saṃprāpte nṛpanandana |
kundena pūjayed devaṃ tenaiva vidhinā tataḥ ||
dhūpaṃ ca guggulaṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ bhaktam eva ca |
prāśanaṃ gomayaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||
caitramāse gaṇakāḥ proktaṃ dhūpaṃ kharjūrasodbhavam |
kuśodakaṃ ca samprāśya kāyaśuddhim avāpnuyāt ||
vaiśākhe kiṃśukaiḥ pūjyaṃ yathāvac ca samācaret |
ghṛtāśanaiś ca naivedyaṃ purāmāṃsaṃ ca pūpakam ||
dadhiprāśanam evātha kartavyaṃ kāyaśodhanam |
jyaiṣṭhe pāṭalayā pūjā vidhātavyā raver nṛpa ||
dhūpaṃ ca guggulaṃ caiva raveḥ prītikaraṃ param |
naivedye saktavaḥ proktāḥ prāśanaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ smṛtam ||
ghṛtaṃ praṇāśanakaraṃ kapilāyā viśuddhaye |
[809] āṣāḍhe munipuṣpaiś ca pūjayed bhāskaraṃ nṛpa ||
dhūpaṃ caivāguruṃ dadyāt śraddhayā parayā nṛpa |
naivedyaṃ ghārikā proktaṃ prāśanaṃ madhunā saha ||
śrāvaṇe tu kadambena pūjanaṃ tīkṣṇadīdhiteḥ |
naivedye modakāś caiva tagaraṃ dhūpam āharet ||
gośṛṅgodakam āsādya sarvapāpād vimucyate |
jātyā bhādrapade pūrvaṃ kṣīraṃ naivedyam ācaret ||
dhūpaṃ nakhīsamudbhūtaṃ prāśanaṃ kṣīram eva ca |
āśvine kamalaiḥ pūjā naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūrikā ||
dhūpaṃ kuṅkumaṃ saṃproktaṃ karpūraṃ prāśanaṃ smṛtam |
tulasyā kārtike pūjā bhāskarasya prakīrtitā ||
naivedyaṃ caiva mṛṣṭānnaṃ dhūpaṃ kausumbhakaṃ nṛpa |
prāśanaṃ calicaṅgākhyaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam ||
bhṛṅgarājena pūjāṃ ca saumye māsi samācaret |
naivedyaṃ karṇikā deyā dhūpaṃ guḍasamudbhavam ||
kakkolaprāśanaṃ caiva bhāskarasya pratuṣṭaye |
śatapatracayaiḥ pūjā pauṣe māsi raveḥ smṛtā ||
sahajaṃ dhūpam ādiṣṭaṃ naivedyaṃ sakulīyakam |
prāśane pūrvam uktāni sarvāṇy eva samācaret ||
samāptau tu tato dadyāt (?) ṣaḍbhājāṃ gṛhasaṃbhavāṃ |
brāhmaṇāya nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||
iṣṭabhojyaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ svaśaktyā pārthivottama |
evaṃ tu kurute yas tu saptamīṃ bhāskarodbhavām ||
[810] sarvapāpavinirmukto nirmalatvaṃ ca gacchati |
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ |
evaṃ purā vai kathitā rohitāśvāya dhīmate |
mārkaṇḍeyena mahābhāga tasmāt tvam api tāṃ kuru ||
iti skānde nāgarakhaṇḍoktaṃ puraścaraṇasaptamīvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvara
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe saptamīvratāni |
[811]
atha dvādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ
athāṣṭamīvratāni
jagattrayīmaṇḍapamaṇḍayitrī
yat kīrtivallījanamānasānām |
nihanti santāpam aśeṣaśoṣā
hemādir āha vratam aṣṭamīṣu ||
tatra jayantīvratam ucyate | viṣṇudharmottare |
pulastya uvāca |
rohiṇyaś ca yadā kṛṣṇe pakṣe ‘ṣṭamyāṃ dvijottama |
jayantī nāma sā proktā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ ||
yad bālye yac ca kaumāre yauvane vārdhake tathā |
bahujanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hanti sopoṣitā tithiḥ ||
vahnipurāṇe |
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bhaved yatra kalaukā rohiṇī nṛpa |
jayantī nāma sā proktā upoṣyā sā prayatnataḥ ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ rājan jagatyāṃ trividhaṃ nṛṇām |
tat kṣālayati govinda tithau tasmin subhāvitaḥ ||
upavāsaś ca tatrokto mahāpātakanāśanaḥ |
[812] jagatyāṃ jagatīpāla vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva rājan kṛtayuge purā |
rohiṇīsaṃyutā ceyaṃ vidvadbhiḥ samupoṣitā ||
viyoge pāraṇaṃ cakrur munayo brahmavādinaḥ |
sāṃyogike vrate prāpte yatraiko ‘pi viyujyate ||
tatraiva pāraṇaṃ kuryād evaṃ vedavido viduḥ |
ataḥ śṛṇu mahīpāla saṃprāpte tāmase kalau |
janmato vāsudevasya bhavitā vratam uttamam ||
janmato hetau pañcamī | bhavitā bhaviṣyati
ārādhitas tu devakyā viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaraḥ purā |
samāyoge tu rohiṇyā niśīthe rājasattama |
samajāyata govindo bālarūpaś caturbhujaḥ ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatāṃ nāthaṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam |
devakī prāñjalir bhūtvā idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
devaky uvāca |
na viyogaṃ ca saṃsoḍhuṃ sauhārdhāt padmalocana |
tadedṛgrūpam ālokya śaṅken ha (?) madhusūdana ||
vāsudeva uvāca |
tvaṃ māṃ drakṣyasya saṃdigdhaṃ dine ‘smiṃś caiva bhāmini |
tava darśanam eṣyāṇi bālarūpeṇa devaki ||
saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamyāṃ niśīthe rohiṇī yadi |
[813] bhavitā saptamī puṇyā yāvac candradivākarau ||
ye tvāṃ puṣpādibhir devīṃ pūjayiṣyanti mānavāḥ |
dine ‘smin māṃ mahābhāgā tavotsaṅge vyavasthitam ||
dāsyanti ye niśīthe ‘rghyaṃ rohiṇyā sahite vidhau |
rohiṇyā sahitaṃ cendraṃ kṛtvā raupyamayaṃ budhaḥ ||
dvādaśāṅgulavistāraṃ tatrārghyaṃ saṃniveśayet |
suvarṇena kṛte pātre rājate vā narottama ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti iha loke paratra ca |
śaṅkhe toyaṃ samādāya sapuṣpaphalakāñcanam ||
jānum ekaṃ dharāṃ kṛtvā candrāyārghyaṃ
nivedya lokānām upakārakam |
anaghasvapadaṃ sadyaḥ pumān saṃkīrtanād api |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe dāmpatyaṃ darbhanirmitam ||
anaghaṃ vānaghīṃ caiva bahuputraiḥ samanvitam |
sthāpayitvā śubhe deśe gomayenānulepite (?) ||
snātvā samarcayet puṣpaiḥ sugandhaiś cānulepanaiḥ |
ṛgvedenoktamantraiś ca daṇḍakaṃ manasā smaran ||
anaghaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu patnī tasyāsthisaṃbhavā |
pradumnādiputravargaṃ harivaṃśe yathoditam ||
oṃ ato devā avantvādimantrāḥ proktā dvijātiṣu |
ato gevā avantvityādi bahvṛcaprasiddhāḥ |
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa strīśūdrāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
kālodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ kandaiḥ bhṛṅgārais tu navaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
[814] bhṛṅgāraṃ kalaśaḥ |
virūḍhadhānyair dhūpaiś ca dīpair gandhaiḥ sudhūpakaiḥ |
tato dvijān bhojayitvā suḥrtsaṃbandhibāndhavān ||
teṣāṃ madhyeṣu dṛḍhavāg anaghavratapāragaḥ |
bhuktvāvasāne gṛhṇīyāt kiṃcid ekaṃ mahāvratam ||
idaṃ jīvan na haniṣye satyaṃ satyaṃ mahoditam |
varṣam ekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā idaṃ tad anaghaṃ smṛtam ||
rātrau prekṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ naṭanartakagāyakaiḥ |
prabhāte ca navamyāṃ ca toyamadhye visarjayet ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha varṣe varṣe ‘naghārcanam |
bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ sa evānagha ucyate ||
iha kīrtim avāpyoccaiḥ mṛto yāti hareḥ padam |
ārogyaṃ saptajanmāni putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ ||
avāpyāṣṭamiyogena tataḥ siddhim avāpnuyāt |
etām aghaughaśamanīm anaghāṣṭamīti
kaunteya saṃprati mayā kathitā hitāya |
kurvanti nānyamanasaḥ svayam ābhivṛddhau
vṛddhiṃ prayānti kṛtavīrya sutānurūpām ||
iti bhaviṣyottare anaghāṣṭhamīvrataṃ nāma |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ pārtha śṛṇu pāpaharaṃ param |
dharmasya jananaṃ loke rudraprītikaraṃ param ||
[815] mārgaśīrṣe ‘tha vaimāsi dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryān naktasya ca vratī ||
samarthāsamarthabhedena vyavasthito vikalpaḥ |
aśvatthavaṛodumbaraplakṣajambūkadambakam |
drākṣākaustubhakāmrātakarīrārjunajātijam ||
dantadhāvanakaṃ kuryāt pratimāsaṃ yathākramam |
karavīraṃ kumbhapuṣpaṃ marukaṃ kuṃśukaṃ tathā ||
candanaṃ bilvapatraṃ ca pāṭalām bhojamallikām |
jātī ca śatapatrāṇi svarṇapuṣpāṇi vā kramāt ||
kṣīrīyakṛśaraś caiva modakāmaṇḍakās tathā |
vaṭakāghārikā pūpād adhibhaktaṃ ca pūrikā ||
guḍodanaṃ (?) śarkarā ca naivedyāni ghṛtaṃ tathā |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ varṣam ekaṃ guror agre śivasya ca ||
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivajalpaparāyaṇaḥ |
vibhāge divasasyeha kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
gatvā śivālayaṃ pārtha guror agre śivasya ca |
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivārcanaparāyaṇaḥ ||
vibhāge divasasyeha kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
gatvā śivālayaṃ pārtha pañcāmṛtapuraḥ saram ||
snapanaṃ kārayitvātha liṅgasya varavāriṇā |
candanenānulipyātha pūjayet kusumottamaiḥ ||
dhūpaṃ vāgurumiśraṃ ca devadevasya bhaktitaḥ |
[816] śivasūktena kartavyaṃ śivasūktair dvijottamaiḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe tathā māsi śaṅkarety abhipūjayet |
gomayaṃ prāg aśitvā ca svaped rātrau jitendriyaḥ ||
pratimāsaṃ śivasyāgre homaṃ kṛṣṇatilair nṛpa |
atirātrasya yajñasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
evaṃ puṣye tu saṃpūjya śambhuṃ nāma maheśvaram |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ||
gomūtraṃ prāśayitvā ca svaped bhūmau jitendriyaḥ |
māghe maheśvaraṃ nāma devadevasya pūjayet ||
gokṣīraṃ niśi saṃprāśya gomedhaphalam āpnuyāt |
phālgune ca mahādevaṃ saṃpūjya prāśayet tilān ||
rājasūyasya yajñasya prāpnoty avikalaṃ phalam |
caitre sthāṇuṃ samabhyarcya yavān saṃbhāśya bhaktitaḥ ||
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
vaiśākhe śivam abhyarcya prāśayec ca kuśodakam ||
phalamedhāt phalaṃ yajñād bhaktitaḥ prāpnuyān naraḥ |
jyaiṣṭhe paśupatiṃ pūjyā gavāṃ śṛṅgodakaṃ pibet ||
gosahasrapradānasya phalam āpnoty anuttamam |
āṣāḍhe cogranāmānaṃ pūjayed bhaktitatparaḥ ||
gomayaṃ prāśayed ratrau sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ labhet |
śrāvaṇe sarvanāmānaṃ pūjayitvā jitendriyaḥ ||
prāśayed arkapatrāgraṃ tasmin sarveśvaraṃ yajet |
bahusvarṇasya yajñasya phalam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
[817] māsi bhādrapade ‘ṣṭamyāṃ tryambakaṃ nāma pūjayet |
bilvapatraṃ niśi prāśya grāmadānaphalaṃ labhet ||
āśvine bhavanāmānaṃ pūjayed bhaktitatparaḥ |
prāśayet taṇḍulajalam agnihotraphalaṃ labhet ||
kārttike rudranāmānaṃ saṃpūjya prāśayed apaḥ |
caturṇām api vedānām adhyāpanaphalaṃ labhet ||
āpośānavad aśnīyād dravadravyaṃ sakṛd vratī |
aṅguṣṭhopakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ gṛhītvā patitodakam ||
ity uktaiś ca tathaivānyaiḥ puṣpādyaiś ca yathākramāt |
saṃpūjya prārthayed īśaṃ mantreṇānena bhaktmān ||
viśvātman sumahādeva vrate vāsmin tvayoditam |
dantadhāvananaivedyaṃ kusumaprāśanādikam ||
mohād vā yadi vā lobhān na kṛtaṃ yad amantravat |
prasādāt tava tac chambhoḥ paripūrṇaṃ mahāmune ||
māsi māsi yajed evaṃ liṅgamūrtiṃ maheśvaram |
atha cārcākṛtiṃ rudraṃ somaṃ kumbhoparisthitam ||
somam umāsahitam | rūpanirmāṇaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottare |
vāmārdhe pārvatī kāryā śivaḥ kāryaś caturbhujaḥ |
akṣamālāṃ triśūlaṃ ca tasya dakṣiṇahastayoḥ ||
darpaṇendīvarau kāryau vāmayor yadunandana |
ekabhakto bhavec chumbhur dātā ca dayitātanuḥ ||
trinetraś ca mahādevaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
[818] mantrapūrvaṃ tu vidhivat pūjayec chaṅkaraṃ vratī ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṣu sarvāsu śivabhaktān yatīn sadā |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān śaktyā dadyāt tebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām ||
vratānte śaṅkaraṃ kṛtvā sauvarṇaṃ pratimākṛtim |
śaṅkaram umāsahimam iti śeṣaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tathā rātrau devaṃ samadhivāsayet ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalair dhūpair naivedair vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
pūjā stutikathābhis tu kārayec ca mahotsavam ||
nivedayet tatheśāya śayyāṃ sopaskarānvitām |
vitānaṃ vyajanaṃ ghatraṃ ghaṇṭābhāratrikādikam ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā cābhyarcya śūlinam |
kṛtvābhikāryau viprāya śivāyai tat samarpayet ||
vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ gāṃ ca kṛṣṇatilair yutām |
prīyatāṃ me śivo nityam ity uktvā vidhivat tataḥ ||
tatas tu bhojayed viprān śivabhāktām svabhaktitaḥ |
pāyasenājyayuktena dadyāt teṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||
śaktyā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi śivadhyānaikamānasaḥ |
śikhāpya śivaśastrāṇi dadyāc ca śivatuṣṭaye ||
sajalāḥ kṛṣṇakalaśās tilair bhakṣyaiḥ samanvitāḥ |
dvādaśānnaṃ pradātavyaṃ chatropānadyugānvitam ||
vācakāya pradātavyā gaiḥ kṛṣṇā tu payasviṇī |
sopaskarā tu rudhro me prīyatām iti kīrtayet ||
[819] rudrāya kṛṣṇakalaśān laḍḍukāṃś ca vitānakam |
dhvajaṃ kiṅkiṇisaṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇam evātra kalpayet ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha vratam etad anuttamam |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||
indrādyais tridaśaiś cīrṇaṃ vratam etan mahāphalam |
devatvam āpuḥ sarve te vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
guṇatvam āyuś ca gaṇādhirājatām | guṇagrahatvaṃ ca tathāguṇagrahaḥ |
bahunātra kim uktena toṣam āyāti śaṅkaraḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratenaha bhaktyācīrṇena pāṇdava ||
na tathā tapasā dattair vratais tīrthābhiṣecanaiḥ |
ity etat te samākhyātaṃ pārtha kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam ||
yac chrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī vratam idaṃ śivabhāvitātmā
saṃprāśanair uditanāmayutair upoṣya
kṛṣṇān dadāti kalaśān nṛpa gāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ
yo ‘sau prayāti padam uttamam indumauleḥ ||
iti bhaviṣottaroktaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
śṛṇu dālbha paraṃ kāmyaṃ vrataṃ santatidaṃ nṛṇām |
yasmin cīrṇe na vicchedaḥ pitṛpiṇḍasya jāyate ||
[820] kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caitramāse snāto niyatamānasaḥ |
kṛṣṇam abhyarcya pūjāṃ ca devakyāṃ kurute tu yaḥ ||
nirāhāro japan nāma kṛṣṇasya jagataḥ pateḥ |
upaviṣṭo japan snātaḥ kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu ||
pūjāyāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya saptavārān prakīrtayet |
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān nālapen naiva nāstikān ||
prabhāte vāmbunā snāto dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām |
bhuñjīta kṛtapūjaś ca kṛṣṇasyaiva jagatpateḥ ||
vaiśākhajyaiṣṭhyoś caiva pāraṇaṃ hi trimāsikam |
upoṣya devadeveśaṃ ghṛtena snāpayet harim ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā |
tathaivāśvayuje māsi kṛtvā māsatrayaṃ tathā ||
upoṣya pūjayed devaṃ haviṣā pāraṇe gate |
pauṣamāghe phālgune ca naras tadvad upoṣitaḥ ||
caturthe pāraṇe pūrṇe ghṛtena snāpayed dharim |
evaṃ kṛtopavāsasya puruṣasya tathā striyaḥ ||
na santateḥ paricchedaḥ kadācid api jāyate |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīm imāṃ yas tu naro yoṣid athāpi vā ||
upoṣyati ca sāhlādaṃ trilokyāṃ prāpya nirvṛtam |
putrapautrasamṛddhiṃ ca mṛtaḥ svarge (?) mahīyate ||
[821] ity etat kathitaṃ dālbha mayā kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam |
viṣṇur uvāca |
kanyāgate savitari kṛṣṇapakṣe ‘ṣṭamī tu yā |
sā ca pāpaharā puṇyā śivasyānandavardhinī ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam |
sarvaprītikaraṃ syād dhi vrataṃ tasyāṃ trilocane ||
viśeṣataḥ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ homaṃ (?) ca vikhivan mune |
tasmāt śrāddhaṃ prayatnena tasyāṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ ||
ekabhaktaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ vidur budhāḥ |
upavāsaṃ tu saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pūjayec chivam ||
pūjayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā pituḥ śrāddhaṃ tu kalpayet |
kṛtvā tu vidhivac chrāddhaṃ bhuñjīta pitṛsevitam ||
yas tasyāṃ kurute śrāddhaṃ pūjayitvā trilocanam |
tasya varṣāṇi tṛptā sthaḥ pitaro daśa pañca ca ||
evaṃ vratam idaṃ kṛtvā svam ekaṃ caivam ādarāt |
svam ekaṃ saṃvatsaram |
nāmabhiḥ pūjayed devaṃ tripurāntakaraṃ param ||
māsi bhādrapade śambhuṃ śaṅkaraṃ tu tathā pare |
śivaṃ tu kārttike māsi sarvaṃ mārgaśire tathā ||
pauṣe māsi tathaiśanam ugraṃ mādhe prakīrtitam |
phālgune tu ināmānaṃ caitre rudraṃ prakīrtayet ||
vaiśākhe nīlakaṇṭhaṃ tu jyaiṣṭhe nāma bhavaṃ param |
[822] mahādevaṃ tathāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe tryambakaṃ dvija ||
etāni māsanāmāni prāśanāni nibodha me |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ||
gorocanāṃ pañcagavyaṃ mandaronmṛttikāṃ tathā |
tilānnaṃ ca tathā kṣīraṃ prāśayet kāyaśuddhaye ||
vahnipuṣpāṇi te vīra devadevasya prītaye |
karavīraṃ tathā jātiṃ pippalātikadambakam ||
unmattakaṃ tathā bilvaṃ śamīpatraṃ kadambakam |
mālatīkusumaṃ vipra tathā mudgarakasya ca ||
kuśapuṣpaṃ tathā puṇyam agastikusumaṃ tathā |
sihlakaṃ vijayaṃ dhūpaṃ mahiṣāṣyaṃ ca guggulam ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed devaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tripurāntakam |
svam ekam ekaṃ viprendra sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
brāhmaṇān pūjayed yas tu vācakaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
mahādevasya vai bhaktān bhaktyā pāśupatān dvijān ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddham aṣṭamyām aṣṭakāsu ca |
pūjayitvā sureśānaṃ śivaviprair manīṣibhiḥ ||
tṛpyanti pitaras tasya varṣāṇi daśapañcakam |
divyāni muniśārdūla sapta sapta ca sapta ca ||
ya evaṃ pālayed bhaktyā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vrataṃ param |
yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhīpseta taṃ taṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
[823] putrakāmo labhet putraṃ dhanakāmo dhanāni ca |
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ kanyārthī kanyakāṃ parām ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śivakṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam |
atha kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam |
devy uvāca |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vidhānaṃ vai nikhilaṃ kriyate tathā |
krameṇa me tathā brūhi tat kartavyaṃ sureśvara ||
īśvara uvāca |
hemante tv atha saṃprāpte māsi mārgaśire tathā |
naktaṃ kṛtvā śucir bhūtvā gomūtraṃ prāśayen niśi ||
naktaṃ kṛtvā naktakalpaḥ |
āhared vāśanaṃ yatra yathānnaṃ ca tathāśayet |
tena naktaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ prāśitenāśitena ca || iti |
tena naktaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ prāśitena ceti | kvacit prāśitena kvacid aprāśitenety arthaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyaṃ vidhānaṃ vai śaṅkaraṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ |
atirātrasya yajñasya phalam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
smarec ca śaṅkaraṃ nāma sāyaṃ rātrau divā yathā |
pauṣe gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya naktaṃ kṛtvā tu mānavaḥ ||
bhaktyā tu pūjayec chambhuṃ bhāvitastutitatparaḥ |
vājapeyāṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
māghe māheśvaraṃ nāma kṣīraprāśanam ādiśet |
[824] anāhāraḥ svaped rātrau śaṅkaraṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
nāma japtvā maheśasya gomedhāṣṭakam āpnuyāt |
phālgune tu mahādevaṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ parikīrtayet ||
tilān prāśya anāhāro niśi japtvā samāhitaḥ |
japan nāmātha devasya saṃsmaran śaṅkaraṃ tathā ||
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet |
japan nāmāni pūrvatra mahādeveti kathyate ||
caitre sthāṇuṃ samabhyarcya pūjayan bhakṣayan madhu |
rātrau saṃprāśya vidhivad anāhāraḥ svapen niśi ||
sthāṇuṃ jayā mahāmantram aśvamedhāṣṭakaṃ bhavet |
kuśodakaṃ vai vaiśākhe śivaṃ devaṃ prapūjayet ||
mantraṃ tatra śivaṃ japtvā naramedhaphalaṃ labhet |
jyaiṣṭhe paśupatiṃ nāma gavāṃ śṛṅgodakaṃ pibet ||
japtvā paśupatiṃ vipra gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ labhet |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyām athāṣāḍhe ugraṃ nāma prakīrtayet ||
prāśayed gomayaṃ tatra sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ labhet |
ugraṃ japati yo mantraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam ||
naktaṃ tu prāśayed arghyaṃ smaran mantraṃ subhāvitaḥ |
sarveti śrāvaṇe proktaḥ sarvakāmakṣayaṃ phalam ||
tryambakaṃ tu japed arkaṃ smaran mantraṃ subhāvitaḥ |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
ambakaṃ ca japed yo vai māsi bhādre tathāṣṭamīm |
[825] prāśayed bilvapatraṃ tu śrutidīkṣāphalaṃ labhet ||
ambakaṃ saṃsmaret tatra ekacittaḥ (?) subhāvitaḥ |
māsi cāśvayuje vīra prāśanaṃ taṇḍulodakam ||
nāmnā īśaṃ smared evaṃ puṇḍarīkāṣṭakaṃ labhet |
rudraṃ tu kārttike māsi dadhi prāśya subhāvitaḥ ||
rātrau saṃsmarate rudraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalāṣṭakam avāpnuyāt ||
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ na sidhyati |
mantreṇa hi vinā devi yatnenāpi vṛthā bhavet ||
tat sarvaṃ ca prayatnena mantram etam udīrayet |
samāpte tu vrate devi varṣānte tu mahāphalam |
yasyaiva tu prasādena padaṃ yāti nirāmayam ||
yasya mantrasyeti śeṣaḥ |
hemante śiśire caiva tathā śaradi śobhane |
vrataṃ nivedayet śambhau tvatprasādāt sureśvara ||
saṃpūrṇaṃ hi vrataṃ deva kṛtaṃ paramapūjitam |
evaṃ nivedya deveśa sāṃnidhyo bhava śaṅkara ||
tvatprasādāt sureśāna yathāśakti japāmy aham |
kandamūlaphalair vāpi varṣānte tarpaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
brāhmaṇāṃś ca yathā śaktyā śivabhaktān dṛḍhavratān |
arcayet parayā bhaktyā kriyatāṃ me anugrahaḥ ||
vratasya tarpaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kariṣye śivacoditam |
[926] tarpaṇaṃ pūraṇam |
iti saṃpūjayet paścād bhakṣyabhojyair anekaśaḥ ||
dātavyā cārjunī kṛṣṇā surūpā tu payasvinī |
hemaśṛṅgī raupyakhurā ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
vastrayugmaparīdhānā puṣpamālyānvitā śubhā |
gurave gauḥ pradātavyā śreyo ‘rthaṃ surasundari ||
ācāryaṃ tu śivaṃ vindyāc chivam ācāryarūpiṇam |
ubhayor antaraṃ nāsti ācāryasya śivasya ca ||
etasmāt kāraṇād devi guruṃ pūjya tadā nṛṇām |
yaḥ samuddharate nityaṃ ghorāt saṃsārasāgarāt ||
na tena sadṛśo mātā na pitā na ca bāndhavāḥ |
yad gurau dīyate dānaṃ tad gṛhṇāti sadā śivaḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjanīyo guruḥ sadā |
ity etat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vidhiḥ paraḥ ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kurute vatsaraṃ naraḥ |
sarvakāmasusaṃpannaḥ prayāti paramaṃ padam ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratam |
atha lakṣaṇārdrāvratam |
skanda uvāca |
śrutāni deva deveśa (?) vratāni bhavato mayā |
[827] rūpasaubhāgyadānīha svargamokṣapradāni ca ||
yena dharmārthakāmāṃś ca rūpaṃ ca guṇavad vibho |
svalpavittapradānena jāyate tadvratam vada ||
īśvara uvāca |
asti vatsa vrataṃ caikaṃ tithinakṣatrayogataḥ |
nabhasye masi rājendra yad ārdrā jāyate tadā ||
vratam etad vidhātavyam umāmāheśvaraṃ bhuvi |
ārogyaiśvaryasaubhāgyarūpasaṃpatpradāyakam ||
kārayitvā yathāśakti sauvarṇaṃ mithunaṃ tayoḥ |
gaurīgiriśayo bhaktyā naktaṃ saṃkalpya pūjayet ||
umāmāheśarūpaṃ tu prathamakṛṣṇāṣṭamyām abhihitaṃ veditavyam |
payodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarāvāribhiḥ kramāt |
saṃsnāpya cārcayed gandhaiḥ pūjayet kusumotkaraiḥ ||
raktair vāpy atha vā pītaiḥ śvetair vā raktamiśritaiḥ |
saṃveṣṭya vastrayugamena mantrair ebhiḥ prapūjayet ||
śaṅkarāya namas tubhyaṃ vimalāya śivāya ca |
svayaṃbhuve hy anantāya bhavāya bhāvine namaḥ ||
sarvāya viśvarūpāya sarvajñāya namo namaḥ |
īśānāya saṃbhave ‘tha virūpākṣāya śaṃbhave ||
vasudhāya mahādevi vikhyāte lalite śive |
śānte raudre mahāvaktre durge gaurī namo ‘stu te ||
supadmapadmapatrākṣi (?) sumukhe viśvato mukhī |
īśvarīndrāṇi rudrāṇi rambhe devi namo namaḥ ||
[828] śarvāya viśvarūpāya sarvajñāya namo namaḥ |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ payaḥ patraṃ phalaṃ candanapaṅkajaiḥ ||
pūrṇaṃ kṛtvāmbikeśābhyāṃ mantram etam udīrayet |
namo gauryai skandamātre viṣṇumūrtyai namo namaḥ ||
namo bhūtādhipataye rūpādhipataye namaḥ ||
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ virūpākṣa rūpārthe (?) ‘bhyarthito mayā |
sa bhāryayā mahādeva devadeva namo ‘stu te ||
arghyaṃ datvā tato dhūpaṃ dadyād agurumiśritam |
dīpaṃ naivedyatāmbūlaphalāni vividhāni ca ||
tato dvātriṃśatādhūpaiḥ sūryasya racitair dṛḍham |
tatsaṃkhyākaiś ca godhūmair vrīhipiṣṭamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
pūrṇaṃ tallakṣaṇaiḥ kṛtvā saṃdīpaṃ sūtraveṣṭitam |
rasapañcakayuktena śuṣkānnena samanvitam ||
godhūmair godhūmapiṣṭamayair lakṣaṇair matsyādimudrāṅkitair bhakṣyaiḥ | rasā dadhidugdhaghṛtamadhuśarkarāḥ, śuṣkānnaṃ modakam |
umāmaheśayor nāndiyutety uddiśya cārpayet |
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ pūrvaṃ sauvarṇaṃ mithunaṃ ca tat ||
bhaktāya yācamānāya suvidyāya kuṭumbine |
ātmajñānaikaniṣṭhāya vedavedāṅgavedine ||
kulaśīlasadācāralakṣaṇair lakṣitāya ca |
nāstikāya na dātavyaṃ nāvrate nājitendriye ||
datvā ceśvarabhaktāya praṇipatya visarjayet |
lakṣaṇāṇy eva tāvanti bhuktvācānnaṃ suhṛdgaṇe ||
[829] sārdhnaktaṃ tataḥ somaṃ śivaṃ dhyāyan sureśvarīm |
tāvanti dvātriṃśat |
nabhasye bahulāṣṭamyām evaṃ yaḥ kurute vratam |
lakṣaṇārtheti vikhyātam idaṃ tasya phalaṃ śṛṇu ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
bhuktvā bhogyān maheśena tataḥ kālaviparyaye ||
rājā bhavati dharmātmā balavīryasamanvitaḥ |
rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyadhanāyuḥkīrtimān bhavet ||
prāpya kālakṣayaṃ tasmād umārudraprasādataḥ |
caturyugasahasrāntaṃ svargaloke mahīyate ||
māsy ārdrarkṣayutāṣtamī bhavati yā kṛṣṇā nabhasye tadā |
sauvarṇaṃ mithunaṃ śivāgiriśayo rūpaṃ tayor lakṣaṇaiḥ ||
pūrṇaṃ piṣṭhamayair dadāti gurave sārdhaṃ rasair bhojanam |
bhuktvā yogayutotsavaṃ sabhuvanaṃ sambhor vrajec chāśvatam ||
matsyapurāṇoktaṃ lakṣaṇārdrāvratam |
atha somavratam |
anilāda uvāca |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi vrataṃ śreyaskaraṃ param |
tasyodāharaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vidhivat pranibodhata ||
vāre somasya vāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣobhau somam arcayet |
[830] vidhinā candracūḍāṅke prājyānnena sacandrakam ||
pakṣobhau atrobhayatra pakṣe niyamo ‘ṣṭamīsomavārayoḥ saṃyogamātraṃ vivakṣitam, prājyānnam ājyabahulam annam | dakṣiṇārdhaṃ haraṃ dhyāyed vāmordhvaṃ tu hariṃ vibhum | somasacandrakavāmārdhaharim iti viśeṣaṇatrayeṇa candraharirūpatvaṃ vāmārdhasyoktam |
ghṛtādyair aikṣavāntaiś ca liṅgam snāpya tu pūrvavat |
ghṛtādyaiḥ pañcāmṛtasaṃjñakaiḥ |
candanenenduyuktena dakṣiṇārdhaṃ vilepayet |
kuṅkumāguruṇā vāmaṃ ghanam arghyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
induyuktena karpūrayuktena, ghanam uśīram |
kāñcanena sacandreṇa harabhāgaṃ tathārcayet |
samauktikena nīlena harer bhāgaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
candreṇa horakayuktena |
paścāt puṣpaiḥ śubhair veṣṭya kārayet puṣpamaṇḍapam |
nīrājanaṃ punaḥ kuryāt pañcaviṃśatipañcakaiḥ ||
ubhābhyāṃ cittadattena praṇamec ca muhur muhuḥ |
ubhābhyāṃ devīdevābhyāṃ cittavṛttena hariharadhyāyinā vidhinā nīrājanasya |
ājyasiddhaiḥ śubhair bhakṣyair naivedyaṃ ca nivedayet |
vratino brāhmaṇāṃś caiva pūjayitvā vibhāvasum ||
vibhāvasur agniḥ |
[831]
mithunāni ca saṃbhojya yathāśaktyā ca dakṣayet |
aṣṭamyāṃ pitarāv arcya vidhinānena suvrata ||
pitarau tāv eva devīdevau |
vatsaraṃ tu tadante tu kartavyaṃ yan nibodhata |
prāguktavidhinā pūjya sitaṃ pītaṃ yugadvayam ||
dadyād vitānake caiva patākāghaṇṭike tathā |
dhūpasaṃcāreṇa vāpi dīpavṛkṣau suśobhinau (?) ||
dhūpasaṃcāraṇā dhūpadahanayā yau dīpavṛkṣau vṛkṣākārau dīpādhārau |
evamādi niyojyaiva pūrvavad bhojam ācaret |
abdapañcakam evaṃ hi yaḥ kariṣyaty asaṃśayam ||
ubhābhyāṃ lokam āsādya padaṃ yāsyaty anāmayam |
asaṃśayasthā jīvanti niyamena samācaret ||
ihaiva saritaḥ sākṣān nararūpīti lakṣayet |
na spṛśet pāpadaṃ cānnaṃ na ca duḥkhī bhavet khalu ||
jvaragrahādibhir naiva pīḍyate ‘sau kadācana ||
tatra vrate nāmamantraiḥ pūjāhomau |
iti kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ somavratam |
atha śaṅkarārkavratam |
anilāda uvāca |
atha cānena mārgeṇa śubhāṃ tām eva cāṣṭamīm |
[832] saṃprāpyādityayogena prāgvidhānena vā naraḥ ||
kiṃ tu dakṣiṇanetrasthaṃ bhāskaraṃ cārcayed budhaḥ |
padmarāgena haimena yojyedaṃ lepanaṃ śṛṇu ||
netre nyasya lalāṭādhaḥ kuṅkumaṃ raktacandanam |
vṛttaṃ tu yojya madhye tu haraṃ pūrvavad arcayet ||
ardhacandrākāraṃ tanmadhye vṛttaṃ ca lepanaṃ kṛtvā hemanibaddhaṃ padmarāgaṃ vṛttamadhye nidhāya sūryarūpanetraṃ (?) kuryād ity arthaḥ |
abhāve padmarāgāder hemaṃ sarvatra yojayet |
rudrabījaṃ paraṃ pūtaṃ yatas tac caiva sarvadā ||
śuklaṃ mālyāṃ varaṃ valkaṃ naivedyaṃ ca ghṛtaplutam |
śeṣaḥ pūrvavidhānena kartavyo vidhivistaraḥ ||
kiṃ tv atroṣya prakurvīta saptamyāṃ vijitendriyaḥ |
śaṅkarārkayutaḥ pūjya ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ ca pārayet ||
uṣya upoṣya |
etat prāgvidhinā kāryaṃ pañcavṛkṣāyaṇau vidhau |
kurvan sūryādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogān vrajet param ||
etat tīrtvā pratāpī syāḍ adīnaḥ svajanapriyaḥ |
asmin loke ca dhanavān lokavāṃś ca bhavet punaḥ ||
iti kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ śaṅkarārkavratam |
[833]
atha somāṣṭamīvratam |
nandy uvāca |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi vrataṃ śreyaskaraṃ param |
śivalokavrataṃ pūjyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ nṛṇām ||
vāee somasya cāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
vidhivac candracūḍābhaṃ somaṃ saṃpūjayen niśi ||
somam umāsahitam | rūpaṃ tu kṛṣṇāṣṭamyām eva vyākhyātam |
tilasarṣapakalkena snāto ‘malajalāśaye |
gṛhe vāyatane vāpi śivaikāhitamānasaḥ ||
brahmakūrcena deveśaṃ prāśayitvā tato vratī |
brahmakūrcaṃ pañcagavyam |
vāmādināmamantraiś ca devaṃ devīṃ tathārcayet ||
candanenenduyuktena dakṣiṇārdhaṃ vilepayet |
induḥ karpūram |
vāmārdhaṃ kuṅkumenāthe saturuṣkeṇa mantravat ||
turuṣkaḥ sihlakam |
devyā mūrdhni nyasen nīlaṃ śivasyopari mauktikam |
paścāt puṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya mitaraktais tv anuttamaiḥ ||
nīrājanaṃ punaḥ kuryāt pañcaviṃśatidīpakaiḥ |
[834] ghṛtasiddhān śubhān śuklān phalāni ca nivedayet ||
saṃpūjyaivaṃ śivaṃ somaṃ stutvā paścāt samāpayet |
dīkṣitasyaivam anyo ‘pi nāmamantreṇa bhaktimān ||
tato vidhivad avyagro brahmakūrcaśṛtāṃs tilān |
sadyojātena juhuyāt samṛddhe ‘gnau subhāvitaḥ ||
saṃprāpya hy aṣṭame vāyaṃ (?) prabhāte naiva tatkṣaṇaḥ |
tat brahakūrcam |
saṃbhojayet sapatnīkān brāhmaṇān saṃśitavratān ||
suvarṇaṃ ca tathā śaktyā raupyaṃ datvā visarjayet |
prīyatāṃ me śivo nityam umā devī ca sarvadā ||
evam ārādhya gaurīśaṃ daśakṛtvo mune śivam |
vratasyānte prakartavyaṃ yat tat sarvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat ||
ṛtvā mahotsavaṃ prāpya pūjayet parameśvaram |
puṣpaiḥ śuklais tathā dhūpair naivedyaiś ca phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
vitānaṃ vāmalaṃ chatraṃ ghaṇṭām vāpy upayogavat |
pūjāprakaraṇaṃ śambhor yathāśakti samarcayet ||
tato vastrair alaṃkāraiḥ svarṇaraupyamayair gurum |
sabhāryam arcayed bhaktyā śivabhaktaṃ ca mānayet |
raupyakhurīṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ sacelāṃ kāṃśadohanām ||
dadyād dhenuṃ savatsāṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ ca sulakṣaṇam |
pūjayec ca vratī sāghūn bhojanācchādanāśanaiḥ ||
[835] yajñaśiṣṭāśanaṃ paścād bhuñjīyāt prayato gṛhī |
ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā pārtha somāṣṭamīvratam ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokam avāpnuyāt |
kurukṣetrādidānena yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ |
tat phalaṃ labhate vidyān pūjyemāṃ vidhivan naraḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ somāṣṭamīvratam |
atha arkāṣṭamīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
athānyad api te vacmi vrataṃ kāmaphalapradam |
sarvapuṇyapradaṃ loke mahāpātakanāśanam ||
yadāṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣe ravivāro ‘bhijāyate |
upoṣyā sā prayatnena tenaiva vidhinā nṛpa ||
arcayed devadeveśaṃ saha devyā maheśvaram |
viśeṣa eva evātra (?) śivasya nayane sthitam ||
bhānuṃ saṃpūjayed bhaktyā gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ |
śivaṃ ca sitapuṣpais tu raktapuṣpais tathāmbikām ||
ratnai raktasitair divyair bhaktimān arcayed vibhum |
kuṅkumenālabhed devīṃ candanena maheśvaram ||
[836] abhāve sarvaratnānāṃ kāñcanaṃ tatra dāpayet |
rudrabījaṃ japan sūktaṃ priyaṃ rudrasya sarvadā ||
sitaraktaṃ vastrayugmaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam |
śeṣaḥ pūrvavidhānena kartavyo vidhivistaraḥ ||
kiṃ tv atropoṣya kartavyaṃ gojalaṃ prāśya pāraṇam |
gojalaṃ gomūtram, pūrvavidhāneneti etasya vratasya bhaviṣottaroktavidhānenety arthaḥ |
haviṣānnena sahito bāndhavai rathibhis tathā |
etat prāgvidhinā yas tu kuryāt sūryāṣṭamīvratam ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate |
pūrvavidhāneneti etasya vratasya bhaviṣyottaroktavidhānenna | atra yady api bhaviṣyottaroktasomāṣṭamīvidhir nairantaryād agrāhyas tathāpi satsādharmyāl likhitaḥ | skandapurānoktasomṣṭamīvratasya vidhigrahaṇe viśeṣābhāvān na kaścid roṣa iti |
haviṣā mlenasahito bāndhaviar arthibhis tathā ||
etat prāgvidhinā yas tu kuryāt sūryāṣṭamīvratam |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
iha vābhyetya sa syād vai pārthivaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
ārogyasarvasaukhyaikabhājano bhānubhāvitaḥ ||
pratāpī bhānuvad bhāti dīnānugrahakṛd bhavet |
yady aṣṭamī bhavati somayutā kadācid
arkeṇa vā kurukulodvaha tām upoṣya |
[837] pūjyo mayā saha haraṃ harināṅkacūḍaṃ
bhaktyā pumān param upaiti padaṃ murāreḥ ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottaroktam arkāṣṭamīvratam |
atha puṣpāṣṭamīvratam |
mahādeva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi mahāpuṇyaṃ māsapūjāphalaṃ śubham |
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ ya upoṣitaḥ ||
snāpayed ghṛtakṣīrābhyāṃ karavīraiś ca pūjayet |
kṛtvāgnikāryaṃ vidhivad atho brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
kanyākarṇitasūtreṇa kārayitvā pavitrakam |
kṛtvā vicitragandhaiś ca kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ ||
kṛtopavāsaṃ saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ viprabhojanam |
āropayati yo bhaktyā so ‘gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
punar bhavati vai rājā bhūtale nātra saṃśayaḥ |
māsi bhādrapade ‘ṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣe varānane ||
snāpayitvā tu māṃ bhaktyā payasā vā ghṛtena vā |
apāmārgeṇa pūjāṃ tu kṛtvā devi vidhānataḥ ||
haṃsayānasamārūḍho mama lokaṃ vrajed iti |
[838] māsi cāśvayuje ‘ṣṭamyāṃ sarvapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet ||
gairikaṃ yānam ārūḍho dhvajamālākulaṃ śubham |
gairikaṃ sauvarṇam |
yukto mayūkhapravarair mama yāti sa mandiram ||
kārttikasya tu māsasya śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu yo naraḥ |
snāpayen madhukṣīrābhyāṃ jātīpuṣpais tu pūjayet ||
kāñcanaṃ yānam āruhya kiṅkaṇījālamālinam |
sa yāti paramaṃ devi gandharvāpsarasāṃ priyaḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe ca vai māsi pañcagavyena yo naraḥ |
snāpayitvā ca taṃ bhaktyā raktapuṣpais tu pūjayet ||
snāpayed dadhikṣīreṇa kuṅkumena vilepayet |
kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ vidhivan naraḥ ||
sa trailokyam atikramya yatrāhaṃ tatra gacchati |
pauṣe māsi tu yo ‘ṣṭamyāṃ bhaktyā māṃ pūjayen naraḥ ||
unmattakasya puṣpais tu snāpayitvā ghṛtena tu |
sa yānaṃ divyam ārūḍhaḥ puṣpakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||
mamālayaṃ samāsādya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ (?) |
māghamāse tathāṣṭamyāṃ bilvapatreṇa yo ‘rcayet ||
snāpayitvā tu māṃ bhaktyā divya-ikṣurasena vā |
prataptārkasamaṃ yānaṃ kāntyātreyasamas tathā ||
ārūḍho modate nityaṃ mama loke na saṃśayaḥ |
[839] phālgunasya tu māsasya gandhatoyena yo naraḥ ||
arcayed droṇapuṣpais tu indrasyāvāsanaṃ labhet |
caitre māsi tathā devi puṣpatoyena yo naraḥ ||
snāpayitvārcayed bhaktyā arkapuṣpais tu sundari |
bahusvarṇasya yajñasya vindate sa phalaṃ mahat ||
vaiśākhe tu yathā māsi aṣṭamyāṃ yas tu mānavaḥ |
karpūrāgurutoyena snāpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
arcayec chubhagandhena so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tathāṣṭamyāṃ dadhnā yaḥ snāpayet tu mām ||
arcayet paśupuṣpaiś ca sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim |
āṣāḍhe yo naro ‘ṣṭamyāṃ nānātīrthodakair navaiḥ ||
snāpayitvārcayed bhaktyā patrair dhustūrakasya tu |
gandharvoragayakṣais tu pūjyamāno naro divi ||
krīḍate ca mayā sārdhaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
ya evaṃ vatsare devi kārayed aṣṭamīvratam ||
na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ satyam etad bravīmy aham |
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ ca śambhuṃ ca sarvaṃ bhīmaṃ maheśvaram ||
virūpākṣaṃ mahādevam ugraṃ tryambakam eva ca |
īśvaraṃ ca śivaṃ devi sarvalokeṣu pūjitam |
etāni māsanāmāni māseṣv eteṣu kīrtayet ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ puṣpāṣṭamīvratam |
[840]
atha tindukāṣṭakāṣṭamīvratam |
jyaiṣthe māsi dvijaśreṣṭha guṇāṣṭamyāṃ trilocanam |
yaḥ pūjayati deveśam īśalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tathāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe ca tathā pare |
pūjayec caturo māsān nīlotpalakadambakaiḥ ||
tripurāntakaraṃ śambhuṃ tryambakāndhakasūdanam |
gandhānāṃ ca kadambena pūjayed guggulena ca ||
ṭemburukaphalaṃ vipra prāśayet kāyaśodhanam |
ṭemburukaṃ tindukaphalam |
devasya kīrtayen nāma bhāskareti punaḥ punaḥ |
māsi cāśvayuje vipra kārttikaṃ ca tathā dvija ||
mārgaśīrṣe tathā māsi pauṣe māsi tathā haram |
pūjayed vidhivad bhaktyā unmattakusumair vibhum ||
unmattakusumair dhustūrapuṣpaiḥ |
karpūrāgurudhūpena deveśaṃ pūjayed dharim |
virūpākṣeti vai nāma prāśayed vidhivat yavān ||
māghe ca phālgune caiva kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ trilocanam |
caitravaiśākhayor bhaktyā śatapatraiḥ samarcayet ||
mahādhūpena dhūpena vidhivat kalpitena ca |
pūjayed vidhivad devaṃ tripurāntakaraṃ haram ||
kakkolāgurukarpūradarpakuṅkumacandanaiḥ |
[841] caturjātena ca mahān yakṣakardama eva ca ||
ity uktaḥ, naivedyaiḥ khaṇḍatraṣṭaiś (?) ca nāma īśeti pūjayet |
ya evaṃ pūjayed devaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ maheśvaram |
svam ekam ekaṃ viprendra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
yad iṣṭaṃ devadevasya śṛṇu tad dvijasattama |
unmakena puṣpeṇa dhūpe kṛṣṇāguruḥ sadā ||
śrīkhaṇḍaḥ sarvagandheṣu naivedyaṃ (?) pāyasaṃ sadā |
pūjākāraḥ pāśupataḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ||
kalpajño brāḥmaṇānāṃ tu vācakas tasya vallabhaḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya nṛpate rudreṇa vidhinā harim ||
pūjā liṅge śaṅkarādināmnā |
vatsarānte baliṃ puṇyaṃ tathā pustakavācanam |
yaḥ kārayati vai bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
svargalokam avāpnoti tejasā śukrasaṃnibhaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ tindukāṣṭakāṣṭamīvratam |
atha dāmpatyāṣṭamīvratam |
kārttike māsi viprendra putrakāmo naro mune |
aṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya pūjayed vidhivad dvija ||
[842] umayā sahitaṃ devaṃ kṛtā darbhamayaṃ vibhum |
gandhapuṣpopahārais tu vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā ||
nīlavaidūryasaṃkāśān samūlān puṣpavarjitān |
vaitastikān tathā sāgrān ṛjūn darbhān dvijottamam ||
gṛhītvā kārayed devaṃ nīlakaṇṭham umāpatim |
umāṃ ca tāṃ satīṃ devīṃ vidhivad brahmasattama ||
pūjayed gandhapuṣpais tu phalair bhakṣyair anekaśaḥ |
nānāprekṣaṇakaiś caiva mukhabādyaiś ca suvrata ||
ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā umāmāheśvaraṃ vratam |
svam ekam ekaṃ viprendra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
svam ekaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ |
caturbhiḥ pāraṇair evaṃ svam ekaṃ kīrtitaṃ budhaiḥ |
prathamaṃ tu tribhir māsaiḥ pāraṇaṃ kārttikādibhiḥ ||
kārttike mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe māsi tathā pare |
unmattakasya puṣpaiś tu phalair bhakṣyair anekaśaḥ ||
unmattakasya dhūstūrakasya |
śrīkhaṇḍacandaneneśaṃ śvetena tu vilepayet |
sājyaṃ tu guggulaṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ param ||
snānaṃ tu pañcagavyena prāśanaṃ tu pravartayet |
mahādeveti vai nāma gaurīdevīti paṭhyate ||
māghe ca phālgune māsi tathā caitre dvijottama |
mālatīkusumair devaṃ kusumair muhur asya ca |
[843] virūpākṣeti vai nāma devyā nāma umeti ca ||
pūjayed vidhivad devaṃ dhūpenāguruṇā vibhum |
kuṅkumena tathā bhaktyā vidhivat tau vilepayet ||
dadhnā śālyodanaṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ śūlapāṇaye |
kuśodakaṃ tathāśnīyād ātmanaḥ kāyaśuddhaye ||
vaiśākhe tu tathā jyaiṣṭhe āṣāḍhe pūjayed dharam |
karavīraiś ca puṣpaiś ca tathā raktotpalair mune ||
prājāpatyena dhūpena rasālāmodakaiś tathā |
rasālā śikhariṇī |
śivaḥ śivā ca vai nāmnī tayor vipra prakīrtate |
snānaprāśanayoḥ śastā ghṛtakṛṣṇatilā budhaiḥ ||
aguruṃ sihlakaṃ dhūpaṃ prājāpatyam iti smṛtam |
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu jātīpuṣpakadambakaiḥ ||
pūjayed vidhivad devīṃ tripurāntakaraṃ haram |
catuḥsamena deveśam arcayed vidhivan mune ||
dhūpenāgurumiśreṇa kṛśarāpūpapāyasaiḥ |
catuḥsamena tvakapatrailākesareṇa |
ebhir yaḥ pūjayed devaṃ caturbhiḥ pāraṇair haram ||
caturvargam avāpnoti kāmayāno na saṃśayaḥ |
prakāmayānaś ca punas turīyaṃ kevalaṃ labhet ||
turīyo mokṣaḥ |
kāmayāno yathā mokṣaṃ kāmaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
putrakāmo labhet putraṃ dhanakāmo labhed dhanam ||
[844] vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ nūnaṃ prāpnoti śaṅkarāt |
kṛtvaivaṃ varṣam ekaṃ tu varṣānte prīṇayed dharim ||
nānāprekṣaṇakair brahman brāḥmaṇāṃś cānnatarpaṇaiḥ |
dāmpatyaṃ bhojayed vipraṃ prītaye śaṅkarasya tu ||
kalpasthaṃ vācakaṃ vipraṃ sapatnīkaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
vācakaṃ kalpayet śambhuṃ svapatnīṃ lalitāṃ mune ||
prīṇayitvā tu dāmpatyaṃ bhakṣyabhojyair anekaśaḥ |
kusumbhaṃ raktavastrāṇi tābhyām dadyād dvijottama ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca punar dadyāt sauvarṇapratimādvayam |
vācakāya mahādevaṃ tatpatnīṃ lalitāṃ mune ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed devaṃ haraṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
sa divyaṃ yānam ārūḍhaḥ suvarṇodbhavam uttamam ||
tejasā śukrasaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā harisaṃnibhaḥ |
sa gacchet paramaṃ sthānam acalaṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ |
tasmād etya bhaved rājā bhūtale bhūtaleśvaraḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ dāmpatyāṣṭamīvratam |
atha pitrīyavratam |
pulastya uvāca |
proṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī tu yā |
sopavāso naro ‘ṣṭamyāṃ yoṣid vā tanayārthinī ||
[845] snātā sarasi dharmajñā toye vāpy atha sārase |
pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya yathā kuryāt tathā śṛṇu ||
ghṛtaprasthena govindaṃ snāpayitvā jagatgurum |
kṣaudreṇa ca tataḥ paścād dadhnā vā snāpayet tataḥ ||
kṣīrṇa snapanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścād virukṣayet |
sarvauṣadhaiś ca sajalaiḥ sarvabījaphalais tathā ||
snāpayitvānuliptā ca candanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ |
karpūreṇa tathā rāma tathā jātīphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
tataḥ kālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā jagatgurum |
dhūpaṃ vāguruṇā dhūpaṃ kṛtvā naivedyam īpsitam ||
viśeṣād gorasaṃ prāśya punnāgair anvitaṃ phalam |
pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena hutvā vānantaraṃ dhruvam ||
śūdro vāpy atha vā nārī nāmnā hutvā jagadguroḥ |
yavapātrāṇi datvā tu phalāni kanakaṃ tathā ||
putrārthaṃ prāśanaṃ kuryāt phalaiḥ punnāmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
strīnāmabhiś ca kanyārthī tato bhuktvā yathepsitam ||
putrakanyām avāpnoti tathā sarvān abhīpsitān |
haviṣyaṃ devadevasya bhūmipānāṃ tu karayet ||
saṃvatsaram idaṃ kṛtvā vratam āpnoty abhīpsitam ||
putrīyam etad vratam uttamaṃ te
mayeritaṃ yady api dharmanityam |
tathāpy anenaiva samastakāmān
kṛtena loke puruṣā labhante ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ putrīyavratam |
[846]
atha santānāṣṭamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
śṛṇu dālbha paraṃ kāmyaṃ vrataṃ santatidaṃ nṛṇām |
yad upoṣya na vicchedaḥ putrapiṇḍasya jāyate ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caitramāse snāto niyatamānasaḥ |
kṛṣṇam abhyarcya pūjāṃ ca devakyāḥ kurute ca yaḥ ||
nirāhārāto naraḥ paścāt (?) kṛṣṇasya jagataḥ pateḥ |
upoṣito japan mantraṃ rātrau prayatamānasaḥ ||
pūjāyāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya saptavārān prakīrtayet |
pākhaṇḍino vikarmasthān baiḍālān bakanāstikān ||
prabhāte ca tataḥ snāto datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām |
bhuñjīta kṛtapūjas tu kṛṣṇasyaiva jagatpateḥ ||
vaiśākhajyaiṣṭhayoś caiva pāraṇaṃ hi trimāsikam |
upoṣya devadevasya ghṛtena snāpayed dharim ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā |
upoṣito dvitīyaṃ vai pāraṇaṃ pūrvavad bhavet ||
āśvine kārttike saumye tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ tathā |
pauṣe māghe phālgune ca caturthaṃ dvijasattama ||
pāraṇe pāraṇe pūrṇe ghṛtena snāpayed dharim |
brāhmaṇebhyo ghṛtaṃ dadyāt tathaiva pratipāraṇam ||
[847] kṛtvā vrataṃ nākam anuprayāti
mānuṣyam āsādya ca nirvṛttiḥ syāt |
santānavṛddhiś ca yathāpnute ‘sau
yāvan mahīṃ sāgaramekhalāntām ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ santānāṣṭamīvratam |
atha maheśvarāṣṭamīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣāt tathārabhya saumyāṣṭamyāṃ narādhipa |
pūjayet sopavāsas tu devadevaṃ trilocanam ||
saumyāṣṭamyāṃ gārgaśīrṣāṣṭamyām |
liṅge vāpy atha cārcāyāṃ kamale yadi vā sthale |
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekeṇa snātena vividhena vā |
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā |
gītena nṛtyavādyena vahnisaṃtarpaṇena ca ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjābhir yathāvan manujottama |
vratāvasāne datvā tu tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm ||
pauṇḍarīkam avāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati |
pauṇḍarīko nāma yajñaviśeṣaḥ tasya phalam avāpnotīty arthaḥ |
aṣṭamīdvitayaṃ kṛtvā tathā saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ||
[848] prāpyāśvamedhasya phalaṃ yathāvad
bhuktvā ca bhogān suranākaloke |
lokān avāpyātha maheśvarasya
sāyojyam āpnoty acireṇa tasya ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ maheśvarāṣṭamīvratam |
atha vasuvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
dhruvo ‘dhruvaś ca somaś ca āpaś caivānilo ‘nalaḥ |
pratyūṣaś ca prabhāvaś ca aṣṭau te vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
aṣṭātmā vāsudevo ‘yaṃ prabhāvenādayena ca |
aṣṭamyāṃ pūjayed yas tu sopavāso narādhipa ||
caitramāsād athārabhya śuklapakṣāc ca yādava |
maṇḍale py atha vārcāsu japec ca manujādhipa ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasampadā |
bahiḥsnānena rājendra tathādhaḥśayanena ca ||
vratānte tu sadā dadyād dhenuṃ viprāya śaktitaḥ |
vratam etan naraḥ snātvā sarvān kāmān avāpnute ||
puṇḍarīkam avāpnoti kulam uddharate svakam |
vasūnāṃ lokam āsādya modate śvarasaṃnibhaḥ ||
mahātejāḥ satyaparo hy arogo vijitendriyaḥ |
[849] satyaparo vinītaḥ |
dhanena dhānyena tathānvitaḥ syāt |
strīṇām abhīṣṭaś ca tathā bhavec ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ vasuvratam |
atha kālāṣṭamīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
nabhasye māsi ca tathā yāsyāt kṛṣṇāṣṭamī śubhā |
yuktā mṛgaśiraiś caiva sā tu kālāṣṭamī smṛtā ||
tasyāṃ sarvaikaliṅgeṣu tithau svapiti śaṅkaraḥ |
vasantasaṃnidhāne tu tatra pūjākṣayā smṛtā ||
ekaliṅgāni vṛṣabhagaṇapatisahitāni paścimābhimukhāni prasiddhāni |
tatra snāyīta vidvān hi gomūtreṇa jalena ca |
snātvā saṃpūjayet puṣpair dhūstūrasya trilocanam ||
dhūpaḥ keśaraniryāsair naivedyaṃ madhusarpiṣā ||
keśaro bakulaḥ |
prīyatāṃ me virūpākṣa ity uccārya ca dakṣiṇām |
viprāya dadyān naivedyaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ dvijottama ||
tadvad āśvayuje māsi sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
navamyāṃ gomayasnānaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ ca paṅkajaiḥ ||
tadvad āśvayuje māsi sopavāsa ity abhidhānāt [850] pūrvamāse ‘py upavāso boddhavyaḥ |
dhūpayet sarjaniryāsair naivedyaṃ madhumodakān |
kṛtvopavāsam aṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ snānam ācaret ||
prīyatāṃ me virūpākṣa dakṣiṇā ca tilaiḥ smṛtā |
kārttike payasā snānaṃ karavīreṇa cārcanam ||
dhūpaṃ śrīvāsaniryāsair naivedyaṃ madhupāyasaiḥ |
sanaivedyaṃ ca rajataṃ dātavyaṃ dānam agraje ||
śrīvāsaḥ saralavṛkṣaḥ, agraje brāhmaṇe |
prīyatāṃ bhagavān sthāṇur iti vācyam anantaram |
kṛtvopavāsam aṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ snānam ācaret ||
māsi mārgaśire snānaṃ tatrārcā rudrajā smṛtā |
arcā pūjā rudrajā śamīpuṣpajā |
dhūpaḥ śrīvṛkṣaniryāso naivedyaṃ madhumodakam ||
śrīvṛkṣo bilvaḥ |
naivedyaṃ raktaśāliś ca dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā |
namo ‘stu prīyatāṃ sarva iti vācyaṃ ca paṇḍitaiḥ ||
pauṣe snānaṃ ca haviṣā pūjā syāt pāraṇena tu |
haviṣā ghṛtena |
dhūpo ‘yaṃ madhukaniryāso naivedyaṃ madhuśaṣkulī ||
sāmudraṃ dakṣiṇā proktā prīṇanāya jagadguroḥ |
vācyaṃ namo ‘stu deveśa tryambaketi prakīrtayet ||
māghe kuśodakasnānaṃ mṛgamadena vārcanam |
[851] mṛgamado latākastūrī |
dhūpaḥ kadambaniryāso naivedyaṃ satilodanam ||
payaḥ kumbhena naivedyaṃ sarukmaṃ pratipādayet |
prīyatāṃ me mahādeva umāpatir itīrayet ||
evam ekaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ ṣaḍbhir māsais tu pāraṇam |
pāraṇānte trigorasya snapanaṃ kārayet kramāt ||
gorocanāṃ candanakuṅkumena
devaṃ samālabhya ca pūjayec ca |
trāyasva dīno ‘smi bhavantam īśa
śaśāṅkanātha praṇato ‘smi nityam ||
tatas tu phālgune māsi kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ yatavraḥ |
upavāsaḥ samuditaḥ kartavyo divjasattama ||
dvitīye ‘hni tataḥ snānaṃ pañcagavyena kārayet |
pūjayet kundapuṣpais tu dhūpayec candanena tu ||
naivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ dadyāt tāmrapātre guḍodanam |
dakṣiṇāṃ ca dvijātibhyo naivedyasahitāṃ mune ||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradadyāc ca rudram abhyarcya nāmataḥ |
caitre cendumbaraphalaiḥ snānaṃ mandārakārcanam ||
gugguluṃ mahiṣākhyaṃ ca ghṛtāktaṃ dhūpayed budhaḥ |
samodakaṃ tathā sarpiḥ prīṇanaṃ vinivedayet ||
dakṣiṇāṃ caiva naivedyam umākāntāya dāpayet |
[852] nandīśvara namas te ‘stu idam uccārya nārada ||
prīṇanaṃ devanāthāya kuryāc ca śraddayānvitaḥ |
vaiśākhe snānam uditaṃ sugandhikuṅkumāmbhasā ||
pūjanaṃ śaṅkarasyoktaṃ bhūtamañjaribhir vibho |
dhūpaṃ sūryākhyapuṣpais tu naivedyaṃ saphalaṃ ghṛtam ||
sūryākhyam arkapuṣpam |
nāma japtavyam īśeti kālaghneti vipaścitā |
jalakumbhān sanaivedyān brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet ||
upānadyugalaṃ chatraṃ dānaṃ dadyāc ca śaktitaḥ |
namas te bhaganetraghna puṣpadantavināśana ||
idam uccārayed bhaktyā prīṇanāya jagatpateḥ |
āṣāḍhe snānam uddiṣṭaṃ śrīphalair arcanaṃ tathā ||
dūstūrakasya kusumair dhūpārthaṃ sihlakaṃ tathā |
naivedyaṃ saghṛtāḥ pūpāḥ dakṣiṇā saghṛtās tathā ||
namas te dakṣayajñaghna idam uccārayet tataḥ |
śrāvaṇe mṛgamadena snānaṃ kṛtvārcayed dharim ||
śrīvṛkṣapatraiḥ saphalair dhūpaṃ dadyāt tathāgurum |
naivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ dadyād dadhipūrṇāṃs tu modakān ||
dadhyodanaṃ kṛśarakaḥ kaṭidhānāḥ saśaṣkulāḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ śvetavṛṣabhaṃ dhenuṃ ca kapilāṃ śubhām ||
kanakaṃ raktavasanaṃ pradadyād brāhmaṇāya tu |
[853] gaṅgādhareti vaktavyaṃ nāma śambhoś ca paṇḍitaiḥ ||
amībhiḥ ṣaḍbhir uditair māsaiḥ pāraṇam uttamam |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ saṃpūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam ||
akṣayān labhate lokān maheśvaraparo naraḥ |
idam uktaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvākṣayakaraṃ śubham |
svayaṃ rudreṇa devarṣe tat tathā na tadanyathā ||
iti vāmanapurāṇoktaṃ kālāṣṭamīvratam |
atha rukmiṇyaṣṭamīvratam |
skanda uvāca |
bhagavan kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yad abhīṣṭaṃ mama prabho |
sāṃprataṃ śrotum icchāmi bhuvi jātasya kasyacit ||
yena putraviyogena bhavec caivaṃ kadācana |
gṛhe hi vasatāṃ kena nityaṃ śrīḥ parikīrtitā ||
śaṅkara uvāca |
śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yena cīrṇena mātreṇa nārī vā puruṣo ‘pi vā ||
na putravirahaṃ kvāpi na ca bhartus tathā kvacit |
gṛhasthopaskarair dravyair hīnatā na prajāyate ||
māsi mārgaśire kṛṣṇapakṣe ‘ṣṭamyāṃ ṣaḍānana |
rukmiṇyaṣṭamisaṃjñā sā sarvakāmaphalapradā ||
[854] tasyāṃ prātaḥ śucir bhūtvā nārī niyamakāriṇī |
varṣe ca prathame kuryād ekadvāraṃ gṛhaṃ mṛdā ||
gṛhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasmin nikṣipya sādaram |
vrīhīn stūpaprakārānnair ghṛtādīṃś ca rasāṃs tathā ||
vastraiḥ kāṣṭhais tathā dantaiś citreṇa likhitās tathā |
kāryāḥ puttalikās tatra tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ||
kṛṣṇaś ca rukmiṇī caiva baladevas tv arundhatī |
pradyumnaś caiva tadbhāryā aniruddha uṣā tathā ||
devakīvasudevādīn sarvāṃs tatra prakalpayet |
tato ‘nupūjayet sarvān aṣṭadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
candrodaye tu saṃjāte dadyād arghyaṃ tad indave |
śaṅkhakundapratīkāśa gaganāṅgaṇadīpaka ||
gṛhāṇārdhyaṃ mayā dattaṃ śaṅkarāya namo ‘stu te |
iti candrārghyamantraḥ |
arghyaṃ datvā tu bhuñjīta mitrasvajanabandhubhiḥ ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye kumāryai tad gṛhaṃ śubham |
dadyāt prītena manasā sarvavastuprapūritam ||
tato dvitīye abde tu kuryād vai mukhamandiram |
pūrvavat pūritaṃ kṛtvā kumāryai vinivedayet ||
tatas tṛtīye abde tu kṛtvābhimukhamandiram |
saṃpūrṇaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā kumāryai vinivedayet ||
tataś caturthe abde tu kṛtvā sukhacatuṣṭayam |
pañcame ‘bde pañcadvāraṃ ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṇmukhasaṃyutam ||
[855] kṛtvā dadyāt prayatnena kumāryai mukhacatuṣṭayam |
pañcame ‘bde pañcadvāraṃ ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṇmukhasaṃyutam ||
kṛtvā dadyāt prayatnena kumāryai saptamandiram |
tatas tu saptame varṣe kuryād udyāpanaṃ śubham ||
saptadvāraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā sudhādhavalitaṃ mahat |
śayyāṃ tūlīṃ ca yānaṃ ca chatropānaham eva ca ||
ādarśaṃ cāmaraṃ caiva muśalolūkhalaṃ tathā |
kāṃsyabhājanapātrāṇi tāmrasya tu mahānti ca ||
gṛhopkaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhe nikiṣpya sarvataḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ ca rukminīṃ caiva pradyumnaṃ ca manoharam ||
kṛtvā svarṇamayān śaktyā pītavastrāvaguṇṭhitān |
pūjayitvopavāsena rātrijāgaraṇena ca ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye tadgṛhe samupāgatam |
sapatnīkaṃ dvijaṃ pūjya vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
tasmād etad gṛhaṃ dadyād gāṃ caivātha suśīlinīm |
evaṃ kṛte vrate putra na duḥkhāni vrajen naraḥ |
nārī vā putraduḥkhārtā bhaven naiva ṣaḍānana ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ rukmiṇyaṣṭamīvratam |
[856]
atha durgāvratam |
brahmovāca |
devīvrataṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaprasādhanam |
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu aṣṭamyāṃ vāyubhojanaḥ ||
snātvā sārdhapuṭo bhūtvā jitakrodhaḥ kriyānvitaḥ |
devīṃ saṃsnāpya toyena punaḥ kṣīreṇa vāriṇā ||
tato gugguladhūpaṃ ca saturuṣkaṃ tu dāpayet |
turuṣkaḥ sihlakaḥ |
tato gandhodakasnānaṃ punaḥ snānaṃ ca vāriṇā ||
śrīkhaṇḍena samālabhya bilvapatraiḥ prapūjayet |
pāyasaṃ dāpayed devyā naivedyantena bhojayet ||
kanyādvijāṃś ca śaktyā tu teṣāṃ dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām |
kātyāyanīti coccārya prīyatāṃ mama sarvadā ||
ātmanaḥ pāraṇaṃ tac ca kṛtvā prāpnoti bhārgava |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ cāgyaṃ devyā lokaṃ ca gacchati ||
tathāgatya imāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivyāṃ jāyate nṛpaḥ |
tena saṃlabhate yogaṃ śivaprāptikaraṃ param ||
māse prauṣṭhapade śukle gośṛṅgāpagrahau tathā |
mṛdayā hy ātmano hy aṅgam upaliptaṃ tu kārayet ||
[857] śukle tu śuklapakṣe tu aṣṭamyām ity anuṣaṅgaḥ |
tadā vāmalakaiḥ snātvā śuciḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ |
pūjayed yūthikāpuṣpair devīṃ kṣīreṇa snāpayet ||
candanodakamiśreṇa kuṅkumena vilepayet |
tataḥ pūpakanaivedyaṃ karṇaveṣṭāṃś ca dāpayet |
aguruṃ dhūpanaivedyaṃ tilatailena dīpakān |
tena tā bhajayet kanyādvijān sadvṛttavartinaḥ ||
tena pūpakādinaivedyānnena |
pāṣaṇḍān nāvaloketa na ca śāstrabahiṣkṛtān |
dakṣiṇāḥ śaktito deyāḥ svastivācyaṃ ca maṅgalam ||
pāraṇaṃ cātmanaḥ krtvā sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ labhet |
prayāti viṣṇulokaṃ ca tathā vipro ‘bhijāyate ||
dhanāḍhyo mahatāṃ gotre vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
putravān dhanavān bhogī sukhaṃ prāpya śivo bhavet ||
śuklāṣṭamyām āśvine ca mṛdā snānaṃ samācaret |
tato devīṃ snaped vatsa dadhnā vekṣūdakena ca ||
ālabhya rocanāṃ candrair dahed dhūpaṃ ca bālakam |
sanakhaṃ sitayā miśraṃ padmapatrais tathārcayet ||
naivedye rohitaṃ māṃsaṃ samānaṃ śalyajaṃ tathā |
godhūmavikṛtān bhakṣyān ghṛtapakvān nivedayet ||
tena kanyās tu saṃbhojya dvijāṃś cāpi kṣamāpayet |
[858] śaktito dakṣiṇā deyā ātmanas tac ca bhojanam ||
gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
arogī sukhavān dhanyo jāyate ceha mānavaḥ ||
durgānāmāni saṃkīrtya tasyā loke mahīyate |
kārttike darbhamūlāni mṛdbhiḥ snāyīta bhārgava ||
devīṃ gandhodakaiḥ snāpya uśīraiḥ pūjya lepayet |
dhūpaṃ pañcarasaṃ deyaṃ tilatailena dīpikāḥ ||
pañcarasaṃ volarālakanduruśrīveṣṭaguggulakrtam |
naivedyaṃ yāvakaṃ sarpiḥ kanyāvipreṣu cātmani |
bhojanaṃ svastivācyaiva dakṣiṇā prīyatāṃ śiva ||
anena vidhinā vatsa vidyādānaphalaṃ labhet |
vedavedāṅgatattvajñas tadante śivatāṃ vrajet ||
mārgaśīrṣe tathā māsi aṣṭamyāṃ girimṛtsayā |
snātvā devīṃ tataḥ snāpya tīrthatoyena bhārgava ||
lepayed vālakaiḥ kuṣṭhaiḥ pūjā jātīgajāhvayaiḥ|
gajāhvayair nāgakesaraiḥ |
dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ dadyād ghṛtair dīpān prabodhayet |
dadhibhaktaṃ tu naivedyaṃ kanyās tenaiva bhojayet ||
śaktito dakṣiṇā deyā ātmanas tac ca pāraṇam |
umā me prīyatāṃ vācyaṃ vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ||
ihaiva dhanavān bhogī dehānte brahmaṇaḥ padam |
pauṣāṣṭamyāṃ tu dūrvāgraiḥ snātvā śuklaparicchadaḥ ||
[859] jitakrodhaḥ snāpayec ca devīṃ karpūravāriṇā |
vilepayet kuṅkumena māṃsī vālakacandanaiḥ ||
dhūpaṃ ca nirdahet prājñaḥ pūjanīyā kuruṇṭakaiḥ |
kṛsaraṃ guḍanaivedyaṃ kanyā bhojyāś ca tena vai ||
ātmanaḥ pāraṇaṃ tac ca śaktyā vai dakṣayed dvijān |
nārāyaṇī sadā prītā mama devī prasīdatu ||
kṛtena graharājendra bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet |
subhago dhanasaṃpannaḥ paratra śivam āpnuyāt ||
māghamāse gavāṃ śṛṅgamṛdbhiḥ snātvā tu bhārgava |
devīṃ toyena saṃsnāpya tathā kṣīraghṛtena ca ||
snāpayeta punas toyaiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet |
dhūpaṃ devadalaṃ dadyāt kundapuṣpais tu pūjayet ||
ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ca naivedyaṃ kanyā viprāṃś ca tena vai |
bhojayed ātmanas tac ca dakṣiṇā prīyatāṃ jayā ||
sarvayāgaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
phālgune sarṣapaiḥ snātvā devīnāmnā phalāmbunā ||
tathā ikṣurasenaiva bhūyas tenodakena ca |
rocanālepane pūjā śatapatrikayā guha ||
dīpo ghṛtena dhūpas tu candanaṃ na tu śarkarā |
naivedye ‘śokavartiś ca bhojanaṃ kanyakāsu ca ||
ātmanas tac ca kurvīta dakṣiṇāṃ svasti vācayet |
[860] vijayā sukhadā nityaṃ sumukhā cetaneti ca ||
anena vidhinā śukra rājasūyaphalaṃ samam |
labheta śraddhayā yukto tato devīmayaṃ jagat ||
caitrāṣṭamyāṃ tu snāyīta mātṛsnāne mṛdāmbuttiḥ (?) |
devīṃ tīrthajalaiḥ snāpya madalepena lepayet ||
dhūpaṃ tu rukmasauśīraṃ hy atimuktais tu pūjayet |
naivedyaṃ śālijaṃ bhaktaṃ śarkarā kanyāsv api ||
ātmanas tac ca vai bhojyaṃ śaktito dakṣiṇā dadet |
ajitā sarvakāmānāṃ pūraṇāya sukhāya vai ||
viprakanyāḥ samāchādya hemadānaphalaṃ labhet |
sahakāraphalaiḥ snānaṃ vaiśākhe hy aṣṭhamīṃ śuciḥ ||
ātmānaṃ devatāḥ snāpya māṃsīvālakavāribhiḥ |
lepanaṃ mṛgakarpūraṃ dhūpaṃ pañcasugandhikam ||
devyāḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta ketakyā campakena tu |
śarkarākṣīranaivedyaṃ kanyāvipreṣu bhojanam ||
ātmanaḥ pāraṇaṃ tac ca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadet |
aparājitā bhavānī ca śivā nāmnā ca vācayet ||
prīyatāṃ sarvakālaṃ me īpsitaṃ tu prayacchatu |
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaṃ tu anenāpnoti bhārgava ||
sūryalokaṃ vrajed ante tattulyo jāyate sadā |
aṣṭamyāṃ caiva jyaiṣṭhasya tilaiḥ snāyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
[861] sarvasaṅgaparityāgī devīṃ jātiphalambunā |
snāpayel lepayet tābhiś candanena sugandhinā |
tato vijayapuṣpais tu pūjayed grahasattama ||
vijayaḥ kumbhakaḥ |
naivedye śaktavo deyāḥ śarkarā kanyakāsv api |
dakṣiṇā śaktito deyā carcikāṃ prati vācayet ||
labhate śukra yajñasya sautrāmaṇisamaṃ phalam |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca tathāṣāḍhe niśātoyena snāpayet ||
tato devīṃ jalaiḥ kuṣṭhair varadāmadhukena ca ||
jalaiḥ kalakaiḥ | madhukena yaṣṭimadhunā |
snātvā vilipya karpūraṃ candanai rocanāmbubhiḥ |
dhūpaś candanakarpūrair vāhlīkaiḥ sitasihlakaiḥ ||
sitā śarkarā |
bhakṣyānnaśarkarāpūpān pānakāni śubhāni ca |
dāpayet kanyakāṃ vipra bhojanaṃ cātmanas tathā ||
śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyān mahiṣaghnīti kīrtayet |
dīpamālā ghṛtenaiva sarvakāmān prayacchati ||
naivedyaṃ śubhrakaṃsāraṃ kanyāviprāṃś ca bhojayet |
sarvayajñamahīdānasarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ||
etad vratavaraṃ śukra mayā rudreṇa viṣṇunā |
[862] jagato hitam icchadbhiś cīrṇaṃ durgāvrataṃ mahat ||
bhānunā grahavidhvaṃsasamare ca kṛtaṃ purā |
yathā devāsurair yakṣanāgakinnaramānavaiḥ ||
apsarobhis tathā strībhiḥ saubhāgyasya vivṛddhaye |
kṛtaṃ vai grahaśārdūla yaś ca kuryād yathāvidhi ||
śravaṇād asya cāpnoti sarvakāmasukhāni ca |
iṣṭāni labhate martyo vandhyā putraṃ prasūyate ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ durgāvratam |
athāśokāṣṭamīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
liṅgapurāṇāt |
aśokakalikāś cāṣṭau ye pibanti punarvasau |
caitre māsi tathāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokam avāpnuyuḥ || iti |
kūrmapurāṇe ‘pi |
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ budhavāre punarvasau |
aśokakusumair rudram arcayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
aśokasyāṣtakalikā mantreṇoktena bhakṣayet |
śokaṃ naivāpnuyān martyo rūpavān api jāyate ||
atra budhapunarvasuyogaḥ prāśastyārthaḥ |
[863] ata eva liṅgapurāṇe |
aśokakalikāpānam aśokatarupūjanam |
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu caitrasya kṛtvā prāpnoti nirvṛttim || iti |
prāśanamantras tūkto liṅgapurāṇe |
tvām aśokaharābhīṣṭa madhumāsasamudbhava |
pibāmi śokasaṃtapto mām aśokaṃ sadā kuru || iti |
kūrmapurāṇoktas tu |
tvām aśoka namāmy enaṃ madhumāseti śobhitam |
śokārtaḥ kalikāḥ prāśye mam aśokaṃ sadā kuru || iti |
ity aśokāṣṭamīvratam |
atha somavratam
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
candrāṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇī syāt tadā candravrataṃ caret |
śivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat snānaiḥ pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ ||
vilepanaṃ tu candreṇa candanena tu vā hitam |
śuklavastrais tathā puṣpaiḥ pūjayet parameśvaram ||
naivedyaṃ kṣīrakumbhaṃ tu sitaśarkarayā yutam |
prāśanaṃ candanenaiva rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ hitam ||
āyuḥkāmaiḥ sadā kāryaṃ kīrtiśrīsādhane hitam |
iti candravrataṃ nāma dāradānena jāyate ||
iti kālāntaroktaṃ somavratam |
[864]
atha rājarājeśvaravratam |
budhasvātyātmiko yogo yadāṣṭamyāṃ prajāyate |
upoṣitas tu vidhinā mahāsnānapuraḥsaram ||
saṃpūjayed virūpākṣam aṅgarāgacatuḥsamam |
mahāvartidvayaṃ dīrghadīpaṃ sāṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||
laghukuṅkumadhūpaṃ tu sitapuṣpais tu pūjayet |
khaṇḍakhādyāny anekāni naivedyaṃ tu prakalpayet ||
ācāryāya śivasyāgre graiveyamukuṭādikam |
rasanākuṇḍale caiva kaṅkaṇaṃ mudrikādvayam ||
vāhanaṃ tu gajaṃ caiva tadabhāvād dhayottama |
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā annaṃ ca śarkarāghṛtam ||
rājarājeśvarapadaṃ prāpnuyād romasaṃkhyayā |
rājarājeśvaraṃ tena vratam etat prakāśitam ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ rājarājeśvaravratam |
atha mahāvratam |
śuklaśrāvaṇayogas tu yadāṣṭamyāṃ prajāyate |
caturdaśyām atho vatsa tadā vrataṃ samācaret ||
upoṣitas tu vidhinā mahāsnānaṃ samācaret |
[865] agurucandanenaiva rocanākuṅkumena ca ||
mahādīpacatuṣkeṇa dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ śivam |
naivedyaṃ ghṛtabhūyiṣṭhaṃ yāvakena samanvitam ||
bhogāṃs tu vidhinā tatra śivasyāgre prakalpayet |
ācaryaṃ pūjayitvā tu vastrahemānnabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
pratyagraṃ kuṅkumaṃ puṣpaiḥ śivasyāgre prakalpayet |
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvaṇām ekaikaṃ tadvad eva hi ||
imaṃ mahāvrataṃ nāma mayā te parikīrtitam |
vilased avanīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ sasāgarām ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ mahāvibhavasambhavaiḥ |
pitṝn pitāmahāṃś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahān ||
putrān pautrān prapautrāṃś ca śivalokeṣu yat phalam |
idaṃ mahāvrataṃ nām kartavyaṃ pṛthivīśvaraiḥ ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ mahāvratam |
atha viśvarūpavratam |
revatīśaniyogas tu sitāṣṭamyāṃ yadā bhavet |
bhūtāyāṃ vā mahāsena tadā jātam idaṃ śṛṇu ||
mahāsnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ nityakṛtyād anantaram |
[866] candreṇaivākgarājaṃ tu ratnapūjāṃ tu kalpayet ||
śitapadmāni deyāni bhūṣaṇāni bahūny api |
candram evaṃ dahed dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtam ||
śvetāśvaṃ taruṇaṃ saumyaṃ śivāya vinivedayet |
aśvāṣṭakaṃ kuñjaraṃ ca ācāryāya pradāpayet ||
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvaṇā pratyaśvaṃ kuñjaraṃ tathā |
rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
putrārthī labhate putrān vāyutulyaparākramaḥ |
bhogārthī labhate bhogān vidyātattvena śāśvatān ||
yān yān kāmayate kāmān tāṃs tān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
viśvarūpam idaṃ tena vratam etad udāhṛtam |
kuśodakaprāśanaṃ tu rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ viśvarūpavratam |
atha budhāṣṭamīvratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
budhāṣṭamīvrataṃ bhūpa bravīmi śṛṇu pāṇḍava |
yena cīrṇena narakaṃ naraḥ paśyati na kvacit ||
purā kṛtayugasyādau ilorājā babhūva ha |
bahubhṛtya yuto mitramantribhiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
[867]
jagāma himavatpārśe mahādevānivāritaḥ |
yau ‘sau praviśate bhūmau sā strī bhavati niścitam ||
sa rājā mṛgasaṅgena praviśet tad umāvaṇe |
ekākī turagopetaḥ kṣaṇāt strītvaṃ jagāma ha ||
sā babhrāma vane śūnye pīnonnatapayodharā |
kā tvaṃ kasya kutaḥ prāptā anurodho ‘sti kiṃcana ||
tāṃ dadarśa budhas tanvīṃ rūpaudāryaguṇānvitām |
aṣṭamyāṃ budhavāreṇa tasyās tuṣṭo budho grahaḥ ||
dadau gṛhāśramaṃ tasyā mānīyata pratoṣitām |
putram utpādayāmāsa yo ‘sau khyātaḥ pururavāḥ ||
candravaṃśakaro rājā ādyaḥ sarvamahīkṣitām |
tataḥ prabhṛti pūjyeyam aṣṭamī budhasaṃyutā ||
sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvopadravanāginī |
ajñānadayite vacmi karma rājakathām alam ||
āsīd rājā videhānāṃ mithilām anu vairibhiḥ |
saṃgrāmenāhato vīras tasya bhāryā daridriṇī ||
urmilā nāma babhrāma mahīṃ vālakasaṃyutā |
avantiviṣayaprāptau brāhmaṇasya niveśane ||
ākārodarapūrṇārthaṃ nityaṃ kaṇḍanapeṣaṇam |
kṛtvā sā stokagodhūmaṃ dadau bālakayos tadā ||
kārpaṇyān mātṛvātsalyāt kṣudhā saṃpīḍyamānayoḥ |
kālena bahudhā sādhvī pañcatvam agamac chubhā ||
putras tasyā videhākhyaṃ gatvā sa pitur āsane |
[868] upaviṣṭaḥ satvayogād bubhuje gamanākulam ||
anviṣya dharmarājo ‘sau sā kanyā mithivaṃśajā |
vivāhitā hitā bhartuḥ sāmahānāyikābhavat ||
śyāmalā nāma cārvuaṅgī prasiddhā śrūyate śrutau |
tām uvāca varārohāṃ dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ priyām ||
vahasva sarvavyāpāraṃ śyāmale tvaṃ gṛhe mama |
kuru svajanabhṛtyānāṃ dānākṣepaṃ yathepsitam ||
kiṃ tv ete pañjarāḥ sapta nālokyā atiyantritāḥ |
kadācid api ghorāś ca tvayā vaidehanandini ||
evam asvtv iti sāpy uktvā nijaṃ karma cakāra ha |
kadācid vyākulībhūtā brahmarājavidehajā ||
udghāṭayitvā prathamaṃ dadarśa jananīṃ svakām |
sā pacyamānā krandantī bhīṣaṇair yamakiṅkaraiḥ ||
helayākṣipyate badhvā taptataile punaḥ punaḥ |
tathaiva tāṃ samālokya vrīḍitā sā manasvinī ||
dvitīye pañjare tadvan mātām eva dadarśa ha |
sudhāvat piṣyamāṇāṃ tāṃ śilāpālyāṣṭaketunā ||
tṛtīye pañjare tadvat tāṃ dadarśa svamātaram |
krakacaiḥ pāṭhyate (?) mūrdhni ghaṇṭayuktaiḥ karolvaṇaiḥ ||
caturthapañjare sthāne bhīṣaṇaiḥ kharuṇānanaiḥ |
bhūjyamānaiḥ svāpadaiś ca krandatīṃ tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
pañcame nihatāṃ bhūmau kaṇṭhaṃ pādena pīḍitām |
[869] saṃdarśair ghanaghātaiś ca vidīrṇā kriyate tu sā ||
ṣaṣṭhe bhuryatramadhyasthāṃ mastake mudvarāhatām |
saṃpīḍyamānām aniśaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ khaṇḍakhaṇḍavat ||
saptame pañjare cārtasvanāṃ pūtisugandhinā |
dṛṣṭvā tathāgatāṃ tāṃ tu mātaraṃ duḥkhakarṣitām ||
śyāmalā mlānavadanā kiṃ ca novāca bhāminī |
athāgatayamaṃ prāha saroṣā śyāmalā patim ||
kiṃ tavāpahṛtaṃ rājan mama tv āśaṃsa dāruṇam |
yena tvaṃ vividhair ghātair vadhyate bahudhācayā ||
yamaḥ prāha priye dṛṣṭvā bhadre nodghaṭitā tvayā |
ete piñjarakāḥ sapta niṣiddhā tvaṃ mayā purā ||
tava mātrā sutasnehād godhūmo ‘pahṛtaḥ kila |
kiṃ na jānāsi te bhadre yena tuṣṭyāpayopari ||
brahmasvaṃ praṇayād bhūtaṃ dahaty āsaptamaṃ kulam |
tad eva cauryarūpeṇa kliśnāty ācandratārakam ||
godhūmās tad ime bhūtāḥ kṛmirūpāḥ sudāruṇāḥ |
ye purā brāhmaṇagṛhe hatā tava kṛte mayā ||
śyāmalovāca |
jānāmi tad ahaṃ sarvaṃ yan me mātrā kṛtaṃ purā |
tathāpi tvāṃ samāsādya tvāṃ ca jāmātaraṃ śubham ||
mucyate kṛmirāśitvād yathāvad adhunā kuru |
tac chrutvā (?) cintayāviṣṭahṛdayo ‘vasthitaś ciram ||
budhāṣṭamī susaṃpūrṇā yathoktaphaladāyinī |
[870] tat phalaṃ yacchatīveyaṃ (?) kuru śīghraṃ jagāda tām ||
dharmarājaḥ sahāsīnāṃ priyāṃ prāṇadhaneśvarīm |
vrataṃ ca saptame ‘tīte janmani brāḥmaṇī śubhā ||
ārtāsi ca tvayā saṅgāt sakhīnāṃ paryupāsitā |
budhāṣṭamī susaṃpūrṇā yathoktaphaladāyinī ||
tat phalaṃ yacchatī vācaṃ satyāṃ kṛtvā mamāgrataḥ |
yena mucyeta te mātā narakāt pāpasaṅkaṭāt ||
tac chrutvā tvaritaṃ snātvā dadau puṇyāhavācakam |
svamātuḥ śyāmalā tuṣṭā tena mokṣaṃ jagāma sā ||
urmilā rūpasaṃpannā divyadehadharā śubhā |
vimānavaram ārūḍhā divyamālyāmbarāvṛtā ||
bhartuḥ samīpe svargasthā dṛśyate ‘dyāpi sā janaiḥ |
budhasya pārśve nabhasi mithirājasamīpataḥ ||
visphurati mahārāja budhāṣṭamyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yady evaṃ pravarā kṛṣṇā tithir vaikā budhāṣṭamī |
tasyā eva vidhiṃ brūhi vidhānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
tasyā eva vidhiṃ brūhi yadi tuṣṭo ‘si me prabho ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pāṇḍavaṃ yatnena budhāṣṭamyāṃ vidhiṃ śubham |
yadā yadā sitāṣṭamyāṃ budhavāro bhaved yati ||
tadā tadaiva sā grāhyā ekabhaktāśanair nṛbhiḥ |
snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhṇe gṛhītvā karaṇaṃ navam ||
[871] jalapūrṇaṃ sahemānaṃ kṛtvā khādyaiḥ samanvitam |
dadyād vidhāya taṃ gatvā gṛhaṃ caiva krameṇa tu ||
aṣṭamyaṣṭavidhānena vicitrānnaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
prathamā modakair bhakṣyaiḥ dvitīyā dhāṇkais tathā ||
tṛtīyā ghṛtapūraiś ca caturthī vaṭakair nṛpa |
pañcamī śubhrakāsāraiḥ ṣaṣṭhīsīhālakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
aśokavartibhiḥ śubhraiḥ saptamī cātivāhayet |
aṣṭamī phāṇitāpūrṇaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭair yudhiṣṭhira ||
evaṃ krameṇa kartavyāḥ suhṛtsvajanabāndhavaiḥ |
sahaikatra sthitair bhojyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ prītipūrvakam ||
upākhyānam idaṃ pārtha bhojanaṃ sahasā tyajet |
tāvad eva hi bhoktavyaṃ yāvan sā kathyate kathā ||
tato bhūtvā (?) budhasyāgre ācamya ca samāhitaḥ |
viprāya vedaviduṣe vācakāya pradāpayet ||
sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca jātarūpamayaṃ śubham |
arcitaṃ carcitaṃ gandhaiḥ puṣpair dhūpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||
pītavastraiḥ samāchannaṃ budhaṃ somātmajākṛtim |
māṣakena suvarṇasya tadardhārdhena vā kṛtām ||
budharūpam uktaṃ matsyapurāṇe |
pītamālyāmbaradharaḥ karṇikārasamadyutiḥ |
khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ || iti |
bhuktiyuktas tu kaunteya dadyād devaṃ samuccaran |
[872] oṃ budhāya namaḥ | oṃ somātmajāya namaḥ | oṃ durbuddhināśāya namaḥ |
oṃ subuddhipradāya namaḥ | oṃ tārājātāya namaḥ | oṃ pītāmbarāya namaḥ |
oṃ saumyagrahāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvasaukhyapradāya namaḥ |
iti pūjāmantrāḥ |
oṃ budho ‘yaṃ pratigṛhṇāti dravyasthas tu punaḥ svayam |
dīyate budharūpeṇa tuṣyatāṃ me budhottamaḥ ||
dānamantraḥ |
oṃ durbuddhibodha duritaṃ nāśayatv avayor budhaḥ |
saukhyaṃ saumanasaṃ nityaṃkarotu śaśinandanaḥ ||
ity uccārya gṛhītvā tu datvā mantrapuraskṛtam |
saptajanmani rājendra bhavej jātismaro bhuvi ||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ putrapautrasamṛddhimān |
dīrghāyur vipulān bhogān bahūn bhuktā mahītale ||
tataḥ sutīrthamaraṇaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ labhet |
mṛto ‘sau svargam āpnoti purandarapurīṃ nṛpa ||
tatrāste yāvad ā sṛṣṭer yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam |
evam eṣā samākhyātā guhyā pārtha budhāṣṭamī ||
yaṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
yaś cāṣṭamīṃ budhayutāṃ samavāpya bhaktyā
saṃpūjayec chaśisutaṃ karakoparistham |
pakvānnapānasahitaṃ sahiraṇyavastraṃ
[873] paśyaty asau yamamukhaṃ na kadācid eva ||
iti bhaviṣyottare budhāṣṭamīvratam |
atha dūrvāṣṭamīvratam |
viṣṇur uvāca |
brahman bhādrapade māsi śuklāṣṭamyām upoṣitaḥ |
pūjayec chaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā yo naraḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devas trilocanaḥ |
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayed yas tu dūrvayā yā hitaṃ mune ||
gaṇeśo maheśvaraḥ |
phalānāṃ sakalair divyair gandhapuṣpair vilepanaiḥ |
dūrvāṃ pūjya tatheṇānaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
śucau deśe prajātāyāṃ dūrvāyāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ |
snāpya liṅgaṃ tato gandhaiḥ puṣpair dhūpaiḥ samarcayet ||
kharjūrair nārikelaiś ca mātuliṅgaphalais tathā |
pūjayec chaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā dūrvayā vidhivad dvija ||
dadhyakṣatair dvijaśreṣṭha pradadyāt tu trilocane |
dūrvāśamībhyāṃ saṃpūjya mānavaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
sa vai sukṛtajanmā syāt sarvadevais tu vanditaḥ |
vidyāṃ prāpnoti vidyārthī putrārthī putram āpnuyāt ||
[874] dharmārthī dharmam āpnoti kanyārthī labhate ca tām |
manasā yad yad iccheta tat tad āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed dūrvāṃ bhūteśaṃ mānavaḥ phalaiḥ |
saptajanmani pāpaudhair mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pūjayec chivam |
dūrvāsametaṃ viprendra dadhyakṣataphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
tvaṃ dūrve ‘mṛtajanmāsi vanditāsi surāsuraiḥ |
saubhāgyaṃ santatiṃ dehi sarvakāryakarau bhava ||
yathā śākhāpraśākhābhir vistṛtāsi mahītale |
tathā mamāpi santānaṃ dehi tvam ajarāmare ||
dūrvāpūjanamantraḥ |
saliṅgamantrair īśānam arcayet prayataḥ śuciḥ |
tataḥ saṃpūjayed viprān phalair nānāvidhair dvija ||
anagnipakvam aśnīyād annaṃ dadhi phalaṃ tathā |
akṣarālavaṇaṃ brahman nāśnīyān madhunānvitam ||
dadyāt phalāni vipreṣu phalāhāraḥ svayaṃ bhavet |
praṇamya śirasā dūrvāṃ śivaṃ śivam avāpnute ||
ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā mahādevasya pūjanam |
gaṇatvaṃ yāty asau brahman mucyate brahmahatyayā ||
evaṃ puṇyā pāpaharā aṣṭamīdevasaṃjñitā |
[875] caturṇām api varṇānāṃ strījanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktaṃ dūrvāṣṭamīvratam |
atha dūrvāṣṭamīvratam |
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu saṃprāpte māsi bhādrapade tathā |
dūrvāpratānaṃ sukhetam uttarāśābhigāminam ||
pūjayed gṛham ānīya gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
phalamūlais tathā caiva dīpaṃ dhūpair visarjayet ||
agnipakvaṃ tathā sarvaṃ nivedya ca kathaṃcana |
bhoktavyaṃ ca tathā brahman vahnipakvavivarjitam ||
dūrvāṅkurasthāṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā yauvane priyam |
yaivanaṃ sthiram āpnoti yatra yatrābhijāyate ||
iti ādityapurāṇoktaṃ dūrvāṣṭamīvratam |
athāśokāṣṭamīvratam |
bhānur uvāca |
aṣṭamīṣu ca sarvāsu pūjanīyāpy aśokikā |
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā ||
tasminn ahani yā bhuṅkte naktam induvivarjite |
bhavaty atho ‘viśokā sā yatra yatrābhijāyate ||
aṣṭamīṣu ca sarvāsu na cec chukleti vai mune |
[876] proṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ yā syāt kṛṣṇāṣṭamī dvijāḥ ||
tasyām avaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ devīṃ pūjya yathāvidhi |
ity ādityapurānoktam aśokāṣṭamīvratam |
qtha mātṛvratam |
mātṝṇām aṣṭamī dattā brahmaṇā tithir uttamā |
etāḥ kṣamāpayed bhaktyā nirāhāro naraḥ sadā ||
tasya tāḥ parituṣṭās tu kṣemārogyaṃ dadanti ca |
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ mātṛvratam |
atha narasiṃhavratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
athāṣṭamīvrataṃ brahman procyamānam idaṃ śṛṇu |
bhavavidhvaṃsanaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvārtiharaṇaṃ param ||
rājā vā rājaputro vā yadi ced ripunāśanam |
tad aṣṭamyāṃ tu susnāto yavāśaṃ ca prakāśayet ||
kuryād aṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tandulair vā prasūnakaiḥ |
karṇikāyām atheśānaṃ narasiṃhākṛtiṃ smaret ||
ugrarūpaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ gambhīrādhvānagarjitam |
[877] bṛhadrajatatuṅgādipravarāhatanudyutim |
calatkarālakuṭilabhrūbhaṅganihatāhitam ||
vaktrāntavṛttijvalitasphuratpadmavilocanam |
daṃṣṭrāgrāntavinirdhūtajvālāvyāptadigantaram ||
nakharāgavinirbhinnavairivakṣaḥ kṣataśrutiḥ |
daityorasthalavikṣodakṣatajānukarāmbujaḥ ||
raktapuṣpaguḍānnena phalamūlena cārcayet |
tatprakāśe mahākumbham avraṇaṃ bhārasaṃmitam ||
tīrthodakena śucinā gandhayuktena pūritam |
vastrayugmena saṃchannaṃ kuśakūrcasamanvitam ||
sarvauṣadhisamāyuktaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitam |
dhānyapūge ‘tha vā śvetataṇḍule sthāpayet sudhīḥ ||
dikṣu vā kalasān aṣṭau śubhavastrādisaṃyutān |
pūrvādikramayogena sthāpayed ekam agrataḥ ||
dvārapradeśe saṃsthāpya kalaśānāṃ dvayaṃ dvayam |
dvārapālān pratiṣṭhāpya kalaśeṣ vahi kramāt ||
rathāṅgaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ ca śārṅgaṃ nandakam eva ca |
smaran pratīcīparyantaṃ kalaśeṣu yathākramam ||
śarāṃś ca muśalaṃ candraṃ smaran koṇeṣu vai gadām |
anantaraṃ ca vai tārkṣaṃ vedātmānaṃ ca saṃsmaran ||
[878] tatra tatra ca vai nāmnā pūjayet susamāhitaḥ |
raktānulepanaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalamūlaiḥ samarcayet ||
tatra tatra ca tanmantraṃ japed aṣṭasahasrakam |
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi svaśaktitaḥ ||
nṛsiṃhaikākṣaraṃ mantraṃ japed vānuṣṭubhaṃ param |
japānte kalpayet kuṇḍam agrataḥ śāstrasaṃmatam ||
dvihastāyām avistāraṃ yoninābhisamanvitam |
caturmekhalakaṃ vāsya trimekhalakam eva vā ||
unmattapuṣpasadṛśaṃ yonirandhraṃ vidur budhāḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuryāt samiddhaṃ jātavedasam ||
tanmadhye saṃsmared devaṃ narasiṃham anuttamam |
sudarśanādyāyudhāni yathāsthānaṃ ca saṃsmaret ||
vidhāyāsgnipratiṣṭhānaṃ praṇavenaiva mantravit |
ādau kuṇḍaṃ ca saṃśodhya kuryād agninimantraṇam ||
paścād agniṃ paristīrya prāgagrair vā kuśair api |
tataḥ saṃśodhya (?) pātrāṇi prokṣayet kramaśas tataḥ ||
praṇītām api saṃśodhya kuryāt tatpariṣecanam |
saṃśodhya homadravyāṇi kuṇḍasyaivāpasavyataḥ ||
vidhāyājyasya saṃskāraṃ pātrādīn paridhāpya ca |
nidhāpya samyak pātrāṇi vājyabhāgau tathaiva ca ||
[879] devatāvāhane paścād dhaviṣaś ca samarpaṇam |
āyuḥ kāmas tu dūrvābhiḥ śrīkāmo bilvasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
ārogyakāmo ‘pāmārgais tilair vāpi ghṛtena ca |
mṛtyor vijayam anvicchan madhvāktaiḥ kamalair navaiḥ ||
puṣpaiś ca campakabhavair dhanārthī jātisaṃbhavaiḥ |
śatror maraṇam ākāṅkṣel lākṣair vāpi vibhītakaiḥ ||
vaśyārthī lavaṇoddhūtaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ samarīcakaiḥ |
tuṣair vā nimbapatrair vā tailenāpi ca sādhayet ||
unmattakais tathonmādair mohane stambhane ‘pi ca |
tadbījais tatphalair vāpi tatkāṣṭhair jvalitānalaiḥ ||
ambujaiḥ śriyam anvicchan sitair avyākulaṃ yadi |
śrīlatākusumaiś cāpi tatpatrair akṣatair api ||
tadbījair aṅkuraiś cāpi trimadhvāktaiś ca taṇḍulaiḥ |
candanakṣodasaṃyuktir utpalaiḥ kumudair api ||
tathā candanakāṣṭhena gavyena payasāpi vā |
ekapatraiḥ parāṃ puṣṭiṃ sahadevyāpy arogatām ||
dhānyair ayus tathārogyam akṣataiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ |
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate mantrī tena tenaiva sādhayet ||
sādhāraṇo vidhir ayaṃ labhate vacmi taṃ punaḥ |
juhuyād daśasāhasraṃ dravyair vātha yathāvidhi ||
yāvat sādhyā garīyas tvaṃ tāvat saṃkhyānadarśanam ||
śrīnivāsa namas te ‘stu śrīvṛkṣa śivavallabha |
[880] mamābhilaṣitāvaptiṃ kṛtvā vighnaharo bhava ||
saptakṛtvas tato abhyarcya śrīvṛkṣaṃ praṇipatya ca |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā śrīdevī prīyatāṃ mama ||
tato bhuñjīta maunena tailakṣāravivarjitam |
anagnipakvaṃ mṛtpātre dadhidhānyaphalaṃ śubham ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha śrīvṛkṣābhyarcanaṃ naraḥ |
nārī vā duḥkhaśokābhyāṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
saptajanmāntaraṃ yāvat sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyutā |
śrīmatī phalinī satyā martyaloke mahīyate ||
śrīvṛkṣam akṣataphalaṃ varadaṃ navamyāṃ
naivedyadicyaphalavastravirūḍhadhānyaiḥ |
pūjyaprabhātasamaye puruṣottamā ye
te prāpnuvanti kamalāṃ puruṣendracandrāḥ ||
atha devasya purataḥ sādhyaṃ kṛtvāsane sthitaḥ |
kumbhatoyena kalaśair mantreṇaivābhiṣecayet ||
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave datvā kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam |
yuddhārambhe janakṣobhe rāṣṭrayātrāripīḍane ||
bhaye vyādhiparikleśe sa kuryād aṣṭamīvratam |
vidyārthī vidyām atulāṃ śriyam icchan mahāśriyam ||
yad yad icchati tat tasya puṣṇāty etaṃ vrataṃ param ||
iti garuḍapurāṇoktaṃ narasiṃhavratam |
[881]
atha haravratam |
brahmovāca |
aṣṭamyāṃ pūjito devo gośrutābharaṇo haraḥ |
jñānaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ kāntiṃ jātiṃ balaṃ tathā ||
gośrutābharaṇaḥ cakṣuḥśravobhūṣaḥ śiva ityārthaḥ |
mṛtyuhā jñānadaś caiva pāpahā ca prapūjitaḥ |
mūlamantrasvasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ ||
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś cātithīśvaraḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate ||
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā |
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ ||
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā |
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvrate vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurānoktaṃ haravratam |
ath sugativratam |
naktāśī tv aṣṭamīṣu syād vatsarānte tu gopradaḥ |
paurandarapadaṃ yāti sugativratam ucyate ||
atra purandaro devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ sugativratam |
[882]
atha vṛṣabhavratam |
sitāṣṭamyāṃ sopavāso vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prapaśyati |
sitavastrayugachannaṃ yadābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
śivaloke ciraṃ sthitvā tato rājā bhaved iha |
vṛṣavratam iha proktaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
sopavāsa iti pūrvadine kṛtopavāsa ity arthaḥ | atra śivo devatā |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ vṛṣabhavratam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ vṛṣabhavratam |
atha gurvaṣṭamīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
brūhi kṛṣṇa vrataṃ kiṃcit sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
pretatvanāśanaṃ caiva bhuktimuktiphalapradam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade rājan śuklapakṣe yādāṣṭamī |
guruvāreṇa saṃyuktā sā tithir dharmavardhinī ||
saṃpūrṇā sarvapāpaghnī pretayonivināśanī |
gṛhṇīyān niyamaṃ samyag dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
[883] ekabhaktena rājendra tasyāṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ |
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyamātmanā ||
sauvarṇaṃ kārayej jīvaṃ rājataṃ vā narottama |
tasyābhāve yathāśaktyā śrīkaṇḍenāpi kārayet ||
śālyodanaṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ ṣaṣṭikānnam athāpi vā |
pātreṣu śāliṃ saṃsthāpya paripūrṇaṃ yathā bhavet ||
kapilā gauḥ pradātavyā vratasaṃpūrṇahetave |
jalapūrṇaṃ tu sadravye sthāpayed brāhmaṇo ghaṭe ||
namas te jñānināṃ śreṣṭha namo nītiviśārada |
tridaśo devadeveśa devarāja namo ‘stu te ||
tridaśādhipaṃ saṃpūjya prārambhe giriśastutaḥ |
gṛhāṇārghyam idaṃ deva namas tubhyaṃ bṛhaspate ||
arghyamantraḥ |
buddhiṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi gatiṃ dehi śurārcita |
bṛhaspate vidhiṃ caiva paripūrṇaṃ kuruṣva me ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
atraivodāhariṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam |
pretamokṣapradaṃ puṇyaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva mahāmate ||
śṛṇu rājan mahābāho sakale kṣitimaṇḍale |
suratho nāma rājābhūt somavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ||
sa kadācid gato ‘raṇye praviṣṭo gahane vane |
[884] śālmalīvṛkṣam ekaṃ ca nirjale sūryatāpite ||
nirjīve nirjale raudre sarvaprāṇabhayaṃkare |
sa dadarśa nṛpas tatra duṣṭarodranibhāntakān ||
asthicarmāvarokāṃś ca ūrdhvakeśabhayāvahān |
daṃṣṭrā karālaraktākṣān pūrvapāpaphalavratān ||
tān uvāca nṛpaḥ pārtha suratho vigatajvaraḥ |
ke yūyaṃ nirjane ‘raṇye kathaṃ bho bhīṣaṇānanāḥ ||
tatas tam ūcuḥ saṃprītāḥ surathaṃ pretasattamāḥ |
rājan karmavipākena vayaṃ pretatvam āgatāḥ ||
athovāca nṛpaḥ pretān karmaṇā kena kathyatām |
nirjane yena vāraṇye tiṣṭhanti pretabhīṣaṇāḥ ||
atha caikena tanmadhyād ukto rājā yathākramam |
kṛtaṃ parastrīgamanam asatyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayā ||
tena karmavipākena pretatvam aham āgataḥ |
dvitīyo ‘thābravīd rājan asmadīyaṃ krtaṃ śṛṇu ||
kurvantīnāṃ gavāṃ pānaṃ jale vighnaṃ mayā kṛtam |
tṛtīyo ‘thābravīd rājan paiśūnyaṃ kṛtavān aham ||
tena karmavipākena pretatvaṃ pragato ‘hy aham |
etasmin kathite rājā provāca suratho nṛpaḥ ||
kathaṃ vo bhojanaṃ pānaṃ śayanaṃ svasti te katham ||
preta uvāca |
yatrocchiṣṭaṃ sthitaṃ bhūmau śleṣmā nāsāvinirgatam |
rajoviniḥsṛtaṃ yonau strīṇāṃ tad api bhojanam ||
[885] nānyathā bhojanaṃ rājan tena lajjāmahe vayam |
na praṣṭavyaṃ mahābāho pānīyaṃ na labhāmahe ||
suratha uvāca |
kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ tapodānaiḥ kiṃ vā tīrthāvagāhanaiḥ |
yuṣmākaṃ ca bhaven mokṣo vratam ekaṃ vinā prabho ||
rājovāca |
kiṃ vrataṃ kathyatāṃ śīghraṃ ko vidhiḥ kā ca devatā |
kasmin vāre dine māse yena mokṣo bhavec ca vaḥ ||
preta uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade rājan śuklapakṣe yadāṣṭamī |
guruvāreṇa saṃpūrṇā labhyate ca mahāvratam ||
gurvaṣṭamī mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī |
budhāṣṭamī sahasrasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
diṅmūḍho ‘haṃ vane pretā bhavanto darśayantu me |
bhūpasya darśayāmāsus te ca mārgaṃ sugāminam ||
rājā ca svapuraṃ gatvā kṛtvā ca vratam uttamam |
pretān nareṇa vidhinā dadau puṇyaṃ trivācakam ||
pretatvād atha muktās te vimānavaram āśritāḥ |
sūryayugmasamaṃ hṛṣṭā surathaṃ nṛpasattamam ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha bṛhaspatiśubhavratam |
tasmin vaṃśe ca na pretā bhaviṣyanti kadācana ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchaty anāmayam |
[886] etat te kathitaṃ pārtha guhyaṃ gurvaṣṭamīvratam ||
yaḥ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ gurvaṣṭamīvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe aṣṭamīvratāni |
[887]
atha trayodaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ
atha navamīvratāni
avāpya yad upāśrayaṃ guṇigaṇaḥ paraṃ ślādhate
pavitritajagattrayaṃ jayati yasya kāntaṃ yaśaḥ |
kramāgatam athocyate sakalalokaśokāpahaṃ
samastanavamītithivratam anena hemādiṇā ||
atha śrīvṛkṣanavamīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
samutpanneṣu ratneṣu kṣīrodamathane purā |
bilvavṛkṣagaṇaṃ gatvā viśrāntā kamalālayā ||
mameyam iti cānyonyaṃ yuyudhur devadānavāḥ |
asurā nirjitāḥ sarve yuddhe cakreṇa cakriṇā ||
pātālaṃ gamitā daityāḥ saśrīkaḥ svayam ābabhau |
śrīkāmāvāsito yasmāt śrīvṛkṣas tena sa smṛtaḥ ||
tasmād bhādrapade caiva śuklapakṣe kurūttama |
navamyām arcayed bhaktyā īṣat sūryodaye ‘nagha ||
śrīvṛkṣaṃ vividhai ratnair anagnipatitaiḥ phalaiḥ |
tilapiṣṭānnagodhūmair dhūpagandhānulepanaiḥ ||
īṣadbhānukarākrānta śrīkṛtā vai nabhastale |
mantreṇānena rājendra pūjayed bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||
[888] śrīnivāsa namas te ‘stu śrīvṛkṣa śivavallabha |
mamāpi sattamāṃ tṛptiṃ kṛtvā vighnaharo bhava ||
saptakṛtvas tato ‘bhyarcya śrīvṛkṣaṃ praṇipatya ca |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā śrīdevī prīyatāṃ mama ||
tato bhuñjīta maunena tailakṣāravivarjitam |
anagnipakvaṃ mṛtpātre dadhidhānyaphalaṃ śubham ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha śrīvṛkṣābhyarcanaṃ naraḥ |
nārī vā duḥkhaśokābhyāṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
saptajanmāntaraṃ yāvat sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyutā |
śrīmatī dyutinī caiva martyaloke mahīyate ||
śrīvṛkṣam akṣataphalaṃ varadaṃ navamyāṃ
naivedyapuṣpaphalaratnavirūḍhadhānyaiḥ |
pūjya prabhātasamaye puruṣottamo ‘syāṃ
te prāpnuvanti kamalāṃ puruṣendracandra ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ śrīvṛkṣanavamīvratam |
atha dhvajanavamīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ulkākhyāṃ navamīṃ rājan kathayāmi nibodha tām |
yā kāśyapena kathitā tārakasyārttināśinī ||
[889] aśvayuk śuklapakṣe yā navamīti ca viśrutā |
nadyā snātvā tam abhyarcya bhagavatyā mahāsuraiḥ |
pūrvavaram anusmṛtya saṃgrāme bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ ||
nānārūpadharā devī avatīrya punaḥ punaḥ |
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya patighne daityasattamān ||
atha raktāsuro nāma mahiṣasya suto mahān |
āsīt tena tapas taptaṃ varṣāṇām ayutāni ṣaṭ ||
tasmai dadau vaturvaktro rājyaṃ trailokyamaṇḍale |
tena labdhavareṇātha hy alapitvā danoḥ sutān ||
prārabdhaṃ saha śakreṇa yuddhaṃ gatvāmarāvatīm |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavabalaṃ saṃnaddhaṃ boddhata dhavjam ||
yuyudhe dānavaḥ sārdhaṃ suraiḥ śukrapuraḥsaraiḥ |
tatra prāvartata nadī śoṇitaughataraṅgiṇī ||
paramasya gadā prāha vasulaṃ dantakacchapā |
vahantī pittale kāye surāsurabhaṭānakāḥ ||
atha raktāsuro roṣād yuyudhe vibudhaiḥ saha |
te hanyamānā vibudhā raktākṣeṇa mahāraṇe ||
bhraṣṭāḥ svargaṃ pariṣvajya tyaktaprāharaṇāhutam |
kaṭachatrāṃ purīṃ prāptā yatrāste bhavavallabhā ||
durgā cāmuṇḍayā sārdhaṃ navadurgāsamanvitā |
ādyā tāvan mahālakṣmīr nandā kṣemaṃkarī tathā ||
śivadūtī mahātuṇḍā bhrāmarī candramaṅgalā |
revatī harisiddhis tu navaitāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
[890] yas tāsāṃ te stutiṃ cakre tridaśāḥ praṇatā matāḥ ||
amarakukuṭacumbitacaraṇāmbujāḥ
sakalabhuvanasukhajananīm |
japantī jagadīśaṃ muditā sakalaniṣkalā durgā || 1 ||
viṣṇate nakhadaśanabhūṣaṇarudhiravasāchuritakṛtakhaḍgahastā |
jayati nararudramaṇḍitapiśācānucarahārakundarī || 2 ||
prajvalitaśikhigaṇolbaṇavikaṭajaṭābaddhacandramaṇīśobhā |
jayati digambare bhūṣāsiddhavaṭe sā lakṣmīḥ || 3 ||
