karakamalajanitaśobhāviprāvabaddhapadmavacanā ca |
jayati kamaṇḍaluhastā nandādevī na nannihara (?) || 4 ||
digvasanā vikṛtamukhā phetkāroddāmapūritadikśobhā |
jayati vikāraṇadehā kṣemaṃkarī raudrabhāvasthā || 5 ||
krośatabrahmāṇḍodaramukharamukharamukhahuṅkṛtaninādā |
jayati mahātihastā śivadūtī prathamaśivabhaktitaḥ || 6 ||
muktāṭṭahāsabhairavaduḥsaha uccakitamakaladigvaktrā |
jayati bhujagendrabandhanaśobhitakarṇāmadātuṇḍā || 7 ||
paṭahamurajamardalakullariktānartitāvayavā |
jayati madhuvratāttapādaityaharī bhrāmarī devī || 8 ||
śāntā praśāntavadanā sihanvyādhyānayogagatiniṣṭhā |
jayati caturbhujadehā candrakalā candramaṇḍalā devī || 9 ||
pakṣapuṭacañcughātaiḥ sacūrnitavividhaśatrusaṅghātā |
jayati śivaśūlahastā bahurūpā revatī bhadrā || 10 ||
paryati jagatiduṣṭā pitṛvananilayeṣu yoginī sahitā |
jayati harasiddhi (?) nāmnāṃ harasiddhir vanditā siddhaiḥ || 11 ||
[891] iti durgā sūkṣmānupamamaryādātiramararāṭ kṛtvā idam ūce saha devaiḥ sāpahy asmāt sarvabhītibhyaḥ |
punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyāpur bhavānāṃ siṃhavāhinīm |
asmākaṃ bhavabhītānāṃ śrutvā tebhyo bhayaṃ tataḥ ||
siṃhāt taṃ ca vinirgatya durgābhiḥ sahitā purāt |
yuyudhe dānavaiḥ sārdhaṃ mahāsamaradurdinam ||
kumārī viṃśatibhujā ghanavidyullatopamā |
te ‘pi tatrāsurāprāptāḥ pracaṇḍā raudrarūpiṇaḥ ||
sarvaṃ laghuvaraḥ sūrā sutaptatapasas tathā |
mahāgrahāpakrāntā hy ata (?) māyāvinirṇaye ||
ābrahmāṇyā hy adhamiṣānāmataś (?) ca nibodhitān |
indramārī manukeśāṃ pralambo narakaḥ kutaḥ ||
kuṣṭhaḥ pulomā śarabhaḥ sambaro dundubhiḥ kharaḥ |
ilvalo namucir bhaumo vātāgryaṃ (?) dhenukaḥ kaliḥ ||
māyāvṛto balau bandhuamadhukaiṭabhakālavit |
rahaḥ pauṇḍrādidaityendrāḥ prādhānyād ye prakīrtitāḥ ||
dhanagobhir janāḥ sarve saṃnaddhā svocchṛtodhvajaḥ |
rūpato varṇitaś caiva dhvajās teṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
pratyadṛśyanta rājendra jvalitā iva pāvakāḥ |
kāñcanāḥ kāñcanāpīḍāḥ kāñcanāsragalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
patākā vividhair bālair utthitā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ |
nīlāḥ pītāḥ sitā raktāḥ kṛṣṇābhāḥ pañcavarṇakāḥ ||
tatra padapaṭī saucā kṛtabudbudakarburā |
[892] patākā kāntivalalā kartavyā iva śobhanāḥ ||
tato halahalārāvaṃ cakrus te dānavottamāḥ |
prāsphālayanti paṇavā bherīmurajagomukhāḥ ||
tān vādayatyānakandye śaṅkhāḍambaraḍiṇḍimān |
evaṃ (?) te samayudhyanta bhavānī daityadānavāḥ ||
samājaghnuḥ śaraiḥ śulaiḥ parighaiḥ śaktitomaraiḥ |
kaṇāyair iva taiḥ kuntaiḥ śataghnīkūṭamudgaraiḥ ||
āhatyamāṇo roṣeṇa jajvāla samare ‘dhikam |
siṃhārūḍhā drutaṃ devī raṇamadhye pradhāvitā ||
acchivācchapravihnāni dhvajā nānāvidhās tathā |
balātkāreṇa daityānām anāthasamare tu vā ||
cihnakāni dadau tuṣṭā devebhyaḥ śīghracāriṇī |
sarvair api gṛhītāni japed devītivādibhiḥ ||
avidyā tu bhṛśaṃ tuṣṭā teṣāṃ cakre kṣaṇāt kṣayam |
kālarātrir dānavānāṃ marīcir (?) nipapāta sā ||
jīvitāni ca jagrāha daityānāṃ davanandinī |
atha raktāsuraṃ kaṇṭhe gṛhītvāpātya bhūtale ||
devī jagrāha tīkṣmena triśūlena bhṛśaṃ divi |
saṃbhinnahṛdaye māsāś cakre daityasudāruṇāḥ ||
tathāpi devyābhihitaḥ papāta ca mamāra ca |
devas tān asurāñ jitvā jitvā śatrupure jitaṃ ||
dadṛśus te kraṇaprānte lambamānā mahādhvajāḥ |
yātrāyāṃ cakruḥ saṃprahṛdyān navamyāṃ dhvajacihnitām ||
[893] atodyāṃ pīha bhūpālair jayalakṣai chipādṛtaiḥ |
upeṣyate narair bhaktaiḥ nārībhiś caiva pāṇḍava ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kīdṛgvidhānaṃ tasyāstu navamyāṃ brūhi me prabho |
sarahasyaṃ ca mantraṃ ca tuṣyate yena caṇḍikā ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
kīdṛgvidhānaṃ tasyās tu navamyāṃ brūhi me prabho |
sarahasyaṃ ca mantraṃ ca tuṣyate yena caṇḍikā ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
pauṣasya śuklapakṣe yā navamī śambarī śrutā |
tasyāṃ snātvā śubhaiḥ puṣpair arcanīyā hareśvasā ||
kumārī bhagavān devī siṃhasyandanagāminī |
dhajān nānāvidhān kṛtvā puratas taṃ ca pūjayet ||
mālatīkusumair dīpair gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
valibhiḥ paśubhir medhyaiḥ (?) surāmāṃsasrapindhanaiḥ ||
dadhicandanacūrṇaiś ca phalaiś cānagnipācitaiḥ |
devīṃ svarṇamayīṃ kṛtvā siṃhārūḍhāṃ caturbhujām ||
khaḍgaśaktidharāṃ śūladharāṃ netratrayānvitām |
mantreṇānena kaunteya brāhmaṇo ‘py atha vā na tu ||
bhadrāṃ bhagavatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ viśvasya jagato hitām |
praveśanīṃ saṃvamanīṃ grahanakṣatramālinīm ||
prapanno ‘haṃ śivāṃ rātrīṃ bhadre māṃ pāhi sarvadā |
sarvabhūtapiśācebhyaḥ sarvasatvasarīsṛpeḥ ||
devebhyo mānuṣebhyaś cobhayebhyo rakṣa māṃ manaḥ |
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācebhyo nāgebhyo vṛścikeṣv api ||
[894] caurādiduṣṭasatvebhyo hiṃsrebhyo rakṣa sarvataḥ |
ity uccārya pradhānyekaṃ dhvajakiṅkaṇimālinam ||
tataś cāropayed rājā devīnāṃ bhavane tathā |
bhojayec ca kumārīś ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
vācakaṃ pūrayitvā ca pariprāpya kṣamāpya ca |
upavāsena kurvīta ekabhaktena vā punaḥ ||
bhaktyā nareṇa dṛḍhayā bhaktis tatra garīyasī |
evaṃ ye pūjayiṣyanti dhvajair bhagavatīṃ naraḥ ||
teṣāṃ durgā durgamārge cauravyālāgnisaṅkaṭe |
raṇe rājakule gehe yuddhamadhye jale sthale ||
rakṣāṃ karoti satataṃ bhavānī sarvamaṅgalā |
asyāṃ babhūva vijayo navamyāṃ pāṇḍunandana ||
bhagavatyās tu tenaiṣāṃ navamī satataṃ priyām |
dhanyā puṇyā pāpaharā sarvopadravanāśinī ||
anuṣṭheyā prayatnena sarvakāmān abhīpsitān ||
devyārcanaṃ hitam idaṃ manujo navamyāṃ
hemasrajaṃ dhavajavarāṃ sa hi ropayed yaḥ |
kāmān avāpya manaso pihitān vihāya
dehaṃ prāyāti parameśvari pādamūlam ||
iti bhaviṣyottare dhvajanavamīvratam |
[895]
atha ulkānavamīvratam |
uṣṇa (?) uvāca |
ulkākhyā navamī rājan kathayāmi nibodha tām |
yā kāśyapena kathitā tārakasyārtināśinī ||
aśvayukśuklapakṣe yā navamī līkaviśrutā |
nadyāṃ snātvā samabhyarcya pitṛdevān yathāvidhi ||
paścāt saṃpūjayed devīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ bhairavī priyām |
puṣpair dhūpaiḥ savaivedyaiḥ māṃsamatsyasurāsavaiḥ ||
pūjayitvā stavaṃ kuryān mantreṇānena mānavaḥ |
samāropyāñjaliṃ mūrdhni jānubhyām avanīṃ gataḥ ||
mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālini |
dravyam āropya vijayaṃ dehi devi namo ‘stu te ||
bhūtapretapiśācebhyo rakṣobhyaś ca maheśvari |
devebhyo mānuṣebhyaś ca bhayebhyo rakṣa māṃ sadā ||
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhike |
ubhe brahmāṇi kaumārī viśvarūpe prasīda me ||
kumārīr bhojayet paścāt navamyāṃ nīlakañcukaiḥ |
paridhānair bhūṣaṇaiś ca bhūṣayitvā kṣamāpayet ||
saptapañcamayaiṣāṃ vā vittavṛttānurūpataḥ |
śraddhayā tuṣyate devī iti vīrānuśāsanam ||
abhyukṣya maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena śuciḥ smṛtaḥ |
[896] datvāsanaṃ copaviśet pātraṃ ca purato nyaset ||
tataḥ susiddham annaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ pariveṣayet |
saghṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ te ‘pi svayaṃ cāpātrasaṃnidhau ||
tṛṇāni puṣṭhim ādāya hy ādāya grāmakaṃ tathā |
prajvālayet tato bhojya yāvaj jvalati pāvakaḥ ||
praśānte bhojanaṃ tyaktā samācamya prasannadhīḥ |
cāmuṇḍāṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā gṛhakṛtyaparo bhavet ||
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsi māsi samācaret |
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte bhojayitvā kumārikāḥ ||
vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ pūjya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
suvarṇaṃ śaktito dadyād gāṃ ca viprāya śobhanām ||
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha puruṣo navamīvratam |
na tasya śatravo nārtiṃ na rājā nāpi taskaraḥ ||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāś ca janayanti bhayaṃ guha |
samudyateṣu śāstreṣu hatā tasya na vidyate ||
rakṣate jayadoyuktā sarvāt suvacaṇḍikā |
naro vā yadi vā nārī vratam etat samācaret ||
ulkāvatsasapatnānāṃ jvalagaste sadā hṛdi ||
tāṃ śuṣkavoḍharasukhī prakaṭī tu daṃṣṭrā
kāmākinīṃ samabalaṃ citimuṇḍamālam |
ulkavrateṣu puruṣo navamīṣu caṇḍo
saṃpūjya kasya hṛdayaṃ na ca śaṅkaroti ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottare ulkānavamīvratam |
[897]
atha uklānavamīvratam |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
vratena yena devendra prasīdaty āśu pārvatī |
tac colkā navamīsaṃjñaṃ śṛṇu sarvaphalapradam ||
tasyāṃ navamyāṃ sarvāṇi mahiṣādīn mahāsurān |
jaghāna samare śatrūn tena sā navamī priyā ||
aśvayukśuklapakṣasya navamyāṃ prayatātmavān |
snātvābhyarcya pitṝn devān manuṣyāṃś ca yathākramam ||
japet paścān mahādevīṃ mahiṣāsuraghātinīm |
puṣpair dhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ payodadhiphalādibhiḥ ||
bhaktyā saṃpūjayitvaivaṃ devīṃ saṃprārthayet tataḥ |
mantreṇānena vṛtrāriṃ śraddhayā parayā vratī ||
mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṣḍe muṇḍamālini |
divyam ārogyavijayaṃ dehi devi namo ‘stu te ||
bhūtapretapiśācebhyo rakṣobhyaś ca maheśvari |
devebhyo mānuṣebhyaś ca bhayebhyo rakṣa māṃ sadā ||
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhike |
ubhe brāhmāṇi kaumāri viśvarūpe prasīda me ||
kumārīr jojayitvā ca bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet |
na ca saptāṣṭakaṃ caikaṃ bālavittānusārataḥ ||
[898] śraddhayā prītim āpnoti devī bhagavatī śivā |
śāstravayasyajac caiva sa taṃ yatnena pūjayet ||
yataḥ śāstreṣu sā devī nivasaty eva santatam |
abhyukṣya maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena suvistaram ||
datvā samaṃ copaviśet pātraṃ ca purato nyaset |
tasyāṃ saṃsiddhamantrādyaṃ tat sarvam upaveṣayet ||
prāk ca sarvaṃ samuddhṛtya vāyasebhyo nivedayet |
tṛṇānāṃ muṣṭim ādāya hastamātraṃ suyantritam ||
anyahastasthitaṃ kṣālya svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
praśānte ‘gnau samācamya śucis tadgatamānasaḥ ||
cāmuṇḍāṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā gṛhakṛtyaparo bhavet |
anena vidhinā varṣe māsi māsi samācaret ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte bhojayitvā kumārikāḥ |
vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ pūjya praṇipatya visarjayet ||
sarukmaśṛṅgīr dadyāc ca gās tu viprāya śobhanāḥ |
naro vā yadi vā nārī vratam etat karoti yaḥ ||
ulkaiva sā sapatnīnāṃ tejasā bhāti bhūtale |
śrīmahānavamī tv (?) eṣā khyātā suratha te ‘dhunā ||
sarvasiddhikarī puṇyā sarvopadravanāśinī |
nādhyātmikaṃ bhayaṃ tasya daivaṃ syān nādhibhautikam ||
rakṣate hi sadā śakra sarvāpatsu ca caṇḍikā |
śāntipuṣṭikarī dhanyā putrārogyārthalābhadā ||
anuṣṭheyā sadā puṃbhiś caturvargaphalārthibhiḥ |
[899] yaś chadmanāpi kurute vratam etad itthaṃ
caṇḍīpriyaṃ suratha te munisiddhajuṣṭam |
rudrāṅganākulavarākulitaṃ vimānam
āruhya yāti sumukhena śivasya lokam ||
iti saurapurāṇoktam ulkānavamīvratam |
atha pradīptanavamīvratam |
hastamātraṃ tṛṇaṃ kāryam aṅguṣṭhatarjanīgatam |
pradīpaṃ yāvan noddīptaṃ tāvad bhojanam ācaret ||
āśvinaśuklanavamyām iti śeṣaḥ |
devīṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu ṣoḍaśārṇena bhāvitaḥ |
oṃ mahābhagavatyai mahiṣāsuramardinyai
nāmnā huṃ paṭ iti ṣoḍaśākṣaram |
hemapuṣpais tathā gandhai ratnaiś citrair yathāvidhi |
saṃvatsaraṃ yathānyāyaṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
pradīptā navamī vatsa hemagodakṣiṇā matā |
ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā saṃgrāmeṣv aparājitā ||
bhavate śatrusaṃghasya yathā devo maheśvaraḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena guggulor guṭikān dadhan ||
pūjayitvā śivaṃ mantraiḥ pradīptāṃ homayed vidhau |
pūrvoktena vidhānena śivaṃ pūjayitvā guggulor gṛṭikāṃ homayed ity anvayaḥ |
[900] mantraiḥ durgāmantraiḥ | pradīpte vidhau prauḍhe candre pradoṣānta ity arthaḥ |
pūrvoktā dakṣiṇā vātra phalaṃ vājimakhoditam ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ pradīptanavamīvratam |
atha navarātrivratam |
devā ūcuḥ |
yāvad bhūr vāyur ākāśaṃ jalaṃ vahniśaśigrahāḥ |
tāvad vai caṇḍikāpūjā bhaviṣyati sadā bhuvi ||
prāvṛṭkāle viśeṣeṇa āśvine hy aṣṭamīṣu ca |
mahāśabdo navamyāṃ ca loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ||
brahmovāca |
etat te devarājendra svargavāsaphalapradam |
varāvaravibhāgaṃ tu kriyāyogena kīrtitam ||
evaṃ mahābalaṃ śakra purā devārikaṇṭakam |
hatvā devīṃ varaṃ dadhyur vidyādyāś ca pratoṣitāḥ ||
śakra uvāca |
āśvine ghātite ghore navamyāṃ prativatsaram |
śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ tāta upavāsajapādikam ||
ghore ghoranāmni daitye ghātite mārite satīty arthaḥ |
[901] brahmovāca |
śṛṇu śakra pravakṣyāmi yathā tvaṃ pṛcchasi svayam |
mahāsiddhipradaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam ||
sarvalokopakārārthaṃ viśeṣād ativṛṣṭiṣu |
kṛtyarthaṃ brāhmaṇādyaiś ca kṣatriyair bhūmipālane ||
godhanārthaṃ viśā vatsa śūdraiḥ putrasukhārthibhiḥ |
saubhāgyārthaṃ striyā kāryam āḍhyaś ca dhanakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
mahāvrataṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śaṅkarādyair anuṣṭhitam |
kartavyaṃ devarājendra devībhaktisamanvitaiḥ ||
kanyāsaṃkhye gurau śakra śuklād ārabhya nandikām |
nandikāṃ pratipat |
yavāśīty atha vai kāśī naktāśīty atha vā punaḥ ||
prātaḥsnāyījitadvandvas trikālaṃ śivapūjakaḥ |
japahomasamāsaktaḥ (?) kanyakābhojayet sadā ||
aṣṭamyāṃ navagehāni dārujāni śubhāni ca |
ekaṃ vā hi tribhāvena kārayet surasattama ||
tasmin devī prakartavyā haimī vā rājatīpi vā |
yuddhakālakṣaṇopetakhaḍgaśūlena pūjayet ||
sarvopahārasaṃpannā vastraratnaphalādibhiḥ |
kārayed rathadolādipūjāṃ ca balidaivikīm ||
baligrāhiṇo devā balidevā vināyakādayaḥ | [902] tatsaṃbandhinīṃ balidaivakīm | puṣpaiś candreṇa bilvāmrajātīpunnāgacampakaiḥ | droṇaḥ kuruvakaḥ |
vicitrāṃ racayet pūjām aṣṭamyām upavāsayet |
durgāgrato japen mantram ekacittaḥ subhāvitaḥ ||
tadardhayāminīśeṣe vijayārthaṃ nṛpotttama |
pañcābdaṃ lakṣaṇopetaṃ mahiṣaṃ ca supūjitam ||
vidhivat kālakālīti japtvā khaḍgena ghātayet |
tasyotthaṃ rudhiraṃ māṃsaṃ gṛhītvā pūjanādiṣu ||
nairṛtāya pradātavyaṃ mahākauśikamantritam |
tasyāgrato nṛpaḥ snāyāc chatruṃ kṛtvā supiṣṭajam ||
khaḍgena ghātayitvā tu dadyāt skandaviśākhayoḥ |
tato devīṃ sumṛtpātre kṣīrasarpirjalādibhiḥ ||
kuṅkumāgurukarpūracandanaiś cārcya dhūpayet |
hemādipuṣparatnādivāsāṃsi āhatāni ca ||
naivedyaṃ suprabhūtaṃ tu deyaṃ devyā subhāvitaiḥ |
devībhaktāṃś ca pūjeta kanyakāḥ pramadādikāḥ ||
dvijātīn andhapāṣaṇḍān annadānena prīṇayet |
nandā bhaktā narā ye tu mahāvratadharāś ca ye ||
rathayātrābalijñeyaṃ jayavādyaravākulam |
kārayet tuṣyate yena devī vastanighātanaiḥ ||
aśvamedham avāpnoti bhaktitaḥ surasattama |
mahānavamyāṃ pūjeyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyikā ||
[903] sarveṣu vatsa varṇeṣu tava bhaktāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
kṛtvāpnoti yaśo rājyaṃ putrāyurdhanasaṃpadaḥ ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ navarātrivratam |
atha mahānavamyutsavavidhim |
kumārīpūjanam apy aśeṣeṇoktaṃ skandapurāṇe |
ekaikāṃ pūjayet kanyām ekavṛddhyā tathaiva ca |
dviguṇāṃ triguṇāṃ cāpi pūjayen navakaṃ tathā ||
navabhir lakṣate bhūmim aiśvaryaṃ dviguṇena ca |
ekavṛddhyā labhet kṣemam ekaikena priyaṃ labhet ||
ekavarṣā tu yā kanyā pūjārthaṃ tāṃ vivarjayet |
gandhapuṣpaphalādīnāṃ prītis tasya na vidyate ||
dvivarṣakanyām ārabhya daśavarṣāvadhi kramāt |
pūjayet sarvakāryeṣu yathāvidhy uktamārgataḥ ||
kumārikā dvivarṣā tu trivarṣā ca trimūrtinī |
caturvarṣā tu kayāṇī pañcavarṣā tu rohiṇī ||
ṣaḍvarṣā tu bhavet kālī saptavarṣā tu caṇḍikā |
aṣṭavarṣā śāṃbavī tu durgā tu navamī smṛtā ||
daśavarṣā subhadreti nāmabhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
ata ūrdhvaṃ tu yāḥ kanyāḥ sarvakāryeṣu varjitāḥ ||
[904] duḥkhadāridranāśāya śatrūṇāṃ nāśanāya ca |
āyuṣyabalavṛddhārthaṃ kumārīḥ pūjayet naraḥ ||
āyuṣkāmas trimūrtiṃ tu trivargasya phalāptaye |
apamṛtyuvyādhipīḍā duḥkhānām apanuttaye ||
saukhyadhānyadhanārogyaputrapautrādhivṛddhaye |
kalyāṇīṃ pūjayed dhīmān nityaṃ kalyāṇavṛddhaye ||
ārogyasukhakāmī ca jayakāmī tathaiva ca |
yaśaskāmī naro nityaṃ rohiṇīṃ paripūjayet ||
vidyārthī ca jayārthī ca rājyārthī ca viśeṣataḥ |
śatrūṇāṃ ca vināśārthī kālikāṃ pūjayen naraḥ ||
saṃgrāme jayakāmī ca caṇḍikāṃ paripūjayet |
duḥkhadāridryanāśāya nṛpasaṃmohanāya ca ||
mahāpāpavināśāya śāmbhavīṃ ca prapūjayet |
sa cet kulāṭaśatrūṇām ugrasādhanakarmaṇi ||
durgāṃ durgatināśāya pūjayed yatnato budhaḥ |
saubhāgyadhanadhānyādivāñchitārthaphalāptaye ||
subhadrāṃ pūjayen martyo dāsīdāsavivṛddhaye |
kumārīpūjāprakāraṃ ca tatraivoktaḥ |
prātaḥkāle viśeṣeṇa kṛtābhyaṅgo viśeṣataḥ |
āvāhayet tataḥ kanyāṃ mantreṇānena bhārgava ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
mantrākṣaramayī lakṣmīr mātṝṇāṃ rūpadhāriṇī |
navadurgātmikāṃ sākṣāt kanyām āvāhayāmy aham ||
[905] tripurāṃ tripurādhārāṃ trivargāṃ jñānarūpiṇīm |
trailokyavanditāṃ devīṃ trimūrtiṃ pūjayāmy aham ||
kalātmikāṃ kalātītāṃ kāruṇyahṛdayāṃ śivām |
kalyāṇajananīṃ nityāṃ kalyāṇīṃ pūjayāmy aham ||
aṇimādiguṇādhārāṃ makārādyakṣarātmikām |
anantaśaktikāṃ lakṣmīṃ rohiṇīṃ pūjayāmy aham ||
kāmacārīṃ śubhāṃ kāntāṃ bāṇacakrasvarūpiṇīm |
kāmadāṃ karuṇōdārāṃ kālīṃ saṃpūjayāmy aham ||
caṇḍavīrāṃ caṇḍamāyāṃ caṇḍamuṇḍaprabhaṅganīm |
pūjayāmi sadā devīṃ caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramām ||
sadānandakarīṃ śāntāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām |
sarvabhūtātmikāṃ lakṣmīṃ śāmbhavīṃ pūjayāmy aham ||
durgame dustare kārye bhavaduḥkhavināśinīm |
pūjayāmi sadā bhaktyā durgāṃ durgārtināśinīm ||
sundarīṃ svarṇadarṇābhāṃ sukhasaubhāgyadāyinīm |
subhadrāṃ jananīṃ devīṃ subhadrāṃ pūjayāmy aham ||
evam abhyarcanaṃ kuryāt kumārīṇāṃ prayatnataḥ |
kambukaiś caiva vastraiś ca gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
nānāvidhair bhakṣyabhojyair bhojayet pāyasādibhiḥ |
hīnādhikāṅgīṃ kuṣṭhādivikārāṃ kukulān tathā ||
granthisphuṭitagarbhāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitān |
jātyandhāṃ kekarīṃ kāṇīṃ kurūpāṃ tanuromaśām ||
[906] saṃtyajed rogiṇīṃ kanyāṃ dāsīgarbhasamudbhavām |
arogiṇīṃ supuṣṭāṅgīṃ surūpāṃ vraṇavarjitām ||
ekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayet |
brāhmaṇīṃ sarvakāryeṣu jayārthe nṛpavaṃśajām ||
dāruṇe cānyajātīyāṃ pūjayed vidhinā naraḥ || iti |
atra cāścasya (?) pūjanam uktaṃ devīpurāṇe |
aśvayukśuklapratipattithiyoge śubhe dine |
pūrvam uccaiḥ śravā nāma prathamaṃ śriyam āvahan ||
tasmāt so ‘śvo narais tatra pūjyo ‘sau śraddhayā saha ¦
pūjanīyāś ca turagā navamīṃ yāvad eva hi ||
śāntiḥ svastyayanaṃ kāryā tadā teṣāṃ dine dine |
dhānyabhallātakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacāṃ siddhārthakāṃs tathā ||
pañcavarṇena sūtreṇa granthis teṣāṃ tu bandhayet |
vāyavair vāruṇaiḥ sauraiḥ śāktair mantraiś ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ ||
vaiśvadevais tathāgneyair homaḥ kuryād dine dine |
turaṅgā rakṣaṇīyās tu puruṣaiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ ||
daridryataḥ kvacit tatra na ca bāhyāḥ kathaṃcana || iti |
asmin navarātre ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bilvaśākhādimantraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tathā liṅgapurāṇe |
[907] aiṃ rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya rāmasyānugrahāya ca |
akāle brahmaṇā bodho devyās tvayi kṛtaḥ purā ||
aham apy āśritaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sāyāhne bodhayāmy ataḥ |
śrīśailaśikhare jāta śrīphala śrīniketana ||
netavyo ‘si mayā gaccha pūjyo durgāsvarūpataḥ |
saptamyāṃ pratas tāṃ śākhāṃ gṛhaṃ chittvā praveśayet ||
tathā ca tatraiva |
mūlābhāve ‘pi saptamyām kevalāyāṃ praveśayet |
ubhābhyām navabilvasya phalābhyāṃ śākhikāṃ tathā || iti |
aṣṭamyāṃ pūjāviśeṣo vihito brahmapurāṇe |
atrāṣṭamyāṃ bhadrakālī dakṣayajñavināśinī. |
prādurbhūtā mahāghorā yoginī koṭibhiḥ saha ||
ato ‘rthaṃ pūjanīyā sā tasminn ahani mānavaiḥ |
upoṣitair vastradhūpair dīpair mālyānulepanaiḥ ||
āmiṣair vividhaiḥ śākair homabrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ |
bilvapatraiḥ śrīphalaiś ca candanena ghṛtena ca ||
navamyāṃ tu kṛtasnānaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūjyās tu brāhmaṇāḥ || iti |
pratipadādiṣu navasu pratidinaṃ durgāpūjādikaraṇāsāmarthye saptamyādidinatrayeṇa kartavyam | tad āha dhaumyaḥ |
āśvine māsi śukle tu kartavyaṃ navarātrakam |
pratipadādikrameṇaiva yāvac ca navamī bhavet ||
[908] trirātraṃ vāpi kartavyaṃ saptamyādi yathākramam || iti |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
puṇyā mahānavamy asti tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ |
sānuṣṭheyā suraiḥ sarvaiḥ prajāpālair viśeṣataḥ ||
bhavānītuṣṭaye pārtha saṃvatsarasukhāya ca |
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ prītyarthaṃ tūtsavāya ca ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kasmāt kālāt pravṛtteyaṃ navamī mahaśabditā |
kimādāv api kṛṣṇāsīd bhagavatyāḥ priyā tithiḥ ||
yaśodāgarbhasaṃbhūtā bhūtayātrā pravartate |
utāho pūrvam evāsīt kṛtatretāyugādiṣu ||
ye cānye prāṇinaḥ kecid dhanyante ghātayanti vā |
hatānāṃ prāṇināṃ teṣāṃ kā gatiḥ pāralaukikī ||
svayaṃ ghnatāṃ ghātayatām anumodayatāṃ tathā |
etan me saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ chettum arhasi keśava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
pārtha yā paramā śaktir anantā lokapūjitā |
ātmā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāvagamyā manoharā ||
ardhāṣṭamī kālikāyāḥ suṣuptā sarvamaṅgalā |
māyā kātyāyanī durgā cāmuṇḍā śaṅkarapriyā ||
[909] dhyāyanti yāṃ yogaratāṃ sā devī parameśvarī |
rūpabhedair nāmabhedair bhavānī pūjyate śivā ||
navamyāṃ tu mahārāja devadānavarākṣasaiḥ |
gandharvair uragair yakṣaiḥ pūjyate kinnarair naraiḥ ||
anyair api mahīpālaiḥ sṛṣṭipūrvaṃ prakīrtitā |
pūjiteyaṃ purā devais tebhyaḥ pūrvataraiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
aśvayukśuklapakṣasya aṣṭamī mūlasamyutā |
sā mahānavamī nāma trailokye ‘pi sudurlabhā ||
kanyāgate savitari śuklapakṣe ‘ṣṭamī tu yā |
mūlanakṣatrasaṃyuktā sā mahānavamī smṛtā ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca janmamokṣapradāmbikām |
pūjayitvāśvine māsi viśoko jāyate naraḥ ||
saṃtarjayantī huṅkārair. vighnaughachedakṛt parā ||
navamyāṃ pūjitā devī dadāty anupamaṃ phalam |
sā puṇyā sā pavitrā ca sudharmasukhadāyinī ||
tasyāṃ sadā pūjanīyā cāmuṇḍā muṇḍamālinī |
tasyai ye hy upayujyante prāṇino mahiṣādayaḥ ||
sarve te svargatiṃ yānti ghnatāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate |
na tathā balidānena puṇyadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
yathā samtuṣyate meṣair māhiṣair vindhyavāsinī |
uddiśya durgāṃ hanyante vividhā yatra jantavaḥ ||
te yānti svargaṃ kaunteya ghatayanto yaśasvinaḥ |
bhavānī prāṅgaṇe prāṇā yeṣāṃ yātā yudhiṣṭhira ||
[910] teṣāṃ svarge dhruvaṃ vāso narās te ‘psarasāṃ priyāḥ |
manvantareṣu sarveṣu kalpeṣu kurunandana ||
teṣu sarveṣu vaivāsīn navamīyaṃ surārcitā |
prasiddhānādinidhanā varṣe varṣe yudhiṣṭhira ||
bhūyo bhūyo ‘vatāreṣu bhavānī pūjyate suraiḥ |
avatīrṇāvatīrṇā ca bhuvi daityanibarhiṇī ||
svargapātālamartyeṣu karoty atithipālanam |
saiṣā kāle mahādevī yaśodāgarbhasaṃbhavā ||
kaṃsāsurasyottamāṅge pādaṃ gatvā gatā divam |
tataḥ prabhṛti daityaghnī yaśodānandinī mayā ||
vindhyācale sthāpayitvā punaḥ pūjyā pravartitā |
pūvaprasiddhāpi punar bhaginyā mahimākṛte ||
bhuvi sattvopakārāya sarvopadravaśāntaye |
evaṃ ca nindhyavāsinyāṃ navarātropavāsinaḥ ||
ekabhaktena janair devī sthāne sthāne pure pure |
gṛhe gṛhe śaktiparair gṛam grāme vane vane ||
snātaiḥ pramuditair hṛṣṭair brāhmaṇair kṣatriyair nṛpaiḥ |
tataḥ saṃpūjayed dhīmān mantrair eva pṛthak pṛthak ||
vaiśyair śūdrair bhaktiyuktair mlecchair anyaiś ca mānavaiḥ |
strībhiś ca kuruśārdūla tadvidhānam idaṃ śṛṇu ||
jayābhilāśī nṛpatiḥ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
lohābhisārikaṃ karma kārayed yāvad aṣṭamīm ||
[911] prāgudakplavaṇe deśe patākābhir alaṃkṛtam |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed divyaṃ navasaptakaraṃ śubham ||
āgneyyāṃ kārayet kuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam (?) |
mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyaśvatthadalālayā ||
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi śastrāṇy astrāṇi yāni ca |
ānīya maṇḍape tāni sarvāṇy evādhivāsayet ||
tatas tu brāhmaṇaiḥ snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ |
oṃkārapūrvakair mantrais talliṅgair juhuyād ghṛtam ||
lohanāmābhavat pūrvaṃ dānavaḥ sumahābalaḥ |
sa devaiḥ samare kruddhair bahudhā śakalīkṛtaḥ ||
tadaṅgasaṃbhavaṃ sarvaṃ lohaṃ yad dṛśyate kṣitau |
lohābhisārikaṃ karma tenaitad ṛṣiāṇ smṛtam ||
hutaśeṣaṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ rājānnam upahārayet |
śastrāstramantrair hotavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam ||
kevalaṃ ghṛtahomas tu rājacihnasumantrakaiḥ |
vaddhānālānakais tatra gajāśvān samalaṃkṛtān ||

athātharvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇāt | [=Atharvaveda Pariśiṣṭa 17.2.1–17; the AVPar readings are given in brackets]
atha navamyām aparāhṇe vāhanāni snapayitvā āhatavāsā brāhmaṇo dvādaśakuśamitaṃ vedam kṛtvā atha tantram ity uktāṃ śāntiṃ kṛtvā tadbhūṣaṇavāhanāni triḥ pokṣya paridhīyān niśālām iti sūktaṃ japan pratyetyābhiṣecayet | yad etenāśvalaṅge kṛtaṃ sabalakaṇṭakam |
kṛtvopasthāya nidadhyād abhayair aparājitaiḥ |
svapuṇyaiḥ svastyayanair apratirathena ca hutvā saṃsthāpya agne rakṣāṃsi apāhateti vāsobhiḥ pracchādya rasaiḥ kumbhān auḍumbarān pūrayitvā pratidivasam avasthāpya nidadhyād evam anyāny udapātrāṇi saṃmiśrya dhānyāṣṭapātrāṇy aṣṭāsu dikṣu tatraiva devatāḥ yajetāgniṃ vāyuṃ varuṇaṃ (??) somam aśvināv iti | payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā samanvārambo ‘gne [samās tvāgne] [921] tvaṃ no atama mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu uduttamaṃ (?) varuṇapāśam asmān sadaspatisam adbhuta aśvinā vācam iti pañcabhir juhuyāt | paurṇamāsī prathameti juhuyād dundubhim āhanyād ity uktam | upa śvāsaya iti tatraivānumantram |
sarvāṇi ca vāditrāṇi vāhanāni ca tantraṃ syāt pratiharṣayanti pañcamīn adhiṣṭhāpaye taṃ ca pakṣainudeva [yakṣmā aitu deva] iti guggulakuṣṭhadhūpaṃ dadyāt | yas te gandhas tryāyuṣam iti bhūtiṃ prayacchet | duṣṭyā dūṣitarasīti [duṣir asīti] pratisaram ābadhya nārtaḥ pustād [purastād] iti pratisaṃkṣipet | bahir nisṛtyottareṇa gatvā bāhyotāpaniḥkramya [bāhyenopaniṣkramya] suhṛde kuryāṃ [kuryāt] śraddadhate kuryād hatānām abhayaṃ karma vivarjitapakṣayor navamīṃ yatnāt kuryāc ca bhayakarmaṇi |
iti gopathabrāhmaṇe mahānavamīvidhiḥ |
iti mahānavayutsavavidhiḥ |
atha ubhayanavamīvratam |
śrīsumantur uvāca |
yo ‘bdam ekaṃ prakurvīta navamyāṃ naktam ādarāt |
iha bhogān avāpyāgryān paratra ca divaṃ vrajet ||

jitendriyaḥ satyavādī kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ ||
pakṣayor navamīṃ yatnād upavāsena pālayet |
[922] trikālaṃ pūjaye dāryāṃ gandhapuṣpopahārataḥ ||
kṛtvāgnikāryaṃ vidhivad bhūmau śayyāṃ prakalpayet |
māsānte snapanaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyai ca ghṛtādibhiḥ ||
kṛtvā dhyānaṃ mahāpūjāṃ caṇḍikāyai prakalpayet |
naivedyaṃ taṇḍulaprasthaṃ kṣīrasiddhaṃ nivedayet ||
kumārīr bhojayed cāṣṭau viprān bhāgavatāṃs tathā |
bhāgavatān bhagavatībhaktān |
kṛtvā piṣṭamayīṃ devīṃ nāmnā āryeti pūjayet ||
caturbhujāṃ śūladharāṃ kundapuṣpaiḥ saguggulaiḥ |
snānaṃ kṛtvā filair viprs tilānāṃ prāśanaṃ tathā ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed āryāṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ vimānavaram āsthitaḥ ||
dodhūyamānaś camaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
gacched durgāpuraṃ ramyaṃ yatrāste caṇḍikā svayam ||
krīḍate devagandharvair yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sardhaṃ bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān ||
punar etya bhuvaṃ vīra rājā bhavati bhūtale |
māghe māse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
kuśarāṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktāṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
upavāsaparo ‘ṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
pūjayed vidhivad durgāṃ nāmnā gaurīti vai nṛpa |
[823] vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
prāpte tu phālgune māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
yavānnaṃ bhuñjamānas tu tyaktvā dūreṇa yoṣitam ||
kṛtvopavāsam aṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayor nṛpa |
upavāsaṃ manasi kṛtvā pūjayed vidhivad durgāṃ navamyupavāsaṃ manasi nidhāyāṣṭamyāṃ naktam |
pūjayet tryambakāṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā godhūmacūrṇataḥ ||
durgām aṣṭabhujāṃ vīra tryambakām iti nāmataḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahārais tu sarvaṃ raktais tu pūjayet ||
dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ dadyān māṃsaṃ dadyāc ca māhiṣam |
dhānyaṃ siddhārthakāḥ snāne prāśane vā yavāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ya evaṃ māghamāse ca pūjayet tryambakāṃ śubhām |
pītais tu pūjayet puṣpaiś candanāgurumiśritaiḥ ||
dadhyodanaṃ tu naivedyaṃ dhūpo ‘yaṃ sihlakaḥ paraḥ |
snānaprāśanayor dhānyaṃ gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam ||
navamyāṃ ca mahādevīṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtādibhiḥ |
kumārīr bhojayed bhaktyā brāhmaṇāṃś ca svaśaktitaḥ ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā durgādevīṃ nṛpottama |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra sā caṇḍikā sthitā ||
caitre māse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
piṣṭakaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ śālisaṃbhavam ||
[924] pūjayed bhagavatīṃ bhaktiyā krtvā vai candanasya ca |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca viṃśārdhabhujasaṃmitāṃ ||
jvālāmukhīti vai nāmnā kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ |
dhūpaṃ sāgurukarpūraṃ bhagavatyai nivedayet ||
dadyāt paśumukhaṃ bhaktyā naivedyaṃ vidhivan nṛpa |
itthaṃ sambhojya deveśīṃ kumārīṃ bhojayet tataḥ ||
brāhmaṇāṃś ca tathā śaktyā tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
padmarāgagaṇair yuktaṃ sauvarṇamaṇivedikam ||
vimānavaram ārūḍho brahmaloke mahīyate |
vaiśākhe māsi rājendra pakṣayor ubhayor dvayoḥ ||
upavāsaparo bhaktyā pūjayāmāsa caṇḍikām |
aṣṭamyāṃ naktaṃ navamyām upavāsaprakārād veditavyam uttareṣv api māseṣu |
nāmnā bhagavatītyevaṃ kṛtvā pakṣamayīṃ vibho ||
rūpeṇāṣṭabhujāṃ śubhrāṃ pūrṇacandranibānanām |
mudgarāṇāṃ prajābhis tu pūjayec chivanāyikām ||
nānāgurukakarpūradhūpena vijayena ca |
naivedyaṃ guḍapūpāś ca atha vā guggulaṃ nṛpa ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat kumārīr bhojayet tataḥ |
puṣpeṣu tanusaṅkāśas tejasvī dhruvasaṃnibhaḥ ||
vimānavaram ārūḍho devīloke mahīyate |
[925] jyaiṣṭhe māsi nṛpaśreṣṭha yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
śālyuttamaṃ śṛtaṃ śubhraṃ bhuñjānaḥ payasā saha |
upavāsaparo bhaktyā navamyāṃ pūjayed drumam ||
kuṅkumāgurukarpūrair dhūpenāgaruṇātha vā |
aśokavartipramukhair nānābhakṣyais tu pūjayet ||
āṣāḍhe māsi rājendra yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
bhuñjānaḥ khaṇḍākādyāni pāyasaṃ ca narādhipa ||
upavāsaparo bhaktyā navamyāṃ pakṣayor dvayoḥ |
pūjayec chraddhayā durgām aindrīnāmnā tu nāmataḥ ||
airāvaṇagatiṃ śubhrāṃ śvetarūpeṇa pakṣiṇīm |
kṛtvā svarṇamayīṃ bhaktyā nānānayanabhūṣitām ||
nānāpuṣpaviśeṣais tu bhakṣyair nānāvidhais tathā |
yakṣakardamagandhaiś ca dhūpaiḥ sāgarucandanaiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya indrāṇīṃ kumārīṃ bhojayet tataḥ |
striyo viprān yathā bhaktyā tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
pañcagavyakṛtasnātaḥ pañcagavyakṛtāśanaḥ |
dhyāyamānas tathā caindrīṃ svayaṃ bhūmau narādhipa ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed durgāṃ bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
upavāsaparo vīra navamyāṃ pakṣayor dvayoḥ ||
pūjayed brāhmaṇaṃ bhaktyā śraddhayā caṇḍikāṃ nṛpa |
[926] kaumārīm iti vai nāmnā nāmataḥ pūjayet sadā ||
kṛtvā raupyamayīṃ bhaktyā yogaṃ vai pāśanāśinīm |
karavīrais tu puṣpais tu gandhaiś cāgarucandanaiḥ ||
naro bhādrapade māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
bhuñjānaḥ pāyasaṃ vīra kālaśākaṃ ca śraddhayā ||
upavāsaparo nityaṃ navamyāṃ pakṣayor dvayoḥ |
pūjayed vaiṣṇavīṃ bhaktyā śaṅkhacakrāsidhāriṇīm ||
jātīpuṣpair mahābāho gandhaiḥ śrīkhaṇḍamiśritaiḥ |
śrīkhaṇḍāgurukarpūraiḥ sihlakena ca dhūpayet ||
naivedyaṃ pāyasayuktaṃ yathāśaktyā nivedayet |
māṃsena prīṇanaṃ tasyās tataḥ pūjyāś ca kanyakāḥ ||
gosakṛt prāśya (?) vidhivat tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
prīṇayitvā dvijān śaktyā yoṣitaś ca narādhipa ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā vaiṣṇavīṃ satataṃ nṛpa |
vimānavaram ārūḍho viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
rājann aśvayuje māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
guḍodanaṃ prabhuñjāno jitātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
upavāsaparo bhūtvā navamyāṃ pakṣayor dvayoḥ |
māheśvarīṃ pūjayec ca kṛtvā raupyamayīṃ śubhām ||
vṛṣabhaṃ ca tathā vīra śvetapuṣpopalepanaiḥ |
dhūpanaṃ ca mahāṅgena khaṇḍakhādyādibhojanaiḥ ||
ajānāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca meṣāṇāṃ ca yathavadhāt |
prīṇayed vidhivad devīṃ māṃsaśoṇitapāyasaiḥ ||
[927] kumārīṃ bhojayed bhaktyā brāhmaṇān yoṣitas tathā |
bhakṣyabhojyair anekaiś ca samāṃsair vidhivan nṛpa ||
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prapya divaṃ vrajet |
dvijendraprabhayā tulyaḥ kāntyā puṣpāyudhasya ca ||
puṣpakaṃ yānam ārūḍho modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
kārtike māsi rājendra yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
kṣīrodanaṃ tu bhuñjānaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
yavānnaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
pūjayec chraddhayā devīṃ vārāhīṃ cakradhāriṇīm |
śatapatrabhrajābhiś ca kuṅkumena vilepayet ||
kṛṣṇāgaruṃ sihlakaṃ ca dhūpaṃ devyai nivedayet |
naivedyaṃ khaṇḍaveṣṭyāṃs tu navamyāṃ pakṣayor dvayoḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vārāhīṃ kumārīṃ bhojayet tataḥ |
brāhmaṇāṃś ca tathā śaktyā tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
prāśayitvā tilān vīra datvā hutvā ca śaktitaḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu vārāhīṃ svargam āpnuyāt ||
krīḍate viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ krīḍamānaiḥ surāsuraiḥ |
punar etya bhuvaṃ rājā sārvabhaumo bhaven nṛpa ||
rājan mārgaśire māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
bhuñjānaḥ śaṣkulīṃ nityaṃ jitātmā ca jitendriyaḥ ||
pūjayed vidhivad bhaktyā cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍanāśanīm |
nīlotpalais tathā padmair bilvapatraiḥ kadambakaiḥ ||
candanāgurukarpūraguggulena tathā nṛpaḥ |
[928] bhakṣyair bhojyair anekaiś ca surāmāṃsair anekaśaḥ ||
rudhireṇa tathā vīra śirobhir vividhair nṛpa |
gajāvimahiṣāṇāṃ ca svadehasya ca bhedanāt ||
navamyāṃ vidhivad bhaktyā pakṣayor ubhayor api |
kumārīr bhojayec cāpi brāhmaṇān yoṣitas tathā ||
pañcagavyakṛtasnātaḥ samyak prāśya vidhānataḥ |
tato bhuñjīta rājendra bhūmiṃ kṛtvā tu bhājanam ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā cāmuṇḍāṃ satataṃ naraḥ |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra sā paramā kalā ||
sauvarṇaṃ yānam āruhya dhvajamālākṛtaṃ śubham |
modate devataiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
punar etya mahīṃ vīra rājā bhavati bhūtale |
prabhayā bhṛgusaṃkāśas tejasā ravisaṃnibhaḥ ||
kāntyā candasamo vīra yuddhe cendrasamo bhavet |
rucyā yamasamo vīra buddhyā dhiṣaṇaśukrayoḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam ubhayanavamīvratam |
atha nāmanavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu kṛte nakte viśeṣataḥ |
māsi cāśvayuje vīra durgādevīti pūjayet ||
bilvapatrais tathādbhiś ca droṇapuṣpais tu sarvaśaḥ |
[929] guggulenātha dagdhena bhakṣyabhojyair anekaśaḥ ||
paramānnena ratnena ajamahiṣair vighātitaiḥ |
saṃprīṇanaṃ tathā kuryād devyā vai bhaktim ācaran ||
bhojayitvā navamyāṃ tu brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kanyakāḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ svastriyaś ca yathā bhavati śaktitaḥ ||
pañagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
ya evaṃ pūjayed atra durgāṃ bhaktyā samanvitaḥ ||
so ‘śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ vrajet |
kāryam āśvinavat sarvaṃ kārttike ‘pi hi sattama ||
kṛtvopavāsam aṣṭamyāṃ māsi mārgaśire nṛpa |
navamyāṃ pūjayed yas tu śaktyā bhagavatīṃ budhaḥ ||
nāmnā bhagavatīty evaṃ jātīpuṣpair narādhipa |
karpūrāgarudhūpena madhunā pāyasena ca ||
bhojayitvā kumārīś ca striyo viprāṃś ca śaktitaḥ |
gomayaṃ prāśya vidhivat tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā naro bhagavatīṃ nṛpa |
rājasūyaphalaṃ prāpya tataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
puṣpe ‘py evaṃ mahābāho navamyāṃ saṃjitendriyaḥ |
pūjayet tryambakāṃ caiva nāmnā tāta naraḥ śivām ||
karavīrasya puṣpeṇa kuṅkumena tu kesaraiḥ |
nivedya sihlakaṃ dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ māṃsapūrikam ||
pūjayed viprakanyāś ca striyo viprāṃś ca śaktitaḥ |
vidhivat prāśya gomūtraṃ tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
[930] ya evaṃ pūjayen martyo vājapeyaśataṃ labhet |
māghe śuklanavamyāṃ ca pūjayec caṇḍikāṃ budhaḥ ||
sarvamaṅgalanāmākhyāṃ yūthikākusumair nṛpa |
prabodhākhyena dhūpena atha vā guggulena ca ||
naivedyaṃ caiva pūpāś ca matsyamāṃsaṃ ca bhārata |
pūjayitvā naro hy evaṃ vidhivat sarvamaṅgalām ||
kumārīr bhojayet paścāt prīyatāṃ sarvamaṅgalā |
godhūmānāṃ śataṃ labdhvā goloke ca mahīyate ||
phālgune māsi rājendra caṇḍiketi sadārcayet |
nāmnā bhagavatīṃ devīṃ kundapuṣpeṇa pūjayet ||
dhūpenāgaruṇā vīra sihlakenāpi vārcayet |
naivedyaṃ modakān dadyān madhumāṃsaṃ payas tathā ||
gokṣīraprāśanāt pūtaḥ pūto bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
pūrvoktān bhojayitvā ca yathā śaktyā vidhānataḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivac caṇḍikāṃ muṇḍamaṇḍanām |
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet ||
caitre māsi mahābāho āryā bhagavatī smṛtā |
pūjayed vidhivad bhaktyā puṣpair mudgarakasya ca ||
dhūpenāgarumiśreṇa sihlakenāpi cārcayet |
dhūpena kusumaughena kāsāreṇa ca pūjayet ||
vaiśākhe māsi rājendra nāmnā bhagavatīṃ yajet |
prāśayet puṣpatoyaṃ tu tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
[931] kumārīr bhojayed bhaktyā pālāśakusumair imam |
dhūpaṃ kṛtvāguruṃ caiva naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūpakān ||
jyeṣṭhe māsi nṛpaśreṣṭha pūjayed ambikām umām |
kuśapuṣpodakaṃ prāśya tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
kumārīr yoṣito viprān pūjayed vidhivad nṛpa |
yūthikākusumair bhaktyā dhūpenāśabalena ca ||
śālyodarajalājāś ca śriyai naivedyam ādiśet |
evaṃ pūjya śriyaṃ devīṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
āṣāḍhe śuklapakṣasya navamyāṃ pūjayed umām |
karṇamauḍhīti nāmnī tu lambakarṇī prakīrtitā ||
śamīpatrakadambais tu (?) pūjayed vidhivan nṛpa |
karpūrāgarumiśreṇa dhūpena ca kapālinām ||
pūjayitvā bhagavatīṃ kumārīṃ bhojayet tataḥ |
striyaś cāpi yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇāṃś ca narādhipa ||
śamīpatraṃ tataḥ prāśya tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
evaṃ pūjya mahākālīṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||
śrāvaṇe māsi rājendra navamyāṃ caṇḍamardinīm |
nārāyaṇīti vai nāmnā pūjayet satataṃ budhaḥ ||
raktais tilaiḥ sabakulaiḥ sakadambais tathā nṛpa |
saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat kumārīr bhojayet tataḥ |
yoṣitaś ca tathā viprān śaktyā ca vidhivan nṛpa ||
[932] bhojayitvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya navamyāṃ vidhivan nṛpa |
evaṃ saṃpūjayed devīṃ sa gacchet paramaṃ padam ||
māsi bhādrapade śukle navamyāṃ candrikāṃ sadā |
mahānandeti vai nāmnā pūjayed vidhivan nṛpa ||
śvetaraktais tathā pītaiḥ sarvapuṣpaiś ca bhārata |
karpūrāgarudhūpena guggulena viśeṣataḥ ||
bhakṣyabhojyair anekaiś ca modakair lopikādibhiḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivan mahādevīṃ narādhipa ||
lopikā godhūmacūrṇapiṇḍikā |
kumārīr bhojayed bhaktyā yoṣito brāhmaṇāṃs tathā |
bhojayitvā tato bilvaṃ prāśayet kāyaśodhanam ||
bhūmiṃ tu bhājanaṃ kṛtvā tato bhuñjīta vāgyamaḥ |
evaṃ triḥ pūjayitvā vai brahmaloke mahīyate ||
varṣānte bhojayed viprān durgābhaktiparāyaṇān |
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ ghṛtena ca pavitrakam ||
kumārīḥ pūjayitvā tu dadyāc cātra ṣaḍaṅginīm |
kapilāṃ kuruśārdūla śīlayuktāṃ payasvinīm ||
ṣaḍaṅginīṅgām (?) |
karoti vai varṣam ekaṃ nairantaryeṇa yo naraḥ |
nāmākhyanavamīṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
vased dūrgāpuraṃ nityaṃ na vehāyāti vā punaḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute puṇyāṃ navamīṃ nāmasaṃjñikām |
[933] sa hi kāmān avāpyātha brahmaloke mahīyate ||
aputro labhate putrān nirdhanaś ca dhanaṃ labhet |
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ yaśo’rthī labhate yaśaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nāmanavamīvratam |
atha rūpanavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
śūlaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā mārge māsi narādhipa |
kṛtvā surājataṃ padmaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kṛtakarṇikam ||
nivedya śraddhayā vīra bhagavatyai prapūjitam |
kāmato ‘pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyādi yad bhavet ||
tat sarvaṃ śūladānena devī nāśayati dhruvam |
vimānavaram ārūḍho devagandharvapūjitaḥ ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ durgāloke mahīyate |
caṇḍikāprītim āpnoti yad icched vipulāṃ śriyam ||
pauṣe māsi mahābāho caturdantaṃ gajaṃ śubham |
kṛtvā rukmamayaṃ bhaktyā nyasya pātre hiraṇmaye ||
indrāṇyai vidhivad dadyān nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam |
evaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā indrāṇīṃ vidhivat tataḥ ||
sa airāvatam ārūḍhaḥ somaloke mahīyate |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ devagandharvapūjitam ||
māghe kṛtvā tu vai meṣaṃ sarvasauvarṇam uttamam |
[934] kṛtvā rukmamaye pātre svāhāyai vinivedayet ||
bhaktagandhaiḥ samāyuktaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam |
vinivedya naro bhaktyā agniloke mahīyate ||
divyaṃ vimānam ārūḍho dhvajamālākulaṃ śubham |
punar etya mahīṃ rājā maṇḍalādhipatir bhavet ||
mayūraṃ phālgune māsi kṛtvā piṣṭamayaṃ nṛpa |
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya kumāryai vinivedayet ||
nivedya vidhivad bhaktyā vimānavaram āsthitaḥ |
krīḍate devagandharvair guhena ca mahātmanā ||
caitre māsi mahābāho garuḍaṃ piṣṭajaṃ kṛtam |
saṃpūjayitvā vidhivad vaiṣṇavyai vinivedayet ||
srajābhir vividhair vīra gandhamālyaiś ca śobhitam |
taṃ nivedya mahābāho viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
citraṃ yānaṃ samāruhya nānānnodakadmbakaiḥ |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ jvalann itva sutejasā ||
kṛtvā maṇimayaṃ vīra vārāhaṃ lokapūjitam |
gandhamālyopahārais tu pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
citrais tu kusumair eva guggulena sugandhinā |
cāmuṇḍāyeti naivedyair haviṣyānnair labhet phalam ||
prayāti ca paraṃ lokaṃ yatra sā caṇḍikā sthitā |
palāyate ca caurādi sarvaśatrur bhayaṃkaraḥ ||
kṛtvā piṣṭamayaṃ jyaiṣṭhe kacchapaṃ ratnabhūṣitam |
[935] bhūṣayitvā rajobhiś ca puṣpāṇāṃ candanena ca ||
nivedya bhaktyā vāruṇyai rudraloke mahīyate |
śaṅkhakundendusaṃkāśaṃ vimānavaram ātaret ||
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ krīḍayitvā narādhipa |
punar etya mahārājo maṇḍalādhipatir bhavet ||
kṛtvā mṛgaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ āṣāḍhe ratnabhūṣitam |
svarṇaśṛṅgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ vāyavyai vinivedayet ||
pūjayitvā suvidhivat puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
naivedyena mahābāho vāyuloke mahīyate ||
narayānaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā rājan suśobhitam |
anekāvarakopetaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi bhūpate ||
puṣpamālyākulaṃ divyaṃ dhvajamālākulaṃ (?) tathā |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
kauverye vinivedyeha aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ durgāloke mahīyate ||
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi sarvahemamayaṃ vibho |
mahiṣaṃ divyasaṃsthānaṃ gandhamālyopaśobhitam ||
yāmyai nivedayed bhaktyā sūryaloke mahīyate |
ekaṃ nivedayed bhaktyā sūryaloke mahīyate ||
tathā cāśvayuje māsi bhagavatyai vidhānataḥ |
susnigdhaiś caiva godhūmair bakṣyabhojyair anekaśaḥ ||
nānāvastrasamāyuktaṃ kṛtvā puṣpamayaṃ dvija |
[936] vicitrayānam ārūḍho rudraloke mahīyate ||
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ krīḍayitvā gaṇaiḥ saha |
kramād āgatya loke ‘smin prājño bhavati bhūtale ||
saptadhātusamāyuktaṃ sarvabījarasādibhiḥ |
bāhule bahulaṃ vīra vitānachatraśobhitam ||
bāhule kārttike |
gandhamālyaiś ca bahubhiḥ pūjite ca tathā śuciḥ |
kṛtvā rukmamayaṃ śaktyā vidhivac candramaṇḍalam ||
suvarṇaṃ maṇimuktāḍhyaṃ rohiṇyāṃ vinivedayet |
ya evaṃ kurute bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
vedānteṣu ca yat puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ munibhiḥ purā |
tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnuyān nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ caṇḍikā varadā yataḥ |
devadānavagandharvaiḥ stūyamāno gaṇādibhiḥ ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ krīḍate saha devataiḥ |
candralokādilokeṣu bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān ||
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya rājā bhavati bhūtale |
surūpaḥ subhago nityaṃ candrikāvaradānataḥ ||
kalpakoṭiṃ samuddiśya naranārīnapuṃsakaḥ |
bhagavatyau gṛhaṃ datvā sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
evaṃ kurute naktam ekabhaktam athāpi vā |
[937] navamyām upavāsaṃ tu kurvāṇo vidhivan nṛpa ||
rūpāṇi yacchamānas tu pūrvoktāni narādhipa |
aśvamedhasahasrasya rājasūyaśatasya ca ||
labdhvā phalaṃ mahābāho brahmaloke mahīyate |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya punar eva mahīpatiḥ |
rājā bhavati durdharṣaḥ saptadvīpādhipo nṛpa ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ rāupanavamīvratam |
atha varavratam |
sumantur uvāca |
navamyāṃ navavarṣāṇi rājan piṣṭāśano bhavet |
tasya tuṣṭā bhaved devī sarvakāmaphalapradā ||
agnipakvam abhuñjāno yāvajjīvaṃ vratī bhavet |
iha cāmutra varadā tasyānantaphalaṃ dadet ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ varavratam |
atha durgānavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
navamyāṃ tu site pakṣe niyataḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ |
māsi cāśvayuje vīra kārttike kārttikottare ||
[938] puṣye ca pūjayed durgāṃ jātipuṣpair vidhānataḥ |
dhūpārthaṃ guggulaṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ guḍapūpakān ||
durgeti nāma japtavyaṃ prayato ‘ṣṭaśataṃ nṛpa |
māghe ca phālgune māsi caitre caitrottare nṛpa ||
śuklapakṣe tu aṣṭavyām upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ |
caitrottare vaiśākhe |
mālatīkaravīreṇa bilvapatraiś ca pūjayet ||
dhūpenāgarukarpūrasihlakair vṛṣaṇena ca ||
sihlakas turuskaḥ | vṛṣaṇaṃ kastūrikā |
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ māṃsaṃ maṅgalāyai nivedayet |
sarvamaṅgala ity evaṃ japtavyaṃ nāma bhārata ||
jyeṣṭhe māse tathāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe śrāvaṇottare |
śrāvaṇottare bhādre |
caṇḍikāṃ pūjayed bhādre caṇḍamuṇḍapraṇāśinīm |
bilvapatrair muhurakaiḥ śātapatikayā tathā ||
prabodhenaiva dhūpena naivedyaṃ modakān nyaset |
svam ekam ekaṃ yas tv evaṃ pūjayed ambikāṃ naraḥ ||
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
aśvamedhasahasrasya rājasūyaśatasya ca ||
[939] phalam āpnoti rājendra sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati |
vimānaṃ divyam ārūḍhaḥ sauvarṇakiṅkinīcitam ||
krīḍitvaivaṃ mahārājaś cāsau bhavati bhūtale |
prathame pāraṇe durgā dvitīye sarvamaṅgalā ||
tṛtīye caṇḍikā proktā rājan bhagavatī budha |
prathamaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca snānaprāśanayor matam ||
dvitīyaṃ bilvapatraiś ca tṛtīyaṃ madhusarpiṣā |
māsi māsi mahābāho kumārīr brāhmaṇān nṛpa ||
svaśaktyā bhojayed rājan bhakṣyabhojyair anekaśaḥ |
pāraṇānte mahābhojyaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhivan nṛpa ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca caṇḍikāṃ pūjayet tataḥ |
nānāprekṣaṇakair vīra brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||
evam ekaṃ svam ekaṃ tu suvratenārcayen naraḥ |
mahānavamīsaṃjñena durgābhaktān narādhipa ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ vimānavaram āsthitaḥ |
yatra sākṣād bhagavatī pūjyā mānya tilai rasaiḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ durgānavamīvratam |
atha gopālanavamīvratam |
ataḥ paraṃ tvaṃ ca kṛṣṇa navamīvratam uttamam |
māṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ trāṇaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
tathā samudragāminyāṃ navamyāṃ snānam ācaret |
[940] śucau tatpuline tīre siktābhiḥ samalaṃkṛte ||
vasudevasutaṃ viṣṇuṃ gopīgaṇaniṣevitam |
vanamālācitoraskaṃ vanyakauśeyavāsasam ||
samānaveṣair atulaiḥ (?) krīḍadbhir itaretaram |
vṛtaṃ gopakumāraiś ca nīlākuñcitamūrdhajam ||
dhyātvā devaṃ paraṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvalokeśvareśvaram |
vanyapuṣpaiś ca bahubhiḥ pāyasena samarcayet ||
phalamūlaiś ca gandhādyaiḥ śucibhiś ca yathāvidhi |
subhagaṃ patim icchantī kanyakā śṛṇuyād vratam ||
gopījanamanaḥkāntagovindagaruḍadhvajaḥ |
varaṃ prayaccha subhagaṃ suveṣaṃ dayitaṃ mama ||
tatas tu sarpiṣā pūrṇaṃ haridrācūrṇapūritam |
kulāṅganābhyas tu dadyāt pātraṃ bījaprapūritam ||
gurave ca varaṃ dadyāt tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇam |
evam abhyañjanaṃ nāma navamīvratam uttamam ||
evaṃ svastyayanaṃ strīṇām uktaṃ sarvasukhapradam |
bhrātā pitā ca kanyārthī vratam etat samācaret ||
aṅganānāṃ vrataṃ caiva arcanīyaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
patir viśvasya bhagavān sarvān kāmān pravarṣati ||
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kaścit siddhir bhavati tasya tam |
alaṃ dadāti bhagavān arcitaḥ kim u yoṣitaḥ ||
paripūrṇo hi bhagavān snigdhair yat kiṃcid īhitam |
[941] sākṣād eva dadātyete tebhyaḥ prīto dadet phalam ||
iti garuḍapurāṇoktaṃ gopālanavamīvratam |
atha rāmanavamīvratam |
agastya uvāca |
sarvānuṣṭhānasāraṃ te sarvadānottamottamaṃ |
rahasyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sutīkṣṇaṃ śṛṇu sattama ||
caitre navamyāṃ prākpakṣe divā puṣye punarvasau |
udaye gurugaurāṃśvoḥ svoccasthe grahapañcake ||
meṣe pūṣaṇi saṃprāpte lagne karkaṭakāhvaye |
āvir āsīt sakalasyā kauśalyāyāṃ (??) paraḥ pumān ||
tasmin dine tu kartavyam upavāsavrataṃ sadā |
tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād raghunāthaparo bhuvi ||
prātar daśamyāṃ kṛtvā tu saṃdhyādyāḥ kālikīḥ kriyāḥ |
saṃpūjya vidhivad rāmaṃ bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā dakṣiṇābhiś ca toṣayet |
gobhūtilahiraṇyādyair vastrālaṃkaraṇais tathā ||
rāmabhaktān prayatnena prīṇayet parayā mudā |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā śrīrāmanavamīvratam ||
anekajanmasiddhāni pātakāni bahūny api |
bhasmī kṛtya vrajanty eva tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
[942] sarveṣām apy ayaṃ dharmo bhuktimuktyekasādhanam |
aśucir vāpi pāpiṣṭhaḥ kṛtvedaṃ vratam uttamam ||
pūjyaḥ syāt sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā rāmas tathaiva saḥ |
yas tu rāmanavamyāṃ tu bhuṅkte sa ca narādhamaḥ ||
kumbhīpākeṣu ghoreṣu pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
akṛtvā rāmanavamīvrataṃ sarvavratottamam ||
vratāṇy anyāni kurute na teṣāṃ phalabhāg bhavet |
rahasyakṛtapāpāni prakhyātāni bahūny api |
mahānti ca praṇaśyanti śrīrāmanavamīvratam ||
ekām api naro bhaktyā śrīrāmanavamīṃ mune |
upoṣya kṛtakṛtyaḥ syāt sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
naro rāmanavamyāṃ tu śrīrāmapratimāpradaḥ |
vidhānena muniśreṣṭha sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
sumantur uvāca |
śrīrāmapratimādānavidhānaṃ vā kathaṃ mune |
kathaya tvaṃ ca rāme ‘pi (?) bhaktasya mama vistarāt ||
agastya uvāca |
kathayiṣyāmi tad dhi śrīpratimādānam uttamam |
vidhānaṃ cāpi yatnena yatas tvaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ||
aṣṭamyāṃ caiva māseṣu śuklapakṣe jitendriyaḥ |
dantadhāvanapūrvaṃ tu prātaḥ snāyād yathāvidhi ||
nadyāṃ taḍāge kūpe vā hrade prasravaṇe ‘pi vā |
[943] tataḥ saṃdhyādikāḥ kāryāḥ saṃsmaran rāghavaṃ hṛdi ||
gṛham āsādya viprendra kuryād aupāsanādikam |
dānaṃ kuṭumbinaṃ vipraṃ vedaśāstraparaṃ sadā ||
śrīrāmapūjānirataṃ suśīlaṃ dambhavarjitam |
vidhijñaṃ rāmamantrāṇāṃ rāmamantaikasādhanam ||
āhūya bhaktyā saṃpūjya vṛṇuyāt prārthayann iti |
śrīrāmapratimādānaṃ kariṣye ‘haṃ dvijottama ||
bhaktyā cārya bhava prītaḥ śrīrāmo ‘si tvam eva ca |
ity uktvā pūjya vipraṃ taṃ snāpayitvā tataḥ param ||
tailenābhyajya vastrādyān cintayan rāghavaṃ hṛdi |
śvetāmbaradharaḥ śvetagandhamālyāni vārayet ||
arcito bhūṣitaś caivaṃ kṛtamādhyāhnikakriyaḥ |
ācāryaṃ bhojayed bhaktyā sāttvikānnaiḥ suvistaram ||
bhuñjīta svayam apy evaṃ hṛdi rāmam anusmaran |
ekabhaktavratī tatra sahācāryo jitendriyaḥ ||
śṛṇvan rāmakathāṃ divyām ahaḥśeṣaṃ nayet pute |
sāyaṃsaṃdhyādikāḥ kuryāt (?) kriyā rāmam anusmaran ||
ācāryasahito rātrāv adhaḥśāyī jitendriyaḥ |
vaset svayaṃ na caikānte śrīrāmārpitamānasaḥ ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā saṃdhyāṃ yathāvidhi |
prātaḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi śīghram eva samāpayet ||
tataḥ svasthamanā bhūtvā vidvadbhiḥ sahito ‘naghaḥ |
svagṛhe cottare deśe dānasyojvalamaṇḍapam ||
[944] caturdvāraṃ patākāḍhyaṃ (?) savitānaṃ satoraṇam |
manomayaṃ mahotsedhaṃ puṣpādyaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam ||
śaṅkhacakrahanūmadbhiḥ prāgdvāre samalaṃkṛtam |
garutman śārṅgabāṇaiś ca dakṣiṇaṃ samalaṃkṛtam ||
gadākhaḍgāṅgadaiś caiva paścimeṣu vibhūṣitam |
padmasvastikanīlaiś ca kauvere samalaṃkṛtam ||
madhye hastacatuṣkāḍhyaṃ vedikāyuktam āyatam |
pavitranṛtyagītaiś ca vādyaiś cāpi susaṃyutam ||
puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra vidvadbhiḥ prītamānasaḥ |
tataḥ saṃkalpayed devaṃ rāmam eva smaran mune ||
asyāṃ rāmanavamyāṃ ca rāmārādhanatatparaḥ |
upoṣyāṣṭasu yāmeṣu pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||
imāṃ svarṇamayīṃ rāma pratimāṃ ca prayatnataḥ |
śrīrāmaprītaye dāsye rāmabhaktyā vidhīyate ||
prīto rāma haratv āśu pāpāni subahūni me |
anekajanmasamsiddhāny abhyastāni mahānti ca ||
tataḥ svarṇamayīṃ rāmapratimāṃ palamātrataḥ |
nirmitāṃ dvibhujāṃ divyāṃ vāmāṅkasthitajānakīm ||
bibhratīṃ dakṣiṇakare jñānamudrāṃ mahāmune |
vāme nādhaḥkareṇātra devīm āliṅgya saṃsthitām ||
siṃhāsane rājavetraṃ paladvayavinirmitam |
pañcāmṛtasnānapūrvaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat tatam ||
mūlamantreṇa niyato nyāsapūrvam atandritaḥ |
[945] divaivaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
divyāṃ rāmakathāṃ kṛtvā rāmabhaktaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
nṛtyagītādibhiś caiva rāmastotrair anekadhā ||
rāmāṣṭakaṃ tathādhyāpya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
karpūrāgarukastūrīkahlārādyair (?) anekaśaḥ ||
pūjayan vidhivad bhaktyā divārātraṃ nayed budhaḥ |
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snānasaṃdhyādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
samāpya vidhivad rāmaṃ pūjayed vidhivan mune |
tato homaṃ prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa mantravit ||
pūrvoktapadmakuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā samāhitaḥ |
laukikāgnau vidhānena śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tataḥ ||
sājyena pāyasenaiva smaran rāmam ananyadhīḥ |
tato bhaktyā susaṃpādya ācāryaṃ pūjayen mune ||
kuṇḍalābhyāṃ saratnābhyām aṅgulīyair anekadhā |
gandhapuṣpākṣatair vastrair vividhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ||
tato rāmaṃ smaran dadyād evaṃ mantram udīrayet |
imāṃ svarṇamayīṃ rāmapratimāṃ samalaṃkṛtām ||
citravastrayugachannāṃ rāmāhaṃ rāghavādya te |
śrīrāmaprītaye dāsye tuṣṭo bhavatu rāghavaḥ ||
iti datvā vidhānena dadyād vai dakṣiṇāṃ dhruvam |
anyebhyaś ca yathānyāyaṃ gohiraṇyādi śaktitaḥ ||
dadyād vāsoyugaṃ dhānyaṃ yathāvibhavam ādṛtaḥ |
[946] brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhuñjīta tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tulāpuruṣadānādiphalaṃ prāpnoti suvrata ||
anekajanmasaṃsiddhapāpebhyo mucyate dhruvam |
bahunā kim ihoktena muktis tasya kare sthitā ||
kurukṣetre mahāpuṇye sūryaparvaṇy aśeṣataḥ |
tulāpuruṣadānādyaiḥ kṛtair yal labhyate phalam |
tat phalaṃ labhate martyo dānenānena suvrata ||
iti agastyasamhitāyāṃ rāmanavamīvratam |
atha rathanavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
kṛtvaivāśvayuje māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe narādhipa |
navamyām upavāsaṃ tu durgādevīṃ prapūjayet ||
puṣpadhūpopahārais tu brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ |
pūjayitvā rathaṃ kṛtvā nānāvastropaśobhitam ||
śobhitaṃ dhvajamālābhiḥ chatracāmaradarpaṇaiḥ |
nānāpuṣpasrajābhiś ca siṃhair yuktaṃ manoramam ||
kṛvā svarṇamayīṃ durgāṃ mahiṣāsanaśobhitām |
durgārūpaṃ tu viṣṇudharmotarāt |
[947] ālīḍhasthānasaṃsthānaṃ tathā rājan caturbhujām |
srucaḥ pātrakarāṃ devīṃ śūlakhaḍgadharāṃ tathā ||
caturthaś ca karas tasyās tathā kāryas tu sāmiṣaḥ || iti |
vinyasya rathamadhye tu pūjayet kṛtalakṣaṇam ||
taṃ rathaṃ rājamārgeṇa śaṅkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ |
navamyāṃ bhrāmayitvā tu nayed durgātapaṃ nṛpa ||
tatra jāgarapūrvaṃ tu pradīpādyupaśobhitam |
nānāprakṣepakair vīra nṛtyamānaiś ca vālakaiḥ ||
jāgaraṃ kārayet tatra pūjayānaś ca caṇḍikām |
prabhāte snapanaṃ kṛtvā tadbhaktānāṃ ca bhojanam ||
rathaṃ śobhāsamāyuktaṃ bhagavatyai nivedayet |
bhuktvā ca bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇamyāryāgṛhaṃ vrajet ||
sarvavratānāṃ pravaraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
sarvayajñeṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yat phalam |
tat phalaṃ labhate vidvān navamīvratapālanāt ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
punar etya mahīṃ rājā sārvabhaumo bhaved iti ||
raktopakaraṇair yuktāṃ devadārumayīṃ śubhām |
śayyāṃ nivedayed yas tu bhagavatyai narādhipa ||
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyair vidhivac caṇḍikāṃ nṛpa |
dukūlavastralūtānāṃ parisaṃkhyā ca yāvatī ||
[948] tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi durgāloke mahīyate |
vṛṣaṃ śūlāṅkitaṃ yaś ca bhagavatyai nivedayet ||
āsaptamaṃ sa tu kulaṃ mahādevālayaṃ vrajet |
yaś cobhayamukhīṃ gaṅgāṃ bhagavatyai suśobhitāṃ ||
saptadvīpāndharāṃ datvā yat phalaṃ tad avāpnuyāt |
padadvayaṃ śirordhaṃ ca yāvad vatsasya nirgatam |
tāvad goḥ pṛthivī jñeyā taddātā syān mahīpradaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe rathanavamīvratam |
atha ānandanavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
anandā nandinī nandā mahānandā mahīpate |
tathādyā navamī puṇyā pañcamī mahatī smṛtā ||
phālgunāmalapakṣasya navamī yā mahīpate |
anandā sā mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā śubhā ||
kṛtvaikabhaktaṃ pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ tathā nṛpa |
ayācitaṃ tu saptamyām upavāsaḥ pare ‘hani ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā navamyāṃ vidhivan nṛpa |
sopavāso ‘rcayed devīṃ dhūpaṃ dadyāt tathāgurum |
mudgarāṇāṃ srajābhis tu puṣpair anyaiś ca pūjayet ||
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyād rasālāmodanaṃ tathā |
[949] pañcagavyaṃ praśastaṃ hi snānaprāśanayor nṛpa ||
japtavyaṃ nāma devyās tu āruṇyākhyabhayāpaham |
ity etat prathamaṃ proktaṃ pāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
māsaiś caturbhir ādīyaṃ dvitīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu |
ādīyaṃ śrāddham |
bhojayed viprakanyāś ca navamyāṃ brāhmaṇastriyaḥ |
māsi māsi mahābāho yathāśaktyā yathavidhi ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi māsi bhādrapade tathā |
tathā vāśvayuje māsi pūjyā bhagavatī vibho ||
kṛtvaikabhaktaṃ pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ tathā nṛpa |
ayācitaṃ tu saptamyām upavāsaḥ pare ‘hani ||
sopavāso navamyāṃ tu pūjayed vidhivac chivām |
so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
jātipuṣpasrajābhis tu tathā raktaiś ca candanaiḥ |
kastūrikākṣatair gandhair devīm ālepayet tathā ||
māhiṣyākhyaṃ guggulaṃ ca dhūpaṃ paramapūjitam |
naivedyaṃ guḍapūpāṃś ca khaṇḍaceṣṭāś ca śaktitaḥ ||
bilvapatrodakasnānaṃ prāśane ca prakīrtitam |
durgākhyaṃ nāma japtavyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham ||
ity evaṃ pūjayitvāryāṃ pūjayitvā guruṃ tathā |
kumārīr bhojayec chaktyā brāhmaṇān yoṣitas tathā ||
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayed bhaktyā yathāvibhavam ātmanaḥ |
sa siṃhāsanam ārūḍho brahmalokaṃ prayāti vai ||
[950] tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ tasmin sarvapāpavināśanam |
dhyāyec chivaṃ sadā śāntaṃ saccidānandavigraham ||
kārttikādi mahāpuṇyaṃ durgāyāḥ prītivardhanam |
nānāvidhānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ jalajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
srajābhir arcayed devīṃ tryambakāṃ jagato ‘mbikām |
kuṅkumāgarukarpūraiḥ sugandhaiś ca pralepayet ||
māṃsagarbhais tathā bhakṣyaiḥ śrīveṣṭaiś cāpi pūjayet |
dhūpo bilvāguruḥ śastaḥ saghṛto guggulas tathā ||
tilasnānaṃ tilair homas tilānāṃ prāśanaṃ varam |
japen nāma tathā devyāḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram ||
aparājitākhyam atulaṃ japed ante vrataṃ nṛṇām |
evaṃ yaḥ kṛcchrapādena navamīṃ tām upāsate ||
māsi māsi mahābāho yāvad eva hi vatsaram |
sa hi putrān avāpyāgryān (?) dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ balaṃ yaśaḥ ||
vipulāṃ ca tathā kīrtim ārogyam atulāṃ śriyam |
tatas tv indrapuraṃ yāti siṃhāsanasamanvitaḥ ||
tejasāmbujasaṃkāśaḥ prabhayāmbujasaṃnibhaḥ |
ya idaṃ śṛṇu yān nityam anandākalpam āditaḥ |
sa hi kāmān avāpyāgryān brahmaloke mahīyate ||
ity anandānavamīvratam |
[951]
atha mātṛvratam |
rājā vijayam āpnoti bhuktvā rājyam akaṇṭakam |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā ye cānye mandajātayaḥ ||
sarvatra jayam āyānti bhayebhyo ‘pi vivarjitāḥ |
mātaraś caiva saṃpūjyāḥ yathāśaktyā prayatnataḥ ||
tadagre śivabhaktāṃs tu vratācāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena sarvatra jayam āpnuyāt ||
brāhmaṇīṃ caiva māheśīṃ kaumārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tathā |
vārāhīṃ nārasiṃhīṃ ca śivakṣemajayāṃ mahīm ||
aindrīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ yogeśīṃ gaurīṃ caiva tathāmbikām |
āgneyīṃ vāruṇīṃ caiva vāyavyāṃ vyomasaṃjñikām ||
lampaṭāṃ gajavaktrāṃ ca gāruḍīṃ ca jayāṃ yajet |
vijayāṃ ca jayantīṃ. ca tathānyāṃ tv aparājitām ||
siddharuktāṃ tathā śuklām utpalāṃ pūjayet tathā |
garuḍāṃ ca tathā rātriṃ surātriṃ ca tathā punaḥ ||
haṃsavaktrāśvavaktrāṃ ca siṃhavyāghramukhīṃ tathā |
jambūlakamukhārāvīṃ mārjārīm ṛkṣavānarīm ||
uṣṭravaktrāṃ śyāmamukhīṃ gomukhīṃ sumukhīṃ tathā |
bairavīṃ caiva saṃpūjyā tathā vai kṛṣṇarevatī ||
śuklarevatisaṃjñā ca tathā śakunirevatīm |
laṅkeśvarī bhadrakarṇā śrīśīghrā siddhir eva ca ||
[952] ghaṇṭākarṇī tathā nidrā mātaraḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
navamyāṃ pūjayed yas tu māsi cāśvayuje sadā ||
akhaṇḍitaprabhāvas tu bhavate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ahany ahani yo nityaṃ bhaktyā pūjāvasānataḥ ||
grahadoṣā na bādhante parakṛtyā viśeṣataḥ |
duḥsvapno vyādhayo bhūtā hiṃsakāś ca vināyakāḥ ||
svagrahāḥ pūtanāś caṇḍā ḍākinyo mārikās tathā |
naśyanti smaraṇāt tasya sarvadurbhikṣakalmaṣāḥ |
mṛtatokā kākabandhyā suprajā vai prajāyate ||
iti mātṛvratam |
atha vaiśākhanavamyor bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ navamīvratam |
vaiśākhe māsi rajendra navamyāṃ pakṣayor dvayoḥ |
upavāsaparo bhaktyā pūjayānas tu caṇḍikām |
vimānavaram ārūḍho devaloke mahīyate \\
iti vaiśākhanavamīvratam |
atha nandānavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade yā tu navamī bahuletarā |
mātṛnandā mahāpuṇyā kīrtitā pāpanāśanī ||
[953] bahulaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ taditarā śuklā |
tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayed durgāṃ vidhivat kurunandana |
so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ vindyād viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati ||
ekabhaktaṃ tu saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
jātīpuṣpaiḥ kadambaiś ca pūjayed vidhivac chivam ||
dūrvāṃ paristhitāṃ devīṃ yathā śāstravinirmitām |
kharjūranālikeraiś ca trapusamalakais tathā ||
pūjayet saptadhānyena piṇyākena ca suvrata |
dadhnā sājyena dhūpena dūrvāṅkuraiś ca dhūpayet ||
prajāgaraṃ tato rātrau nandāyāḥ purato nṛpa |
nānāprekṣaṇakaiḥ kuryād brahmaghoṣaiś ca puṣphalaiḥ (?) ||
nandākhyaṃ ca japen mantram aṣṭottaraśataṃ vibho |
vibho nandākhyaḥ |
oṃ nandāyai namaḥ svāhā huṃ phaḍ iti |
prabhāte tu navamyāṃ (?) tu pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu caṇḍikām |
prīṇayitvā guruṃ śaktyā kumārīr bhojayet tataḥ ||
evaṃ cāśvayuje māsi kārttike kārtikottare |
kārttikottare mārgaśīrṣe |
pūjayec caturo māsān nandāṃ bhagavatīṃ vibho ||
snāne kuśodakaṃ proktaṃ prāśane ca narādhipa |
[954] iti te kathitaṃ vīra prathamaṃ pāraṇaṃ śubham ||
dvitīye śṛṇu me pauṣe pāraṇāsnānaprāśanam |
caṇḍikāṃ pūjayed atra nāmnā kanakanandinīm (?) ||
nānāsrajābhiḥ kusumaiḥ kuṅkumāgarucarcitām |
nānāvidhair bhakṣyabhojyair dhūpenāguruṇā tathā ||
pañcagavyakṛtasnānaḥ sopavādo jitendriyaḥ |
pūjayitvā mahāvedīṃ rātrau svapiti bhūtale ||
punar navamyāṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat kanakanandinīm |
hutvā tu śāṇḍilīputraṃ kumārīr bhojayet tataḥ ||
śāṇḍilīputram agnim |
vaiśākhādiṣu māseṣu pūjayed vidhinācyutam |
muhurāṇāṃ srajābhis tu aśokānāṃ ca bhārata ||
kuṅkumāgarukarpūraiś candanena vilepayet |
dhūpenāgurumiśreṇa payasā pāyasena ca ||
acyutākhyaṃ japen nāma sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam |
gorocanāmbunā snānaṃ prāśanaṃ gomayasya tu ||
kṛtvopavāsam aṣṭamyāṃ pūjayitvā tathācyutam |
navamyāṃ bhojayec chaktyā kumārīr brāhmaṇān striyaḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute nandāṃ navamīṃ vidhivad vibho |
svam ekam ekaṃ vidhivac cintitaṃ labhate phalam ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ nandānavamīvratam |
[955]
athāsyām eva bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ durgāpūjanam |
māsi bhādrapade yā syān navamī bahuletarā |
mātṛnandā mahāpuṇyā kīrtitā pāpanāśinī ||
tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayed durgāṃ vidhivat kurunandana |
so ‘śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati ||
atha bhādrapadakṛṣṇanavamyāṃ devipurāṇoktaṃ durgābodhanam |
kanyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pūjayitvā ubhe ‘pi vā |
navamyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ gītavāditranisvanaiḥ || iti |
kanyāyāṃ darśāntabhādrapade |
iti nānāpurāṇoktaṃ durgāpūjanam |
atha mahānavamīvratam |
sumantur uvāca |
māghamāse tu yā śuklā navamī lokapūjitā |
mahānandeti sā proktaṃ sadānandakarī nṛṇām ||
asyāṃ (?) snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ tathā homa upoṣitam |
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ proktaṃ yad asyāṃ kriyate naraiḥ ||
śvetapuṣpasrajābhis tu nandāṃ bhagavatīṃ yajet |
kuṅkumena tathā vīra dhūpenāgaruṇā tathā ||
modakair vividhair vīra phalair nānāvidhais tathā |
tilakalkakṛtasnāno homayed vidhivat tilān ||
[956] pūjayec caturo māsān nandāṃ bhagavatīṃ śivām |
kumārīṃ bhojayed bhaktyā yoṣito brāhmaṇāṃs tathā ||
jyaiṣṭhādipāraṇe vīra jātīpuṣpakadambakaiḥ |
pūjayed vidhivad durgāṃ nāmnā vindhyanivāsinīm ||
prāśayet pañcagavyaṃ tu snānaṃ tenaiva puṇyadam |
pāyasān madhusarpibhyāṃ tathā dadhyodanaṃ param ||
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu pūjayed dhi smitānanām |
kundapuṣpasrajābhis tu karavīraiś ca suvrata ||
kastūrikākṛtair gandhair dhūpenāgaruṇā tathā |
ghṛtapūraiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiḥ śrīphalaiś cāpi pūjayet ||
gośṛṅgakṣālanasnānāt pūtadeho narādhipa |
pūjayed vidhivad devīṃ bhaktyā śvetamukhīṃ vibho ||
ya evaṃ pūjayed varṣaṃ caṇḍikāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpyāgryān brahmaloke mahīyate ||
krīḍitvā brahmaṇaḥ sārdharātraṃ tatra prapūjitaḥ |
pūjayed vidhivad devīṃ bhaktyā bhavati bhūtale |
dhanadhānyasamṛddhas tu putravān kīrtimān bhavet ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe mahānavamīvratam |
atha durgānavamīvratam |
brahmovāca |
durgāṃ saṃpūjya durgāṇi navamyāṃ tarati tayā |
[957] saṃgrāme vyavahāre ca sadā vijayam āpnuyāt ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthā kartavyā ca tithīśvarā ||
tithīśvarātra durgā tadrūpaṃ tu rathanavamīvrate |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhena kṛtvāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ payasā tena vai kṛtaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ durgānavamīvratam |
atha śauryavratam |
agastya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śauryavratam anuttamam |
yena bhīror api mhat śauryaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||
māsi cāśvayuje śuddhā navamī samupoṣitā |
saptamyāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ sthitvāṣṭamyāṃ nirodanaḥ ||
navamyāṃ prāśayet piṣṭaṃ prathamaṃ bhaktito nṛpa |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā devīṃ caiva tu pūjayet ||
durgāṃ devīṃ mahābhāgāṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahāprabhām ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad upoṣya vidhivan nṛpa |
[958] vratānte bhojayed dhīmān yathāśaktyā kamārakān ||
hemavastrādibhiḥ snātuṃ pūjayitvā tu śaktitaḥ |
paścāt kṣamāpayet kṣāntuṃ devī me prīyatām iti ||
evaṃ kṛtvā bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
avidyo labhate vidyāṃ bhīruḥ śauryaṃ ca vindati ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ śuaryavratam |
atha vīravratam |
navamyām ekabhaktaṃ tu kṛtvā kanyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ |
bhojayitvā samāṃ dadyād dhemakumbhaṃ ca vāsasī ||
samāṃ saṃvatsaram, yāvan navamyām eva bhojayet |
tathā hemaṃ tu dātavyaṃ mṛto śivapuraṃ vrajet |
pratijanma surūpaḥ syāc chatrubhiś cāparājitaḥ ||
etad vīravrataṃ nāma nārīṇāṃ ca sukhapradam |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ vīravratam |
atha āgneyavratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
sakṛn navamyāṃ bhaktena pūjayed vindhyavāsinīm |
[959] puṣpair dhūpais tato dīpair naivedyair vividhair api ||
pūjayitvā tato vidyāt pañjaraṃ sukasaṃyutam (?) |
hemaṃ viprāya dadyād yaḥ sa vāgmī jāyate naraḥ ||
sakṛd bhaktena naktena agnilokapradāyakam |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam āgneyavratam |
atha varṣavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
himavān hemakūṭaś ca śṛṅgāvān merumālyavān |
gandhamādana evaitān pūjayet pārthevarṣabhāh (?) ||
śailān nṛpa navamyāṃ tu caitram ārabhya pārthiva |
sopavāsena dharmajña gandhamālyānnasampadā ||
jambudvīpasya saṃsthānaṃ vratānte rājataṃ naraḥ |
tulāpramāṇāṃ dadyāt tu sarvān kāmān avāpnute ||
tulā pralaśatam |
aśvamedham avāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati |
mānuṣyamānādyata tatoś (??) cakravartī nṛpo bhavet ||
ciraṃ ca kalaṃ vasudhāṃ praśādyulokāvāpnoti tato ‘dhilokān (???) |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ varṣavratam |
[960]
atha bhadrakālīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
navamyāṃ sopavāsas tu bhadrakālīṃ prapūjayet |
śuklapakṣe mahārāja kārttikṅāt prabhṛti kramāt ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā |
saṃvatsarānte saṃpūjye vratānte brāhmaṇāya tu ||
vastrayugmaṃ naro datvā yatheṣṭaṃ kāmam āpnuyāt |
rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt ||
rājakāryābhiyuktaś ca mucyate ca mahābhayāt |
nāmarebhyo bhayaṃ tasmān na narebhyaḥ kathaṃcana ||
putrān avāpnoti dhanaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ
yaśaś ca puṇyaṃ vividhaṃ ca kupyam |
pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā vidhivad bhavānyāḥ
kāmān avāpnoti tathādibhūtān |
hemarūpyavyatiriktaṃ dhanaṃ kupyam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ bhadrakālīvratam |
rājovāca |
vidhinā pūjayet kanyāṃ bhadrakālīṃ narādhipa |
navamyām aśvine māsi śuklapakṣe narottama ||
puskara uvāca |
pūrvottare tu digbhāge likhed vāstymanohare |
bhadrakālīṃ nṛpagṛhaṃ citravastrair alaṃkṛtam ||
[961] bhadrakālīṃ paṭe kṛtvā tatra saṃpūjayed dvija |
bhadrakālīrūpanirmāṇaṃ tatraiva darśitam |
aṣṭādaśabhujā kāryā bhadrakālī manoharā |
ālīḍhasthānasaṃsthānā catuḥsiṃhe rathe sthitā ||
akṣamālāṃ triśūlaṃ ca khaḍgaś candrākhya eva ca |
bāṇavāpau (?) ca kartavyau śaṅkhapadmau tathaiva ca ||
śrukśruvau ca tathā kāryau tathā vaidikamaṇḍalam |
daṇḍaśaktī ca kartavye tathā śaktihutāśane ||
hastānāṃ bhadrakālyās tu tārakānikaraḥ karaḥ |
ekaṃ caiva mahābhāga ratnapātraṃ bhaved iti ||
āśvine śuklapakṣasya aṣṭamyāṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ |
tatraivāyudhacarmādyaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ ca pūjayet ||
rājaliṅgāni sarvāṇi tathā śasstrāṇi pūjayet |
phalair medhyais tathā bhakṣyair bhojyaiś ca sumanoharaiḥ ||
balibhiś ca vicitraiś ca prekṣyādānais tathaiva ca |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt tatraiva vasudhādhipa ||
upoṣito dvitīye ‘hni pūjayet punar eva tāḥ |
āyudhānāṃ ca sakalaṃ pūjayed vasudhādhipa ||
evaṃ sa pūjayed devīṃ varadāṃ bhaktavatsalām |
kātyāyanīṃ kāmagamāṃ bahurūpāṃ varapradām ||
[962] pūjitā sarvakāryaiḥ sā yunakti vasudhādhipa |
evaṃ hi saṃpūjya jagatpradhānāṃ
yātrāsu devyā vasudhādhipena |
prāpnoti siddhiṃ paramāṃ maheśāj
janas tathānyo ‘pi ca vittaśaktyā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ bhadrakālīvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe navamīvratāni samāptāni |
[963]
atha caturdaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
atha daśamīvratāni |
anyaṃ na vetti viṣayāntaram antarāyaṃ
yaś candracūḍacaraṇārpitavittavṛttiḥ |
satyavrataḥ sakalaśailasamūhasūryo
hemadrir adya daśamīvratavṛndam āha ||
sanatkumāra uvāca |
atha tvaṃ śṛṇu viprarṣe daśamīvratam uttamam |
sarvarogārtiśamanaṃ sattvapuṣṭipradaṃ śubham ||
vratam etan mahābuddhe kāryam ārogyam icchatā |
sarvakāryārtham etad dhi lipsunā jīvitaṃ ciram ||
upavāsaś ca kartavyo navamyām iha suvrata |
daśamyāṃ tu kṛtasnāno maṅgalāyatanaṃ harim ||
devam indirayā sārdhaṃ dhyātvā ca jagatāṃ patim |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārddhāsidharam uttamam ||
indirayā lakṣmyā |
phalaiś ca dhūpaiś ca puṣpaiś ca pāyasena samarcayet |
agrataḥ sthāpayet kumbhṃ tīrthatoyena pūritam ||
[964] asminn āvāhayet padma cakrādyāny āyudhāny api |
pūjayed raktapuṣpais tu guḍānnena samāhitaḥ ||
droṇamātratilaiḥ kṛṣṇa kārayed ajinopari |
tasminn aṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca nidhāya vai ||
manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prāṇān buddhiṃ daleṣv api |
karṇikāyṃ tathā kālaṃ krameṇaivam arthārcayet ||
anāmayānīndriyāṇi prāṇaś ca cirasaṃsthitaḥ |
anākūtāsanā buddhiḥ sarveṣu nirupadravā ||
manasā karmaṇā vācā mayā janmani janmani |
saṃcitaṃ kṣapayatv enaḥ kālātmā bhagavān hariḥ ||
ity evaṃ pārthivaṃ kṛtvā devadevasya cāgrataḥ |
daridrāya saputrāya satputrāya dvijanmane ||
iṣṭāpūrtavidhijñāya dadyāt sarvam atandritaḥ |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyaś ca bhojanam ||
ācāryaḥ sādhakaṃ paścāt snāpayet kumbhavāriṇā |
avaśiṣṭena cānnena gurvanujñāpuraḥsaram ||
bāndhavaiḥ saha bhuñjīta niyamān utsṛjet tataḥ |
jahyād dvyādhikṛtāṃ pīḍāṃ svapnoktām api suvrata ||
vratenānena vai martyaḥ sakṛt siddhena saṃyutaḥ |
putrapautrasuhṛdbandhupaśvādīn api nityaśaḥ ||
[965] ārogyaṃ cirajīvatvaṃ vratam etat prayacchati |
rājayakṣmaplīhāṣṭhīlāgulmaśūlabhagandarāḥ ||
naśyanti ca mahāsarve vratino nātra saṃśayaḥ |
anapatyaḥ sutaṃ devi dīrgham āyuś ca vindati ||
antarāmaraṇaṃ jahyād ānandārogyam ṛcchati |
antarāmaraṇaṃ jhyādity apamṛtyuṃ nāpnotīty arthaḥ |
iti garuḍapurāṇoktam ārogyavratam |
atha rājyāptidaśamīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
kratur dakṣo muniḥ satyaḥ kālaḥ kāmo vasus tathā |
kuravān manujo vipra romasāraś ca te daśa ||
viśvedevāḥ samākhyātā daśātmā keśavo vibhuḥ |
tasya saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ sitapakṣe narādhipa ||
ārabhya kārtikān māsād daśamyāṃ nṛpapuṅgava |
maṇḍaleṣv atha puṇyeṣu yadi vārcāsu yādava ||
gandhamālyanabhaskāradīpadhūpānnasampadā |
arcā pratimā, sā ca yathāsaṃbhavaṃ suvarṇādidhātumayo vidheyā |
vratānte kanakaṃ dadyād yathāśakti dvijātaye |
[966] kṛtvā vrataṃ kevalam etad iṣṭaṃ
prāpnoti teṣāṃ suciraṃ tu lokān |
tatroṣya loke puruṣottamasya
rājā bhaved brāhmaṇapuṅgavo vā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rājyāptidaśamīvratam |
atha brahmāvāptivratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
ātmā hy āyur mano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇas tathaiva ca |
haviśṇoś (?) ca gatis tasya dakṣaḥ pratyaś ca te daśa ||
devās tv aṅgiraso nāma daśamyāṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
sopavāsaḥ pūrvapakṣe pūrvoktavidhinā ciram ||
pūrvoktavidhinā anantaroktavidhinā |
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
prāpnoti teṣāṃ suciraṃ hi lokān |
taroṣya kālaṃ puruṣatvam etya
rājā bhaved brāhmaṇapuṅgavo vā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ brahmāvaptivratam |
[967]
atha padārthavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu sopavāsas tathā naraḥ |

gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā |
dikpālapūjanaṃ kuryād diśāṃ saṃpūjanam tathā ||
gāṃ vatsarānte dadyāc ca tathaiva ca payasvinīm |
brāhmaṇāya mahābhāga yathā ca manujottama ||
etad vrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yatra kvacana gacchati |
tatreṣṭaṃ kāmyam āpnoti putreṣṭiphalam aśnute ||
vāṇijyakaṇṭhasya narasya siddhaṃ
yāvān tathānyāṃ vijīgīṣavaś ca |
vidyārthino vā ripunāśanaṃ vā
hitaṃ padārthaṃ vratam etad iṣyam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottare padārthavratam |
atha dharmavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu sopavāsas tu mānavaḥ |
dharmaṃ saṃpūjayed devaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham ||

gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā ||

vratāvasāne dadyāc ca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm ||
vratam etad dhi nirdiṣṭam aśvamedhaphalapradam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tathāpy etat kāryaṃ manujasattama ||
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
svargalokam avāpnoti kulam uddharati svakam ||
dharmeti ca bhavet tasya dharmaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
yatra yatrābhijāyet tatra dharmaparo bhavet ||
vratenānena sarvatra naro dharmaparo bhavet |
āyuṣyam ārogyayaśaskaraṃ tat
sthānapradaṃ pāpavināśakāri |
kartavyam etat puruṣo yathāvat
pūjyo hi viṣṇur bhagavān sa dharmaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ dharmavratam |
athāparājitadaśamīvidhiḥ |

śravaṇenābhyudiyād etāni pādetāni khalu paścimadvārāṇi sa yatraiva diśam abhyutthitaḥ | śayanahastena vā tṛṇahastena vā āsandīhastena vā nīvīhastena vā jānuhastena vā sameyān nivṛttotārvāk (nivartetārvāk) khalv etakvāndhād (etat krośād) ūrdhvaṃ krośād arvāk ghātukatham [krośād avyāghātukam] asya [arthasya] bhavati | vidalaṃ tapena [vidalasūpena] bhuktvā śraviṣṭhāsv abhyudayād
