[ālabhyātha] juhuyāt pavitrāṇi sākaṃ hi rocanāni svāhety agnau hutvā raseṣu saṃpātān ānīya saṃsthāpya homas [homāṃs] tu snapanaṃ prāśaya nirasāni vavaitasmai karoti sarveṣāṃ lohānāṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvāsāṃ śravantīnāṃ janitādhpatirajanir bhavati |
citrāṇi sākaṃ dadhirocanāni [divi rocanāni]
sarīsṛpāṇi bhavane janāni |
turmiśaṃ sumatim icchamāno
ahāni gīrbhiḥ saparyāṇi nākam || [verse restored with APariś]
suhatvam [suhavam] agne kṛttikā rohiṇī
castu bhadraṃ mṛgaśiraḥ śam ārdrā |
**vāstu prāśayati raśān evaṃ cainasmai sauvubhadremṛśatiraḥ samudrā** [this is garbled in Hemādri]
punarvasvos śūnyatā [punarvasū sūnṛtā] vātuṣacākṣuṣo [cāru puṣyo]
bhānur aśleṣā āyanaṃ gayā [maghā] me |
puṇyaṃ sarvaphālguś cānuhastāś [pūrvā phalgunyau cātra hastaś]
vināśiścāti [citrā śivā svāti] sukho me astu |
**śūnyatācānurādhe viśākhāsahabānurādhā**
rādhe viśākhe suhavā anurdhā
jyeṣṭhā sunakṣatram ariṣṭhamūlam ||
annaṃ pūrvā rasantāṃ me svāhā [aṣāḍhā]
**ūrdhvaṃ pūrvād etyutrarāvāha** |
ūrjaṃ dehy uttarā ā vahantu |
uktaṃ prāsthānikam ity upakramya |
tad apy ete ślokāḥ |
alaṃkṛto bhūṣitabhṛtyavargaḥ
pariṣkṛtottuṅgaturaṅgamārgaḥ |
vāditranādapratināditāśaḥ
sumaṅgalācāraparamparāśīḥ ||
rājā nirgatya bhavanāt purohitapurogamāḥ |
prāsthānikaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhet pūrvato diśi ||
[971] gatvā nagarasīmāntaṃ vāstupūjāṃ samārabhet |
saṃpūjya cārthadikpālān pūjayet pathi devatāḥ ||
mantraiḥ sarvair dikpaurāṇaiḥ pūjayec ca śamītarum |
amaṅgalānāṃ śamanīṃ śamanīṃ duṣkṛtasya ca ||
duḥsvapnaśamanīṃ dhanyāṃ prapadye ‘haṃ śamīṃ śubhām |
satatāśīḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi viṣṇukramāt kramet ||
ripoḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā dhyātvā vā manasā tathā |
śareṇa svarṇapuṅkhena viddho hṛdayamarmaṇi ||
diśāṃ vijayamantrāś ca paṭhitavyāḥ purodhasā |
evam eva vidhiṃ kuryād dakṣiṇādidiśāsv api ||
pūjyān dvijāṃś ca saṃpūjya saṃvatsaraṃ purohitaḥ |
gajavājipadātīnāṃ prekṣākautukam ācaret ||
jayamaṅgalaśabdena tataḥ svabhavanaṃ viśet |
nīrājyamānaḥ puṇyābhir gaṇikābhiḥ sumaṅgalam ||
ya evaṃ kurute rājā varṣe varṣe sumaṅgalam |
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ vijayaṃ ca sa gacchati ||
nādhayo vyādhayas tasya bhavanti na parājayaḥ |
śriyaṃ puṇyām avāpnoti vijayaś ca sadā bhuvi || iti |
uktaṃ prāsthānikam iti vivāham uddiśya yad uktam prāsthānikaṃ tad ihāpi jñātavyam ity arthaḥ |
[972] tac ca prāsthānikaṃ yathā |
athātaḥ prāsthānikaṃ vyākhyāsyāmo janeṣu gamiṣyatsu pārthivā vā tasya tvāṃ dundubhayaḥ syur vīṇāś copavādayeran hṛṣṭālaṃkṛtās cāru vadanta udagayane pūrvapakṣe puṇyanakṣatre keśaśmaśruromanakhāni vāpayitvā saṃbhārānupakalpayitvā muhūrtam upasamādhāya śāntipratisaraṃ kārayitvā voḍhārantenābhiṣiñced anyatoktam añjanābhyañjnānulepanaṃ kārayitvā vāso gandhān srajaś cāvadhya puraḥsthātāraṃ snāpayitvā kartānvālabhya juhoty abhayair api rājiterāpuṣpaiḥ svastyayanaiḥ śarmavarmabhijanaiś ca hutvā pārthivasyetibhāpragāmeti bahudhā āgacchatā gatasyetīsyetīndraṃ (?) sthālipākeneṣṭvā ātiṣṭhājiṣṇuranṛkṣarāṛjeva (?) iti panthānam asthāpya japed imau pādau yat indra trātāram indraṃ mānovidannabhayaṃ somo ‘haspatir naḥ paripātu paścād iti trīn viṣṇukāmān krāntvā vivāhaṃ kārayen naddharāt pratiṣṭhen na parihaset sadya eva kuryād iti |
purāṇasamuccaye tv asyām evāparājitā pūjoktā | āśvinaśuklapakṣaṃ prakramya daśamyāṃ ca naraiḥ samyak pūjanīyā parājitā |
aiśānīṃ diśam āśritya aparāhṇe prayatnataḥ || iti |
iyaṃ tithidvaidhe paradine śravaṇābhāve pūrvoktā | āśvinaśuklapakṣaṃ prakamya (?) daśamyāṃ ca naraiḥ samyak pūjanīyāparājitā |
[973] yadā śravaṇyuktā tadā saiva kāryā | tad uktaṃ kalpapena |
udaye daśamī kiṃcit saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yadi |
śravaṇarkṣaṃ yadākāle sā tithir vijayābhidhā ||
śravaṇarkṣe tu pūrṇāyāṃ kākutsthaḥ prasthito yataḥ |
ullaṅghayeyuḥ sīmāntaṃ taddinarkṣe tato narāḥ || iti |
anyeṣu sarveṣu pakṣeṣu navamīyuktā grāhyā | tad uktaṃ purāṇasamuccaye |
yā pūrṇā navamīyuktā tasyāṃ pūjyāparājitā |
kṣemārthaṃ vijayārthaṃ ca prasiddhavidhinā naraiḥ ||
navamī śeṣasaṃyuktā daśamyām aparājitā |
dadāti vijayaṃ devī pūjitā jayavardhanī ||
tathā āśvine śuklapakṣe tu daśamyāṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ na kurvīta pūjanaṃ cāparājitam || iti |
skandapurāṇe ‘pi |
daśamīṃ yaḥ samullaṅghya prasthānaṃ kurute nṛpaḥ |
tasya samvatsaraṃ rājye na kvāpi vijayo bhavet || iti |
ity aparājitādaśamīvidhiḥ |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
pūrvaṃ kṛtayugasyādau bhṛgor bhāryā mahāsatī |
divye rāmāśrame ramye gṛhakāryeṣu tatparā ||
[974] babhūva sā bhṛgor nityaṃ hṛdayepsitakāriṇī |
tasyāṃ munir mahātejā agnihotraṃ nidhāya ca ||
viṣṇos trāso dānavānāṃ kutrālakṣaṇasamākulam |
muktvā yuddhasthitaṃ pārśve samarpya munipuṅgavaḥ ||
datvā nikṣepakaṃ sarvaṃ divyayā sumahātapāḥ |
jagāma himavatpārśvaṃ haraṃ toṣayituṃ haraḥ ||
saṃjīvanīkṛte nityaṃ kaṇair dhūmam adhomukhaḥ |
yayau dānavarājasya vijayāya purohitaḥ ||
ājagām gate tasmin garuḍenāśrayo hariḥ |
abhyetya tatsthalaṃ cakre cakreṇa kṛttakandharam ||
galadrudhirapallalodhai (?) nohitārṇavasaṃnibham |
dṛṣṭāsurabalaṃ sarvaṃ nihataṃ viṣṇunā tadā ||
divyāstrasaṃyukāmo ‘bhūt viṣṇum asrvāvilekṣaṇam |
yāvan noccarate vācaṃ cakreṇa kṛtakandharam ||
tāvan nipātayāmāsa śiras tasya sakuṇḍalam |
pāpya saṃjīvanīṃ vidyāṃ yāvad āyāty asau muniḥ ||
tāvat sadaityadaityān hi paśyti sma nipātitān |
roṣāchāśāpa ca hariṃ bhṛkūṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ||
avaśyabhāvabhāvitvād viśvasya hitakāraṇāt |
yasmāt tvayā hatā daityā brāhmaṇī matparigrahā ||
tasmāt tvaṃ mānuṣe loke daśavāraṃ gamiṣyasi |
atīrthaṃ mānuṣe loke rakṣārthaṃ ca mahībhṛtām ||
[975] avatāro daśākāro bhūyo bhūyaḥ pṛthagvidhaḥ |
pūrvoktakāraṇaiḥ pārtha avatīrṇaṃ mahītale |
māṃ narā ye ‘rcayiṣyanti teṣāṃ vāsas tripiṣṭhape ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
vrataṃ daśāvatārākhyaṃ kṛṣṇa brūhi savistaram |
samantraṃ sarahasyaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
proṣṭhapade site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
snātvā jalāśaye svacche pitṛdevāditarpaṇam ||
kṛtvā kurukulaśreṣṭha gṛham āgatya mānavaḥ |
gṛhṇīyāt dhānyacūrṇasya dvihastaprasṛtitrayam ||
krameṇa pācayet tat tu puṃsaṃjñaghṛtasaṃyutam |
varṣaṃ varṣaṃ dine tasmin yāvad varṣāṇi vai daśa ||
prathame pūrikāṃ varṣe dvitīye ghṛtapūrikāṃ |
tṛtīye śuklakāsāraṃ caturthe modakān śubhān ||
sohālakān pañcame ‘bde ṣaṣṭhe ‘bde khaṇḍaveṣṭakān |
saptame ‘bde kokvarasyalakāpuṣṭas tathāṣṭame ||
daśātmano daśahare daśaviprāya dāpayet |
krameṇa bhakṣayitvā ca yathoktaṃ bharatarṣabha ||
ardhārdhaṃ viṣṇave deyaṃ ardhārdhaṃ vā dvijātaye |
svata evārdham aśnīyād gatvā ramye jalāśaye ||
daśāvatārān abhyarcya puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
[976] mantreṇānena medhāvī harim abhyukṣya vāriṇā ||
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ varāhaṃ
trivikramaṃ rāmaṃ rāmaṃ rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca
buddhaś caiva sakalkikam |
gato ‘smi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||
praṇato ‘smi jagannātha sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu |
chittvā tu vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ bhagnāṃ prīto janārdanaḥ ||
śvetadvīpaṃ nayatv asmān mayātmā vinivedayet |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute partha vidhinānena suvratam ||
daśāvatāranāmākhyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
śrūyate yās tv imā loke puruṣāṇāṃ daśādaśa ||
tāṃś chinatti na saṃdehaś cakrapraharaṇair hariḥ |
saṃsārasāgarā ghorā tat ūrdhvarate hariḥ ||
śvetadvīpaṃ nayaty āśu vratennena toṣitaḥ |
kiṃ tasya na bhavel loke yasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ ||
so ‘haṃ janārdano rājan kālarūpo rarāmy ataḥ |
martyaloke ‘bhayaṃ pārtha cariṣyati mayoditam ||
salakṣmyā calayā bhaktyā bhartṛputrasamanvitā |
martyaloke ciraṃ sthitvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
viṣṇulokād indralokaṃ tato yāti paraṃ padam |
ye pūjayanti puruṣāḥ puruṣottamasya
matsyādikān daśamīṣu daśāvatārān |
martye daśasv api daśāsu sukhaṃ vihṛtya
te yānti yānam adhiruhya sureśalokān ||
iti bhaviṣyottare daśāvatāraṃ nāma |
[977]
atha sodyāpanam āśādaśamīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
pārtha pathi vivardhantamukhapaṅkaja sadrave |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito vacmi tavāśādaśāmīvratam ||
nalatāpo bhavet pūrvaṃ viṣadheṣu mahīpate |
sa bhrātrā vijito rājan niṣkarenāti niṣkṛtiḥ ||
akṣair dūtena rājendra niryayau bhāryayā saha |
vanaṃ bhayapratibhayaṃ śūnyaṃ śillītagaṇanāditaḥ ||
sa gatvā prītihotrānnajalamātreṇa varjayet |
dadarśa vanamadhyasthāṃ cchkunīn kāñcanacchavīn ||
grahītum icchus tān rājan samācchādya svavāsasā |
samīpe tu khagāt tūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā vasanaṃ śubham ||
āsasāda sabhāṃ kāṃcid dhṛtavāsā suduḥkhitaḥ |
damayantī sabhāṃ prāpya nidrayāpahṛtā tadā ||
duḥkhād utsṛjya gatavān cānyatra pradhaneśvaram |
gate tu naiṣedhe bhaimī prabuddhā carcitānanā ||
apaśyantī nalaṃ vīra bhaimī sutaṃ patiṃ vane |
itaś cetaś ca babhrāma hāheti rudantī muhuḥ ||
duḥkhaśokasamākrāntā naladarśanalālasā |
āsasāda vane kaiścit sā caidyapurapuñjasā ||
unmattavat parivṛttā śiśubhiḥ kautakākulaiḥ |
[978] dṛṣṭvā ca cedirājasya jananī janaceṣṭitā ||
candralekheva patitā bhūmau bhāsitadiṅmukhā |
āropya sā svabhavanaṃ pṛcchakā tvaṃ varānane ||
uvāca bhaimī savrīḍaṃ sairindhrīṃ māṃ nibodhata |
na dhāvayeyaṃ caraṇau nocchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayāmy aham ||
yadi prārthayate kaścid daṇḍyas te sāṃprataṃ bhavet |
pratijñayā tayā devi tiṣṭhe ‘haṃ tava veśmani ||
evam astv anavadyāṅgi rājamātāpy uvāca tām |
evaṃ vai dāsabhavane kaṃcit kālam aninditā ||
uvāsa vatsarārdhena pravṛttāte kila dvija |
anayā māsam uditāddamayantī (?) gṛhaṃ pituḥ ||
mātrā pitrā samāyuktā sutair bhrātṛbhir eva ca |
damayantī tathāpy āste duḥkhaṃ naiṣadhavarjite ||
provāca viprān āhūya vrataṃ dānam athāpi vā |
kathayadhvaṃ yathā me syād iṣṭena sahasaṅgamaḥ ||
tatretihāsakuśalo vipraḥ provāca buddhimān |
bhadre tvam āśādaśamīṃ kuruṣvepsitasiddhidam ||
cakāra sarvaṃ tanvaṅgī yat purāṇavidā tadā |
khyātam ākhyānaviduṣā damanena purodhasā ||
vratasyāsya prabhāvena damayantyā narottama |
saṃjātaḥ sukhadīptyarthaṃ (?) bhartrā saha samāgamaḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
katham āśādaśamyeṣā govinda kriyate kadā |
[979] sarvam etat samācakṣva māsatiṣyādi yādava ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
rājyāśayā rājaputraḥ kṛṣyarthaṃ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ |
bhāryārthaṃ tu vaṇikputraḥ putrārthaṃ gurviṇī tathā ||
dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhyai loke kanyā varārthinī |
yaṣṭukāmo dvijavaro rogī rogāpanuttaye ||
vīra pravasite kānte tadārttitāpapīḍitā |
eteṣv anyeṣu kartavyam āśāvratam idaṃ tadā ||
yadā yasya bhaved ārtikāryaṃ tena tadā vratam |
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu snātvā saṃpūjya devatāḥ ||
naktaṃ daśamyāṃ saṃpūjyaḥ puṣpālaktakacandanaiḥ |
gṛhīgaṇo likhayitvā yavaiḥ piṣṭālakena vā ||
strīrūpāś cādhipūjyās tu svacihnenaiva cihnitāḥ |
yathā devasya śakrādeḥ śastravāhanalakṣaṇam ||
datvā ghṛtāktaṃ naivedyaṃ pṛthak dīpāṃś ca dāpayet |
phalāni kālajātāni tataḥ kāryaṃ nivedayet ||
āśāsvāśā sadā santu vidyantāṃ me manorathāḥ |
bhavānīnāṃ prasādena sadā kalyāṇam astv iti ||
evam saṃpūjya bhuñjīta datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām |
anena kramayogena māsi māsi samācaret ||
dhāvan manorathaḥ pūrṇas tataḥ paścāt samudyamān |
māsi pūrṇe ca ṣaṇmāse varṣe varṣadvaye gate ||
[980] sauvarṇī kārayed āśāḥ raupyā piṣṭātakena vā |
jñātibandhujanaiḥ sārdhaṃ snātaḥ samyag alaṃkṛtaḥ ||
pūjayen mantrasaṃdarbhair ebhir dhyātvā gṛhāṅgaṇe |
tava saṃnihitaḥ śakraḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ||
pūrvaccandreṇa sahitā aindrīdigdevate namaḥ |
agneḥ parigrahācārye tvam āgneyī samucyase ||
tejo hy apāṃ parā śaktir āgneyī varadā bhava |
devarājaṃ samāsādya lokaḥ saṃyamaty asau ||
tena saṃyaminīyāsi yāmye kāmapradā bhava |
khaḍgaṃ saheti vikṛtānair ṛtis tvāmuṣāmṛtam ||
tena nairṛtanāmni tvaṃ kṛtavān bhavataḥ sadā |
tvayāste bhavanādhāra varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ||
iṣṭakāmārthsiddhyarthaṃ vāruṇiprabhavo bhava |
adhitvāsi ca yasmāt tvaṃ vāyudā jagatāṃ punaḥ ||
vāyavye tvam ataḥ śāṇtiṃ nityaṃ yaccha namo namaḥ |
kauverovaśisaumyā ca prābhyāptā (??) tvam athottarā ||
niruttarā bhavāsmāsu datvā sadyo manorathān |
ye pānījagadīśena śambhunā tvam alaṃkṛtā ||
atas tvaṃ śivasāṃnidhyaṃ dabhivyāhi (?) śive namaḥ |
sarpāṭaka kulena tvaṃ sevitāsi tathāpy adhaḥ ||
nāgāṅganābhiḥ sahitotāhitā (?) na sarvadā bhava |
saptalokaiḥ parigataḥ sarvadā tvaṃ śivāya tu ||
sanakādyaiḥ parivṛtā brāhmajihvānapāṃ (?) kuru |
[981] nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahās tārāgrahās tathā ||
nakṣatramātaro ye ca bhūtapretavināyakāḥ |
sarve mameṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ bhavantu praṇatā sadā ||
ebhir mantraiḥ samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ |
āpobhir abhisaṃsthāpya phalāni vinivedayet ||
tat sūryadhvanighoṣeṇa gītamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ |
nṛtyatībhiḥ kṣumāpyastās tāṃ rātrim ativāhayet ||
kuṅkumakṣodatīvreṇa dānamānādibhiḥ sukham |
prabhāte vedaviduṣe sarvaṃ tat pratipādayet ||
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ kṣamāpya praśriyasya ca |
bhuñjīta mitrasahitaḥ suhṛdbandhujanair api ||
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha daśamīvratam ādarāt |
sa sarvakāmam āpnoti manasābhīpsitaṃ naraḥ ||
strībhir viśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ vratam etad yudhiṣṭhira |
laghuvittapater nārya sadā kāmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
kathitaṃ te mahārāja mayā vratam anuttamam ||
ye mānavā manujapuṅgavakāmakāmāḥ
saṃpūjayanti daśamīṣu sadā daśāśāḥ |
teṣāṃ viśeṣanihitā hṛdaye prakāmam
āśāḥ phalaṃ tṛlamalaṃ bahunoditena ||
iti bhaviṣyottare sodyāpanam āśādaśamīvratam |
[982]

brahmovāca |

kurute kurute tasya nārakī naiva vāsanā ||
yamaḥ pāpāni viprendra svapaṭātmāñjapatkṛtā ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
yogāyati viśālākṣi jñānato ‘jñānato ‘pi vā |
mama prajāgare gītair nityaṃ bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ ||
yāvantaś ca svarāḥ kecid gāyamānā yaśasvini |
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate ||
madbhaktaś caiva jāyeta śakralokam upāsthitaḥ |
sarvakarmaguṇaśreṣṭhas tatrāpi mama pūjakaḥ ||
[986] indralokaparibhraṣṭo mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ |
pramuktaḥ sarvasaṃsārān mama lokāya gacchati ||
tathā śṛṇuta tattvena me bhūmiṃ kathyamānaya |
mama māyāprabhāveṇa siddhiṃ prāpto mahaujasīṃ ||
tatraiva cāśrame kaścic caṇḍālaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ |
dūrāj jāgaraṇe gāyen mama bhaktivyavasthitaḥ ||
evaṃ tu gāyatas tasya jagmur varṣāṇy anekaśaḥ |
svapākaṃ suguṇaḥ so ‘tha madbhaktaś ca vasundahe ||
kaumudasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣasya dvādaśīm |
susaṃgate jane yāte vīṇām ādāya jāgaram ||
tato ‘rdhamārge caṇḍālo gṛhīto brahmarākṣasaiḥ |
alpaprāṇaḥ śvapāko vai balavān brahmarākṣasaḥ ||
duḥkhena caiva saṃtapto na śaknoti viceṣṭitam |
sa vai proktaḥ śvapākena balavān brahmarākṣasaḥ ||
kiṃ tvayā ceṣṭitaṃ mahyaṃ yas tv evaṃ paridhāvasi |
śvapākavacanaṃ śrutvā tadā vai brahmarākṣasaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ mānuṣoddhāralolupaḥ |
adya me daśarātro ‘yaṃ nirāhārasya gacchati ||
dhātrā suvihito ‘si tvam āhārārthe purasthitaḥ |
adya te bhakṣayiṣyāmi naramāṃsaṃ ca śoṇitam ||
pītvā caiva yathānyāyaṃ yathā vā tava rocate |
[987] brahmarakṣovacaḥ śrutvā śvapāko gītalālasaḥ ||
rākṣasaṃ chandayāmāsa mama bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ |
evam etan mahābhāga bhakṣāya samupāgataḥ ||
avaśyam eva kartavyaṃ dhātrā dattaṃ yathā tava |
paścāt khādasi māṃ rakṣo jāgare vinivartite ||
viṣṇoḥ saṃtoṣaṇārthāya mamaitad vratam uttamam |
saṃrakṣa vratabhaṅgād vai devanārāyaṇaṃ prati ||
jāgare vinivṛtte tu māṃ bhakṣaya yadīcchasi (?) |
śvapākasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarakṣaḥ kṣudhārditam ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śvapākaṃ tadanantaram |
mithyā vadasi cāṇḍāla tvaṃ kathaṃ punar eṣyasi ||
ko hi rakṣomukhād bhraṣṭo mānavo vinivartate |
tathā |
rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā cāṇḍālo dharmasaṃsthitaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ rākṣasaṃ piśitāśanam |
yady apy alaṃ hi cāṇḍālaḥ pūrvakarmavidūṣitaḥ ||
prāpto ‘smi mānuṣaṃ janma garhitenāntarātmanā |
śṛṇu tatsamayaṃ rakṣo yena me punar āgamaḥ ||
dūrasthaṃ jāgaraṃ kṛtvā lokanāthasya rātritaḥ |
satyamūlaṃ jagat sarvaṃ loke satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
satyena lebhire siddhim ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ |
nāhaṃ satyāt pramucyeya tasthau brahmo hyatendriyaḥ ||
sa yāti caiva satyena nāgam iṣyāmi yady aham |
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā ||
[988] teṣāṃ gatiṃ prapadyeyaṃ nāgam iṣyāmi yady aham |
brahmarākṣasam uktas tu śvapākaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ ||
punar gāyati matsthaṃ vai mama bhaktyā vyavasthitaḥ |
atha prabhāte vimale gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca jāgare ||
nāmnā śvapākā gāyanti śvapāko na nivartate |
tataḥ svaritam āgatya puruṣodāttarupabhāk (?) ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śvapākaṃ tadanantaram |
kuto gacchati tattvena drutaṃ gamananiścitaḥ ||
ekadā caṅkramet sarvaṃ yatra tatra pravartate |
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā śvapākaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ puruṣād asya saṃsadi |
samayo me kṛtaḥ pūrvam agrato brahmarakṣasaḥ ||
tatrāhaṃ gantum icchāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
tato rākṣasasāṃnidhyaṃ śvapāka ity uvāca ha ||
gaccha caṇḍāla bhadraṃ te gantuṃ tatra na cārhasi |
yatrāsau rākṣasaḥ prāptaḥ piśitāsanasaṃsadaḥ ||
athovāca śvapāko ‘sau maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ |
nāham evaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā tvaṃ vadase ‘nagha ||
na cāhaṃ nāśaye satyam etan me niścitaṃ vratam |
nāhaṃ samayam utsṛjya śapathāṃś ca kadācana ||
satyam itthaṃ kariṣyāmi gaccha tāvan namo ‘stu te |
[989] evaṃ pracāraṇaṃ tasmin vai śvapāke satyavādini ||
brahmarakṣasi satyatvāt satyavākyaprabhāṣaṇāt |
dṛṣṭvā tu rākṣasaṃ tatra śvapākas tam uvāc ha ||
āgato ‘smi mahābhāga gītvā gāthāṃ yathepsitām |
viṣṇor vai lokanāthasya mama pūrṇā manorathāḥ ||
ehy ehi mama gātrāṇi bhakṣayasva yathepsitam |
śvapākasya vacaḥ śrutvā provāca brahmarākṣasaḥ ||
tava tuṣṭo ‘smy ahaṃ vatsa satyadharmānupālanāt |
cāṇḍālasya vidhijñasya yasya vai buddhi īdṛśī ||
tataḥ provāsa rātrau ca viṣṇvajye jāgaraḥ kṛtaḥ |
phalaṃ gītasya me dehi yadi jīvitum icchasi ||
athovāca śvapākas tu mayā satyaṃ vacaḥ kṛtam |
khāda rākṣasa māṃsāni na dadyāṃ gītajaṃ phalam ||
uvāca rākṣaso gītaṃ dīyatām ardharātrikam |
tato mokṣyāmi kalyāṇa rākṣastvāc ca bhāṣaṇāt ||
athovāca śvapāko ‘sau tvaṃ pāhi brahmarākṣasaḥ |
tvāṃ bhakṣayāmīty evoktaṃ gīte puṇyaṃ kim icchasi ||
śvapākasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarakṣo jagāda ha |
ekayāmasya me dehi puṇyaṃ śāntasya vai phalam ||
taṃ rākṣasam uvācātha cāṇḍālo gītalubdhakaḥ |
na ca yāmyaphalaṃ dadmi brahmarakṣas tavepsitam ||
pibasva śoṇitaṃme ‘dya yat tvayā pūrvabhāṣītam |
śvapākasya vacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaḥ pratyabhāṣata ||
[990] ekagītasya me dehi yat phalaṃ viṣṇusaṃsadi |
ātmānaṃ tārayiṣyāmi tava gītaphalena tu ||
nāmnāhaṃ somaśarmeti brāhmaṇo brahmayoninā |
sūtrayantraparibhraṣṭo yajñakarmasu niṣṭhitaḥ ||
tato ‘smi kṛtavān yajñaṃ lomahomaprapīḍitaḥ |
tasya yajñasya doṣeṇa jāto ‘smi brahmarākṣasaḥ ||
mantrahīnasya yad dattaṃ svarahīnaṃ ca yat kṛtam |
yad iṣṭaṃ putrahīnena vidhvastaṃ karmajanmayā ||
parimāṇaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca mayā nātropalakṣitam |
lābhalomasya doṣeṇa yoniṃ prāpto ‘smi rākṣasīm ||
tvaṃ tu gītapradānena māṃ tārayitum arhasi |
yujyeyaṃ rākṣasatvāc ca viṣṇugītaprasādataḥ ||
brahmarakṣovacaḥ śrutvā śvapākaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ |
bāḍham ity eva tadvākye brahmarākṣasam abravīt ||
gītavān asmi yat paścāt svaram ekam anuttamam |
phalena tasya bhadra tvāṃ rākṣasatvād amocayam ||
sakṛd gāyati saṃyuktaḥ kauśikaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau |
sa tārayati durgāṇi śvapāko rākṣasam tathā ||
evaṃ tatra varaṃ (?) labdhvā sa tadā brahmarākṣasaḥ |
jātas tu vimalo bhadre śaradīva niśākaraḥ ||
yajñaśāpād vinirmuktaḥ somaśarmā dvijas tadā |
jāto bhāgavato bhūmikṣetre datto mahāyaśāḥ ||
śvapākaś cāpi suśroṇi mama***opagāyanāt [broken type] |
[991] kṛtvā suvimalaṃ karma so ‘pi brahmatvam āgataḥ ||
etad bhūmikathāṃ sarvāṃ kathitaṃ tava sundari |
brahmapurāṇe |
devasyopari kurvīta śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ |
nānāpuṣpair muniśreṣṭha vicitrapuṣpamaṇḍapam ||
kṛtvā vāvaraṇaṃ paścāj jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi |
kathāṃ ca vāsudevasya gītakaṃ vāpi kārayet ||
dhyāyan paṭhan stavan devaṃ pretayed rajanīṃ budhaḥ |
mama jāgaraṇe gītasvarasaṅghaikaniścitam ||
yas tu gāyati suśroṇi kaumudadvādaśīniśi |
sa sarvasaṅgaṃ saṃtyajya mama lokāya gacchati ||
yas tu gāyati gītāni mama jāgaraṇe sadā |
yuktaś cāntasthiro bhūtvā brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati ||
yas tu gāyati gītāni mama jāgaraṇe sadā |
yuktam antasthito bhūtvā brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati ||
etat te kathitaṃ bhūmigāyane mama jāgare |
nityaṃ tu gāyanenaiva taret saṃsārasāgarāt ||
vāditrasya pravakṣyāmi tac chṛṇu tvaṃ vasundhare |
saptavat tu phalaṃ yasmād vāditrād dharmasaṃsthitaḥ ||
samyak kālaprayogeṇa saṃnipātena vā punaḥ |
[992] navavarṣasahasrāṇi navavarṣaśatāni ca ||
kuberabhavanaṃ gatvā modate ‘sau yadṛcchayā |
kuberabhavanād bhraṣṭaḥ svacchando dhanavān sukhī ||
samyak kālanipātena mama lokāya gacchati |
nartanasya pravakṣyāmi tac chṛṇu tvaṃ vasundhare ||
manujā yena gacchanti chitvā saṃsārasāgaram |
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśadvarṣaśatāni ca ||
puṣkaradvīpam āsādya svacchandagamano bhavet |
nṛtyaṃ tu jāgare devi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
rūpavān guṇavāṃś caiva śīlavāṃś caiva jāyate |
madbhaktaś caiva jāyeta saṃsārād api mucyate ||
yas tu jāgaraṇe nṛtye mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ |
jambūdvīpaṃ samāsādya rājarājaḥ sa jāyate ||
sarvakarmasamāyukto rakṣitā pṛthivītale |
madbhaktaś caiva jāyet śūraḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ ||
upagacchet tu mām ante mama karmapathe sthitaḥ |
etat te kathitaṃ bhūmi gītavāditranartanam ||
madbhaktānāṃ sukhārthāya sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam |
iti khalu nikhilasmṛtipurāṇanigamādivihitam ekādaśīvratam |
atha bahavo vipratipadyante |
[993] ekādaśyām upavaset pakṣayor ubhayor api |
viṣṇurahasyaskandapurāṇayoḥ |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ samyak pakṣayor ubhayor api |
garuḍapurāṇe |
upoṣyaikādaśī nityaṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
sanatkumāraproktam |
ekādaśī sadopoṣyā pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ |
tathā |
ekādaśyām upavasen na kadācid atikramet |
matsyabhaviṣyapurāṇayoḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yo bhuṅkte dvādaśidine |
śukle vā yad divā kṛṣṇe tad vrataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahat ||
āgneyapurāṇe |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta vratam etad dhi vaiṣṇavam |
upavāsaparam idaṃ vacanaṃ yugalam, vratam iti vākyaśeṣāt |
viṣṇudharmottare kūrmapurāṇe ca |
na śaṅkhena pibet toyaṃ na khādet kūrmaśūkarau |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
parahoraṭatetyarthaṃ mṛgāriripumastake |
abhuktvā daśamīṃ lokā mamatvena vivarjitāḥ ||
prāṇabādheṣu kāryeṣu deveśaś cintyatāṃ hariḥ |
[994] raṭantīha purāṇāni bhūyo bhūyo varānane ||
na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare |
viṣṇusmṛtau |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta kadācid api mānavaḥ |
etāny api vacanāni nādityam īkṣateti ca vadata upavāsavrataparāṇy eva kvacit kvacid upvāsapratipādanāc ca | arthavidhau mūlabhūtavedāntarakalpanāprasaṅgāl lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāc ca ekamūlatvāya lakṣaṇatvānumataiva (?) | yad vaikādaśyām upavased ity upakramya ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīteti devalādivacanaṃ tad upasaṃhārārthaṃ guṇavidhānārthaṃ vā tathā copavāsaprakaraṇapaṭhanam apy ucitaṃ bhavati | tena svatantraṃ nārthavidhiparam eva mādivacanam iti matam apāstam | tathā ca siddhaś copavāso vratarūpaḥ | sa ca nityaḥ phalaśravaṇāt, kalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, vihitatvāc ca sadākaraṇaṃ na kadācid atikramed iti vacanāt akaraṇe pratyavāyasmaraṇāc ca | tathā hi sanatkumāraprokte |
na karoti hi yo mūḍha ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
sa naro narakaṃ yāti rauravaṃ tamasāvṛtam ||
tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ muniśreṣṭha yo bhuṅkte dvijapuṅgavaḥ |
[995] pratigrāsaṃ sa bhuṅkte ca malaṃ kuṣṭhīsamudbhavam || iti |
niṣkṛtir brahmahaproktā dharmaśāstre maṇīṣibhiḥ |
ekādaśyannakāmasya niṣkṛtiḥ kvāpi noditā ||
madyapānān muniśreṣṭha pāpī ca narakaṃ vrajet |
ekādaśyannakāmas tu pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati ||
nāradīye |
so ‘śnāti pārthivaṃ pāpaṃ yo ‘śnāti madhubhir dine |
tathā |
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca |
annam āśritya tiṣṭhanti saṃprāpte harivāsare ||
tānipāpāni vāpnoti bhuñjāno harivāsare ||
skandapurāṇe |
mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva bhrātṛhā guruhā tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ tu bhuñjāno viṣṇulokāc cyuto bhavet ||
svīkṛtavrataparityāge ca pāpaṃ kṛtam | viṣṇupurāṇe |
samādāya vidhānena dvādaśīvratam uttamam |
tasya bhaṅgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā rauravaṃ (?) narakaṃ vrajet ||
tathā dvādaśīvratam ādāya vratabhaṅgaṃ karoti yaḥ |
dvādaśābdavrataṃ cīrṇam aphalaṃ tasya jāyate ||
parigṛhya vrataṃ samyag ekādaśyādikaṃ yadi |
na samāpayate tasya gatiḥ pāpā garīyasī ||
[996] nāradīye |
ekādaśyāṃ vinā raṇḍā yatiś ca sumahāmate |
pacyate hy andhatāmiśre yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
vidhavā yā bhaven nārī bhūñjītaikādaśīdine |
tasyās tu sukṛtaṃ naśyed brahmahatyā dine dine ||
viṣṇurahasye |
dvādaśī na pramoktavyā yāvadāyuḥ suvṛttibhiḥ |
agnipurāṇe |
upoṣyaikādaśī rājan yāvadāyuḥ suvṛttibhiḥ |
viṣṇurahasyaskandapurāṇayoḥ |
param āpadam āpanno harṣe vā smupasthite |
sūtake mṛtake vāpi na tyājyaṃ dvādaśīvratam ||
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta nārī dṛṣṭe rajasy api |
pulastyo ‘pi |
saṃpravṛtte ‘pi rajasi na tyājyaṃ dvādaśīvratam |
sūtakādāv upavāsamātraṃ kāryaṃ na punar arcanādi |
viṣṇurahasyaskandapurāṇe |
sūtake ‘pi naraḥ snātvā praṇamya manasā harim |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta vratam evaṃ na lupyate ||
sūtake ‘pi na bhuñjīta ekādaśyāṃ sadā naraḥ |
[997] dvādaśyāṃ tu samaśnīyān no vā viṣṇuṃ praṇamya ca ||
kecit tu putravato gṛhiṇaḥ kṛṣṇaikādaśyām upavāse nādhikāra ity āhuḥ | yad āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ saṃkrāntyāṃ grahaṇe cāpi vā pumān |
upvāsaṃ na kurvīta sarvabandhudhanakṣayāt ||
saṃkrāntyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe ca raviśuktadine tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ na kurvīta upavāsaṃ ca pāraṇam ||
gautamaḥ |
āditye ‘hani saṃkrāntāv asitaikādaśīṣu ca |
vyatīpāte kṛte śrāddhe putrī nopavased gṛhī ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
ekādaśīṣu kṛṣṇāsu ravisaṃkramaṇe tathā |
candrasūryoparāge ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī ||
upavāsam iti śeṣaḥ | naitat sādhīyaḥ, kṛṣṇaikādaśyādinimittakāmyopavāsapratiṣedhaparatvād eṣāṃ vacanānām | tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
tannimittopavāsasya niṣedho ‘yam upāhṛtaḥ |
prayuktāntarayuktasya na vidhir na niṣedhanam ||
smṛtimīmāṃsāyāṃ jaiminiḥ |
tannimittopavāsasya niṣedho ‘yam upāhṛtaḥ |
[998] nānuṣaṅgakṛto grāhyo yato nityam upoṣaṇam ||
ayam arthaḥ | tannimittasya bhānudinadinādinimittasyopavāsasyāyam udāhṛto niṣedhaḥ | na tu bhānuvārādyanuṣaktaikādaśyupavāsaviṣayaḥ | yata ekādaśyām upoṣaṇaṃ nityam avaśyakartavyaṃ | tathā vihitam, na ca tasya niṣedhaḥ kalpyate vikalpāpatteḥ | na ca saṃkrāntyādīnām ekādaśīviśeṣaṇatvam | candrasūryagrahaṇasāhacaryāt, asamānavibhaktinirdeśāt, tathā padaprayogāc ca, saṃkrāntyādiyuktāyām apy ekādaśyupavāsavidhānāc ca | tathā sanatkumāraprokte |
bhānuvāreṇa yā yuktā tathā saṃkrāntisaṃyutā |
ekādaśī sadopoṣyā sarvasaṃpatkarī tithiḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
saṃkrāntī ravivāro ekādaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
upoṣyā sā mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā hi sā ||
tathā |
vyatīpāto vaidhṛtir vā ekādaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
upoṣyā sā tu vijñeyā putrasaṃpadvivardhanī ||
śrāddhadineṣu viśeṣam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
upavāso yadā nityaṃ śrāddhaṃ naimittikaṃ bhavet |
upavāsaṃ tadā kuryād āghrāya pitṛsevitam ||
asty eva gṛhiṇaḥ putavatī rukmāṅgadādeḥ [999] kṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaśravaṇam | kiṃ ca svīkṛta ubhayaikādaśīvratopavāsaḥ putrajanmani kṛṣṇaikādaśīparityāgaprasaṅgaḥ | tathā ca, samādāya vidhānena dvādaśīvratam ityādivacanavirodhāt | aparaṃ tu,
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
vanasthayatidharmo ‘yaṃ śuklām evaṃ sadā gṛhī ||
gautamavacanabalād gṛhiṇaḥ śuklāyām evopavāsaḥ tadvrataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahad iti vacanavirodhaḥ syāt | aparathā vaiṣṇavo vātha śaivo vā kuryād ekādaśīvratam iti matsyapurāṇavacanavirodhaḥ syāt | ataḥ sarveṣāṃ ubhayaikādaśyupavāse ‘dhikāra iti yuktam | tathā ca skandakūrmapurāṇayoḥ |
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā na viśeṣo ‘sti kaścana ||
sanatkumāraprokte |
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā yathā kṛṣṇā tathetarā |
nāndīpurāṇe |
tasmāt śraddhāṃ puraskṛtya kṛṣṇe śukle harer dine |
pūjayej jagatāṃ bīja (?) sopavāso janārdanam ||
sadyaugair yat padaṃ sāṃkhyaiḥ prāpyate vā navā dvija |
anāyāsena yat prāpyaṃ padaṃ haridinānugaiḥ ||
[1000] tasya devasya nediṣṭhaṃ mūrtidvayam idaṃ smṛtam |
pāvako brahmaṇaś ceti tac ca jñeyānubhāvataḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā viśeṣo nāsti kaścana |
sauradharmeṣu |
ekādaśī sadopoṣyā śuklā kṛṣṇā tathaiva ca |
matsyapurāṇe |
yathā supūjito gauraḥ kṛṣṇo vā vedavid dvijaḥ |
santārayati dātāram ekādaśyau tathā smṛte ||
taile śukletarāṇāṃ vai tilānāṃ sadṛśaṃ yathā |
kṛṣṇāyāś ca sitāyāś ca gor gavyaṃ sadṛśaṃ yathā ||
dvādaśyāḥ sadṛśaṃ tadvat puṇyaṃ syāc chuklakṛṣṇayoḥ |
darśaś ca pūrṇamāsī ca puṇyatas tu yathā same ||
tathā tathā site puṇye dvādaśyau munibhiḥ smṛte |
yathottaradakṣiṇaṃ ca ayane ca prakīrtitam ||
tulyaṃ puṇyam avāpnoti dvādaśyos tu tathobhayoḥ |
padmapurāṇe |
somasūryagrahau puṇyau tathaiva munibhiḥ smṛtau |
tathā tathā site puṇye dvādaśyāṃ dharmataḥ same ||
yathā viṣṇuḥ śivaś caiva saṃpūjyau munibhiḥ smṛtau |
tathā pūjyatame prokte dvādaśyau śuklakṛṣṇake ||
iti śukakṛṣṇaviveke pāpasmaraṇāt | tathā ca kūrmapurāṇe viṣṇudharmottare ca |
subrahmahā surāpaḥ syāt kṛtaghno gurutalpagaḥ |
[1001] skandapurāṇe |
subrahmahā sagoghnaś ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ |
kālikāpurāṇe |
sarveṣām iha pāpānām āśrayaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ | iti |
teṣām uttarārthaṃ vivecayati |
yaś ca mohād ekādaśyau śuklakṛṣṇe sitāsite |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
evaṃ jñātvā sadopoṣyā dvādaśī śuklakṛṣṇajā |
tayor bhedaṃ na kurvīta tadbhedān narakaṃ vrajet ||
gāruḍapurāṇe |
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
athaikādaśīvratākaraṇena nindā sanatkumārapokte |
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā viśeṣo nāsti kaścana |
viśeṣaṃ kurute yas tu pitṛhā sa tu kīrtitaḥ ||
sanatkumāraprokte |
ekādaśyor dvayor yas tu viśeṣaṃ kurute naraḥ |
tasyoddhāraṃ na paśyāmi yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
athaikādaśīvratākaraṇanindā sanatkumāraprokte |
na karoti hi yo mūḍha ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
sa naro narakaṃ yāti rauravaṃ tamasāvṛtam ||
tathā tathā muniśreṣṭha yo bhuṅkte dvijajanmavān ||
tathā |
pratigrāsaṃ sa bhuṅkte tu kilbiṣaṃ śvādiviṭsamam |
niṣkṛtir madyapasyoktā dharmaśāstre manīṣibhiḥ ||
[1002] ekādaśyannakāmasya niṣkṛtiḥ kvāpi noditā |
madyapānāṃ muniśreṣṭha pātaiva narakaṃ vrajet ||
ekādaśyannakāmas tu pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati |
nāndīyapurāṇe |
so ‘śnāti pārthivaṃ pāpaṃ yo ‘śnāti madhubhir dine |
tathā |
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca |
annam āśritya tiṣṭhanti saṃprāpte harivāsare ||
tāni pāpāny avāpnoti bhuñjāno harivāsaram |
dine ca sarvapāpāni bhavanty atra sthitāni tu ||
tāni mohena yo ‘śnāti na sa pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
tasmād avaśyaṃ kartavyā dvādaśī somakātmajā |
sa kevalaṃ malaṃ bhuṅkte yo bhuṅkte harivāsare ||
skandapurāṇe |
mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva bhrātṛhā guruhā tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ tu bhuñjāno viṣṇulokāc cyuto bhavet ||
nāradīyapurāṇe raṇḍā yatīnām ekādaśīvratasyākaraṇe pratyavāyaviśeṣārdham āha |
ekādaśīṃ vinā raṇḍā yatiś ca sumahāmate |
pacyate hy andhatāmiśre yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
kātyāyanaś ca |
vidhavā yā bhaven nārī bhuñjītaikādaśīdine |
tasyās tu sukṛtaṃ naśyed bhrūṇahatyā dine dine ||
strīkṛtavrataparityāge pāpam uktam |
[1003] viṣṇurahasye |
samādāya vidhānena dvādaśīvratam uttamam |
tasya bhaṅgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
tathā |
dvādaśīvratam ādāya vratabhaṅgaṃ karoti yaḥ |
dvādaśābdaṃ vrataṃ cīrṇam aphalaṃ tasya jāyate ||
tathā |
parigṛhya vrataṃ samyag ekādaśyādikam yadi |
na samāpayate tasya gatiḥ pāpā garīyasī ||
athāsmin dine adhikāriṇam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
aṣṭavarṣādhiko martyo hy apūrṇāśītivatsaraḥ |
ekādaśyām upavaset pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
nāndīyapurāṇe |
aṣṭavarṣādhiko martyo aśītir na hi pūryate |
yo bhuṅkte māmake rāṣṭre viṣṇor ahani pāpakṛt ||
sa me vadhyaś ca daṇḍyaś ca vivāsyo deśataḥ sa me |
kātyāyanaḥ |
etasmād kāraṇād vipra ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
kuryān naro vā nārī vā pakṣayor ubhayor api |
atrānukalpe sarva evādhikārī jñātavyaḥ | yathāha brahmavaivarte |
ekādaśīṃ vinā vipra na saṃsārād vimokṣaṇam |
tatrāpy ayaṃ viśeṣo ‘sti karyaśaktimatāṃ ca saḥ ||
na tu dehaṃ viduḥ prājño pīḍayāno mahāgrahāt |
śarīraṃ pīḍyate yena suśubhenāpi karmaṇā ||
[1004] atyantaṃ tan na kurvīta anāyāsaḥ sa ucyate |
dharmasādhanam ādyaṃ yaḥ śarīraṃ bahupuṇyakṛt ||
yathā kathaṃcin maurkhyān na pīḍayed eva helayā |
gūḍhagrāheṇātmano yaḥ pīḍayā kurute tapaḥ ||
na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim |
adhikāriṇo ‘sāmarthye pratinidhim āha vārāhapurāṇe |
asāmarthye śarīrasya vrate tu samupasthite |
kārayed dharmapatnīṃ vā putraṃ vā vinayānvitam ||
bhaginīṃ bhrātaraṃ vāpi vratam asya na lupyate |
śṛṇu yo vānyam uddiśya ekādaśyām upoṣati ||
yam uddiśya kṛto vipras tasya pūrṇaphalaṃ bhavet |
kartā daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoty asya na saṃśayaḥ ||
athopavāsavratānuṣṭhānakramaḥ | tatropavāsasya sāmānyena svrūpam | yathāha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
upāvṛttasya pāpebhyo yas tu vāso guṇaiḥ saha |
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ||
pāpebhyo upāvṛttasya varjyebhyo nivṛttasya, guṇair viṣṇunāmakīrtanādibhiḥ | [1005] etad upavāsavrataṃ dvividhaṃ nityaṃ phalārthaṃ ca | nitye tu yathā kathaṃcid ekādaśyāṃ bhojanadvayaparihārarūpeṇopavāsavratena pratyavāyaparihāraḥ | tathā ca brahmavaivarte |
iti vijñāya kurvītāvaśyam ekādaśīvratam |
viśeṣaniyamāśakto ‘horātraṃ bhuktivarjitaḥ ||
nigṛhītendriyaḥ śraddhāsahāyo viṣṇutatparaḥ |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
atha nityopavāsī cet sāyaṃprātar bhujikriyām |
saptajanmeti māṃ devi saṃprāpte harivāsare ||
atha phalārtham upavāsavratasvarūpaṃ tatraivāha |
śaktimāṃs tu punaḥ kuryān niyamaṃ saviśeṣaṇam |
sāyam ādyantayor aghnoḥ prātaḥsāyaṃ ca madhyame |
upavāsaphalaṃ prepsur jahyād bhaktacatuṣṭayam ||
iti nityakāmyayor upavāsavratayor anyataram ārambhamāṇaḥ prathamadaśamyāṃ bhojanānantaraṃ dantadhāvanaṃ kuryāt | tad āha |
daśamyāṃ dantakāṣṭhena jihvāṃ leḍhi yathā yathā |
dvādaśīniyamārthāya nirāśaḥ syodyamas tathā ||
nirmārjayati tat pāpaṃ taṭasthaṃ dīnamānasaḥ |
abhuktakarmā yad yāti pātakī vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ||
[1006] tato daśamyāṃ rātrau niyamagrahaṇāya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | brahmavaivarte |
prāpte haridine samyag vidhāya niyamaṃ niśi |
daśamyām upavāsasya prakuryād vaiṣṇavaṃ vratam ||
saṃkalpamantrahetudaivatāny āha |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvāham apare ‘hani |
bhokṣyāmi puṇdarīkākṣa tāraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta ||
iti saṃkalpyaṃ vidhāya ekādaśīdine devasya puṣpamaṇḍapaṃ viracayet |
yathāha brahmapurāṇe |
devasyopari kurvīta śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ |
nānāpuṣpair muniśreṣṭhā vicitraṃ puṣpamaṇḍapam ||
kṛtvā cāvaraṇaṃ paścāj jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi |
evaṃ maṇḍapaṃ vidhāya rātrau devaṃ pūjayet ||
tathā bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ekādaśyupavāsena rātrau saṃpūjayed dharim |
tāṃ ca rātriṃ yathāśakti purāṇaśravaṇādinā |
nītveti śeṣaḥ | brahmavaivarte |
tasmāc chraddhāṃ puraskṛtya śuklāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca dvādaśīm |
saṃprāpya pūjayed devaṃ sopavāso janārdanam ||
[1007] brahmapurāṇe |

yogeśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo māsanāmāny anukramāt ||

ante vratānte |

tasmin kāle pradātavyās te ghaṭā māsanāmabhiḥ |

sūryāyeti śeṣaḥ |

mahārauravapūrnebhyo narakebhyo ‘tha tārayet ||

brahmahastyādipāpānām aśvamedhair bhavet kṣayaḥ ||

aśvamedhād gayāśrāddhād vratam etad viśiṣyate ||

narakasthāś ca ye kecid garbhavāse raṇe ca ye ||

necchanti santatiṃ ye ca mucyante ca kilbiṣaiḥ ||

atha kṛṣṇadvādaśīvratam |

[1014] mahāpuṇyapradaṃ pārtha mahāpātakanāśanam ||

ity uktvātha gurūn natvā pūjayitvā janārdanam ||
bhūmau svapej jitakrodhaḥ śabdādiviṣayojjhitaḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale keśavārpitamānasaḥ ||
keśaveti tadā vākyaṃ kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu |
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpaṃ darśanasparśanādinā ||
tyajed dinatrayaṃ pārtha vratavaikalyakārakam |
tato madhyāhūsamaye nadyādau vimale jale ||
snānaṃ kuryāj jitakrodhaḥ pañcagavyapuraḥsaram |
snānaṃ kṛtvaikacittas tu prapūtātmā dayānvitaḥ ||
ādityāya namaskṛtya keśavaṃ kāraṇaṃ vrajet |
uttīrya paridhāyīta chukre ‘chidre ca vāsasī ||
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ datvā toyāñjalīṃs tataḥ |
svarṇācāravidhinā kṛtakṛtyo gṛhaṃ vrajet ||
[1015] pūjayet tatra govindaṃ keśaveti japan budhaḥ |
puṣpadhūpais tathā dīpair naivedyair vividhair api ||
gītavādyaiḥ kathābhiś ca jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi |
kumbham saṃsthāpayitvā tu ratnagarbhaṃ sakāñcanam ||
chāditaṃ vastrayugmena śitacandanacarcitam |
gandhamālyasamāyuktaṃ dīpair dikṣu svalaṃkṛtam ||
kumbhasyaikāṅgadeśe tu śitacandanacarcitām |
pratimāṃ devadevasya śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtam ||
kṛtvābhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ prabhāte vimale sati |
dvādaśyāṃ kṛtakṛtyas tu samabhyarcya jagadgurum ||
viprāya dadyāt kalaśaṃ dakṣiṇopaskarānvitam |
saṃbhojya vipramukhyāya dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām ||
bhṛtyān saṃbhojayitvā tu datvā goṣu gavāhnikam |
pañcagavyaṃ tu saṃprāśya svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
anena vidhinā māsi tasmin kṛṣṇām upoṣayet |
dvādaśīṃ puruṣavyāghra dyāyan saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vibhum ||
prāgvat sarvaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
bhojayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ dadyāt tebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām ||
bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścāt pañcagavyahutāśanam |
evaṃ pauṣetu saṃkalpya dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ ||
nārāyaṇaṃ japan prājñaḥ sarvaṃ prāgvidhim ācaret |
snānaprāśanadānāni bhojanaṃ tadvad ācaret ||
brāhmanebhyas tathā dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ yadunandana |
[1016] nārāyaṇaḥ prīyatāṃ me ity ācāryaṃ kṣamāpayet ||
asyaiva puṣyamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣataḥ |
vāsudeveti saṃpūjya prāguktavidhinā nṛpa ||
devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |
tato dadyād dvijātibhyo dakṣiṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
bhojanaṃ pūrvavat kuryād dānaṃ pūjādikaṃ tataḥ |
śuklāyāṃ māghamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ tu viśāṃpate ||
mādhaveti japan nāma pūjayet pūrvavad dharim |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tadvat puṣpadhūpadīpakaiḥ ||
pūjayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhān mādhavaḥ prīyatām iti |
prāśanādikam evātra pūrvoktavidhinā smṛtam ||
asyaiva māghamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣataḥ |
pradyumneti japan prājñaḥ sarvaṃ prāgvidhim ācaret ||
snānaprāśanadānāni bhojanaṃ tadvad eva hi |
brāhmaṇebhyas tathā dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ pāṇḍunandana ||
phālgunāmalapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
govindeti japan viṣṇoḥ pūjayet pratimāṃ naraḥ ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād govindaḥ prīyatām iti |
japapūjanadānāni pūrveṇa vidhinācaret ||
phālgunasya tathā kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ |
aniruddheti kṛṣṇasya japan pūrvavad ācaret ||
tenaiva vidhinā pārtha sarvapāpāpahāraṇam |
puṣpadhūpanaivedyaiś ca gandhadīpādiśobhayā ||
[1017] naivedyādyupacārais tu pūrvaṃ dānaṃ samācaret |
aniruddhaḥ prīyatāṃ me dānakāle hy udīrayet ||
caitrasyāmalapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ pāṇḍunandana |
pañcagavyajalaiḥ snātvā viṣṇunāmānukīrtayet ||
upasthānaṃ tu kurvīta bhāskarasya vicakṣaṇaḥ |
ya eva bhāskaro devaḥ sa vai viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
viṣṇur bhavatu suprīto devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
bhuktimuktipradānāya tava datto mayāñjaliḥ ||
ity uccāryāñjaliṃ kṣiptvā gandhapuṣpākṣatair yutam |
pūrvavad devam abhyarcya dānaṃ dadyāc ca śaktitaḥ ||
viṣṇur me prīyatāṃ devo jagadyoniḥ sanātanaḥ |
asmin māsi tathā kṛṣṇāṃ dvādaśīṃ vidhinā kṣipet ||
snānabhojanakāle tu japan vai puruṣottamam |
tenaiva vidhinā pārtha snānadānaṃ samācaret ||
vaiśākhasyāmale pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ vidhivan naraḥ |
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūjayen madhusūdanam ||
pūrvavat puṣpadhūpādyair gandhadīpaṃ nivedayet |
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt prīyatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ||
ity uccārya mahābāho sarvaṃ niṣpādayed idam |
māse ‘smin kṛṣṇapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ bharatarṣabha ||
kṛtvā prāgvidhinā sarvaṃ japan devam adhokṣajam |
pūjayan pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ sugandhaiḥ puṣpacandanaiḥ ||
tato dadyād dvijātibhyo dakṣiṇāṃ vittasārataḥ |
[1018] jyaiṣṭhamāsāmale pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ pūrvavan nṛpa ||
snānādi sarvaṃ nirvartya pūjayec ca trivikramam |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaiḥ prabhāte vimale sati ||
prājyakṣīrājyasaṃbhojyair bhojayitvā dvijottamān |
jyaiṣṭhamāsāmale pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ pūrvavan nṛpa ||
snānādi sarvaṃ nirvartya pūjayec ca trivikramam |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaiḥ prabhāte vimale sati ||
pājyakṣīrājyasaṃbhojyair bhojayitvā dvijottamān |
tebhyaś ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt prīyatāṃ me trivikramaḥ ||
ity uccārya naravyāghra svayaṃ bhuñjīta pūrvavat |
jyaiṣṭhasyaiva hi kṛṣṇāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ tu viśāṃpate ||
snātvā prāgvidhinā bhaktyā nṛsiṃhaṃ pūjayed vibhum |
puṣpair dhūpais tathā dīpair gandhair naivedyakarair api ||
vāmanaḥ prīyatāṃ devo mama nityaṃ sanātanaḥ |
bhojanaṃ prāgvidhānena kartavyaṃ vratinā tadā ||
āṣāḍhasyaiva kṛṣṇāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
pūjayed acyutaṃ devaṃ tenaiva vidhinā nṛpa ||
nirvartya pūrvavat sarvaṃ prabhāte nimale ravau |
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād acyutaḥ prīyatām iti ||
śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ |
snātvā pūrvavidhānena śrīdhareti japan budhaḥ ||
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
tato viprāya dātavyā dakṣiṇā śaktyapekṣayā ||
[1019] viśeṣān navanītaṃ tu tadā deyaṃ dvijātaye |
śrīdharaḥ prīyatām etya śriyaṃ puṣṇātv anuttamām (?) ||
ity uccārya kuruśreṣṭha tato viprān visarjayet |
tato bhuñjīta pūrvoktavidhinā susamāhitaḥ ||
śrāvaṇasyaiva deveśaṃ tūrśvoktavidhinā (?) tataḥ |
janārdaneti saṃpūjya pratimāṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
tato vipreṣu dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ sahadakṣiṇam |
janārdanaḥ prīyatāṃ me vākyam etad udīrayet ||
svayaṃ bhṛtyais tataḥ sārdhaṃ bhuñjīyāt pūrvavan nṛpa |
māsi bhādrapade bhadra dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ ||
pūrvavat kalpayet sarvaṃ devam abhyarcayet tataḥ |
hṛṣīkeśeti saṃkalpya kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayec chaktyā tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām |
viśeṣeṇārcayed devaṃ kṣīraṃ vipreṣu pāṇḍava ||
kṛṣīkeśaḥ prīyatāṃ me vākyam etad udīrayet |
kṣamāpaṇaṃ tataḥ pārtha bhuñjīyāt pūrvavad gṛhī ||
kṛṣṇāpy evaṃ hi kartavyā māsi bhādrapade nṛpa |
upendreti ca saṃpūjya pratimāṃ śārṅgadhanvinaḥ ||
pūrvavad dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād viprāṇāṃ bhaktitatparaḥ |
prītaye devadevasya mamaiva pāṇḍunandana ||
aśvayucchuklapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
snātvā pūrvavidhānena kṛtvā devāya tarpaṇam ||
[1020] padmanābheti nāmnā vai pūjayet pratimāṃ hareḥ |
pūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kṛtvā jāraṇādikam ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛtasnānādiko gṛhī |
viprān saṃbhojayitvā ca tebhyo hema svaśaktitaḥ ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
prīyatāṃ padmanābhāya iti vācam udīyaret ||
aśvayukśuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīṃ bhaktimān naraḥ |
upoṣya vidhinā tena harir ity api pūjayet ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāśaktyā nṛpottama |
harir me prīyatāṃ devo mantram etam udīrayet ||
kārttikasya tu māsasya dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ |
ādyena vidhinā sarvaṃ snānādi vinivartya ca ||
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ pāṣaṇḍālāpavarjitaḥ |
gṛham abhyetya medhāvī vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
kuryāc chobhādikaṃ sarvaṃ puṣpadhūpanivedanam |
vaṃśapātre ca kartavyā sarvakarmasu bhārata ||
dāsīdarāyeti saṃpūjya nāma devasya cakriṇaḥ |
viśeṣād utsavaṃ kṛtvā gītavādyādibhir nṛpa ||
kṛṣṇāpy evaṃ tu nirvartya dvādaśī kārttike tadā |
kṛṣṇeti nāma saṃpūjya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
pranuttasya vidhiḥ pārtha viśeṣān na vidhīyate |
asmin vrate keśavādyā caturviṃśanmūrtayaḥ pūjanīyāḥ |
atra deyāni nāmāni ṣoḍaśaiva vidhīyate ||
[1021] golakṣaṃ gosahasraṃ vā gośataṃ dvādaśaiva gāḥ |
tulāpuruṣadānāni mukhyāni vidhivat tadā ||
deyāni vipramukhyānāṃ vratānte samupasthite |
sūryāparāge yadā tu kurukṣetre kurūttama ||
hemavāsasaṃ datvā tatphalaṃ taddine bhavet |
vibhāsaṃ nādhikaṃ pārtha na gayā nava puṣkaram ||
vārāṇasi na vā tadvat prayāgam atha vāpi ca |
tīrthāṇi ca tataḥ pūrvaṃ paścimāni janeśvara ||
sarvāṇy eva nṛpaśreṣṭha udīcidigbhavāni ca |
na samāni mahābāho vratānte kārttikasya ca ||
ubhayadvādaśīyogāc chraddadhāno narottama |
vittaśāṭhyāṃ na kurvīta kṛṣṇaikagatamānasaḥ ||
sarvadayādisaṃyuktaḥ purāṇārthaikaniṣṭhitaḥ |
kulāny uddhṛtya saptaiva viṣṇoḥ sāyujyatāṃ vrajet ||
etad uddeśataḥ proktam ubhayadvādaśīphalam |
śraddadhānasya yat puṇyaṃ partha tat kena varṇyate ||
etat puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca vratānām uttamaṃ param |
nāśiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ na cāśuśrūṣave kvacit ||
nāvaiṣṇavāya rājendra anyathā narakaṃ vrajat |
mumukṣūṇām idaṃ brahmaṇ bubhukṣūṇām iyaṃ gatiḥ ||
idaṃ hi yaḥ pārtha naro mahātmā
śṛṇoti yo bhaktiparaḥ smared vā |
vimuktapāpaḥ sa vihāya duḥkhaṃ
prayāti sāṃnidhyam anantamūrteḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam ubhayadvādaśīvratam |
[1022] atha matsyadvādaśīvratam |
satyapā uvāca |
ko ‘sau dharaṇyāṃ saṃcīrṇa upavāso mahāmune |
kāni vratāni ca tathā etan me vaktum arhasi ||
durvāsā uvāca |
mārgasya śuklapakṣe tu daśamyāṃ niyatātmavān |
snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā agnikāryaṃ yathāvidhi ||
śucivāsāḥ prasannātmā havyaṃ cānnaṃ susaṃskṛtam |
bhuktvā pañcapadaṃ gatvā punaḥ śaucaṃ tu pādayoḥ ||
kṛtvāṣṭāṅgulam ānantu kṣīratṛkṣasamudbhavam |
bhakṣayed dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu tata ācamya yatnataḥ ||
spṛṣṭvā khāni tathādbhiś ca ciraṃ dhyātvā janārdanam |
khānīndriyāṇi |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītavastraṃ kirīṭinam |
prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ||
dhyātvā jalaṃ gṛhītvā tu bhānurūpaṃ janārdanam |
dṛṣṭvārghyaṃ dāpayet paścāt karatoyena mānavaḥ ||
evam uccārayed vācaṃ tasmin kāle mahāmune |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro bhūtvāham apare ‘hani ||
bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta |
[1023] evam uktvā tato rātrau devadevasya saṃnidhau ||
japan nārāyaṇayeti svayaṃ bhūmau vidhānataḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale nadīṃ gatvā samudragām ||
itarāṃ vā taḍāgaṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān |
ānīya mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ mantreṇānena mānavaḥ ||
dhāraṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tvatto bhūtānāṃ devi sarvadā |
tena satyena māṃ divye pāpān mocaya mṛttike ||
mṛttikāmantraḥ |
brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te raveḥ |
bhavanti pūtāni yato mṛttikām ālabhet tataḥ ||
ādityasya mṛttikādarśanamantraḥ |
tvayi sarve sthitān nityaṃ sthitā varuṇa sarvadā |
te na māṃ mṛttikāṃ prāpya māṃ pūtaṃ kuru māciram ||
mṛttikābhyukṣaṇamantraḥ |
evaṃ mṛdaṃ raviṃ toyaṃ prāsādyātmānam ālabhet |
triḥkṛtvāśeṣamṛdayā kuṇḍam ālikhya vai jale ||
tataḥ snātvā naraḥ samyak mantravac copacārataḥ |
ācamyāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā punar devagṛhaṃ vrajet ||
tatrārādhya mahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum |
keśavāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca ||
ūruyugmaṃ nṛsiṃhāya uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe |
[1024] kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya vakṣaḥ śrīpataye tathā ||
trailokyavijayāyeti bāhū sarvātmane śiraḥ |
rathāṅgadhāriṇe vaktraṃ śaṅkarāyeti vārijam ||
vārijaṃ śaṅkham |
gambhīrāyeti ca kaṭyāṃ tu kajaśāntatrimūrtaye |
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||
punas tasyāgrataḥ kumbhāṃs caturaḥ sthāpayed budhaḥ |
jalapūrṇān samālyāṃś ca sitacandanalepitān ||
caturbhis tilapātraiś ca sthagitān ratnagarbhiṇaḥ |
catvāras te samudrās tu kalaśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
teṣāṃ madhye śubhaṃ pīṭhaṃ sthāpayed vastrasaṃyutam |
tasmiṃś ca raupyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tāmraṃ vā dāravaṃ tathā ||
alābhatas toyapūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ tato nyaset |
alābhataḥ sauvarṇādīnām alābhe dāravam api kuryād ity arthaḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ matsyarūpeṇa kṛtvā devaṃ janārdanam |
vedavedāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ śrutismṛtivibhūṣaṇam ||
toyapūrṇaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā tatra matsyarūpaṃ janārdanaṃ nyased ity anvayaḥ |
tatrānekavidhair bhakṣyaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiś ca śobhitam |
gandhair mannaiś (?) ca dhūpaiś ca arcayitvā yathāvidhi ||
rasātalagatā vedā yathā deva tvayāhṛtāḥ |
matsyarūpeṇa tadvan māṃ bhavād uddhara keśava ||
[1025] evam uccārya tasyāgre jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
yathāvibhavasāreṇa prabhāte vimale tathā ||
caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca caturo dāpayed ghaṭān |
pūrvaṃ ca bahvṛce dadyāc chandoge dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||
yajuḥ śākhānvite dadyāt paścimaṃ ghaṭam uttamam |
uttare ‘tharvaṇe dadyād eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ṛgvedaḥ prīyatāṃ pūrve sāmavedas tu dakṣiṇe |
paścime tu yajurvedo ‘tharvavedas tathottare ||
tāmrapātrais tu satilaiḥ sthagitān kārayed ghaṭān |
tatas tu jalapātraṃ vai brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
dadyād eva mahābhāga tataḥ paścāt tu bhojayet |
brāhmaṇān pāyasenāgryān tataḥ paścāt svayaṃ naraḥ ||
bhuñjīta sahito bhṛtyair vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
yaḥ sakṛd dvādaśīm etāṃ karoti vidhivan mune ||
sa brahmalokam āpnoti tatkālaṃ caiva tiṣṭhati |
dvādaśī dotradharaṇī vrateṣv ekādaśīparaḥ ||
tatkālaṃ brahmakālam |
tato brahmopasaṃhāre tallayas tiṣṭhate ‘ciram |
punaḥ sṛṣṭau bhaved devo vairājo nāmanāmataḥ ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni iha loke kṛtāny api |
akāmataḥ kāmato vā tāni naśyanti tatkṣaṇāt ||
iha loke daridro vā rājyaṃ bhraṣṭo bhaven nṛpaḥ |
upoṣya tu vidhānena meśvaro rājyabhāg bhavet ||
[1026] meśvaraḥ lakṣmīśvaraḥ |
vandhyā nārī bhaved yā tu anena vidhinā śubhā |
upoṣyati bhavet tasyāḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ||
agamyāgamanaṃ yena jānatājānatā kṛtam |
sa imaṃ vidhim āsthāya tasmāt pāpād vimucyate ||
brahmakriyāyā lopena bahuvarṣakṛtena ca |
upoṣyemāṃ sakṛd bhaktyā vedasaṃskāram āpnuyāt ||
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena na tad asti mahāmune |
prāpyaṃ vā prāpyate naiva pāpavān yan na paśyati ||
adīkṣitāya no deyaṃ vidhānaṃ nāstikāya ca |
devavedadviṣe vāpi na śrāvyaṃ tu kadācana ||
gurubhaktāya dātavyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
iha janmani vārogyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varastriyaḥ |
bhavanti vividhā yas tu upoṣyati vidhānataḥ ||
iti dharaṇīvratamatsyadvādaśīvratam |
atha kūrmadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
puṣyamāsasya yā puṇyā dvādaśī śuklapakṣataḥ |
tasyāṃ prāg iva saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
nirvartyārādhayed rātrāv ekādaśyāṃ janārdanam |
pṛthaṅ mantrair dvijaśreṣṭha devadevaṃ janārdanam ||
[1027] kūrmāya pādau prathamaṃ tu pūjya
nārāyaṇāyeti kaṭiṃ hares tu |
saṅkarṣaṇāyety udaraṃ hares tu
uroviśokāya bhavāya kaṇṭham ||
suvāhavety eva bhujau śiraś ca
namo viśālāya rathāṅgaśaṅkhau |
svanāmamantraiś ca sudhūpagandhair
nānānivedyair vividhaiḥ phalaiś ca ||
abhyarcya devaṃ kalaśaṃ tadagre
saṃsthāpya mālyāstṛtadāmakaṇṭham |
taṃ ratnagarbhaṃ tu pureva kṛtvā
svaśaktito hemamayaṃ ca devam ||
samandaraṃ kūrvarūpeṇa kṛtvā
saṃsthāpayet tāmrapātre ghṛtasya |
pūrṇe ghaṭe paryatha saṃniveṣyā-
tho brāhmaṇāyaiva sarvaṃ tu dadyāt ||
ghṛtasya pūrṇe tāmrapātre samandaraṃ kūrmarūpaṃ nidhāya ghaṭopari niveśya prabhāte dadyād ity arthaḥ |
śvo brāhmaṇān bhojya sadakṣiṇāṃś ca
yathāśaktyā prīṇayed devadevam |
nārāyaṇaṃ kūrmapurāṇe paścāt
svayaṃ bhuñjīta sabhṛtyavargaḥ ||
evaṃkṛte vai trividhaṃ hi papaṃ
vinaśyate nātra vicāraṇāsti |
saṃsāracakraṃ tu vhiāya śuddhaṃ
prāpnoti lokaṃ tu hareḥ purāṇam ||
anekajanmāntarasaṃcitāni
naśyanti pāpāni narasya bhaktyā |
prāguktarūpaṃ tu phalaṃ labheta
nārāyaṇas tuṣṭim upaiti sadyaḥ ||
iti dharṇīvrate kūrmadvādaśīvratam |
atha vārāhadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
evaṃ māghe site pakṣe dvādaśīdaraṇībhṛtaḥ |
vārāhasya śṛṇuṣvānyāṃ puṇyāṃ paramadhārmikaḥ ||
[1028] prāguktena vidhānena saṃkalpasnānam eva ca |
kṛtvā devaṃ samabhyarcya ekādaśyāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
puṣpair naivedyagandhaiś ca hy arcayitvācyutaṃ naraḥ |
paścāt tasyāgrataḥ kumbhaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu vinyaset ||
varāhāyeti pādau tu mādhavāyeti vai kaṭim |
kṣetrajñāyeti jaṭharaṃ viśvarūpaṃ purohitaḥ ||
sarvajñāyeti vaikaṇṭhaṃ prajānāṃ pataye śiraḥ |
pradyumnāyeti ca bhujau divyāstrāya sudarśanam ||
amṛtodbhavāya śaṅkhaṃ ca eṣa evārcane vidhiḥ |
evam abhyarcy medhāvī tasmin kumbhe tu vinyaset ||
sauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vā vārāhaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddhṛtāṃ pṛthvīṃ saparvatavanadrumām ||
mādhavaṃ madhuhantāraṃ vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthitam |
sarvabījabhṛte pātre ratnagarbhaghaṛopari ||
sthāpayet paramaṃ devaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ harim |
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ tatrābhāve tu vaiṇave ||
sthāpyārcya gandhapuṣpaiś ca naivedyair vividhaiḥ phalaiḥ |
puṣpamaṇḍayikāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet ||
prādurbhāvān hares tatra vācayed gāyayed budhaḥ |
evaṃ saṃstūyamānasya prabhāte hy udite ravau ||
śuciḥ snāto hariṃ pūjya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
vedavedāṅgaviduṣe sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate ||
viṣṇubhaktāya vipratṣe viśeṣeṇa tu dāpayet |
[1029] evaṃ vidhānato datvā hariṃ vārāharūpiṇam ||
brāhmaṇāya ca tad dadyāt phalaṃ tasya niśāmaya |
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ śrīḥ kāntis tuṣṭir eva ca ||
jñānavān vittavān bhogī aputraḥ putravān bhavet |
bhogī aputraḥ putravān bhavet |
iti dharaṇīvrate vārāhadvādaśīvratam
atha nṛsiṃhadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
tadvat tu phālgune māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe tu dvādaśī |
upoṣyā proktavidhinā harim āvāhayed budhaḥ ||
narasiṃhāya pādau tu govindāyodaraṃ tathā |
kaṭiṃ viśvabhuje tadvad aniruddhety uras tathā ||
kaṇṭhaṃ tu śitikaṇṭhāya piṅgakeśāya vai śiraḥ |
asuradhvasanāyeti cakravoḍhrātmane tathā ||
śaṅkham ity eva saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpaphalais tathā |
tadagre sthāpya tu ghaṭaṃ sitavastrayugānvitam ||
tatropari nṛsiṃhaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrabhājane |
sauvarṇaṃ śaktitaḥ kṛtvā dāruvaṃśamayo ‘pi vā ||
nṛsiṃharūpaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottare ‘bhihitam |
pīnaskandhakaṭigrīvaḥ kṛśamadhyaḥ kṛśodaraḥ |
siṃhāsano nṛdehaś ca nīlavāsā prabhānvitaḥ ||
[1030] ālīḍasthānasaṃsthānaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ |
jyālāmālākulamukhojvālākesaramaṇḍalaḥ ||
hiraṇyakaśipor vakṣaḥ pāṭayannakharaiḥ kharaiḥ |
nīlotpalābhaḥ kartavyo devatānugatas tathā ||
hiraṇyakaśipur daityaḥ saṃvṛto ‘yam iti dhruvam | iti |
ratnagarbhaghaṭe sthāpya taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānataḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ kṛte phalaṃ prāptaṃ yat purā pārthivena ca ||
vatsanāmnā tu tat te ‘haṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāmune |
tasya vratānte bhagavān narasiṃhas tutoṣa ca ||
cakraṃ prādāt tu śatrūṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakaraṃ mṛdhaḥ | iti |
tenāstreṇa svakaṃ rājyaṃ jitavān sa nṛpottamaḥ ||
rājye sthitvāśvamedhānāṃ sahasram akarot prabhuḥ |
ante ca brahmalokākhyaṃ padam āgāc ca sattama ||
eṣā dhanyā pāpaharā dvādaśī bhavato mune |
kathitemāṃ prayatnena śrutvā kuru yathecchasi ||
iti dharaṇīvrata nṛsiṃhadvādaśīvratam |
atha vāmanadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
evam eva mune māsi caitre saṃkalpya dvādaśī |
upoṣya dārayad bhaktyā devadevaṃ janārdanam ||
[1031] vāmanāyeti pādau tu viṣṇave kaṭim arcayet |
vāsudeveti jaṭharam uraḥ saṅkarṣaṇāya ca ||
kaṇṭhaṃ viśvabhṛte pūjya śiro vai vyomarūpiṇe |
bāhū viśvajite pūjya svanāmnā śaṅkhacakrake ||
anena vidhinābhyarcya devadevaṃ janārdanam |
prāgvaṃśenodaraṃ kumbhaṃ sayugmaṃ purato nyaset ||
yugmaṃ vastrayugmam |
prāguktapātre saṃsthāpya vāmanaṃ kāñcanaṃ budhaḥ |
yathāśaktikṛtaṃ hrasvaṃ sitayajñopavītinam ||
kuṇḍikāṃ sthāpayet pārśve chatrikāpāduke tathā |
akṣamālāṃ ca saṃsthāpya yaṣṭikāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
etair upaskarair yuktaṃ prabhāte brāhmaṇāya tu |
dāpayet prīyatāṃ viṣṇuḥ hrasvarūpīti kīrtayet ||
māsanāmnā tu saṃyuktaṃ prādurbhāvābhidhānakam |
prīyatām iti sarvatra vidhir eṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
māsanāmnā mārgaśīrṣādimāsakeśavādināmnā prādurbhāvābhidhānakaṃ matsyarūpī kūrmarūpīty evamādi |
śrūyate ca purā rājā haryaśvaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
aputraḥ sa tapas tepe putram icchaṃs tapodhanam ||
tasyaivaṃ kurvatas tv iṣṭaṃ putrārthaṃ munisattama |
ājagāma harir devo dvijarūpasamanvitaḥ ||
sa uvāca nṛpaṃ rājan kiṃ te vyavasitaṃ tv iti |
putrārtham iti covāca na ca taṃ pratyuvāca ha ||
[1032] idam eva vidhānaṃ tu kuru rājan prayatnataḥ |
sa vipra evam uktvā ca kṣaṇād antarhitas tataḥ ||
rājā ca tac cakārātha mantravit tu dvijātaye |
daridrāya tathā prādāj jyotirgarbhāya dhīmate ||
yathā diter aputrāyāḥ vayaṃ putratvam āgataḥ |
bhagavaṃs tena saftvena mamāpy astu suto varaḥ ||
idam eva vidhānaṃ vāmanavad dvādaśīvratam | vidhimantravit yathā diter aputrāyā ityādimantrajñaḥ | taṃ vāmanam |
anena vidhinoktena tasya putro ‘bhavan mune |
ugrāśva iti vikhyātaś cakravartī mahābalaḥ ||
aputro labhate putrān dhanahīno labhed dhanam |
bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ||
iti dharaṇīvrate vāmanadvādaśīvratam |
atha jāmadagnyavratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
vaiśākhasyevam evaṃ tu saṃkalpavidhinā naraḥ |
tadvat snānaṃ mṛdā kṛtvā tato devālayaṃ vrajet ||
tatrārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā ebhir mantrair vicakṣaṇaḥ |
jāmadagnyāya pādau tu udaraṃ sarvadhāriṇe ||
[1033] madhusūdanāyeti kaṭiṃ uraḥ śrīvatsadāriṇe |
kṣatrāntakāyaṃ bāhū ca maṇikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhakam ||
svanāmnā śaṅkhacakre tu śiro brahmāṇḍadhāriṇe |
evam abhyarcya medhāvī prāgvat tasyāgrato ghaṭam ||
vinyaset sthagitaṃ vastrayugena ca viśeṣataḥ |
vaiṇavena ca pātreṇa tasmin saṃsthāpayed dharim ||
jāmadagnyena rūpeṇa kṛtvā sauvarṇam agrataḥ |
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ haste tasya devasya kārayet ||
sarvagandhaiś ca saṃpūjya puṣpair nānāvidhais tathā |
tatas tasyāgrataḥ kuryāj jāgaraṃ śaktimān naraḥ ||
prīyatāṃ madhusūdano jāmagnyarūpīti mantraḥ |
prabhāte vimale sūryaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yat phalaṃ tan nibodha me ||
āsīd rājā mahābhāgo vīraseno mahābalaḥ |
aputraḥ sa purā tīvraṃ tapas tepe mahābalaḥ ||
caratas tat tapo ghoraṃ yājñavalkyo mahāmuniḥ |
ājagāma mahāyogī taṃ draṣṭuṃ vā niyogataḥ ||
rājovāca |
kathaṃ me bhavitā putraḥ svalpāyāsena vai dvija |
etan me kathaya prītyā bhagavān praṇatasya me ||
evam ukto munis tena pārthivena yaśasvinā |
ācakhyau dvādaśīṃ cemāṃ vaiśākhe sitapakṣajām ||
[1034] sa hi rājā vidhānena putrakāmo viśeṣataḥ |
upoṣya lakṣmavān putraṃ nalaṃ paramadhārmikam ||
yo ‘dyāpi kīrtyate loke puṇyaśloko nṛpottamaḥ |
prāsaṅgikaṃ phalaṃ hy etaf vratasyāsya mahāmune ||
suputro jāyate vittavidyāvān kīrtimāṃs tathā |
iha janmani kiṃ citraṃ paraloke śṛṇuṣva me ||
kalpam ekaṃ brahmalokam uṣitvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
krīḍate ‘taḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭau jāyate cakravartinaḥ ||
triṃśatkalpasahasrāṇi jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti dharaṇīvrate jāmadagnyadvādaśīvratam |
atha rāghavadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
jyaiṣṭhamāseṣv evam evaṃ saṃkalpya vidhinā naraiḥ |
arcayet paramaṃ devaṃ puṣpair nānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
oṃ namo rāghavāyeti pādau pūrvaṃ samarcayet |
triviktamāyeti kaṭiṃ dhṛtavastrāya vai haram ||
uraḥ saṃvatsarāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ saṃvartakāya ca |
sarvāstradhāriṇe bāhū svanāmnābjarathāṅgake ||
sahastraśirase ‘bhyarcya śiras tasya mahātmanaḥ |
abjarathāṅgake śaṃkhacakrake |
[1035] evam abhyarcya vidhivad ghṛtakumbhaṃ prakalpayet |
prāgvad vastrayugacchanno sauvarṇau rāmalakṣaṇau ||
anayoḥ svarūpaṃ viṣṇudharmottarāt |
rāmo dāśarathir maulī rājalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ |
maulī mukuṭavān |
bharato lakṣamanaś caiva śatrughnaś ca dhanurdharaḥ |
tathaiva nūnaṃ kartavyāḥ kiṃ tu maulivivarjitā || iti |
arcayitvā vidhānena prabhāte brāhmaṇāya tau |
dātavyau manasā kāmam īhatā puruṣeṇa tu ||
aputreṇa purā pṛṣṭo rājñā daśarathena tu |
vasiṣṭhaḥ putrakāmāya provāca paramārthataḥ ||
idam eva vidhānaṃ tu kathayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ |
prāgrahasyaṃ viditvā tu sa rājā kṛtavān idam ||
tasya putraḥ svayaṃ jajñe rāmākhyo madhusūdanaḥ |
caturaṃśo ‘py abhūd viṣṇuḥ paritoṣān mahāmune ||
etad eva hi cākhyātaṃ pāratrikam ataḥ śṛṇu ||
divyān bhogān bhuñjate svargasaṃstho yāvad indrā daśa ca dvidvisaṃkhyāḥ atītakāle punar etya martyaṃ rājajāgo jāyate yajñayājī |
daśa dvidvisaṃkhyāḥ caturdaśety arthaḥ |
naśyanti pāpāni ca tasya puṃsaḥ
kāmān avāpnoti yathāsamīhān |
niṣkāma etad vratam eva cīrtvā
prāpnoti nirvāṇaphalaṃ sthitaṃ tat ||
etad vratam eva nirvāṇasādhanāntaram anuṣṭhāyāpīty arthaḥ |
iti dharaṇīvrate rāghavadvādaśīvratam |
[1036]
atha vāsudevadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
āṣāḍhe ‘py evam evaṃ tu saṃkalpya vidhinā tataḥ |
arcayet paramaṃ devaṃ gandhapuṣpair vidhānataḥ ||
vāsudevāya pādo tu kaṭiṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca |
pradyumnāyeti jaṭharam aniruddhāya vai uraḥ ||
cakrapāṇayeti bhujau kaṇṭhaṃ bhūpataye tathā |
svanāmnā śaṅkhacakre tu puruṣāyeti vai śiraḥ ||
evam abhyarcya medhāvī prāgvat tasyāgrato ghaṭam |
vinyased vastrayugmaṃ tu tasyopari tato nyaset ||
kāñcanaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu caturbāhuṃ sanātanam |
tam abhyarcya vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ||
prāgvat tu brāhmaṇe dadyād devavādini suvrate |
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yat puṇyaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva me ||
vasudevo bhaved rājā yaduvaṃśavivardhanaḥ |
devakī tasya bhāryāsīt samānavratacāriṇī ||
sātvaputrā bhavet sādhvī patidharmaparāyaṇā |
tasyāḥ kālena mahatā nārado ‘bhyāgamad gṛham ||
vasudevena tadbhaktyā pūjito vākyam abravīt |
kathayāmāsa dharmajño devakīvasudevayoḥ ||
tāv apy evaṃ vidhiṃ bhaktyā cakratuḥ śraddhayānvitau |
[1037] tayos tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ putratvaṃ ca jagāma ha ||
evam eṣā pāpaharā dvādaśī putradā smṛtā |
imām upoṣyeha sutān vidyāvittaṃ labheta ca ||
rājyaṃ ca bhraṣṭarājyas tu pāpinaḥ pāpasaṃkṣayam |
yayā bhāvopanītas tu dharaṇyāṃ keśavena vai ||
mṛto viṣṇupure ramye modate kālasaṃkṣayam |
manvantarāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśat tataḥ kālātyaye punaḥ ||
iha loke bhaved rājā saptavarṣāyutāni tu |
dātā yajvā kṣamāyuktas tato nirvāṇam āpnuyāt ||
iti dharaṇīvrate vāsudevadvādaśīvratam |
atha vṛddhadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
evam eva śrāvaṇe tu māsi saṃkalpya dvādaśīm |
arcayet paramaṃ devaṃ gandhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ ||
buddhāya pādau saṃpūjya śraudharāyeti vai kaṭim |
padmodbhavāya jaṭharam uraḥ saṃvatsarāya vai ||
sugrīvāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ tu bhujau dvau viśvavāhanaḥ |
prāgvac chastrāṇi saṃpūjya śiro vai paramātmane ||
evam abhyarcya medhāvī tasyāgre pūrvavad ghaṭam |
[1038] sthāpayet tatra sauvarṇaṃ buddhaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
buddhasvarūpam uktaṃ purāṇāntare |
buddhas tu dvibhujaḥ kāryo dhyānastimitalocahaḥ || iti |
tam apy evaṃ tu saṃpūjya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
anena vidhinā pūrvaṃ dvādaśī samupoṣītā ||
śuddhodanena buddho ‘bhūt svayaṃ putro janārdanaḥ |
mahatīṃ ca śriyaṃ prāptaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
bhuktvā rājyaśriyaṃ so ‘tha paramikāṃ gataḥ ||
iti dharṇīvrate buddhadvādaśīvratam |
atha kalkidvādaśī vratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
tadvad bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm |
saṃkalpya vidhinā devam arcayet parameśvaram ||
namo ‘stu kalkine pādī hṛṣīkeśāya vai kaṭim |
mlecchadhvaṃsanāyorū jaganmūrtis tathodaram ||
śrīkaṇṭhāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ tu khaḍgamāṇīti vai bhujau ||
svanāmnā śaṅkhacakre tu viśvamūrtes tathā śiraḥ |
evam abhyarcya medhāvī prāgvat tasyāgrato ghaṭam ||
vinyasya kalkinaṃ devaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tatra dārayet |
kalkisvarūpam purāṇāntarāt |
[1039] kṛpāṇapāṇiḥ kartavyaḥ kalkī turagavāhanaḥ || iti |
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ gandhapuṣpopaśobhitam |
kṛtvā prabhāte viprāya pradeyaṃ śāstravittame ||
pūrvaṃ rājā viśālo ‘bhūt kāśīpuryāṃ mahābalaḥ |
dvādaśīṃ kṛtavān so ‘pit cakravartī babhūva ha ||
yajñaiś ca vividhair iṣṭvā paraṃ nirvāṇam āptavān |
pūjyate matsyarūpeṇa sarvajñatvam abhīpsubhiḥ ||
svavaṃśoddharaṇārthāya kūrmarūpī tu pūjyate |
bhavodadhinimagnena varāhaḥ pūjyate naraiḥ ||
vāmano mohanārthāya vittārthe jamadagnijaḥ |
krūraśatruvināśāya yajed dāśarathiṃ budhaḥ ||
balakṛṣṇo yajed dhīmān putrakāmo na saṃśayaḥ |
rūpakāmo yajed buddhaṃ kalkinaṃ śatrughātane ||
iti dharaṇīvrate kalkidvādaśīvratam |
atha padmanābhadvādaśīvratam |
durvāsā uvāca |
tadvad āśvayuje māsi dvādaśī śuklapakṣiṇīm |
[1040] saṃkalpyābhyarcayed devaṃ padmanābhaṃ sanātanam ||
udaraṃ sarvadevāya puṣkarākṣāya vai uraḥ |
avyāgrāya tathā bāhū prāgvad asrāṇi pūjayet ||
prabhavāya śiraḥ pūjya prāgvad agre ghaṭaṃ nyaset |
tasmin hemamayaṃ devaṃ padmanābhaṃ tu vinyaset ||
padmanābhas tu dakṣiṇādhohastād ārabhya svayena śaṅkhapadmagadādhārī kāryaḥ |
taṃ devadevaṃ saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
āsīt kṛtayuge rājā bhadrāśvaṃ nāva vīryavān |
yasya nāmnā bhaved varṣaṃ bhadrāśvaṃ nāmanāmataḥ ||
tasyāgastyaḥ kadācit tu gṛham āgamad bhūpate |
uvāca pañcarātraṃ tu vasāmi bhavato gṛhe ||
taṃ rājā śirasā natvā sthīyatām ity abhāṣata |
tasya kāntimatī nāmnā bhāryā paramaśobhanā ||
tām agastyas tathā dṛṣṭvā rūpatejo’nvitāṃ śubhām |
sapatnyaś ca bhayāt sarvāḥ kurvantyaḥ kurma śobhanam |
sādhu pārtha jagannātha strī śūdraḥ sādhusādhviti ||
evam uktvā nanartoccair agastyo rājasaṃnidhau |
rājovāca |
kiṃ harṣakāraṇaṃ brahman yenaivaṃ nṛtyate bhavān |
[1041] agastya uvāca |
iyaṃ rājñī tavadīyābhūd dāsī vaiśyasya vaidiśe |
nagare haridattasya tvam asyāḥ patir eva ca ||
tasyaiva karmakāro ‘bhūt śūdro vidhyeti nāmataḥ |
sa vaiśyo ‘śvayuje māsi dvādaśyaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
svayaṃ viṣṇvālayaṃ gatvā gandhapuṣpādibhir harim |
abhyarcya svagṛhe prāyād bhavantau rakṣa pālakau ||
sthāpya dvāv api dīpānāṃ jvālanārthaṃ mahāmate |
gate tasmin bhavane taddīpaprajvālane sthitau ||
yāvat prabhātā rajanī niḥśāṭhyena narottama |
tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛtau dvāv api dampatī ||
tena puṇyena te janma priyavratagṛhe ‘bhavat |
iyaṃ ca patnī te jātā vaiśyadāsy abhavat purā ||
svenayaḥ punar arthena viṣṇum ābhyarcya dīpakam |
jvālayet tasya yat puṇyaṃ tat saṃkhyātuṃ na śakyate ||
iti śrīdharaṇīvrate padmanābhadvādaśīvratam |
atha yogeśvaravratam | atha dharaṇīvratam |
agastya uvāca |
śṛṇuṣva bhaktito rājan kārttikekādaśīṃ (?) tathā |
[1042] upoṣya vidhinā yena sarvāsāṃ prāpnuyāt phalam ||
prāgvidhānena saṃkalpya tadvat snānaṃ samarcayet |
vilomenārcayed devaṃ nārāyaṇam akalmaṣam ||
namaḥ sahasraśirase śiraḥ saṃpūjya vai hareḥ |
puruṣāyeti ca bhujau kaṇṭhe vai viśvarūpiṇe ||
jñānātmaneti cāstrāṇi śrīvatsāya tathā uraḥ |
jagadvasiṣṇave pūjya udaraṃ viśvamūrtaye ||
kaṭiṃ sahasrāpādāya pādau devasya pūjayet |
anulomena deveśaṃ pūjayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
namo dāmodarāyeti sarvāṅgaṃ pūjayed dharim |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tasyāgre caturo ghaṭān ||
sthāpayed ratnagharbhāṃs tu sitacandanacarcitān |
sragdāmabaddhagrīvāṃs tu sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitān ||
sthagitān tāmrapātrais tu tilapūrṇaiḥ sakāñcanaiḥ |
catvāraḥ sāgarāś caite kalpitā dvijasattama ||
tanmadhye prāgvidhānena sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayed dharim |
yogeśvaraṃ yoganidrāśāyinaṃ pītavāsasam ||
tam apy evaṃ tu saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
kuryāt tu vaiṣṇavaṃ yāgaṃ japed yogeśvaraṃ harim ||
ṣoḍaśāre rathāṅge tu rajobhir bahubhiḥ kṛte |
ṣoḍaśāre rathāṅge ṣoḍaśāracakre |
evaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tu brāhmaṇān pañca vānayet ||
catvāraḥ kalaśā devāś caturṇāṃ pañcamasya tu |
[1043] sauvarṇaṃ pradadyāt prayataḥ śuciḥ
vedādhyetre samaṃ dattaṃ tadvide dviguṇaṃ tathā ||
ācārye pañcarātrāṇāṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet |
yas tv imaṃ sarahasyaṃ tu samantraṃ copapādayet ||
vidhānaṃ tasya bhaktyā vai dattaṃ koṭiguṇottaram |
yogye tiṣṭhati yas tv anyam āsannaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ ||
durgatiṃ samavāpnoti dattaṃ tasya ca niśphalam |
evaṃ datvā vidhānena tattvato viṣṇum arcya ca ||
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dadyād yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
dharaṇīvratam etad dhi purā kṛtvā prajāpatiḥ ||
prajāṃ lebhe tathā muktiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vimalaṃ śubham |
yuvanāśvaś ca rājarṣir anena vidhinā purā ||
māndhātāraṃ lebhe paraṃ brahma ca śāśvatam |
tathā haihayadāyādaḥ kṛtavīryo narādhipaḥ ||
kārtavīryaṃ sutaṃ lebhe paraṃ brahma ca śāśvatam |
śakuntalāpy evam eva vrataṃ cīrtvā mahāmune ||
lebhe śākuntalaṃ putraṃ dauśmantaṃ cakravartinam |
anena vidhinā prāptaṃ cakravartitvam uttamam ||
dharaṇyā api pātāle padmayā tu kṛtaṃ purā |
vratam etat tato nāmnā dharaṇīvratam ucyate ||
supte ‘smiṃs tu dharā devī hariṇā krīḍarūpinā |
[1044] uddhṛtādyāpi tuṣṭena dhāritā naur ivāmbhasi ||
dharaṇīvratam etad dhi kīrtitaṃ tan mayā mune |
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā yaś ca kuryān narottamaḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusālokyatāṃ vrajet |
ekaikayāpi vāpatsu rājyam ekaiva yacchati |
kiṃ punar dvādaśaitās tu yatredaṃ na daduḥ param ||
iti yogeśvaradvādaśī | iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ dharaṇīvratam |
atha bhīmadvādaśīvratam |
pulstya uvāca |
kṛṣṇaḥ kadācid āsīnaḥ svapur yāmam atidyutiḥ |
pravṛttāsu purāṇīṣu dharmasaṃbandhinīṣu ca ||
kathāsu bhīmasenena paripṛṣṭaḥ pratāpavān |
dhārmikasyāpy aśaktasya tīvrāgnitvād upoṣaṇe ||
kiṃcid vratam aśeṣāṇāṃ vratānām adhikaṃ mama |
nirūpayatu viśvātmā vāsudevo jagadguruḥ ||
aśeṣayajñaphaladam aśeṣāghavināśanam |
aśeṣaduṣṭadamanam aśeṣasurapūjitam ||
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam |
vāsudeva uvāca |
yady aṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśīṣv atha bhārata |
[1045] anyeṣv api dinarkṣeṣu na śaktas tvam upoṣitum ||
tataḥ puṇyām imāṃ bhaimīṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm |
upoṣya vidhinānena gaccha viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||
māghamāsasya daśamī yadā śuklā bhavet tadā |
ghṛtenābhyañjanaṃ kṛtvā tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
tathaiva viṣṇum abhyarcya namo nārāyaṇeti ca |
kṛṣṇāya pādau saṃpūjya śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ ||
vaikuṇṭhāyeti vai kaṇṭham uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe |
śaṅkhine cakriṇe tadvad gadine varadāya vai ||
sarve nārāyaṇasyaivaṃ saṃpūjyā bāhavaḥ kramāt |
dāmodarāyety udaraṃ meḍhraṃ pañcaśarāya vai ||
ūrū saubhāgyanāthāy jānunī bhūtadhāriṇe |
namo nīlāya vai jaṅghe pādau viśvasṛje namaḥ ||
namo devyai namaḥ śāntyai namo lakṣmyai namaḥ śriye |
namaḥ puṣṭyai namas tuṣṭyai namas tuṣṭyau tathā priye ||
namo vihaṅganāthāya vāyuvegāya pakṣmaṇe |
viṣaprabhāviṇe nityaṃ garuḍaṃ cābhipūjayet ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindam umāpativināyakau |
gandhamālyais tathā dhūpair bhakṣyair nānāvidhais tathā ||
gavyena payasā siddhāṃ kṛśarāṃ tv atha vāgyataḥ |
sarpiṣā saha bhuñjāno gatvā śatapadaṃ budhaḥ ||
[1048] caturbhir bahvṛcair homas tataḥ kārya udaṅmukhaiḥ |
rudrajāpaś caturbhiś ca yajurvedaparāyaṇaiḥ ||
vaiṣṇavāni ca sāmāni catvāraḥ sāmavedinaḥ |
ariṣṭavargasahitāny abhitaḥ paripāṭhayet ||
ariṣṭavargaḥ tapamūṣuvājitam ity asyāmṛnmutpannasāmadvayam |
evaṃ dvādaśaviprāṃs tān vastramālyānulepanaiḥ |
pūjayed aṅgulīyaiś ca kaṭakair hemasūtrakaiḥ ||
vāsobhiḥ śamanīyaiś ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
pañcakṣapātivāhyā vai gītamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ ||
upādhyāyasya ca punar dviguṇaṃ sarvam eva tu |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale samutthāya trayodaśa ||
gāś ca dadyāt kuruśreṣṭha sauvarṇamukhasaṃyutāḥ |
payasvinīḥ śīlavatīḥ kāṃsyadohasamanvitāḥ ||
raupyakhurāḥ. savastrāś ca candanenābhiṣevitāḥ |
tās tu teṣāṃ tato datvā bhakṣyabhojyānnapiṇḍitān ||
kṛtvā vai brāhmaṇān sarvān ratnair nānāvidhair yutān |
bhuktvā vākṣāralavaṇam ātmanā ca visarjayet ||
anugamya padāny aṣṭau putrabhāryāsamanvitaḥ |
prīyatām atra deveśaḥ keśavaḥ kleśanāśanaḥ ||
śivasya hṛdayaṃ viṣṇuḥ viṣṇorś ca hṛdayaṃ śivaḥ |
yathottaraṃ na paśyāmi tathā me svasti vāyudhaḥ ||
evam uccārya tān kumbhān gāthaivaṃ śāṃyanāni ca |
[1049] vāsāṃsi caiva sarveṣāṃ gṛhāṇi prāpayed budhaḥ ||
abhāve bahuśayyāyām ekām api susaṃskṛtām |
śayyāṃ dadyād gṛhī bhīma sarvopaskarasaṃyutām ||
itihāsapurāṇāni vācayitvātivāhayet |
tad dinaṃ naraśārdūla ya icchad vipulāṃ śriyam ||
tasmāt tvaṃ sattvam ālambya bhīmaseno vimatsaraḥ |
kuru vratam idaṃ samyak snehād guhyaṃ mayoditam ||
tvayā kṛtam idaṃ vīra tvannāmakaṃ bhaviṣyati |
sā bhaimī dvādaśī hy eṣā sarvapāpaharā śubhā ||
yā tu kalyāṇinī nāma purā kalpeṣu paṭhyate ||
snātaḥ purā maṇḍalam eṣa tadvat
tejomayaṃ vedaśarīram āpa |
asyāṃ ca kalyāṇatithau vivasvān
sahasradhāreṇa sahasraraśmiḥ ||
idam iha hi kṛtaṃ mahendramukhair
vasubhir athāsuradevakoṭibhiś ca |
phalam iha hi na śakyate ‘nuvaktum
yadi jihvāyutakoṭayo mukheṣu ||
kalikaluṣavidāriṇīm atas tām
iti kathayiṣyati yāvadendra te |
api narakagatān pitṝn aśeṣān
alam uddhartum ihaiva yaḥ karoti ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇe bhīmadvādaśīvratam |
atha bhīmadvādaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
vidarbhādipatiḥ śrīmān āsīt pūjyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ |
[1050] damayantyā pitā puṛvaṃ nalasya śvaśuro bhuvi ||
satyavadanaśīlaś ca prajāpālanatatparaḥ |
kṣātradharmarataḥ śrīmān saṃgrāmeṣv aparājitaḥ ||
tasyāpi kuvato rājyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
ājagāma mahābhāgaḥ pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ||
sarvajñānavidhiḥ śrīmāṃs tīrthayātrāprasaṅgataḥ |
tam āyatam ato dṛṣṭvā brahmayonim akalmaṣam ||
utthāya pradadau rājā svam āsanam abhīpsitam |
arghaiḥ pādyaiś ca kiṃcit tat tasmai pradadet svayam ||
rājyaṃ caivātmanā sārdhaṃ nivedya sa kṛtāñjaliḥ |
tena caivābhyanujñāto nisasāda ca āsanam ||
papraccha kuśalaṃ praśnaṃ tapasy adhyayane tathā |
tatheti coktaḥ sa munis taṃ rājānam abhāṣata ||
pulastya uvāca |
kathitaṃ kusalaṃ rājan kośe janapade pure |
dharme ca te matir nityaṃ tasmāt pārthiva vartyate ||
bhīma uvāca |
sarvatra kuśalaṃ brahman yeṣāṃ kuśalam icchati |
tavāgamanato nāhaṃ pracitaḥ saṅgacāriṇaḥ ||
etaṃ no sarvadā kṛtvā saṃbhāṣye ‘pi parasparam |
rasāntaiḥ pūrvavṛttāntaiḥ kathābhir itaretaram ||
tataḥ kathānte rājendra pulastyo yāti vismayam |
papraccha sarvalokasya hitāya jagataḥ patiḥ ||
[1051] bhagavan prāṇinaḥ sarve saṃsārārṇavamadhyagāḥ |
dṛśyante vividhair duḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānāṃ divāniśam ||
narake garbhavāse ca vyādhibhir janapā tathā |
tathāceṣṭaviyogādiduḥkhair daurgatyasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
balāpacayam āpannān paripīḍopajīvinaḥ |
evaṃvidhāny anekāni duḥkhāni munipuṅgava ||
daivāny etāni tāny eva bhṛśam me vyathitaṃ manaḥ |
teṣāṃ duḥkhāni bhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhūmim āpadā ||
upakārakaraṃ brūhi mamānugrahakāmyayā |
svalpāyāsena sumahaj jāyate sumahat phalam ||
pulastya uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yām upoṣya na duḥkhānāṃ bhājanaṃ bhajate janaḥ ||
māghamāse site pakṣe dvādaśī pāvanā smṛtā |
tasyāṃ jalārdravasana upoṣya sukhabhāg bhavet ||
bhīma uvāca |
kathaṃ sā muniśārdūla upoṣyā dvādaśī bhavet |
vidhinā kena viprendra tan me brūhi yathākramam ||
pulastya uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan n avahito vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam |
[1052] tava śuśrūṣaṇād vācyaṃ mayāpy etan na saṃśayaḥ ||
adīkṣitāya no deyā nāśiṣyāya kadācana |
viṣṇubhaktāya śāntāya dharmaniṣṭhāya caiva hi ||
vācyam etan mahārāja bhavatānyasya kasyacit |
brahmahā gurughātī ca somastrīghātakas tathā ||
kṛtaghno mitradhruk cauraḥ kṣudro bhagnavratas tathā |
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair vratenānena bhūpate ||
śuddhe tithau muhūrtte ca maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tatha |
daśahastapramāṇena deśe pūrvottaraplave ||
tanmadhye pañcahastāṃ tu vedikāṃ parikalpayet |
śuklāṃ sakardamāṃ bhūmiṃ vedīṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ ||
vilikhen maṇḍalaṃ tatra pañcavarṇavidhānataḥ |
brāḥmaṇo vedasaṃpanno viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ ||
pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ svācārābhiratas tathā |
kuṇḍāni kalpayet tatra aṣṭau catvāri vā punaḥ ||
brāhmaṇās tena yuñjīta cātuścaraṇikāḥ śubhāḥ |
madhye ca maṇḍalasyātha karṇikāyāṃ janārdanam ||
prāṅmukhaṃ tu nyased devaṃ caturbāhum arindama |
pūjayeta vidhānena śāstroktena vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
gandhapuṣpais tathā dhūpair naivedyair vividhair api |
evam saṃpūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha deśikaḥ ||
[1053] nyaset stambhadvayaṃ paścān nimbakāṣṭhasamanvitam |
devasyābhimukhaṃ tatra pīṭhasyopari kalpayet ||
ṣaḍtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ |
tatra śilāṃ samālambya suvṛttaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam ||
āropayed ghaṭaṃ tatra yādṛśaṃ tu śṛṇuṣva me |
kaladhautaṃ tathā raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vāpy atha mṛṇmayam ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ vyaṅgavarjitam |
taṃ sahasraśataṃ kuryād adhidram atha vāpi vā ||
svakulatvānurūpeṇa pārśvaikachidram eva vā |
saṃnidhāne tataḥ kuryāt salilaṃ vastramātalam |
homārthaṃ kalpayec cāpi palāśāḥ samidhaḥ śubhāḥ ||
tilā ghṛtaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ śamīpatrāṇi caiva hi |
vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge grahapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet ||
tatra pūjyā grahāḥ sarve grahayajñavidhānataḥ |
pūrvasyāṃ diśi śakrasya pūjāṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ ||
dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamasyātha pratīcyāṃ varuṇasya ca |
kuberasya tathodīcyāṃ baliṃ kuryāt phalākṣataiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ śukāmbaradharas tathā |
samalambya śubhair gandhair darbhapāṇir atandritaḥ ||
pīṭham āropayeyus te yajamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
yajamāno ‘pi devasya saṃmukhaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
upaviśya paṭhan mantraṃ purāṇoktam idaṃ śṛṇu |
namas te devadevasya namas te bhuvaneśvara ||
[1054] vratenānena māntrāhi paramātmā namo ‘stu te |
tilodakasya dhārās tāḥ pratisaṃdhyāsamanvitaḥ ||
śirasā dhārayet tūṣṇīṃ tadghṛtenāntarātmanā |
homaṃ kuryus tato viprā dikṣu sarvāsu tatparāḥ ||
paṭheyuḥ śāntikādhyāyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñāni yāni ca |
vāditrais tāḍyamānaiś ca śaṅkhageyasvanais tathā ||
puṇyāhaṃ jayaśabdaiś ca vedadhvanivimiśritaiḥ |
maṅgalaiḥ stutisaṃyuktaiḥ kārayet tu mahotsavam ||
devadevasya caritaṃ keśavasya mahātmanaḥ |
harivaṃśādikaṃ sarvaṃ śrāvayed brāhmaṇo varaḥ ||
sauvarṇikam athākhyānaṃ bhāratākhyānam eva ca |
vyākhyānakuśalaḥ kaścic chrāvayet purataḥ sthitaḥ ||
anena vidhināsādya tāṃ rātrīṃ pratyavardhinīm |
yajamāno nayed dhīmān yāvat sūryodayo bhavet ||
brāhmaṇāś cāpi tāṃ rātriṃ sukṛto jātavedasam |
mantrais tu vaiṣṇavair divyaiḥ kṣapeyur mahīpate ||
vāsudevasya śiraso dhārāṃ tatra prapātayet |
kṣīreṇājyena vā rājan sarvasiddhipradāyinīm ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye yajamāno dvijaiḥ saha |
snānaṃ kuryān nṛpaśreṣṭha nadyāṃ sarasi vā punaḥ ||
atha vā śaktihīnas tu yajamānoṣṇavāriṇā |
tataḥ śuklāni vastrāṇi paridhāya yatavrataḥ ||
[1055] arghyaṃ datvā bhāskarasya savidhānaṃ prasannadhīḥ |
puṣpair dhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayet puruṣottamam ||
hutvā hutāśanaṃ bhaktyā datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ |
dakṣayed brāhmaṇān sarvān hotāro ye ‘tra kalpitāḥ ||
śayyālājaiś ca godānair vastrair ābharaṇais tathā |
ācāryaḥ pūjanīyo ‘tra sarvasvenāpi bhārata ||
yena vā tuṣṭiḥ syād eva devatulyo gurur yataḥ |
vittaśaktivihīnas tu bhaktiśaktisamanvitaḥ ||
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭaebhyo bandinaś ca samāgatāḥ |
teṣām annaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dadyāc chuddhena cetasā ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya viprāya bhojayitvā yathepsitam |
yathāvibhavasāreṇa paścād bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
haviṣyam annaṃ yatnena na haviṣyātilas tathā |
eṣa yajño mahārājan cokto yas te prakīrtitaḥ ||
yat kṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ yājayanti śataṃ samāḥ ||
sarve te viddhi yāgasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
saptajanmani saubhāgyam āyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ ||
prāpnoti dvādaśīm etāṃ yām upoṣya vidhānataḥ |
mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti viṣṇunā saha modate ||
caturyugāni dvātriṃśad viṣṇurūpadharas tathā |
rudraloke tathā rājan yugāni dvādaśaiva tu ||
[1056] brahmaloke tathā trīṇi sūryaloke yuge tathā |
puṇyakṣayād ihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
pṛthivyadhipatiḥ śrīmān vijitāriḥ pratāpavān |
vratam etat purā cīrṇaṃ sagareṇa mahātmanā ||
ajena dhundhumāreṇa dilīpena yayātinā |
anyaiś ca pṛthivīpakṣapālitair iha bhūtale ||
strībhir vaiśyais tathā śūdraiḥ dharmakāmaiḥ sadā nṛpa |
bhṛgvādyair munisaṅghaiś ca brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ ||
tvayā ca pṛṣṭena mayā kathitaṃ tan narādhipa |
adyaprabhṛti caiveti khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale ||
bhīmākhyā dvādaśī ceti kṛtakṛtyā narā yataḥ |
eṣā pulastyamuninā kathitā kurunandana ||
yaś caināṃ kathitāṃ yatnāt kuryād vā bhaktibhāvitaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
daridreṇāpi vā pārtha vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
viṣṇubhaktena kartavyā saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā ||
bhīmena yā kila purā samupoṣitatvād
rātrau galatsthirasuśītalavāridhārā |
tāṃ dvādaśīṃ tridaśavedyamukhāṃ smared yaḥ
samyak samācarati yāti sa viṣṇulokam ||
iti bhaviṣottaroktaṃ somadvādaśīvratam |
[1057]
nandikeśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi viṣṇor vratam uttamam |
vibhūtidvādaśī nāma sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
kārttike vātha vaiśākhe mārgaśīrṣe ‘tha phālgune |
āṣāḍhe vā daśamyāṃ tu śuklāyāṃ laghubhuṅ naraḥ ||
kṛtvā sāyaṃtanīṃ saṃdhyāṃ gṛhṇīyān niyamaṃ budhaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdhanam ||
dvādaśyāṃ dvijasaṃyuktaḥ kariṣye bhojanaṃ tataḥ | |
tad avighnena me yātu sāphalyaṃ madhusūdana ||
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtvā snānajapaṃ śuciḥ |
pūjayet puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śuklamālyanulepanaiḥ ||
vibhūtide namaḥ pādau vikośāyeti jānunī |
namaḥ śivāyeti corū kaṭiṃ vai viśvarūpiṇe ||
kandarpāya namo meḍhram ādityāya namaḥ karau |
dāmodarāyety udaraṃ vāsudevāya ca sthanau ||
mādhavāyety uro viṣṇo kaṇṭham utkaṇṭhine namaḥ |
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ keśān keśavāyetinā radaḥ ||
dhṛtaśārṅgadhārāyeti śravaṇe varadāya vai |
svanāmnā śaṅhacakrāsi gadāvaradapāṇayaḥ ||
śiraḥ sarvātmane brahman nama ity abhipūjayet |
matsyam utphullasaṃyuktaṃ haimaṃ kṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ ||
udakumbhasamāyuktam agrataḥ sthāpayed vibhoḥ |
[1058] guḍapātraṃ tilair yuktaṃ sitavastrābhiveṣṭitam ||
rātrau ca jāgaraṃ kuryād itihāsakathādikam |
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
sakāñcanotpalaṃ devaṃ sodakumbhaṃ nivedayet |
yathā nāmocyate viṣṇo sadā sarvavibhūtibhiḥ ||
tathā mām uddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārakardamāt |
daśāvatārarūpāṇi pratimāsakramān mune ||
dattātreyaṃ tathā vyāsam utpalaena samanvitam |
pratimāsaṃ tu kartavyā mūrtayaḥ kāñcanena vai ||
kāñcanasyaiva padmasya saṃsthāpyopari pūjayet |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyair bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ ||
vastrair ābharaṇaiś caiva yathāvibhavasārataḥ |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītanṛtyādibhir naraiḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛtasnānādikakriyaḥ |
upadeṣṭre tu dātavyaṃ sarvam etat samāhṛtam ||
pratimāsaṃ purāṇajñair vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ |
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte viśeṣaṃ śaktipūrvakam |
śaktipūrvakaṃ vibhūtipuraḥsaram |
kṛtvā saṃpūjya lavaṇaparvatena samanvitam ||
lavaṇaparvatadānavidhis tu dānakhaṇḍe vilokanīyaḥ |
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ gāṃ caivopaṣkarānvitām |
grāmaṃ deśapatir dadyāt kṣetraṃ grāmādipas tathā ||
nivartanaṃ kṣetrapatir bavanaṃ ca samṛddhimat |
[1059] evaṃ vibhavasāreṇa pūjayitvedṛśaṃ gurum ||
anyān api yathāśaktyā tarpayitvā dvijottamān |
vastrānnagohiraṇyādisattvam āsthāya cottamam ||
yatra sattvaṃ tatra haris toṣam āyāty asaṃśayam |
yaś cātiniṣṭhaḥ puruṣo bhaktimān mādhavaṃ prati ||
puṣpārcanavidhānena sa kuryād vatsaradvayam ||
padmapurāṇāt |
śeṣe gās tu pradātavyā madhyame bhūmir uttamā |
kanyā sakāñcanā deyā hīty eṣā dakṣiṇā smṛtā ||
prathamaṃ brahmadaivatyaṃ dvitīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā |
tṛtīyaṃ rudradaivatyaṃ trayo devāḥ triṣu sthitāḥ ||
matsyapurāṇāt |
anena vidhinā yas tu vibhūtidvādaśīvratam |
kuryāt sa pāpanirmukto gurūṇāṃ tārayec chatam ||
saptajanmāny asau martyo vibhūtiṃ prāpnuyāt param |
rogadaurgatyapāpānāṃ bhājanaṃ nopajāyate ||
bhaktiś ca yajñapuruṣe tasya janmani janmani |
prāpnuyād acytaṃ sthānam acyutasya prasādataḥ ||
iyaṃ cākhaṇḍitā kāryā vibhūtidvādaśī naraiḥ |
sarvapāpopaśamanī phalam īdṛkpradāyinī ||
[1060] iti kaluṣavidāraṇaṃ janānāṃ
paṭhati sadā śṛṇoti yaś ca bhaktyā |
matim api ca dadāti devaloke
vasati ciraṃ ca sa pūjyate ‘maro ‘ghaiḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ vibhūtidvādaśīvratam |
vajra uvāca |
dvādaśīṣu kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sopavāsena pūjitaḥ |
rājyapradaḥ syād dharmajña tan me tvaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ ||
brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho ‘py abhikṣukaḥ |
rājñā saṃrakṣitāḥ sarve śaknuvanti niṣevitum ||
mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa rājā devavapurdharaḥ |
kṣatriyo ‘pi satāṃ pūjyo brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ||
vinā rājyaṃ hi yā lakṣmīḥ paratantrā hi sā matā |
tasmād rājyaṃ praśaṃsanti tatrājñānaṃ vihanyate ||
tulyadhātuśarīrāṇāṃ tulyāvayavadhāriṇām |
narendrāṇāṃ narair brahman devavad bhuvi vartate ||
rājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ tasmād vaktum arhati me bhavān |
yām upoṣya mahadrājyaṃ prāptavān sa tu vai dvija ||
markaṇḍeya uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājan dvādaśīṃ rājyadāṃ śivām |
[1061] yām upoṣya naro loke rājyam āpnoty akaṇṭakam ||
mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣe narādhipa |
daśamyāṃ prayataḥ śuddhaḥ snānam abhyaṅgapūrvakam ||
haviṣyabhuk praśāntātmā dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
upavāsasya saṃkalpaṃ śvobhūtasya tu kārayet ||
devāṅgaṇe kuśastīrṇām ekavastrottarachadām |
adhyāsīta mahīṃ tatra tāṃ rātrīṃ saṃyato nayet ||
dvitīye ‘hni tataḥ kuryād adbhiḥ snānam atandritaḥ |
pūjanaṃ caiva sarvasya sarvamuktena kārayet ||
karpūraṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ mallikā śvetayūthikā |
jātyaś ca śuklā rājendra dhūpaṃ kundurum eva ca ||
ghṛtena dīpā dātavyā śuklavartisamanvitāḥ |
ghṛtodanaṃ dadhikṣīre paramānnaṃ tathaiva ca ||
ikṣum ikṣuvikāraṃ vā devadeve nivedayet |
kālodbhavaṃ mūlaphalaṃ parṇaṃ tatra na cintayet ||
yathālābhena tad deyaṃ śuklaṃ vā syād viśeṣataḥ |
havanaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ paramānnena pārthiva ||
tad viṣṇoḥ (?) param ity evaṃ homamantro ‘bhidhīyate |
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ strīśūdreṣu vidhīyate ||
tato ‘gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā saṃpūjya ca dvijān |
[1062] sitaraṅgeṇa kartavyā bhūmiśobhā surālaye ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca pārthiva |
karmaṇā devadevasya kartavyaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ||
dvādaśyāṃ vidhinainena punaḥ pūjyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
rājyaliṅgaṃ pradātavyam ekaṃ viprāya dakṣiṇā ||
tataś ca paścād bhoktavyaṃ haviṣyaṃ pārthivottama |
ekādaśī yathā madhye snānayor vartate nṛpa ||
tathā bhoktavyam ity śeṣaḥ | dvivacanabalād ekabhaktasnānam anukṛṣyate | ayam arthaḥ | ekādaśyām anāgatāyāṃ yo me viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ tam abhuktam atītāyāṃ pāraṇam, snānagrahaṇaṃ dūrato varjanārtham |
kārtsnyaṃ maunaṃ ca kartavyaṃ japyaṃ kāryaṃ tu mānasam |
