dvādaśīṣv atha śuklāsu sarvāsv eva viśeṣataḥ ||
vidhistavāyaṃ (?) nirdiṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāṣv evaṃ ca kārayet |
viśeṣaṃ tāsu vakṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||
raktavastreṇa kartavyā devapūjā yathāvidhi |
raktaṃ ca deyaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpagandhānulepanam ||
tilatailena dīpāś ca mahārajatarañjitāḥ |
dīeṣu varttayo deyā homaḥ karyas tathā tilaiḥ ||
bhūmiśobhā ca kartavyā raktair bhūpāla varṇakaiḥ |
anena vidhinā pūjya rājan saṃvatsaraṃ prabhum ||
kārttikyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet |
vratāvasāne tasyāṃ tu mahāvarttiṃ pradāpayet ||
[1063] vāsasā ca samagreṇa tulayā ca ghṛtasya ca |
brāhmaṇāya ca dātavyā dhenuḥ kāṃsyopadohanā ||
hemaśṛṅgaiḥ khurair raupyair mukālāṅgūlabhūṣitāḥ |
vastrottarīyā dātavyā śaktyā draviṇasaṃyutā ||
saṃvatsareṇa rāja syān naraḥ parvatagahvare |
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ puṇyair jāyate maṇḍaleśvaraḥ ||
tathā dvādaśabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ |
rājyapradā te ‘bhihitā mayaiṣā
syād dvādaśī pāpaharā vasiṣṭhā |
upoghya yāṃ bhūmitale narendro
bhavaty ajyeyas tu raṇe ‘risaṃghaiḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rājyadvādaśīvratam |
ambarīṣa uvāca |
kathaṃ sunāmabhir devo dvādaśyāṃ munisattama |
pūjyate keśavā martye muktimāmaphalārthibhiḥ ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūpa sunāmadvādaśī śubhā |
sarvapāpaharā svargyā bhuktimuktipradāyikā ||
manasā ca cikīrṣanti dvādaśī ye narottamāḥ |
te ‘pi ghoraṃ na paśyanti punaḥ saṃsārasāgaram ||
[1064] ādyaṃ sarvavratānāṃ tu vaiṣṇavānāṃ nṛpottama |
narais tribhiś ca kartavyaṃ viṣṇos tuṣṭikaraṃ param ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śuklapakṣe yatavrataḥ |
prathamaṃ caiva gṛhṇīyād dvādaśī vidhivan naraḥ ||
manovākkāyaceṣṭābhiḥ suviśuddho jitendriyaḥ |
daśamyāṃ niyataḥ snātvā praṇipatya janārdanam ||
haviṣyānnakṛtāhāraḥ śucir bhūtvā bhaved vratī |
upatipte śucau deśe bakṣayed dantadāvanam ||
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ samyak pūjayitvā janārdanam |
sunāmadvādaśīṃ deva ahaṃ bhokṣye pare ‘hani ||
evaṃ saṃkalpya niyamaṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam |
daśamyām ekabhaktāśī saṃyataḥ saṃvasen niśām ||
ekādaśyāṃ tataḥ prātar ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ |
pūrve saṃpūjayet sūryaṃ tato devaṃ prapūjayet ||
devaṃ viṣṇum |
namas te devadeveśa namas te bhaktavatsala |
bhāskarāya namas tubhyaṃ ravaye tvayi bhānave ||
namaḥ sūryāya devāya namas te saptasaptaye |
ekasmai hi namas tubhyam ekavakrarathāya ca ||
jyotiṣāṃ pataye nityaṃ sarvatejoharāya ca |
divākara namas te ‘stu prabhākara namo ‘stu te ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ |
[1065] dīpair vastraiḥ sanaivedyais tato viṣṇugṛhaṃ vrajet ||
acyutaṃ cārcayed bhaktyā mālatīkusumair bhṛśam |
guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dīpaṃ dadyād ahar niśam ||
pāyasāpūpasaṃyāvakarambhādikadambakaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ haraye dadyāt phalamodakaphāṇitaiḥ ||
gītavādyair harer iṣṭaiḥ praṇamec ca muhur muhuḥ |
evaṃ pūjāṃ hareḥ kṛtvā dvijaṃ jñānapradāyakam ||
pūjayed antaraṃ nāsti viprakeśavayor iva |
tato vrataṃ samālabhya candanena navaṃ ghaṭam ||
sragviṇaṃ toyasaṃpūrṇaṃ nyased devasya saṃnidhau |
sunīlamauktikākhyaṃ tu vajraṃ ratnasuvarṇakam ||
nyastagarbhaṃ savastraṃ tu pūjayet tatra keśavam |
keśavamūrtis tu dakṣiṇādhohastād ārabhya pradakṣiṇaṃ padmaśaṅkhacakragadādhāriṇī sā ca svarṇamayī vidheyā |
yasya rocisthitā meghāḥ sarve saviṣapannagāḥ ||
sāgarāḥ kukṣideśasthāḥ sotrāsanajagatpatiḥ |
vanaspatiraso divyaḥ sarvagandheṣu cottamaḥ ||
ghṛtena sahasaṃmiśraḥ dhūpo ‘yaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
keśavaṃ keśihā duṣṭakaṃsadaityaniṣūdanaḥ ||
sarvakāmaprado devaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyāpohatu |
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
[1066] dvādaśyāṃ gandhatoyena snāpayitveha māghavam |
sarvapāpavinirmukto vaiṣṇavīṃ labhate tanum ||
kṛtābhiṣekaḥ puṇyātmā samyag abhyarcya keśavam |
navasūtāṃ tathā dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet ||
keśavaḥ prīyatāṃ devaḥ keśihantā mahādyutiḥ |
sa ca me bhagavān prīta iṣṭān kāmān prayacchatu ||
evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam |
triṃśadabdakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hatvā sa trividhaṃ naraḥ ||
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi svarge modati devavat |
yadā kālādihāyāni sa dharmadhanavān bhavet ||
atha vā daśadhenūnāṃ tanmātraṃ kalpayen naraḥ |
tatphalaṃ hi vinirdiṣṭaṃ yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇā ||
vibhaktyā phalam āpnoti bhaktir evātra kāraṇam |
pauṣe caiva tu māse vā yaś caivaṃ kurute naraḥ ||
samāhitamanā bhūpa rasaṃ nu vipradāyakaḥ |
āpo narā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ ||
ayanaṃ vartayet tasmān nārāyaṇa iti smṛtaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ prīyatāṃ me devo narapriyaḥ sadā ||
iṣṭakāmapradaṃ nityaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ ||
evaṃ hi yajamānasya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
[1067] ṣaṣṭirvarṣakṛtṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ||
datvā svargam avāpnoti varṣāṇām ayutaṃ śubham |
māghasyaiva tu māsasya dvādaśī śuklapakṣataḥ ||
yaḥ kṣaped dhi śucir bhūtvā ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ |
tapane pūjane nityaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||
pradāne nṛpaśārdūla imaṃ mantram udīrayet |
mahālakṣmīḥ purāretyī bhaginī śaśino ‘nujā ||
dhavastvam api tasyāstu sarvakāmada mādhava |
prīyatāṃ devadevo me madhukaiṭabhasūdanaḥ ||
kaṃsakeśinihantā ca mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute nūnaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
yāvajjanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hatvā sarvam aśeṣataḥ |
divyavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaṃ vasati ṣoḍaśa ||
guḍadhenuprado māghe ihāyātaḥ sadā sukhī |
bhaved rājanirātaṅkaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ||
tatra viṣṇuparo bhūtvā kramān mokṣam avāpnuyāt |
phālgunāmalapakṣasya daśamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena gandhapuṣpādinā harim |
tiladhenuṃ tato dadyād vṛṣaṃ cāpi subhaktitaḥ ||
mantreṇānena rājendra govindaḥ prīyatām iti |
gavāṃ bhakto ‘si gosvāmī govāso gokṛtālayaḥ ||
sarvakāmaprado nityaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śṛṇu puṇyaṃ yathātatham ||
[1068] balīvardasahasrāṇāṃ daśānāṃ dhuravāhinī |
na tais tat phalam āpnoti dvādaśyāṃ yad bhaven nṛpa ||
divyavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaṃ tiṣṭhati svargivat |
caitrasya dvādaśī śuklā samupoṣyā nṛpottama ||
snātvā saṃpūjayed viṣṇuṃ jagatāntaracāriṇam |
pūrvoktavidhivat snātvā gomūtrair gomayena vā ||
snāpayitvāmṛtenaiva pañcānāṃ gavyasaṃyutaiḥ |
jalaiḥ paścāt tu pūjyaivaṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
puṣyavāsobhir evaṃ hi mantreṇānena buddhimān |
praveśano sadāśīlo bhagavān rakṣaṇāya ca ||
durvṛttāṃś (?) ca vinirjetuṃ māsi viṣṇurato hareḥ |
viṣṇur bhavatu me prīto viṣṇur devaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
sarvapāpavināśāya viṣṇur me prīyatām iti |
madhudhenum abhāvāc ca śaktitaḥ pātram eva ca ||
datvā yat phalam āpnoti tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu |
sarvajanmani yat pāpam iha janmani sāṃpratam ||
vartate sakalaṃ hatvā svargaloke mahīyae |
vaiśākhasya tu māsasya pūjayen madhusūdanam ||
pūrvoktavidhinā rājan sauvarṇaṃ madhusūdanam |
jalakumbhena saṃsthāpya mantreṇānena pūjayet ||
ekārṇave jale dhātar hatā vedāḥ purā hare |
madhunāmā hataḥ so ‘pi tenānu madhusūdanaḥ ||
[1069] sa me bhavatu suprīto devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
sarvapāpāpanodāya prīyatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ||
ghṛtam annam atho datvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā datvā deyāṃ tathaiva gām ||
evaṃ tu rakṣamāṇasya tasya puṇyam ataḥ śṛṇu |
kapilāyāḥ sahasrasya samyak dattasya yat phalam |
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti bhaktiyukto na saṃśayaḥ ||
yāvad indro vaset svarge tāvad eva sa tiṣṭhati |
jyaiṣṭhasyaiva tu māsasya śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm ||
pūjayed vidhivad bhaktyā samupoṣya trivikramam |
jaladhenum atho dadyād viprāya niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
yajñabhāgabhujo daityān saṃnihatya kramais tribhiḥ |
trailokaym āhataṃ tasmāt tenāsi tvaṃ trivikarmaḥ ||
trivikramaṃ trilokeśaṃ prīṇayāmi trivikramam |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā bāhmaṇebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām ||
datvā tu bhojayet tāṃs tu śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam |
vājapeyasya yajñasya samyag iṣṭasya pārthiva ||
tat phalaṃ labhate martyo paratraiva sukhī bhavet |
vāmanaṃ tu yathāṣāḍhe samupoṣya prayatnataḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ niyamāhāro vāmanaṃ tatra pūjayet |
hitāya sarvadevānām ādityaḥ kāmado yathā ||
tathā tvaṃ bhava me deva vāmano balibandhanaḥ |
[1070] tiladhenuṃ tato dadyād vāmanaḥ prīyatām iti ||
indrasthānāc ca sarasas tathā parvatamastakān |
etābhiḥ snāpya deveśaṃ dadyād gorocanāṃ śubhām ||
tatas tu kalaśā deyā yathāvat samalaṃkṛtāḥ |
jātīpallavasaṃyuktāḥ saphalāś ca sakāñcanāḥ ||
puṇyāhavedaśabdena vīṇāveṇuraveṇa ca |
śabdena madhureṇaiva sūtamāgadhabandināṃ ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpya govindaṃ svanuliptaṃ svalaṃkṛtam |
suvāsaḥ (?) saṃpūjayet taṃ sumanobhiś ca kuṅkumaiḥ ||
dhūpair dīpair manojñaiś ca pāyasena tu bhūriṇā |
mātrāratnapradānaiś ca homaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ ||
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇair hṛdyair gobhir aśvagajair api |
brāhmaṇāḥ pūjanīyāś ca viṣṇor ādyāḥ sumūrtayaḥ ||
viṣṇo rātrau prasuptasya dāmodaragatasya ca |
brahmāṇḍasya suto ‘si tvaṃ dāmodara iti smṛtaḥ ||
dāmodara imāṃ dhenuṃ gṛhṇātu svayam eva hi |
dvijarūpeṇa te viṣṇo prakṛtyeṣā sanātanī ||
ity evaṃ pṛthivīdānāt phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
suvarṇasya mahādhenuṃ datvā varaṃ nṛpottama ||
hatvā pāpāny aśeṣāṇi śatajanmāntarāṇi vai |
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āpnoti yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
samyag atra vrate cīrṇe saptajanmānugaṃ phalam |
dadāti bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kramāt mokṣaṃ nareśvara ||
[1071] brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā bhakṣyais tūccāvacair api |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām ||
kalaśān dvādaśāṃś caiva brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāpayet |
vajreṇa veṣṭate grīvān homagarbhopaśobhitān ||
dadhikṣīrayutāṃś caiva saguṇāna nṛpa bhūriśaḥ |
śaktir yathā tathā dadyād bhaktir evātra kāraṇam ||
prasaṅge nāpi yo rājan sunāmadvādaśīṃ naraḥ |
karoti puṇyabhāgī sa yathā dadyād bhaved baliḥ ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājan sunāmadvādaśīṃ naraḥ |
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ samadhikaṃ bhavet ||
sarvadāneṣu yat puṇyaṃ yac ca puṇyaṃ tapovane |
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ tat puṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
gāvo dvādaś dātavyā vastrayugmāni kāñcanam |
alābhāc caiva gām ekāṃ pātraṃ ca svarṇasaṃyutam ||
samāsenātha vāpy evaṃ cañcalaṃ jīvitaṃ tataḥ |
bahuvighāni dharmasya kartuḥ chidraṃ na jāyate ||
etaj jñātvā tu medhāvī vrate yugmena yatnataḥ |
na tasya vittalobho ‘stu bhaktigrāhyo ‘sti keśavaḥ ||
anena vidhinā yas tu dvādaśīṃ parivatsaram |
kṛtvā naraḥ paraṃ yāti viṣṇulokam anāmayam ||
sunāmadvādaśī caiṣā vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
ādyā narais tu kartavyā toṣayadbhir janārdanam ||
yaś caimāṃ kīrtayet puṇyāṃ śṛṇuyād dvādaśīṃ naraḥ |
[1072] tāv ubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ kartā viṇūpuraṃ vrajet ||
iti vahnipurāṇoktaṃ sunāmadvādaśīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
phālgunāmalapakṣasya ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
naro vā yad vā nārī samabhyarcya jagatpatim ||
harer nāma japan bhaktyā saptavārān janeśvara |
uttiṣṭhan prasvapaṃś caiva harim evāśu kīrtayet ||
ataḥ prabhāte vimale dvādaśyāṃ niyato harim |
snātvā samyak samabhyarcya datvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ||
harim uddiśya caivāgnau ghṛtahomaṃ samācaret |
praṇipatya jagannātham iti vāṇim udīrayet ||
pātālasaṃsthā vasudhā pradādya ca manorathān |
avāpa vāsudevo me sa dadātu manorathān ||
yam abhyarcya diti (?) prāptā sakalāṃś ca manorathān |
bhraṣṭarājyaś ca devendro yam abhyarcya jagatpatim ||
manorathān avāpyāśu sa dadātu manorathān |
evam abhyarcya pūjāṃ ca niṣpādya harate tataḥ ||
saṃbhojya tithibhṛtyāṃś ca haviṣyānnena vāgayataḥ |
svayaṃ bhuñjīta ca naro hariṃ dhyātvā vimatsaraḥ ||
phālgunaś caitravaiśākhau jyaiṣṭhamāsaś ca pārthiva |
caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsair ebhir niṣpāditaṃ bhavet ||
raktapuṣpaiś ca caturo māsān kurvīta vārcanam |
[1073] dahec ca guggulaṃ prāsya gośṛṅgakṣālanaṃ (?) param ||
haviṣyānnaṃ ca naivedyam ātmanaś cāpi bhojanam |
tad astu śrūyatām anyā āṣāḍhādiṣu vā kriyā ||
jātīpuṣpāṇi dhūpaś ca śastaḥ sarjarasena tu |
prāśya darbhodakaṃ cātra śālyannaṃ ca nivedayet ||
svayam eva tad aśnīyāc cheṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret |
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam ||
sugandhaṃ svecchayā dhūpaṃ pūjāṃ bhṛṅgārakeṇa ca |
bhṛṅgārako mākandaḥ |
kāsāraṃ vātra naivedyaṃ bhuñjīyāt tac ca vai svayam |
pratimāsaṃ ca viprāya dātavyā dakṣiṇā tathā ||
prīṇanaṃ devadevasya pāraṇe pāraṇe gate |
yathāśaktyā ca kurvīta vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ (?) ||
sadbhāvenaiva govindaḥ prītim āpnoty anuttamām |
ato ‘rthaṃ pāraṇasyānte prīṇanīyo janārdanaḥ ||
prīṇītaś cepsitān kāmān dadāty avyāhatān bhuvi |
varṣānte pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ kārayitvā suśobhanām ||
suvarṇaṃ na yathāśaktyā gadā śaṅkhāsi bhūṣitām |
śuklavastrayugacchannāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
dvādaś brāhmaṇāṃs tatra bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet |
[1074] dvādaśātra pradātavyāḥ kumbhāḥ sānnajalākṣatāḥ ||
chatropānadyugaiḥ sārdhaṃ dakṣiṇābhiś ca sattama |
gāś caivātra pradātavyā gurave ca payasvinīḥ ||
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktāḥ savatsāḥ śīlasaṃyutāḥ |
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā dvādaśī phalam icchatām ||
yathābhilaṣitān kāmān dadāti nṛpasattama |
pūrayitvākhilān bhaktyā yataś caiṣā manorathān ||
manorathā dvādaśīyantato loke viśrutā |
upoṣyaitāṃ tribhuvanaṃ prāptam indreṇa vai purā ||
ādityā vepsitān putrān dhanam auśanasā tathā |
dhaumyenādhyayanaṃ prāptam anyaiś cābhimataṃ phalam ||
aputro labhate putrān nirdhano dhanam āpnuyāt |
rogābhibhūtaś cārogyaṃ kanyā prāpnoti satpatim ||
samāgamaḥ pravasitair upoṣyaitad avāpyate |
sarvakāmān avāpnoti mṛtaḥ svargaṃ ca modate ||
nāputro nāpi nidhano viyukto na ca nirguṇaḥ |
upoṣyaitad vrataṃ martyaḥ strījito vāpi jāyate ||
svargalokaṃ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ manujādhipa |
bhogān abhimatān bhuktvā svargaloke ‘bhikāṅkṣitān ||
iha puṇyavatāṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanināṃ sādhuśīlinām |
gṛheṣu jāyate rājā sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ ||
na dvādaśīm upavasanti manorathākhyāṃ
naivārcayanti puruṣottamam ādidevam |
[1075] gobrāhmaṇāṃś ca na namanti na pūjayanti
ye te mano’bhilaṣitaṃ katham āpnuvanti ||
iti śrīpadmapurāṇoktaṃ manorathadvādaśīvratam |
bhīṣma uvāca |
kim abhīṣṭaviyogaśokasaṅghān
alam uddhartum upoṣaṇaṃ vrataṃ vā |
vibhavodbhavakāri bhūtale ‘smin
bhavabhīter api sūdanaṃ ca puṃsām ||
pulastya uvāca |
param iṣṭam idaṃ jagat priyante
vibudhānām api durlabhaṃ mahatvāt |
tava bhaktimatas tathā ca vakṣye
vratam indrādisuradānaveṣu guhyam ||
puṇye vāśvayuje māsi viśokadvādaśīvratam |
yac cīrtvā śokadaurgatyabhājanaṃ na naro bhavet ||
daśamyāṃ laghubhuk rātrau kṛtvā vai dantadhāvanam |
udaṅmukho prāṅmukho vā vākyam etad udīrayet ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya ca keśavam |
śriyaṃ ca jagatāṃ bhūtiṃ bhokṣyāmīty apare ‘hani ||
evaṃ niyamam ākhyāya suptā rātrau jitendriyaḥ |
prabhāte vimale gatvā madhyāhne tu jalāśayam ||
[1076] snānaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ kuryāt pañcagavyajalena ca |
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ samabhyetya gṛhaṃ tataḥ ||
pūjayej jagatāṃ nāthaṃ lakṣmīdayitam utpalaiḥ |
keśavāya jānunī tadvad ūrū ca jalaśāyine |
kandarpāya namo guhyaṃ mādhavāya namaḥ kaṭim ||
dāmodarāyety udaraṃ pārśve ca vipulāya vai |
nābhiṃ ca padmanābhāya hṛdayaṃ manmathāya ca ||
śrīdharāya vibhor vakṣaḥ karau tu madhughātine |
cakṣiṇe (?) vāmabāhuṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ gadine namaḥ ||
nāsāṃ śokavināśāya vāsudevāya cākṣiṇī |
lalāṭaṃ vāmanāyeti haraye ca punar bhruvau ||
alakān sādhanāyeti karīṭaṃ viśvarūpiṇe |
namaḥ sarvātmane tubhyaṃ sarvāṅgāny abhipūjayet ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
tad asu maṇḍapasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayen mṛdā ||
caturasraṃ samantāc ca triratnimātram ucchrayam (?) |
sūkṣmaṃ hṛdyaṃ ca purato vapradvayasamāvṛtam ||
vapraprakāraḥ |
trir aṅgulocchritaṃ vapraṃ tadvistāro dviraṅgulaḥ |
sthaṇḍilasyopariṣṭāt tu bhittir aṣṭāṅgulā bhavet ||
[1077] nadī vālukayā śūrpe lakṣmyāḥ pratikṛtiṃ nyaset |
sthaṇḍile śūrpam āropya lakṣmīm ity arcayed budhaḥ ||
namo devyai namaḥ śāntyai namas tasyai namaḥ śriye |
namas tuṣṭyai namaḥ puṣṭyai sṛṣṭyai vṛṣṭyai namo namaḥ ||
viśokā duḥkhanāśāya viśokā varadāstu te |
viśokā me ‘stu santatyai viśokā sarvasiddhaye ||
śukāmbaradharaḥ sūryaṃ veṣṭya saṃpūjayet phalaiḥ |
bhakṣyair nānāvidhais tadvat sauvarṇe kamalena ca ||
yathā vibhavato bhīṣma vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
darbhodakaṃ praśaṃsanti rātrāv asmin vrate sadā ||
prāśanaṃ jāgaraṃ caiva gītanṛtyādibhis tathā |
yāmatraye vyatīte tu sarvopaskarasaṃyutaḥ ||
abhigamya ca viprāṇāṃ muthunāni samarcayet |
śaktitas trīṇi caikaṃ vā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ ||
śayanasthāni pūjyāni namo ‘stu jalaśāyine |
tatas tu gītavādyādi niśāśeṣe vivarjayet ||
prabhāte kṛtakṛtyas tu dampatyāni ca bhojayet |
yathāśaktyā kuruśreṣṭha tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
divāsvapnaṃ parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanaṃ (?) maithunam |
kṣaudrṃ tailāmiṣaṃ caiva dvādaśyāṃ sapta varjayet ||
ato ‘rthaṃ pāraṇād ūrdhvaṃ purāṇaśravanādibhiḥ |
siddhinādais tathā cānyais tad dinaṃ cātivāhayet ||
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsi māsi samācaret |
[1078] vratānte śayanaṃ dadyād guḍadhenusamanvitam ||
sopadhānakaviśrāmaṃ savastrābharaṇaṃ śubham |
mantreṇānena rājendra viprendrāya nivedayet ||
yathā lakṣmīr na deveśa tvāṃ parityajya tiṣṭhati |
tathārogyaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca viśokaṃ vāstu me sadā ||
yathā devena rahitā na lakṣmīr jātu jāyate |
tathā viśokatā me ‘stu bhaktir agryā ca keśave ||
vidhinānena tat sarvaṃ śūrpaṃ sakalaṃ tathā |
dātavyaṃ vedaviduṣe ātmano bhūtim icchatā ||
utpalaṃ karavīraṃ ca amlānakusumaṃ tathā |
bhṛṅgāraṃ sindhuvāraṃ ca mallikāgandhapāṭalam ||
kadambakumudaṃ jātī śastāny etāni pūjayet |
viśokadvādaśī caiṣā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||
yām upoṣya naro bhaktyā śubhasaubhāgyabhāg bhavet |
bhuktvā kāmān aśeṣāṃs tu ante smaraṇam āpnuyāt ||
smṛtvācyutaṃ hy antakāle yāti tatsamam antataḥ |
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotīha samyak
madhumuranarakārer arcanaṃ cāpi paśyet |
matim api kurute yo devatāsv indraloke
vasati ca sasurādyaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ sadaiva ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ dvādaśīvratam |
[1079]
dālbhya uvāca |
atīva bhīṣaṇā nityaṃ śastrāgnibhayadākṣara |
kathaṃ na gacchen narakān etan me vaktum arhati ||
aho ‘tikaṣṭaṃ pāpānāṃ vipāko narakasthitiḥ |
puruṣair bhujyate brahman tan mokṣaṃ vada sattama ||
pulastya uvāca |
puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ puṇya eva dvijottama |
cetasaḥ pariṇāyārthaṃ svargasthair bhujyate naraiḥ ||
tathaiva pākaḥ pāpānāṃ puruṣair narakasthitaiḥ |
bhujyate tāvad akhilo yāvat pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ vrajet ||
yatheyaṃ dvādaśī śastā nṛṇāṃ sukṛtakarmaṇām |
yām upoṣya dvijaśreṣṭha na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ ||
phālgunāmalapakṣasya ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭha pūjayen madhusūdanam ||
ekādaśyāṃ samutthiṣṭan (?) viṣṇor nāmānukīrtanam |
pūjāyāṃ vāsudevasya kurvīta susamāhitaḥ ||
namo nārāyaṇāyeti vākyaṃ vākyam aharniśam |
krodhaṃ pāpaṃ tatherṣyāṃ ca dambhalobhaṃ ca varjayet ||
kāmakrodhaṃ madaṃ vāpi mānam aiśvaryam eva ca |
sarvam etat parityājyaṃ viṣṇubhaktena cetasā ||
asāratāṃ ca loke ‘smin saṃsāre bhāvayann iti |
tathaiva kuryād dvādaśyāṃ nāmnām uccāraṇaṃ dvija ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
[1080]
sauvarṇatāmrapātrāṇi mṛṇmayāny api pāṇḍava |
yavapātrasthāni kṛtvā pratimāsam upoṣitaḥ ||
nāmatrayam aśeṣeṇa māsi māsi dinadvayam |
tathaivoccārayed adyād (?) dvādaśyāṃ ca yathoditam ||
praṇamya ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ prasādayet |
viṣṇo namas te jagataḥ prasūte śrīvāsudevāya namo ‘stu te ||
nārāyaṇo ‘stu dharmā (?) me jahi pāpam aśeṣataḥ |
sarvapāpakṣayo me ‘stu mahāsukṛtakarmabhiḥ ||
anekajanmajanitaṃ bālyayauvanavārddhake |
puṇyaṃ vivṛddhim āyātu pāpaṃ ca saṃkṣayaṃ vrajet ||
tatśāntivṛddhim āyātu pāpānāṃ pañcakṣayam |
ākāśādiṣu śabdādau śrotrādimahadādiṣu ||
prakṛtipuruṣau caiva brahmasaṃprāptim āpnute |
yathaika eva sarvātmā vāsudevo vyavasthitaḥ ||
tena satyena me pāpaṃ narakārtipradakṣayam |
prayātu sukṛtasyāstu mama tu dinasaṃcayam (?) ||
pāpasya hāniṃ puṇyaṃ tu vṛddhim abhyetv anuttamām |
evam uccārya viprāya datvā vā kathitaṃ tava ||
bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyas tu pāraṇe pāraṇe gate |
pāraṇānte ca devasya prīṇatāṃ śaktito dvija ||
kurvītākhilapāṣaṇḍair ālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kāñcanīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ ||
pūjayitvā vastrapuṣpaghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutām |
[1081] gāṃ savatsāṃ ca viprāya dadyāt kṛṣṇāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
vilambitaṃ ca yat pūrvaṃ daivāt pātraṃ bhaved yadi |
tasminn ahani dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ cānivāritam ||
ity eṣā kathitā dālbhya sukṛtasya jayāvahāḥ |
dvādaśī narakaṃ martyo yām upoṣya na paśyati ||
nāgnayo na ca śastrāṇi na ca lohamukhāḥ khagāḥ |
narakās taṃ na bādhante matir yasya janārdane ||
nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa viṣṇoḥ kṣīṇāghasaṃcayaḥ |
bhavaty apāstapāpasya narake gamanaṃ kutaḥ ||
namo nārāyanāyeha vāsudeveti kīrtayet |
na yāti narakaṃ martyaḥ saṃkṣīṇāśeṣapātakaḥ ||
tasmāt pāṣaṇḍisaṃsargam akurvan dvādaśīm imām |
upoṣya puṇyopacayīṃ na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ sukṛtadvādaśīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe phālgune māsi yo naraḥ |
japan kṛṣṇeti devasya nāma bhaktyā punaḥ punaḥ ||
devārcanaṃ vāṣṭaśataṃ kṛtvaitat tu japec chuciḥ |
snānaprasthānakāle ca utthāne skhalite kṣaye ||
pāśaṇḍān patitāṃś caiva tathaivāntyāvasāyinaḥ |
nālapet tu tathā devam arcayec chraddhayānvitaḥ ||
idaṃ codāharen mantraṃ manaś cādhāya tatparaḥ |
[1082] kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛpālas tvam agatīnāṃ gatir bhava ||
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ prasīda madhusūdana |
evaṃ prasādyopavāsaṃ kṛtvā niyatamānasaḥ ||
pūrvāhṇa eva cānyedyur gavāṃ saṃprāśya vai sakṛt |
snāto ‘rcayitvā kṛṣṇeti punar nāma prakīrtayet ||
vāridhārātrayaṃ caiva vikṣiped devapādayoḥ |
caitravaiśākhayoś caivaṃ tadvaj jaiṣṭhe ca pūjayet ||
martyaloke gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ dālbhya prāpnoti vai naraḥ |
utkrāntikāle kṛṣṇasya smaraṇaṃ ca tathāpnuyāt ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā |
tathaivāśvayuje devam anena vidhinā naraḥ ||
upoṣya saṃpūjya tathā keśaveti ca kīrtayet |
gomūtraprāśanāt pūtaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
ārādhitasya jagatām īśvarasya mahātmanaḥ |
utkrāntikāle smaraṇaṃ keśavasya tathāpnuyāt ||
kṣīrasya prāśanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vidhinedaṃ yathoditam |
kārttikādi yathānyāyaṃ kuryān māsacatuṣṭayam ||
tenaiva vidhinā brahman tatra viṣṇuṃ prakīrtayet |
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ viṣṇuṃ smarati tatkṣaye ||
pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo dadyād dānaṃ yathecchayā |
cāturmāsye ca saṃpūrṇe puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanam ||
kathāṃ ca vāsudevasya tadgītaṃ vāpi kārayet |
evam eva gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ devānām anukīrtanāt ||
[1083] kathitaṃ pāraṇaṃ yat te kuryān māsacatuṣṭayam |
ādhipatyaṃ tena bhogān divyam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
dvitīyena tathā bhogān aindrān prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
viṣṇuloke tṛtīyena pāraṇaṃ tu tathāpnuyāt ||
evam etat samākhyātaṃ gatiprāpakam uttamam |
vidhānaṃ dvijaśārdūla kṛṣṇatuṣṭipradaṃ nṛṇām ||
sugatidvādaśīm etāṃ śraddadhānaś ca yo naraḥ |
upoṣyati tathā nārī prāpnoti trividhāṃ gatim ||
eṣā dhanyā pāpaharā tathir nityam upāsitā |
ārādhanāya śasteṣā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ sugatidvādaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
ṛṇais tribhiḥ parivṛtaḥ puruṣo jāyate kila |
ṛṇatrayāt tu mucyeta puruṣaḥ putradarśanāt ||
punnāmanarakād yasmāt pitaraṃ trāyate sutaḥ |
tasmāt putra iti proktaḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā ||
digambaraṃ gatavrīḍaṃ jaṭilaṃ dhūlidhūsaram |
puṇyahīnā na paśyanti gaṅgādharam ivātmajam ||
tasmāt putrasya lābhāya vratam etad udīrayet |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ekādaśyāṃ cāśvayuje snātvopoṣyārcayed dharim |
gāṃ rātrau pūjayed dadyāt savastāyā gavāhnikam ||
[1084] apare ‘hni tathābhyārcya niśi bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
māse māse ‘tha caitāni harināmāni kīrtayet ||
aparājito ‘jātaśatruḥ puruhūtaḥ purandaraḥ |
vardhamānaḥ sureśaś ca mahābāhuḥ prabhur vibhuḥ ||
subhūtiḥ sumanāś caiva supracetā itīrayet |
evaṃ dvādaśabhir miśrair māsair vā pārayed vratam ||
vratānte juhuyād (?) devaṃ nāmabhir ghṛtapāyasam |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād varānnaṃ māsasaṃkhyayā ||
māsi māsi yathāśaktyā dānaṃ prārthanam eva ca |
yathā diter bhavān putraḥ śāśvataś cākṣayo ‘cyutaḥ ||
tathā bhavatu me devaḥ putro janmani janmani |
vaiṣṇavī surabhī mātā brahmaṇā devapūjitā ||
gṛhāṇedaṃ mayā dattaṃ piṇḍam ānṛṇyamulakam |
vastrābharaṇagodānair brāhmaṇaṃ prīṇayed gurum ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurānoktaṃ govatsadvādaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
hatvā bhayaṅkaraṃ pāpaṃ pṛthivīkṣayakārakam |
paripṛcchāmi govinda tvāṃ namaskṛtya pādayoḥ ||
guhyād guhyataraṃ brūhi vrataṃ kiṃcid anuttamam |
tarāmi yena pāpaughaṃ bhīṣmadroṇavadhārṇavam ||
[1085] kṛṣṇa uvāca |
āsīt purā naro nāmā vidarbhāyāṃ kuśadhvajaḥ |
śāntaḥ purusuto yena cakre rāṣṭram atandritaḥ ||
jaghāna tāpasaṃ so ‘py apramādaṃ mṛgayāṅgataḥ |
mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ devamohitaḥ ||
tena karmavipākena dehānte gavayas tataḥ |
tatrāsau patanād ghorāśva (?) tu bhūpātipīḍitam ||
tasmād idhāgato martyo raudro viṣadharo bhavet |
adarśat so ‘pi rājendra brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe tu ṣā (?) ||
salatāṃ hatapañcatvaṃ jagāma dvipasūnutām |
vipannaś ca tataḥ siṃho dvitīye ‘bhūt sudāruṇaḥ ||
vidāritamukho hiṃsro nāma sattvabhayaṅkaraḥ |
janmānte so ‘bhavat śreṣṭharājanyo mṛgayāgataḥ ||
tatobhi (?) bahubhiḥ śastrai rājā lokair nipātitaḥ |
punar vyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye ‘pi bhavāntare ||
tīkṣṇapādanakhāghātavyāpāditamṛgānvayaḥ |
tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ gataḥ kaścil latāntare ||
sanīrakṛmirāśitvaṃ lokaiḥ khyātanipātanān |
sa jātas tāpakṛd rakṣo nakharāhatajantubhuk ||
jaghāna vālaṃ caṇḍālād asau mṛtyum avāpnuyāt |
[1086] pañcame makaro jātaḥ samudreti bhayaṅkaraḥ ||
striyaṃ jaghāna taruṇīṃ snātukāmāṃ yathāgatām |
prabhāte śaṅkarasyāgre śaśāṅkagrahaṇe niśi ||
tatrāpi baḍisaṃ datvā janaiḥ prāṇair viyojayet |
punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātau piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ ||
krūraḥ chidraparaḥ kṣudro naraprāṇaviyojakaḥ |
so ‘vatīrṇo narasyāṅgaṅkanāmā sa ca kasyacit ||
mantreṇa pūyasiddhena vātikena vyasuḥ kṛtaḥ |
saptame sa punar jātau durnirīkṣavapur bhṛśam ||
krūradaṃṣṭraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ |
digvāsā manubhasīṣu vāsiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ ||
rāṣṭraṃ ca gaur jaraṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ cakre viṣādiṣu |
ākramya somadāsena rājā rākṣasaśatruṇā ||
samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ |
bhūyo bhavadvyāghrasamaḥ syāj janmany aṣṭame bhuvi ||
vane tarāṇāṃ ktudvīgo (?) brāhmaṇārtau nigandhanam |
sa tu hastī jabhallena mātaṅgena dhauṣmatā ||
ekādeśe ‘pi pāñcālo pañcamadhye ‘tibhīṣaṇaḥ |
ūrdhvakarṇo ‘tiraktākṣo jātau hrasvatanur dṛḍhaḥ ||
pāpo dharmadhvajo rakṣo devatojinamālyadhṛk |
sa daṇḍapāśikenaiva vṛkṣāgre hy avalambitaḥ ||
dvādaśe sa punar jātaḥ pulkaśaḥ kleśabhājanaḥ |
[1087] bhakṣyalobhād vilagato vyādhena vinipātitaḥ ||
tena vāsīt kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tārakadvādaśīvratam |
tasya prabhāvāj jāto ‘pi duṣṭayonau punaḥ punaḥ ||
avāpa śīghraṃ pañcatvaṃ saṃsārabhavasāgare |
punar evābhavad rājā vidarbhāyāṃ sudhārmikaḥ ||
bhūyaḥ sopoṣitā tena tārakā dvādaśo śubhā |
paśyatāṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ jātau jātau punaḥ punaḥ ||
vrataprabhāvād bhuvane bhuktvā rājyam akaṇṭakam |
prāpa viṣṇupure sthānaṃ yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
yudhiṣthira uvāca |
kathaṃ tat kṛṣṇa kartavyaṃ tārakadvādaśīvratam |
pāpo ‘pi sadgatiṃ prāpto yatprabhāvāt kuśadhvajaḥ ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe gṛhītvā dvādaśīvratam |
akṛttime jale snānam aparāhṇe samācaret ||
praṇamya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā |
maunenaivāvasthātavyaṃ yāvad astaṃ vrajed raviḥ ||
tato muktāphalaiḥ puṣpair gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
sajalaṃ sākṣataṃ yuktaṃ hiraṇyāttaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
ramye tāmramaye pātre jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ |
pūrvāmukhaḥ pradoṣāgre mūrdhni kṛtvārghyabhājanam ||
bhūmau maṇḍalikaṃ kṛtvā gomayena satāṅkitam |
candanena samālipya dhruvaṃ ca mṛgagomukham ||
[1088] sahasraśīrṣāmantreṇa bhūmau dhyātvā jagadgurum |
tārakānāṃ kuruśreṣṭha dadyād arghyaṃ jitendriyaḥ ||
paryukṣya dhūpam utkṣipya dadyād viprāya dakṣiṇām |
krameṇa sarvaṃ nirvartya bhojyaṃ bhojyaṃ niśāgame ||
mārgaśīrṣe khaṇḍakhādyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śovālakaiḥ subhaiḥ |
māghe tilānnakṛśaraiḥ phālgune guḍapūrakaiḥ ||
vasante modakair divyair vaiśākhe khaṇḍaveṣṭakaiḥ |
jyaiṣṭhe śaktubhṛtaiḥ pātrair āṣāḍhe guḍapūrakaiḥ ||
śrāvaṇe śaṣkulībhiś ca nabhasye pāyasena ca |
ghṛtapūrair aśvayuje kāsāraiḥ kārttike kramāt ||
ebhir dvādaśabhir bhakṣyair bhojayitvā dvijān svayam |
bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ pārtha paścād viprān kṣamāpayet ||
samāpte tu vrate kṛtvā rājataṃ tārakāgaṇam |
paiṣṭaṃ vā pūrvavidhinā pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet ||
kumbhā dvādaśa dātavyāḥ sodakā modakānvitāḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ parīdhānaṃ padmarāgaṃ sakañcukam ||
śvetāṃ ca gāṃ brāhmaṇāya candanaṃ copavītakam |
kuṅkumāñjanatāmbūlaṃ strīṇāṃ datvā kṣamāpayet ||
anena vidhinā rājan yaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ |
nārī vā bhartṛparamā vidhavā śīlabhūṣaṇā ||
nakṣatralīkaṃ vrajati vimānenārkavarcasā |
apsarogaṇagandharvayakṣavidyādharaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
tīvratārāvṛtaḥ svarge yugāntam api pūjyate |
[1089] etad vrataṃ purā cīrṇaṃ śavyā rājñyā śriyā mayā||
yā sītayā damayantyā rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā |
anyābhir api nārībhiḥ puruṣaiś ca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
cīrṇam etad vrataṃ pārtha sarvapāpabhayāpaham |
janmāntareṣv api kṛtāni dahaty aghāni
yā sandadhāty ahar ahaḥ sukṛtopayogam |
tārābhidhānam atipātakatūlakīlā
tan nāsti yatra vidadhāti kṛtā manuṣyaiḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktatārakādvādaśīvratam (?) |
śrutā me mānavā dharmā vāsiṣṭhāś ca mayā śrutāḥ |
dvaipāyana yathoddiṣṭā vaiṣṇavān vaktum arhasi ||
vyāsa uvāca |
śrutās te mānavā dharmā vaidikāś ca śrutā mayā |
kalau yuge śakyante te vai kartuṃ narādhipa ||
sukhopāyam alpadhanam alpakleśaṃ mahāphalam |
purāṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sārabhūtaṃ vadāmi te ||
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṅkte yo na yāti narakaṃ tu saḥ ||
vyāsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kampito ‘śvatthaparṇavat |
[1090] bhīmaseno mahābāhur bhīto vākyam abhāṣata |||
bhīma uvāca |
pitāmaha na śakto ‘ham upavāsaṃ karomi kim |
ato bahuphalaṃ brūhi vratam ekam api prabho ||
vyāsa uvāca |
vṛṣasthe mithunasthe ‘rke śuklā hy ekādaśī bhavet |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi prayatnena sopoṣyā jalavarjitaiḥ ||
snāne vācamane caiva varjayitvodakaṃ budhaḥ |
upabhuñjīta naivānyad vratabhaṅgo ‘nyathā bhavet ||
udayād udayaṃ yāvad varjayitvā jalaṃ budhaḥ |
aprayatvād avāpnoti dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśī naraḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvādaśyāṃ snānam ārabhet |
jalaṃ suvarṇaṃ datvā tu dvijātibhyo yathāvidhi ||
bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyas tu brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vaśī |
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ bhīmasena śṛṇuṣva tat ||
saṃvatsaraṃ yathā madhye ekādaśyo bhavanty uta |
tāsāṃ phalam avāpnoti atra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ||
iti māṃ keśavaḥ prāha śaṅkhagadādharaḥ |
asya vratasya yat puṇyaṃ tan me brūhi janārdana ||
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe jyaiṣṭhasyodakavarjitam |
upoṣya phalaṃ prāpnoti yat tu śṛṇu vṛkodara ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yat phalam |
[1091] sarvahomeṣu yat puṇyaṃ tad asyāḥ samupoṣaṇāt ||
saṃvatsarasya yāvatyaḥ śuklāḥ kṛṣṇā vṛkodaraḥ |
upoṣitās tu tāḥ sarvā ekādaśyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
dhanadhānyavahāḥ puṇyāḥ putrārogyapradās tathā |
upoṣitā naravyāghra iti satyaṃ bravīmi te ||
yamadūtā mahākāyā karālakṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ |
daṇḍapāśadharā raudrā maraṇe dṛṣṭigocarāḥ ||
na prayānti taravyāghra ekādaśyām upoṣaṇāt |
pītāmbaradharāḥ saumyāś cakrahastā manojavāḥ ||
antakāle nayaty evaṃ vaiṣṇavā vaiṣṇavīṃ purīm |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena upoṣya jalavarjitam |
jaladhenuṃ tathā datvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
iti śrīmahābhāratoktanirjalaikādaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
bhagavan brūhi te samyak gaṇaya dvādaśīvratam |
saprāśanaṃ sopavāsaṃ sarahasyaṃ samantrakam ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
kaunteya yat purā cīrṇaṃ sitayā vanasaṃsthayā |
vrataṃ rāghavavākyena agastyaṛṣibhāṣitam ||
lopāmudrālaye sarvā munipatnyo bahuprajāḥ |
bhojitās tarpitāḥ sarvair āhāraiḥ sarvakāyikaiḥ ||
[1092] tām ihaikamanāḥ pārtha araṇyadvādaśīṃ śṛṇu |
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ dinodayam ||
snātvā naraḥ sopavāsaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ janārdane |
gandhapuṣpārghyadhūpaiś ca dīpair jāgaraṇādibhiḥ ||
niśāṃ nītvā prabhāte ca vanoddeśe ‘tiśobhane |
sajale kṛṣṇasāṃnidhye vedavedāṅgapāragam ||
bhojayitvā phalaprāyaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
pañcagavyapūrṇam eva prāśanaṃ vātha taddine ||
varṣam ekaṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ pārayitvā yudhiṣṭhira |
śrāvaṇe kārttike māghe caitre vātha samudyamet ||
vratī pakvānnasaṃpūrṇān bhāḍukān (?) ghṛtapūrakān |
annaṃ svādu ca susvinnaṃ khaṇḍakhādyādisaṃyutam ||
bhakṣyair nānāvidhaiḥ pārtha saṃyutaṃ ṣaḍraseṇa tu |
vyañjanaiḥ patraśākaiś ca śuṣkādrair atiśobhanaiḥ ||
pānakaiḥ patrasāraiś ca sugandhaiḥ svāduśītalaiḥ |
phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ sarvair yathāvibhavam ātmanaḥ ||
gatvā vanaṃ muktajanaṃ (?) svādutoyaṃ dhanañjaya |
tatra viprān sukhāsīnān prāgudīcyamukhāñ chucīn ||
bhojayed daśa ca dvau ca kṛtapūjādikakriyaḥ |
alābhe yatimukhyānāṃ gṛhasthān api bhojayet ||
supatnīkān sadācārān agniyuktān guṇapriyān |
uddiśya devaṃ govindaṃ pṛthak dvādaśanāmabhiḥ ||
vāsudevaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ viṣṇuṃ dāmodaraṃ harim |
[1093] trivikramaṃ ca govindaṃ padmanābhaṃ janārdanam ||
govardhanadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīdharaṃ kramaśo nṛpa |
praṇavādinamaskārair nāmabhiḥ pūjayed dvijān ||
gandhapuṣpādinā pārtha bhaktyā tadbhāvitātmanā |
bhojayitvā śubhānnāni svācārāṃs tān sadakṣiṇān ||
praṇamyātho visṛjyaitān viṣṇur me prīyatām iti |
tato bhuñjīta sahito bhṛtair bandhujanena ca ||
āśritair arthibhiḥ pārtha sāmānyair atha vāgyataḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyag araṇyadvādaśīṃ naraḥ ||
sa dehānte vimānastho divyakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ |
uddhṛtya svapitṝṃś (?) cāpi śvetadvīpaṃ haraḥ priyam ||
yatra lokāḥ pītavastrāḥ śyāmadehāś caturbhujāḥ |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmavyagrahastāḥ sakaustubhāḥ ||
tārkṣyāsanāḥ samukuṭā divyakuṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ |
nīlotpalamahāpadmamālayā lalitorasaḥ ||
lakṣmīdharā meghavarṇāḥ keyūrāṅgadabhūṣaṇāḥ |
tiṣṭhanti viṣṇusāmānyā yādavāhūtasaṃplavam ||
tatra bhogāṃś ciraṃ bhuktvā paśyan viṣṇuṃ sanātanam |
puṇyaśeṣāt samāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate ||
sārvabhaumaḥ śriyā yukto rājā syād rājapūjitaḥ |
tatrāpi punar evemām araṇyadvādaśīṃ śubhām ||
karoti dvādaśaivāsau janmāni haritatparaḥ |
tadante bandhunirmukto yāti brahma sanātanam ||
[1094] ekādaśīm upavasanti sitāsaraṇya-
nāmnīṃ vane dvijavarā vratam ācaranti |
sādhyastriyaḥ śucaritābharaṇāś ca teṣāṃ
viṣṇuḥ prasādam upayānti dadāti mokṣam ||
iti bhaviṣottaroktam aparādvādaśīvratam |
yājñavalkya uvāca |
kṛṣṇpakṣe tu pauṣasya saṃprāptidvādaśīṃ śṛṇu |
yām upoṣya samāpnoti sarvān eva manorathān ||
pāṣaṇḍādibhir ālāpam akurvan viṣṇutatparaḥ |
pūjayet prayato devam ekāgramatir acyutam ||
pauṣādipāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhir jyaiṣṭhāntikaṃ smṛtam |
prathame puṇḍarīkākṣanāma devasya gīyate ||
dvitīye mādhavākhyaṃ tu viśvarūpaṃ tu phālgune |
puruṣottamākhyaṃ ca tataḥ pañcame ‘cyutasaṃjñitam ||
ṣaṣṭhe jayeti devasya guhyaṃ nāma prakīrtayet |
pūrveṣu ṣaṭsu māseṣu snānaprāśanayos tilāḥ ||
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu pañcagavyam udāhṛtam |
snānaṃ ca prāśanaṃ caiva pañcagavyaṃ sadeṣyate ||
pūjayet puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ punas tenaiva nāmabhiḥ |
[1095] pratimāsaṃ ca devasya kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhi ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāc chraddadhānaḥ svaśaktitaḥ |
pāraṇānte tu devasya prīṇanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam ||
kurvīta śaktyā govinde sadā sābhyarcanaṃ yataḥ |
naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca naras tailakṣāravivarjitam ||
ekādaśyām uṣitvaivaṃ dvādaśyām atha vā dine |
evam ekādaśyām upoṣya dvādaśīnaktaṃ dinaṃ vā bhuñjītety (?) anvayaḥ |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāne dadāti prītimāṃs tataḥ |
dhenuṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ bhojanam āsanam ||
śayyāṃ ca brāhmaṇe dadyāt keśavaḥ prīyatām iti |
etām upoṣya vidhivad viṣṇuprīṇanatatparaḥ ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
yataḥ sarvam avāpnoti yad yad icchati cetasā ||
tato lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ saṃprāptidvādaśīti vai |
kṛtābhilāṣitā dṛṣṭvā prārabdhā karmatatparaiḥ |
pūrayaty akhilān kāmān saṃsmṛtā ca dine dine ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ saṃprāptidvādaśīvratam |
pauṣe kṛṣṇe viśākhāsu yuktā caikādaśī bhavet |
tasyāṃ saṃpūjayed viṣṇum upoṣya vidhivan naraḥ ||
sugandhapuṣpanaivedyair vastrabhūṣaṇasaṃbhavaiḥ |
māsānumāsaṃ pūjayed vidhinā jagatīpatim ||
[1096] prāśaṇṃ kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ kāryaṃ māsakrameṇa (?) tu |
gomūtram udakaṃ sarpir ācasya (?) kāmataḥ param ||
tato darvyā dadhivrīhitilāṃś caiva yavāṃs tathā |
jalam arkakarais taptaṃ darbhāṃś ca kṣīram eva ca ||
dvādaśyāṃ bhojayed viprān dadhikṣīraguḍaudanaiḥ |
māsakrameṇa viprebhyo dadyāt samyak kṛte (?) vratī ||
ghṛtaṃ tilān vrīhiyavasuvarṇasaṃyutaṃ ghaṭam |
modakaiś ca yutaṃ kumbham ātapatraṃ tu pāyasam ||
phāṇitaṃ candanaṃ mālāḥ sugandhāś ceti dakṣiṇāḥ |
vratam etan mahāpuṇyaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam ||
kartavyaṃ dharmaniratair viṣṇupūjanatatparaiḥ |
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā viprāṇāṃ pravare kule ||
sujanmā jāyate dhīmān vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
nirātaṅko ‘nantasukhaḥ sukhataś ca tathārihā ||
bahuputro bhaved dhīmān dhanaiś ca dhanadopamaiḥ |
yathā naras tathā nārī vratam etat samācaret |
iha prāpya parāṃ lakṣmīṃ mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktaṃ mahāphaladvādaśīvratam |
dvādaśyāṃ bhojayed viprān tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām |
pratimāsaṃ tithau tasyāṃ gobhyo dadyād gavāhnikam ||
[1097] gavāṃ kṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ dadhnā vātha ghṛtena vā |
mṛtpātre ca samaśnīyād akṣāralavaṇaṃ vratī ||
saṃvatsaram upoṣyaiva govindadvādaśīṃ naraḥ |
punar gobhyo yathāśaktyā bhūyo dadyād gavāhnikam ||
govindadvādaśī yātu upoṣya vidhivan naraḥ |
prāpnoti vidhivad datvā gosahasrasya yat phalam ||
samupoṣya mahāpuṇyāṃ govindadvādaśīm imām |
gavāṃ lokam avāpnoti dadhikṣīraghṛtaplutam ||
tatra bhogān varān bhuktvā cirakālaṃ manorathān |
govindasya sadānanaṃ tato lokam avāpnuyāt ||
tatra tiṣṭhen nirātaṅko mudā paramayā yutaḥ |
govindasya prasādena yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktaṃ govindadvādaśīvratam |
nārada uvāca |
dvādaśyo vidhivat proktās tvayā lokapitāmaha |
anuṣṭhānavihīnānāṃ tāsāṃ brūhi kriyāphalam ||
prārambhaṃ ca samāptiṃ ca dvādaśīnāṃ yathāvidhi |
vratacaryāphalaṃ caiva kathayasva pitāmaha ||
brahmovāca |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vipra viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ śubham |
puṇyaṃ vratānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dvādaśīvratam uttamam ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śuklapakṣe yatavrataḥ |
[1098] prathamaṃ caiva gṛhṇīyād dvādaśīṃ vidhivan naraḥ ||
kārayec ca harer yajñam ācāryādyair vidhānataḥ |
arcayitvā hariṃ tatra labdhvānujñāṃ dvijas tataḥ ||
cakratīrthaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā mathurāyāṃ ca keśavam |
dṛṣṭvāśokavane viṣṇuṃ kuñjāgre ca janārdanam ||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇe |
manovākkāyaceṣṭābhiḥ śuciḥ śuddho dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
tato bandhūn gurūn viprān praṇamyaivānumanya ca |
dharmakāmo naraḥ kuryād etaiḥ kṛcchrair na kārayet ||
guorś cānujñayā tatra bhakṣayed dantakāṣṭhakam |
sākṣataṃ codakaṃ gṛhya vratasyānupakalpayet ||
upoṣyaikadaśīṃ viṣṇor yāvac ca parivatsaram |
avighnaviddhim āyātu tvatprasādāj janārdana ||
evaṃ saṃvartya niyamaṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam |
jitendriyaḥ śāntamanā daśamyāṃ nivasen niśām ||
ekādaśyāṃ tataḥ prātaḥsnānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ |
madhunā nāspya deveśaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ ||
sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ pūrṇaiḥ kumbhaiḥ pallavacandanaiḥ |
kuṅkumośīrakarpūraiḥ sragdāmapariśobhitaiḥ ||
tatrārcayet sthitaṃ bhaktyā mālatīkusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
dhūpaṃ vāgurusaṃsiddhaṃ guggulaṃ vā ghṛtaplutam ||
dahed devādhidevāya dīpaṃ dadyād aharniśam |
[1099] pāyasaṃ pūpasaṃyāvaṃ phalaiḥ sārdhaṃ karambhakam ||
karambhā dadhisaṃmiśrāḥ śaktavaḥ |
naivedyaṃ tu harer dadyād bhaktyā caiva vidhānataḥ |
gītavādyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā yathāśaktyā niśām nayet ||
evaṃ pūjāṃ hareḥ kṛtvā dvijaṃ caivānupūjayet |
yogye sati ca na tv anyam āsannaṃ pūjayed yadi ||
sa durgatim avāpnoti khaṇḍaṃ caiva vrataṃ nayet |
khaṇḍavratāc ca nirayaṃ gatvā kalpaśataṃ sthitaḥ ||
yāto bhavati devarṣe khaṇḍasthānāṃ tu bhajanam |
yathāśaktyā naro dadyād gurave dakṣiṇāṃ sudhīḥ ||
guruṇā tatra vai kumbhe japaḥ kāryaḥ prayatnataḥ |
ekākṣareṇa mantreṇa yat toyaṃ cānumantrayet ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā jalarūpaṃ nyased ravim |
yasya romni sthitā meghāḥ sarvasandhiṣu nimnagāḥ ||
samudrāḥ kukṣimadhyasthāḥ sarvatīrthāṇi pādayoḥ |
evaṃ nyasya jale viṣṇuṃ tāṃ rātriṃ vāsayed vadan ||
evaṃ vadan jale nyasyety anvayaḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ tena toyena taṃ śiṣyaṃ snāpayed guruḥ |
tena snānena vidhivan mantrapūtena nārada ||
punar tu sarvatīrthāni sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ |
toyenādyābhiṣiñcantu sarvapāpavimuktaye ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto vaiṣṇavīṃ tu labhet tanum |
kṛtābhiṣekaḥ puṇyātmā samabyarcyātha keśavam ||
[1100] guruṃ jñānapradaṃ caiva bhojayed brāhmaṇaiḥ saha |
bhojayitvā dvijebhyo ‘tha dakṣiṇāṃ pratipādayet ||
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ pratimāsaṃ dvijottamam |
arcayet kīrtya nāmāni māsi māsi tathā śṛṇu ||
mārgaśīrṣe tu puṣye ca nāma nārāyaṇaṃ tathā |
māghe tu mādhavaṃ pūjya govindaṃ phālgune tathā ||
caitre ca keśavaṃ viṣṇuṃ vaiśākhe madhusūdanam |
jyaiṣṭhe trivikramaṃ devam āṣāḍhe vāmanaṃ mune ||
śrāvaṇe śrīdharākhyaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ nabhasy atha |
padmanābhaṃ cāśvayuje tasmād dāmodaraṃ tathā ||
evaṃ saṃkīrtya nāmāni dvādaśaiva yathākramam |
prīyatāṃ me hṛṣīkeśa ity uktvā praṇamet tataḥ ||
tato viprāya śāntāya savatsāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm |
kṛṣṇasya prītaye dadyād vratasyāsya ca siddhayet ||
upānahau ca vastrāṇi mudrikāṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
karṇamātrān ghaṭāṃs toyapūrṇāṃś ca saha modakaiḥ ||
dvādaśa dvādaśebhyaś ca viprebhyaś ca sadakṣiṇān |
anena vidhinā yas tu dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet ||
pūjayitvā hariṃ yānti viṣṇor lokam anāmayam |
nāmākhyadvādaśī hy etadvratānāṃ prathamaṃ mune ||
narais tribhir anuṣṭheyā toṣayadbhir janārdanam |
oṃkāraḥ sarvavedānāṃ yathādau paripaṭhyate ||
yaś caināṃ kīrtayed bhaktyā śṛṇoti śraddhayānvitaḥ |
[1101] tatsarvapāpanirmukto viṣṇuloke vrajaty asau ||
evaṃ kṛte yac ca phalaṃ labhate ca tad ucyate |
mānī dhanī jñānayuto ‘tha vipra-
kule pradhāne dhanadānyapūrṇe |
vivekavinyastasamastaduḥkhe
prāpnoti janmāvikalendriyaś ca ||
tasmāt tvam apy etad amoghavidyo
nārāyaṇārādhanam apramattaḥ |
kuruṣva viṣṇuṃ bhavantam īśam
ārādhyamānaś ca phalāny apaihi ||
dhāte tad uktvā hy abhavat sa tūṣṇīṃ
tadā sa vāgbhiḥ paripūjitaḥ san |
iti viṣṇurahasyoktanāmadvādaśīvratam |
agastya uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga śubhavratam anuttamam |
yena saṃprāpyate viṣṇuḥ śubhenaiva na saṃśayaḥ ||
māsi mārgaśire puṇye prathamābdāt samācaret |
ekabhaktaṃ site pakṣe yāvat syād daśamī tithiḥ ||
tato daśamyāṃ madhyāhne snātvā keśavam arcayet |
bhuktvā saṃkalpataḥ prāgvad dvādaśyāṃ śuddhamānasaḥ ||
keśaveti hariṃ pūjya dadyāt tatprītaye tilān |
[1102] sahiraṇyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ prayato nṛpa ||
tām apy evam uṣitvā ca yavān dadyād dvijātaye |
kṛṣṇāyeti harir vācyo dāne home tathārcane ||
cāturmāsyām athaivaṃ tu kṣapitvā rājasattama |
caitrādiṣu punas tadvad upoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
śaktupātrāṇi viprāṇāṃ sahiraṇyāni dāpayet |
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu tadvad govindam arcayet ||
triṣu māseṣu yāvat tu kārttikaḥ syād ihāgataḥ |
tam apy evaṃ kṣapayitvā daśamyāṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
arcayitvā hariṃ bhaktyā māsanāmnā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
priyadattetyādimantreṇa |
saṃkalpya kārayed bhaktyā dvādaśyāṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ yathā bhaktyā kārayet pṛthivīṃ nṛpa |
kāñcanīṃ saptapātālakulaparvatasaṃyutām ||
bhūvinyāsavidhānena sthāpayet tāṃ hareḥ puraḥ |
sitavastrayugachannāṃ sarvabījasamanvitām ||
saṃpūjya priyadatteti pañcagandhair vicakṣaṇaḥ |
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta prabhāte tu punar dvijān ||
āmantrya saṃkhyayā rājann ekaviṃśatināmataḥ |
teṣām ekaikaśo gāṃ ca anaḍvāhaṃ ca dāpayet ||
ekaikaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca ekaikaṃ cāṅgulīyakam |
kaṭakaṃ caiva sauvarṇaṃ karṇābharaṇam eva ca ||
[1103] ekaikaṃ grāmam eteṣāṃ rājā rājyaprado bhavet |
yathāvibhavasāreṇa tato gāṃ saṃpradāpayet ||
aśaktyā karaṇe caiva daridro ‘pi svaśaktitaḥ |
yathāśaktyā mahīṃ kṛtvā kāñcanīṃ goyugaṃ tathā ||
vastrayugmama athaikaṃ vā dadyād vibhavaśaktitaḥ |
goyugmāsaṃbhavāt sarvaṃ hiraṇyenaiva kārayet ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tathā kṛṣṇadvādaśyām evam eva tu |
raupyāṃ cet pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ ||
pradadyād brāhmaṇānāṃ tu tathā teṣāṃ tu bhojanam |
upānahau yathāśaktyā pāduke chatrikāṃ tathā ||
evaṃ dadyād vedavide kṛṣṇo dāmodaro mama |
prīyatāṃ sarvadevo ‘pi viśvarūpo harir mama ||
dāne ca bhojane caiva muktvā yat phalam aśnute |
na tac chakyaṃ sahasreṇa varṣāṇām api kīrtitum ||
śubhavratam idaṃ yas tu puṇyaṃ kuryān nareśvaraḥ |
sa sarvasaṃpadaṃ prāpya tato viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ śubhadvādaśīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga vrataṃ cānuttamaṃ śubham |
māsi cāśvayuje brahman yadā padmajasaṃnidhiḥ ||
nābhyāṃ niryāti jagatām īśituś cakradhāriṇaḥ |
tasmin ramye śubhe kāle yā śukaikādaśī bhavet ||
[1104] tasyāṃ samyag yajed viṣṇuṃ yena khaṇḍaṃ prapūryate |
yena viṣṇuprapūjanena khaṇḍam asaṃpūrṇaṃ dharmādibhiḥ paripūrṇaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ |
puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalair vāpi gandhavarṇasamanvitaiḥ |
oṣadhībhiś ca sarvābhir yāvatsthāvarasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
ghṛtaṃ tilān vrīhiyavān hiraṇyaṃ kanakādi ca |
maṇimuktāpravālāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ||
rasāś ca svādukatvamlakaṣāyalavaṇāni ca |
tiktāni ca nivedyāni tāny akhaṇḍāni yāni hi ||
tatpūjārthaṃ pradātavyaṃ keśavāya mahātmane |
yena saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇam akhaṇḍaṃ jāyate gṛhe ||
kṛtopavāso devarṣe dvitīye ‘hani sarvataḥ |
snānena tena snāyīta yenākhaṇḍaṃ hi vatsaram ||
siddhārthakais tilair vāpi tenaivodvartanaṃ smṛtam |
haviṣā padmanābhasya snānam eva samācaret ||
home tad eva gadito dāne śaktyā dvijottama |
pūjayec cātha kusumaiḥ pādād ārabhya keśavam ||
dhūpayed vidhivad dhūpaṃ yena syād vatsaraṃ param |
hiraṇyaratnavāsobhiḥ pūjayet taṃ jagadgurum ||
sarasadravacūṣyāṇi haviṣyāṇi nivedayet |
prathamaikādaśyāṃ yena dravyeṇa yat karma niṣpāditaṃ śeṣāsv ekādaṣīṣu tenaiva dravyeṇānyan niṣpādyam |
[1105] tataḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ padmanābhaṃ jagadgurum |
vijñāyayen muniśreṣṭha mantreṇānena suvrata ||
namo ‘stu padmanābhāya padmāvaha mahādyute |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇi akhaṇḍāni bhavantu me ||
vikāsipadmapatrākṣa yathākhaṇḍo ‘si sarvataḥ |
tena sarveṇa dharmādyās tv akhaṇḍāḥ santu keśava ||
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
akhaṇḍaṃ pārayed brahman vrate vai sarvavastuṣu ||
asmiṃś cīrṇe vrate vyaktaṃ parituṣyati mādhavaḥ |
dharmārthakāmamokṣādyāḥ svecchayā saṃbhavanti ca ||
iti vāmanapurāṇoktākhaṇḍadvādaśīvratam |
munaya ūcuḥ |
kumbhikāvratam asmākaṃ prabrūhi munisattama |
yathā jāgaraṇaṃ tasyāṃ yathā vai devapūjanam ||
yad devaṃ yat phalaṃ tasyāṃ tad brūhi munisattama |
śaunaka uvāca |
ativratam idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśana |
śrāvayet puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devānām api durlabham ||
ekādaśyāṃ kārttikasya śuklapakṣe tu kārayet |
kumbhyādinarakebhyas tu uddharet svam aśeṣataḥ ||
prayatnāt kārttike māsi viṣṇor agre tu jāgaram |
[1106] suśuklaikādaśīṃ rātrau viśeṣād arcayanti ca ||
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ gomayenopalipya ca |
caturbhiḥ śāligodhūmavarṇakair upaśobhitam ||
snātvā nārāyaṇaṃ pūjya sthaṇḍīle pratimāsu ca |
hutvā diśāṃ baliṃ datvā vidhānam avadhārayet ||
dīpamālānvitaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayet tataḥ |
kumbhīṃ devamayīṃ dhyatvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
kumbhīnāma prasiddhā |
yadā sukumopetā kumbhī kalmaṣanāśinī |
tasyā mūle sthito viṣṇus tadūrdhve ca pitāmahaḥ ||
skandhe ca saṃsthito rudra ante ca tripurāntakaḥ |
indravāyusamāyuktaśākhāsu ṛṣayas tathā ||
parṇe caranti devāś ca mūleṣu marutaḥ smṛtāḥ |
sarvadevanamaskāryā sarvavratakarī smṛtā ||
sarvadevanamaskāryā sarvavratakarī smṛtā ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kāryaṃ vai kumbikāvratam |
sadā jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ nṛtyagītapuraḥsaraṃ ||
dampatyoḥ paridhānaṃ ca pūjā ca madhusūdana |
yathāśakti tathā deyā dakṣiṇā pāpanāśanī ||
ya evaṃ kurute kaścit kumbhījāgaraṇaṃ śubham |
mantreṇa pūjayet kumbhīṃ kumbhījāgaraṇaṃ śubham ||
vallīṃ svarṇamayīṃ kṛtvā raupyaṃ ca puṣpam eva ca |
sauvarṇaṃ kesaraṃ caiva nānāphalasamāyutam ||
[1107] lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ caiva sauvarṇaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā kumbhīkāyāḥ samīpataḥ ||
īśe tvaṃ daivataiḥ pūrvaṃ preṣitā bhuvanāgatā |
gṛhāna pūjāṃ bhadraṃte sarvakāryārthasiddhaye ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
phalapuṣpākṣatais toyaiḥ karpūraiś candanena ca |
raupyapātre ca śaṅkhe vā dadyād arghyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me devi sarvapāpapraṇāśanī |
arghyaṃ tubhyaṃ mayā dattaṃ kumbhīkāyai namo ‘stu te ||
arghyamantraḥ |
tvanmātā sarvabhūtānāṃ tvam eva parameśvarī |
vidyā paramavidyānāṃ sarvabhūtavaśaṃkarī ||
putrasaubhāgyadā devī sarvasaukhyahitaiṣiṇī |
matsyāya pādau saṃpūjya ūrū kūrmāya vai tathā ||
varāhāya kaṭiṃ pūjya nṛsiṃhāya uras tathā |
vāmanāya ca kaṇṭhaṃ ca bhujau rāmadvayena ca ||
rāmanāmnā ca netre tu buddhanāmnaḥ śrias tathā |
kalkināmnā tathā keśān vāmanāyeti sarvataḥ ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
jaya viṣṇo jayānanta jaya vāmanarūpadhṛk |
[1108] savatsāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ śubhāṃ yajñopavītinīm ||
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ saghaṇṭikām |
kāmsyopadohnayutāṃ sitacandanacarītām ||
muktvā phalasrajandivyāṃ hiraṇyoparisaṃsthiām |
hiraṇyaṃ vācayitāgre brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
nandācaivopananḍā ca suśīlā surabhī tathā ||
gāvo mama gṛhe santu gāvo me lokamātaraḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā naktaṃ vā vyād upoṣaṇam ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sakalaṃ prāpnuyāt phalam |
sa putrapaśuratnāni akṣayāṇi pitāmaha ||
saptakalpasahasrāṇi saptakalpaśatāni ca |
kurvīta kumbhīvratam idaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ kumbhīvratam |
dālbhya uvāca |
alpāyāsena viprarṣe dānenālpena vā vibho |
pāpapraśamam āyāti yena tad vaktum arhasi ||
pulastya uvāca |
śṛṇu dālbhya parāṃ puṇyāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśanīm |
yām upoṣya paraṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyāc chraddhayānvitaḥ ||
[1109] māghamāse tu saṃprāpte āṣāḍharkṣyaṃ bhaved yadi |
mūlaṃ vā kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ ||
gṛhṇīyāt puṇyaphaladaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya me śṛṇu |
devadevaṃ samabhyarcya susnātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
kṛṣṇanāmnā tu saṃpūjya ekādaśyāṃ mahāmatiḥ |
upoṣito dvitīye ‘hni punaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam ||
saṃstūya nāmnā tenaiva kṛṣṇākhyena punaḥ punaḥ |
dadyāt tilāṃs tu viprāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatām iti ||
snānaprāśanayoḥ śastās tathā kṛṣṇatilā mune |
viṣṇuprīṇanamantraiś ca samāpte varṣapāraṇe ||
kṛṣṇakumbhās tilaiḥ sārdhaṃ pakvānnena ca saṃyutāḥ |
chatropanadyugaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvītā (?) ratnagarbhiṇaḥ ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ pradeyās te yathāvanma sasaṃvyayā (?) |
kṛṣṇāṃ ca gāṃ brāhmaṇāya pītavastrāṃ payasvinīm ||
chatropanadyugaṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇo me prīyatām iti |
tilaprarohajāḥ kṣetre yāvatsaṃkhyās tilā dvijāḥ ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate |
arogo jāyate nityaṃ naro janmani janmani ||
andho na ca vihīnāṅgo na kuṣṭhī na ca kutsitaḥ |
bhavaty etām uṣitvā tu tilākhyāṃ dvādaśīṃ naraḥ ||
viṣṇuprīṇanamantroktyā samāpte varṣapāraṇe |
pūjāṃ ca kuryād viprāya bhūyo dadyāt tathā tilān ||
anena vidhinā dālbhya tiladānān na saṃśayaḥ |
[1110] mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair anāyāsena mānavaḥ ||
dānaṃ vidhis tathā śraddhā sarvapātakaśāntaye |
nārthaprabhūto nāyāsaḥ śarīre munisattama ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ tiladvādaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śaratalpagataṃ bhīṣmaṃ paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
vratena yena puṇyena yamaloko na dṛśyate ||
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi śokaṃ caiva na paśyati |
tan mamācakṣva dharmajña pitāmaha kṛpāṃ kuru ||
bhīṣma uvāca |
ekādaśī vaitaraṇī yā tāṃ kṛtvā sukhī bhava |
yamalokaṃ na paśye ca śokaṃ caiva na vindati ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kena tāta vidhānena kartavyā sā mahāphalā |
pitāmaha samākhyāhi tadvidhānaṃ mama prabho ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ekādaśī tithiḥ kṛṣṇā mārgaśīrṣagatā nṛpa |
tām āsādya naraḥ samyag gṛhṇīyān niyamaṃ śuciḥ ||
ekādaśī tithiḥ kṛṣṇā nāmnā vaitaraṇī śubhā |
sā vratena mayā kāryā varṣaṃ naktaparā sitā ||
madhyāhne tu naraḥ snātvā nityaṃ nirvartitakriyaḥ |
[1111] rātrau surabhim ānīya kṛṣṇām arcet yathāvidhi ||
pūrvābhimukhy abhidhātavyā kṛṣṇā gaur liptabhūtale |
agrapādāditaḥ pūjyā paścāt pādadvayāvadhi ||
gopucchaṃ tu samāsādya kuru vai pitṛtarpaṇam |
tataḥ pūjā prakartavyā śāstradṛṣṭavidhānataḥ ||
gāṃ caiva śraddhayā yuktaś candanenānulepayet |
gandhatoyena caraṇau śṛṅge prakṣālya bhaktitaḥ ||
tato tu pūjayed bhaktyā puṣpair gandhādivāsinaiḥ |
mantraiḥ purāṇasaṃproktair yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhi ||
tatra pūjāmantraḥ |
gor agrarādābhyāṃ namaḥ | gor āsyāya namaḥ | goḥ śṛṅgābhyāṃ namaḥ | goḥ skandhābhyāṃ namaḥ | gopucchāya namaḥ | go’grapādābhyāṃ namaḥ | goḥ sarvāṅgebhyo namaḥ |
sthāneṣv eteṣu gandhāṃś ca prakṣipec chuddhamānasaḥ |
paścāt pradāpayed dhūpaṃ gaur dīpaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
asipatrādikaṃ ghoraṃ nadīvaitaraṇīṃ tathā |
prasādāt te tariṣyāmi gomātas te namo namaḥ ||
sukhena tīryate yasmān nadī vaitaraṇī dhruvam |
tasmād ekādaśīṃ kṛtvā nāmnā vaitaraṇī bhavet ||
ānandakṛt sarvaloke devānāṃ ca sadā priyā |
gaus tvaṃ pāhi jagannāthe dīpo ‘yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
dīpamantraḥ |
ācchādanaṃ gave dadyāt samyak śuddhaṃ sunirmalam |
[1112] surabhir vastradānena prīyatāṃ parameśvarī ||
ācchādanamantraḥ |
mārgaśīrṣādike bhaktaṃ yāvan māsacatuṣṭayam |
anyan māsacatuṣkaṃ tu yavakāśanam eva ca ||
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu caturṣv adyāc ca pāyasam |
tad annasya trayo bhānāḥ goguru svārtham eva ca ||
naivedyaṃ hi mayā dattaṃ surabhi prīyatām iti |
dvitīyaṃ gurave dadyāt tṛtīyaṃ svayam eva ca ||
māsān māsaṃ prakurvīta māsadvādaśakaṃ vratam |
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt pūrṇe saṃvatsare sadā ||
śayyā satūlikā kāryā dampatyoḥ paridhānakam |
savatsā kṛṣṇavarṇā tu dhenuḥ kāryā payasvinī ||
sauvarṇī pūjayen mantraiḥ pūrvoktair bhaktisaṃyutaiḥ |
tatas tu gurave dadyāt sarvaṃ tatra kṣamāpayet ||
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
rājyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhuktvā svargaloke mahīyate ||
bhāro lohasya dātavyaḥ kāryo ‘sau droṇasaṃmitaḥ |
vaitaraṇyāṃ samāptyarthaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭimbine ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ vaitaraṇīvratam |
[1113] yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
meghāvṛte ‘mbare deva prāvṛṭkāle hy upasthite |
dardurārāvabhūyiṣṭhe kekānādaninādite ||
kiṃ vrataṃ tatra kartavyaṃ strībhiḥ puṃbhir athāpi vā |
brūhi me tat sopavāsaḥ sarvanāmāni mantrakam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
prakṛte śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe samāhitaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ śucir bhūtvā snātvā sarvaiṣadhījalaiḥ ||
māṣacūrṇena rājendra kuryād indurikāśatam |
modakāṃś ca tathā pañca ghṛtaprasthaḥ sunirmalaḥ ||
ātmopayogam uddiśya tato gatvā jalāśayam |
duṣṭayādovirahitam abjopetajalair vṛtam ||
tasyaiva puline ramye jalānte gomayādinā |
kṛtvā maṇḍakaṃ vṛttaṃ piṣṭakādibhir arcitam ||
carcitaṃ gandhakusumair dhūpadīpākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ |
tatra candraṃ likhet pārśve rohiṇyā sahitaṃ bhuvi ||
arcayīta śubhārthena mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ |
somarāja namas tubhyaṃ rohiṇyā te namo namaḥ ||
mahāsati mahādevi saṃpādaya mamepsitam |
itthaṃ saṃpūjya tasyāgre naivedyaṃ deyam arcitam ||
tac caivaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāt somo naḥ prīyatām iti |
prīyatām iti me devi rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā ||
evam uccārya tad datvā taj jalaṃ svayam āviśet |
[1114] kaṇṭhāntaṃ jalamātraṃ vā jānugulphāntam eva vā ||
dhyāyate somarājaṃ ca rohiṇīsahitaṃ vibhum |
jalastham eva bhuñjīta svayam indurikāśatam ||
pañca modakān ghṛtaprasthasyeti śeṣaḥ |
yāvat samastaṃ tad bhuktaṃ bhuktvā tat taṭasaṃsthitaḥ |
nivedya vācanaṃ vācyaṃ tato viprāya bhojanam ||
dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ dadyāt svaśaktyā paridhānakam |
bhaktyā paramayā pārtha vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
yaḥ karoti naro rājan nārī vātha kumārikā |
varṣe varṣe vidhānena parthedaṃ rohiṇīvratam ||
ihaloke ciraṃ sthitvā dhanadhānyasamākule |
gṛhāśrame śubhe pārtha putrapautrādisaṃyute ||
tataḥ sutīrthamaraṇaṃ labdhvā viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet |
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sthitvā bhuktvā bhogān anuttamān ||
iha cābhyetya rājāsau jāyate janavallabhaḥ ||
khe rohiṇī śaśibhṛtā vihṛtā hitā
yat kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu narendra nivedayāmi |
satpiṣṭamāṣaracitendurikāśataṃ yad
muktaṃ jale guḍaghṛtena phalaṃ tad eva ||
goḍo modakaḥ |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ rohiṇīdvādaśīvratam |
[1115] yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇe śrīvatsa garuḍāsana |
mallākhyadvādaśīṃ brūhi kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca kiṃ phalam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi devarṣipitṛsevite |
yadā ca baṇḍīravaṭe ramāmi yamunātaṭe ||
gopālamadhye govastair aṣṭavarṣo ‘smi līlayā |
kaṃsāsuravadhārthāya yamunopavane tadā ||
avalovālarūpeṇa gopamallair valotkaṭaiḥ |
ta eva mallagopāś ca balena saha kānane ||
āṣphoṭayanti nṛtyanti tridive tridaśā iva |
subhadro mandulīgaṇḍasvargovardhanagāyanaḥ ||
pakṣendrabhaṭa ityādi teṣāṃ nāmāni gokule |
gopīnām api nāmāni prādhānyena ca bodhayet ||
gopālī pālikā dhanyā viśākhānyā viniścikā |
gandhānugandhā sīmābhā tārakā daśamī tathā ||
ity evamādibhir aham upaveśya varāsane |
pūjito ‘smi śubhaiḥ puṣpair dadhidūrvākṣatais tathā ||
śatānāṃ trīṇi puṣpāṇi mallānāṃ pūjayanti mām |
mallaiś caiva surāgaiś ca raṅgajā maranartanaiḥ ||
mallayuddhair bahuvidhair mattamallabhaṭaiḥ sphuṭaiḥ (?) |
bhakṣyair bhojyais tathā pānair dadhidugdhaghṛtāśanaiḥ ||
snehasaṅkarṣaṇair hāsyaiḥ karṣaṇakrīḍane mithaḥ |
[1116] evaṃ dvādaśa kartavyāḥ smartavyāḥ susamāhitaiḥ ||
mallair viśeṣataḥ kāryās tathānyair api bhaktitaḥ |
pūjayanti krameṇaiva māsi māsi tanūr mama ||
mārgaśīrṣādibhiḥ pārtha pūjayen māsanāmabhiḥ |
pāraṇe pāraṇe dadyān mallikāni dvijātaye ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpais tathā dīpair gītavādyair manoharaiḥ |
mallayuddhaiś ca vividhair jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi ||
ghṛtadānaiḥ kṣīradānair dadhidānaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
sarvatra devadeveśaḥ kṛṣṇo me prīyatām iti ||
evam eva vidhiḥ prokto mantradānasamanvitaḥ |
dvādaśīyaṃ mayādyāpi kriyate balavṛddhaye ||
mallānāṃ jayadā yasmān malladvādaśisaṃjñitā |
tasmān mallaiḥ prakartavyā mallayuddhajayārthibhiḥ ||
anyeṣām api kaunteya sarvārthajayadāyinī |
imāṃ cīrtvā pāpasaṅghair mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
araṇye syād yato bhojyaṃ dattaṃ tais tu parasparam |
krameṇa pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha tenaiṣāraṇyadvādaśī |
eṣaiva mārgaśīrṣe tu gṛhītā pārtha mānavaiḥ ||
dvādaśisaṃjñā tu vikhyātā dvādaśī bhuvanatraye |
yasyāḥ prabhāvād rājendra gopagokulasaṅkulāḥ ||
ajāvigomahiṣyādidhanadhānyasamṛddhibhiḥ |
imāṃ pāpaharāṃ puṇyāṃ nāmākhyadvādaśīṃ nṛpaḥ ||
ye kariṣyanti madbhaktās teṣāṃ dāsyāmi hṛdgatam |
[1117] ārogyaṃ balam aiśvaryaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ ca śāśvatam |
bhaṇḍīrapādapatale militair mahadbhir
mallair anākulabāhubalaṃ niyuddhaiḥ |
saṃpūjitaḥ sapadi yatra tithau tataś ca
sā dvādaśī bhuvi gatā valamallasaṃjñā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ malladvādaśīvratam |
maitreya uvāca |
upavāsavratānāṃ tu vaikalyaṃ yan mahāmate |
dānakarmakṛtaṃ tasya vipāko vada yādṛśaḥ ||
yājñavalkya uvāca |
yajñānām upavāsānāṃ vratānāṃ ca yatavrataḥ |
vaikalyāt phalavaikalyaṃ yādṛśaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me ||
upavāsādinā rājyaṃ prāptāś cānye tathā vasu ||
bhraṣṭaiś caryā nirdhanāś ca bhavanti puruṣāḥ punaḥ |
rūpaṃ tathottamaṃ prāpya vratavaikalyadoṣataḥ ||
kāṇāḥ kubjāś ca bhūyas te bhavanty andhāś ca mānavāḥ |
upavāsān naraḥ patnīṃ nārī vāpi tathā patim ||
viyogavratavaikalyād ubhayaṃ tad avāpnute |
ye ‘pi havye satyadārās tathānye satyanagnayaḥ ||
kule vasati duḥśīlā duṣkule śīlinaś ca ye |
vastrānulepanair hīnā bhūṣaṇaiś cātirūpiṇaḥ ||
virūparūpāś ca tathā prasādhanaguṇānvitāḥ |
[1118] sarve te vratavaikalyāt phalavaikalyatāṃ gatāḥ ||
tasmād vrate tathā dāne yajñe vopoṣite tathā |
vaikalyaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ vaikalyād vikalaṃ phalam ||
maitreya uvāca |
kathaṃcid yadi vaikalyam upavāsādike bhavet |
kiṃ tatra vada kartavyaṃ niśchidraṃ yena jāyate ||
yājñavalkya uvāca |
akhaṇḍadvādaśīm etāṃ samas teṣv api karmasu |
vaikalyaśamanāyālaṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama ||
mārgaśīrṣe ‘male pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
kṛtopavāso deveśaṃ samabhyarcya janārdanam ||
snāto nārāyaṇaṃ vakti bhuñjan nārāyaṇaṃ tathā |
bhuñjan nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svapan nārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ ||
pañcagavyajalasnāto viṣṇuṃ dhyātvā jitendriyaḥ |
yavavrīhibhṛtaṃ pātraṃ datvā viprāya bhaktitaḥ ||
idam uccārayet paścād devasya purato hareḥ |
saptajanmani yat kiṃcin mayā khaṇḍavrataṃ kṛtam ||
bhagavaṃs tvatprasādena tad akhaṇḍam ihāstu me |
yathākhaṇḍajagatsarvaṃ tvam eva puruṣottama ||
tathākhilāny akhaṇḍāni vratāni mama santu vai |
evaṃ me tvatprabhāveṇa kāmāvāptis tu sāṃpratam ||
evaṃ māsānumāsaṃ ca cāturvarṇyavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
caturbhir eva māsais tu pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam ||
[1119] prīṇanaṃ ca hareḥ kuryāt pāraṇe pāraṇe punaḥ |
caitrādiṣu tu māseṣu caturtheṣv eva pāraṇam ||
tatrāpi śaktupātrāṇi dadyāt śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu kārttikānteṣu pāraṇam ||
tatrāpi ghṛtapātrāṇi (?) dadyād viprāya śaktitaḥ |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ pātram iṣyate ||
svaśaktyapekṣayā rājan pālāśambātha kārayet |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte brāhmaṇān saṃyatendriyān ||
āmantritān dvādaśa vai bhojayed ghṛtapāyasaiḥ |
vastrābharaṇadānaiś ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
upadeṣṭāram api ca pūjayed vidhivad gurūn |
gāṃ ca datvā nṛpaśreṣṭha praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
evaṃ samyag yathānyāyam akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ naraḥ |
samupoṣyānakhaṇḍasya vratasya phalam aśnute ||
saptajanmāni vaikalyaṃ yadvratasya kvacit kṛtam |
karoty akhaṇḍam akhilam akhaṇdadvādaśī yataḥ ||
tasmād eṣā prayatnena naraiḥ strībhiś ca suvrate |
akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ samyag upoṣya phalakāṅkṣayā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottare akhaṇḍadvādaśīvratam | viṣṇudharmottaroktam udyāpanam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
nāradena purā viṣṇur akhaṇḍadvādaśīvratam |
[1120] udyāpanavidhiṃ pṛṣṭaḥ kathayāmāsa taṃ śṛṇu ||
nārada uvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa purāṇapuruṣotama |
kaccit pṛcchāmi saṃdehaṃ kāruṇyāt kathaya prabho ||
akhaṇḍadvādaśī yāsau purāṇe kathitā tu yā |
sā sarvavratakhaṇḍānāṃ pūraṇāya kim ucyate ||
yathā sarvavratānāṃ tu vaikalyaṃ pūryate prabho |
tasyā udyāpanavidhir na samyak kathitas tvayā ||
na tatpraśnasya vaktāsti śrītā vāpi sudrlabhaḥ |
viṣnur uvāca |
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śuklapakṣe śucivrataḥ |
daśamyāṃ keśavaṃ pūjya haviṣyānnakṛtāśanaḥ ||
nirvartya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ gṛhṇīyād dantadhāvanam |
upaspṛśya yathānyāyaṃ mantram etam udīrayet ||
kṛṣṇa viṣṇo hṛṣīkeśa keśava kleśanāśana |
kariṣye ‘haṃ vratārambhaṃ bhaved yāvad dinatrayam ||
iti saṃprārthya govindaṃ mantreṇādau tataḥ svapet ||
vratagrahaṇamantraḥ |
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya yathoktaṃ vratam ācaret |
caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ kathitaṃ yad dvijottama ||
tatpātradānavidhinā bhidyate na hi pāraṇam |
evaṃ dvādaś nirvartya dvādaśīḥ padmabhodbhava ||
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryād vidhimantrapuraskṛtam |
[1121] ekādaśyāṃ śuciḥ snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharo vratī ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yat phalam |
tvatpādapadmatoyena sarvaṃ me bhavatu prabho ||
iti snānamantraḥ |
snānaṃ kṛtvā tato devaṃ pūjayed garuḍadhvajam |
ekatra mūrtisaṃpannaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||
yathāśaktyā prakurvīta sauvarṇaṃ ratnabhūṣitam |
sahasraśīrṣāmantreṇa snāpayed gandhavāriṇā ||
madhuvātādibhir mantrair madhunā snāpayed dharim |
yathāryamnetimantreṇa kṣīreṇa snāpayet tataḥ ||
evaṃ snāne kṛte paścāt pūjāṃ kartuṃ samārabhet |
candanośīrakarpūrakuṅkumādibhir arcayet ||
tair vilipya hariṃ bhaktyā tato mantram udīrayet |
yathāśaktyā mayā deva snāpitaś cānulepitaḥ ||
nyūnātiriktaṃ tat sarvaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ kṣamet ||
anulepanamantraḥ |
tato vastrayugaṃ śreṣṭham ānīya paridhāpayet |
pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vāpi śvetaṃ nānāvicitritam ||
paridhānaṃ yathāśaktyā tava deva samarpitam |
nyūnātiriktaṃ tat sarvaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ kṣamet ||
iti paridhānamantraḥ |
paridhāpya tato devaṃ puṣpair nānāvidhaiḥ śūbhaiḥ |
[1122] saṃchādya puṣpamālābhir mantram etam udīrayet ||
puṣpair api yathāśaktyā pūjito ‘si janārdana |
nūnātiriktaṃ tat sarvaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ kṣamet ||
iti puṣpārcanamantraḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena śayyāṃ caiva nivedayet |
tūlīparyaṅkayuktāṃ tu chedapracchedagūḍakaiḥ ||
pratipādasamārūḍhaiḥ catuḥpādapratiṣṭhitaiḥ |
niveśya tatra deveśaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ śubham ||
naivedyādinivedyāni nānābhakṣyayutāni ca |
lehyāny abhyavahāryāṇi cūṣyāṇi carvaṇāni ca ||
pānakāni ca vai yatnād yasmin deśe yatha tathā |
tāni sarvāṇy upādāya devāya vinivedayet ||
phalāni ca sugandhīni pakvānnāni nivedayet |
evaṃ nivedya tat sarvaṃ bhaktyā mantram udīrayet ||
yathāvittopasaṃyuktaṃ mayā tava niveditam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇa vibho bhaktyā tat pratigṛhyatām ||
iti naivedyadānaṃ tu bhaktyā devasya kārayet |
devasya tu śiraḥ pūrvaṃ pādau paścāt prakalpayet ||
śiraḥsthāne tataḥ kumbhaṃ vāripūrṇaṃ manoharam |
sthāpayet karkaṭīyuktaṃ saratnaṃ vastrabhūṣitam ||
sthāpayitvā tu taṃ kumbhaṃ tato mantram udīrayet |
[1123] bhuktvā pītvā tathācamya toyenānena keśava |
madbhaktyā prītito deva sutṛptaḥ sumukhaḥ svayam ||
iti sthāpanamantraḥ |
śayyopacāraṃ yat kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ vinivedayet |
yāvat pūjā samārabdhā snānadānāśanāntikāḥ ||
saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ tāvad dahed devāgrato niśi |
tato vipraṃ samānīya bhāryayā sahitaṃ śubham ||
sarvadurlakṣaṇair hīnaṃ sāṅgopāṅgasamanvitam |
vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ pūjitaḥ svakulodbhavaiḥ ||
devasyānte tato vipraṃ bhāryayā sahitaṃ nyaset |
prāṅmukhaṃ vimalaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktyā taṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||
bahunā kiṃ pralāpena kathiteneha nārada |
devaḥ saṃpūjito yadvat tadvad vipraṃ ca pūjayet ||
viṣṇubrāḥmaṇayor bhedaṃ na kadācid vikalpayet |
iti yeṣāṃ hṛdi sadā pūjyā viprā yatīśvarāḥ ||
dvādaśānyāṃs tathā kumbhān pūrṇān śuddhena vāriṇa |
snāpayed devaparyaṅkoparitaḥ śubhacetasā ||
dvādaśaiva tathā gāvaḥ savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ |
kṣīravatsaḥ suśīlāś ca sthāpayed devasaṃnidhau ||
atha vā vittavaikalye kuryād gotritayaṃ naraḥ |
dadyāt tu samyak bhaktāya tatrāśaktim ataḥ sataḥ ||
ekāpyam (?) uttamaguṇā tasya sā dvādaśādhikā |
[1124] svavittaśaktyā yat kiṃcid dātum utsahate naraḥ ||
tat sarvaṃ dvijadevābhyāṃ saṃnidhau saṃprakalpayet |
upaskarāṇi dānāni chatropānatprapādukāḥ ||
gosaṃkhyādikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ dānaṃ tasmin prakalpayet |
yadā dānena gaur ekakalpā śaktiprapūrvakam ||
sā saṃpūrṇā tu kartavyā vatsena saha pūjitā |
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇasaṃyutām ||
tadvarṇavastrasaṃvītāṃ vatsena saha pūjayet |
evaṃ nirvartya vidhinā snānapūjādinā samam ||
devabrāhmaṇayor bhaktyā tato viprān kṣamāpayet |
etad gṛhāṇ me vipra bhāryayā sahitaḥ prabho ||
etenāvāhya taṃ vipraṃ tasmin sarvaṃ nivedayat |
pratigrahītā dātā ca vratī viṣṇur yathā tathā ||
mayā dattaṃ idaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhāṇ tvaṃ dvijottama ||
dānamantraḥ |
dātā ca viṣṇur bhagavān antataḥ
pratigrahītā sa ca eva viṣṇuḥ |
tasmāt tvayā dattam idaṃ hi sarvam
pratigṛhītaṃ ca mayā śubhāya ||
brāhmaṇamantraḥ |
anyebhyo ‘pi yathāśaktyā tasmin kāle pradīyate |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇādibhyas tadakṣayaphalaṃsmṛtam ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta samagraphalam āpnuyāt |
[1125] ity akhaṇḍavratasyaiva udyāpanavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
kathitas te mayā vatsa tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
yāvaj jagaj jaladhiśailadharādi tāvat
tat santatir bhavati puṇyaphalopabhoktī |
tāvan na viṣṇubhavanāt parivartate ‘sau
ante layaṃ ca paramātmani yāti viṣṇau ||
ity akhaṇḍadvādaśyā upāyanavidhiḥ |
yatas tad durlabhaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām |
nāradena purā prāptaṃ sakāśāc cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
na ca vyūhaṃ paraṃ pātraṃ svayaṃ devena bhāṣitam |
tad vadasva guru tvaṃ me kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mayi ||
markaṇḍeya uvāca |
śvetadvīpasthito viṣṇuḥ purā devāsurarṣiṇā (?) |
ārādhito harir bhaktyā varṣāṇāṃ koṭayas tu ṣaṭ ||
prasannas tasya devarṣeḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
prādurbhūtvābravīd vākyaṃ nāradaṃ munisattamam ||
brūhi nārada devarṣe varado ‘smi tavānagha |
matsakāśād varo yas te cirāt samabhikāṅkṣitaḥ ||
nārada uvāca |
vedaśāstrāṇi vedāṅgadharmaśāstrāṇi vā prabho |
adhītāni mayā samyak sakāśāt padmayonitaḥ ||
[1126] na śrutaṃ hi mayā devapūjane naitad uttamam |
tattvānāṃ ca samuddhāram aṅgānāṃ ca tathārcanam ||
yajñaṃ ca vibhavaṃ yajñe bhuktimuktiphalapradam |
yadi te ‘sti dayā deva kṛṣṇa me tad vada prabho (?) ||
śrībhagavān ucāca |
ādau tu maṇḍapaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvaikamanā mune |
yat praviṣya naro yāti tat sthānaṃ paramaṃ mama ||
kasyacit śuklapakṣaḥ syād ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
pumṛkṣalagnasaṃyoge yajñaṃ kurvīta vaiṣṇavam ||
phālgunāṣāḍhaśuklāyāṃ kārttikyāṃ grahaṇe ‘pi vā |
ekādaśyāṃ saṅkrāntyau kartavyaṃ yajanaṃ mama ||
yathā copanataṃ śiṣyaṃ śraddadhānaṃ jitendriyam |
sarvasattvahitaṃ viprabhaktaṃ ca suparīkṣitam ||
yajñas tadaiva kartavyo bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ |
śaivāya calacittāya hiṃsakāyājitātmane ||
mama yajño na dātavyo prārthamānasya kasyacit |
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ saguṇāṃ yajñārthaṃ prāgudakplavām ||
mantrayet prathamaṃ tasyās tataḥ kurvīta maṇḍapam (?) |
aṅgāratuṣakeśāsthivalmīkakṛmisaṃkulām ||
saśalyām ūṣarāṃ bhūmaṃ yatnena parivarjayet |
nīlāṃ pītāṃ tathā raktāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ hi saṃtyajet ||
ācāryo vaiṣṇavo yajñaṃ kartum arhati yogavit |
anyadaranasaṃlīnaṃ śūdraṃ saṅkarajaṃ śaṭham |
[1127] akāryakāriṇaḥ sarvān ācāryān dūratas tyajet ||
tataḥ pravartayet samyak maṇḍāpaṃ muktidāyakam |
ācāryaḥ kavacaṃ kṛtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ tv abhayapradam ||
pratimāyāṃ kṛtau pūrvaṃ catuḥkoṇapuraṃ likhet |
dvāraiś caturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ samare khāṅkitaṃ śubham ||
tasya madhye sthitaṃ padmam aṣṭapatraṃ tu vartulam |
pītā sauvarṇikā tasya raktakesararañjitā ||
puradvārāṇi śuklān koṇān raktena rañjayet |
caturo vinyasec chaṅkhān ślakṣān padmasya koṇagān ||
pūrayed raktapuṣpais tu antaraṃ purapadmayoḥ |
āyudhāni digīśānāṃ vilikhed vāgyataḥ pumān ||
vajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ gadāṃ |
śūlaṃjite digīśānāṃ svāsu dikṣu vinirdiśet ||
varṇādi vinyaset tattvaṃ vāsudevākhyam avyayam |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ karṇikāyāṃ mahāprabhum ||
pūrvoktāntare varṇaṃ raktaṃ pūrvadale sthitam |
tattvaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ caiva sarvalokeṣu pūjitam ||
ādyaṃ bindusamāyuktaṃ viśuddhakanakaprabham |
āgneye tu dale tattavaṃ (?) prāṅmukhaṃ tu vinirdiśet ||
savisargaṃ tathaivādyaṃ bhinnāñjanasamanvitam |
khavarṇāt saptamaṃ varṇaṃ yāmye binduvibhūṣitam ||
tattvaṃ nārāyaṇākhyaṃ tu nyasen naiṛtidigdale |
[1128] sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ tattvaṃ raktākhyaṃ kusumaprabham ||
īśāne ca dale pūjyaṃ vāmanaṃ tattvam avyayam |
ākārāṇi navaitāni namo’ntāni tapodhana ||
khyātāni navatattvāni navavyūheti śabditam |
aṅgāni vāsya mukhyāni navavyūhasya sattama ||
vāhanāny āyudhānāṃ ca samyag bhogaṃ yathādiśet |
vainateyaṃ garutmantaṃ pakṣirājam anuttamam ||
maṇḍapasya nyased dvāsi pūrvaṃ caiva tathāpare |
taṃ thaṃ raṃ huṃ phaḍ iti cakraṃ trailokyavanditam ||
sudarśanamahāvīraṃ nyaset pīṭhasya dakṣiṇe |
khaṃ dhaṃ phaṃ yaṃ kṣaṃ gadāṃ devī maṃ śaṃ śaktiṃ sudurjayām ||
uttare tu nyased dvāri pūrvaṃ caiva tathā pare |
balavantaṃ mahāśaṅkhaṃ mṛṇālarajataprabham ||
pīṭhasya paścime bhāge pāñcajanyaṃ vinirdiśet |
padmahastāṃ śriyaṃ devīṃ svāhākāraṃ padmabhūṣitām ||
vāme caināṃ parākāntiṃ nyaset pīṭhasya dakṣiṇe |
maṇḍapaṃ ca catuḥṣaṣṭisattvavīryabalapradam ||
gaṇaiśaṃ śāśvatīṃ chāyāṃ nyaset pīṭhasya cottare |
varvaṇodgamāmālāṃ (?) ca bhūṣaṇāya mamottamā ||
pīṭhasya paścime bhāge nyasec ca mama saṃnidhau |
kṣataṃ kṣatraṃ vavaṃ rukṣaṃ kaustubhaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mama ||
paścime vinyaset tatra paścime munisattama |
[1129] taṃ maṃ yaṃ śaṃ mahābhogaṃ phaṇāmaṇivibhūṣaṇa ||
ādhāraḥ sarvalokānāṃ tam apy asya vinirdiśet |
navaitāni mamāṅgāni sākārāṇi yathākramam ||
pīṭhamadhye ‘rcayet samyag bahiḥ padmasya sattama |
navavyūhaṃ tathāṅgāni parikalpya yathā purā ||
upariṣṭād vitānaṃ tu patākābhir alaṃkṛtam |
darpaṇau puṣpamālābhir yathāśobhaṃ vibhūśitau ||
evam abhyarcya māṃ tatra ācāryaḥ śiṣyasaṃvṛtaḥ |
agnikuṇḍaṃ tato gacchet pradīptaṃ dakṣiṇānvitam ||
niviśya mām ataḥ śiṣyān pūjayitvā hutāśanam |
juhuyān mūlamantreṇa tilān vrīhighṛtaplutān ||
lakṣam aṣṭottaraṃ hutvā sahasraṃ śatam eva ca |
śiṣyāṇāṃ kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ samayaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mune ||
navavyūhasya mūrtānām aṅgānāṃ ca yathākramam |
śataṃ śataṃ tu sarveṣāṃ hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak ||
hutvā lakṣaṃ sahasraṃ vā aṣṭadhā tu vidhānataḥ |
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt samāptau ca viśeṣataḥ ||
samāpte tu mahāyajñye tuṣṭyarthaṃ tridavaukasām |
vasor dhārāṃ tataḥ tataḥ kuryāt pradīpte yajñavāṭake ||
śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣair mṛdaṅgapaṇavasvanaiḥ |
kartavyākhyānakuśalaiḥ manujair jāgarataṃ niśi ||
samāpya vidhivad yajñaṃ prabhūtaṃ dhanasaṃcayam |
[1130] tato ‘nupūjayed bhaktyā guruṃ dīkṣāpradāyakam ||
yaḥ prakāśayate jñānaṃ niṣkalaṃ vipulaṃ dhanam |
sa gurur vandanīyo hi yathaivāhaṃ tathā mune ||
dīkṣāṃ prāpya guroḥ samyaj jñānaṃ vā matprakāśakam |
guruṃ na praṇamed yas tu sa pāpo narakaṃ vrajet ||
ataḥ praṇamya śirasā dadyāc ca gurudakṣiṇām |
bhūgāmbaikāñcanaṃ dhānyavastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca ||
nivedya gurave sarvam ātmānaṃ vibhavaṃ gṛham |
tathā mithaḥ prakurvīta yathā suprītaye guroḥ ||
parituṣṭe gurus tasya tuṣto ‘haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
vimānite bhṛśaṃ kruddhe gurau vāhaṃ vimānitaḥ ||
tato dhānyāni bhūgāvau bhakṣyabhojyam avāritam |
caturthasthāśramebhyaś ca bhaktyā deyaṃ priyaṃvada ||
yaḥ kārayati me yajñaṃ yo vidyād bhaktimān naraḥ |
yaḥ paśyati viśuddhātmā sa yāti bhavanaṃ mama ||
imaṃ yajñaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam |
navavyūhaṃ ca te putra proktaṃ saṃsāramuktidam ||
ādāhaṃ yo navavyūhaṃ yajñe yasmin praviśya tu |
viśuddho janmaduḥkhaughāl līyate mayi mānavaḥ ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
iti guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ navavyūhaṃ kapiñjala |
bhāśitaṃ vāsudevena nāradāya mahātmane ||
te narāḥ paśavo loke kiṃ teṣāṃ jīvitaiḥ phalam |
[1131] yair labdhā na haret dīkṣāṃ nārcito vā janārdanaḥ ||
saṃsāre ‘smin mahāghore janmarogabhākule |
sa evaiko mahābhāgaḥ pūjayed yo janārdanam ||
sa evaikaḥ kṛtī loke kulaṃ tenāpy alaṃkṛtam |
ādhāraḥ sarvalokānāṃ yena viṣṇuḥ prasāditaḥ ||
iti viṣṇor mahāyajñaṃ ye kurvanti narā bhuvi |
te yānti śāśvataṃ viṣṇor ānandaṃ paramaṃ padam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ navavyūhārcanam |
skanda uvāca |
viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭham āsīnaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam |
praṇamya śirasā bhaktyā prahlādo daityasattamaḥ ||
vāsudeva jagannātha bhāktānām abhyaprada |
ahaṃ hi manujaiḥ pṛṣṭo lokānāṃ ca śūbhāśubham ||
śubhagā (?) manujāś caiva kecid deveśa durbhagāḥ |
bhavanti karmaṇā kena sarūpā rūpavarjitāḥ ||
tais tu sarvair ahaṃ pṛṣṭo na jānāmi janārdana |
praṇamya śirasā bhaktyā prahlādo daityasattamaḥ ||
vāsudeva jagannātha bhaktānāṃ abhayaprada |
āpṛṣṭavā janān sarvān āgato ‘smi tavāntikam ||
evaṃ sarvaṃ tato mahyaṃ janānām mama caiva hi ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
purā kṛtayuge tāta na tejo ‘bhūt (?) hutāśane |
[1132] brāhmaṇasya ca śāpena tanus tasya virūpitā ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve ṛṣibhiḥ kaṃnaraiḥ saha |
tena duḥkhena saṃtaptā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
devā ūcuḥ |
devadeva jagatkartā lokānāṃ prapitāmaha |
hutabhuk dvijaśāpena na ca yajñeṣu hūyate ||
brahmovāca |
āsīt (?) purā vrataṃ gopyantiladāhīti saṃjñakam |
tena vratena devendra prerayadhvaṃ hutāśanam ||
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa pāvako hoṣyate ‘dhvaraiḥ |
tatheti coktvā devās te vratam agnim akārayan ||
tadā prabhṛtiyajñeṣu hūyate ca yathā purā |
lokapāleṣu vaiśitvaṃ dattaṃ ca brahmaṇā svayam ||
tiladāhī tathāpy ekā prasiddhā divi daivataiḥ |
tathā tvam api daityendra gaccha śīghraṃ janān prati ||
prahlāda uvāca |
vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ tiladāhī vratottamam |
kasmin māse tithau caiva vidhinā kena tad bhavet ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
pauṣamāseṣu yā kṛṣṇatithir ekādaśī śubhā |
tām upoṣya tadā snānaṃ kṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ japet ||
[1133] puṣyarkṣeṇa tu saṃgṛhya gomayena tu piṇḍakān |
kārayet tilasaṃyuktān dhyāyed devaṃ janārdanam ||
homaṃ kuryād yathāśaktyā mantraiś cāgamasaṃbhavaiḥ |
maṇḍalaṃ kārayed viṣṇoḥ kumbhān sthāpya caturdiśam ||
saptadhyānyam (?) udīcyāṃ ca vastrāṇi ca phalāni ca |
tilaprasthopari devaṃ saśriyaṃ svarṇasaṃbhavam ||
nārāyaṇaṃ nyaset pādau jānubhyām viṣṇurūpiṇam |
ūrvos trikramaṃ ciava meḍhre trailokyarūpakam ||
kaṭyāṃ ca śrīdharaṃ devaṃ padmākhyaṃ nābhimaṇḍale |
udare narasiṃhaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhamaṇḍale ||
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ bāhvor mukhe vijñānvigraham |
netre saṃsāradīpaṃ ca sarvātmānaṃ śiras tathā ||
evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā mantramūrtiṃ prakalpayet |
kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāyogaṃ tato hy arghyaṃ prapūjayet ||
phalaratnasamāyuktaṃ puṣpadhūpādidhūpitam |
mantreṇānena daityendra tato ‘haṃ toṣam āvaham ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛpālus tvaṃ sarvāghaughavināśana |
dehi me rūpasaubhāgyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me ||
tiladāhīti ye kecid vrataṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
varado ‘haṃ sadā teṣāṃ dadāmi vipulāṃ śriyam ||
evaṃ saṃśrutya daityendro namaskṛtya janārdanam |
āgato yatra saṃmarde janānāṃ saṃsthito bhuvi ||
[1134] lokā ūcuḥ |
brūhi daityendra yad vṛttaṃ kathitaṃ cakrapāṇinā |
tvayā pṛṣṭena lokānāṃ hitāyāgre tathā tv iha ||
prahlāda uvāca |
aho janā yuṣmadarthe gato ‘haṃ yatra keśavaḥ |
mama duḥkhataraṃ ghoraṃ marditaṃ cakrapāṇinā ||
yathopadiṣṭaṃ devena nirṇayaṃ kathayāmy aham |
savistaraṃ tato loke vyākhyānaṃ dānavena vai ||
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa puruṣatvaṃ prajāyate |
ajarā jāyate tatra na ca duḥkhaṃ prapaśyati ||
manorathāḥ susaṃpūrṇāḥ putrapautrasamanvitāḥ |
avaidhavyaṃ sadā strīṣu satītvaṃ jāyate jane ||
bhartrā saha tathaikatvaṃ sunirvāṇaṃ samṛcchati |
pūrvaṃ tāvat kṛtaṃ śacyā indrapatnyā suśīlayā ||
anusūyārundatībhyāṃ sītayā ca kṛtaṃ tathā |
draupadyaitad vrataṃ sarvaṃ yāvajjīvam anuṣṭhitam ||
sukham ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ rūpasaubhāgyabuddhidam |
saṃdhyayā saṃstutaṃ sarvaṃ pāñcālyā yad anuṣṭhitam ||
tat sarvaṃ sātha papraccha viṣṇupatnī yaśasvinī |
tiladāhīvrataṃ bhadre brūhi tvaṃ sakhi suvrate ||
vidhim udyāpanaṃ caiva kathayasva yathātatham |
draupadī kathayāmāsa vratasyāsya vidhikramam ||
pauṣe māse tu yā kṛṣṇā tithir ekādaśī tathā |
[1135] tām upoṣya tataḥ snānaṃ vidhipūrvaṃ samācaret ||
maunaṃ saṃkalpya saṃcitya purāṇapuruṣottamaṃ |
tataḥ pūjā vidhātavyā mantraiḥ svāgamasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
arghyaṃ datvā vidhānena stutiṃ kuryāt punaḥ punaḥ |
udyāpanavidhiṃ vacmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sati ||
tilaprasthoparidevaṃ saśriyaṃ suvarṇasaṃbhavam |
pūjayen maṇḍalaṃ paścād vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
kumbhāḥ savastrāḥ kartavyāś catvāro maṇḍapād bahiḥ |
saptadhānyam udīcyāṃ tu prācyaṃ homaṃ tu kārayet ||
ācāryaṃ sakalatraṃ ca vārcayet kusumādibhiḥ |
vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalair nānāvidhottamaiḥ ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhadre nārī vā puruṣo ‘pi vā |
varṣe varṣe tu śuśroṇi gāṃ ca dadyāt sadakṣiṇām ||
tiladāhīvrataṃ samyag ye prakurvanti mānavāḥ |
teṣāṃ saubhāgyam atulaṃ sundrāṅgaḥ prajāyate ||
etad vrataṃ savistāram udyāpanasamanvitam |
yaḥ karoti sadā bhaktyā sa vaiṣṇavapuraṃ vrajet ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhadre nārī vā puruṣo ‘pi vā |
sarvakāmasamṛddhaṃ tu paraṃ padam avāpnuyāt ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ tiladāhīvratam |
[1136]
maitreya uvāca |
vidhānaṃ śṛṇu rājendra yathādṛṣṭaṃ manṣīṣibhiḥ |
yathoktaṃ niyamaṃ kuryād ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ ||
dantakāṣṭhaṃ pragṛhyādau vāgyato niyatendriyaḥ |
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge samupoṣya janārdanam ||
arcayitvā vidhānena ahaṃ bhokṣye pare ‘hani |
nadīnāṃ saṃgame snāyād arcayed yatra vā manaḥ ||
sauvarṇaṃ raktasaṃyuktaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam ucchritam |
pītavastraiḥ śubhair veṣṭya bhṛṅgāraṃ nirvrataṃ navam ||
hiraṇmayena pātreṇa arghyapātraṃ prakalpayet |
dadhyakṣataphalaiś caiva sahiraṇyaṃ sacandanam ||
namas te padmanābhāya namas te jalaśāyine |
tubhyam arghyaṃ prayacchāmi vālavāmanarūpiṇe ||
namaḥ kamalakiñjalkapītanirmalavāsase |
mahāhararipuskandha dhṛtacakrāya cakriṇe ||
namaḥ śārṅgāsiśaṅkhābjapāṇaye vāmanāya ca |
yajñāya yajñeśvarāya yajñopakaraṇāya ca ||
yajñabhuk phaladātre ca vāmanāya namo namaḥ |
deveśvarāya devāya devasaṃbhūtikāriṇe ||
prabhave sarvadevānāṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ |
matsyakūrmavarāhāya narasiṃhasvarūpiṇe ||
rāmarāmatrirāmāya vāmanāya namo namaḥ |
[1137] śrīdharāya namas tubhyaṃ namas te garuḍadhvaja ||
caturbāho namas te ‘stu namas te dharaṇīdhara |
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena naraḥ srakcandanādibhiḥ ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt purato jalaśāyinaḥ |
dhṛtvā jalamayaṃ rūpaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
brahmāṇḍam udare yasya mahadbhūtair adhiṣṭhitam |
māyāvī vāmanaḥ śrīśaḥ so ‘trāyātu jagatpatiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu dvādaśyām udaye raveḥ |
bhṛṅgārasahitaṃ vastraṃ saṃvatsaraṃ prapūjayet ||
vāmanaḥ pratigṛhṇātu vāmano ‘haṃ dadāmi tam |
vāmanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ vijayārthaṃ nivedayet ||
jaladhenuṃ tathā dadyāc chatraṃ caiva tu pādukam (?) |
sahiraṇyāni vastrāṇi dhenuṃ vānaḍuhaṃ (?) nṛpa ||
yat kiṃcid dīyate tatra tadānantyāya kalpate |
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge saṃpūjya garuḍadhvajam ||
datvā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo viyoge pāraṇaṃ tataḥ |
siṃhasthite tu mārtaṇḍe śravaṇasthe niśākare ||
śravaṇadvādaśī jñeyā na syād bhādrapadād ṛte |
daśamy ekādaśī yatra sānupoṣyā bhavet tithiḥ ||
śravaṇena tu saṃyuktā sā śubhā sarvakāmadā |
śravaṇena yuktā yā daśamī sāpy upoṣyety arthaḥ |
[1138] pāraṇaṃ tithivṛddhau tu dvādaśyām uḍusaṃkṣayāt ||
vṛddhau kuryāt trayodaśyāṃ tatra doṣo na vidyate |
dvādaśītaulye nakṣatre dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇam adhika trayodaśyām ity arthaḥ |
ity eṣā kathitā rājan dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe tathā |
kartavyā sā prayatnena ihāmutraphalapradā ||
ity agnipurāṇe vijayadvādaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
dvādaśyās tu vidhiḥ proktaḥ śravaṇena yudhiṣṭhira |
sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ ||
ekādaśī yadā śuklā śravaṇena samanvitā |
vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā ||
purā devagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samavetair varārthibhiḥ |
nāradaḥ prārthito viṣṇuś candrāgnyanilasaṃyutaḥ ||
balavān vijito daityo balir nāmā mahābalaḥ |
tena devagaṇāḥ sarve tyājitāḥ suramandiram ||
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvadevānāṃ śīghram asmākam uddhara |
jahi daityaṃ mahābāho baliṃ balavatāmbaram ||
śrutvā viṣṇus tadā vākyaṃ devānāṃ daruṇodayam |
uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajño devānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||
jānāmi virocaneḥ putraṃ baliṃ trailokyakaṇṭakam |
tapasā bhāvitātmānaṃ śāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam ||
[1139] madbhaktaṃ madgataprānaṃ satyasandhaṃ mahābalam |
prajāpatisamaṃ khyātyā prajānāṃ priyakārakam ||
tadguṇā na hi śakyante vaktuṃ kair api bhūtale |
avaśyaṃ nāvaseyo ‘to bhoktavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ||
tapasyāntaś ca bahunā kālenāsya bhaviṣyati |
atha kāle bahutithe sāditir gurviṇī bhavet ||
suṣuve navame māsi putraṃ bālākṛtiṃ harim |
hrasvapādaṃ hrasvakāyaṃ mahāsirasam arbhakam ||
pāṇipādodarakṛśam ūrūkandharakadvayam |
dṛṣṭvā suvāmanaṃ jātam aditeś cakitaṃ manaḥ ||
bhayaṃ babhūva daityānāṃ devānāṃ toṣam ābabhau |
jātakarmādikas tasya saṃskāraḥ svayam eva hi ||
cakre ca kaśyapo dhīmān prajāpatisamanvitaḥ |
ābaddhamekhalo daṇḍo yatir yajñopavītināṃ ||
kuśacarmājinadharaḥ kamaṇḍaluvibhūṣitaḥ |
baler balavato yajñaṃ jagāma bahuvistaram ||
dṛṣṭvā baliṃ tu yajvānaṃ vāmano ‘bhyetya tatkṣaṇam |
arthaṃ nāhaṃ yajñapate dīyatām mam medinī ||
padatrayapramāṇena paṭhanārthe sthito hy asi |
dattā dattāstu ca mayā baliḥ prāha dvijottamam ||
[1140] tato vaditum ārabdhaṃ vāmano ‘nantavikramaḥ |
pādau bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpya śirasāvṛtya rodasī ||
nābhyām indrādikān lokān lalāṭe brahmaṇaḥ padam |
na tṛtīyaṃ padaṃ lebhe tato nedur divaukasaḥ ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahad āścaryaṃ siddhādyā ṛṣayas tathā |
sādhu sādhv iti deveśaṃ praśaśaṃsur mudānvitāḥ ||
tato daityagaṇāḥ sarve jitvā tribhuvanaṃ vaśī |
balim āha hy adho gaccha sukhaṃ sabalavāhanaḥ ||
tatra tvam īpsitān bhogān bhuktvā madbāhupālitaḥ |
asyendrasyāvasāne tu tvam evendro bhaviṣyasi ||
evam ukto baliḥ prāyān namaskṛtya narottamam |
visarjyāyaṃ baliṃ devalokapānān uvāca ha ||
svāni dhiṣṇāni gacchadhvaṃ tiṣthadhvaṃ vigatajvarāḥ |
devenoktā gatā devāḥ prahṛṣṭā pūjya vāmanam ||
evam uktvā jagatkartā tatraivāntar adhīyata |
etat sarvaṃ samabhavad ekādaśyāṃ narādhipa ||
teneṣṭā devadevasya sarvathā vijayānvitaḥ |
eṣaiva phālgune māsi puṣyeṇa sahitā nṛpa ||
vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā |
eṣaiveti śuklapakṣaikādaśī parāmṣyate |
[1141] ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso rātrau saṃūjayed dharim |
raupyasauvarṇapātre vā dāruvaṃśamaye ‘pi vā ||
ācchādya pātraṃ vāsobhir ahataiḥ phalasaṃyutaiḥ |
mārgacarmeṇa gandhaiś ca bhaktyā vā śaktyapekṣayā ||
tilāḍhakena vittāḍhyaiḥ prasthena kuḍam eva vā |
alābhe yavagodhūmaiḥ phalaiḥ śuklatilair bhavet ||
puṣpair gandhaiḥ phalair dhūpaiḥ kālotthair arcayed dharim |
nānāvidhaiś ca naivedyair bhakṣyabhojyair guḍodanaiḥ ||
svavittam anusāreṇa sahiraṇyaṃ ca kārayet |
mantravate śataguṇaṃ bhaktyā lakṣaguṇottaram ||
bhaktimantraguṇopetaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇottaram |
