ebhir mantrapadais tatra pūjayed garuḍadhvajam ||
upahārair naraśeṣṭha śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
oṃ jalopamadehāya jalajāsyāya śaṅkhine |
jalarāśisvarūpāya namas te puruṣottama ||
namaḥ kamalanābhāya namas te jalaśāyine |
namas te keśavānanta vāsudeva namo ‘stu te ||
snānamantraḥ |
malayeṣu samutpannaṃ gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam |
mayā niveditaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara ||
candanamantraḥ |
[1142] vanaspatisamutpannaṃ gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam |
mayā niveditaṃ puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama ||
puṣpamantraḥ |
namaḥ kamalakiñjalka pītanirmalavāsase |
mahāhave ripuskandhaghṛṣṭacakrāya cakriṇe ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
matsyakūrmavarāhaṃ ca nārasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanam |
rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca arcayāmi namo namaḥ ||
arcanamantraḥ |
pādādyaikāsya pūjanaṃ śīrṣam ataḥ sarvāṅgapūja
dhūpo ‘yaṃ devadeveśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara |
acyutānanda govinda vāsudeva namo ‘stu te ||
dhūpamantraḥ |
tvam eva pṛthivī jyotir vāyur ākāśam eva ca |
tvam eva jyotiṣāṃ jyotir dīpo ‘yaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
dīpamantraḥ |
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam |
mayā niveditaṃ deva prasīda parameśvara ||
agnir yamo vaiśravaṇaḥ pāpaṃ me hantu me ‘vyayam ||
naivedyamantraḥ |
jagadādir jagadrūpo hy anādir jagadantakṛt |
[1143] jalāśayajagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ ||
prīṇanamantraḥ |
anekakarmanirbandhadhvaṃsinaṃ jalaśāyinam |
nato ‘smi madurāvāsaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam ||
namo vāmanarūpāya namas te ‘stu trivikrama |
namas te maṇibandhāya vāsudeya namo ‘stu te ||
namaskāramantraḥ |
namao namas te govinda vāmaneśa trivikrama |
aghaughasaṃkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāmaprado bhava ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
sarvagaḥ sarvadeveśaḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīniketanaḥ |
viśveśvarāya viṣṇuś ca śrīśāyī ca namo namaḥ ||
śayanamantraḥ |
sarvaṃ saṃpūjayed rātrārekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama |
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta geyavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
yāśrava śravaṇe yuktā dvādaśī paramā tithiḥ |
tasyāhaṃ saṃgame snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
evaṃ sa niyamaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte vimale sati |
pradeyaḥ śāstravidūṣi brāhmaṇe mantrato nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇaś cāpi mantreṇa pratigṛhṇīta mantravit |
vāmano buddhido dātā dravyastho vāmanaḥ svayam ||
vāmanasya pratigrāhī vāmanāya mans tu te |
[1144] oṃ guhyam | oṃ śirasi | puṣpaphananaivdyaṃ sarvam etad arcanavidhinā dadyāt |
evam upoṣya vidhivad ekādaśyāṃ samantrakam |
pūrvoktavidhinā caiva pratipakṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ ||
hastyaśvarathajātīnāṃ dātā bhoktā vimatsarī |
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyur nirjito bhavet ||
putraiḥ parivṛto jīvo jīvec ca śaradaḥ śatam |
eṣā vyuṣṭiḥ samākhyātā ekādaśyāṃ mayā tava ||
pūrvam eva samākhyātā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ paścād dvādaśīm apy upoṣayet ||
na cātra vidhilopaḥ syād ubhayor devatā hariḥ |
ekādaśī dvādaśī cānyatarasyāṃ vā śravaṇayuktāyāṃ śravaṇayuktopavāsenaiva vratadvayasiddhiḥ ekasmin vrate pūrvam anyāṃ tithim upoṣya paścād apārayitvā nānyopoṣyā iti yo vidhilopaḥ sa eva devataikatve na bhavatīty arthaḥ |
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī saṅgamodakam |
snānaṃ dadhyodanaṃ samyag upavāsaḥ paro vidhiḥ ||
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhundhumāreṇa gādinā |
etaiś cānyaiś ca rājendra kāmāc ca dvādaśīvratam ||
sā dvādaśī budhayutā śraveṇena sākaṃ
syāj jāyateti kathitā ṛṣibhir nabhasye |
[1145] tām ādareṇ samupoṣya naro ‘martatvam
āpnoti pārtha aṇimādiguṇopapannam ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottare vijayadvādaśīśravaṇadvādaśīvratam |
brahmovāca |
ekādaśyāṃ yathoddiṣṭā viśvedevāḥ prapūjitāḥ |
prajāṃ paśūn dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ prayacchanti mahīṃ tathā ||
mūlamantraḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅkhamantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
atra tithīśvaro viśvedevāḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ viśvavratam |
kṛtvā bhūritaraṃ pāpaṃ jñānato ‘jñānato ‘pi vā |
tasya pāpasya śāntyarthaṃ kiṃ dānaṃ kim atha vratam ||
brahmovāca |
mahāvratam idaṃ vatsa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
kīrtayiṣyāmi te vatsa sukhakīrtidhanapradam ||
[1146] puṣyarkṣeṇa samāyuktā śuklā vai dvādaśī bhavet |
sā proktā vāsudevena sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||
ye ‘rcayanti narās tasyāṃ bhaktyā devaṃ janārdanam |
samupoṣya vimucyante pāpais te śatajanmajaiḥ ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā yat pāpaṃ samupārjitam |
tat kṣālayati govinda tithau tasyāṃ samarcitaḥ ||
tat kṣālayati govinda tithau tasyāṃ samarcitaḥ |
snānaṃ japo ‘tha vā homaḥ samuddiśya janārdanam ||
narair yat kriyate tasyāṃ tadantaphalaṃ bhavet |
yasmān nāśayate jantoḥ pāpaṃ janmaśatodbhavam ||
puṣyarkṣaikādaśī tasmāt proktā pāpapraṇāśinī |
evam eva purā prāha bhānuḥ sārathinaṃ prati ||
bhānur uvāca |
dvādaśī vā parā bradhnapuṣyeṇaiva ca saṃyutā |
upoṣyā tu prayatnena dvādaśī pāpanāśanī ||
puṣyeṇa dvādaśīyuktā śuklā vai phālgunasya ca |
jayā sā dvādaśī proktā svayaṃ vā viṣṇunā purā ||
tasyāṃ dattaṃ tapas taptaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇottaram |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādasyāṃ viṣṇum arcayet ||
raupyasauvarṇapātre vā dāruvaṃśamaye ‘pi vā |
ācchādya pātraṃ vāsobhir ahataiḥ suparīkṣitaiḥ ||
mārgaiś ca meḍhajaiś caiva siddhiḥ syāc chaktyapekṣayā |
tilāḍhakena vittāḍhyaiḥ prasthena kaṭajena vā ||
alābhe caiva godhūmaiḥ phalaṃ mukhyaṃ tilair bhavet |
[1147] puṣpair dhūpaiḥ phalair gandhaiḥ kālotthair arcayed dharim ||
nānāvidhaiś ca vaivedyair bhakṣyair bhojyair guḍodanaiḥ |
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta geyavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
evaṃ saniyamasyāsya prabhāte vimale sati |
bhaktyā vā vittasāreṇa sahiraṇyaṃ pradāpayet ||
samāpte tu vrate brahman yat puṇyaṃ tan nibodha me |
caturyugānāṃ viprendra ekasaptati khecara ||
tāvad viṣṇupure tatra krīḍate kālam akṣayam ||
ity ādityapurāṇoktaṃ vijayādvādaśīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
ekādaśyāṃ śulkapakṣe yadā tu syāt punarvasuḥ |
nāmnā sā tijayā khyātā tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
yo dadāti tilaprasthaṃ trikālaṃ vatsaraṃ nṛpa |
upavāsaṃ tu tasyāṃ yaḥ karoty abhyetya tatsamam ||
tasyāṃ jagatpatir devaḥ sarvalokeśvaro hariḥ |
pratyakṣatāṃ pratyāty asmāt tatrānantaphalṃ smṛtam ||
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhundhumāreṇa gādhinā |
tasyām ārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo dattvān akhilāṃ bhuvam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam ativijayaikādaśīvratam |
vajra uvāca |
kevalaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśīṣu janārdana |
[1148] kadāprabhṛti dharmajña vidhinā kena vārcayet ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
māghyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ dvādaśī yā bhaven nṛpa |
tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyaṃ vratam etad upoṣitā ||
dvādaśīṣu ca kṛṣṇāsu nāma kṛṣṇasya kīrtayet |
tenaiva nāmnā kartavyau japahomau tathaiva ca ||
tilair nivedanaṃ kāryaṃ home kāryaṃ tathā tilaiḥ |
pauṣyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet ||
tasyāṃ vratāvasāne tu tilān dadyād dvijātiṣu |
suvarṇaṃ ca mahīpāla raktavastraṃ tathaiva ca ||
saṃvatsaram idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ manujapuṅgava |
tiryagyoniṃ na cāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
yāvajjīvaṃ vratam idaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ |
na sa duḥkham avāpnoti nārakaṃ manujottama ||
yatra vaitaraṇī durgā kṣuradhārā saparvatā |
pāpānāṃ pāvanā yatra tarāsau na gamiṣyati ||
yasyā gaṇā bhīmabalā mahogrā
daṃṣṭrākarālāgrakarograveṣā |
vidrāvaṇāḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇāṃ
dṛṣṭer na tasyānadya yānti mārgam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ kṛṣṇadvādaśīvratam |
[1149] vajra uvāca |
ekām upoṣya kṛṣṇāṃ yāṃ dvādaśīṃ vidhinā naraḥ |
mahāphalam avāpnoti tan mamācakṣva mārgava ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
mādhyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā |
dvādaśī yā bhavet kṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī ||
tilaiḥ snānaṃ tilair homaṃ naivedyaṃ tilamodakaiḥ |
dīpaiś ca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakam ||
tilāś ca deyā vipreṣu tasminn ahani pārthiva |
upavāsadine rājan hotavyāś ca tathā tilāḥ ||
upoṣitenāpare ‘hni hotavyaś ca viśeṣataḥ |
indhanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu tathānagha ||
tilaprasthaṃ tadā hutvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
na durgatim avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ nitye somamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
pauruṣaṃ ca tathā sūktaṃ śrīsūkena ca saṃyutam ||
homaḥ kāryo ‘tha rājendra sāvitryā paramātmanaḥ |
etat proktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ strīśudreṣu ca yat śṛṇu ||
dvādaśākṣarau mantrau ca teṣāṃ proktau mahātmanām |
hitau tau ca dvijātīnāṃ mantraśreṣṭhau narādhipa ||
tebhyo ‘py adhikamantro ‘pi vidyate na hi kutracit ||
vajra uvāca |
dvādaśāṣṭākṣarau mantrau kathayasva mamānagha |
[1150] puṇyoḥ pavitrau māṅgalyau sarvapāpapraṇāśanau ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya |
etau mayā vaḥ kathitau pavitrau
mantrāvinau pāpaharau dharaṇyām |
parāyaṇau sarvatapasvināṃ varau
varasya bhūtau bhuvaneṣu nityam ||
yathātithis te śravaṇena yuktā
māghasya māsasya tathā mayoktā |
kāryā tatheyaṃ nṛpater viśeṣād
yoge pavitre saritāhvayasya ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ tiladvādaśīvratam |
ekādaśī tathā kṛṣṇāṃ phālgune māsi bhārgava |
chandodevasya kartavyaḥ pūjā dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||
pūjancchādanadevasya yenāyaṃ guṇavarjitam |
na prāpnoti tathā prītiṃ guṇavantīṃ na saṃśayam ||
iti dharmottaroktaṃ kṛṣṇaikādaśīvratam |
[1151] ekādaśīṃ tathā prāpya caitre śuklasya pūjayet |
saṃpūjya taṃ mahābhāgaṃ gṛhamaṅgalam aśnute ||
tam iti chandodevam |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam avaidhavyaśuklaikādaśīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
ahaṃkārakaṃ tathā sūryaṃ nirṛtiṃ vāpageśvaraḥ |
havanaṃ veśvaraṃ mṛtyuṃ kapālakaṣakiṅkiṇīm ||
tatra vaikādaśād yas tu devān tribhuvaneśvarān |
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāsaḥ somaṃ saṃpūjayet tathā ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasampadāḥ |
mārgaśīrṣād athārabhya yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ bhavet ||
saṃvatsarānte dadyāc ca brāhmaṇāya payasvinīm |
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
rudratvam āpnoti naras tu rājan |
rudreṇa sārdhaṃ suciraṃ vasitvā
kāmān aprāpnoti [avāpnoti?] mano ‘bhirāmān ||
tathā sarvagatān rudrān mudā sarvatra pūjayet |
sarvakāmān avāpnoti sarvagān aparājitān ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sarvakāmavratam |
[1152] sanatkumāra uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade śuklapakṣe yadi harer dinam |
budhaśravaṇayogaś ca prāpyate tatra pūjitaḥ ||
prayacchati sutān kāmān vāmano manasi sthitān |
vijayā nāma sā proktā tithiḥ prītikaro hareḥ ||
saṃgamaḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ saṃgame tatra jāyate |
śuklā bhādrapade svargaṃ kṛṣṇā kaluṣasaṃkṣayam ||
phālgune kurute mokṣam api brahmāvadhāraṇam (?) |
gaṅgāyamunayoḥ puṇye narmadāsaritsaṃgame ||
sarasvatyaruṇayoś caiva saṃgame pāpanāśane |
brahmavalmīsābhrāme saptadhāre ‘tha vā dvija ||
anyeṣu saṃgameṣv eva svayam āyāti vāmanaḥ |
tatra saṃpūjito ‘thāsau (?) jāyate pretamokṣadaḥ ||
dadhyodanasamāyuktāṃ vāridhānīṃ pradāpayet |
pūjaya tvaṃ jagannāthaṃ vāmanaḥ prīyatām iti ||
mahāpuṇyapradā hy eṣā saṃgame vijayā tithiḥ |
sarvapāpakṣayo nūnaṃ jāyate ca upoṣaṇāt ||
gṛhītvā niyamaṃ prātar gatvā nadyādisaṃgame |
sauvarṇaṃ vāmanaṃ kṛtvā sauvarṇamāṣakeṇa vā ||
yathāśaktyā tu vinyasya kumbhopari jagatpatim |
pūrṇapātre snāpayitvā mantrair etaiḥ prapūjayet ||
oṃ vāmanāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca |
ūrū śrīpataye guhyaṃ kāmadevāya pujayet ||
[1153] pūjayej jagatāṃ patyur udaraṃ viśvadhāriṇe |
hṛdaye yogināthāya kaṇṭhaṃ śrīpataye namaḥ ||
mukhaṃ ca paṅkajasthāya śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ |
itthaṃ saṃpūjya vāsobhir ācchādya ca jagadgurum ||
dadyāt suśraddhayā vārghyaṃ nārikelādibhiḥ phalaiḥ |
oṃ namo namas te govinada budhaśravaṇasaṃjñayā ||
aghaughasaṃkṣayaṃ kṛtvā pretamokṣaprado bhava ||
ity arthyamantraḥ |
chatropanadyugaṃ dānaṃ dadyād annaṃ kamaṇḍalum |
viśeṣeṇa dvijāgryāya vāmanaḥ prīyatām iti ||
dhenudānaṃ praśaṃsanti saṃgame jagatāṃ patim |
uddiśya kamalākāntaṃ puṇyanadyās tu saṃgame ||
trīṇy āhur atidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī |
āsaptamaṃ punāty eva dohavān iha vedanaiḥ ||
yathāśaktyā ca dānāni dvijāgryebhyaḥ pradāpayet |
kuryāj jāgaraṇaṃkuryād gītaṃ śāstrasamanvitam ||
śraddhayā parayā yukto niśām animiṣekṣaṇaḥ |
prabhāte bhojayed viprān dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
kuryāt trayaṃ śraddhayā ca sarvaṃ saphalatāṃ vrajet |
evaṃ kṛte tu vijayāvrate ‘smin vai jayādine ||
na durlabhataraṃ kiṃcid iha loke paratra ca |
durlabhā vijayā nṝṇāṃ durlabhas tatra saṃgamaḥ ||
[1154] sudurlabhatarā śraddhā tatra govindapūjane |
sarvatīrthena bhūyiṣṭhe saṃgame yāti saṃgamam ||
vijayāvāsare sarvadevānāṃ saṃgame bhuvi |
api ramyodakasyātra saṃgamaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ||
āpagāsaṃgamasyātra phalaṃ vaktuṃ na pāryate |
idaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu rahasyaṃ parigīyate ||
saṃgame vāmanaṃ pūjya preto yena na jāyate |
phalam asya vratasyokaṃ devapitruddharottamaḥ ||
vaṃśoddhārakaraṃ muktiṃ yāti paivatsaṇād api |
na pāvanaṃ na tat kiṃcid ataḥ param ihocyate ||
vijayāvratatulyaṃ yad aparaṃ paripadyate |
vāmāsi vāmanaṃ vāridhānīṃ dhenucatuṣṭayam ||
datvātra saṃgame tāta yāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām |
anṛṇo jāyate mohādevānām atithikriyā ||
kurvann eva manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vijayāvratāt |
aśraddhayā kṛtaṃ dattaṃ tapas taptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat ||
viphalaṃ jāyate tāvan na ca tat pretya no iha |
śraddhā dharmasutā devī śraddhā sādhanam uttamam ||
śraddhāmayo ‘yaṃ manujo yacchraddhādaḥ sa eva saḥ |
yo yogena gatiṃ yāti yāṃ ca sāṃkhyena yogataḥ ||
iṣṭāpūrtena yāṃ yāti tāṃ kalau vāmanārcanāt |
mucyate tasya pūrve ‘pi pitṛmātāmaḥāḥ kule ||
[1155] pretabhāvā na jāyante tadvaṃśe pretayonayaḥ
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ
purāṇasaṃgheṣu munipraṇītam |
viśeṣakāryaṃ vijayābhidhānaṃ
vadanti santaḥ paramātmaniṣṭhāḥ ||
iti brahmavaivartoktaṃ vijayādvādaśīvratam |
devy uvāca |
katham etad vrataṃ kāryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇuvallabham |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vidhinā kena tad vada ||
īśvara uvāca |
phālgunasya site pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
snātvā nadyāṃ taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ kūpe gṛhe ‘pi vā ||
gatvā girau vane vāpi yatra sā prāpyate śivā |
kṣīrode mathyamāne tu yadā vṛkṣaḥ samutthitaḥ ||
āmardandeva daityānāṃ tena sāmalakī smṛtā |
asmin vṛkṣe sthitā lakṣmīḥ sadā pitṛgṛhe nṛpa ||
śivālakṣmīsthito vṛkṣaḥ sevyate surasattamaiḥ |
devair brahmādibhiḥ sarvair vṛkṣo ‘sau vaiṣṇavaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
tatra gatvā hariḥ pūjyo vṛkṣamūle ‘tha vā śivā |
pūjyā puṣpaiḥ śubhai rātrau kāryaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ naraiḥ ||
aṣṭādhikaśataiḥ kāryā phalais tasyāḥ pradakṣiṇā |
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tato bhoktavyaṃ tu phalaṃ naraiḥ ||
[1156] karakaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pātrasaṃyutam |
haviṣyānnaṃ tu kartavyaṃ dīpaḥ kāryo vidhānataḥ ||
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ yathā śravaṇatatparaiḥ |
mucyante dehinaḥ pāpaiḥ kalijaiḥ kāyasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
dehānte ye narāḥ pūrve pūjyante harimandiram ||
iti skandapurāṇīyaprabhāsamkhaṇḍoktaṃ āmalakaikādaśīvratam |
atha godohamantrais tu vidhinā kena vai mune |
hariṃ saṃpūjitā śīghraṃ narāṇāṃ sa prasīdati ||
kṣīrode mathyamāne ca mune pūrvaṃ surāsuraiḥ |
pañca gāvaḥ samutpannāḥ sarvalokasya mātaraḥ ||
sarvalokopakārārthaṃ devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca |
yajñānāṃ dohasaṃpatyai tathā hariharasya ca ||
gomayaṃ rocanā kṣīraṃ mūtraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ gavām |
ṣaḍaṅgāni pavitrāṇi tathā siddhikarāṇi ca ||
ucchrito bilavṛkṣaś ca gomayān munisattama |
tatrāsau labhate lakṣmīṃ śrīvṛkṣas tena bodhyate ||
gorocanāyāṃ māṅgalyāḥ saṃjātāḥ sarvakāmikāḥ |
guggulas tu tato jāto gomūtrāc chubhadarśanaḥ (?) ||
yat kiṃcij jagato vīryaṃ tat sarvaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam |
dadhno jātāni sarvāṇi maṅgalārthasya siddhaye ||
[1157] ghṛtād amṛtasaṃbhūtiḥ (?) surāsurapriyā dhruvam |
hariṃ susnāpayet tasmād payodadhighṛtais tathā ||
guggulaṃ nirdahaty aśvair mantraiḥ paurāṇasaṃbhavaiḥ |
naivedyair vividhākārair dīpair vastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena brāhmaṇāṃs tarpayet tataḥ |
munipuṣpāṇi pūjarthaṃ yāvatsu tithiṣu tv iha ||
tāvarghugasahasrāṇi (?) svargaloke mahīyate |
tato viṣṇupadaṃ yāti yasmān nāvartate punaḥ ||
ye tasya pitaraḥ santi patitā narakārṇave |
te ‘pi svargaṃ samāsādya modante vigatajvarāḥ ||
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yathāpagām |
dhenuṃ sarvaguṇopetāṃ krameṇa munipuṅgava ||
anena vidhinā pañca śaradāntadināni tu |
kartavyam ekabhaktena dinānte saghubhug naraḥ ||
jalājyamadhudhenuṃ ca tilahemavatīṃ tathā |
datvā puṇyam avāpnoti na tat sarvamahāmakhaiḥ ||
sarvaṃ yat kurute samyaṅ mahāvṛddhivrataṃ param |
nāvalimpati pāpena padmapatram ivāmbhasā ||
yatra saṃkīrtya karmāṇi martyāḥ santi mahādhiyaḥ |
prāyaścittāni nirdiṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ sugatikāminām ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni agamyāgamanāni ca |
kṛtvā steyaṃ surāpaś ca prasādaṃ mucyate mune ||
vikrayaṃ tiladhenūnāṃ kṛtvā vratam idaṃ śuciḥ |
[1158] mucyate pātakāt sadyaḥ kīrtitāt smaraṇān mune ||
evaṃ vā dvādaśān māsān upoṣyaikādaśīṃ budhaḥ |
yad yaḥ karoti śuddhātmā kṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhī bhavet ||
sunāmadvādaśī pūjyā nāmnā dvādaśabhis tathā |
dvādaśā dhenavo deyā hariḥ kāmān prayacchati ||
divi devāḥ sadevendrāḥ kṛtvā karmāṇy anekaśaḥ |
paścād ārādhayantīha hariṃ śuddhavratena hi ||
iti vahnipurāṇoktaṃ śuddhivratam |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam |
arcayed brāhmaṇamukhe sa gacchet paramaṃ padam ||
eṣā tithir vaiṣṇavī syād dvādaśīśuklapakṣakā |
tasyām ārādhayed devaṃ prayatnena janārdanam ||
iti kūrmapurāṇoktaṃ dvādaśīvratam |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam |
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
iti kūrmapurāṇoktaṃ dvādaśīvratam |
mārgaśīrṣe śite pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samajāyata |
matsyo viṣṇuḥ samāhātmyaḥ tasyeṣṭeyaṃ sadā tithiḥ ||
ekādaśyām upoṣyādau paṭhan matsyāvatārakam |
[1159] śṛṇvan sauvarṇaṃ mantraṃ ca kārayitvā vaded idam ||
viṣṇudharme |
prīyatāṃ matsya ity uktvā taṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya tu |
yo dadyāt sa sukhī bhūtvā viṣṇulokaṃ vrajec chubham ||
pauṣe māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samajāyata |
kūrmarūpī sa bhagavān tasyeṣṭeyaṃ sadā tithiḥ ||
ekādaśyām upoṣyādau paṭhan kūrmaṃ ca tārakam |
śṛṇvan sauvarṇaṃ kūrmaṃ ca kārayitvā vaded idam ||
viṣṇur me prīyatāṃ kūrma ity uktvā brāhmaṇāya tu |
yo dadyāt sa sukhī bhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
yo martyo māghaśuklasya dvādaśyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
upoṣya bhaktyā vābhyarcya varāhaṃ rukmanirmitam ||
dadyāt paṭhec ca caritaṃ vārāhaṃ harim uttamam |
varāhajanmadivase viprāya śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
sutam etaṃ samāsādya modate kālam akṣayam |
varāhaviṣṇuprītiṃ ca kūrmadevaṃ yathātatham ||
nārasiṃhaṃ phālgune tu ekādaśyāṃ site śuciḥ |
upoṣyābhyarcayed bhaktyā nārasiṃhabhave dine ||
sauvarṇaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ (?) ca kṛtvā śaktyā dvijāya tu |
dadyān nṛsiṃhacaritam idaṃ śṛṇvan paṭhaṃś ca vā ||
śatrūn vijityeha lakṣmīṃ prāpya nityaṃ narottamaḥ |
pātālasvargam āpnoti nāgadaityāṅganāyutam ||
caitre māsi site pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
[1160] vāmanasya dine ‘bhyarcya vāmanaṃ puruṣottamam ||
sauvarṇaṃ vāmanaṃ dadyāt paṭhed bhaktyā ca yo naraḥ |
sa ciraṃ vāmanasyedaṃ śṛṇuyād (?) vāpy upoṣitaḥ ||
sa dhanair anvito bhuktvā bhogān iha ca mānuṣān |
brahmalokam avāpnoti vidyān nāmānutatparaḥ ||
vaiśākhaśuklaikādaśyām upoṣyābhyarcayec chuciḥ |
jāmadagnyaṃ tathā rāmaṃ dadyād viprāya rukmajam (?) ||
idaṃ ca rāmacaritaṃ śṛṇuyād vā paṭhen naraḥ |
rāmasya janmadivase tathā dāśarather dvijaḥ ||
sītārāmaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ yo viprāya prayacchati |
dvādaśyāṃ rāmacaritam idaṃ śṛṇvan paṭhaṃś ca vā ||
sa indralokaṃ labhate rāmasyaiva prasādataḥ |
iha kīrtim avāpnoti dhanaṃ putrāṃś ca jīvitam ||
āṣāḍhamāsi śuklāṃ ya upoṣyaikādaśīṃ dvijaḥ |
dvādaśyām arcayed rāmaṃ rauhiṇeyaṃ mahābalam ||
rauhiṇeyasya rāmasya tithau janmani sūttame |
sauvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇāyāpi rāmaṃ dadyāt sapātrakam ||
sa nāgalokam āpnoti yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
iha strībhogam āpnoti balavān nirujo bhavet ||
śrāvaṇe māsi śuklāṃ ya upoṣyaikādaśīṃ dvija |
dvādaśyām arcayet kṛṣṇaṃ rukmiṇīsahitaṃ śuciḥ ||
rukmapratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā dadyāc ca brāhmaṇāya ca |
paṭhec ca kṛṣṇacaritaṃ kṛṣṇajanmadine śuciḥ ||
[1161] śrāvaṇe śṛṇuyād vāpi ya idaṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
sa mucyate ‘smāt saṃsārād bhuktvā bhogam uttamam ||
yas tu bhādrapade māsi ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
śuklāyām arcayet kālaṃ viṣṇuṃ sauvarṇam acyutam ||
dvādaśyāṃ janmadivase kalkiviṣṇuḥ sureśvaraḥ |
dadyād viprāya taṃ vāpi bhaktyānuṣṭhānato mudā ||
paṭhed idaṃ kalkiviṣṇoś caritaṃ śṛṇuyāt tataḥ |
janalokam avāpnoti kṛte janma labhed yuge ||
tasmiṃs tu tasmin divase dattaṃ viṣṇvavatārakam |
arcayantu surāḥ sarve bhaveyuḥ sarvadārcitāḥ ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇoktaṃ daśāvatāravratam |
ekādaśyāṃ tu naktāśī yaś ca kaṃ vinivedayet ||
viprāyeti śeṣaḥ |
kṛtvā martye ca sauvarṇaṃ sa viṣṇoḥ padam āpnuyāt |
etat kṛṣṇavrataṃ nāma kalpāntaiḥ sukhalābhakṛt ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kṛṣṇavratam |
agastya uvāca |
ekādaśyāṃ tu yatnena naktaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi |
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu kṛṣṇāyām ārabhyādau vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
[1162] tad vrataṃ dhanadasyeha (?) kṛtaṃ vittaṃ prayacchati ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ dhanadavratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe ekādaśīvratāni |
atha ṣoḍaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
atha dvādaśīvratāni |
bhaktā viṣṇoḥ sūrihemādiṇeha
prastūyante dvādaśīsthavratāni |
kṛtvā yāni prāṇino laṅghayanti
taṃ durvārāsārasaṃsārapāram ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
rāma uvāca |
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ kiṃ syād ekam upoṣitam |
mahāphalaṃ mahādeva tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
yā rāmaśravaṇopetā dvādaśī mahatī tu sā |
tasyām upoṣitaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam ||
[1163] prāpnot prayatnāt dharmajña dvādaśadvādaśīphalam |
dadhyodanayutaṃ tasyāṃ jalapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ dvije ||
vastrasaṃveṣṭitaṃ datvā chatropanaham eva ca |
na durgatim avāpnoti jātim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
akṣayyaṃ sthānam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge budhavāro bhaved yadi ||
atyantaṃ mahatī nāma dvādaśī sā prakīrtitā |
snānaṃ japyaṃ tathā dānaṃ homaṃ śrāddhaṃ surārcanam ||
sarvam akṣayam āpnoti tasyāṃ bhṛgukulodvaha |
tasmin dine tathā snāto yatra kvacana saṃgame ||
svargaṅgāsnānajaṃ rāma phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
śrāvaṇe saṃgamāḥ sarve parapuṣṭipradāḥ sadā ||
viśeṣād dvādaśīyukte budhayuktā viśeṣataḥ |
tathaiva dvādaśī proktā budhaśravaṇasaṃyutā ||
tṛtīyā ca tathā proktā sarvakāmaphalapradā |
tathā tṛtīyā dharmajña tathā pañcadaśī śubhā ||
brahmavaivartapurāṇe |
namasye phālgune māsi yadi vā dvādaśī bhavet |
śuddhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saṅgamo vijayā smṛtā ||
vāridhānīpradāno syād dadhyodanasamāyutā |
[1164] pretayonau na jāyeta pūjayitvā ca vāmanam ||
vaṃśaḥ samuddhṛtas tena muktaṃ pitṛṛṇād asau (?) ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ sadaiva puruṣottama |
ekayā dvādaśī puṇyā tā upoṣya mamānagha ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā |
sarvakāmapradā puṇyā upavāse mahāphalā ||
saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
samayaṃ samavāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam ||
atra dvādaśa dvādaśyām evopavāsavidhānam, vacanasāmarthyāt |
athā coktaṃ viṣṇurahasye |
dvādaśyām upavāso ‘tra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam |
niṣiddham api kartavyam ity ājñā parameśvarī ||
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saiva ced dvādaśī bhavet |
atīva mahatī tasyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtam ihākṣayam ||
dvādaśīṃ śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati bhārata |
saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā gaṅgādisnānajaṃ phalam ||
sopavāsam avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
jalapūrṇaṃ tadā kumbhaṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
pañcaratnasamopetaṃ sopavītaṃ supūjitam |
[1165] tasya skandhe sughaṭitaṃ sthāpayitvā janārdanam ||
yathāśaktyā svarṇamayaṃ śaṅkhaśārṅgavibhūṣitam |
snāpayitvā vidhānena sitacandanacarcitam |
sitavastrayugachannaṃ chatropānadyugānvitam ||
oṃ namo vāsudevāya śiraḥ saṃpūjayet tataḥ |
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvad vaikuṇṭhāya dṛśe namaḥ ||
namaḥ śrīpataye vaktraṃ bhujau sarvāstradhāriṇe |
vyāpakāya namaḥ kukṣau keśavāyodaraṃ namaḥ ||
trailokyajanakāyeti meḍhraṃ saṃpūjayed dhareḥ |
sarvādhipataye jaṅghe pādau sarvātmane namaḥ ||
anena vidhinā rājan puṣpair dhūpaiḥ samarcayet |
tatas tasyāgrato deyaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam ||
modakāṃś ca navān kumbhān śaktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām |
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet ||
prabhāte vimale snātvā saṃpūjya garuḍadhvajam |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaiḥ phalair vastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ||
puṣpāñjaliṃ tato datvā mantram etam udīrayet |
namo namas te govinda budhaśravaṇasaṃjñaka ||
aghaughasaṃkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaukhyaprado bhava |
anantaraṃ brāhmaṇedaṃ vedavedāṅgapārage ||
purāṇajñe viśeṣeṇa vidhivat saṃpradāpayet |
prīyatāṃ devadeveśo mama nityaṃ janārdana ||
[1166] anenaiva vidhānena nadyās tīre narottama |
sarvaṃ nivartayet sasyagekabhaktarato ‘pi san ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam |
mahaty araṇye yad vṛttaṃ bhūmipāla śṛṇuṣva tat ||
deśo deśorako nāma tasya bhāge tu paścime |
ativājanmanuddeśo sarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ||
sutaptasikatā bhūmir yatra kṛṣṭā mahoragāḥ |
alpachāyadrumākīrṇā mṛtaprāṇisamākulā ||
śamīkhadirapālāśakrīraiḥ pīlubhis tathā |
satpatatrabhīmadrumāḥ pārtha kaṇṭhakair āvilā dṛḍhaiḥ ||
gandhaprāṇigaṇākīrṇā tatra bhūr dṛśyate kvacit |
atarkatāpaviṣamā bhūstṛṇā puruṣo khaga ||
jvalitāgnisamaś caiva yat kiṃcit tatra dṛśyate |
tathāpi jīvā jīvanti sarvakarmanibandhanāḥ ||
nodakaṃ notpalārājanuvanta (?) tatra valāhakāḥ |
kadācid api dṛśyante plavamānā vihaṅgamāḥ ||
sakāntaragatiḥ kaiścic chiśubhis tṛṣitaiḥ samam |
uktantajīvitā rājan dṛśyante vihatottamāḥ ||
utplutyotplutyatarasā mṛgaḥ saikasatāṅgataḥ |
śakyate caiva naśyanti jalaiḥ saikatasetuvat ||
tasmin tathāvidhe deśe kaścid daivavaśād vaṇik |
nijasārthaparibhraṣṭhaḥ praviṣṭo marujaṅgale ||
[1167] uktavān malināt takṣātrir māsān bhaumadarśanāt |
babhrāmodbhrāntahṛdayaḥ kṣuttṛṣāśramakarṣitāḥ ||
dyugrāmadyujalākhāhaṃ yāsyāmi na budhopamaḥ |
katham eti dadarśāsau tṛṣṇāvyākulitendriyāḥ ||
snāyubaddhāsthicaraṇā dhāvamānānitas tataḥ (?) |
pretaskandhasamārūḍham ekaṃ vicitradarśanam ||
dadarśa bahubhiḥ pretaiḥ samantāt parivāritam |
āgacchāmānam avyagraṃ stutiśabdapuraḥsaram ||
pretaskandhāṃ mahīṃ gatvā tasyāntikam upāgamat |
so ‘bhivādya vaṇik śreṣṭam idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
asmin ghoratare deśe bhavataḥ katham āgamaḥ |
tam uvāca vaṇig dhīmān sārthabhraṣṭasya me vane ||
praveśo daivayogena pūrvakarmakṛtena tu |
tṛṣṇā me bādhate sārtha kṣudbhramo ‘yaṃ bhṛśaṃ tathā ||
prāṇāḥ kaṇṭham anuprāptā vacanaṃ nṛpatīva me |
annopāyaṃ na paśyāmi jīveyaṃ nṛpa kenacit ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ity evam ukte pretas taṃ vaṇijaṃ vākyam abravīt |
punnāmam idam utsṛjya pratīkṣa samuhūrtakam ||
kṛtyātithyo mayā rājan janiṣtasi. yathāsukham |
evamuktas tathā cakre sa vaṇik tṛṣṇayārditaḥ ||
madhyāhnasamaye prāpte tatas taddeśamāgataḥ |
sannāsavṛkṣāchāntodrā vāridhāṇī manoramā ||
[1168] dadhyodanasya yuktena vardhamānena saṃyutān |
avatīrya tatas tv agryaṃ pradadātīṣṭaye tadā ||
teṣāṃ gām annadānena vaṇik tṛptim upāgataḥ |
vitṛṣṇo vijvaraś caiva kṣaṇena samapadyata ||
tatas tu metasaṃ yasya tasmād bhāgaṃ samādadau |
dadhyodanānnapānīyāt pretās tṛptiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ ||
atithiṃ tarpayitvā ca pretalokaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
tataḥ svayaṃ ca bubhuje bhuktaśeṣaṃ yathāsukham ||
tasya bhuktavataś chatraṃ pānīyaṃ cākṣayaṃ yayau |
pretādhipatayas tasya vaṇigvacanam abravīt ||
āścaryam etat paramaṃ vane ‘smiṃś cātibhāti me |
annapānasya saṃprāptiḥ param asya kutas tava ||
stokena ca tathānnena bibharṣi subahūn pṛthak |
tṛmamas te kathaṃ tattve nirmāsābhinnakukṣavaḥ ||
aparaṃ ca kathaṃ śleha mama vāpaparikṣaye |
hastābalaṃ vakaṃ kas tvaṃ saṃtapto nirjale vane ||
tṛṣṇaś cāsi kathaṃ grāsamātre geṣu bhavān api |
kas tvam asyāṃ sughorāyāṃ suvṛthāṃ tuhatīlalaḥ ||
tad etac chaṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama |
evam uktaḥ sa vaṇijā preto vacanam abravīt ||
śṛṇu bhadra pravakṣyāmi duṣkṛtaṃ karma cātmanaḥ |
śālake nagare ramye aham āsaṃ sudurmatiḥ ||
vaṇik saktaḥ purā kālo tītorvahur (?) mamayānagha |
[1169] sākale nagare ramye nāstikasya durātmanaḥ ||
dhanalobhān mayā tatra na kadā vittabheditā |
na dattā bhikṣave bhikṣā tṛṣṇāyā jaladena ca ||
prativeśas tu tatrāsīd brāhmaṇo gunavān mama |
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā ||
saha kaścin mayā sārdhaṃ toṣīṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau |
tasyāś ca saṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ yatrāsīc candragaṅgayā ||
candrabhāgā somasutā tatrāsīc cārkanandinī |
tapaḥśītoṣṇasalile saṃgame sumanohare ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snānaṃ caiva tathoṣitaḥ |
candrabhāgasya toyasya vāridhān pītavān dṛḍham ||
dadhyodanayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃpūrṇair vardhamānakaiḥ |
chatropanadyugaṃ vastraṃ pratimāṃ vidhivad dhareḥ ||
pradadau vipramukhyāya rahasyajño mahāmuniḥ |
vittasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya tasyāpi ca tato mayā ||
sopavāsena dattā vā paridhātisuśobhanā |
candrabhāgasya pradadau vipra puṣpayutā tadā ||
etat kṛtvā gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ tataḥ kālena kenacit |
pañcatvam aham āsādya nāstikyāt pretatāṃ gataḥ ||
asyām aṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ tathā dṛṣṭās tvayānagha |
brahmasvahāriṇas tv ete pāpāḥ pretatvam āgatāḥ ||
paradāraratāḥ kecit svāmidroharatāḥ pare |
mitradroharatāḥ kecid deśe ‘smiṃs tu sudāruṇe ||
[1170] mamaite vipado yātā annapānakṛte ‘nagha |
akṣayo bhagavān viṣṇuḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ||
yad dīyate tam uddiśya akṣayaṃ tat prakīrtitam |
mayā vihīnāḥ kiṃ tattvaṃ vane ‘smin bhṛśadāruṇe ||
pīḍām anubhaviṣyanti dāruṇāṃ karmayonijām |
eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga mamānugrahakāmyayā ||
anekanāmagotrāṇi gṛhṇīyās tv akhilena ca |
asti cokṣāgatā caiva tava saṃpuṭikā śūbhā ||
himavatyāṃ tathāsādya yatra tv anviṣyate nidhim |
gatyāśīrṣaṃ tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate ||
ekam ekam athoddiśya pretaṃ pretaṃ yathāsukham |
evaṃ saṃbhāṣyamāṇo ‘sau taptajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ ||
vimānavaram āruhya svargalokam ito gataḥ |
svarge ca pretanāthena prabhāvāt sa vaṇik kramāt ||
nāmagotrāṇi saṃgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himācalam |
tatra prāpya nidhiṃ gatvā vinikṣipya svake gṛhe ||
dhanabhāgam upādāya gayāśīrṣaṃ vaṭaṃ yayau |
pretānāṃ kramaśas tatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dine dine ||
yasya yasya yathāśrāddhaṃ sa karoti dine vaṇik |
sa sa tasya sadā svapne darśayaty ātamanas tanum ||
vratīti ca mahābhāga prasādena tavānagha |
pretabhāvaṃ mayā tyaktaṃ prāpto ‘smi paramāṃ gatim ||
satkṛtvā dhanalābhasya pretānṃ satkṛtiṃ vaṇik |
[1171] jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tathā ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam |
dānaṃ ca datvā viprebhyaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
mahānadīsaṃgameṣu prativarṣaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
cakāra vidhivad dānaṃ tato dṛṣṭāntam āgataḥ ||
avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ sarvamānavaiḥ |
tatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ||
śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣakriṇyo manoramāḥ |
taṃ deśam āsādya vaṇika mahātmā
sumṛṣṭajāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgaḥ |
kalpaṃ samagraṃ saha sundarībhiḥ
sārdhaṃ suhṛdbhir muditaḥ sadaiva ||
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī saṃgamodake |
dānaṃ dadhyodanaṃ śastam upavāsaparo vidhiḥ ||
sagareṇa kukutsthena dhundhumāreṇa gādhinā |
etaiś cānyaiś ca rājendra kāmadā dvādaśī kṛtā ||
yā dvādaśī budhayutā śravaṇena sārdhaṃ
sā vai jayeti kathitā munibhir nabhasye |
tām ādareṇa samupoṣya naro hi samyak
prāpnoti siddhim aṇimādiguṇopapannām ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ śravaṇadvādaśīvratam |
[1172]
brahmovāca |
trailokyagāmino devī lakṣmīs te ‘stu sadā priyā |
dvādaśī ca tithis te ‘stu kāmarūpī ca jāyate ||
hariṃ pratīdaṃ vacanam |
ghṛtāśano (?) bhaved yas tu dvādaśyāṃ tatparāyaṇaḥ |
sa svargavāsī bhavatu pumān strī vā viśeṣataḥ ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ harivratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
bhuvane bhārataś caiva sujātyaḥ sujanas tathā |
kratuḥ sarvaś ca mūrdhā ca tejaḥ satyasravāḥ sadā ||
prasavaś cāvyayaś caiva dakṣo dvādaśakas tathā |
bhagīvā nāma nirdiṣṭā devā dvādaśa yajñiyāḥ ||
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kuryād dvādaśyāṃ niyamena tu |
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadāḥ ||
saṃvatsarānte dadyāc ca brāhmaṇāya payasvinīṃ ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
prāpnoti teṣāṃ tu salokam eva |
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyo
rājā bhaved vā dvijapuṅgavo vā ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ bhṛguvratam |
[1173]
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
manomanas tathā prāṇo naro jātaś ca vīryavān |
vītir hayonaghaś caiva haṃso nārāyaṇas tathā ||
vibhiś cāpi prabhuś caiva svādhyā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ |
pūjayec chuklapakṣe tān dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣataḥ ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
prāpnoti teṣāṃ tu sa salokam eva |
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyo
rājā bhaved vā dvijapuṅgavo vā ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ sādhyavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
dhātā mitro ‘ryamā pūṣā śakro ‘ṃśo varuṇo bhagaḥ |
tvaṣṭā vivasvān savitā viṣṇur dvādaśakas tathā ||
pūjayed dvādaśādityān śuklapakṣe upoṣitaḥ |
mārgaśīrṣād athārabhya dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ ||
datvā vratānte puruṣaḥ suvarṇaṃ
prāpnoti lokān savitur nṛvīra |
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavaty arogo
jitendriyaś caiva dhanānvitaś ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ dvādaśādityavratam |
[1174]
pulastya uvāca |
pauṣe māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ śakradaivate |
nakṣatrayogage viṣṇuṃ prathamaṃ tu samarcayet ||
tataḥ prabhṛti viprendra māsi māsi janārdanam |
upoṣitaḥ pūjayeta yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ gatam ||
māse ca māse vidhinoditena
tasyāṃ tithau dānam iti bravīmi |
prāśyaṃ yathāvad vidhivat krameṇa
tad ucyamānaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha ||
ghṛtaṃ yathā vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ
yavānnam ambhaś caṇakānnapānam |
chatraṃ payo ‘nnaṃ guḍaphāṇitāḍyaṃ
sucandanaṃ vastram anukrameṇa ||
ekaikapādoktam ekaikadānaṃ
gomūtram ambho ghṛtam āmaśākam |
dūrvādadhivrīhiyavaṃ tilāṃś ca
sūryāṃśutaptaṃ jalam ambudārbham ||
kṣīraṃ ca māsakramaśaḥ prayuktaṃ
dārbham ambukuśodakam |
kulapradhāne dhanadhānyapūrṇe
vivekavatyastasamastaduḥkhe ||
[1175] prāpnoti janmāvikalendriyaś ca
bhavaty arogo matimān sukhī ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sujanmadvādaśīvratam |
bṛhaspatir uvāca |
kathaṃ sa rājā bhāgyasthaḥ sarvalokādhiko vibhuḥ |
kathaṃ ca divyatāṃ prāpto viṣṇusāyujyatāṃ vibho ||
sarvadeveśvaras tasya kathaṃ tuṣṭa umāpatiḥ ||
brahmovāca |
bhāgyarkṣadvādaśī nāma sarvabhāgyapradāyinī |
tatra kṛtvā harer arcām iṣṭvā padmair yathāvidhi ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannām aṣṭāvakro mahāmuniḥ |
harer arcā harirūpā pratimā |
śaṅkarārdhaṃ hareḥ puṃsa ubhe saṃsthāpayed vaśī ||
śaṅkarārdhaṃ harer ityādi śaṅkarasyārdhaṃ hareś ca puruṣasyārdhaṃ saty evaṃ hariharamūrtim ubhe saṃsthāpayed ity arthaḥ |
bhaktyā sarvopahāreṇa dvādaśīreṇumaṇḍāle |
ādyena cakrarājena pūjito madhusūdanaḥ ||
tutoṣa tasya nṛpates tena bhāgyatvam āpnuyāt |
cakrarājo mahāsudarśanamantraḥ |
tuṣṭena devadevena varo datto dvijottama ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ bhavān vatsa mama tulyo bhaviṣyati |
[1176] bhāgyarkṣadvādaśī tāta aṣtamyāṃ vā tadarcanam ||
yāgamaṇḍalapūjārghaṃ harim uddiśya kārayet |
ācāryāya pradātavyaṃ hemagobhūtilādikam ||
dakṣiṇāṃ vittasāreṇa punāti narkārṇavāt |
yugabhāgyaprabhāvena prayacchati phalaṃ hariḥ ||
yugabhāgyaprabhāveṇeti yugasya kṛtāder bhāgyasya karmaṇaḥ prabhāveṇety arthaḥ |
yathā kāle ca kṣetre ca ekāpi gaṇikā gatā |
prayāti śatadhā vṛddhiṃ tathā bhāgyayuge dvija ||
yathā bhāgye tathā pauṣṇe vāsave ca dvijottama |
tulyarūpaṃ vijānīyād dvādaśyām aṣṭamīṣu ca ||
bhāgyaṃ bhagadaivatyaṃ pūrvaphalgunī nakṣatraṃ pauṣṇaṃ revatī vāsavaṃ dhaniṣṭhā |
tuṣyate devadeveśaḥ śaśāṅkāṅkitaśekharaḥ |
putrāyūrājyasaubhāgyaṃ prayacchati janardanaḥ ||
māsi māsi ca yo martyaḥ karoti hariharārcanam |
padme sulakṣaṇopete sarvavarṇopaśobhite ||
tasya tuṣyati deveśaś cakrapāṇir janārdanaḥ ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ bhāgyarkṣadvādaśīvratam |
puṣyārakdvādaśī puṇyā sarvapāpanivarhaṇī |
kṛtā vā kena sā śakra ghṛtapātraprayādinā ||
tadā pratyakṣatas tasya devadevo janārdanaḥ |
[1177] dadarśa svāṃ tanuṃ śubhrāṃ pītāṃ caiva caturbhujām ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ puṣyārkadvādaśīvratam |
brahmovāca |
dvādaśyāṃ viṣnum iṣṭveha sarvadā vijayī bhavet |
pūjyaś ca sarvalokānāṃ yathā gopatigokaraḥ ||
gopatiḥ sūryo gokaro natraraśmir yasya sa gopatigokaro viṣṇuḥ |
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiśca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etat tu vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaviṣṇuvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
aviyogavrataṃ brūhi mama yādavanandana |
vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛk ca kiṃ puṇyaṃ kātra devatā ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pāṇḍava yatnena kathyamānaṃ mayā khila (?) |
aviyogavrataṃ nāma vratānām uttamaṃ vratam ||
[1178] śukle proṣṭhapade māsi dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
snātvā jalāśaye svacche śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ||
jalānte maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayenātiśobhanam |
godhūmacūrṇais tanmadhye salakṣmīkaṃ janārdaham ||
lepayitvā haraṃ gaurīṃ sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā saha |
rājñā saha raviṃ rājaṃs trailokyodyotakārakam ||
gandhapuṣpais tathā dhūpair naivedyair bhaktito ‘rcayet |
aviyogavrataṃ pārtha mantreṇānena tadgataḥ ||
aviyogā dṛḍhamanāś cetasy ādhāya keśavam |
śaṅkaraṃ padmayoniṃ ca raviṃ gaganabhūṣaṇam ||
idam uccārayet pārtha kṛtvā tatpraṇavaṃ namaḥ |
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ padmanābho janārdanaḥ ||
vyāsarṣikapilācāryau bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
nārāyaṇo ‘tha madhuhā viṣṇur dāmodaro hariḥ ||
mahāvarāho govindaḥ keśavo garuḍadhvajaḥ |
śrīdharaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo viśvarūpas trivikramaḥ ||
upendro vāsmano rāmo vaikuṇṭho mādhavo dhruvaḥ |
vāsudevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo ‘cyutaḥ ||
aniruddho mahāyogī pradyumno ‘nanta eva ca |
nityaṃ mamāstu suprītaḥ śrīkaṇṭho ‘riniṣūdanaḥ ||
umāpatir nīlakaṇṭhaḥ sthānuḥ śambhur bhago ‘rihā |
īśāno bhairavaḥ śūlī tryambakas tripurāntakaḥ ||
kapardī gopatir liṅgī mahākālo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
[1179] śivaḥ sarvo mahādevo rudro bhūtagaṇeśvaraḥ ||
mamāstu saha pārvatyā śaṅkaraḥ śaṅkaraḥ sadā |
brahmā śambhur vibhuḥ (?) sraṣṭā pauṣakaraḥ prapitāmahaḥ ||
hiraṇyagarbho vedajñaḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ |
vedhāś caturmukhaḥ kartā svayaṃbhūḥ kamalāsanaḥ ||
viriñciḥ padmayoniś ca mamāstu varadaḥ sadā |
ādityo bhāskaro bhānuḥ sūryo ‘rkaḥ savitā raviḥ ||
mārtaṇḍo maṇḍalo dyoto raśmimālī grahāgraṇīḥ |
prabhākaraḥ saptasaptis taraṇir dyumaṇiḥ khagaḥ ||
divākaro dinakaraḥ sahasrāṃśur marīcimān |
padmaprabodhanaḥ pūṣā jagaccakṣur dyubhūṣaṇaḥ ||
dvādaśātmā mahātejā mitraḥ kālāntako hariḥ |
nikṣubhāvallabho devaḥ suprīto ‘stu sadā mama ||
lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ kamalā padmā vibhūtir harivallabhā |
pārvatī lalitā gaurī umā śambhupriyā satī ||
gāyatrī prakṛtiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ sāvitrī devasaṃmatā |
rājñī bhānumatī saṃjñā nikṣubhā bhāskarapriyā ||
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtir vimalā tathā |
amoghā vidyutiś caiva ity ete mūrtirūpatataḥ (?) ||
iti svarūpo jñeyaḥ | sūryas tu śmaśrulaś caturbāhur ūrdhvakaradvayadhṛtakamalaḥ adhaḥkara-dvayadhṛtapuṣpamālaḥ kartavyaḥ vāmapārśve svarṇapaṅkajakarā nikṣubhā kartavyā iti | padmanābhaśaṅkarapitāmahārkādīn sapriyān kṛtvā | datvā dānaṃ gurave cānte vrajed veśma-[1180]-yaś caritanaraḥ kaścid vratam etad bhaktibhāvito loko bhavati ca sa dhanabhāgī santatimān vigatasantāpaḥ | hariharahiraṇyagarbhaprabhākarāṇāṃ krameṇa lokeṣu bhuktvā bhogān vipulān viyogī atha sunirvṛto bhavati strīpuṃsayor yadi yugmaṃ puruṣo ‘pi yadi samācaret kaścid yad nārī vā vratam etac cīrtvā yātpālayaṃ viṣṇoḥ |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam aviyogadvādaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
akṣauhiṇyo daśāṣṭau ca madrājyārthe kaṣayaṃgatāḥ |
tena pāpena me citte jugupsātīva jāyate ||
tatra brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyāḥ śūdrādayo hatāḥ |
bhīṣmadroṇakaliṅgādikarṇaśalyasuyodhanāḥ ||
teṣāṃ vadhena yat pāpaṃ tan me marmāṇi kṛntati |
pāpaprakṣālanaṃ kiṃcid dharmaṃ brūhi jagatpate ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
sumahatpuṇyajananaṃ govindadvādaśīvratam |
asti pārtha mahābāho pāṇḍavānāṃ duharandhara ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yeyaṃ godvādaśī nāma vidhānaṃ tatra kīdṛśam |
katham eṣā samutpannā kasmin kāle janārdana ||
[1181] etat sarvaṃ hare brūhi māṃ tara narakārṇavāt ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā kṛtayuge pārtha munikoṭiḥ samāgatāḥ |
tapaś cacāra vipulaṃ nānāvratadharā girau ||
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā devadarśanakāṅkṣayā |
jambūmārge mahāpuṇye nānātīrthavibhūṣite ||
pāripātre siddhapātre ramye badarikāśrame |
ghaṇṭāravīti vikhyāte uttame śikhare nṛpe ||
tāpasāraṇyam atulaṃ divyakānanamaṇḍitam |
vasiṣṭhaśukrāṅgirasakratudakṣādibhir vṛtam ||
valkalājinasaṃvītair bhṛgor āśramamaṇḍalam |
nānāmṛgagaṇair yuṣṭaṃ (?) śākhāmṛgagaṇair yutam ||
praśāntasiṃhahariṇaṃ vastusarvagatadrumam |
gahanaṃ nirutsanaṃ ramyaṃ tālasantānasaṃkulam ||
siṃhavyāghragajair bhinnaṃ hariṇaiḥ śaṃśaraiḥ śaraiḥ |
varāhatutubhiś citraiḥ samantād upaśobhitam ||
tapasyatāṃ tatra teṣāṃ munīnāṃ darśanārthinām |
vyājaṃ cakre mahīnātha dvādaśārdhārdhalocanaḥ ||
babhūva brāhmaṇo vṛddho jarāpāṇḍuramūrdhajaḥ |
ślathacarmatanuḥ kubjo pāśapāṇiḥ savepathuḥ ||
umā vicakre gorūpaṃ śṛṇuyāt pārtha yādṛśam |
kṣīrodatoyasaṃbhūtāḥ yāḥ purāmṛtamanthane ||
pañca gāvaḥ śubhāḥ pārtha pañcakasya ca mātaraḥ |
[1182] nandā subhadrā surabhī suśīlā bahulā satī ||
yato lokopakārāya devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca |
jamadagnir bharadvājavasiṣṭhaśivagautamāḥ ||
jagṛhuḥ kāmadāḥ pañca gāvo datvā surais tataḥ |
gomayaṃ rocanā mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ gavām ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni pavitrāṇi saṃśuddhikaraṇāni ca |
gomayād utthitaḥ śrīmān bilvavṛkṣaḥ śivapriyaḥ ||
tatrāste padmahastā śrīḥ śrīvṛkṣas tena sa smṛtaḥ |
bījāny utpalapadmānāṃ punar jātāni gomayāt ||
gorocanā ca māṅgalyā pavitrā sarvasādhikā |
gomūtrāj juhūṣur jātaḥ sugandhaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ||
āhāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ śivasya ca viśeṣataḥ |
jagadbījaṃ jagatkiṃcit taj jñeyaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam ||
dadhnaḥ sarvāṇi jātāni maṅgalāny arthasiddhaye |
ghṛtād amṛtam utpannaṃ devānāṃ toṣakāraṇam ||
brāhmaṇāś caiva gāvaś ca kulam ekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam |
ekatra mantrās tiṣṭhanti havir anyatra tiṣṭhati ||
goṣu yajñāḥ pravartante goṣu devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
goṣu devāḥ samudgīrṇāḥ sa ṣaḍaṅgapadakramāḥ ||
śṛṅgamūle gavāṃ nityaṃ brahmaviṣṇū samāśritau |
śṛṅgāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ||
śiromadhye mahādevaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam |
[1183] lalāṭe saṃsthitā gaurī nāsārandhre ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ ||
kambale ‘śvatarau nāgau nāsāpuṭasamāśritau |
karṇayor aśvinau devau cakṣuṣoḥ śaśibhāskarau ||
danteṣu vasavaḥ sarve jihvāyāṃ varuṇaḥ sthitaḥ |
sarasvatī ca huṅkāre yamayakṣau ca gaṇḍayoḥ ||
saṃdhyādvayaṃ tathoṣṭhābhyāṃ grīvāyāṃ ca purandaraḥ |
rakṣāṃsi kukṣau devyau ca pārṣṇikāye vyavasthitau ||
catuṣpāt sakalo dharmo nityaṃ jaṅghāsu tiṣṭhati |
khuramadhyeṣu gandharvāḥ kurāgreṣu ca pannagāḥ ||
khurāṇāṃ paścime bhāge rākṣasāḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ |
rudrā ekādaśāḥ pṛṣṭhe vasavaḥ sarvasandhiṣu ||
śroṇītaṭasthāḥ pitaraḥ kulvākeṣu ca mānavaḥ |
udare pṛthivī sarvā saśailavanakānanā ||
catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ pūrṇā gavāṃ ye tu payodharāḥ |
parjanyaḥ kṣīradhārāsu meghabinduvyavasthitāḥ ||
udare gārhapatyo ‘gnir dakṣiṇāgnir hṛdi sthitaḥ |
kaṇṭhe āhavanīyo ‘gniḥ sabhyo ‘gniḥ sthāṇuni sthitaḥ ||
asthni vācaḥ sthitāḥ śailā majjāsu kratavasthitāḥ |
[1184] ṛgvedo ‘tharvavedaś ca sāmavedo yajus tathā ||
sitaraktapītakṛṣṇā gavāṃ varṇā vyavasthitāḥ |
nāsārūpam upāśritya surabhīṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
yatśritya tatkṣaṇād gaurī ādityasaṛśī tanuḥ |
ātmānaṃ vidadhe devī darmarāja śṛṇuṣva tat ||
ṣaḍunnatāṃ pañcanimnāṃ maṇḍukākṣīṃ suvāladhim |
tāmrasūnīsthitakaṭhiṃ sukharīṃ sumukhīṃ mitām ||
suśīlāṃ ca vasusnehāṃ susukṣīrāṃ paryodharām |
gorūpiṇīmukhāṃ spṛṣṭvā svāmine cātra vāsakam ||
caryayā prataraṃ hṛṣṭo mahādevasya cetasi |
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ yayau pārtha viprarūpī mahāśramaḥ ||
datvā kulapateḥ pārśvaṃ bhṛgoḥ svāṅgaṃ nivedayet |
tapasvināṃ mahātejās teṣu sarveṣu pāṇḍava ||
nyāsarūpāṃ dadau dhenuṃ rakṣatv enāṃ dinadvayam |
yāvat svatvā itas tīrtvā jāmbūmārgād ihāsmy aham ||
rakṣiṣyāmo pratijñā yā munibhiḥ surabhīm imām |
ataddhe mṛgavad devaḥ punar vyāghro babhūva ha ||
vajracakranakho darvī jvalapiṅgalalocanaḥ |
jihvākarālavadano jihvā lāṅgūladātugaḥ ||
saṃpadāśramaphādantīṃ dhenuṃ caiva savatsakām |
trāsayāmāsa nādena munīnāṃ dikṣv avasthitāḥ ||
ṛṣayo ‘pi samākrāntā dārtanādaṃ pracakrire |
hā hety uccaiḥ kecud ūcuḥ huhuṅkārāṃs tathāpare ||
[1185] tālasphoṭāṃ daduḥ kecid vyāghraṃ dṛṣṭvātibhairavam |
svāminaṃ bhīravaṃ cakre gaur uplūtya savatsakā ||
tasyā vyāghrabhayārtāyāḥ kapilāyā yudhiṣṭhiria |
palāyāsyāḥ śilāmadhye kṣaṇaṃ ca haratuṣṭaye ||
vyāghravatsakayos tatra vandanaṃ surakinnaraiḥ |
dṛśyate ‘tīva suvyaktaṃ na dadāmi catuṣpadam ||
sajalaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ ca śambos tīrthaṃ tad uttamam |
yas tvaṃ spṛśati rājendra sa govadhād vyapohati ||
tatra snātvā mahātīrthe jambūmārge gaṇādhipa |
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpair mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
tatas te munayaḥ kruddhā brahmadattāṃ mahāsvanām |
jaghnur ghaṇṭāṃ surair dattāṃ girikandarapūraṇīm ||
śabdena tena vyāghro ‘pi muktvā gāvaṃ savatsakām |
viprais tatra kṛtaṃ nāma ḍhuḍhugīr iti viśrutam ||
apiban paripeyārthaṃ te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
atha pratyakṣataḥ śreṣṭhas teṣāṃ devo maheśvaraḥ ||
śūlapānis tripurahā kāmāpto vṛṣabhe sthiraḥ |
umāsahāyo varadaḥ sasvāmī savināyakaḥ ||
sanandī samahākālaḥ sabhṛṅgī sabalo haraḥ |
vīrabhadaś ca cāmuṇḍāghaṇṭākarṇādibhir vṛtaḥ ||
mātṛbhir vata saṃghātair yakṣarākṣasaguhyakaiḥ |
devadānavagandharvamunividyādharoragaiḥ ||
praṇamya devadevāya patnībhiḥ sahitais tathā |
[1186] gorūpiṇī savatsā ca pūjitā brahmacāribhiḥ ||
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ nandinīvrataiḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra avatīrṇo mahītale ||
uttānapādena tathā vrataṃ cīrṇam idaṃ śṛṇu |
uttānapādanāmāsīt kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsīd ruciśrughnīti viśrutam |
śrughnyāṃ (?) jāto dhruvaḥ putro bālapādadharo ‘vyayaḥ ||
rucyāḥ samarpitaḥ śrughnyā dhruvo ‘yaṃ rakṣyatāṃ sakhi |
ahaṃ kariṣye śuśrūṣāṃ bhartus tāvat sadā svayam ||
nṛvīraṃ savituṃ nityaṃ pratijñā jāyate gṛhe |
karoti bhartuḥ (?) śuśrūṣāṃ śrughnī (?) nityaṃ pativratā ||
kadācit krodham āsādya sapatnyā janitaṃ tayā |
svayaṃ ca vyāhaniṣyāmi śuśuḥ khaṇḍachaviḥ kṛtaḥ ||
tato ‘pi kāyaṃ tatsthālyām ekaḥ siddhaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ |
annabhojanavelāyāṃ dadāti nṛpateḥ svayam ||
bhuñjīta svapatiṃ coktvā sāmiṣaṃ bhojanaṃ kila |
atha bhojanavelāyāṃ dhruvo jīvitam āptavān ||
tathaiva ca prasannātmā mātur utsaṅgago ‘bhavat |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahad āścaryaṃ śrughnī papraccha vismitā ||
kim etad brūhi vṛttāntaṃ yasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ tat tayā |
kiṃ tvayā caritaṃ kiṃcid vrataṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā ||
[1187] satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ yena jīvati te sutaḥ |
śayyāyāṃ suptavān bālo nihatya śakalīkṛtaḥ ||
pakvaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ sthālyāṃ vyañjanaiḥ saha bhojanaiḥ |
pariśiṣyamānā (?) punaḥ kathaṃ jīvitam āptavān ||
kiṃ te siddhā mahāvidyā mṛtasaṃjīvanī śubhā |
ratnaṃ maṇimahāratnaṃ yogāñjanamahauṣadham ||
kathayasva mahābhāge satyaṃ satyaṃ bhaginy asi |
evam ukte tu vṛtte ‘syāḥ vyācakhyau vatsakavratam ||
kārttike śukladvādaśyāṃ yathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ purā |
vratasyāsya prabhāvena punar jīvati me sutaḥ ||
vatso me vatsavelāyāṃ mano’rthe malate punaḥ |
samāgamaś ca bhavati vrataiḥ pravasitair api ||
yathārtham etad vyākhyātaṃ tava godvādaśīvratam |
kadāpi caitat sarvaṃ tu bhaviṣyati śubhāśubhā ||
evam uktavrataṃ cīrṇaṃ rucyāḥ putrāḥ sukhānvitāḥ |
saṃprāptajīvitānte ca dhruvasthāne niveṣitāḥ ||
brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāreṇa rucir bhartrā sahoṣitā |
daśanakṣatrasaṃyukto dhruvaḥ so ‘dyāpi dṛśyate ||
dhruvarkṣeṇa yadā dṛṣṭe lokaḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
[1188] yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kīdṛśaṃ tadvidhānaṃ ca tan me brūhi janārdana |
yat kṛtaṃ śrughnīvacanād rucyā yadukulodvaha ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
saṃpāpte kārttike māsi śuklapakṣe nṛpottama |
dvādaśyāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ (?) snātvā śuddhe jalāśaye ||
naro vā yadi vā nārī naktaṃ saṃkalpya cetasi |
tato madhyāhnasamaye kṛtvā devārcanādikam ||
pratīkṣetāgamaṃ bhaktyā gavāṃ godhyānatatparaḥ |
savatsāṃ tulyavarṇāṃ ca śīlinīṃ gām payasvanīm ||
candanāibhir ālilpya puṣpamālābhir arcayet |
kuṅkumālaktakair dhūpaiḥ dhūpadīpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||
atha tāmramaye pātre kṛtvā puṣpākṣatais tilaiḥ |
candanaiḥ kuṅkumair gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavais tathā ||
pādamūle tu dātavyā mantreṇānena pāṇḍava |
pātā rudreṇa ity eṣa mantraḥ prokto dvijanmanā ||
strīśūdrāṇāṃ mahābāho mantro ‘yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ |
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūte surāsuranamaskṛte ||
sarvadevamaye mātar gṛhāṇārdhyaṃ namo ‘stu te |
[1189] dattārghyaṃ tajjalaṃ puṇyaṃ sākṣataṃ (?) mūrdhni nikṣipet ||
tato māsādi saṃsiddhān vaṭakāṃś ca nivedayet |
pañc asapta daśaikaṃ vā yathāvibhavam ātmanaḥ ||
surabhi tvaṃ jaganmātar nityaṃ viṣṇupade sthite |
sarvadevamaye grāsaṃ nayādya tvam imaṃ śubham ||
dattārghyo dattanaivedyaḥ kṛtapūjaḥ susaṃyataḥ |
prārthayed āśiṣaṃ prājño vadhyāgre karasaṃpuṭam ||
sarvadevamaye devi sarvavedair alaṅkṛtā |
mātar mamābhilaṣitaṃ saphalaṃ kuru nandini ||
evam abhyarcya vidhivad datvā gavi gavāhnikam |
paryukṣya vāriṇā bhaktyā praṇamyātha punaḥ punaḥ ||
taddine tāyikāpakvaṃ (?) sthālīpākaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
gokṣīraṃ goghṛtaṃ datvā dadhikṣīraṃ visarjayet ||
māṣānnaṃ kāmato ‘śnīyād rātrau vigatamatsaraḥ |
bhūmyāṃ svapan brahmacārī śṛṇu yat phalam āpnuyāt ||
yāvanti gātraromāṇi gavāṃ kauravanandana |
tāvad dināni goloke pūjito modate ‘maraiḥ ||
nārī vā kurute jātu vratam etad yudhiṣṭhira |
meroḥ pūrvāṣṭakaṃ ramyam indrāgniyamarakṣasām ||
varuṇānilarudrāṇāṃ rudrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira |
teṣām upari golokas tatra yāti sa govratī ||
[1190] ūrjām ante hi daśame ‘hni ca gāṃ savatsāṃ
yāḥ pūjayanti vaṭakaiḥ kusumaiś ca hṛdyaiḥ |
tāḥ sarvakāmasukhabhogavibhūtibhājo
martye ca santi suciraṃ nṛpateś ca vatsāḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ govatsadvādaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā babhūva rājarṣir ajāpāla iti śrutaḥ |
prāpitaḥ sa prajābhis tu sarvaduḥkhāpanuttaye ||
duḥkhāpanodanaṃ kuru bho vyādhir nānā nareśvara |
evam uktaś ciraṃ dhyātvā kṛtvā vyādhīnajāgaṇān ||
pālayāmāsa hṛṣṭo ‘sau ajāpālas tato ‘bhavat |
tenaiṣā nirmitā śāntiḥ nāmnā nīrājanā jane ||
tasyāṃ tu pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha lakṣaṇaṃ vacmi te śṛṇu |
rājā purohitaiḥ sārdham anuṣṭhāya vidhānataḥ ||
tasmin kāle babhūvātha rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ |
laṅkāsthitaḥ suragaṇo niyunakti svakarmasu ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ candram ātapatraṃ cakāra ha |
indraṃ senāpatiṃ cakre vāyuṃ pāṃśupramārjakam ||
varuṇaṃ bandhakarmasthaṃ dhanadaṃ dhanarakṣakam |
yamaṃ saṃyamane ‘rīṇāṃ yuyuje mantraṇe manum ||
medhāchandanti lipyanti drumā puṣpāṇi cikṣipuḥ |
saptarṣayaḥ śāntiparā brāhmaṇāḥ saṃsthitāḥ pare ||
[1191] yamo yāmakakakṣāyāṃ gandharvā gītatatparāḥ |
prekṣaṇīye ‘psaro ‘ṣṭau vā bāhye vidyādharāvṛtāḥ ||
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ pāne gārhapatyo hutāśane |
tiṣṭhanti pārthivāḥ pūrvāṃ purasevāvidhāyinaḥ ||
dīpyanti bhāsurai ratnaiḥ praśālāto vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha praśastaṃ pratihārakam ||
parāvartya mama sthāne brūhi ko ‘tra samāgataḥ |
uvāca ca praṇamyāgre danḍapāṇir niśācaraḥ ||
eṣāṃ kakustho māndhātā dhundhumāro nalo ‘rjunaḥ |
yayātir nahuṣo bhīmo rāghavo ‘yaṃ vidūrathaḥ ||
ete cānye ca bahavo rājāna iti āsate |
sevākarā na ca sthānenājāpāla ihāgataḥ ||
rāvaṇaḥ kupitaḥ prāha śīghraṃ dūtaṃ visarjaya |
ity ukte prahito dūto dhūmrākṣo nāma rākṣasaḥ ||
dhūmrākṣa gaccha brūhi tvam ajāpālaṃ mamājñayā |
sevāṃ kuru samāgaccha kabandhāyasya pārthiva ||
anyathā candrahāsena tvāṃ kariṣye vikandharam |
rāvaṇenaivam utktas tu dhūmrākṣo garuḍo yathā ||
saṃprāpya tāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ tac ca rājakulaṃ gataḥ |
dadarśa yatam ekaṃ sa ajāpālam ajāvṛtam ||
muktakeśaṃ muktakakṣaṃ naikabhuktaṃ kramadvayam |
yaṣṭiskandhaṃ reṇubhṛtaṃ vyādhibhiḥ parivāritam ||
[1192] nihatāmitraśārdūlaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam |
mahyām ālikhya nāmāni vinighnanti dviṣāṃ gaṇam ||
snānaṃ bhuktaṃ śubhe sthāne kṛtakṛtyaṃ manuṃ yathā |
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanāḥ prāha dhūmrākṣo rāvaṇoditam ||
sākṣepama ajapālo ‘pi pratyuktā kāraṇāntaram |
preṣayāmāsa dhūmrākṣaṃ tataḥ satyaṃ samādadhe ||
jvaram ākārayitvā tu provācedaṃ mahīpatiḥ |
gaccha laṅkādhipasthānam ācarasva yathocitam ||
niyuktas tv ajapālena jvararājo jagāma ha |
gatvā ca kampayāmāsa sagaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram ||
rāvaṇas tv aviditvā tu jvaraṃ paramadāruṇam |
provāca tiṣṭhatu nṛpas tena me na prayojanam ||
tataḥ sa vijvaro rājā babhūva dhanadānujaḥ |
tenaiṣā nirmitā śāntir ajapālena dhīmatā ||
sarvarogapraśamanī sarvopadravanāśanī |
kārttike śuklapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe ||
samutthite vinidre tu deve dāmodare tathā |
vidyānte naramālābhiramye strīvānurantike (?) ||
janayitvā navaṃ viṣṇuṃ hutvā mantrair dvijottamaiḥ |
vardhamānatapuṣpābhir dīpikābhir hutāśanam ||
kṛtvā mahājanāḥ sarve hariṃ nīrājayec chanaiḥ |
puṣpair abhyarcanaṃ devaṃ samālabhya ca candanaiḥ ||
badaraiḥ karvaraiś caiva trapusair ikṣubhis tathā |
[1193] gandhaiḥ puṣpair alaṃkārair vastrai ratnaiś ca pūjitaiḥ ||
tasyaivānumatāṃ lakṣmīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā |
ādityaṃ śaṅkaraṃ gaurīṃ yakṣaṃ gaṇapatiṃ grahān ||
mātaraḥ pitaro gāvaḥ sarvā nīrājayet kramāt |
gavāṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryān mahiṣyādeś ca maṇḍalam ||
bhrāmayet trāsayec chabdair ghaṇṭāvādanachādanaiḥ |
tā gāvaḥ prasnutā yāś ca tāsāṃ (?) pīḍā tathāgadā ||
sindūrakṛtaśṛṅgāgrā hambārāvāḥ savatsakāḥ |
anuyānti ca gopālāḥ kalayanto vanāni te ||
chedānuliptaraktāṅgā raktapītasitāmbarāḥ |
pañcakolāhale vṛtte gavāṃ nīrājanotsave ||
turaṅgān lakṣaṇair yuktān dviradāṃś ca supūjitān |
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi uddhṛtya svagṛhāṅgaṇe ||
rājā purohitaiḥ sārdhaṃ mantribhṛtyapuraḥsaraḥ |
siṃhāsanopaviṣṭaś ca śaṅkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ ||
pūjayed gandhakusumair vasudīpavilepanaiḥ |
iyam aśvādipūjā mahānavamyutsave draṣṭavyā |
tatra strī lakṣaṇair yuktā veśyā vātha kulāṅganā |
[1194] śīrṣopari narendrasya trirvāraṃ bhrāmayec ca sā ||
śāntir astu samidbhiś ca dvijair vedasvanena vā |
tato nīrā jayet sainyaṃ hastyaśvarathasaṃkulam ||
evam eṣā mahāśantiḥ khyātā nīrājanā jane |
yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pure grāme kriyate pāṇḍunandana ||
teṣāṃ rogāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti subhikṣaṃ vardhate sadā |
śāntinīrājanāloke sarvarogān vyapohati ||
lokānāṃ vardhayitvāyur ajapālacaro yathā |
yeṣāṃ rogādipīḍāsu jantūnāṃ hitam icchatā ||
varṣe varṣe prayoktavyā śāntinīrājanā iti |
nīrājayanti navemedhanibhaṃ hariṃ yo
gobrāhmaṇārthahitakāriṇam aśvagobhiḥ |
te sarvarogarahitāḥ sahitāś ca bhṛtyaiḥ
dīrghāyuṣo bhuvi bhavanty ajapālavākyāt ||
iti bhaviṣyottare nīrājanadvādaśīvratam |
sūta uvāca |
purā devāsure yuddhe hatais tu hariṇāsuraiḥ |
putrapautreṣu śokārtā gatvā bhūrlokam uttamam ||
[1195] samante pañcake tīrthe sarasvatyāḥ śubhe taṭe |
bhartur ārādhanaparā tapa ugraṃ cakāra ha ||
tadā ditir daityamātā ṛṣirūpeṇa saṃsthitā |
phalāhārā tapas tepe kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇān bahūn ||
yāvad varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ jarāśokasamākulā |
tataḥ sā tapasā taptā vasiṣṭhādīn apṛcchata ||
kathayantu bhavanto me putraśokavināśanam |
vrataṃ saubhāgyaphaladam iha loke paratra ca ||
ūcur vasiṣṭhapramukhā madanadvādaśīvratam |
yasya prasādād abhavat sutaśokavivarjitā ||
ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ |
śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ tvatto madanadvādaśīvratam |
sutān ekonapañcāśad yena lebhe ditiḥ purāḥ ||
sūta uvāca |
yad vasiṣṭhādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ diteḥ kathitam uttamam |
vistareṇa tad evedaṃ matsakāśān nibodhata ||
caitre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ sitataṇḍulapūritam ||
nānāphalayutaṃ tadvad ikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam |
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ sitacandanacarcitam ||
nānābhakṣyasamopetaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
[1196] tāmrapātraṃ guḍopetaṃ tasyopari niveśayet ||
tadabhāve kathāṃ kuryāt kāmakeśavayor niraḥ |
kāmanāmnā haret arcāṃ snāpayed guḍavāriṇā ||
śuklapuṣpākṣatatilair arcayed iti keśavam |
kāmāya pādau saṃpūjya jaṅghe saubhāgyadāyakam ||
ūrū smarāyeti punar manmathāyeti vai kaṭim |
stambodayāyety udaram anaṅgāyety uro hareḥ ||
mukhaṃ padmamukhāyeti bāhū pañcaśarāya vai |
namaḥ sarvātmane maulim arcayed iti keśavam ||
evaṃ prajāgaraṃ kṛtvā śuklamālyāmbaro vratī |
tataḥ prabhāte taṃ kumbhaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayec chaktyā svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ |
bhuktvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
prīyatām atra bhagavān kāmarūpī janārdanaḥ |
hṛdaye sarvabhūtānāṃ ya ātmety abhidhīyate ||
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsi māsi samācaret |
upavāsī trayodaśyām arcayed viṣnum avyayam ||
phalam ekaṃ ca saṃprāśya dvādaśyāṃ bhūtale svapet |
tatas trayodaśe māsi ghṛtadhenusamanvitām ||
śayyāṃ dadyād dvijendrāya sarvopaskarasaṃyutām |
kāñcanaṃ kāmadevaṃ ca śuklāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm ||
[1197] vāsobhir dvijadāmpatyaṃ pūjya śaktyā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
sarvagandhādikaṃ dadyāt prīyatām ity udīrayet ||
homaṃ śuklatilaiḥ kuryāt kāmanāmāni kīrtayet |
gavyena sarpiṣā tadvat pāyasena ca dharmavit ||
viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
ikṣudaṇḍān atho dadyāt puṣpamālāḥ svaśaktitaḥ ||
yaḥ kuryād vidhinānena nandanadvādaśīm imām |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti harisātmyatām ||
iha loke varān putrān saubhāgyasukham aśṇute |
yaḥ smaraḥ saṃsmṛto viṣṇur ānandātmā maheśvaraḥ ||
sukhārthī kāmarūpeṇa yajet taṃ jagadīśvaram |
tat śrutvā ca cacārāsu ditiḥ sarvam aśeṣataḥ ||
kaśyapo vratamāhātmyād āgatya parayā mudā |
ckārākarkaśāṃ bhūyo rūpayauvanaśālinīm ||
varair ācchādayāmāsa sā tu vavre varaṃ sutam |
tataḥ sā vratamāhātmyāl lebhe garbham anuttamam ||
kadācil labdhasaṃcāraṃ śatrutvāj jaṭharaṃ diteḥ |
praviśyaikonapañcāśat kṛtvā śakro jaghāna tām ||
tāvanto vālakā bhūya rurudurnamṛtiṃ gatāḥ |
tato vai cintayāmāsa kim etad iti vṛtrahā ||
dharmasya paśya māhātmyaṃ punaḥ saṃcīvitās tv amī |
kadācid anayā nūnaṃ madanadvādaśī kṛtā ||
[1198]
tatprasādena jīvanti janayā nihatā api |
nūnam etat pariṇatam adhunā tat tu pūjanam ||
vajreṇābhihatāḥ santo na vināśam avāpnuyuḥ |
ekāpy anekatām āpa yasmād garbho hato ‘py alam ||
aho māhātmyam etasmin madanadvādaśīvrate |
jīvaputrā bahusutā yena nārī prajāyate ||
iti matsyapurānoktaṃ madanadvādaśīvratam |
bhadrāśva uvāca |
vijñānotpattikāmasya ka ārādhyo bhaved dvija |
katham ārādhyate so hi etad ākhyāhi me dvija ||
agastya uvāca |
viṣṇur eva mahāyajñaḥ sarvadevair api prabhuḥ |
tasyopāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yenāsau varado bhavet ||
rahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ munīnām uttamas tathā |
nārāyaṇaḥ paro devaḥ taṃ praṇamya na sīdati ||
śrūyate ca purā rājan nāradena mahātmanā |
kathitaṃ puṣṭidaṃ viṣṇor vratam apsarasāṃ tathā ||
nāradas tu purākalpe gatavān mānasaṃ śaraḥ |
snānārthaṃ tatra so ‘paśyat sarvam apasarāṃ gaṇam ||
[1199] tās taṃ dṛṣṭvā vilāsinyo jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam |
asthicarmāvaśeṣaṃ tu chatrakuṇḍīkapālinam ||
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ didṛkṣuṃ kalahaṃ sadā |
brahmaputraṃ tapoyuktaṃ papracchus tā varānanāḥ ||
apsarasa ūcuḥ |
bhagavān brahmatanaya bhartṛkāmā vayaṃ dvija |
nārāyaṇaś ca bhartā no yathā syād ācacakṣva tat ||
nārada uvāca |
praṇāmapūrvakaḥ praśnaḥ sarvato bhavate śubhaḥ |
sa ca me na kṛto garvād yuṣmābhir yauvanasmayāt ||
tathā hi devadevasya viṣṇor yan nāmakīrtitam |
bhavatībhis tathā bhartā bhavatv iti hariḥ śubhaḥ ||
tannāmoccāraṇād eva kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
idānīṃ kathayāmāsa vrataṃ yena hariḥ svayam ||
varadantam avāpnoti bhartṛtvaṃ ca niyacchati |
vasante śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī yā bhavec chubhā ||
tasyām upoṣya vidhivat saśrīkaṃ harim arcayet |
paryaṅkāstaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nānāstaraṇasaṃyutam ||
tatra lakṣmyā yutaṃ devaṃ raupyaṃ kṛtvā nivedayet |
tasyopari tataḥ puṣyair maṇḍapaṃ kārayed budhaḥ ||
nṛtyavāditragītaiś ca jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
[1200] manobhavāyeti śiras tv anaṅgāyeti vai kaṭim ||
kāmāya bāhumūle tu kuśumāstrāya codaram |
manmathāyeti pādau tu harayeti ca sarvataḥ ||
puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ mallikājātibhis tathā |
paścāc catura ādāya ikṣudaṇḍān suśobhanān ||
caturdikṣu nyaset tasya devasya praṇato nṛpa |
evaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tu dāpayed brāhmaṇāya tam ||
vedavedāṅgayuktāya saṃpūrṇāṅgāya dhīmate |
brāhmaṇāṃś ca tathā bhojya vratam etat samāpyate ||
vratasyānte tato viṣṇur bhartā vo bhavati dhruvam |
akṛtvā matpraṇāmaṃ tu pṛṣṭaṃ garveṇa śobhanāḥ ||
vratenānena deveśaṃ patiṃ labdhvābhimānataḥ |
avamāne ‘paharaṇaṃ gopālair vo bhaviṣyati ||
parāhṛtānāṃ kanyānāṃ devo bhartā bhaviṣyati |
evam uktvā sa devarṣiḥ prayayau nāradaḥ kṣaṇāt ||
ato ‘py etad vrataṃ cakrus tuṣṭas tāsāṃ svayaṃ hariḥ |
iti bhaviṣyatpurānoktaṃ bhartṛprāptivratam |
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe ca māsi bhādrapade naraḥ |
naivedyagandhapuṣpādyair arcayej jalaśāyinam ||
[1201] na cālpaed vikarmasthān pāṣaṇḍān patitān narān |
snātvā japann ananteti śatam aṣṭottaraṃ budhaḥ ||
vrajaṃs tiṣṭhan svapan bhuñjan budhyan praskhalite kṣute |
vedanārtaḥ smaren nityam anantaṃ manasā girā ||
vratam etad vidhānena kuryāt saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ |
tato ‘tha bhojayed viprān śaktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
pūrṇe saṃvatsare śaktyā pūjayitvā janārdanam |
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādyair gītanṛtyaṃ tu kārayet ||
arcayitvā hariṃ bhaktyā kārayitvā tu jāgaram |
anantaphalam āpnoti gītavādyair udāhṛtam ||
ahiṃsakaḥ śucir dāntaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktam anantadvādaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yat kṛtvā mucyate jantur mahataḥ pañcapātakāt |
pañcapātakinaḥ pretān pitṝṃs tārayate tathā ||
niśākṛdāpyāyanaś ca pūrṇimādaivatā imāḥ |
jagannātho mahīdhārī devendro devakīsutaḥ ||
caturbhujo gadāpāṇiḥ surabhīdaḥ sulocanaḥ |
sarvagataś cakrapāṇiḥ śūraś cāpy asurāntakaḥ ||
śrīśaś ca dvādaśa imā devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
[1202] svāhākārānvitair etaiś caturthyantaiś ca nāmabhiḥ ||
śrāvaṇādau devatānāṃ pūjāṃ ca kurute vratī |
śravaṇād eva kurvīta dvādaśyāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ||
pūrṇimāyāṃ tu devebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ juhuyāt tataḥ |
amāvāsyāṃ devatānāṃ tilamudgaguḍodanam ||
pañcaratnāni devatānāṃ pañcapātakaśāntaye |
pañcamūrtiṃ svarṇamayīṃ pañcāmṛtasamanvitām ||
bhojayed brāhmaṇān rājan pañcadvādaśasamkhyayā |
etaccīrṇe vṛtravadhān muktavān pākaśāsanaḥ ||
ahalyā saṅgadoṣāc ca surāpānād bṛhaspatiḥ |
gurustrīgamanāt somaḥ suvarṇaharaṇād baliḥ ||
anyair api mahīpālair dilīpasagarādibhiḥ |
mahāpātakajair doṣair vimuktāś copapātakaiḥ ||
tasmāt tvam api kaunteya kuru vratam idaṃ śubham |
yad vāñchati mahārāja śākhatīṃ gatim ātmanaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ pañcamahāpāpanāśanadvādaśīvratam |
dvādaśa dvādaśīr yas tu samāpyopoṣaṇair naraḥ |
govatsaṃ kāñcanaṃ viprān arcayed bhaktitaḥ punaḥ ||
paraṃ padam avāpnoti viṣṇuvratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ viṣṇuvratam |
[1203]
varāha uvāca |
dvādaśyām upavāsaṃ tu ye vai kurvanti te narāḥ |
mām eva pratipadyante mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||
kṛtvā caivopavāsaṃ tu gṛhītvā ca jalāñjalim |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti ādityaṃ cāvalokayet ||
yāvanto bindavaḥ kecit patanty añjalito jalāt |
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
tathaiva tasyāṃ (?) dvādaśyāṃ kṛtvā karma yathāvidhi |
pāṇḍuraiś caiva puṣpais tu mṛṣṭair gandhaiś ca dhūpanaiḥ ||
ya evaṃ kārayed bhūmiṃ (?) tasyāpi śṛṇuyād gatim |
datvā śirasi puṣpāṇi imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
om iti kṛtvā mantraḥ |
suraśreṣṭha dharādhāra sumanasaḥ sumanā gṛhya prīyatāṃ ma
bhagavān ambikaḥ |
etena mantreṇa sumano dadyāt | gandhamantra ucyate |
oṃ namas tubhyaṃ svasti vidhyuktasugandhaṃ gṛhṇemaṃ (?) maṅgalavate
viṣṇave |
etena mantreṇa gandhān dadyāt |
aśrutvāpi ca śāstrāṇi yo mām evaṃ ca kārayet |
mama lokaṃ sa gacchec ca jāyate ca caturbhujaḥ ||
śyāmākaṃ ṣaṣṭikaṃ caiva sadbhojyāni guṇāṃs tathā |
[1204] guṇāṃś ca vyañjanāni |
śālīn yavānnaṃ ca tathā nīvārabhaktakaṃ tathā ||
etāni yas tu bhuñjīta mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ |
sa syāc ca śaṅkhacakrāṅko lāṅgalī muśalī gadī ||
upavāsaḥ sūryārghyo viṣṇupūjā śyāmākādyanyatamaṃ pāraṇaṃ ceti vratam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ viṣṇudvādaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
dvādaśyāṃ guhyakān arcya palalākṣatasaṃyutaiḥ |
hemaṃ viprāya vai dadyād upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||
etad vai guhyakaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ guhyakadvādaśīvratam |
dvādaśyāṃ devadeveśaṃ pūjayitvā jalādhipam |
puṇḍarīkam avāpnoti varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ puṇḍarīkayajñaprāptivratam |
sarvaṃ devarathaṃ śakraṃ pūjayitvā tathā naram |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śakravratam |
[1205] umovāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi āścaryaṃ paramaṃ vibho |
kathitavyaṃ prasādena yady asti mama sauhradam ||
deva yena virūpatvaṃ yadvratena praṇaśyati |
saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ caiva prāpyate kasya sevanāt ||
tan me kathaya deveśa paramābhīṣṭadāyakam |
īśvara uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ vai paraṃ guhyaṃ vrataṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham |
surūpā dvādaśī nāma mahāpātakanāśanī ||
rūpapradāyinī caiva tathā saubhāgyavardhanī |
kulavṛddhikarī caiva sarvasaukhyapradāyinī ||
tāṃ śṛṇuṣva prayatnena kathyamānāṃ mayānaghe |
purā vai dvāparasyānte viṣṇur (?) daityanisūdakaḥ ||
utpanno mṛtyulokeśa vasudevakule kila |
tenoḍhā rukmiṇī nāma bhīṣmasya ca sutā punaḥ ||
atyantarūpasubhagā pativrataparāyaṇā |
na hi tasyā vinā kṛṣṇaḥ (?) stokam udvahate sukham ||
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādavandanaṃ bhartṛtatparā |
kenāpi karmadoṣeṇa kupitāṃ kṛṣṇamātaram ||
na prasādayati kṣipraṃ pratimatvecchatī priyam |
tato devyāḥ samutpannaḥ kopaḥ sarvaguṇāpahaḥ ||
[1206] kṛṣṇaṃ provāca kupitā yadi te jananī svayam |
tatas tayāpi vai bāhyā kurūpā nirguṇādhikā ||
madvākyaṃ nānyathā kartuṃ nārhasi tvaṃ kulodvaha |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
apāpāṃ rukmiṇīṃ tyaktum utsahe ‘haṃ kathāṃ śubhām |
yaḥ parityajate bhāryām aviluptaśarīriṇīm ||
sa prāpnoti ca mandātmā daurbhāgyaṃ sāptapauruṣam |
virūpatvam avāpnoti na sukhaṃ vindate kvacit ||
vyādhir vā jāyate loke nindanīyaś ca dehinām |
ity ahaṃ nānumāno ‘pi kathaṃ kuryāt tathā vacaḥ ||
devaky uvāca |
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ dānaṃ tīrthādi yacchati |
mātā gurutarā vatsa kas tasyā vacanaṃ tyajajet ||
mama vākyasya karaṇāt kathaṃ pāpiṣṭhatā bhavet |
jananī pūjyate loke na bhāryā yadunandana ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
na ca tyajāmy ahaṃ mataḥ priyāṃ prāṇadhaneśvarīm |
iti tūṣṇīṃ parābhūtāṃ mātaraṃ prekṣya keśavaḥ ||
cintām avāpa paramāṃ kathaṃ saukhyaṃ bhaved iti |
etasminn eva kāle tu nārado munisattamaḥ ||
abhyājagāma sahasā viṣṇuṃ prekṣya ca vismitam |
pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā arghyaṃ tasmai niveditam ||
[1207] upaviṣṭe yathānyāyaṃ (?) paryapṛcchad anāmayam |
nārada uvāca |
kiṃ tvaṃ sakhedaparamaḥ kim udvegasya kāraṇam |
kiṃ na sudhyati te ‘bhīṣṭaṃ tyajodvegaṃ yadūttama ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
mātrā niyukto devarṣe pariṇetuṃ dvijottama |
kanyām udvaha yasyāpi kurūpāṃ kasyacit prabho ||
yathā mātur niyogo ‘tra kṛto bhavati satkṛtiḥ |
nārada uvāca |
śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi pūrvavṛttāntam ādarāt |
lakṣmīyuktaḥ purā nātha krīḍamāno ha nandane ||
tatrāyayau sa bhagavān durvāsā ṛṣisattamaḥ |
satkṛtaś ca yathānyāyam abhyutthānakapūrvakam ||
prekṣya bibhatsarūpaṃ taṃ devyā hāsaḥ kṛtas tadā |
sa ca kopena mahatā vaiśvānarasamaprabhaḥ ||
śaśāpa lakṣmīṃ duṣṭātmā muniḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ |
hasito ‘haṃ tvayā mugdhe ātmano rūpam īkṣitā ||
virūpā bhava durbuddhe kiṃ na jñāto hy ahaṃ tvayā |
ity uktā sā tayā devyā yathāvat samprasāditaḥ ||
prasanno jagade vākyaṃ me śāpo na vṛthā bhavet |
[1208] janmāntareṇa sāphalyaṃ bhaviṣyati kurūpatā ||
sā eva cāvatīrṇā hi gotrakasya gṛhe sutā |
satyabhāmā virūpāṅgī virūpadarśanaṃ tathā ||
karṇanāsātivikṛtāṃ saṃjātāṃ tatprabhāvataḥ |
pāṇipādau kaṭigrīvā sarvaṃ vairūpyalakṣaṇam ||
tapādasvo (?) mahāprājñaḥ sa te kanyāṃ pradāsyati |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
bhagavan virūpaṃ vadanaṃ kathāṃ drakṣyāmi nityaśaḥ |
kā nirvṛtiṃ gamiṣyāmi tāṃ vivāhya kurūpikām ||
nārada uvāca |
tasyā eva prasādena rukmiṇyā yadunandana |
uttamaṃ prāpya saurūpaṃ saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ sukham ||
mātā hi tāvan mānyā vai dharmakāmārtham icchatā |
evaṃ purā vyatītyaivaṃ (?) saṃbandho vihitaḥ purā ||
tvayā vākyaṃ tathā kāryaṃ gurūṇāṃ vacanaṃ mahat |
mātā gurutarā bhūme iti vedeṣu gīyate ||
īśvara uvāca |
evam uktvā māhādevīṃ nāradas tridivaṃ gataḥ |
kṛṣṇaś ca mātaraṃ prāha vaivāhyaṃ hi vidhīyatām ||
vivāhitāvasānena vedoktavidhinā tataḥ |
[1209] ānīyatāṃ tadā devi darśayāmāsa tāṃ vadhūm ||
paśya tvaṃ vacanād brūhi pariṇītā śucivratā |
nirvṛttiparamaṃ gaccha prasādaparamā bhava ||
ity uktvā vīkṣya tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ praṇipatya svamātaram |
jagāma devakāryāṇāṃ karaṇāya mahābalaḥ ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devamātā ca babhau duḥkhānvitā bhṛśam |
īdṛgvirūpaṃ vikṛtiṃ kathaṃ kartāsmi gopanam ||
cintā ca meti mahatīm atīvodvignamānasaḥ |
kasyāpi nācacakṣe ‘pi virūpaṃ taccharīrajam ||
atha kiṃ vihitaṃ kāle rukmiṇī tava cāgrataḥ |
namaskṛtya tataḥ śvaśrūṃ saṃpṛṣṭvā caraṇau tadā ||
uvāca prastutaṃ vākyaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ sukhāvaham |
prabhāvaṃ draṣṭum icchāmi bhavatīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām ||
darśayantu ca me śīghraṃ prasādaṃ suvidhīyatām |
devaky uvāca |
śvaśrūr hy ahaṃ te subhage mamāpi vacanaṃ kuru |
dīyatāṃ tvaritaṃ śrubhru surūpādvādaśīvratam ||
[1210] saṃprayacchati cetasyaṃ darśanaṃ te bhaviṣyati |
rukmiṇy uvāca |
kathaṃ yad dīyate dharmaṃ vrataṃ cāpi suduṣkaram |
kathaṃ tasyāṃ prayacchāmi phalaṃ devaiḥ sudurlabham ||
devy uvāca |
ardhaṃ pradīyatām asyai tadardham atha vā punaḥ |
pañcamaḥ saptamaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśo ‘tha vāpi vā ||
devy uvāca |
srūpādvādaśī puṇyatilārdham api notsahe |
kiṃ punaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśena sapatnyā duṣṭacetasaḥ ||
evam uktvā jagāmātha mandiraṃ sā śubhekṣaṇā |
punaḥ pṛcchati te sā tu praṇipātena vai ruṣā ||
devi pṛcchāmi cokto ‘yaṃ na karoti prabhur mama |
kathaṃ paśyāmi tāṃ tanvīṃ navoḍhāṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ambā drakṣyasi te subhrūṃ dhigrūpāṃ tāṃ sumadhyamām |
karṇanāsā ca vikṛtā virūpā vikṛtānanā ||
ahaṃ tu notsahe draṣṭum īdṛgrūpāṃ sucismite |
karma nṛṇāṃ phalaṃ te ca śubhāśubhasaṃśayam ||
[1211] evaṃ bahugate kāle devaiś caiva prabhāvataḥ |
devyāgāraṃ satyabhāmā śiṣyā datvā ca veśitā ||
prārthaye yatatāṃ tūrṇaṃ surūpādvādaśīvratam |
tilād api hi ṣaḍbhāgaṃ homād api hi niḥsṛtam ||
sā gatā tatsakāśaṃ tu vivāhadvāramāra (?) tu |
uvāca rukmiṇīṃ sā ca satyabhāmā śucivratā ||
ekām apy āhutiṃ devi dehi me bhīṣmanandini |
ardhāhutiṃ vā me dehi sadyasti (?) mama sauhṛdam ||
rukmiṇy uvāca |
ko ‘yaṃ matibhramas te vai surūpāṃ dvādaśīṃ prati |
tilāhutiṃ ca dāsyāmi udghāṭaya kapāṭakam ||
ity uktvā tvaritaṃ snātvā datvā hy ekāṃ tilāhutim |
tilaṃ caiva pradattaiyaṃ rūpeṇaivādhikā bhavat ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaparā papraccha dayitāṃ hareḥ |
kathyatāṃ mama kā hi tvaṃ kimarthamiha cāgatā ||
satyabhāmovāca |
tavāhaṃ bhaginī bhadre kṛṣṇavoḍhāsmi dharmataḥ |
satyabhāmeti me nāma namāmi caraṇau tava ||
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ vismayotpullalocanā |
novāca kiṃcic cārcaṅgī atyarthaṃ vismitābhavat ||
etasminn eva kāle ca vāg uvācāśarīriṇī |
tava dānaprabhāvena satyavrataparāyaṇe ||
[1212] surūpā dvādaśīpuṇyaṃ devānām api durlabham |
devy uvāca |
karmaṇā kena kartavyaṃ kumācāraṃ vadasva me |
niyamaṃ homadānaṃ ca prasādaḥ saṃvidhīyatām ||
īśvara uvāca |
pauṣamāsaṃ tu saṃprāpya puṣyarkṣe tu suśodhayet |
tasyāṃ rātrau saṃyatātmā dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ sanātanam ||
śvetā gaur ekavarṇā ca tasyā grāhyaṃ ca gomayam |
antarikṣāt prapatitaṃ śucir maunam avāsthitaḥ ||
tasyāḥ kṛtvā hutīnāṃ ca śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tilaiḥ |
pratīkṣaikādaśīṃ kṛṣṇām upavāsaparāyaṇaiḥ ||
bhāvyaṃ niyamasaṃyuktair viśeṣāt saṃyatātmabhiḥ |
snātvā nadyāṃ taḍāge vā viṣṇum evātha cintayet ||
sauvarṇaṃ ca hariṃ kṛtvā rūpyaṃ vāsaḥ svaśaktitaḥ |
tilapātroparisthe ca nyaset kumbhe sadravyake ||
tato viṣṇupūjā |
iti saṃpūjya vidhinā puṣpair dhūpaiḥ sacandanaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ tilamiśraṃ ca phalāni vividhāni ca ||
arghyamantropayuktāni tadagre stavanaṃ paṭhet |
namaḥ paramaśāntāya virūpākṣa namo ‘stu te ||
sarvakalmaṣanāśāya gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo ‘stu te |
arghyamantraḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ homayed gomayāhutīḥ |
[1213] tilān āhutisaṃyuktān mantraiḥ sahasraśīrṣakaiḥ ||
hṛdi dhyātvā ca deveśaṃ lakṣmīyuktaṃ sanātanam |
śaṅkhacakragadākheṭaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ janārdanam ||
homānte kārayec chrāddhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijasattama |
datvā ca bhojanaṃ tebhyaḥ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ||
dharmaśravaṇasaṃyuktā jāgrato tatra tāṃ niśām |
taṃ kumbhaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtiṃ viprāya pratipādayet ||
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ sarvaṃ tatra kṣamāpayet ||
īśvara uvāca |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute devi surūpādvādaśīvratam |
naro vā yadi vā nārī tac ca puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ||
daurbhāgyaṃ naśyate tasya api janmāntarārjitam |
api bhūmasya saṃparko jāyate kāraṇāntarāt ||
tasyāpi na bhaved duḥkhaṃ vairūpyaṃ tasya janmani |
bandhujanaviyogaṃ ca neṣṭaiḥ saha viyogataḥ ||
jāyate gotravṛddhiś ca kīrtimān jāyate bhuvi |
jātismaraṇam āpnoti padaṃ nirvāṇam āpnuyāt ||
vācyamānam idaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ |
puṇyam āpnoti satataṃ svargaloke mahīyate ||
iti umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde surūpādvādaśīvratam |
[1214] māndhātā uvāca |
ekādaśī mahābrahman mahāpuṇyaphalapradā |
ṛkṣayogais tu saṃyuktā kathayasva mama prabho ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī pāpanāśanī |
sarvapāpaharā caiṣā kartavyā phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe yadā ṛkṣaṃ punarvasuḥ |
sā nāmnā ca jayā khyātā tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
samupoṣya vratī pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
yadā śukle tu dvādaśyāṃ nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavet |
vijayā sā tathā proktā tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
tasyāṃ snātaḥ sarvatīrthe snāto bhavati mānavaḥ |
dānaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ tathā caiva prayojanam ||
homajapopavāsaiś ca sahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ labhet |
yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ rohiṇī ca prajāyate ||
jayantī nāma sā proktā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ |
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ||
tat kṣālayati govindas tasyām abhyarcya bhaktitaḥ |
yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ puṣyaṃ bhavati karhicit ||
tadā sātimahāpuṇyā kathitā pāpanāśanī |
[1215] yo dadāti ca yat puṇyaṃ nityaṃ saṃvatsare naraḥ ||
upavāsaṃ tu tasyāṃ ca yaḥ karoti mahat phalam |
tasyāṃ jagatpatir devaḥ sarvalokeśvaro hariḥ ||
pratyakṣatāṃ prayāty āśu tad anantaphalaṃ smṛtam |
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhundhumāreṇa gādhinā ||
tasyām ārādhito devo dattavān akhilāṃ bhuvam |
upavāsas tu tasyāṃ ca deva ārādhitaḥ sa ca ||
tasmai sa rājyam akhilaṃ saṃtuṣṭo bhuvi dattavān |
vācikān mānasāṃś caiva kāyikāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
imām ekām upoṣyaiva puṣyanakṣatrasaṃyutām ||
ekādaśīsahasreṇa phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyadevatārcanam ||
yad asyāṃ kriyate kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet |
puruṣais tu prayatnena kartavyā phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
phālgune ca viśeṣeṇa viśeṣaḥ kathito nṛpa |
āmārdakīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇulokaphalapradam ||
āmardakīm adho gatvā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
kṛtvā tu jāgaraṃ viṣṇor gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ||
māndhātā uvāca |
āmardakī kadā hy eṣā utpannā dvijasattama |
etat sarvaṃ samācakṣa paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||
[1216] kasmād iyaṃ pavitrā ca kasmāt pāpapraṇāśanī |
kasmāj jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ||
vasiṣtha uvāca |
kathayāmi mahābhāga gaccheyaṃ bhagavān kṣitau |
āmardakī mahāvṛkṣaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ||
ekārṇave purā jāte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame |
naṣṭe devāsuragaṇe pranaṣṭoragarākṣase ||
tatra devādhideveśaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ |
jajāpa paramaṃ brahma ātmanaḥ padam avyayam ||
tato ‘sya japato brahma mukhāc chaśisamaprabhaḥ |
ṣṭhīvanād bindusaṃpannaḥ sa bhūmau nipapāta ha ||
tasmād bindoḥ samutpannaḥ svayaṃ dhātrī nago mahān |
śākhāpraśākhābahulā phalabhārāvanāmitaḥ ||
sarveṣām caiva vṛkṣāṇām ādir eṣa prakīrtitaḥ |
etasminn eva kāle tu sasṛje bahudhāḥ prajāḥ ||
brāhmaṇān asṛjat tena samsṛṣṭāś ca imāḥ prajāḥ |
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ||
tāṃś ca dṛṣṭvā mahābhāga paraṃ vismayam āgatāḥ |
najātīya (?) imān vṛkṣān vintayāno ‘pi sarvataḥ ||
evaṃ cintayatas teṣāṃ vāg uvācāśarīriṇī |
saṃjātā vaiṣṇavī tatra ṛṣīṇāṃ pratibodhanī ||
asṛjad bhagavān deva ṛṣayas tu tathāmarāḥ |
ajitāś cātra yatrāste dhārā vai viṣnusaṃbhavā ||
[1217] āmardakī nago hy eṣa pravaro lokaviśrutaḥ |
viṣṇor niṣṭhīvanāj jātaḥ pravaro vaiṣṇavo (?) nagaḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sevyā āmardakī sadā |
sarvapāpaharā proktā vaiṣṇavī pāpanāśanī ||
asyā mūle sthito viṣṇur ūrdhve caiva pitāmahaḥ |
skandhe ca bhavagān rudraḥ saṃsthitas tripurāntakaḥ ||
śākhāsu saritaḥ sarvāḥ praśākhāsu ca devatāḥ |
parṇeṣu vasavo devāḥ puṣpeṣu marutas tathā ||
prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve phale caiva vyavasthitāḥ |
sarvadevamayī hy eṣā dhātrī ca kathitā mayā ||
tasmāt pūjyatamā hy eṣā viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaiḥ ||
ṛṣir uvāca |
ko bhavān na hi jānāmi akasmād vada he śubhaḥ |
devo vā yadi vā cānyaḥ kathayasva yathātatham ||
vāg uvāca |
yaḥ kartā sarvalokānāṃ bhuvanānāṃ caturdaśa |
anaṅgāṅgavapuḥ prekṣya so ‘haṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ||
tac chrutvā tasya devasya bhāṣitaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sthitāḥ |
viṣayotphullanayanāḥ paraṃ vismayam āgatāḥ ||
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ stotuṃ caiva pracakramuḥ |
oṃ namo bhūtātmane ca bhūtāya paramātmane ||
[1218] avyaktāya namo nityam anantāya namo namaḥ |
dāmodarāya śucaye yajñeśāya namo namaḥ ||
namo māyāpaṭacchannajagaddhātrīmahātmane |
acyutāya namo nityam anantāya namo namaḥ ||
evaṃ stutas tadā taiś ca tutoṣa bhagavān hariḥ |
pratyuvāca maharṣīṃs tān abhīṣṭaṃ kiṃ dadāmi vaḥ ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
yadi tuṣṭo hi bhagavān asmākaṃ hitakāmyayā |
vrataṃ kiṃcit samākhyāhi svargamokṣapradaṃ param ||
dhanadhānyapradaṃ puṇyam ātmanas tuṣṭidāyakam |
alpāyāsaṃ bahuphalaṃ vrtānām uttamaṃ vratam ||
kṛtena yena deveśa viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
viṣṇur uvāca |
phālgunāmalapakṣeṣu dvādaśī ṛṣisattamāḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ mahāpuṇyā sarvapātakanāśanī ||
viśeṣas tatra kathitaḥ śṛṇuṣva ṛṣisattamāḥ |
āmardakīṃ tu saṃprāpya jāgaraṃ yas tu kārayet ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet |
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā vratānām uttamaṃ vratam ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
vratasyāsya vidhiṃ brūhi paripūrṇaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
ke mantrāḥ ke namaskārā devatāḥ kāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
kathaṃ snānaṃ kathaṃ dānaṃ kathaṃ pūjāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
[1219] arghyapradānamantraś ca kathayasva yathātatham ||
viṣṇur uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ yo vidhiḥ samyag vratasyāsya dvijottama |
na kasyacin mayākhyāto vratasya vidhir uttamaḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ ca niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyād dantadhāvanam |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraṃ sthitvā caivāpare ‘hani ||
bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta |
iti kṛtvā ca niyamaṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam ||
nālāpet patitāṃś caurān tathā pāṣaṇḍino narān |
durvinītān bhinnamaryādān gurudāraprakarṣakān ||
aparāhṇe tathā snānaṃ vidhivat kārayed budhaḥ |
nadyāṃ taḍāge kūpe vā gṛhe vā niyamāśanaḥ ||
mṛttikālambhanaṃ pūrvaṃ tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte (?) vasundhare ||
mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yan mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
mṛttikāmantraḥ |
tvam āpo yoniḥ sarveṣāṃ devadānavarakṣasām |
śvetayonir bhujaṅgāsyaṃ rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||
snāto ‘haṃ sarvatīrtheṣu hrade praśravaṇeṣu sa |
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu atra snānaṃ tu me bhava ||
[1220] snānamantraḥ |
jāmadagniṃ tataś caiva (?) kārayitvā hiraṇmayam |
māṣakeṇa suvarṇasya tadardhenātha vā punaḥ ||
gṛham āgatya devānāṃ pūjāhomaṃ tu kārayet |
tataś cāmardakīṃ gacchet poṣayec ca samantataḥ ||
tasyādho jalakumbhaṃ ca sthāpayen mantrasaṃyutam |
pañcaratnasamopetaṃ divyagandhādivāsitam ||
chatropānahavastraiś ca sitacandanacarcitam |
sragmālālaṃkṛtagrīvaṃ sarvato dhūpadhūpitam ||
dīpamālākulaṃ kuryāt sarvatas tu manoharam |
tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ divyadānaiḥ prapūjitam ||
pātropari nyased devaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ mahābhujam |
viśokāya namaḥ pādau jānunī viśvarūpiṇe ||
ugrāya ca namaḥ kaṇṭhe āsyaṃ yajñamukhāya vai |
nanāma śokaviyuto vāsudevāya cakṣuṣī ||
lalāṭe vāmanāyeti rāmāyeti punar bhruvau |
namaḥ kūrmātmane tadvāt śira ity abhipūjayet ||
pūjayitvā tato devaṃ arghyaṃ caiva pradāpayet |
phalena caiva śubhreṇa bhiktiyuktena cetasā ||
namas te devadeveśa jāmadagne namo ‘stu te |
imaṃ devam imaṃ devaṃ śrīlakṣmyā sahito hariḥ ||
[1221] arghyamantraḥ |
tato jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād bhaktiyuktena cetasā |
nṛtyair gītaiś ca vāditrair dharmākhyānakathānakaiḥ ||
vaiṣṇavaiś ca tathā khyātaiḥ kṣapayec charvarīṃ tu tām |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryād āmardakyā namas tadā ||
śatam aṣṭādhikaṃ caiva aṣṭāviṃśatim eva ca |
tataḥ prabhātasamaye nītvā nīrājanaṃ hareḥ ||
brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu sarvaṃ tasmai nivedayet |
jāmadagnyaṃ ghaṭacchannaṃ vastrayugmam upānahau ||
jāmadagasvarūpī ca prīyatāṃ mama keśavaḥ |
tataś cāmardakīṃ spṛṣṭvā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena brāhmaṇān bhojayet tadā |
tataś ca svayam aśnīyāt kukkuṭena samanvitaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayāmy aham |
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yat phalam ||
sarvayajñādhikaṃ caiva labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
etad vaḥ sarvam ākhyātaṃ vratānām uttamam vratam ||
etad vrataṃ gatamalaṃ kathitaṃ mayā vai
pāpāpahaṃ śucimatir harivāsare te |
yo vai kariṣyati naraḥ śuciśuddhacittaḥ
sa prāpsyate haripadaṃ paramaṃ paratra ||
[1222] etāvad uktvā deveśas tatraivāntaradhīyata |
te cāpi ṛṣayaḥ sarve cakruḥ sarvam aśeṣataḥ ||
tathā tvam api rājendra kartum arhasi sattama |
vratam etad durādharṣaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
iti mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe āmadakīvratam |
iti śrīmahārjādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe dvādaśīvratāni |
